text_mt: Beginning with 'ka' and ending with 'sa', and arising from the creative emission, it is fivefold: / outside, inside, in the heart, in sound (nāda), and then in the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
bindurātmani mūrdhāntaṃ hṛdayādvyāpako hi saḥ /
ādimāntyavihīnāstu mantrāḥ syuḥ śaradabhravat // 223
meaning:
बिन्दुरात्मनि मूर्धान्तं हृदयाद्व्यापको हि सः /
आदिमान्त्यविहीनास्तु मन्त्राः स्युः शरदभ्रवत् // 223
text_mt: The point (bindu) is in the Self, pervading indeed from the heart up to the head; / but mantras devoid of the first ('a') and the last ('ha') are like autumn clouds [yielding no rain].

sanskrit_iast:
gurorlakṣaṇametāvadādimāntyaṃ ca vedayet /
pūjyaḥ so'hamiva jñānī bhairavo devatātmakaḥ // 224
meaning:
गुरोर्लक्षणमेतावदादिमान्त्यं च वेदयेत् /
पूज्यः सोऽहमिव ज्ञानी भैरवो देवतात्मकः // 224
text_mt: The definition of a guru is just this: he should make known the first and the last. / Such a knower is to be revered like myself, being Bhairava, having the nature of the deity.

sanskrit_iast:
ślokagāthādi yatkiṃcidādimāntyayutaṃ tataḥ /
tasmādvidaṃstathā sarvaṃ mantratvenaiva paśyati // 225
meaning:
श्लोकगाथादि यत्किंचिदादिमान्त्ययुतं ततः /
तस्माद्विदंस्तथा सर्वं मन्त्रत्वेनैव पश्यति // 225
text_mt: Whatever verse, meter, and the like exists is therefore endowed with the first and the last; / therefore, knowing thus, one sees everything only as mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
visargaśaktirviśvasya kāraṇaṃ ca nirūpitā /
aitareyākhyavedānte parameśena vistarāt // 226
meaning:
विसर्गशक्तिर्विश्वस्य कारणं च निरूपिता /
ऐतरेयाख्यवेदान्ते परमेशेन विस्तरात् // 226
text_mt: And the power of creative emission is explained as the cause of the universe / at length by the Supreme Lord in the Vedānta known as Aitareya.

sanskrit_iast:
yallohitaṃ tadagniryadvīryaṃ sūryenduvigraham /
a iti brahma paramaṃ tatsaṃghaṭṭodayātmakam // 227
meaning:
यल्लोहितं तदग्निर्यद्वीर्यं सूर्येन्दुविग्रहम् /
अ इति ब्रह्म परमं तत्संघट्टोदयात्मकम् // 227
text_mt: That which is red is fire; that which is virility has the form of sun and moon; / 'a' is the supreme Brahman, whose nature is the arising of their collision.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi ca paraṃ vīrya pañcabhūtakalātmakam /
bhogyatvenānnarūpaṃ ca śabdasparśarasātmakam // 228
meaning:
तस्यापि च परं वीर्य पञ्चभूतकलात्मकम् /
भोग्यत्वेनान्नरूपं च शब्दस्पर्शरसात्मकम् // 228
text_mt: And the supreme virility of that consists of the energies of the five elements; / as the object of enjoyment it has the form of food, consisting of sound, touch, and taste.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdo'pi madhuro yasmādvīryopacayakārakaḥ /
taddhi vīryaṃ paraṃ śuddhaṃ visisṛkṣātmakaṃ matam // 229
meaning:
शब्दोऽपि मधुरो यस्माद्वीर्योपचयकारकः /
तद्धि वीर्यं परं शुद्धं विसिसृक्षात्मकं मतम् // 229
text_mt: For even sweet sound causes the accumulation of virility; / that supreme, pure virility is indeed considered to consist of the desire to emit.

sanskrit_iast:
tadbalaṃ ca tadojaśca te prāṇāḥ sā ca kāntatā /
tasmādvīryātprajāstāśca vīrya karmasu kathyate // 230
meaning:
तद्बलं च तदोजश्च ते प्राणाः सा च कान्तता /
तस्माद्वीर्यात्प्रजास्ताश्च वीर्य कर्मसु कथ्यते // 230
text_mt: That is strength, that is vigor, those are the vital breaths, and that is loveliness; / from that virility offspring are born, and that virility is declared in sacrificial acts.

sanskrit_iast:
yajñādikeṣu tadvṛṣṭau sauṣadhīṣvatha tāḥ punaḥ /
vīrye tacca prajāsvevaṃ visarge viśvarūpatā // 231
meaning:
यज्ञादिकेषु तद्वृष्टौ सौषधीष्वथ ताः पुनः /
वीर्ये तच्च प्रजास्वेवं विसर्गे विश्वरूपता // 231
text_mt: In sacrifices and the like, that [becomes] rain; that in turn [becomes] plants; / they become virility, and that [becomes] offspring; thus, the form of the universe exists in creative emission.

sanskrit_iast:
śabdarāśiḥ sa evokto mātṛkā sāca kīrtitā /
kṣobhyakṣobhakatāveśānmālinīṃ tāṃ pracakṣate // 232
meaning:
शब्दराशिः स एवोक्तो मातृका साच कीर्तिता /
क्षोभ्यक्षोभकतावेशान्मालिनीं तां प्रचक्षते // 232
text_mt: That very [power] is called the totality of sounds (śabdarāśi), and she is celebrated as Mātṛkā; / because of the penetration of the agitated and the agitator, they call her Mālinī.

sanskrit_iast:
bījayonisamāpattivisargodayasundarā /
mālinī hi parā śaktirnirṇītā viśvarūpiṇī // 233
meaning:
बीजयोनिसमापत्तिविसर्गोदयसुन्दरा /
मालिनी हि परा शक्तिर्निर्णीता विश्वरूपिणी // 233
text_mt: Lovely with the emergence of the creative emission from the union of seed and womb, / Mālinī is indeed determined to be the supreme power whose form is the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā vastuta ekaiva parā kālasya karṣiṇī /
śaktimadbhedayogena yāmalatvaṃ prapadyate // 234
meaning:
एषा वस्तुत एकैव परा कालस्य कर्षिणी /
शक्तिमद्भेदयोगेन यामलत्वं प्रपद्यते // 234
text_mt: She is in reality singular, the supreme drawer of time; / through connection with the division of the possessor of power, she assumes dyadic nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pratyavamarśo yaḥ paripūrṇo'hamātmakaḥ /
sa svātmani svatantratvādvibhāgamavabhāsayet // 235
meaning:
तस्य प्रत्यवमर्शो यः परिपूर्णोऽहमात्मकः /
स स्वात्मनि स्वतन्त्रत्वाद्विभागमवभासयेत् // 235
text_mt: His reflective awareness, which is full and consists of 'I', / displays division within Himself through His absolute autonomy.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāgābhāsane cāsya tridhā vapurudāhṛtam /
paśyantī madhyamā sthūlā vaikharītyabhiśabditam // 236
meaning:
विभागाभासने चास्य त्रिधा वपुरुदाहृतम् /
पश्यन्ती मध्यमा स्थूला वैखरीत्यभिशब्दितम् // 236
text_mt: And in the manifestation of division, His body is declared to be threefold: / designated as the visionary (paśyantī), the intermediate (madhyamā), and the gross (vaikharī).

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāmapi tridhā rūpaṃ sthūlasūkṣmaparatvataḥ /
tatra yā svarasandarbhasubhagā nādarūpiṇī // 237
meaning:
तासामपि त्रिधा रूपं स्थूलसूक्ष्मपरत्वतः /
तत्र या स्वरसन्दर्भसुभगा नादरूपिणी // 237
text_mt: Their form too is threefold, through gross, subtle, and supreme states; / among them, that which is charming with the arrangement of musical notes, having the form of sound (nāda),

sanskrit_iast:
sā sthūlā khalu paśyantī varṇādyapravibhāgataḥ /
avibhāgaikarūpatvaṃ mādhuryaṃ śaktirucyate // 238
meaning:
सा स्थूला खलु पश्यन्ती वर्णाद्यप्रविभागतः /
अविभागैकरूपत्वं माधुर्यं शक्तिरुच्यते // 238
text_mt: is indeed gross paśyantī, because of the absence of differentiation of phonemes and the like; / sweet charm (mādhurya) is the sole condition of non-differentiation, and is called power.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānavāyvādigharṣotthā sphuṭataiva ca pāruṣī /
tadasyāṃ nādarūpāyāṃ saṃvitsavidhavṛttitaḥ // 239
meaning:
स्थानवाय्वादिघर्षोत्था स्फुटतैव च पारुषी /
तदस्यां नादरूपायां संवित्सविधवृत्तितः // 239
text_mt: Distinctness arising from the friction of places of articulation, breath, and the like is harshness (pāruṣī). / Therefore, in this [paśyantī] which has the form of sound, because consciousness functions in close proximity,

sanskrit_iast:
sājātyāntarma[ttama] yībhūtirjhagityevopalabhyate /
yeṣāṃ na tanmayībhūtiste dehādinimajjanam // 240
meaning:
साजात्यान्तर्म[त्तम] यीभूतिर्झगित्येवोपलभ्यते /
येषां न तन्मयीभूतिस्ते देहादिनिमज्जनम् // 240
text_mt: the absorption consisting of identity of genus within is perceived immediately. / Those who do not experience that absorption, who are ignorant of the immersion of body and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
avidanto magnasaṃvinmānāstvahṛdayā iti /
yattucarmāvanaddhādi kiṃcittatraiṣa yo dhvaniḥ // 241
meaning:
अविदन्तो मग्नसंविन्मानास्त्वहृदया इति /
यत्तुचर्मावनद्धादि किंचित्तत्रैष यो ध्वनिः // 241
text_mt: whose measure of consciousness is submerged, are without heart. / But whatever sound exists there on a drum or the like covered with hide,

sanskrit_iast:
sa sphuṭāsphuṭarūpatvānmadhyamā sthūlarūpiṇī /
madhyāyāścāvibhāgāṃśasadbhāva iti raktatā // 242
meaning:
स स्फुटास्फुटरूपत्वान्मध्यमा स्थूलरूपिणी /
मध्यायाश्चाविभागांशसद्भाव इति रक्तता // 242
text_mt: that is intermediate (madhyamā) having a gross form, because of its indistinct-distinct nature; / and because an aspect of non-differentiation exists in madhyamā, there is delight.

sanskrit_iast:
avibhāgasvaramayī yatra syāttatsurañjakam /
avibhāgo hi nirvṛtyai dṛśyatāṃ tālapāṭhataḥ // 243
meaning:
अविभागस्वरमयी यत्र स्यात्तत्सुरञ्जकम् /
अविभागो हि निर्वृत्यै दृश्यतां तालपाठतः // 243
text_mt: Where it consists of non-differentiated musical sound, that brings delight; / for non-differentiation leads to bliss: let it be seen from the recitation of rhythm.

sanskrit_iast:
kilāvyaktadhvanau tasminvādane parituṣyati /
yā tu sphuṭānāṃ varṇānāmutpattau kāraṇaṃ bhavet // 244
meaning:
किलाव्यक्तध्वनौ तस्मिन्वादने परितुष्यति /
या तु स्फुटानां वर्णानामुत्पत्तौ कारणं भवेत् // 244
text_mt: Indeed, one is completely satisfied in that playing of instruments with indistinct sound. / That, however, which is the cause in the arising of distinct phonemes,

sanskrit_iast:
sā sthūlā vaikharī yasyāḥ kāryaṃ vākyādi bhūyasā /
asminsthūlatraye yattadanusandhānamādivat // 245
meaning:
सा स्थूला वैखरी यस्याः कार्यं वाक्यादि भूयसा /
अस्मिन्स्थूलत्रये यत्तदनुसन्धानमादिवत् // 245
text_mt: is gross vaikharī, whose effect is predominantly sentences and the like. / In this triad of gross forms, that synthesis which is, as before,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthakpṛthaktattritayaṃ sūkṣmamityabhiśabdyate /
ṣaḍjaṃ karomi madhuraṃ vādayāmi bruve vacaḥ // 246
meaning:
पृथक्पृथक्तत्त्रितयं सूक्ष्ममित्यभिशब्द्यते /
षड्जं करोमि मधुरं वादयामि ब्रुवे वचः // 246
text_mt: distinctly threefold, is called subtle: / 'I produce the note ṣaḍja,' 'I play sweetly,' 'I speak words'—

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagevānusandhānatrayaṃ saṃvedyate kila /
etasyāpi trayasyādyaṃ yadrupamanupādhimat // 247
meaning:
पृथगेवानुसन्धानत्रयं संवेद्यते किल /
एतस्यापि त्रयस्याद्यं यद्रुपमनुपाधिमत् // 247
text_mt: the triad of syntheses is indeed experienced distinctly. / That primary form of this triad which is free of limiting conditions

sanskrit_iast:
tatparaṃ tritayaṃ tatra śivaḥ paracidātmakaḥ /
vibhāgābhāsanāyāṃ ca mukhyāstisro'tra śaktayaḥ // 248
meaning:
तत्परं त्रितयं तत्र शिवः परचिदात्मकः /
विभागाभासनायां च मुख्यास्तिस्रोऽत्र शक्तयः // 248
text_mt: is the supreme triad; therein, Śiva consists of supreme consciousness. / And in the manifestation of division, three powers are primary here:

sanskrit_iast:
anuttarā parecchā ca parāparatayā sthitā /
unmeṣaśaktirjñānākhyā tvapareti nigadyate // 249
meaning:
अनुत्तरा परेच्छा च परापरतया स्थिता /
उन्मेषशक्तिर्ज्ञानाख्या त्वपरेति निगद्यते // 249
text_mt: the unexcelled (anuttarā) is supreme; will (icchā) stands as both supreme and non-supreme; / the power of unfoldment (unmeṣaśakti), named knowledge, is declared to be non-supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣobharūpātpunastāsāmuktāḥ ṣaṭ saṃvido'malāḥ /
āsāmeva samāveśātkriyāśaktitayoditāt // 250
meaning:
क्षोभरूपात्पुनस्तासामुक्ताः षट् संविदोऽमलाः /
आसामेव समावेशात्क्रियाशक्तितयोदितात् // 250
text_mt:
From the state of agitation among them, again, six immaculate states of consciousness are declared.
Through the very immersion in these, arisen in the form of the power of action,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvido dvādaśa proktā yāsu sarvaṃ samāpyate /
etāvaddevadevasya mukhyaṃ tacchakticakrakam // 251
meaning:
संविदो द्वादश प्रोक्ता यासु सर्वं समाप्यते /
एतावद्देवदेवस्य मुख्यं तच्छक्तिचक्रकम् // 251
text_mt:
twelve states of consciousness are proclaimed, in which everything is culminated.
Such is the primary circle of powers of the God of gods.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvatā devadevaḥ pūrṇaśaktiḥ sa bhairavaḥ /
parāmarśātmakatvena visargākṣepayogataḥ // 252
meaning:
एतावता देवदेवः पूर्णशक्तिः स भैरवः /
परामर्शात्मकत्वेन विसर्गाक्षेपयोगतः // 252
text_mt:
By virtue of this much, the God of gods, that Bhairava, possesses full power,
possessing the nature of reflective awareness, through connection with the projection of creative emission.

sanskrit_iast:
iyattākalanājjñānāttāḥ proktāḥ kālikāḥ kvacit /
śrīsāraśāstre cāpyuktaṃ madhya ekākṣarāṃ parām // 253
meaning:
इयत्ताकलनाज्ज्ञानात्ताः प्रोक्ताः कालिकाः क्वचित् /
श्रीसारशास्त्रे चाप्युक्तं मध्य एकाक्षरां पराम् // 253
text_mt:
Because of reckoning finite measures, [and] through knowledge, they are elsewhere called the Kālikās.
And in the venerable Sāraśāstra it is also said: in the center, the supreme [goddess] of one syllable,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedbhairavātmākhyāṃ yoginīdvādaśāvṛtām /
tābhya eva catuḥṣaṣṭiparyantaṃ śakticakrakam // 254
meaning:
पूजयेद्भैरवात्माख्यां योगिनीद्वादशावृताम् /
ताभ्य एव चतुःषष्टिपर्यन्तं शक्तिचक्रकम् // 254
text_mt:
having the nature of Bhairava, surrounded by twelve yoginīs, should be worshipped.
Beginning from these alone, the circle of powers extending up to sixty-four,

sanskrit_iast:
ekārataḥ samārabhya sahasrāraṃ pravartate /
tāsāṃ ca kṛtyabhedena nāmāni bahudhāgame // 255
meaning:
एकारतः समारभ्य सहस्रारं प्रवर्तते /
तासां च कृत्यभेदेन नामानि बहुधागमे // 255
text_mt:
commencing with one spoke, proceeds up to a thousand spokes.
And in the scripture their names are manifold according to the division of their functions,

sanskrit_iast:
upāsāśca dvayādvaitavyāmiśrākārayogataḥ /
śrīmattraiśirame tacca kathitaṃ vistarādbahu // 256
meaning:
उपासाश्च द्वयाद्वैतव्यामिश्राकारयोगतः /
श्रीमत्त्रैशिरमे तच्च कथितं विस्तराद्बहु // 256
text_mt:
and their modes of worship, according to their association with dual, non-dual, and mixed forms.
And in the venerable Traiśirasa that has been explained at great length.

sanskrit_iast:
iha no likhitaṃ vyāsabhayāccānupayogataḥ /
tā eva nirmalāḥ śuddhā aghorāḥ parikīrtitāḥ // 257
meaning:
इह नो लिखितं व्यासभयाच्चानुपयोगतः /
ता एव निर्मलाः शुद्धा अघोराः परिकीर्तिताः // 257
text_mt:
It has not been written here for fear of prolixity and due to its lack of utility [here].
Those very [powers], stainless and pure, are renowned as the Aghorā [powers].

sanskrit_iast:
ghoraghoratarāṇāṃ tu sotṛtvācca tadātmikāḥ /
sṛṣṭau sthitau ca saṃhāre tadupādhitrayātyaye // 258
meaning:
घोरघोरतराणां तु सोतृत्वाच्च तदात्मिकाः /
सृष्टौ स्थितौ च संहारे तदुपाधित्रयात्यये // 258
text_mt:
Yet, because they also engender the Ghorā and Ghoratarā [powers], they are identical with them.
In creation, maintenance, and dissolution, and in the transcendence of that triad of limiting conditions,

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāmeva sthitaṃ rūpaṃ bahudhā pravibhajyate /
upādhyatītaṃ yadrūpaṃ taddvidhā guravo jaguḥ // 259
meaning:
तासामेव स्थितं रूपं बहुधा प्रविभज्यते /
उपाध्यतीतं यद्रूपं तद्द्विधा गुरवो जगुः // 259
text_mt:
the enduring form of those very [powers] is divided in many ways.
The teachers have proclaimed that the form transcending limiting conditions is twofold:

sanskrit_iast:
anullāsādupādhīnāṃ yadvā praśamayogataḥ /
praśamaśca dvidhā śāntyā haṭhapākakrameṇa tu // 260
meaning:
अनुल्लासादुपाधीनां यद्वा प्रशमयोगतः /
प्रशमश्च द्विधा शान्त्या हठपाकक्रमेण तु // 260
text_mt:
either from the non-manifestation of limiting conditions, or through their pacification.
And pacification is twofold: by gentle quieting, but [also] through the process of sudden digestion.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ grāsarasākhyena satataṃ jvalanātmanā /
haṭhapākapraśamanaṃ yattṛtīyaṃ tadeva ca /
upadeśāya yujyeta bhedendhanavidāhakam // 261
meaning:
अलं ग्रासरसाख्येन सततं ज्वलनात्मना /
हठपाकप्रशमनं यत्तृतीयं तदेव च /
उपदेशाय युज्येत भेदेन्धनविदाहकम् // 261
text_mt:
Enough with that perpetually blazing nature known as the taste of devouring!
That pacification through sudden digestion which is the third,
consuming the fuel of duality, is indeed fitting for instruction.

sanskrit_iast:
nijabodhajaṭharahutabhuji bhāvāḥ sarve samarpitā haṭhataḥ /
vijahati bhedavibhāgaṃ nijaśaktyā taṃ samindhānāḥ // 262
meaning:
निजबोधजठरहुतभुजि भावाः सर्वे समर्पिता हठतः /
विजहति भेदविभागं निजशक्त्या तं समिन्धानाः // 262
text_mt:
Forcibly offered into the fire of the belly of one's own consciousness,
all entities abandon the partition of duality, kindling it by their own power.

sanskrit_iast:
haṭhapākena bhāvānāṃ rūpe bhinne vilāpite /
aśnantyamṛtasādbhūtaṃ viśvaṃ saṃvittidevatāḥ // 263
meaning:
हठपाकेन भावानां रूपे भिन्ने विलापिते /
अश्नन्त्यमृतसाद्भूतं विश्वं संवित्तिदेवताः // 263
text_mt:
When the differentiated form of entities has been dissolved through sudden digestion,
the deities of consciousness consume the universe converted into the nectar [of oneness].

sanskrit_iast:
tāstṛptāḥ svātmanaḥ pūrṇa hṛdayaikāntaśāyinam /
cidvyomabhairavaṃ devamabhedenādhiśerate // 264
meaning:
तास्तृप्ताः स्वात्मनः पूर्ण हृदयैकान्तशायिनम् /
चिद्व्योमभैरवं देवमभेदेनाधिशेरते // 264
text_mt:
Having become satiated, they recline non-differently in the god Bhairava,
the ether of consciousness, who rests in the solitary retreat of their own full heart.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛtyakriyāveśānnāmopāsābahutvataḥ /
āsāṃ bahuvidhaṃ rūpamabhede'pyavabhāsate // 265
meaning:
एवं कृत्यक्रियावेशान्नामोपासाबहुत्वतः /
आसां बहुविधं रूपमभेदेऽप्यवभासते // 265
text_mt:
Thus, through immersion in functions and actions, and through the multiplicity of names and forms of worship,
their manifold form shines forth, even while non-difference persists.

sanskrit_iast:
āsāmeva ca devīnāmāvāpodvāpayogataḥ /
ekadvitricatuṣpañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭanavottaraiḥ // 266
meaning:
आसामेव च देवीनामावापोद्वापयोगतः /
एकद्वित्रिचतुष्पञ्चषट्सप्ताष्टनवोत्तरैः // 266
text_mt:
And through the permutation of insertion and omission of these very goddesses,
progressing by ones, twos, threes, fours, fives, sixes, sevens, eights, and nines,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrārkānyakalāsenāprabhṛtirbhedavistaraḥ /
alamanyena bahunā prakṛte'tha niyujyate // 267
meaning:
रुद्रार्कान्यकलासेनाप्रभृतिर्भेदविस्तरः /
अलमन्येन बहुना प्रकृतेऽथ नियुज्यते // 267
text_mt:
there is an extensive differentiation—the Rudras, the suns, other energies, armies, and so forth.
Enough with much else; now let what is relevant be undertaken.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvidātmani viśvo'yaṃ bhāvavargaḥ prapañcavān /
pratibimbatayā bhāti yasya viśveśvaro hi saḥ // 268
meaning:
संविदात्मनि विश्वोऽयं भाववर्गः प्रपञ्चवान् /
प्रतिबिम्बतया भाति यस्य विश्वेश्वरो हि सः // 268
text_mt:
This entire manifold collection of entities shines as a reflection
within the self that is consciousness—he in whom it so shines is indeed the Lord of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
evamātmani yasyedṛgavikalpaḥ sadodayaḥ /
parāmarśaḥ sa evāsau śāṃbhavopāyamudritaḥ // 269
meaning:
एवमात्मनि यस्येदृगविकल्पः सदोदयः /
परामर्शः स एवासौ शांभवोपायमुद्रितः // 269
text_mt:
He in whose self such a non-conceptual, ever-arisen
reflective awareness exists, is sealed by the Śāmbhava means.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāhantāparāmarśo yo'syāyaṃ pravivecitaḥ /
mantramudrākriyopāsāstadanyā nātra kāścana // 270
meaning:
पूर्णाहन्तापरामर्शो योऽस्यायं प्रविवेचितः /
मन्त्रमुद्राक्रियोपासास्तदन्या नात्र काश्चन // 270
text_mt:
This reflective awareness of full I-consciousness which has been examined here—
no other mantras, mudrās, actions, or forms of worship are required in this regard.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyobhūyaḥ samāveśaṃ nirvikalpamimaṃ śritaḥ /
abhyeti bhairavībhāvaṃ jīvanmuktyaparābhidham // 271
meaning:
भूयोभूयः समावेशं निर्विकल्पमिमं श्रितः /
अभ्येति भैरवीभावं जीवन्मुक्त्यपराभिधम् // 271
text_mt:
Resorting again and again to this non-conceptual immersion,
he attains the state of Bhairava, which is known by another name as liberation in life.

sanskrit_iast:
ita eva prabhṛtyeṣā jīvanmuktirvicāryate /
yatra sūtraṇayāpīyamupāyopeyakalpanā // 272
meaning:
इत एव प्रभृत्येषा जीवन्मुक्तिर्विचार्यते /
यत्र सूत्रणयापीयमुपायोपेयकल्पना // 272
text_mt:
Beginning only from this point is liberation in life investigated,
where even this scheme of means and goal is formulated.

sanskrit_iast:
prāktane tvāhnike kācidbhedasya kalanāpi no /
tenānupāye tasminko mucyate vā kathaṃ kutaḥ // 273
meaning:
प्राक्तने त्वाह्निके काचिद्भेदस्य कलनापि नो /
तेनानुपाये तस्मिन्को मुच्यते वा कथं कुतः // 273
text_mt:
In the preceding daily lesson, however, there was not even a notion of duality;
therefore, in that absence of means, who is liberated, or how, or from what?

sanskrit_iast:
nirvikalpe parāmarśe śāmbhavopāyanāmani /
pañcāśadbhedatāṃ pūrvasūtritāṃ yojayedbudhaḥ // 274
meaning:
निर्विकल्पे परामर्शे शाम्भवोपायनामनि /
पञ्चाशद्भेदतां पूर्वसूत्रितां योजयेद्बुधः // 274
text_mt:
In this non-conceptual reflective awareness named the Śāmbhava means,
the wise person should apply the fiftyfold division formulated earlier.

sanskrit_iast:
dharāmevāvikalpena svātmani pratibimbitām /
paśyanbhairavatāṃ yāti jalādiṣvapyayaṃ vidhiḥ // 275
meaning:
धरामेवाविकल्पेन स्वात्मनि प्रतिबिम्बिताम् /
पश्यन्भैरवतां याति जलादिष्वप्ययं विधिः // 275
text_mt:
Seeing even the earth non-conceptually reflected in one's own self,
one attains the state of Bhairava; this same rule applies also to water and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadante paraṃ tattvaṃ samastāvaraṇordhvagam /
vyāpi svatantraṃ sarvajñaṃ yacchivaṃ parikalpitam // 276
meaning:
यावदन्ते परं तत्त्वं समस्तावरणोर्ध्वगम् /
व्यापि स्वतन्त्रं सर्वज्ञं यच्छिवं परिकल्पितम् // 276
text_mt:
until, in the end, the supreme principle transcending all coverings,
pervasive, autonomous, omniscient, which is conceived as Śiva—

sanskrit_iast:
tadapyakalpitodārasaṃviddarpaṇabimbitam /
paśyanvikalpavikalo bhairavībhavati svayam // 277
meaning:
तदप्यकल्पितोदारसंविद्दर्पणबिम्बितम् /
पश्यन्विकल्पविकलो भैरवीभवति स्वयम् // 277
text_mt:
seeing even that reflected in the mirror of unconstructed, noble consciousness,
free from conceptual constructs, one becomes Bhairava oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā raktaṃ puraḥ paśyannirvikalpakasaṃvidā /
tattaddvāraniraṃśaikaghaṭasaṃvittisusthitaḥ // 278
meaning:
यथा रक्तं पुरः पश्यन्निर्विकल्पकसंविदा /
तत्तद्द्वारनिरंशैकघटसंवित्तिसुस्थितः // 278
text_mt:
Just as someone, seeing a red object in front of him with non-conceptual consciousness,
stands firmly in the undivided, unitary awareness of the pot through those various senses,

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaddharādikaikaikasaṃghātasamudāyataḥ /
parāmṛśansvamātmānaṃ pūrṇa evāvabhāsate // 279
meaning:
तद्वद्धरादिकैकैकसंघातसमुदायतः /
परामृशन्स्वमात्मानं पूर्ण एवावभासते // 279
text_mt:
so, reflecting on his own self through the aggregate of earth and the rest, individually and collectively,
he shines forth as completely full.

sanskrit_iast:
matta evoditamidaṃ mayyeva pratibimbitam /
madabhinnamidaṃ ceti tridhopāyaḥ sa śāmbhavaḥ // 280
meaning:
मत्त एवोदितमिदं मय्येव प्रतिबिम्बितम् /
मदभिन्नमिदं चेति त्रिधोपायः स शाम्भवः // 280
text_mt:
"This has arisen from me alone; it is reflected in me alone;
and this is non-different from me": such is the threefold Śāmbhava means.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭeḥ sthiteḥ saṃhṛteśca tadetatsūtraṇaṃ kṛtam /
yatra sthitaṃ yataśceti tadāha spandaśāsane // 281
meaning:
सृष्टेः स्थितेः संहृतेश्च तदेतत्सूत्रणं कृतम् /
यत्र स्थितं यतश्चेति तदाह स्पन्दशासने // 281
text_mt:
This formulation of creation, maintenance, and dissolution has been made [by him].
He declared that in the Spanda teaching: "wherein it rests and whence [it arises]".

sanskrit_iast:
etāvataiva hyaiśvarya saṃvidaḥ khyāpitaṃ param /
viśvātmakatvaṃ cetyanyallakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ nu kathyatām // 282
meaning:
एतावतैव ह्यैश्वर्य संविदः ख्यापितं परम् /
विश्वात्मकत्वं चेत्यन्यल्लक्षणं किं नु कथ्यताम् // 282
text_mt:
For by this much alone the supreme sovereignty of consciousness
and its identity with the universe have been proclaimed; what other characteristic could possibly be stated?

sanskrit_iast:
svātmanyeva cidākāśe viśvamasmyavabhāsayan /
sraṣṭā viśvātmaka iti prathayā bhairavātmatā // 283
meaning:
स्वात्मन्येव चिदाकाशे विश्वमस्म्यवभासयन् /
स्रष्टा विश्वात्मक इति प्रथया भैरवात्मता // 283
text_mt:
"I am illuminating the universe in the sky of consciousness, within myself alone;
I am the creator, identical with the universe": through this expansion, one is Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍadhvajātaṃ nikhilaṃ mayyeva pratibimbitam /
sthitikartāhamasmīti sphuṭeyaṃ viśvarūpatā // 284
meaning:
षडध्वजातं निखिलं मय्येव प्रतिबिम्बितम् /
स्थितिकर्ताहमस्मीति स्फुटेयं विश्वरूपता // 284
text_mt:
"The entire aggregate of the six paths is reflected in me alone;
I am the agent of maintenance": this universal form becomes manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
sadoditamahābodhajvālājaṭilatātmani /
viśvaṃ dravati mayyetaditi paśyanpraśāmyati // 285
meaning:
सदोदितमहाबोधज्वालाजटिलतात्मनि /
विश्वं द्रवति मय्येतदिति पश्यन्प्रशाम्यति // 285
text_mt:
"In my self, tangled with the flames of ever-arisen great awakening,
this universe dissolves in me": seeing thus, one becomes pacified.

sanskrit_iast:
anantacitrasadgarbhasaṃsārasvapnasadmanaḥ /
ploṣakaḥ śiva evāhamityullāsī hutāśanaḥ // 286
meaning:
अनन्तचित्रसद्गर्भसंसारस्वप्नसद्मनः /
प्लोषकः शिव एवाहमित्युल्लासी हुताशनः // 286
text_mt:
"I am Śiva alone, the burner of the dream-abode of saṃsāra,
which contains within itself endless varieties": such is the flashing fire.

sanskrit_iast:
jagatsarvaṃ mattaḥ prabhavati vibhedena bahudhā tathāpyetadrūḍhaṃ mayi vigalite tvatra na paraḥ /
taditthaṃ yaḥ sṛṣṭisthitivilayabhekīkṛtivaśādanaṃśaṃ paśyetsa sphurati hi turīyaṃ padabhitaḥ // 287
meaning:
जगत्सर्वं मत्तः प्रभवति विभेदेन बहुधा तथाप्येतद्रूढं मयि विगलिते त्वत्र न परः /
तदित्थं यः सृष्टिस्थितिविलयभेकीकृतिवशादनंशं पश्येत्स स्फुरति हि तुरीयं पदभितः // 287
text_mt: The entire universe originates from me in various divisions; nevertheless, it is grounded in me; when this is dissolved, there is nothing other [than me]. / Thus, he who, by uniting creation, maintenance, and dissolution, sees [them] as partless, flashes forth indeed all around the fourth state.

sanskrit_iast:
tadasminparamopāye śāmbhavādvaitaśālini /
ke'pyeva yānti viśvāsaṃ pasmeśena bhāvitāḥ // 288
meaning:
तदस्मिन्परमोपाये शाम्भवाद्वैतशालिनि /
केऽप्येव यान्ति विश्वासं पस्मेशेन भाविताः // 288
text_mt:
Therefore, in this supreme means characterized by the Śāmbhava non-duality,
only a few attain faith, being graced by the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ vrataṃ dehaśuddhirdhāraṇā mantrayojanā /
adhvaklṛptiryāgavidhirhomajapyasamādhayaḥ // 289
meaning:
स्नानं व्रतं देहशुद्धिर्धारणा मन्त्रयोजना /
अध्वक्लृप्तिर्यागविधिर्होमजप्यसमाधयः // 289
text_mt:
Bathing, vows, bodily purification, mental concentration, application of mantras,
arrangement of the path, sacrificial rites, fire offerings, recitations, and meditative absorptions—

sanskrit_iast:
ityādikalpanā kāpi nātra bhedena yujyate /
parānugrahakāritvamatrasthasya sphuṭaṃ sthitam // 290
meaning:
इत्यादिकल्पना कापि नात्र भेदेन युज्यते /
परानुग्रहकारित्वमत्रस्थस्य स्फुटं स्थितम् // 290
text_mt:
any such mental construct is not applicable here through differentiation;
that the one established here bestows supreme grace is clearly established.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tādṛganugrāhyo daiśikasyopasarpati /
athāsau tādṛśo na syādbhavabhaktyā ca bhāvitaḥ // 291
meaning:
यदि तादृगनुग्राह्यो दैशिकस्योपसर्पति /
अथासौ तादृशो न स्याद्भवभक्त्या च भावितः // 291
text_mt:
If such a candidate for grace approaches the spiritual guide—
yet if he should not be of that kind, though imbued with devotion to Bhava,

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ cārādhayate bhāvitādṛśānugraheritaḥ /
tadā vicitraṃ dīkṣādividhiṃ śikṣeta koviṃdaḥ // 292
meaning:
तं चाराधयते भावितादृशानुग्रहेरितः /
तदा विचित्रं दीक्षादिविधिं शिक्षेत कोविंदः // 292
text_mt:
and worships him, prompted by grace of that kind that has arisen [in him],
then the wise [master] should teach the manifold rite of initiation and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvinyo'pi hyupāsāstā straivāyānti niṣṭhitim /
etanmayatvaṃ paramaṃ prāpyaṃ nirvarṇyateśivam // 293
meaning:
भाविन्योऽपि ह्युपासास्ता स्त्रैवायान्ति निष्ठितिम् /
एतन्मयत्वं परमं प्राप्यं निर्वर्ण्यतेशिवम् // 293
text_mt:
For even future forms of worship find their completion in this very [state];
this supreme state of identity with this [reality] to be attained is described as Śiva.

sanskrit_iast: iti kathitamidaṃ suvistaraṃ paramaṃ śāmbhavamātmavedanam // 294
meaning: इति कथितमिदं सुविस्तरं परमं शाम्भवमात्मवेदनम् // 294
text_mt: Thus has this supreme Śāmbhava self-knowledge been expounded in full detail.

sanskrit_iast: atha śāktamupāyamaṇḍalaṃ kathayāmaḥ paramātmasaṃvide // 1
meaning: अथ शाक्तमुपायमण्डलं कथयामः परमात्मसंविदे // 1
text_mt: Now we explain the realm of the Śākta means for the realization of the supreme Self.
title: Śāktopāyaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
anantarāhnikokte'sminsvabhāve pārameśvare /
pravivikṣurvikalpasya kuryātsaṃskāramañjasā // 2
meaning:
अनन्तराह्निकोक्तेऽस्मिन्स्वभावे पारमेश्वरे /
प्रविविक्षुर्विकल्पस्य कुर्यात्संस्कारमञ्जसा // 2
text_mt: Wishing to enter into this essential nature belonging to the Supreme Lord, which was explained in the immediately preceding daily lesson, / one should straightway effect the refinement of conceptual construct.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpaḥ saṃskṛtaḥ sūte vikalpaṃ svātmasaṃskṛtam /
svatulyaṃ so'pi so'pyanyaṃ so'pyanyaṃ sadṛśātmakam // 3
meaning:
विकल्पः संस्कृतः सूते विकल्पं स्वात्मसंस्कृतम् /
स्वतुल्यं सोऽपि सोऽप्यन्यं सोऽप्यन्यं सदृशात्मकम् // 3
text_mt: Refined conceptual construct generates another conceptual construct refined by its own nature / equal to itself; and that one too [generates] another, and that another, identical in kind.

sanskrit_iast:
caturṣveva vikalpeṣu yaḥ saṃskāraḥ kramādasau /
asphuṭaḥ sphuṭatābhāvī prasphuṭansphuṭitātmakaḥ // 4
meaning:
चतुर्ष्वेव विकल्पेषु यः संस्कारः क्रमादसौ /
अस्फुटः स्फुटताभावी प्रस्फुटन्स्फुटितात्मकः // 4
text_mt: Through just four conceptual constructs, this refinement proceeds in succession: / indistinct, becoming distinct, radiant, and fully unfolded;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sphuṭataro yāvadante sphuṭatamo bhavet /
asphuṭādau vikalpe ca bhedo'pyastyāntarālikaḥ // 5
meaning:
ततः स्फुटतरो यावदन्ते स्फुटतमो भवेत् /
अस्फुटादौ विकल्पे च भेदोऽप्यस्त्यान्तरालिकः // 5
text_mt: from there, more distinct, until in the end it becomes most distinct; / and even in the indistinct and other conceptual constructs, there are intermediate differences.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sphuṭatamodāratādrūpyaparivṛṃhitā /
saṃvidabhyeti vimalāmavikalpasvarūpatām // 6
meaning:
ततः स्फुटतमोदारताद्रूप्यपरिवृंहिता /
संविदभ्येति विमलामविकल्पस्वरूपताम् // 6
text_mt: Then, reinforced by that most distinct, sublime identity, / consciousness attains the spotless essential nature of the non-conceptual.

sanskrit_iast:
ataśca bhairavīyaṃ yattejaḥ saṃvitsvabhāvakam /
bhūyo bhūyo vimṛśatāṃ jāyate tatsphuṭātmatā // 7
meaning:
अतश्च भैरवीयं यत्तेजः संवित्स्वभावकम् /
भूयो भूयो विमृशतां जायते तत्स्फुटात्मता // 7
text_mt: Therefore, this splendor belonging to Bhairava, whose essential nature is consciousness, / becomes clearly manifest to those who contemplate it again and again.

sanskrit_iast:
nanu saṃvitparāmraṣṭrī parāmarśamayī svataḥ /
parāmṛśyā kathaṃ tāthārūpyasṛṣṭau tu sā jaḍā // 8
meaning:
ननु संवित्पराम्रष्ट्री परामर्शमयी स्वतः /
परामृश्या कथं ताथारूप्यसृष्टौ तु सा जडा // 8
text_mt: [Objection:] Surely, consciousness is inherently the grasper and consists of reflective awareness; / how can it be grasped? If an objective identity is created for it, it would be inert!

sanskrit_iast:
ucyate svātmasaṃvittiḥ svabhāvādeva nirbharā /
nāsyāmapāsyaṃ nādheyaṃ kiṃcidityuditaṃ purā // 9
meaning:
उच्यते स्वात्मसंवित्तिः स्वभावादेव निर्भरा /
नास्यामपास्यं नाधेयं किंचिदित्युदितं पुरा // 9
text_mt: [Reply:] It is taught: consciousness of one's own self is completely full by its very nature; / nothing is to be removed from it and nothing added, as was said before.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu durghaṭakāritvātsvācchandyānnirmalādasau /
svātmapracchādanakrīḍāpaṇḍitaḥ parameśvaraḥ // 10
meaning:
किं तु दुर्घटकारित्वात्स्वाच्छन्द्यान्निर्मलादसौ /
स्वात्मप्रच्छादनक्रीडापण्डितः परमेश्वरः // 10
text_mt: Yet, because He accomplishes the impossible, and through His immaculate absolute autonomy, / the Supreme Lord is skilled in the play of concealing His own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
anāvṛtte svarūpe'pi yadātmācchādanaṃ vibhoḥ /
saiva māyā yato bheda etāvānviśvavṛttikaḥ // 11
meaning:
अनावृत्ते स्वरूपेऽपि यदात्माच्छादनं विभोः /
सैव माया यतो भेद एतावान्विश्ववृत्तिकः // 11
text_mt: That which is the concealment of Himself by the omnipresent Lord, even though His nature is unconcealed, / is precisely māyā, from which arises this vast differentiation operating throughout the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tathābhāsanamevāsya dvaitamuktaṃ maheśituḥ /
taddvayāpāsanenāyaṃ parāmarśo'bhidhīyate // 12
meaning:
तथाभासनमेवास्य द्वैतमुक्तं महेशितुः /
तद्द्वयापासनेनायं परामर्शोऽभिधीयते // 12
text_mt: Its very manifestation in such a manner has been called the duality of the Great Lord; / by casting off that duality, this reflective awareness is described.

sanskrit_iast:
durbhedapādapasyāsya mūlaṃ kṛntanti kovidāḥ /
dhārārūḍhena sattarkakuṭhāreṇeti niścayaḥ // 13
meaning:
दुर्भेदपादपस्यास्य मूलं कृन्तन्ति कोविदाः /
धारारूढेन सत्तर्ककुठारेणेति निश्चयः // 13
text_mt: The wise sever the root of this tree of hard-to-cut differentiation / with the sharp axe of right reasoning; such is the conclusion.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmenāṃ bhāvanāmāhuḥ sarvakāmadughāṃ budhāḥ /
sphuṭayedvastu yāpetaṃ manosthapadādapi // 14
meaning:
तामेनां भावनामाहुः सर्वकामदुघां बुधाः /
स्फुटयेद्वस्तु यापेतं मनोस्थपदादपि // 14
text_mt: The wise call this very thing creative contemplation, which yields all desires, / which can make evident even an object removed from the realm of the mind.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpūrvaśāstre tatproktaṃ tarko yogāṅgamuttamam /
heyādyālocanāttasmāttatra yatnaḥ praśasyate // 15
meaning:
श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे तत्प्रोक्तं तर्को योगाङ्गमुत्तमम् /
हेयाद्यालोचनात्तस्मात्तत्र यत्नः प्रशस्यते // 15
text_mt: In the venerable Pūrvaśāstra, it is said: 'Reasoning is the supreme limb of yoga.' / Because it discriminates what is to be abandoned and the like, effort in that regard is commended.

sanskrit_iast:
mārge cetaḥ sthirībhūtaṃ heye'pi viṣayecchayā /
prerya tena nayettāvadyāvatpadamanāmayam // 16
meaning:
मार्गे चेतः स्थिरीभूतं हेयेऽपि विषयेच्छया /
प्रेर्य तेन नयेत्तावद्यावत्पदमनामयम् // 16
text_mt: Even if the mind is fixed on a path that ought to be abandoned out of desire for sense objects, / one should impel it with that [reasoning] and guide it until it reaches the untroubled state.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgo'tra mokṣopāyaḥ sa heyaḥ śāstrāntaroditaḥ /
viṣiṇoti nibadhnāti yecchā niyatisaṃgatam // 17
meaning:
मार्गोऽत्र मोक्षोपायः स हेयः शास्त्रान्तरोदितः /
विषिणोति निबध्नाति येच्छा नियतिसंगतम् // 17
text_mt: The 'path' here is the means of liberation; that [path] taught in other scriptures ought to be abandoned. / That desire which binds and enchains [the soul] conditioned by restriction

sanskrit_iast:
rāgatattvaṃ tayoktaṃ yat tena tatrānurajyate /
yathā sāmrājyasaṃbhogaṃ dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvāthabādhame // 18
meaning:
रागतत्त्वं तयोक्तं यत् तेन तत्रानुरज्यते /
यथा साम्राज्यसंभोगं दृष्ट्वादृष्ट्वाथबाधमे // 18
text_mt: is termed the principle of attachment by which one is captivated there, / just as a person, having seen imperial enjoyment, or even not having seen it, in an inferior

sanskrit_iast:
bhoge rajyeta durbuddhistadvanmokṣe'pi rāgataḥ /
sa evāṃśaka ityuktaḥ svabhāvākhyaḥ sa tu sphuṭam // 19
meaning:
भोगे रज्येत दुर्बुद्धिस्तद्वन्मोक्षेऽपि रागतः /
स एवांशक इत्युक्तः स्वभावाख्यः स तु स्फुटम् // 19
text_mt: enjoyment might delight, if foolish—so too in [a false] liberation through attachment. / That itself has been called a limitation known as 'nature'; clearly,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhyaṅgamiti mokṣāya pratyūha iti kovidāḥ /
śivaśāsanamāhātmyaṃ vidannapyata eva hi // 20
meaning:
सिद्ध्यङ्गमिति मोक्षाय प्रत्यूह इति कोविदाः /
शिवशासनमाहात्म्यं विदन्नप्यत एव हि // 20
text_mt: it is an auxiliary to worldly accomplishment, but an obstacle to liberation, according to the wise. / For this very reason, even one who knows the greatness of the Śaiva teaching,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavādhyeṣu rajyeta mūḍho rāgeṇa rañjitaḥ /
yatastāvati sā tasya vāmākhyā śaktiraiśvarī // 21
meaning:
वैष्णवाध्येषु रज्येत मूढो रागेण रञ्जितः /
यतस्तावति सा तस्य वामाख्या शक्तिरैश्वरी // 21
text_mt: deluded, colored by attachment, may find pleasure in Vaiṣṇava and other doctrines; / because to that extent the divine power named Vāmā

sanskrit_iast:
pāñcarātrikavairiñcasaugatādervijṛmbhate /
dṛṣṭāḥ sāmrājyasaṃbhogaṃ nindantaḥ ke'pi vāliśāḥ // 22
meaning:
पाञ्चरात्रिकवैरिञ्चसौगतादेर्विजृम्भते /
दृष्टाः साम्राज्यसंभोगं निन्दन्तः केऽपि वालिशाः // 22
text_mt: unfolds itself belonging to Pāñcarātrikas, Brahmins, Saugatas, and others. / Some fools are seen reviling imperial enjoyment,

sanskrit_iast:
na tu saṃtoṣataḥ sveṣu bhogeṣvāśīḥpravartanāt /
evaṃcidbhairavāveśanindātatparamānasāḥ // 23
meaning:
न तु संतोषतः स्वेषु भोगेष्वाशीःप्रवर्तनात् /
एवंचिद्भैरवावेशनिन्दातत्परमानसाः // 23
text_mt: not out of contentment, but because a wish arises for their own [meager] enjoyments. / Likewise, those whose minds are intent on reviling the immersion into the consciousness of Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
bhavantyatisughorābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ pātitā yataḥ /
tena śāṃbhavamāhātmyaṃ jānanyaḥ śāsanāntare // 24
meaning:
भवन्त्यतिसुघोराभिः शक्तिभिः पातिता यतः /
तेन शांभवमाहात्म्यं जानन्यः शासनान्तरे // 24
text_mt: because they have been cast down by the extremely terrifying powers, / do not cross over the great ocean of differentiation on that account,

sanskrit_iast:
āśvasto nottarītavyaṃ tena bhedamahārṇavāt /
śrīkāmikāyāṃ proktaṃ ca pāśaprakaraṇe sphuṭam // 25
meaning:
आश्वस्तो नोत्तरीतव्यं तेन भेदमहार्णवात् /
श्रीकामिकायां प्रोक्तं च पाशप्रकरणे स्फुटम् // 25
text_mt: even if they know the Śāmbhava greatness, resting confident in another teaching. / And in the venerable Kāmikā, it is explicitly taught in the chapter on bonds:

sanskrit_iast:
vedasāṃkhyapurāṇajñāḥ pāñcarātraparāyaṇāḥ /
ye kecidṛṣayo dhīrāḥ śāstrāntaraparāyaṇāḥ // 26
meaning:
वेदसांख्यपुराणज्ञाः पाञ्चरात्रपरायणाः /
ये केचिदृषयो धीराः शास्त्रान्तरपरायणाः // 26
text_mt: 'Those who know the Vedas, Sāṃkhya, and the Purāṇas, those devoted to Pāñcarātra, / whatever wise sages are devoted to other scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
bauddhārhatādyāḥ sarve te vidyārāgeṇa rañjitāḥ /
māyāpāśena baddhatvācchivadīkṣāṃ na vindate // 27
meaning:
बौद्धार्हताद्याः सर्वे ते विद्यारागेण रञ्जिताः /
मायापाशेन बद्धत्वाच्छिवदीक्षां न विन्दते // 27
text_mt: Buddhists, Jainas, and all others—colored by attachment to limited knowledge, / being bound by the fetter of māyā, do not attain the Śaiva initiation.'

sanskrit_iast:
rāgaśabdena ca proktaṃ rāgatattvaṃ niyāmakam /
māyīye tacca taṃ tasmiñchāstre niyamayediti // 28
meaning:
रागशब्देन च प्रोक्तं रागतत्त्वं नियामकम् /
मायीये तच्च तं तस्मिञ्छास्त्रे नियमयेदिति // 28
text_mt: And by the word 'attachment', the determining principle of attachment is designated, / which belongs to māyā; and that [principle] would restrict him to that scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣo'pi vaiṣṇavāderyaḥ svasaṃkalpena bhāvitaḥ /
paraprakṛtisāyujyaṃ yadvāpyānandarūpatā // 29
meaning:
मोक्षोऽपि वैष्णवादेर्यः स्वसंकल्पेन भावितः /
परप्रकृतिसायुज्यं यद्वाप्यानन्दरूपता // 29
text_mt: Even the liberation of the Vaiṣṇava and others, conceived by their own imagination, / whether union with higher Prakṛti, or consisting of bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddhacittamātraṃ vā dīpavatsaṃtatikṣayaḥ /
sa savedyāpavedyātmapralayākalatāmayaḥ // 30
meaning:
विशुद्धचित्तमात्रं वा दीपवत्संततिक्षयः /
स सवेद्यापवेद्यात्मप्रलयाकलतामयः // 30
text_mt: or mere purified consciousness, or the extinction of the mind's continuum like a lamp, / consists in the state of a dissolutive knower, with objective consciousness or devoid of it.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ prāpyāpi ciraṃ kālaṃ tadgogābhogabhuktataḥ /
tattattvapralayānte tu tadūrdhvāṃ sṛṣṭimāgataḥ // 31
meaning:
तं प्राप्यापि चिरं कालं तद्गोगाभोगभुक्ततः /
तत्तत्त्वप्रलयान्ते तु तदूर्ध्वां सृष्टिमागतः // 31
text_mt: Even having attained that, after long time, through enjoying the fullness of that enjoyment, / at the end of the dissolution of that respective principle, having entered into creation above it,

sanskrit_iast:
mantratvameti saṃbodhādananteśena kalpitāt /
etaccāgre taniṣyāma ityāstāṃ tāvadatra tat // 32
meaning:
मन्त्रत्वमेति संबोधादनन्तेशेन कल्पितात् /
एतच्चाग्रे तनिष्याम इत्यास्तां तावदत्र तत् // 32
text_mt: he attains the status of a mantra through the awakening fashioned by Ananteśa. / And we will elaborate this further on; so let that be for now.

sanskrit_iast:
tenājñajanatāklṛptapravādairyo viḍambitaḥ /
asadgurau rūḍhacitsa māyāpāśena rañjitaḥ // 33
meaning:
तेनाज्ञजनताक्लृप्तप्रवादैर्यो विडम्बितः /
असद्गुरौ रूढचित्स मायापाशेन रञ्जितः // 33
text_mt: Therefore, one who is deceived by doctrines fashioned by ignorant people, / whose mind is established in an untrue guru, is colored by the bond of māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi sattarkayogena nīyate sadguruṃ prati /
sattarkaḥ śuddhavidyaiva sā cecchā parameśituḥ // 34
meaning:
सोऽपि सत्तर्कयोगेन नीयते सद्गुरुं प्रति /
सत्तर्कः शुद्धविद्यैव सा चेच्छा परमेशितुः // 34
text_mt: Even he is led to a true guru by the practice of right reasoning; / right reasoning is indeed Pure Knowledge, and that is the will of the Supreme Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpūrvaśāstre tenoktaṃ sa yiyāsuḥ śivecchayā /
bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati // 35
meaning:
श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे तेनोक्तं स यियासुः शिवेच्छया /
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रसिद्ध्यर्थं नीयते सद्गुरुं प्रति // 35
text_mt: Therefore, in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra it is said: 'Desiring to go by the will of Śiva / for the attainment of enjoyment and liberation, he is led to a true guru.'

sanskrit_iast:
śaktipātastu tatraiṣa kramikaḥ saṃpravartate /
sthitvā yo'sadgurau śāstrāntare vā satpathaṃ śritaḥ // 36
meaning:
शक्तिपातस्तु तत्रैष क्रमिकः संप्रवर्तते /
स्थित्वा योऽसद्गुरौ शास्त्रान्तरे वा सत्पथं श्रितः // 36
text_mt: However, that descent of power operates gradually in this case: / having stayed with a false guru or in another scripture, he takes refuge in the true path.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśāstragate sattve'sattve cātra vibhedakam /
śaktipātasya vaicitryaṃ purastātpravivicyate // 37
meaning:
गुरुशास्त्रगते सत्त्वेऽसत्त्वे चात्र विभेदकम् /
शक्तिपातस्य वैचित्र्यं पुरस्तात्प्रविविच्यते // 37
text_mt: The differentiating factor here between true and false in gurus and scriptures / is the variety of the descent of power, which will be analyzed further on.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ svacchandaśāstre tat vaiṣṇavādyānpravādinaḥ /
sarvānbhramayate māyā sāmokṣe mokṣalipsayā // 38
meaning:
उक्तं स्वच्छन्दशास्त्रे तत् वैष्णवाद्यान्प्रवादिनः /
सर्वान्भ्रमयते माया सामोक्षे मोक्षलिप्सया // 38
text_mt: It is stated in the Svacchandaśāstra: 'Māyā deludes all disputants / such as the Vaiṣṇavas, in that which is not liberation, through the desire to attain liberation.'

sanskrit_iast:
yastu rūḍho'pi tatrodyatparāmarśaviśāradaḥ /
sa śuddhavidyāmāhātmyācchaktipātapavitritaḥ // 39
meaning:
यस्तु रूढोऽपि तत्रोद्यत्परामर्शविशारदः /
स शुद्धविद्यामाहात्म्याच्छक्तिपातपवित्रितः // 39
text_mt: However, one who, even though established there, is skilled in emerging reflective awareness, / purified by the descent of power through the greatness of Pure Knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
ārohatyeva sanmārgaṃ pratyūhaparivarjitaḥ /
sa tāvatkasyacittarkaḥ svata eva pravartate // 40
meaning:
आरोहत्येव सन्मार्गं प्रत्यूहपरिवर्जितः /
स तावत्कस्यचित्तर्कः स्वत एव प्रवर्तते // 40
text_mt: ascends to the true path, completely free from obstacles. / In some persons, that reasoning operates entirely of itself;

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca sāṃsiddhikaḥ śāstre proktaḥ svapratyayātmakaḥ /
kiraṇāyāṃ yadapyuktaṃ gurutaḥ śāstrataḥ svataḥ // 41
meaning:
स च सांसिद्धिकः शास्त्रे प्रोक्तः स्वप्रत्ययात्मकः /
किरणायां यदप्युक्तं गुरुतः शास्त्रतः स्वतः // 41
text_mt: and it is declared in the scripture as spontaneous, consisting of self-validating conviction. / As is also stated in the Kiraṇa: 'From the guru, from scripture, or of oneself'—

sanskrit_iast:
tatrottarottaraṃ mukhyaṃ pūrvapūrva upāyakaḥ /
yasya svato'yaṃ sattarkaḥ sarvatraivādhikāravān // 42
meaning:
तत्रोत्तरोत्तरं मुख्यं पूर्वपूर्व उपायकः /
यस्य स्वतोऽयं सत्तर्कः सर्वत्रैवाधिकारवान् // 42
text_mt: among these, each subsequent one is superior, while each preceding one is a means. / One in whom this right reasoning arises of itself possesses authority everywhere;

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣiktaḥ svasaṃvittidevībhirdīkṣitaśca saḥ /
sa eva sarvācāryāṇāṃ madhye mukhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ // 43
meaning:
अभिषिक्तः स्वसंवित्तिदेवीभिर्दीक्षितश्च सः /
स एव सर्वाचार्याणां मध्ये मुख्यः प्रकीर्तितः // 43
text_mt: he is consecrated and initiated by the goddesses of his own consciousness; / he alone is proclaimed the chief among all masters.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃnidhāne nānyeṣu kalpiteṣvadhikāritā /
sa samastaṃ ca śāstrārthaṃ sattarkādeva manyate // 44
meaning:
तत्संनिधाने नान्येषु कल्पितेष्वधिकारिता /
स समस्तं च शास्त्रार्थं सत्तर्कादेव मन्यते // 44
text_mt: In his presence, other manufactured [masters] have no authority. / And he grasps the entire meaning of the scriptures through right reasoning alone.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhavidyā hi tannāsti satyaṃ yadyanna bhāsayet /
sarvaśāstrārthavettṛtvamakasmāccāsya jāyate // 45
meaning:
शुद्धविद्या हि तन्नास्ति सत्यं यद्यन्न भासयेत् /
सर्वशास्त्रार्थवेत्तृत्वमकस्माच्चास्य जायते // 45
text_mt: For it is Pure Knowledge: there is nothing true that it does not illuminate; / and knowledge of the meaning of all scriptures arises in him spontaneously.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīpūvavākye tad+akasmāditi-śabdataḥ /
lokāprasiddho yo hetuḥ so'kasmāditi kathyate // 46
meaning:
इति श्रीपूववाक्ये तद्+अकस्मादिति-शब्दतः /
लोकाप्रसिद्धो यो हेतुः सोऽकस्मादिति कथ्यते // 46
text_mt: Thus, in the statement from the venerable Pūrva, by the word 'spontaneously' [akasmāt]: / that cause which is not well-known to the world is termed 'spontaneous'.

sanskrit_iast:
sa caiṣa parameśānaśuddhavidyāvijṛmbhatam /
asya bhodāśca bahavo nirbhittiḥ sahabhittikaḥ // 47
meaning:
स चैष परमेशानशुद्धविद्याविजृम्भतम् /
अस्य भोदाश्च बहवो निर्भित्तिः सहभित्तिकः // 47
text_mt: And this is the blossoming of the Pure Knowledge of the Supreme Lord. / And its varieties are many: without support and with support.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvago'ṃśagataḥ so'pi mukhyāmukhyāṃśaniṣṭhitaḥ /
bhittiḥ paropajīvitvaṃ parā prajñātha tatkṛtiḥ // 48
meaning:
सर्वगोऽंशगतः सोऽपि मुख्यामुख्यांशनिष्ठितः /
भित्तिः परोपजीवित्वं परा प्रज्ञाथ तत्कृतिः // 48
text_mt: [This pure knowledge is] all-pervading or partial; and even that [partial one] resides in a primary or secondary part. / The 'support' [consists of] depending on another, [namely] another's intellect or its product.

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kaścidvetti tattvataḥ /
sa siddhibhāgbhavennityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣitaḥ // 49
meaning:
अदृष्टमण्डलोऽप्येवं यः कश्चिद्वेत्ति तत्त्वतः /
स सिद्धिभाग्भवेन्नित्यं स योगी स च दीक्षितः // 49
text_mt: Anyone who thus knows [the reality] as it is, even without having seen a maṇḍala, / shall always attain spiritual accomplishment; he is a yogin and he is initiated.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī /
dīkṣā bhavediti proktaṃ tacchrītriṃśakaśāsane // 50
meaning:
एवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वेन तस्य निर्वाणगामिनी /
दीक्षा भवेदिति प्रोक्तं तच्छ्रीत्रिंशकशासने // 50
text_mt: It is stated thus in the venerated Triṃśikā-śāsana: / for one who knows [the reality] as it is, there is initiation leading to nirvāṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
akalpito gururjñayaḥ sāṃsiddhika iti smṛtaḥ /
yastu tadrūpabhāgātmabhāvanātaḥ paraṃ vinā // 51
meaning:
अकल्पितो गुरुर्ज्ञयः सांसिद्धिक इति स्मृतः /
यस्तु तद्रूपभागात्मभावनातः परं विना // 51
text_mt: The innate (sāṃsiddhika) guru should be known as 'unfabricated' (akalpita): / he who attains that nature through self-cultivation without an external [master].

sanskrit_iast:
śāstravitsa guruḥ śāstre prokto'kalpitakalpakaḥ /
tasyāpi bhedā utkṛṣṭamadhyamandādyupāyataḥ // 52
meaning:
शास्त्रवित्स गुरुः शास्त्रे प्रोक्तोऽकल्पितकल्पकः /
तस्यापि भेदा उत्कृष्टमध्यमन्दाद्युपायतः // 52
text_mt: One who knows the scripture is declared in the scripture to be an 'unfabricated fabricator' (akalpita-kalpaka) guru; / and his divisions too [arise] through superior, middling, or inferior means.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvanāto'tha vā dhyānājjapātsvapnādvratāddhuteḥ /
prāpnotyakalpitodāramabhiṣekaṃ mahāmatiḥ // 53
meaning:
भावनातोऽथ वा ध्यानाज्जपात्स्वप्नाद्व्रताद्धुतेः /
प्राप्नोत्यकल्पितोदारमभिषेकं महामतिः // 53
text_mt: From creative contemplation (bhāvanā), meditation, recitation, a dream, an observance, or oblation, / the great-minded one attains an exalted, unfabricated consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadvājasanīye śrīvīre śrībrahmayāmale /
śrīsiddhāyāmidaṃ dhātrā proktamanyatra ca sphuṭam // 54
meaning:
श्रीमद्वाजसनीये श्रीवीरे श्रीब्रह्मयामले /
श्रीसिद्धायामिदं धात्रा प्रोक्तमन्यत्र च स्फुटम् // 54
text_mt: This is clearly declared by the Creator in the illustrious Vājasanīya, the Vīra, the Brahmayāmala, / the Siddhā, and elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya svecchāpravṛttatvātkāraṇānantateṣyate /
kadācidbhaktiyogena karmaṇā vidyayāpi vā // 55
meaning:
तस्य स्वेच्छाप्रवृत्तत्वात्कारणानन्ततेष्यते /
कदाचिद्भक्तियोगेन कर्मणा विद्ययापि वा // 55
text_mt: Because it proceeds from his own will, an endlessness of causes is accepted: / sometimes through devotion, ritual action, or even knowledge;

sanskrit_iast:
jñānadharmopadeśena mantrairvā dīkṣayāpi vā /
evamādyairanekaiśca prakāraiḥ parameśvaraḥ // 56
meaning:
ज्ञानधर्मोपदेशेन मन्त्रैर्वा दीक्षयापि वा /
एवमाद्यैरनेकैश्च प्रकारैः परमेश्वरः // 56
text_mt: through the teaching of gnosis and duty, through mantras, or through initiation— / by these and many such manners, the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsāriṇo'nugṛhṇāti viśvasya jagataḥ patiḥ /
mātṛmaṇḍalasaṃbodhātsaṃskārāttapasaḥ priye // 57
meaning:
संसारिणोऽनुगृह्णाति विश्वस्य जगतः पतिः /
मातृमण्डलसंबोधात्संस्कारात्तपसः प्रिये // 57
text_mt: the Master of the entire universe, graces transmigrating souls: / 'O dear one, from the awakening granted by the circle of mothers, from sacramental refinement, from asceticism,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānādyogājjapājjñānānmantrārādhanāto vratāt /
saṃprāpyaṃ kulasāmānyaṃ jñānaṃ kaulikasiddhidam // 58
meaning:
ध्यानाद्योगाज्जपाज्ज्ञानान्मन्त्राराधनातो व्रतात् /
संप्राप्यं कुलसामान्यं ज्ञानं कौलिकसिद्धिदम् // 58
text_mt: from meditation, yoga, recitation, knowledge, propitiation of mantras, and observances, / that knowledge common to the Kula is obtained which bestows Kaula accomplishment.'

sanskrit_iast:
tattvajñānātmakaṃ sādhyaṃ yatra yatraiva dṛśyate /
sa eva hi gurustatra hetujālaṃ prakalpyatām // 59
meaning:
तत्त्वज्ञानात्मकं साध्यं यत्र यत्रैव दृश्यते /
स एव हि गुरुस्तत्र हेतुजालं प्रकल्प्यताम् // 59
text_mt: Wherever the goal consisting of knowledge of reality is observed, / there he alone is the guru; let the web of causes be devised there.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvajñānādṛte nānyallakṣaṇaṃ brahmayāmale /
tatraiva coktaṃ sevāyāṃ kṛtāyāmavikalpataḥ // 60
meaning:
तत्त्वज्ञानादृते नान्यल्लक्षणं ब्रह्मयामले /
तत्रैव चोक्तं सेवायां कृतायामविकल्पतः // 60
text_mt: In the Brahmayāmala there is no other characteristic than knowledge of reality; / and right there it is said: when selfless service has been performed without doubt,

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakasya na cetsiddhiḥ kiṃ kāryamiti codite /
ātmīyamasya saṃjñānakrameṇa svātmadīkṣaṇam // 61
meaning:
साधकस्य न चेत्सिद्धिः किं कार्यमिति चोदिते /
आत्मीयमस्य संज्ञानक्रमेण स्वात्मदीक्षणम् // 61
text_mt: if the adept does not attain spiritual accomplishment, to the question 'What is to be done?': / one's own self-initiation through the sequence of his own consciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
sasphuratvaprasiddhyarthaṃ tataḥ sādhyaṃ prasiddhyati /
anena svātmavijñānaṃ sasphuratvaprasādhakam // 62
meaning:
सस्फुरत्वप्रसिद्ध्यर्थं ततः साध्यं प्रसिद्ध्यति /
अनेन स्वात्मविज्ञानं सस्फुरत्वप्रसाधकम् // 62
text_mt: in order to establish the state of vibrant pulsing; then the goal is accomplished. / By this, realization of one's own self establishes vibrant pulsing;

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ mukhyatayācāryo bhavedyadi na sasphuraḥ /
tatraiva ca punaḥ śrīmadraktārādhanakarmaṇi // 63
meaning:
उक्तं मुख्यतयाचार्यो भवेद्यदि न सस्फुरः /
तत्रैव च पुनः श्रीमद्रक्ताराधनकर्मणि // 63
text_mt: it is taught that he would essentially be a master (ācārya) if he possesses vibrant pulsing. / And in that very [text], concerning the rite of worship of the illustrious Raktā:

sanskrit_iast:
vidhiṃ proktaṃ sadā kurvanmāsenācārya ucyate /
pakṣeṇa sādhako'rdhārdhātputrakaḥ samayī tathā // 64
meaning:
विधिं प्रोक्तं सदा कुर्वन्मासेनाचार्य उच्यते /
पक्षेण साधकोऽर्धार्धात्पुत्रकः समयी तथा // 64
text_mt: Constantly performing the prescribed ritual, he is called a master in a month; / an adept in a fortnight; a spiritual son in half of half of that; and likewise an initiate into the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣayejjapayogena raktādevī kramādyataḥ /
guroralābhe proktasya vidhimetaṃ samācaret // 65
meaning:
दीक्षयेज्जपयोगेन रक्तादेवी क्रमाद्यतः /
गुरोरलाभे प्रोक्तस्य विधिमेतं समाचरेत् // 65
text_mt: Since Goddess Raktā would initiate by means of recitation in due succession, / in the absence of a declared guru one should perform this ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
mate ca pustakādvidyādhyayane doṣa īdṛśaḥ /
ukto yastena taddoṣābhāve'sau na niṣiddhatā // 66
meaning:
मते च पुस्तकाद्विद्याध्ययने दोष ईदृशः /
उक्तो यस्तेन तद्दोषाभावेऽसौ न निषिद्धता // 66
text_mt: And the fault in studying knowledge from a book that is mentioned in the Mata / is of such a nature: therefore, when that fault is absent, this [study] is not prohibited.

sanskrit_iast:
mantradravyādiguptatve phalaṃ kimiti codite /
pustakādhītavidyā ye dīkṣāsamayavarjitāḥ // 67
meaning:
मन्त्रद्रव्यादिगुप्तत्वे फलं किमिति चोदिते /
पुस्तकाधीतविद्या ये दीक्षासमयवर्जिताः // 67
text_mt: To the question, 'What is the fruit when mantras, substances, and the like are kept secret?': / Those who have studied knowledge from books while devoid of initiation and observances,

sanskrit_iast:
tāmasāḥ parahiṃsādi vaśyādi ca carantyalam /
na ca tattvaṃ vidustena doṣabhāja iti sphuṭam // 68
meaning:
तामसाः परहिंसादि वश्यादि च चरन्त्यलम् /
न च तत्त्वं विदुस्तेन दोषभाज इति स्फुटम् // 68
text_mt: dominated by tamas, excessively perform harm to others, subjugation, and so forth, / and do not know the reality; hence they clearly incur fault.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ padayugaṃ vācyamanyonyaṃ hetuhetumat /
yastu śāstraṃ vinā naiti śuddhavidyākhyasaṃvidam // 69
meaning:
पूर्वं पदयुगं वाच्यमन्योन्यं हेतुहेतुमत् /
यस्तु शास्त्रं विना नैति शुद्धविद्याख्यसंविदम् // 69
text_mt: The first pair of words must be understood as mutually related as cause and effect. / But he who does not attain the consciousness named pure knowledge without scripture,

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ sa śāstramanvicchustaduktaṃ kramamācaret /
yena kenāpyupāyena gurumārādhya bhaktitaḥ // 70
meaning:
गुरोः स शास्त्रमन्विच्छुस्तदुक्तं क्रममाचरेत् /
येन केनाप्युपायेन गुरुमाराध्य भक्तितः // 70
text_mt: seeking scripture from a guru, should perform the sequence taught by him. / Having worshiped the guru through whatever means with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
taddīkṣākramayogena śāstrārthaṃ vettyasau tataḥ /
abhiṣekaṃ samāsādya yo bhavetsa tu kalpitaḥ // 71
meaning:
तद्दीक्षाक्रमयोगेन शास्त्रार्थं वेत्त्यसौ ततः /
अभिषेकं समासाद्य यो भवेत्स तु कल्पितः // 71
text_mt: he knows the meaning of scripture through the method of his initiation. / Then, having received consecration, whoever emerges is 'fabricated' (kalpita).

sanskrit_iast:
sannapyaśeṣapāśaughavinivartanakovidaḥ /
yo yathākramayogena kasmiṃścicchāstravastuni // 72
meaning:
सन्नप्यशेषपाशौघविनिवर्तनकोविदः /
यो यथाक्रमयोगेन कस्मिंश्चिच्छास्त्रवस्तुनि // 72
text_mt: Even while being skilled in removing the entire mass of bonds, / he who, through the method of succession, with regard to some particular topic of scripture,

sanskrit_iast:
ākasmikaṃ brajedbodhaṃ kalpitākalpito hi saḥ /
tasya yo'kalpito bhāgaḥ sa tu śreṣṭhamaḥ smṛtaḥ // 73
meaning:
आकस्मिकं ब्रजेद्बोधं कल्पिताकल्पितो हि सः /
तस्य योऽकल्पितो भागः स तु श्रेष्ठमः स्मृतः // 73
text_mt: attains sudden awakening, is indeed 'fabricated-unfabricated' (kalpitākalpita). / The part of him that is unfabricated is considered the highest;

sanskrit_iast:
utkarṣaḥ śuddhavidyāṃśatāratamyakṛto yataḥ /
yathā bhedenādisiddhācchivānmuktaśivā hyadhaḥ // 74
meaning:
उत्कर्षः शुद्धविद्यांशतारतम्यकृतो यतः /
यथा भेदेनादिसिद्धाच्छिवान्मुक्तशिवा ह्यधः // 74
text_mt: for superiority is caused by the gradations of the portion of pure knowledge. / Just as liberated Śivas are indeed lower by distinction from Śiva who is eternally perfected,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sāṃsiddhikajñānādāhṛtajñānino'dhamāḥ /
tatsaṃnidhau nādhikārasteṣāṃ muktaśivātmavat // 75
meaning:
तथा सांसिद्धिकज्ञानादाहृतज्ञानिनोऽधमाः /
तत्संनिधौ नाधिकारस्तेषां मुक्तशिवात्मवत् // 75
text_mt: so those whose knowledge is acquired [from without] are inferior to one with innate knowledge. / In his presence they have no authority, just like the liberated Śivas;

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tu tūṣṇīṃ-sthitiryadvā kṛtyaṃ tadanuvartanam /
yastvakalpitarūpo'pi saṃvādadṛḍhatākṛte // 76
meaning:
किं तु तूष्णीं-स्थितिर्यद्वा कृत्यं तदनुवर्तनम् /
यस्त्वकल्पितरूपोऽपि संवाददृढताकृते // 76
text_mt: rather, there should be silence, or their task is to follow him. / But he who, though unfabricated in nature, for the sake of confirming harmony,

sanskrit_iast:
anyato labdhasaṃskāraḥ sa sākṣādbhairavo guruḥ /
yataḥ śāstrakramāttajjñaguruprajñānuśīlanāt // 77
meaning:
अन्यतो लब्धसंस्कारः स साक्षाद्भैरवो गुरुः /
यतः शास्त्रक्रमात्तज्ज्ञगुरुप्रज्ञानुशीलनात् // 77
text_mt: has received refinement from another, is a guru who is Bhairava directly. / Because from the sequence of scripture and from constant reflection on the intellect of a guru who knows it,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmapratyayitaṃ jñānaṃ pūrṇatvādbhairavāyate /
tena śrīkiraṇoktaṃ yadgurutaḥ śāstrataḥ svataḥ // 78
meaning:
आत्मप्रत्ययितं ज्ञानं पूर्णत्वाद्भैरवायते /
तेन श्रीकिरणोक्तं यद्गुरुतः शास्त्रतः स्वतः // 78
text_mt: knowledge verified by oneself becomes Bhairava-like due to fullness. / Therefore, what is said in the illustrious Kiraṇa: 'From the guru, from scripture, and from oneself—

sanskrit_iast:
tripratyayamidaṃ jñānamiti yacca niśāṭane /
tatsaṃghātaviparyāsavigrahairbhāsate tathā // 79
meaning:
त्रिप्रत्ययमिदं ज्ञानमिति यच्च निशाटने /
तत्संघातविपर्यासविग्रहैर्भासते तथा // 79
text_mt: this knowledge has threefold verification'; and that which is in the Niśāṭana: / 'It shines thus through the aggregates, inversions, and distinct forms.'

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇasya vicitratvādvicitrāmeva tāṃ chidam /
kartuṃ vāsīṃ ca ṭaṅkaṃ ca krakacaṃ cāpi gṛhṇate // 80
meaning:
करणस्य विचित्रत्वाद्विचित्रामेव तां छिदम् /
कर्तुं वासीं च टङ्कं च क्रकचं चापि गृह्णते // 80
text_mt: Because of the variety of the instrument, in order to make that very cutting diverse, / people take an adze, a chisel, and a saw;

sanskrit_iast:
tāvacca chedanaṃ hyekaṃ tathaivādyābhisaṃdhitaḥ /
itthameva mitau vācyaṃ karaṇasya svakaṃ vapuḥ // 81
meaning:
तावच्च छेदनं ह्येकं तथैवाद्याभिसंधितः /
इत्थमेव मितौ वाच्यं करणस्य स्वकं वपुः // 81
text_mt: yet the cutting is simply one, just as intended at the outset. / In this very way must the own-form of an instrument be explained with respect to valid cognition.

sanskrit_iast:
na svatantraṃ svato mānaṃ kuryādadhigamaṃ haṭhāt /
pramātrāśvāsaparyanto yato'dhigama ucyate // 82
meaning:
न स्वतन्त्रं स्वतो मानं कुर्यादधिगमं हठात् /
प्रमात्राश्वासपर्यन्तो यतोऽधिगम उच्यते // 82
text_mt: A means of valid knowledge does not forcibly produce apprehension autonomously by itself, / because apprehension is said to culminate in the certitude of the knower;

sanskrit_iast:
āśvāsaśca vicitro'sau śaktipātavaśāttathā /
pramite'pi pramāṇānāmavakāśo'styataḥ sphuṭaḥ // 83
meaning:
आश्वासश्च विचित्रोऽसौ शक्तिपातवशात्तथा /
प्रमितेऽपि प्रमाणानामवकाशोऽस्त्यतः स्फुटः // 83
text_mt: and this certitude is diverse according to the descent of power. / Hence, there is clearly scope for means of valid knowledge even regarding what is already known.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā samāśliṣya ciraṃ saṃcarvya cetasā /
priyā yaiḥ parituṣyeta kiṃ brūmaḥ kila tānprati // 84
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वा समाश्लिष्य चिरं संचर्व्य चेतसा /
प्रिया यैः परितुष्येत किं ब्रूमः किल तान्प्रति // 84
text_mt: Seeing again and again, embracing, and savoring for a long time in mind, / those through whom the beloved is fully pleased—what can we possibly say to them?

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ ca mānasaṃplutyāmapi nādhigate gatiḥ /
na vyarthatā nānavasthā nānyonyāśrayatāpi ca // 85
meaning:
इत्थं च मानसंप्लुत्यामपि नाधिगते गतिः /
न व्यर्थता नानवस्था नान्योन्याश्रयतापि च // 85
text_mt: And thus, even when means of valid knowledge converge, there is no [superfluous] movement toward what is already known, / no uselessness, no infinite regress, nor mutual dependence.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ yogāṅgamiyati tarka eva na cāparam /
antarantaḥ parāmarśapāṭavātiśayāya saḥ // 86
meaning:
एवं योगाङ्गमियति तर्क एव न चापरम् /
अन्तरन्तः परामर्शपाटवातिशयाय सः // 86
text_mt: Thus, among the limbs of yoga, reasoning alone [is primary], and nothing else; / it serves to heighten the dexterity of internal reflective awareness.

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyamasteyabrahmacaryāparigrahāḥ /
iti pañca yamāḥ sākṣātsaṃvittau nopayoginaḥ // 87
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहाः /
इति पञ्च यमाः साक्षात्संवित्तौ नोपयोगिनः // 87
text_mt: Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, and non-possessiveness: / these five restraints are not directly useful for consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tapaḥprabhṛtayo ye ca niyamā yattathāsanam /
prāṇāyāmāśca ye sarvametadbāhyavijṛmbhitam // 88
meaning:
तपःप्रभृतयो ये च नियमा यत्तथासनम् /
प्राणायामाश्च ये सर्वमेतद्बाह्यविजृम्भितम् // 88
text_mt: And the observances such as asceticism, likewise posture, / and the breath-controls—all this is external manifestation.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadvīrāvalau coktaṃ bodhamātre śivātmake /
cittapralayabandhena pralīne śaśibhāskare // 89
meaning:
श्रीमद्वीरावलौ चोक्तं बोधमात्रे शिवात्मके /
चित्तप्रलयबन्धेन प्रलीने शशिभास्करे // 89
text_mt: And it is said in the illustrious Vīrāvalī: 'In mere consciousness consisting of Śiva, / when the moon and sun dissolve through the binding of the mind's dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte ca dvādaśe bhāge jīvāditye svabodhake /
mokṣaḥ sa eva kathitaḥ prāṇāyāmo nirarthakaḥ // 90
meaning:
प्राप्ते च द्वादशे भागे जीवादित्ये स्वबोधके /
मोक्षः स एव कथितः प्राणायामो निरर्थकः // 90
text_mt: and when the twelfth portion, the sun of life which awakens itself, is reached, / that alone is declared liberation; breath-control is useless.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmo na kartavyaḥ śarīraṃ yena pīḍyate /
rahasyaṃ vetti yo yatra sa muktaḥ sa ca mocakaḥ // 91
meaning:
प्राणायामो न कर्तव्यः शरीरं येन पीड्यते /
रहस्यं वेत्ति यो यत्र स मुक्तः स च मोचकः // 91
text_mt: Breath-control should not be performed by which the body is afflicted. / One who knows the secret wherever it is, he is liberated and he is a liberator.'

sanskrit_iast:
pratyāhāraśca nāmāyamarthebhyo'kṣadhiyāṃ hi yaḥ /
anibaddhasya bandhasya tadantaḥ kila kīlanam // 92
meaning:
प्रत्याहारश्च नामायमर्थेभ्योऽक्षधियां हि यः /
अनिबद्धस्य बन्धस्य तदन्तः किल कीलनम् // 92
text_mt: And retraction, indeed, is that drawing back of the intellect of the senses from objects; / it is truly the pegging inward of an unbonded bondage.

sanskrit_iast:
cittasya viṣaye kvāpi bandhanaṃ dhāraṇātmakam /
tatsadṛgjñānasaṃtāno dhyānamastamitā param // 93
meaning:
चित्तस्य विषये क्वापि बन्धनं धारणात्मकम् /
तत्सदृग्ज्ञानसंतानो ध्यानमस्तमिता परम् // 93
text_mt: The binding of the mind to any object consists of fixation (dhāraṇā); / a continuous flow of cognition similar to that is meditation (dhyāna); beyond that, [all else] disappears.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu jñeyatādātmyameva saṃvidi jāyate /
grāhyagrahaṇatādvaitaśūnyateyaṃ samāhitiḥ // 94
meaning:
यदा तु ज्ञेयतादात्म्यमेव संविदि जायते /
ग्राह्यग्रहणताद्वैतशून्यतेयं समाहितिः // 94
text_mt: When, however, identity with the knowable arises directly in consciousness, / free from the duality of the grasper and the grasped, that is samādhi.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeṣā dhāraṇādhyānasamādhitritayī parām /
saṃvidaṃ prati no kaṃcidupayogaṃ samaśnute // 95
meaning:
तदेषा धारणाध्यानसमाधित्रितयी पराम् /
संविदं प्रति नो कंचिदुपयोगं समश्नुते // 95
text_mt: Therefore, this triad of dhāraṇā, dhyāna, and samādhi / serves no function toward the supreme consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
yogāṅgatā yamādestu samādhyantasya varṇyate /
svapūrvapūrvopāyatvādantyatarkopayogataḥ // 96
meaning:
योगाङ्गता यमादेस्तु समाध्यन्तस्य वर्ण्यते /
स्वपूर्वपूर्वोपायत्वादन्त्यतर्कोपयोगतः // 96
text_mt: Yet the nature of limbs of yoga from yama up to samādhi is described / because each serves as an expedient for the one after it, culminating in the service of liberating discernment (tarka).

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥ saṃvidi rūḍhaṃ hi taddvārā prāṇadehayoḥ /
buddhau vārpyaṃ tadabhyāsānnaiṣa nyāyastu saṃvidi // 97
meaning:
अन्तः संविदि रूढं हि तद्द्वारा प्राणदेहयोः /
बुद्धौ वार्प्यं तदभ्यासान्नैष न्यायस्तु संविदि // 97
text_mt: For what is rooted internally in consciousness is imparted through it / into breath and body, or into the intellect by repeated practice; but this rule does not apply to consciousness [itself].

sanskrit_iast:
atha vāsmaddṛśi prāṇadhīdehāderapi sphuṭam /
sarvātmakatvāttatrastho'pyabhyāso'nyavyapohanam // 98
meaning:
अथ वास्मद्दृशि प्राणधीदेहादेरपि स्फुटम् /
सर्वात्मकत्वात्तत्रस्थोऽप्यभ्यासोऽन्यव्यपोहनम् // 98
text_mt: Or rather, in our view, because even breath, intellect, body, and the rest / are clearly all-pervasive, the practice residing there too consists in the exclusion of other [constructs].

sanskrit_iast:
deha utplutisaṃpātadharmojjigamiṣārasāt /
utplāvyate tadvipakṣapātāśaṅkāvyapohanāt // 99
meaning:
देह उत्प्लुतिसंपातधर्मोज्जिगमिषारसात् /
उत्प्लाव्यते तद्विपक्षपाताशङ्काव्यपोहनात् // 99
text_mt: The body is made to leap out of the relish of the desire to rise, whose nature is leaping and falling, / by dispelling the suspicion of the opposite—falling down.

sanskrit_iast:
guruvākyaparāmarśasadṛśe svavimarśane /
prabuddhe tadvipakṣāṇāṃ vyudāsaḥ pāṭhacintane // 100
meaning:
गुरुवाक्यपरामर्शसदृशे स्वविमर्शने /
प्रबुद्धे तद्विपक्षाणां व्युदासः पाठचिन्तने // 100
text_mt: When one's own reflective awareness, resembling the contemplation of the guru's words, / is awakened, the removal of its opposites occurs through study and contemplation.

sanskrit_iast:
nahyasya guruṇā śakyaṃ svaṃ jñānaṃ śabda eva vā /
dhiyi ropayituṃ tena svaprabodhakramo dhruvam // 101
meaning:
नह्यस्य गुरुणा शक्यं स्वं ज्ञानं शब्द एव वा /
धियि रोपयितुं तेन स्वप्रबोधक्रमो ध्रुवम् // 101
text_mt: For the guru cannot implant his own knowledge or speech / into another's intellect; by that [instruction], a sequence of self-awakening indeed [ensues].

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva svapnakāle śrute tatrāpi vastuni /
tādātmyabhāvanāyogo na phalāya na bhaṇyate // 102
meaning:
अत एव स्वप्नकाले श्रुते तत्रापि वस्तुनि /
तादात्म्यभावनायोगो न फलाय न भण्यते // 102
text_mt: For this very reason, even regarding a matter heard during a dream, / the application of contemplation on identity is not said to be devoid of fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃketānādare śabdaniṣṭhamāmarśanaṃ paṭhiḥ /
tadādare tadarthastu cinteti paricarcyatām // 103
meaning:
संकेतानादरे शब्दनिष्ठमामर्शनं पठिः /
तदादरे तदर्थस्तु चिन्तेति परिचर्च्यताम् // 103
text_mt: Recitation is reflection resting in speech without regard to convention; / but when that [convention] is respected, its meaning is contemplation—let this be investigated.

sanskrit_iast:
tadadvayāyāṃ saṃvittāvabhyāso'nupayogavān /
kevalaṃ dvaitamālinyaśaṅkānirmūlanāya saḥ // 104
meaning:
तदद्वयायां संवित्तावभ्यासोऽनुपयोगवान् /
केवलं द्वैतमालिन्यशङ्कानिर्मूलनाय सः // 104
text_mt: Therefore, in non-dual consciousness practice is useless; / it serves solely to eradicate the suspicion of the stain of duality.

sanskrit_iast:
dvaitaśaṅkāśca tarkeṇa tarkyanta iti varṇitam /
tattarkasādhanāyāstu yamāderapyupāyatā // 105
meaning:
द्वैतशङ्काश्च तर्केण तर्क्यन्त इति वर्णितम् /
तत्तर्कसाधनायास्तु यमादेरप्युपायता // 105
text_mt: And doubts regarding duality are resolved by discernment (tarka), as has been explained; / but yama and the other [limbs] serve as expedients for the attainment of that discernment.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrīpūrvaśastre ca na dvaitaṃ nāpi cādvayam /
liṅgapūjādikaṃ sarvamityupakramya śaṃbhunā // 106
meaning:
उक्तं श्रीपूर्वशस्त्रे च न द्वैतं नापि चाद्वयम् /
लिङ्गपूजादिकं सर्वमित्युपक्रम्य शंभुना // 106
text_mt: And in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara, starting with the statement: / "Neither duality nor non-duality, all things such as liṅga worship, etc.,

sanskrit_iast:
vihitaṃ sarvamevātra pratiṣiddhamathāpi vā /
prāṇāyāmādikairaṅgairyogāḥ syuḥ kṛttrimā yataḥ // 107
meaning:
विहितं सर्वमेवात्र प्रतिषिद्धमथापि वा /
प्राणायामादिकैरङ्गैर्योगाः स्युः कृत्त्रिमा यतः // 107
text_mt: are here enjoined, or even prohibited," / Śambhu [said]: "Since yogas attained through limbs like prāṇāyāma are artificial,

sanskrit_iast:
tattenākṛtakasyāsya kalāṃ nārghanti ṣoḍaśīm /
kiṃ tvetadatra deveśi niyamena vidhīyate // 108
meaning:
तत्तेनाकृतकस्यास्य कलां नार्घन्ति षोडशीम् /
किं त्वेतदत्र देवेशि नियमेन विधीयते // 108
text_mt: therefore they are not worth a sixteenth part of this uncreated [yoga]. / But this, O goddess of the gods, is enjoined here as a rule:

sanskrit_iast:
tattve cetaḥ sthiraṃ kāryaṃ tacca yasya yathāstviti /
evaṃ dvaitaparāmarśanāśāya parameśvaraḥ // 109
meaning:
तत्त्वे चेतः स्थिरं कार्यं तच्च यस्य यथास्त्विति /
एवं द्वैतपरामर्शनाशाय परमेश्वरः // 109
text_mt: the mind must be made firm in reality, and that may be as it suits anyone." / Thus, to destroy the reflective awareness of duality, the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitsvabhāvamamalamāmṛśannaniśaṃ sthitaḥ /
yaḥ svabhāvaparāmarśa indriyārthādyupāyataḥ // 110
meaning:
क्वचित्स्वभावममलमामृशन्ननिशं स्थितः /
यः स्वभावपरामर्श इन्द्रियार्थाद्युपायतः // 110
text_mt: abiding incessantly reflecting upon His own immaculate nature, / [reveals that] reflective awareness of one's nature, arising through the senses and their objects

sanskrit_iast:
vinaiva tanmukho'nyo vā svātantryāttadvikalpanam /
tacca svacchasvatantrātmaratnanirbhāsini sphuṭam // 111
meaning:
विनैव तन्मुखोऽन्यो वा स्वातन्त्र्यात्तद्विकल्पनम् /
तच्च स्वच्छस्वतन्त्रात्मरत्ननिर्भासिनि स्फुटम् // 111
text_mt: or even without them, or another [awareness] arising through autonomy, is its conceptual construction. / And that [conceptual construction], clearly establishing differentiation among the multitude of entities

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaughe bhedasaṃdhātṛ svātmano naiśamucyate /
tadeva tu samastārthanirbharātmaikagocaram // 112
meaning:
भावौघे भेदसंधातृ स्वात्मनो नैशमुच्यते /
तदेव तु समस्तार्थनिर्भरात्मैकगोचरम् // 112
text_mt: appearing within the jewel of the pure, autonomous Self, is called the [nocturnal] night of the Self. / But that very [construct] which has for its sole domain the Self full of all things,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhavidyātmakaṃ sarvamevedamahamityalam /
idaṃ vikalpanaṃ śuddhavidyārūpaṃ sphuṭātmakam // 113
meaning:
शुद्धविद्यात्मकं सर्वमेवेदमहमित्यलम् /
इदं विकल्पनं शुद्धविद्यारूपं स्फुटात्मकम् // 113
text_mt: consisting of pure knowledge (śuddhavidyā) as "All this is indeed myself"— / this conceptual construct, having the nature of pure knowledge and fully manifest,

sanskrit_iast:
pratihantīha māyīyaṃ vikalpaṃ bhedabhāvakam /
śuddhavidyāparāmarśo yaḥ sa eva tvanekadhā // 114
meaning:
प्रतिहन्तीह मायीयं विकल्पं भेदभावकम् /
शुद्धविद्यापरामर्शो यः स एव त्वनेकधा // 114
text_mt: completely strikes down the construct of Māyā that creates duality. / That reflective awareness of pure knowledge, however, is manifold

sanskrit_iast:
snānaśuddhyarcanāhomadhyānajapyādiyogataḥ /
viśvametatsvasaṃvittirasanirbharitaṃ rasāt // 115
meaning:
स्नानशुद्ध्यर्चनाहोमध्यानजप्यादियोगतः /
विश्वमेतत्स्वसंवित्तिरसनिर्भरितं रसात् // 115
text_mt: through bath, purification, worship, oblations, meditation, recitation, and the like. / Joyfully penetrating this universe, which is brimming with the nectar of one's own consciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
āviśya śuddho nikhilaṃ tarpayedadhvamaṇlam /
ullāsibodhahutabhugdagdhaviśvendhanodite // 116
meaning:
आविश्य शुद्धो निखिलं तर्पयेदध्वमण्लम् /
उल्लासिबोधहुतभुग्दग्धविश्वेन्धनोदिते // 116
text_mt: the purified one should gratify the entire wheel of the path. / When the fuel of the universe is burned by the flaming fire of consciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
sitabhasmani dehasya majjanaṃ snānamucyate /
itthaṃ ca vihitasnānastarpitānantadevataḥ // 117
meaning:
सितभस्मनि देहस्य मज्जनं स्नानमुच्यते /
इत्थं च विहितस्नानस्तर्पितानन्तदेवतः // 117
text_mt: the immersion of the body in the resulting white ash is called the bath. / Having thus performed the bath, having satisfied the infinite deities,

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi dehārambhīṇi tattvāni pariśodhayet /
śivātmakeṣvapyeteṣu buddhiryā vyatirekiṇī // 118
meaning:
ततोऽपि देहारम्भीणि तत्त्वानि परिशोधयेत् /
शिवात्मकेष्वप्येतेषु बुद्धिर्या व्यतिरेकिणी // 118
text_mt: he should then thoroughly purify the principles that constitute the body. / Even though these consist of Śiva, that awareness which separates them [from Him]

sanskrit_iast:
saivāśuddhiḥ parākhyātā śuddhistaddhīvimardanam /
evaṃ svadehaṃ bodhaikapātraṃ galitabhedakam // 119
meaning:
सैवाशुद्धिः पराख्याता शुद्धिस्तद्धीविमर्दनम् /
एवं स्वदेहं बोधैकपात्रं गलितभेदकम् // 119
text_mt: is said to be the supreme impurity; purification is the crushing of that awareness. / Thus viewing his own body as the sole vessel of consciousness, free of differentiation,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyansaṃvittimātratve svatantre tiṣṭhati prabhuḥ /
yatkiṃcinmānasāhlādi yatra kvāpīndriyasthitau // 120
meaning:
पश्यन्संवित्तिमात्रत्वे स्वतन्त्रे तिष्ठति प्रभुः /
यत्किंचिन्मानसाह्लादि यत्र क्वापीन्द्रियस्थितौ // 120
text_mt: the Lord abides in autonomous pure consciousness alone. / Whatever delights the mind, wherever the senses may be situated,

sanskrit_iast:
yojyate brahmasaddhāmni pūjopakaraṇaṃ hi tat /
pūjā nāma vibhinnasya bhāvaughasyāpi saṃgatiḥ // 121
meaning:
योज्यते ब्रह्मसद्धाम्नि पूजोपकरणं हि तत् /
पूजा नाम विभिन्नस्य भावौघस्यापि संगतिः // 121
text_mt: is offered into the real abode of Brahman; that is indeed an implement of worship. / Worship is the union even of a differentiated stream of entities

sanskrit_iast:
svatantravimalānantabhairavīyacidātmanā /
tathāhi saṃvideveyamantarbāhyobhayātmanā // 122
meaning:
स्वतन्त्रविमलानन्तभैरवीयचिदात्मना /
तथाहि संविदेवेयमन्तर्बाह्योभयात्मना // 122
text_mt: with the consciousness of Bhairava, which is autonomous, immaculate, and infinite. / For this very consciousness, by virtue of its absolute autonomy,

sanskrit_iast:
svātantryādvartamānaiva parāmarśasvarūpiṇī /
sa ca dvādaśadhā tatra sarvamantarbhavedyataḥ // 123
meaning:
स्वातन्त्र्याद्वर्तमानैव परामर्शस्वरूपिणी /
स च द्वादशधा तत्र सर्वमन्तर्भवेद्यतः // 123
text_mt: abides consisting of reflective awareness, having an internal, external, and dual nature; / and that is twelvefold, because everything is contained within it.

sanskrit_iast:
sūrya eva hi somātmā sa ca viśvamayaḥ sthitaḥ /
kalādvādaśakātmaiva tatsaṃvitparamārthataḥ // 124
meaning:
सूर्य एव हि सोमात्मा स च विश्वमयः स्थितः /
कलाद्वादशकात्मैव तत्संवित्परमार्थतः // 124
text_mt: For the sun itself has the nature of the moon, and it abides consisting of the universe; / in ultimate truth, that consciousness has the nature of the twelve kalās.

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca mātari vijñāne māne karaṇagocare /
meye caturvidhaṃ bhāti rūpamāśritya sarvadā // 125
meaning:
सा च मातरि विज्ञाने माने करणगोचरे /
मेये चतुर्विधं भाति रूपमाश्रित्य सर्वदा // 125
text_mt: And it always shines having assumed a fourfold form: / in the knower, in cognition, in the means of knowledge situated in the sense organ, and in the knowable.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhasaṃvinmayī prācye jñāne śabdanarūpiṇī /
karaṇe grahaṇākārā yataḥ śrīyogasaṃcare // 126
meaning:
शुद्धसंविन्मयी प्राच्ये ज्ञाने शब्दनरूपिणी /
करणे ग्रहणाकारा यतः श्रीयोगसंचरे // 126
text_mt: In the first it consists of pure consciousness, in cognition it consists of verbal articulation, / and in the instrument it takes the form of apprehension, as is said in the venerable Yogasaṃcara:

sanskrit_iast:
ye cakṣurmaṇḍale śvete pratyakṣe parameśvari /
ṣoḍaśāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ tatrasthaṃ cakramuttamam // 127
meaning:
ये चक्षुर्मण्डले श्वेते प्रत्यक्षे परमेश्वरि /
षोडशारं द्वादशारं तत्रस्थं चक्रमुत्तमम् // 127
text_mt: "The two white circles of the eyes, O supreme goddess, visible to perception— / situated there is the supreme wheel of sixteen spokes and twelve spokes;

sanskrit_iast:
prativāraṇavadrakte tadbahirye taducyate /
dvitīyaṃ madhyage ye te kṛṣṇaśvete ca maṇḍale // 128
meaning:
प्रतिवारणवद्रक्ते तद्बहिर्ये तदुच्यते /
द्वितीयं मध्यगे ये ते कृष्णश्वेते च मण्डले // 128
text_mt: it is said to be like a protective rim outside them, [radiating] red. / The second [pair] consists of the black and white circles in the center;

sanskrit_iast:
tadantarye sthite śuddhe bhinnāñjanasamaprabhe /
caturdale tu te jñeye agnīṣomātmake priye // 129
meaning:
तदन्तर्ये स्थिते शुद्धे भिन्नाञ्जनसमप्रभे /
चतुर्दले तु ते ज्ञेये अग्नीषोमात्मके प्रिये // 129
text_mt: those resting within them, pure and radiant like crushed collyrium, / are to be known as having four petals, O dear one, composed of fire and moon.

sanskrit_iast:
mithunatve sthite ye ca cakre dve parameśvari /
saṃmīlanonmīlanaṃ te anyonyaṃ vidadhātake // 130
meaning:
मिथुनत्वे स्थिते ये च चक्रे द्वे परमेश्वरि /
संमीलनोन्मीलनं ते अन्योन्यं विदधातके // 130
text_mt: And the two wheels that abide as a couple, O supreme goddess, / continuously close and open each other.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yoniśca liṅgaṃ ca saṃyogātsravato'mṛtam /
tathāmṛtāgnisaṃyogāddravataste na saṃśayaḥ // 131
meaning:
यथा योनिश्च लिङ्गं च संयोगात्स्रवतोऽमृतम् /
तथामृताग्निसंयोगाद्द्रवतस्ते न संशयः // 131
text_mt: Just as the yoni and the liṅga emit nectar from their union, / so from the union of fire and nectar do they melt without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
taccakrapīḍanādrātrau jyotirbhātyarkasomagam /
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāṃ jyotsnāṃ kālajñānaṃ pravartate // 132
meaning:
तच्चक्रपीडनाद्रात्रौ ज्योतिर्भात्यर्कसोमगम् /
तां दृष्ट्वा परमां ज्योत्स्नां कालज्ञानं प्रवर्तते // 132
text_mt: From the compression of those wheels, at night the light going to sun and moon shines forth; / beholding that supreme moonlight, knowledge of time arises.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāraṃ bhaveccakraṃ tābhyāmupari saṃsthitam /
tataścakrātsamudbhūtaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ tadudāhṛtam // 133
meaning:
सहस्रारं भवेच्चक्रं ताभ्यामुपरि संस्थितम् /
ततश्चक्रात्समुद्भूतं ब्रह्माण्डं तदुदाहृतम् // 133
text_mt: A thousand-spoked wheel exists, situated above them; / from that wheel arises the egg of Brahmā, so it is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthāṃ muñcate dhārāṃ somo hyagnipradīpitaḥ /
sṛjatītthaṃ jagatsarvamātmanyātmanyanantakam // 134
meaning:
तत्रस्थां मुञ्चते धारां सोमो ह्यग्निप्रदीपितः /
सृजतीत्थं जगत्सर्वमात्मन्यात्मन्यनन्तकम् // 134
text_mt: The moon, ignited by fire, releases the stream situated therein; / in this way it creates the whole universe, infinite, in self after self.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśadvādaśārābhyāmaṣṭāreṣvatha sarvaśaḥ /
evaṃ krameṇa sarvatra cakreṣvamṛtamuttamam // 135
meaning:
षोडशद्वादशाराभ्यामष्टारेष्वथ सर्वशः /
एवं क्रमेण सर्वत्र चक्रेष्वमृतमुत्तमम् // 135
text_mt: From the sixteen- and twelve-spoked wheels to the eight-spoked wheels everywhere, / in this sequence throughout all the wheels, the supreme nectar,

sanskrit_iast:
somaḥ sravati yāvacca pañcānāṃ cakrapaddhatiḥ /
tatpunaḥ pibati prītyā haṃso haṃsa iti sphuran // 136
meaning:
सोमः स्रवति यावच्च पञ्चानां चक्रपद्धतिः /
तत्पुनः पिबति प्रीत्या हंसो हंस इति स्फुरन् // 136
text_mt: the moon, flows as far as the path of the five wheels; / and that again the Haṃsa drinks with delight, throbbing as 'haṃsa haṃsa'.

sanskrit_iast:
sakṛdyasya tu saṃśrutyā puṇyapāpairna lipyate /
pañcāre savikāro'tha bhūtvā somasrutāmṛtāt // 137
meaning:
सकृद्यस्य तु संश्रुत्या पुण्यपापैर्न लिप्यते /
पञ्चारे सविकारोऽथ भूत्वा सोमस्रुतामृतात् // 137
text_mt: Hearing this but once, one is not tainted by merits or sins. / Then, undergoing transformation in the five-spoked [wheel] from the nectar flowed by the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
dhāvati trirasārāṇi guhyacakrāṇyasau vibhuḥ /
yato jātaṃ jagallīnaṃ yatra ca svakalīlayā // 138
meaning:
धावति त्रिरसाराणि गुह्यचक्राण्यसौ विभुः /
यतो जातं जगल्लीनं यत्र च स्वकलीलया // 138
