text_mt: this all-pervading Lord rushes to the secret wheels of three and six spokes, / from which the universe is born and into which it dissolves by His own play.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrānandaśca sarvasya brahmacārī ca tatparaḥ /
tatra siddhiśca muktiśca samaṃ saṃprāpyate dvayam // 139
meaning:
तत्रानन्दश्च सर्वस्य ब्रह्मचारी च तत्परः /
तत्र सिद्धिश्च मुक्तिश्च समं संप्राप्यते द्वयम् // 139
text_mt: There is the bliss of everything, and the celibate is intent upon it; / there, both spiritual accomplishment and liberation are attained simultaneously."

sanskrit_iast:
ata ūrdhvaṃ punaryāti yāvadbrahmātmakaṃ padam /
agnīṣomau samau tatra sṛjyete cātmanātmani // 140
meaning:
अत ऊर्ध्वं पुनर्याति यावद्ब्रह्मात्मकं पदम् /
अग्नीषोमौ समौ तत्र सृज्येते चात्मनात्मनि // 140
text_mt: From here it rises further, reaching up to the state identical with Brahman; / there fire and moon are created equal by the Self within the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthastāpitaḥ somo dvedhā jaṅghe vyavasthitaḥ /
adhastaṃ pātayedagniramṛtaṃ sravati kṣaṇāt // 141
meaning:
तत्रस्थस्तापितः सोमो द्वेधा जङ्घे व्यवस्थितः /
अधस्तं पातयेदग्निरमृतं स्रवति क्षणात् // 141
text_mt: Residing there and heated, the moon stationed two-fold in the shanks / is cast downwards by the fire, and nectar flows in an instant.

sanskrit_iast:
gulphajānvādiṣu vyaktaṃ kuṭilārkapradīpitā /
sā śaktistāpitā bhūyaḥ pañcārādikramaṃ sṛjet // 142
meaning:
गुल्फजान्वादिषु व्यक्तं कुटिलार्कप्रदीपिता /
सा शक्तिस्तापिता भूयः पञ्चारादिक्रमं सृजेत् // 142
text_mt: Clearly kindled by the coiled sun in the ankles, knees, and so forth, / that heated power generates once again the sequence beginning with the five-spoked [wheel].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śrotre'pi vijñeyaṃ yāvatpādāntagocaram /
pādāṅguṣṭhātsamārabhya yāvadbrahmāṇḍadarśanam // 143
meaning:
एवं श्रोत्रेऽपि विज्ञेयं यावत्पादान्तगोचरम् /
पादाङ्गुष्ठात्समारभ्य यावद्ब्रह्माण्डदर्शनम् // 143
text_mt: In this way it should be understood in the ear, as far as the range ending at the feet, / starting from the big toe of the foot up to the perception of the cosmic egg.

sanskrit_iast:
ityajānannaiva yogī jānanviśvaprabhurbhavet /
jvalannivāsau brahmādyairdṛśyate parameśvaraḥ // 144
meaning:
इत्यजानन्नैव योगी जानन्विश्वप्रभुर्भवेत् /
ज्वलन्निवासौ ब्रह्माद्यैर्दृश्यते परमेश्वरः // 144
text_mt: Not knowing this, one is no yogin at all; knowing it, one becomes the lord of the universe. / Blazing, as it were, this Supreme Lord is beheld by Brahmā and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
atra tātparyataḥ proktamakṣe kramacatuṣṭayam /
ekaikatra yatastena dvādaśātmakatoditā // 145
meaning:
अत्र तात्पर्यतः प्रोक्तमक्षे क्रमचतुष्टयम् /
एकैकत्र यतस्तेन द्वादशात्मकतोदिता // 145
text_mt: Here, essentially, a quadruple succession has been declared in each sense organ; / because it is present in each one, a twelvefold nature has thereby been proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
na vyākhyātaṃ tu nirbhajya yato'tisarahasyakam /
meye'pi devī tiṣṭhantī māsarāśyādirūpiṇī // 146
meaning:
न व्याख्यातं तु निर्भज्य यतोऽतिसरहस्यकम् /
मेयेऽपि देवी तिष्ठन्ती मासराश्यादिरूपिणी // 146
text_mt: It has not been explained in full detail, however, because it is deeply esoteric. / Even in the object of knowledge the goddess abides, taking the form of the months, zodiacal signs, and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
ata eṣā sthitā saṃvidantarbāhyobhayātmanā /
svayaṃ nirbhāsya tatrānyadbhāsayantīva bhāsate // 147
meaning:
अत एषा स्थिता संविदन्तर्बाह्योभयात्मना /
स्वयं निर्भास्य तत्रान्यद्भासयन्तीव भासते // 147
text_mt: Therefore this consciousness abides as both internal and external: / manifesting itself, it shines as though illuminating something else within itself.

sanskrit_iast:
tataśca prāgiyaṃ śuddhā tathābhāsanasotsukā /
sṛṣṭiṃ kalayate devī tannāmnāgama ucyate // 148
meaning:
ततश्च प्रागियं शुद्धा तथाभासनसोत्सुका /
सृष्टिं कलयते देवी तन्नाम्नागम उच्यते // 148
text_mt: And therefore, initially pure and eager to manifest in such a manner, / the goddess projects creation; she is designated by that name in the scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā bhāsitavastvaṃśarañjanāṃ sā bahirmukhī /
svavṛtticakreṇa samaṃ tato'pi kalayantyalam // 149
meaning:
तथा भासितवस्त्वंशरञ्जनां सा बहिर्मुखी /
स्ववृत्तिचक्रेण समं ततोऽपि कलयन्त्यलम् // 149
text_mt: Directed outward, she colors the parts of the objects thus manifested; / along with the wheel of her own faculties, she then fully projects maintenance.

sanskrit_iast:
sthitireṣaiva bhāvasya tāmantarmukhatārasāt /
saṃjihīrṣuḥ sthiternāśaṃ kalayantī nirucyate // 150
meaning:
स्थितिरेषैव भावस्य तामन्तर्मुखतारसात् /
संजिहीर्षुः स्थितेर्नाशं कलयन्ती निरुच्यते // 150
text_mt: This very [process] is the persistence of an entity; through the savor of inward turning, / desiring to withdraw that [entity], she is described as projecting the destruction of its persistence.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi saṃhārarase pūrṇe vighnakarīṃ svayam /
śaṅkāṃ yamātmikāṃ bhāge sūte saṃharate'pi ca // 151
meaning:
ततोऽपि संहाररसे पूर्णे विघ्नकरीं स्वयम् /
शङ्कां यमात्मिकां भागे सूते संहरतेऽपि च // 151
text_mt: Even then, when the savor of withdrawal is full, she herself produces / and also withdraws doubt in the [objective] realm—a hinderer having the nature of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhṛtya śaṅkāṃ śaṅkyārthavarjaṃ vā bhāvamaṇḍale /
saṃhṛtiṃ kalayatyeva svātmavahnau vilāpanāt // 152
meaning:
संहृत्य शङ्कां शङ्क्यार्थवर्जं वा भावमण्डले /
संहृतिं कलयत्येव स्वात्मवह्नौ विलापनात् // 152
text_mt: Having withdrawn doubt, or else excluding the object of doubt, in the circle of entities / she indeed projects dissolution through liquefaction into the fire of her own self.

sanskrit_iast:
vilāpanātmikāṃ tāṃ ca bhāvasaṃhṛtimātmani /
āmṛśatyeva yenaiṣā mayā grastamiti sphuret // 153
meaning:
विलापनात्मिकां तां च भावसंहृतिमात्मनि /
आमृशत्येव येनैषा मया ग्रस्तमिति स्फुरेत् // 153
text_mt: And within herself she directly grasps that dissolution of entities consisting of liquefaction, / so that this vibrant awareness pulses: “It has been swallowed by me.”

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhāryopādhiretasyāḥ svasvabhāvo hi saṃvidaḥ /
nirupādhini saṃśuddhe saṃvidrūpeṣastamīyate // 154
meaning:
संहार्योपाधिरेतस्याः स्वस्वभावो हि संविदः /
निरुपाधिनि संशुद्धे संविद्रूपेषस्तमीयते // 154
text_mt: For the limiting condition to be dissolved belongs to the very nature of this consciousness; / it comes to an end in the pure form of consciousness devoid of limiting conditions.

sanskrit_iast:
vilāpite'pi bhāvaughe kaṃcidbhāvaṃ tadaiva sā /
āśyānayedya evāste śaṅkā saṃskārarūpakaḥ // 155
meaning:
विलापितेऽपि भावौघे कंचिद्भावं तदैव सा /
आश्यानयेद्य एवास्ते शङ्का संस्काररूपकः // 155
text_mt: Even when the flood of entities is dissolved, she may at that very moment / solidify some entity that remains in the form of the residual trace of doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśubhatayā so'yaṃ soṣyate phalasaṃpadam /
pūrvaṃ hi bhogātpaścādvā śaṅkeyaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate // 156
meaning:
शुभाशुभतया सोऽयं सोष्यते फलसंपदम् /
पूर्वं हि भोगात्पश्चाद्वा शङ्केयं व्यवतिष्ठते // 156
text_mt: In the form of the auspicious or inauspicious, this will yield an abundance of fruit; / for either before enjoyment or after, this doubt remains.

sanskrit_iast:
anyadāśyānitamapi tadaiva drāvayediyam /
prāyaścittādikarmabhyo brahmahatyādikarmavat // 157
meaning:
अन्यदाश्यानितमपि तदैव द्रावयेदियम् /
प्रायश्चित्तादिकर्मभ्यो ब्रह्महत्यादिकर्मवत् // 157
text_mt: Even what has been solidified at another time she may liquefy at that very moment, / just as actions such as the murder of a brahmin [are dissolved] through actions such as expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
rodhanāddrāvaṇādrūpamitthaṃ kalayate citiḥ /
tadapi drāvayedeva tadapyāśyānayedatha // 158
meaning:
रोधनाद्द्रावणाद्रूपमित्थं कलयते चितिः /
तदपि द्रावयेदेव तदप्याश्यानयेदथ // 158
text_mt: Consciousness thus projects form through obstruction and liquefaction; / it may also liquefy that very [form], or it may then solidify it.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ bhogye'pi saṃbhukte sati tatkaraṇānyapi /
saṃharantī kalayate dvādaśaivāhamātmani // 159
meaning:
इत्थं भोग्येऽपि संभुक्ते सति तत्करणान्यपि /
संहरन्ती कलयते द्वादशैवाहमात्मनि // 159
text_mt: In this way, even when the object of enjoyment has been enjoyed, / she withdraws the instruments of that [enjoyment] and projects precisely twelve [forms] in the Self of “I”.

sanskrit_iast:
karmabuddhyakṣavargo hi buddhyanto dvādaśātmakaḥ /
prakāśakatvātsūryātmā bhinne vastuni jṛmbhate // 160
meaning:
कर्मबुद्ध्यक्षवर्गो हि बुद्ध्यन्तो द्वादशात्मकः /
प्रकाशकत्वात्सूर्यात्मा भिन्ने वस्तुनि जृम्भते // 160
text_mt: For the group of the senses of action and intellect, ending with the intellect, consists of twelve parts; / having the nature of the sun due to its illuminating power, it expands toward differentiated objects.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃkārastu karaṇamabhimānaikasādhanam /
avicchinnaparāmarśī līyate tena tatra saḥ // 161
meaning:
अहंकारस्तु करणमभिमानैकसाधनम् /
अविच्छिन्नपरामर्शी लीयते तेन तत्र सः // 161
text_mt: The ego, however, is the instrument whose sole function is appropriation; / having continuous reflective awareness, it dissolves therein.

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhi khaṅgapāśādeḥ karaṇasya vibhedinaḥ /
abhedini svahastādau layastadvadayaṃ vidhiḥ // 162
meaning:
यथाहि खङ्गपाशादेः करणस्य विभेदिनः /
अभेदिनि स्वहस्तादौ लयस्तद्वदयं विधिः // 162
text_mt: For just as an instrument that produces division, such as a sword or noose, / dissolves into that which is undivided, such as one's own hand, so too is this rule.

sanskrit_iast:
tenendriyaughamārtaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ kalayetsvayam /
saṃviddevī svatantratvātkalpite'haṃkṛtātmani // 163
meaning:
तेनेन्द्रियौघमार्तण्डमण्डलं कलयेत्स्वयम् /
संविद्देवी स्वतन्त्रत्वात्कल्पितेऽहंकृतात्मनि // 163
text_mt: Therefore the goddess of consciousness, by virtue of her autonomy, projects / the solar orb of the senses into the fabricated self of the ego.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva paramādityaḥ pūrṇakalpastrayodaśaḥ /
karaṇatvātprayātyeva kartari pralayaṃ sphuṭam // 164
meaning:
स एव परमादित्यः पूर्णकल्पस्त्रयोदशः /
करणत्वात्प्रयात्येव कर्तरि प्रलयं स्फुटम् // 164
text_mt: He alone is the supreme sun, nearly complete, the thirteenth; / because it is an instrument, it clearly undergoes dissolution in the agent.

sanskrit_iast:
kartā ca dvividhaḥ proktaḥ kalpitākalpitātmakaḥ /
kalpito dehabuddhyādivyavacchedena carcitaḥ // 165
meaning:
कर्ता च द्विविधः प्रोक्तः कल्पिताकल्पितात्मकः /
कल्पितो देहबुद्ध्यादिव्यवच्छेदेन चर्चितः // 165
text_mt: And the agent is declared to be of two kinds: having a fabricated nature and an unfabricated nature. / The fabricated one is considered through delimitation by the body, intellect, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnirudrasaṃjñāsya śāstreṣu paribhāṣitā /
kālo vyavacchittadyukto vahnirbhoktā yataḥ smṛtaḥ // 166
meaning:
कालाग्निरुद्रसंज्ञास्य शास्त्रेषु परिभाषिता /
कालो व्यवच्छित्तद्युक्तो वह्निर्भोक्ता यतः स्मृतः // 166
text_mt: His designation in the scriptures is defined as Kālāgnirudra; / for Time (kāla) is endowed with delimitation, and Fire (agni) is remembered as the enjoyer.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārāklṛptiklṛptibhyāṃ rodhanāddrāvaṇātprabhuḥ /
anivṛttapaśūbhāvastatrāhaṃkṛtpralīyate // 167
meaning:
संसाराक्लृप्तिक्लृप्तिभ्यां रोधनाद्द्रावणात्प्रभुः /
अनिवृत्तपशूभावस्तत्राहंकृत्प्रलीयते // 167
text_mt: Through the non-construction and construction of saṃsāra, through obstruction and liquefaction, the Lord / whose condition as a bound soul has not ceased dissolves the ego therein.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi kalpitavṛttitvādviśvābhedaikaśālini /
vikāsini mahākāle līyate'hamidaṃmaye // 168
meaning:
सोऽपि कल्पितवृत्तित्वाद्विश्वाभेदैकशालिनि /
विकासिनि महाकाले लीयतेऽहमिदंमये // 168
text_mt: Even he, having a fabricated activity, dissolves into the blossoming Mahākāla, / who is characterized solely by non-differentiation from the universe and consists of “I” and “this”.

sanskrit_iast:
etasyāṃ svātmasaṃvittāvidaṃ sarvamahaṃ vibhuḥ /
iti pravikasadrūpā saṃvittiravabhāsate // 169
meaning:
एतस्यां स्वात्मसंवित्ताविदं सर्वमहं विभुः /
इति प्रविकसद्रूपा संवित्तिरवभासते // 169
text_mt: In this consciousness of one's own Self, consciousness shines forth / in an expanding form, [aware that] “All this am I, the all-pervading Lord.”

sanskrit_iast:
tato'ntaḥsthitasarvātmabhāvabhogoparāgiṇī /
paripūrṇāpi saṃvittirakule dhāmni līyate // 170
meaning:
ततोऽन्तःस्थितसर्वात्मभावभोगोपरागिणी /
परिपूर्णापि संवित्तिरकुले धाम्नि लीयते // 170
text_mt: Then, colored by the enjoyment of all universal states resting within, / consciousness, though completely full, dissolves in the Akula abode.

sanskrit_iast:
pramātṛvargo mānaughaḥ pramāśca bahudhā sthitāḥ /
meyaugha iti yatsarvamatra cinmātrameva tat // 171
meaning:
प्रमातृवर्गो मानौघः प्रमाश्च बहुधा स्थिताः /
मेयौघ इति यत्सर्वमत्र चिन्मात्रमेव तत् // 171
text_mt: The class of knowers, the flood of means of knowledge, the diverse forms of valid cognition, / and the flood of knowables—all that is here nothing but pure consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
iyatīṃ rūpavaicitrīmāśrayantyāḥ svasaṃvidaḥ /
svācchandyamanapekṣaṃ yatsā parā parameśvarī // 172
meaning:
इयतीं रूपवैचित्रीमाश्रयन्त्याः स्वसंविदः /
स्वाच्छन्द्यमनपेक्षं यत्सा परा परमेश्वरी // 172
text_mt: That independent, unconditioned freedom of one's own consciousness, / which resorts to such variety of form, is the supreme Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
imāḥ prāguktakalanāstadvijṛmbhocyate yataḥ /
kṣepo jñānaṃ ca saṃkhyānaṃ gatirnāda iti kramāt // 173
meaning:
इमाः प्रागुक्तकलनास्तद्विजृम्भोच्यते यतः /
क्षेपो ज्ञानं च संख्यानं गतिर्नाद इति क्रमात् // 173
text_mt: For these aforesaid projections are said to be her expansion: / casting out, knowing, counting, motion, and sound, in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
svātmano bhedanaṃ kṣepo bheditasyāvikalpanam /
jñānaṃ vikalpaḥ saṃkhyānamanyato vyatibhedanāt // 174
meaning:
स्वात्मनो भेदनं क्षेपो भेदितस्याविकल्पनम् /
ज्ञानं विकल्पः संख्यानमन्यतो व्यतिभेदनात् // 174
text_mt: Casting out (kṣepa) is the differentiation of oneself; knowing (jñāna) is the non-differentiation of what has been differentiated; / counting (saṃkhyāna) is conceptual thought, through distinct differentiation from another;

sanskrit_iast:
gatiḥ svarūpārohitvaṃ pratibimbavadeva yat /
nādaḥ svātmaparāmarśaśeṣatā tadvilopanāt // 175
meaning:
गतिः स्वरूपारोहित्वं प्रतिबिम्बवदेव यत् /
नादः स्वात्मपरामर्शशेषता तद्विलोपनात् // 175
text_mt: motion (gati) is the ascending into one's own essential nature, just like a reflection; / sound (nāda) is the remaining as reflective awareness of one's Self, through the dissolution of that [reflected image].

sanskrit_iast:
iti pañcavidhāmenāṃ kalanāṃ kurvatī parā /
devī kālī tathā kālakarṣiṇī ceti kathyate // 176
meaning:
इति पञ्चविधामेनां कलनां कुर्वती परा /
देवी काली तथा कालकर्षिणी चेति कथ्यते // 176
text_mt: Performing this fivefold projection, the supreme / Goddess is called Kālī as well as Kālakarṣiṇī.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛsadbhāvasaṃjñāsyāstenoktā yatpramātṛṣu /
etāvadantasaṃvittau pramātṛtvaṃ sphuṭībhavet // 177
meaning:
मातृसद्भावसंज्ञास्यास्तेनोक्ता यत्प्रमातृषु /
एतावदन्तसंवित्तौ प्रमातृत्वं स्फुटीभवेत् // 177
text_mt: Her designation as “Mātṛsadbhāva” (the True Essence of the Mothers) is stated because in knowing subjects, / subjectivity becomes clear only when consciousness extends this far.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmeśvarīti-śabdena proktā śrīniśisaṃcare /
itthaṃ dvādaśadhā saṃvittiṣṭhantī viśvamātṛṣu // 178
meaning:
वामेश्वरीति-शब्देन प्रोक्ता श्रीनिशिसंचरे /
इत्थं द्वादशधा संवित्तिष्ठन्ती विश्वमातृषु // 178
text_mt: She is proclaimed by the word Vāmeśvarī in the venerable Niśisaṃcāra. / Abiding in this manner in twelve modes among the knowers of the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaiveti na ko'pyasyāḥ kramasya niyamaḥ kvacit /
kramābhāvānna yugapattadabhāvātkramo'pi na // 179
meaning:
एकैवेति न कोऽप्यस्याः क्रमस्य नियमः क्वचित् /
क्रमाभावान्न युगपत्तदभावात्क्रमोऽपि न // 179
text_mt: she is only one; thus there is no fixed rule anywhere regarding her succession. / Because there is no succession, there is no simultaneity; and because that is absent, there is not even succession.

sanskrit_iast:
kramākramakathātītaṃ saṃvittattvaṃ sunirmalam /
tadasyāḥ saṃvido devyā yatra kvāpi pravartanam // 180
meaning:
क्रमाक्रमकथातीतं संवित्तत्त्वं सुनिर्मलम् /
तदस्याः संविदो देव्या यत्र क्वापि प्रवर्तनम् // 180
text_mt: The principle of consciousness, utterly pure, transcends talk of succession and non-succession; / therefore, wherever this goddess of consciousness operates,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tādātmyayogena pūjā pūrṇaiva vartate /
parāmarśasvabhāvatvādetasyā yaḥ svayaṃ dhvaniḥ // 181
meaning:
तत्र तादात्म्ययोगेन पूजा पूर्णैव वर्तते /
परामर्शस्वभावत्वादेतस्या यः स्वयं ध्वनिः // 181
text_mt: right there worship occurs fully through identification [with her]. / The spontaneous sound that exists, because her essential nature is reflective awareness,

sanskrit_iast:
sadoditaḥ sa evoktaḥ paramaṃ hṛdayaṃ mahat /
hṛdaye svavimarśo'sau drāvitāśeṣaviśvakaḥ // 182
meaning:
सदोदितः स एवोक्तः परमं हृदयं महत् /
हृदये स्वविमर्शोऽसौ द्राविताशेषविश्वकः // 182
text_mt: and which is ever-risen, is declared to be the supreme, great Heart. / In the Heart, that reflective awareness of oneself, which has liquefied the entire universe,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvagrahādiparyantabhāvī sāmānyasaṃjñakaḥ /
spandaḥ sa kathyate śāstre svātmanyucchalanātmakaḥ // 183
meaning:
भावग्रहादिपर्यन्तभावी सामान्यसंज्ञकः /
स्पन्दः स कथ्यते शास्त्रे स्वात्मन्युच्छलनात्मकः // 183
text_mt: and exists right up to the grasping of objects, is called the universal; / in scripture it is called spanda, which consists in surging up within oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃciccalanametāvadananyasphuraṇaṃ hi yat /
ūrmireṣā vibodhābdherna saṃvidanayā vinā // 184
meaning:
किंचिच्चलनमेतावदनन्यस्फुरणं हि यत् /
ऊर्मिरेषा विबोधाब्धेर्न संविदनया विना // 184
text_mt: For that subtle movement is just this: the vibrant radiance that is non-different [from consciousness]. / This is the wave of the ocean of awakening; without it there is no consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
nistaraṅgataraṅgādivṛttireva hi sindhutā /
sārametatsamastasya yaccitsāraṃ jaḍaṃ jagat // 185
meaning:
निस्तरङ्गतरङ्गादिवृत्तिरेव हि सिन्धुता /
सारमेतत्समस्तस्य यच्चित्सारं जडं जगत् // 185
text_mt: For being an ocean consists precisely in the states of wavelessness, waves, and the like. / This is the essence of all: that the insentient universe has consciousness as its essence.

sanskrit_iast:
tadadhīnapratiṣṭhatvāttatsāraṃ hṛdayaṃ mahat /
tathā hi sadidaṃ brahmamūlaṃ māyāṇḍasaṃjñitam // 186
meaning:
तदधीनप्रतिष्ठत्वात्तत्सारं हृदयं महत् /
तथा हि सदिदं ब्रह्ममूलं मायाण्डसंज्ञितम् // 186
text_mt: Because its subsistence depends upon it, its essence is the great heart. / For this existing world, rooted in Brahman, is termed the cosmic egg of Māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
icchājñānakriyārohaṃ vinā naiva saducyate /
tacchaktitritayārohādbhairavīye cidātmani // 187
meaning:
इच्छाज्ञानक्रियारोहं विना नैव सदुच्यते /
तच्छक्तित्रितयारोहाद्भैरवीये चिदात्मनि // 187
text_mt: Without ascending into will, knowledge, and action, it is not spoken of as existing at all. / From ascending into this triad of powers within the conscious self belonging to Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjyate hi tattasmādbahirvātha visṛjyate /
evaṃ sadrūpataivaiṣāṃ satāṃ śaktitrayātmatām // 188
meaning:
विसृज्यते हि तत्तस्माद्बहिर्वाथ विसृज्यते /
एवं सद्रूपतैवैषां सतां शक्तित्रयात्मताम् // 188
text_mt: it is indeed emitted from it, or rather, it is emitted externally. / Thus, the very state of existence of these real entities is the nature of the triad of powers,

sanskrit_iast:
visargaṃ parabodhena samākṣipyaiva vartate /
tatsadeva bahīrūpaṃ prāgbodhāgnivilāpitam // 189
meaning:
विसर्गं परबोधेन समाक्षिप्यैव वर्तते /
तत्सदेव बहीरूपं प्राग्बोधाग्निविलापितम् // 189
text_mt: and abides precisely by comprehending creative emission through supreme awakening. / That very real entity, appearing externally, is first dissolved in the fire of awakening;

sanskrit_iast:
antarnadatparāmarśaśeṣībhūtaṃ tato'pyalam /
khātmatvameva saṃprāptaṃ śaktitritayagocarāt // 190
meaning:
अन्तर्नदत्परामर्शशेषीभूतं ततोऽप्यलम् /
खात्मत्वमेव संप्राप्तं शक्तित्रितयगोचरात् // 190
text_mt: reduced to the residue of reflective awareness sounding internally, and then thoroughly / attaining the very nature of empty space from the domain of the triad of powers,

sanskrit_iast:
vedanātmakatāmetya saṃhārātmani līyate /
idaṃ saṃhārahṛdayaṃ prācyaṃ sṛṣṭau ca hṛnmatam // 191
meaning:
वेदनात्मकतामेत्य संहारात्मनि लीयते /
इदं संहारहृदयं प्राच्यं सृष्टौ च हृन्मतम् // 191
text_mt: it reaches the nature of pure knowing and dissolves in the self of reabsorption. / This is considered the heart of reabsorption, and the heart previously mentioned in emission.

sanskrit_iast:
etadrūpaparāmarśamakṛtrimamanābilam /
ahamityāhureṣaiva prakāśasya prakāśatā // 192
meaning:
एतद्रूपपरामर्शमकृत्रिममनाबिलम् /
अहमित्याहुरेषैव प्रकाशस्य प्रकाशता // 192
text_mt: They call this genuine, unclouded reflective awareness of such a nature / 'I'; this alone is the luminosity of luminosity.

sanskrit_iast:
etadvīryaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ hṛdayātmakam /
vinānena jaḍāste syurjīvā iva vinā hṛdā // 193
meaning:
एतद्वीर्यं हि सर्वेषां मन्त्राणां हृदयात्मकम् /
विनानेन जडास्ते स्युर्जीवा इव विना हृदा // 193
text_mt: For this is the potency of all mantras, consisting of the heart. / Without it, they would be insentient, like living beings without a heart.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtrimaitaddhṛdayārūḍho yatkiṃcidācaret /
prāṇyādvā mṛśate vāpi sa sarvo'sya japo mataḥ // 194
meaning:
अकृत्रिमैतद्धृदयारूढो यत्किंचिदाचरेत् /
प्राण्याद्वा मृशते वापि स सर्वोऽस्य जपो मतः // 194
text_mt: Whatever one who has mounted this genuine heart may perform, / or whether he breathes or perceives, all that is considered his repetition of mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
yadeva svecchayā sṛṣṭisvābhāvyādbahirantarā /
nirmīyate tadevāsya dhyānaṃ syātpāramārthikam // 195
meaning:
यदेव स्वेच्छया सृष्टिस्वाभाव्याद्बहिरन्तरा /
निर्मीयते तदेवास्य ध्यानं स्यात्पारमार्थिकम् // 195
text_mt: Whatever is created externally or internally by his own will through the inherent nature of emission, / that alone would be his ultimate meditation.

sanskrit_iast:
nirākāre hi ciddhāmni viśvākṛtimaye sati /
phalārthināṃ kācideva dhyeyatvenākṛtiḥ sthitā // 196
meaning:
निराकारे हि चिद्धाम्नि विश्वाकृतिमये सति /
फलार्थिनां काचिदेव ध्येयत्वेनाकृतिः स्थिता // 196
text_mt: Indeed, when the formless realm of consciousness consists of all forms, / only a particular form is established as an object of meditation for those who seek fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā hyabhedātpūrṇe'pi bhāve jalamupāharan /
anyākṛtyapahānena ghaṭamarthayate rasāt // 197
meaning:
यथा ह्यभेदात्पूर्णेऽपि भावे जलमुपाहरन् /
अन्याकृत्यपहानेन घटमर्थयते रसात् // 197
text_mt: Just as someone fetching water, though reality is full in its non-difference, / eagerly seeks a pot, disregarding other forms,

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva parameśānaniyatipravijṛmbhaṇāt /
kācidevākṛtiḥ kāṃcit sūte phalavikalpanām // 198
meaning:
तथैव परमेशाननियतिप्रविजृम्भणात् /
काचिदेवाकृतिः कांचित् सूते फलविकल्पनाम् // 198
text_mt: so, too, through the unfolding of the Supreme Lord's restriction, / a particular form generates a particular conceptualization of fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu saṃpūrṇahṛdayo na phalaṃ nāma vāñchati /
tasya viśvākṛtirdevī sā cāvacchedavarjanāt // 199
meaning:
यस्तु संपूर्णहृदयो न फलं नाम वाञ्छति /
तस्य विश्वाकृतिर्देवी सा चावच्छेदवर्जनात् // 199
text_mt: However, for one whose heart is complete and who desires no fruit at all, / the goddess possesses every form, and that because of the absence of limitation.

sanskrit_iast:
kule yogina udriktabhairavīyaparāsavāt /
ghūrṇitasya sthitirdehe mudrā yā kācideva sā // 200
meaning:
कुले योगिन उद्रिक्तभैरवीयपरासवात् /
घूर्णितस्य स्थितिर्देहे मुद्रा या काचिदेव सा // 200
text_mt: Whatever position in the body of a yogi in the Kula, reeling / from the heightened, supreme liquor of Bhairava, that alone is a mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
antarindhanasaṃbhāramanapekṣyaiva nityaśaḥ /
jājvalītyakhilākṣaughaprasṛtograśikhaḥ śikhī // 201
meaning:
अन्तरिन्धनसंभारमनपेक्ष्यैव नित्यशः /
जाज्वलीत्यखिलाक्षौघप्रसृतोग्रशिखः शिखी // 201
text_mt: Disregarding entirely the internal accumulation of fuel at all times, / the fire blazes forth, its fierce flames spreading through the entire host of sense organs.

sanskrit_iast:
bodhāgnau tādṛśe bhāvā viśantastasya sanmahaḥ /
udrecayanto gacchanti homakarmanimittatām // 202
meaning:
बोधाग्नौ तादृशे भावा विशन्तस्तस्य सन्महः /
उद्रेचयन्तो गच्छन्ति होमकर्मनिमित्तताम् // 202
text_mt: Entering into such a fire of awakening, entities, increasing / its true majesty, become the cause of the rite of oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ kaṃcitparameśānaśaktipātapavitritam /
purobhāvya svayaṃ tiṣṭheduktavaddīkṣitastu saḥ // 203
meaning:
यं कंचित्परमेशानशक्तिपातपवित्रितम् /
पुरोभाव्य स्वयं तिष्ठेदुक्तवद्दीक्षितस्तु सः // 203
text_mt: Placing before oneself whomever has been purified by the descent of power of the Supreme Lord, / one should abide as described; he is indeed initiated.

sanskrit_iast:
japyādau homaparyante yadyapyekaikakarmaṇi /
udeti rūḍhiḥ paramā tathāpītthaṃ nirūpitam // 204
meaning:
जप्यादौ होमपर्यन्ते यद्यप्येकैककर्मणि /
उदेति रूढिः परमा तथापीत्थं निरूपितम् // 204
text_mt: Although supreme firm establishment arises in each single ritual, / from repetition of mantra up to the oblation, nevertheless it has been explained in this way:

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhi tatra tatrāśvaḥ samanimnonnatādiṣu /
citre deśe vāhyamāno yātīcchāmātrakalpitām // 205
meaning:
यथाहि तत्र तत्राश्वः समनिम्नोन्नतादिषु /
चित्रे देशे वाह्यमानो यातीच्छामात्रकल्पिताम् // 205
text_mt: Just as a horse, being ridden here and there over varied terrain, / even, low, or raised, goes in a manner formed merely by will,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā saṃvidvicitrābhiḥ śāntaghoratarādibhiḥ /
bhaṅgībhirabhito dvaitaṃ tyājitā bhairavāyate // 206
meaning:
तथा संविद्विचित्राभिः शान्तघोरतरादिभिः /
भङ्गीभिरभितो द्वैतं त्याजिता भैरवायते // 206
text_mt: so consciousness, made to abandon duality completely through varied / modes, peaceful, extremely terrible, and so forth, acts as Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā puraḥsthe mukure nijaṃ vaktraṃ vibhāvayan /
bhūyo bhūyastadekātma vaktraṃ vetti nijātmanaḥ // 207
meaning:
यथा पुरःस्थे मुकुरे निजं वक्त्रं विभावयन् /
भूयो भूयस्तदेकात्म वक्त्रं वेत्ति निजात्मनः // 207
text_mt: Just as one, contemplating his own face in a mirror placed before him, / repeatedly recognizes that very face of his own self as one with it,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vikalpamukure dhyānapūjārcanātmani /
ātmānaṃ bhairavaṃ paśyannacirāttanmayībhavet // 208
meaning:
तथा विकल्पमुकुरे ध्यानपूजार्चनात्मनि /
आत्मानं भैरवं पश्यन्नचिरात्तन्मयीभवेत् // 208
text_mt: so, seeing oneself as Bhairava in the mirror of conceptual construct / consisting of meditation, worship, and veneration, one soon becomes identical with that.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmayībhavanaṃ nāma prāptiḥ sānuttarātmani /
pūrṇatvasya parā kāṣṭhā setyatra na phalāntaram // 209
meaning:
तन्मयीभवनं नाम प्राप्तिः सानुत्तरात्मनि /
पूर्णत्वस्य परा काष्ठा सेत्यत्र न फलान्तरम् // 209
text_mt: Becoming identical with that means attainment in the unexcelled Self; / that is the supreme summit of fullness, so there is no other fruit here.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ sarvamapūrṇatve tatra tatra prakalpitam /
akalpite hi pūrṇatve phalamanyatkimucyatām // 210
meaning:
फलं सर्वमपूर्णत्वे तत्र तत्र प्रकल्पितम् /
अकल्पिते हि पूर्णत्वे फलमन्यत्किमुच्यताम् // 210
text_mt: All fruit is imagined only in the state of incompleteness in various contexts; / when fullness is unconstructed, what other fruit could be spoken of?

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa yāgavidhiḥ ko'pi kasyāpi hṛdi vartate /
yasya prasīdecciccakraṃ drāgapaścimajanmanaḥ // 211
meaning:
एष यागविधिः कोऽपि कस्यापि हृदि वर्तते /
यस्य प्रसीदेच्चिच्चक्रं द्रागपश्चिमजन्मनः // 211
text_mt: This extraordinary rule of sacrifice dwells in the heart of someone / for whom the wheel of consciousness quickly becomes gracious, whose current birth is the last.

sanskrit_iast:
atra yāge gato rūḍhiṃ kaivalyamadhigacchati /
lokairālokyamāno hi dehabandhavidhau sthitaḥ // 212
meaning:
अत्र यागे गतो रूढिं कैवल्यमधिगच्छति /
लोकैरालोक्यमानो हि देहबन्धविधौ स्थितः // 212
text_mt: Attaining firm establishment in this sacrifice, one reaches isolation, / even while being seen by people and abiding in the condition of the bodily bond.

sanskrit_iast:
atra nāthaḥ samācāraṃ paṭale'ṣṭādaśe'bhyadhāt /
nātra śuddhirna cāśuddhirna bhakṣyādivicāraṇam // 213
meaning:
अत्र नाथः समाचारं पटलेऽष्टादशेऽभ्यधात् /
नात्र शुद्धिर्न चाशुद्धिर्न भक्ष्यादिविचारणम् // 213
text_mt: Here, in the eighteenth chapter, the Lord declared the traditional practice: / 'Here there is neither purity nor impurity, nor consideration of edible food and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
na dvaitaṃ nāpi cādvaitaṃ liṅgapūjādikaṃ na ca /
na cāpi tatparityāgo niṣparigrahatāpi vā // 214
meaning:
न द्वैतं नापि चाद्वैतं लिङ्गपूजादिकं न च /
न चापि तत्परित्यागो निष्परिग्रहतापि वा // 214
text_mt: neither duality nor non-duality, neither worship of the liṅga and the like / nor its abandonment, neither lack of possessions

sanskrit_iast:
saparigrahatā vāpi jaṭābhasmādisaṃgrahaḥ /
tattyāgo na vratādīnāṃ caraṇācaraṇaṃ ca yat // 215
meaning:
सपरिग्रहता वापि जटाभस्मादिसंग्रहः /
तत्त्यागो न व्रतादीनां चरणाचरणं च यत् // 215
text_mt: nor having possessions, taking up matted hair, ashes, and so forth, / nor abandoning them, neither the practice nor non-practice of observances and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetrādisaṃpraveśaśca samayādiprapālanam /
parasvarūpaliṅgādi nāmagotrādikaṃ ca yat // 216
meaning:
क्षेत्रादिसंप्रवेशश्च समयादिप्रपालनम् /
परस्वरूपलिङ्गादि नामगोत्रादिकं च यत् // 216
text_mt: neither entering sacred fields and such places, nor keeping the rules, / neither the insignia and so forth of another's nature, nor name, lineage, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
nāsminvidhīyate kiṃcinna cāpi pratiṣidhyate /
vihitaṃ sarvamevātra pratiṣiddhamathāpi ca // 217
meaning:
नास्मिन्विधीयते किंचिन्न चापि प्रतिषिध्यते /
विहितं सर्वमेवात्र प्रतिषिद्धमथापि च // 217
text_mt: Nothing is prescribed in this, nor is anything prohibited; / everything is indeed prescribed here, and likewise prohibited.

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tvetadatra deveśi niyamena vidhīyate /
tattve cetaḥ sthirīkāryaṃ suprasannena yoginā // 218
meaning:
किं त्वेतदत्र देवेशि नियमेन विधीयते /
तत्त्वे चेतः स्थिरीकार्यं सुप्रसन्नेन योगिना // 218
text_mt: Rather, O Queen of the Gods, this is prescribed here as a rule: / the mind must be made firm in reality by the perfectly tranquil yogi.

sanskrit_iast:
tacca yasya yathaiva syātsa tathaiva samācaret /
tattve niścalacittastu bhuñjāno viṣayānapi // 219
meaning:
तच्च यस्य यथैव स्यात्स तथैव समाचरेत् /
तत्त्वे निश्चलचित्तस्तु भुञ्जानो विषयानपि // 219
text_mt: And in whatever way that may happen for anyone, he should act precisely in that way. / But one whose mind is motionless in reality, even while enjoying sense objects,

sanskrit_iast:
na saṃspṛśyeta doṣaiḥ sa padmapatramivāmbhasā /
viṣāpahārimantrādisaṃnaddho bhakṣayannapi // 220
meaning:
न संस्पृश्येत दोषैः स पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा /
विषापहारिमन्त्रादिसंनद्धो भक्षयन्नपि // 220
text_mt: is not touched by faults, just as a lotus leaf is not touched by water. / Even when consuming poison, one who is protected by poison-dispelling mantras and the like

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṃ na muhyate tena tadvadyogī mahāmatiḥ /
aśuddhaṃ hi kathaṃ nāma dehādyaṃ pāñcabhautikam // 221
meaning:
विषं न मुह्यते तेन तद्वद्योगी महामतिः /
अशुद्धं हि कथं नाम देहाद्यं पाञ्चभौतिकम् // 221
text_mt: is not bewildered by it; in the same way the yogi of great intellect [is unaffected]. / For how indeed could the body and the like, made of the five elements, be impure?

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśatātirikte kiṃ śuddhyaśuddhī hi vastunaḥ /
aśuddhasya ca bhāvasya śuddhiḥ syāttādṛśaiva kim // 222
meaning:
प्रकाशतातिरिक्ते किं शुद्ध्यशुद्धी हि वस्तुनः /
अशुद्धस्य च भावस्य शुद्धिः स्यात्तादृशैव किम् // 222
text_mt: Can purity and impurity belong to an entity beyond luminosity? / And could the purification of an impure entity be of the same nature?

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyāśrayavaiyarthyānavasthā itthamatra hi /
pṛthivī jalataḥ śuddhyejjalaṃ dharaṇitastathā // 223
meaning:
अन्योन्याश्रयवैयर्थ्यानवस्था इत्थमत्र हि /
पृथिवी जलतः शुद्ध्येज्जलं धरणितस्तथा // 223
text_mt: Thus, here there would be mutual dependence, futility, and infinite regress. / Earth would be purified by water, and water in turn by earth—

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyāśrayatā seyamaśuddhatve'pyayaṃ kramaḥ /
aśuddhājjalataḥ śuddhyeddhareti vyarthatā bhavet // 224
meaning:
अन्योन्याश्रयता सेयमशुद्धत्वेऽप्ययं क्रमः /
अशुद्धाज्जलतः शुद्ध्येद्धरेति व्यर्थता भवेत् // 224
text_mt: this is mutual dependence; this same sequence applies also to impurity: / if earth were purified by impure water, futility would result.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyuto vāriṇo vāyostejasastasya vānyataḥ /
bahurūpādikā mantrāḥ pāvanātteṣu śuddhatā // 225
meaning:
वायुतो वारिणो वायोस्तेजसस्तस्य वान्यतः /
बहुरूपादिका मन्त्राः पावनात्तेषु शुद्धता // 225
text_mt: [If water is purified] by air, or air by fire, or that by another [there is infinite regress]. / [If it is argued that] mantras such as the Bahurūpa are purifying, and so purity is in them,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāḥ svabhāvataḥ śuddhā yadi te'pi na kiṃ tathā /
śivātmatā teṣu śuddhiryadi tatrāpi sā na kim // 226
meaning:
मन्त्राः स्वभावतः शुद्धा यदि तेऽपि न किं तथा /
शिवात्मता तेषु शुद्धिर्यदि तत्रापि सा न किम् // 226
text_mt: [then] if mantras are pure by nature, why are those [elements] not also so? / If their purity is their being identical with Śiva, why does that not exist there too?

sanskrit_iast:
śivātmatvāparijñānaṃ na mantreṣu dharādivat /
te tena śuddhā iti cettajjñaptistarhi śuddhatā // 227
meaning:
शिवात्मत्वापरिज्ञानं न मन्त्रेषु धरादिवत् /
ते तेन शुद्धा इति चेत्तज्ज्ञप्तिस्तर्हि शुद्धता // 227
text_mt: If it is said: 'In mantras, unlike earth and the like, there is no non-recognition of identity with Śiva, / and through that they are pure'—then knowledge of that is purity.

sanskrit_iast:
yoginaṃ prati sā cāsti bhāveṣviti viśuddhatā /
nanu codanayā śuddhyaśuddhyādikaviniścayaḥ // 228
meaning:
योगिनं प्रति सा चास्ति भावेष्विति विशुद्धता /
ननु चोदनया शुद्ध्यशुद्ध्यादिकविनिश्चयः // 228
text_mt: And that [knowledge] exists for the yogi with regard to [all] entities; thus there is complete purity. / If it is objected: 'Surely purity, impurity, and the like are determined by scriptural injunction?'—

sanskrit_iast:
itthamastu tathāpyeṣā codanaiva śivoditā /
kā syātsatīti cedetadanyatra pravitānitam // 229
meaning:
इत्थमस्तु तथाप्येषा चोदनैव शिवोदिता /
का स्यात्सतीति चेदेतदन्यत्र प्रवितानितम् // 229
text_mt: be it so! Even then, which can be the true injunction uttered by Śiva? / If asked, this has been expounded at length elsewhere.

sanskrit_iast:
vaidikyā bādhiteyaṃ cedviparītaṃ na kiṃ bhavet /
samyakcenmanyase bādho viśiṣṭaviṣayatvataḥ // 230
meaning:
वैदिक्या बाधितेयं चेद्विपरीतं न किं भवेत् /
सम्यक्चेन्मन्यसे बाधो विशिष्टविषयत्वतः // 230
text_mt: If it is said that this is sublated by Vedic injunction, why should it not be the reverse? / If you consider correctly, sublation must occur because it has a specific domain.

sanskrit_iast:
apavādena kartavyaḥ sāmānyavihite vidhau /
śuddhyaśuddhī ca sāmānyavihite tattvabodhini // 231
meaning:
अपवादेन कर्तव्यः सामान्यविहिते विधौ /
शुद्ध्यशुद्धी च सामान्यविहिते तत्त्वबोधिनि // 231
text_mt: A specific exception must override a rule laid down in general; / and purity and impurity are laid down in general for one who is being awakened to reality.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsi te bādhite eva tathā cātreti varṇitam /
nārthavādādiśaṅkā ca vākye māheśvare bhavet // 232
meaning:
पुंसि ते बाधिते एव तथा चात्रेति वर्णितम् /
नार्थवादादिशङ्का च वाक्ये माहेश्वरे भवेत् // 232
text_mt:
for a person who knows the true principle, those two are indeed sublated, and so it has been explained here.
Moreover, in a statement of the Great Lord, there can be no suspicion of its being mere commendation or the like.

sanskrit_iast:
abuddhipūrvaṃ hi tathā saṃsthite satataṃ bhavet /
vyomādirūpe nigame śaṅkā mithyārthatāṃ prati // 233
meaning:
अबुद्धिपूर्वं हि तथा संस्थिते सततं भवेत् /
व्योमादिरूपे निगमे शङ्का मिथ्यार्थतां प्रति // 233
text_mt:
Indeed, suspicion regarding falsehood may constantly arise
in the Vedic tradition, which is established non-intentionally like empty space and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
anavacchinnavijñānavaiśvarūpyasunirbharaḥ /
śāstrātmanā sthito devo mithyātvaṃ kvāpi nārhati // 234
meaning:
अनवच्छिन्नविज्ञानवैश्वरूप्यसुनिर्भरः /
शास्त्रात्मना स्थितो देवो मिथ्यात्वं क्वापि नार्हति // 234
text_mt:
the Lord, however, established in the form of scripture,
overflowing with the universal forms of unrestricted knowledge, never admits of falsehood anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
icchāvānbhāvarūpeṇa yathā tiṣṭhāsurīśvaraḥ /
tatsvarūpābhidhānena tiṣṭhāsuḥ sa tathā sthitaḥ // 235
meaning:
इच्छावान्भावरूपेण यथा तिष्ठासुरीश्वरः /
तत्स्वरूपाभिधानेन तिष्ठासुः स तथा स्थितः // 235
text_mt:
Just as the Lord, endowed with will, chooses to abide in the form of existing entities,
so he stands choosing to abide by expressing their intrinsic nature.

sanskrit_iast:
arthavādo'pi yatrānyavidhyādimukhamīkṣate /
tatrāstvasatyaḥ svātantrye sa eva tu vidhāyakaḥ // 236
meaning:
अर्थवादोऽपि यत्रान्यविध्यादिमुखमीक्षते /
तत्रास्त्वसत्यः स्वातन्त्र्ये स एव तु विधायकः // 236
text_mt:
Even where a commendatory passage looks to the face of an injunction or the like,
let it be untrue there; but in absolute autonomy, it is itself an injunction.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhivākyāntare gacchannaṅgabhāvamathāpi vā /
na nirarthakaṃ evāyaṃ saṃnidhergajaḍādivat // 237
meaning:
विधिवाक्यान्तरे गच्छन्नङ्गभावमथापि वा /
न निरर्थकं एवायं संनिधेर्गजडादिवत् // 237
text_mt:
Or even when it becomes subordinate to another injunctive statement,
it is never merely meaningless by proximity, like ‘ga, ja, ḍa’ and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
svārthapratyāyanaṃ cāsya svasaṃvittyaiva bhāsate /
tadapahnavanaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ vidhiniṣedhayoḥ // 238
meaning:
स्वार्थप्रत्यायनं चास्य स्वसंवित्त्यैव भासते /
तदपह्नवनं कर्तुं शक्यं विधिनिषेधयोः // 238
text_mt:
Its conveying of its own meaning is revealed through one’s own consciousness alone;
can that be concealed in the case of injunctions and prohibitions?

sanskrit_iast:
yuktiścātrāsti vākyeṣu svasaṃviccāpyabādhitā /
yā samagrārthamāṇikyatattvaniścayakāriṇī // 239
meaning:
युक्तिश्चात्रास्ति वाक्येषु स्वसंविच्चाप्यबाधिता /
या समग्रार्थमाणिक्यतत्त्वनिश्चयकारिणी // 239
text_mt:
And here, in these statements, there is reasoning as well as unsublated self-awareness,
which brings about the ascertainment of the true nature of all objects, like gems.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtadehe'tha dehotthe yā cāśuddhiḥ prakīrtitā /
anyatra neti buddhyantāmaśuddhaṃ saṃvidaścyutam // 240
meaning:
मृतदेहेऽथ देहोत्थे या चाशुद्धिः प्रकीर्तिता /
अन्यत्र नेति बुद्ध्यन्तामशुद्धं संविदश्च्युतम् // 240
text_mt:
And the impurity that is proclaimed regarding a dead body or what arises from the body,
and not elsewhere—let them understand that what has fallen from consciousness is the impure.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvittādātmyamāpannaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhamataḥ sthitam /
śrīmadvīrāvalau coktaṃ śuddhyaśuddhinirūpaṇe // 241
meaning:
संवित्तादात्म्यमापन्नं सर्वं शुद्धमतः स्थितम् /
श्रीमद्वीरावलौ चोक्तं शुद्ध्यशुद्धिनिरूपणे // 241
text_mt:
Everything that has attained identity with consciousness is therefore established as pure.
And it is said in the venerable Vīrāvalī, in the determination of purity and impurity:

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ vāhako jīvo nāsti kiṃcidajīvakam /
yatkiṃcijjīvarahitamaśuddhaṃ tadvijānata // 242
meaning:
सर्वेषां वाहको जीवो नास्ति किंचिदजीवकम् /
यत्किंचिज्जीवरहितमशुद्धं तद्विजानत // 242
text_mt:
‘Life is the bearer of all; there is nothing devoid of life.
Whatever is devoid of life—know that to be impure.’

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādyatsaṃvido nātidūre tacchudvimāvahet /
avikalpena bhāvena munayo'pi tathābhavan // 243
meaning:
तस्माद्यत्संविदो नातिदूरे तच्छुद्विमावहेत् /
अविकल्पेन भावेन मुनयोऽपि तथाभवन् // 243
text_mt:
Therefore, whatever is not too far from consciousness brings purity.
By means of a non-conceptual state, the sages too became like that.

sanskrit_iast:
lokasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ tu tattattvaṃ taiḥ pragopitam /
bahiḥ satsvapi bhāveṣu śuddhyaśuddhī na nīlavat // 244
meaning:
लोकसंरक्षणार्थं तु तत्तत्त्वं तैः प्रगोपितम् /
बहिः सत्स्वपि भावेषु शुद्ध्यशुद्धी न नीलवत् // 244
text_mt:
However, for the sake of preserving the world, that true reality was hidden by them.
Even though external entities exist, purity and impurity are not like the color blue;

sanskrit_iast:
pramātṛdharma evāyaṃ cidaikyānaikyavedanāt /
yadi vā vastudharmo'pi mātrapekṣānibandhanaḥ // 245
meaning:
प्रमातृधर्म एवायं चिदैक्यानैक्यवेदनात् /
यदि वा वस्तुधर्मोऽपि मात्रपेक्षानिबन्धनः // 245
text_mt:
this is a property of the subject alone, arising from the experience of unity or non-unity with consciousness;
or if it is also a property of the object, it is grounded upon the relative reference to a subject.

sanskrit_iast:
sautrāmaṇyāṃ surā hotuḥ śuddhānyasya viparyayaḥ /
anena codanānāṃ ca svavākyairapi bādhanam // 246
meaning:
सौत्रामण्यां सुरा होतुः शुद्धान्यस्य विपर्ययः /
अनेन चोदनानां च स्ववाक्यैरपि बाधनम् // 246
text_mt:
In the Sautrāmaṇī sacrifice, liquor is pure for the hotṛ priest, but the reverse for another.
By this, the sublation of scriptural injunctions even by their own statements

sanskrit_iast:
kvacitsaṃdarśitaṃ brahmahatyāvidhiniṣedhavat /
bhakṣyādividhayo'pyenaṃ nyāyamāśritya carcitāḥ // 247
meaning:
क्वचित्संदर्शितं ब्रह्महत्याविधिनिषेधवत् /
भक्ष्यादिविधयोऽप्येनं न्यायमाश्रित्य चर्चिताः // 247
text_mt:
has been shown in some instances, like the injunction and prohibition concerning the killing of a brahmin.
Injunctions regarding what may be eaten and so forth have also been discussed by taking recourse to this principle.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñānottarādau ca bhāṣate sma maheśvaraḥ /
nararṣidevadruhiṇaviṣṇurudrādyudīritam // 248
meaning:
सर्वज्ञानोत्तरादौ च भाषते स्म महेश्वरः /
नरर्षिदेवद्रुहिणविष्णुरुद्राद्युदीरितम् // 248
text_mt:
And in the Sarvajñānottara and other scriptures, the Great Lord declared:
‘That which is uttered by human beings, sages, gods, Druhiṇa, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and others,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarottaravaiśiṣṭyāt pūrvapūrvaprabādhakam /
na śaivaṃ vaiṣṇavairvākyairbādhanīyaṃ kadācana // 249
meaning:
उत्तरोत्तरवैशिष्ट्यात् पूर्वपूर्वप्रबाधकम् /
न शैवं वैष्णवैर्वाक्यैर्बाधनीयं कदाचन // 249
text_mt:
sublates each preceding one because of the superiority of each succeeding one.
Never should a Śaiva statement be sublated by Vaiṣṇava statements.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavaṃ brahmasaṃbhūtairnetyādi paricarcayet /
bādhate yo vaiparītyātsamūḍhaḥ pāpabhāgbhavet // 250
meaning:
वैष्णवं ब्रह्मसंभूतैर्नेत्यादि परिचर्चयेत् /
बाधते यो वैपरीत्यात्समूढः पापभाग्भवेत् // 250
text_mt:
A Vaiṣṇava statement should not be investigated by those born of Brahmā,’ and so on.
One who sublates in reverse becomes bewildered and incurs sin.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmukhyatayā skanda lokadharmānna cācaret /
nānyaśāstrasamuddiṣṭaṃ srotasyuktaṃ nije caret // 251
meaning:
तस्मान्मुख्यतया स्कन्द लोकधर्मान्न चाचरेत् /
नान्यशास्त्रसमुद्दिष्टं स्रोतस्युक्तं निजे चरेत् // 251
text_mt:
‘Therefore, principally, O Skanda, one should not practice worldly norms;
one should not practice what is prescribed in another scripture, but practice what is declared in one’s own current.’

sanskrit_iast:
yato yadyapi devena vedādyapi nirūpitam /
tathāpi kila saṃkocabhāvābhāvavikalpataḥ // 252
meaning:
यतो यद्यपि देवेन वेदाद्यपि निरूपितम् /
तथापि किल संकोचभावाभावविकल्पतः // 252
text_mt:
Because, even though the Veda and other scriptures were also set forth by the Lord,
nonetheless, owing to the conceptual construction of the presence or absence of contraction,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkocatāratamyena pāśavaṃ jñānamīritam /
vikāsatāratamyena patijñānaṃ tu bādhakam // 253
meaning:
संकोचतारतम्येन पाशवं ज्ञानमीरितम् /
विकासतारतम्येन पतिज्ञानं तु बाधकम् // 253
text_mt:
knowledge of the bound soul is stated according to the gradation of contraction,
whereas the Lord’s knowledge sublates it according to the gradation of expansion.

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ dvaitamidaṃ neti parasparaniṣedhataḥ /
māyīyabhedaklṛptaṃ tatsyādakālpanike katham // 254
meaning:
इदं द्वैतमिदं नेति परस्परनिषेधतः /
मायीयभेदक्लृप्तं तत्स्यादकाल्पनिके कथम् // 254
text_mt:
Because of the mutual exclusion of ‘this is duality, this is not’,
that is constructed through illusory differentiation; how could it exist in what is non-conceptual?

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ bhargaśikhāyāṃ ca mṛtyukālakalādikam /
dvaitādvaitavikalpotthaṃ grasate kṛtadhīriti // 255
meaning:
उक्तं भर्गशिखायां च मृत्युकालकलादिकम् /
द्वैताद्वैतविकल्पोत्थं ग्रसते कृतधीरिति // 255
text_mt: And it is said in the Bhargaśikhā: / ‘The wise person swallows death, time, parts, and the rest, / which arise from the conceptual construct of duality and non-duality.’

sanskrit_iast:
siddhānte liṅgapūjoktā viśvādhvamayatāvide /
kulādiṣu niṣiddhāsau dehe viśvātmatāvide // 256
meaning:
सिद्धान्ते लिङ्गपूजोक्ता विश्वाध्वमयताविदे /
कुलादिषु निषिद्धासौ देहे विश्वात्मताविदे // 256
text_mt:
In the Siddhānta, the worship of the liṅga is taught for the sake of knowing the identity of the entire path;
in the Kula and other traditions, it is forbidden for the sake of knowing universal identity in the body.

sanskrit_iast:
iha sarvātmake kasmāttadvidhipratiṣedhane /
niyamānupraveśena tādātmyapratipattaye // 257
meaning:
इह सर्वात्मके कस्मात्तद्विधिप्रतिषेधने /
नियमानुप्रवेशेन तादात्म्यप्रतिपत्तये // 257
text_mt:
Here, in that which consists of everything, why should there be injunction and prohibition of it?
For the sake of realizing identity through entering into a restrictive rule.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭādi kaule tyāgo'sya sukhopāyopadeśataḥ /
vratacaryā ca mantrārthatādātmyapratipattaye // 258
meaning:
जटादि कौले त्यागोऽस्य सुखोपायोपदेशतः /
व्रतचर्या च मन्त्रार्थतादात्म्यप्रतिपत्तये // 258
text_mt:
In the Kaula, the abandonment of matted hair and the like is taught because of its being an easy means,
and the observance of ascetic vows is for realizing identity with the meaning of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tanniṣedhastu mantrārthasārvātmyapratipattaye /
kṣetrapīṭhopapīṭheṣu praveśo vighnaśāntaye // 259
meaning:
तन्निषेधस्तु मन्त्रार्थसार्वात्म्यप्रतिपत्तये /
क्षेत्रपीठोपपीठेषु प्रवेशो विघ्नशान्तये // 259
text_mt:
Its prohibition, however, is for realizing that the meaning of the mantra is all-encompassing.
Entering sacred fields, seats, and secondary seats is taught for the pacification of obstacles

sanskrit_iast:
mantrādyārādhakasyātha tallābhāyopadiśyate /
kṣetrādigamanābhāvavidhistu svātmanastathā // 260
meaning:
मन्त्राद्याराधकस्याथ तल्लाभायोपदिश्यते /
क्षेत्रादिगमनाभावविधिस्तु स्वात्मनस्तथा // 260
text_mt:
of one who worships mantras and the like, or for obtaining them;
whereas the rule against going to sacred fields and the like is likewise described

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvarūpyeṇa pūrṇatvaṃ jñātumityapi varṇitam /
samayācārasadbhāvaḥ pālyatvenopadiśyate // 261
meaning:
वैश्वरूप्येण पूर्णत्वं ज्ञातुमित्यपि वर्णितम् /
समयाचारसद्भावः पाल्यत्वेनोपदिश्यते // 261
text_mt:
for the sake of knowing the fullness of one’s own self through universal form.
The presence of traditional conduct is taught as something to be observed

sanskrit_iast:
bhedaprāṇatayā tattattyāgāttattvaviśuddhaye /
samayādiniṣedhastu mataśāstreṣu kathyate // 262
meaning:
भेदप्राणतया तत्तत्त्यागात्तत्त्वविशुद्धये /
समयादिनिषेधस्तु मतशास्त्रेषु कथ्यते // 262
text_mt:
for the purification of reality through the renunciation of various entities whose life is difference;
whereas the prohibition of traditional observances and the like is taught in the Mata scriptures

sanskrit_iast:
nirmaryādaṃ svasaṃbodhaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ buddhyatāmiti /
parakīyamidaṃ rūpaṃ dhyeyametattu me nijam // 263
meaning:
निर्मर्यादं स्वसंबोधं संपूर्णं बुद्ध्यतामिति /
परकीयमिदं रूपं ध्येयमेतत्तु मे निजम् // 263
text_mt:
so that one may realize: ‘Let self-awareness be known as boundless and complete.’
‘This is an external form, to be meditated upon, but this is my own;

sanskrit_iast:
jvālādiliṅgaṃ cānyasya kapālādi tu me nijam /
ādiśabdāttapaścaryāvelātithyādi kathyate // 264
meaning:
ज्वालादिलिङ्गं चान्यस्य कपालादि तु मे निजम् /
आदिशब्दात्तपश्चर्यावेलातिथ्यादि कथ्यते // 264
text_mt:
the fiery liṅga and the like belong to another, but the skull and the like are my own.’
By the word ‘and the like’, ascetic practices, times, lunar days, and so forth are meant.

sanskrit_iast:
nāma śaktiśivādyantametasya mama nānyathā /
gotraṃ ca gurusaṃtāno maṭhikākulaśabditaḥ // 265
meaning:
नाम शक्तिशिवाद्यन्तमेतस्य मम नान्यथा /
गोत्रं च गुरुसंतानो मठिकाकुलशब्दितः // 265
text_mt:
‘His name ends with Śakti, Śiva, and the like; mine is not otherwise.’
And the lineage and the guru’s transmission are termed the hermitage-kula;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsaṃtatistryambakākhyā tadardhāmardasaṃjñitā /
itthamardhacatasro'tra maṭhikāḥ śāṃkare krame // 266
meaning:
श्रीसंततिस्त्र्यम्बकाख्या तदर्धामर्दसंज्ञिता /
इत्थमर्धचतस्रोऽत्र मठिकाः शांकरे क्रमे // 266
text_mt:
the venerable transmission is called Tryambaka, its half, and Āmarda;
thus here there are three and a half hermitages in the Śāṃkara tradition.

sanskrit_iast:
yugakrameṇa kūrmādyā mīnāntā siddhasaṃtatiḥ /
ādiśabdena ca gharaṃ pallī pīṭhopapīṭhakam // 267
meaning:
युगक्रमेण कूर्माद्या मीनान्ता सिद्धसंततिः /
आदिशब्देन च घरं पल्ली पीठोपपीठकम् // 267
text_mt:
According to the sequence of world-ages, there is the lineage of Siddhas beginning with Kūrma and ending with Mīna.
And by the word ‘and the like’, house, village, sacred seat, and secondary seat,

sanskrit_iast:
mudrā chummeti teṣāṃ ca vidhānaṃ svaparasthitam /
tādātmyapratipattyai hi svaṃ saṃtānaṃ samāśrayet // 268
meaning:
मुद्रा छुम्मेति तेषां च विधानं स्वपरस्थितम् /
तादात्म्यप्रतिपत्त्यै हि स्वं संतानं समाश्रयेत् // 268
text_mt:
mudrā, and secret recognition signs—the rule of these belonging to oneself or to another is laid down.
Indeed, for the sake of realizing identity, one should resort to one’s own lineage;

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjīta pūjayeccakraṃ parasaṃtāninā nahi /
etacca mataśāstreṣu niṣiddhaṃ khaṇḍanā yataḥ // 269
meaning:
भुञ्जीत पूजयेच्चक्रं परसंतानिना नहि /
एतच्च मतशास्त्रेषु निषिद्धं खण्डना यतः // 269
text_mt:
one should not eat or worship the circle with one belonging to another lineage.
And this is forbidden in the Mata scriptures, because fragmentation

sanskrit_iast:
akhaṇḍe'pi pare tattve bhedenānena jāyate /
evaṃ kṣetrapraveśādi saṃtānaniyamāntataḥ // 270
meaning:
अखण्डेऽपि परे तत्त्वे भेदेनानेन जायते /
एवं क्षेत्रप्रवेशादि संताननियमान्ततः // 270
text_mt:
arises through this differentiation, even in the unfragmented supreme reality.
Thus, beginning with entry into sacred fields and ending with lineage rules,

sanskrit_iast:
nāsminvidhīyate taddhi sākṣānnaupayikaṃ śive /
na tasya ca niṣodho ya nna tattattvasya khaṇḍanam // 271
meaning:
नास्मिन्विधीयते तद्धि साक्षान्नौपयिकं शिवे /
न तस्य च निषोधो य न्न तत्तत्त्वस्य खण्डनम् // 271
text_mt:
nothing is enjoined in this [tradition], for that is not directly conducive to Śiva;
nor is there a prohibition against it, which would fragment that reality.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvātmano hi nāthasya svasminrūpe vikalpitau /
vidhirniṣedho vā śaktau na svarūpasya khaṇḍane // 272
meaning:
विश्वात्मनो हि नाथस्य स्वस्मिन्रूपे विकल्पितौ /
विधिर्निषेधो वा शक्तौ न स्वरूपस्य खण्डने // 272
text_mt:
For an injunction or a prohibition, conceptually constructed within his own form
by the Lord who is universal, is not capable of fragmenting his intrinsic nature.

sanskrit_iast:
paratattvapraveśe tu yameva nikaṭaṃ yadā /
upāyaṃ vetti sa grāhyastadā tyājyo'tha vā kvacit // 273
meaning:
परतत्त्वप्रवेशे तु यमेव निकटं यदा /
उपायं वेत्ति स ग्राह्यस्तदा त्याज्योऽथ वा क्वचित् // 273
text_mt:
Upon entering the supreme reality, whichever means one knows as close at that time
is to be grasped then, or in some cases to be abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
na yantraṇātra kāryeti proktaṃ śrītrikaśāsane /
samatā sarvadevānāmovallīmantravarṇayoḥ // 274
meaning:
न यन्त्रणात्र कार्येति प्रोक्तं श्रीत्रिकशासने /
समता सर्वदेवानामोवल्लीमन्त्रवर्णयोः // 274
text_mt:
‘No constraint should be practiced here,’ so it is taught in the venerable Trika teaching;
there is equality of all deities, ovallīs, mantras, and syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
āgamanāṃ gatīnāṃ ca sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ yataḥ /
sa hyakhaṇḍitasadbhāvaṃ śivatattvaṃ prapaśyati // 275
meaning:
आगमनां गतीनां च सर्वं शिवमयं यतः /
स ह्यखण्डितसद्भावं शिवतत्त्वं प्रपश्यति // 275
text_mt:
of āgamas and paths, because everything is composed of Śiva.
For he perceives the Śiva-reality whose true being is unfragmented,

sanskrit_iast:
yo hyakhaṇḍitasadbhāvamātmatattvaṃ prapadyate /
ketakīkusumasaurabhe bhṛśaṃ bhṛṅga eva rasiko na makṣikā /
bhairavīyaparamādvayārcane ko'pi rajyati maheśacoditaḥ // 276
meaning:
यो ह्यखण्डितसद्भावमात्मतत्त्वं प्रपद्यते /
केतकीकुसुमसौरभे भृशं भृङ्ग एव रसिको न मक्षिका /
भैरवीयपरमाद्वयार्चने कोऽपि रज्यति महेशचोदितः // 276
text_mt:
who realizes the self-reality whose true being is unfragmented.
Only the bee is truly passionate for the fragrance of the ketakī blossom, not the fly; / impelled by the Great Lord, some rare person delights in the worship of the supreme non-duality of Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
asmiṃśca yoge viśrāntiṃ kurvatāṃ bhavaḍambaraḥ /
himānīva mahāgrīṣme svayameva vilīyate // 277
meaning:
अस्मिंश्च योगे विश्रान्तिं कुर्वतां भवडम्बरः /
हिमानीव महाग्रीष्मे स्वयमेव विलीयते // 277
text_mt: And for those who rest in this yoga, the pomp of worldly existence / dissolves spontaneously, like a mass of snow in the height of summer.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ vātiprasaṅgena bhūyasātiprapañcite /
yogyo'bhinavagupto'sminko'pi yāgavidhau budhaḥ // 278
meaning:
अलं वातिप्रसङ्गेन भूयसातिप्रपञ्चिते /
योग्योऽभिनवगुप्तोऽस्मिन्कोऽपि यागविधौ बुधः // 278
text_mt: Enough with excessive expansion on what has already been vastly elaborated! / Some wise person here, Abhinavagupta, is fit for this sacrificial rite.

sanskrit_iast: ityanuttarapadapravikāse śāktamaupayikamadya viviktam // 279
meaning: इत्यनुत्तरपदप्रविकासे शाक्तमौपयिकमद्य विविक्तम् // 279
text_mt: Thus, regarding the unfolding of the unexcelled abode, the Śākta means has now been distinguished.

sanskrit_iast: āṇavena vidhinā paradhāma prepsatāmatha nirūpyata etat // 1
meaning: आणवेन विधिना परधाम प्रेप्सतामथ निरूप्यत एतत् // 1
text_mt: Now, for those who desire to attain the supreme abode by the Āṇava method, this is explained:
title: Āṇavopāyaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpasyaiva saṃskāre jāte niṣpratiyogini /
abhīṣṭe vastuni prāptirniścitā bhogamokṣayoḥ // 2
meaning:
विकल्पस्यैव संस्कारे जाते निष्प्रतियोगिनि /
अभीष्टे वस्तुनि प्राप्तिर्निश्चिता भोगमोक्षयोः // 2
text_mt: Once the conceptual construct alone has been purified so as to be free of any counter-entity, / the attainment of enjoyment and liberation in the desired reality is assured.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpaḥ kasyacitsvātmasvātantryādeva susthiraḥ /
upāyāntarasāpekṣyaviyogenaiva jāyate // 3
meaning:
विकल्पः कस्यचित्स्वात्मस्वातन्त्र्यादेव सुस्थिरः /
उपायान्तरसापेक्ष्यवियोगेनैव जायते // 3
text_mt: For someone, the conceptual construct becomes firmly stabilized solely through the absolute autonomy of one's own Self, / arising entirely without dependence on any other means.

sanskrit_iast:
kasyacittu vikalpo'sau svātmasaṃskaraṇaṃ prati /
upāyāntarasāpekṣastatroktaḥ pūrvako vidhiḥ // 4
meaning:
कस्यचित्तु विकल्पोऽसौ स्वात्मसंस्करणं प्रति /
उपायान्तरसापेक्षस्तत्रोक्तः पूर्वको विधिः // 4
text_mt: For another, however, this conceptual construct depends on other means / for its own purification; with respect to that, the previous method was spoken.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpo nāma cinmātrasvabhāvo yadyapi sthitaḥ /
tathāpi niścayātmāsāvaṇoḥ svātantryayojakaḥ // 5
meaning:
विकल्पो नाम चिन्मात्रस्वभावो यद्यपि स्थितः /
तथापि निश्चयात्मासावणोः स्वातन्त्र्ययोजकः // 5
text_mt: Even though a conceptual construct by nature consists of pure consciousness alone, / nevertheless, being determinative, it unites the bound soul with absolute autonomy.

sanskrit_iast:
niścayo bahudhā caiṣa tatropāyāśca bhedinaḥ /
aṇuśabdena te coktā dūrāntikavibhedataḥ // 6
meaning:
निश्चयो बहुधा चैष तत्रोपायाश्च भेदिनः /
अणुशब्देन ते चोक्ता दूरान्तिकविभेदतः // 6
text_mt: And this determination is manifold, and the means therein are diversified; / and they are designated by the word 'aṇu' because of distinctions of distance and proximity.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra buddhau tathā prāṇe dehe cāpi pramātari /
apāramārthike'pyasmin paramārthaḥ prakāśate // 7
meaning:
तत्र बुद्धौ तथा प्राणे देहे चापि प्रमातरि /
अपारमार्थिकेऽप्यस्मिन् परमार्थः प्रकाशते // 7
text_mt: There, in the intellect as well as in the vital breath, and also in the body, the knower, / though non-ultimate, the ultimate reality shines forth.

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ prakāśāccinmātrāt prāṇādyavyatirekavat /
tasyaiva tu svatantratvāddviguṇaṃ jaḍacidvapuḥ // 8
meaning:
यतः प्रकाशाच्चिन्मात्रात् प्राणाद्यव्यतिरेकवत् /
तस्यैव तु स्वतन्त्रत्वाद्द्विगुणं जडचिद्वपुः // 8
text_mt: Because, from the luminosity of pure consciousness, the vital breath and so forth are not distinct; / yet owing to its very autonomy, it has a twofold form: insentient and sentient.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ traiśirase caitaddevyai candrārdhamaulinā /
jīvaḥ śaktiḥ śivasyaiva sarvatraiva sthitāpi sā // 9
meaning:
उक्तं त्रैशिरसे चैतद्देव्यै चन्द्रार्धमौलिना /
जीवः शक्तिः शिवस्यैव सर्वत्रैव स्थितापि सा // 9
text_mt: And this was spoken to the Goddess by the moon-crested Lord in the Traiśirasa: / 'The individual soul is the power of Śiva alone; yet though it is omnipresent,

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpapratyaye rūḍhā jñānasyonmīlanātparā /
tasya cidrūpatāṃ satyāṃ svātantryollāsakalpanāt // 10
meaning:
स्वरूपप्रत्यये रूढा ज्ञानस्योन्मीलनात्परा /
तस्य चिद्रूपतां सत्यां स्वातन्त्र्योल्लासकल्पनात् // 10
text_mt: rooted in the awareness of its essential nature, it is supreme due to the unfolding of knowledge.' / Perceiving its nature of consciousness as real through the imaginative display of absolute autonomy,

sanskrit_iast:
paśyañjaḍātmatābhāgaṃ tirodhāyādvayo bhavet /
tatra svātantryadṛṣṭyā vā darpaṇe mukhabimbavat // 11
meaning:
पश्यञ्जडात्मताभागं तिरोधायाद्वयो भवेत् /
तत्र स्वातन्त्र्यदृष्ट्या वा दर्पणे मुखबिम्बवत् // 11
text_mt: and setting aside the insentient aspect, one becomes non-dual. / Or, through the vision of absolute autonomy therein, like a reflection of a face in a mirror,

sanskrit_iast:
viśuddhaṃ nijacaitanyaṃ niścinotyatadātmakam /
buddhiprāṇādito bhinnaṃ caitanyaṃ niścitaṃ balāt // 12
meaning:
विशुद्धं निजचैतन्यं निश्चिनोत्यतदात्मकम् /
बुद्धिप्राणादितो भिन्नं चैतन्यं निश्चितं बलात् // 12
text_mt: one ascertains one's pure consciousness to be not of that [insentient] nature. / Once consciousness is firmly ascertained as distinct from the intellect, vital breath, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
satyatastadabhinnaṃ syāttasyānyonyavibhedataḥ /
viśvarūpāvibheditvaṃ śuddhatvādeva jāyate // 13
meaning:
सत्यतस्तदभिन्नं स्यात्तस्यान्योन्यविभेदतः /
विश्वरूपाविभेदित्वं शुद्धत्वादेव जायते // 13
text_mt: in reality it is non-distinct from them, since they are distinct from one another; / its non-distinctness from the universal form arises solely from its purity.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣṭhitaikasphuranmūrtermūrtyantaravirodhataḥ /
antaḥ saṃvidi satsarvaṃ yadyapyaparathā dhiyi // 14
meaning:
निष्ठितैकस्फुरन्मूर्तेर्मूर्त्यन्तरविरोधतः /
अन्तः संविदि सत्सर्वं यद्यप्यपरथा धियि // 14
text_mt: Because a single established, flashing form excludes any other form, / everything exists internally in consciousness; otherwise, how could it pass over into the intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇe dehe'thavā kasmātsaṃkrāmetkena vā katham /
tathāpi nirvikalpe'sminvikalpo nāsti taṃ vinā // 15
meaning:
प्राणे देहेऽथवा कस्मात्संक्रामेत्केन वा कथम् /
तथापि निर्विकल्पेऽस्मिन्विकल्पो नास्ति तं विना // 15
text_mt: or into the vital breath, or into the body? By what means or how? / Nevertheless, within this non-conceptual [awareness], there is no conceptual construct without it.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭe'pyadṛṣṭakalpatvaṃ vikalpena tu niścayaḥ /
buddhiprāṇaśarīreṣu pārameśvaryamañjasā // 16
meaning:
दृष्टेऽप्यदृष्टकल्पत्वं विकल्पेन तु निश्चयः /
बुद्धिप्राणशरीरेषु पारमेश्वर्यमञ्जसा // 16
text_mt: Even when seen, it is as if unseen; but through a conceptual construct, determination occurs. / Sovereign divinity is readily to be conceptualized

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpyaṃ śūnyarūpe na pramātari vikalpanam /
buddhirdhyānamayī tatra prāṇa uccāraṇātmakaḥ // 17
meaning:
विकल्प्यं शून्यरूपे न प्रमातरि विकल्पनम् /
बुद्धिर्ध्यानमयी तत्र प्राण उच्चारणात्मकः // 17
text_mt: in the intellect, vital breath, and body; conceptualization cannot occur in the void-like knower. / There, the intellect consists of meditation; the vital breath consists of sounding forth.

sanskrit_iast:
uccāraṇaṃ ca prāṇādyā vyānāntāḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ /
ādyā tu prāṇanābhikhyāparoccārātmikā bhavet // 18
meaning:
उच्चारणं च प्राणाद्या व्यानान्ताः पञ्च वृत्तयः /
आद्या तु प्राणनाभिख्यापरोच्चारात्मिका भवेत् // 18
text_mt: And sounding forth consists of the five functions, beginning with prāṇa and ending with vyāna; / the first, however, called prāṇana, consists of the supreme sounding forth.

sanskrit_iast:
śarīrasyākṣaviṣayaitatpiṇḍatvena saṃsthitiḥ /
tatra dhyānamayaṃ tāvadanuttaramihocyate // 19
meaning:
शरीरस्याक्षविषयैतत्पिण्डत्वेन संस्थितिः /
तत्र ध्यानमयं तावदनुत्तरमिहोच्यते // 19
text_mt: The body's state consists in being an aggregate of these sense objects. / There, that which consists of meditation is spoken of here first as unexcelled.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ prakāśaḥ svatantro'yaṃ citsvabhāvo hṛdi sthitaḥ /
sarvatattvamayaḥ proktametacca triśiromate // 20
meaning:
यः प्रकाशः स्वतन्त्रोऽयं चित्स्वभावो हृदि स्थितः /
सर्वतत्त्वमयः प्रोक्तमेतच्च त्रिशिरोमते // 20
text_mt: This autonomous luminosity, whose nature is consciousness, seated in the heart, / is declared to consist of all principles of reality; and this is stated in the Triśiromata:

sanskrit_iast:
kadalīsaṃpuṭākāraṃ sabāhyābhyantarāntaram /
īkṣate hṛdayāntaḥsthaṃ tatpuṣpamiva tattvavit // 21
meaning:
कदलीसंपुटाकारं सबाह्याभ्यन्तरान्तरम् /
ईक्षते हृदयान्तःस्थं तत्पुष्पमिव तत्त्ववित् // 21
text_mt: The knower of reality sees that which abides within the heart / like that banana flower, shaped like a plantain calyx, with exterior and interior compartments.

sanskrit_iast:
somasūryāgnisaṃghaṭṭaṃ tatra dhyāyedananyadhīḥ /
taddhyānāraṇisaṃkṣobhānmahābhairavahavyabhuk // 22
meaning:
सोमसूर्याग्निसंघट्टं तत्र ध्यायेदनन्यधीः /
तद्ध्यानारणिसंक्षोभान्महाभैरवहव्यभुक् // 22
text_mt: With undistracted mind, one should meditate there on the conjunction of the moon, sun, and fire. / From the agitation of the firesticks of that meditation, the consumer of oblations, Great Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayākhye mahākuṇḍe jājvalan sphītatāṃ vrajet /
tasya śaktimataḥ sphītaśakterbhairavatejasaḥ // 23
meaning:
हृदयाख्ये महाकुण्डे जाज्वलन् स्फीततां व्रजेत् /
तस्य शक्तिमतः स्फीतशक्तेर्भैरवतेजसः // 23
text_mt: blazing in the great sacrificial pit known as the heart, expands. / One should contemplate the abode known as the knower, means of knowledge, and object of knowledge

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛmānaprameyākhyaṃ dhāmābhedena bhāvayet /
vahnyarkasomaśaktīnāṃ tadeva tritayaṃ bhavet // 24
meaning:
मातृमानप्रमेयाख्यं धामाभेदेन भावयेत् /
वह्न्यर्कसोमशक्तीनां तदेव त्रितयं भवेत् // 24
text_mt: in non-differentiation from that fire of Bhairava, the possessor of power whose power is expanded; / that itself becomes the triad of the powers of fire, sun, and moon.

sanskrit_iast:
parā parāparā ceyamaparā ca sadoditā /
sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhāraistāsāṃ pratyekatastridhā // 25
meaning:
परा परापरा चेयमपरा च सदोदिता /
सृष्टिसंस्थितिसंहारैस्तासां प्रत्येकतस्त्रिधा // 25
text_mt: And these, Parā, Parāparā, and Aparā, are ever arisen; / each of them is threefold through emission, maintenance, and reabsorption,

sanskrit_iast:
caturthaṃ cānavacchinnaṃ rūpamāsāmakalpitam /
evaṃ dvādaśa tā devyaḥ sūryabimbavadāsthitāḥ // 26
meaning:
चतुर्थं चानवच्छिन्नं रूपमासामकल्पितम् /
एवं द्वादश ता देव्यः सूर्यबिम्बवदास्थिताः // 26
text_mt: and their fourth form is undivided and unconstructed. / Thus, those twelve goddesses abide like the disc of the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikamāsāṃ vahnyarkasomatacchāntibhāsanam /
etadānuttaraṃ cakraṃ hṛdayāccakṣurādibhiḥ // 27
meaning:
एकैकमासां वह्न्यर्कसोमतच्छान्तिभासनम् /
एतदानुत्तरं चक्रं हृदयाच्चक्षुरादिभिः // 27
text_mt: Each one of them is the illumination of fire, sun, moon, and their peace. / This unexcelled wheel issues forth from the heart through the eyes and other

sanskrit_iast:
vyomabhirniḥsaratyeva tattadviṣayagocare /
taccakrabhābhistatrārthe sṛṣṭisthitilayakramāt // 28
meaning:
व्योमभिर्निःसरत्येव तत्तद्विषयगोचरे /
तच्चक्रभाभिस्तत्रार्थे सृष्टिस्थितिलयक्रमात् // 28
text_mt: openings into the range of their respective objects. / By the radiances of that wheel, upon that object, through the sequence of emission, maintenance, and dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
somasūryāgnibhāsātma rūpaṃ samavatiṣṭhate /
evaṃ śabdādiviṣaye śrotrādivyomavartmanā // 29
meaning:
सोमसूर्याग्निभासात्म रूपं समवतिष्ठते /
एवं शब्दादिविषये श्रोत्रादिव्योमवर्त्मना // 29
text_mt: its form, consisting of the light of the moon, sun, and fire, becomes established. / In this way, upon the objects such as sound, through the path of the void of the ear and other senses,

sanskrit_iast:
cakreṇānena patatā tādātmyaṃ paribhāvayet /
anena kramayogena yatra yatra patatyadaḥ // 30
meaning:
चक्रेणानेन पतता तादात्म्यं परिभावयेत् /
अनेन क्रमयोगेन यत्र यत्र पतत्यदः // 30
text_mt: one should contemplate identity with this wheel as it descends. / By this sequential practice, wherever this

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ sarvātmakaṃ tattatsārvabhaumamahīśavat /
itthaṃ viśvādhvapaṭalamayatnenaiva līyate // 31
meaning:
चक्रं सर्वात्मकं तत्तत्सार्वभौममहीशवत् /
इत्थं विश्वाध्वपटलमयत्नेनैव लीयते // 31
text_mt: all-encompassing wheel descends, like a sovereign universal monarch, / thus the veil of the entire path dissolves without any effort

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavīyamahācakre saṃvittiparivārite /
tataḥ saṃskāramātreṇa viśvasyāpi parikṣaye // 32
meaning:
भैरवीयमहाचक्रे संवित्तिपरिवारिते /
ततः संस्कारमात्रेण विश्वस्यापि परिक्षये // 32
text_mt: in the great wheel of Bhairava surrounded by the retinue of consciousness. / Then, when even the universe has dissolved through mere latent impression,

sanskrit_iast:
svātmocchalattayā bhrāmyaccakraṃ saṃcintayenmahat /
tatastaddāhyavilayāt tatsaṃskāraparikṣayāt // 33
meaning:
स्वात्मोच्छलत्तया भ्राम्यच्चक्रं संचिन्तयेन्महत् /
ततस्तद्दाह्यविलयात् तत्संस्कारपरिक्षयात् // 33
text_mt: one should contemplate the great wheel whirling through the surge of one's own Self. / Then, through the dissolution of that fuel, through the vanishing of those latent impressions,

sanskrit_iast:
praśāmyadbhāvayeccakraṃ tataḥ śāntaṃ tataḥ śamam /
anena dhyānayogena viśvaṃ cakre vilīyate // 34
meaning:
प्रशाम्यद्भावयेच्चक्रं ततः शान्तं ततः शमम् /
अनेन ध्यानयोगेन विश्वं चक्रे विलीयते // 34
text_mt: one should contemplate the wheel as coming to rest, then peaceful, and then as peace itself. / Through this discipline of meditation, the universe dissolves into the wheel,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃvidi tataḥ saṃvidvilīnārthaiva bhāsate /
citsvābhāvyāt tato bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭiryaccinmaheśvarī // 35
meaning:
तत्संविदि ततः संविद्विलीनार्थैव भासते /
चित्स्वाभाव्यात् ततो भूयः सृष्टिर्यच्चिन्महेश्वरी // 35
text_mt: that dissolves into consciousness, and then consciousness shines forth with its objects dissolved; / and from the nature of consciousness, there is emission once again, since consciousness is the Great Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ viśvaṃ svasaṃvidi vilāpayan /
visṛjaṃśca tato bhūyaḥ śaśvadbhairavatāṃ vrajet // 36
meaning:
एवं प्रतिक्षणं विश्वं स्वसंविदि विलापयन् /
विसृजंश्च ततो भूयः शश्वद्भैरवतां व्रजेत् // 36
text_mt: Dissolving the universe into one's own consciousness every moment in this manner, / and emitting it again from that, one permanently attains the state of Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ triśūlāt prabhṛti catuṣpañcārakakramāt /
pañcāśadaraparyantaṃ cakraṃ yogī vibhāvayet // 37
meaning:
एवं त्रिशूलात् प्रभृति चतुष्पञ्चारकक्रमात् /
पञ्चाशदरपर्यन्तं चक्रं योगी विभावयेत् // 37
text_mt: In this way, the yogin should contemplate the wheel starting from the trident, / in the progression of four and five spokes, up to fifty spokes,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣṣaṣṭiśatāraṃ vā sahasrāramathāpi vā /
asaṃkhyārasahasraṃ vā cakraṃ dhyāyedananyadhīḥ // 38
meaning:
चतुष्षष्टिशतारं वा सहस्रारमथापि वा /
असंख्यारसहस्रं वा चक्रं ध्यायेदनन्यधीः // 38
text_mt: or with sixty-four or a hundred spokes, or even a thousand spokes; / or with an undistracted mind, one should meditate on the wheel of countless thousands of spokes.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvinnāthasya mahato devasyollāsisaṃvidaḥ /
naivāsti kācitkalanā viśvaśaktermaheśituḥ // 39
meaning:
संविन्नाथस्य महतो देवस्योल्लासिसंविदः /
नैवास्ति काचित्कलना विश्वशक्तेर्महेशितुः // 39
text_mt: For the Lord of consciousness, the great god whose consciousness is surging forth, / the supreme ruler who possesses the universal power, there is no limitation whatsoever.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktayo'sya jagat kṛtsnaṃ śaktimāṃstu maheśvaraḥ /
iti māṅgalaśāstre tu śrīśrīkaṇṭho nyarūpayat // 40
meaning:
शक्तयोऽस्य जगत् कृत्स्नं शक्तिमांस्तु महेश्वरः /
इति माङ्गलशास्त्रे तु श्रीश्रीकण्ठो न्यरूपयत् // 40
text_mt: The entire universe is his powers, but the Great Lord is the possessor of power: / so the venerable Śrīkaṇṭha explained in the auspicious scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
ityetat prathamopāyarūpaṃ dhyānaṃ nyarūpayat /
śrīśaṃbhunātho me tuṣṭastasmai śrīsumatiprabhuḥ // 41
meaning:
इत्येतत् प्रथमोपायरूपं ध्यानं न्यरूपयत् /
श्रीशंभुनाथो मे तुष्टस्तस्मै श्रीसुमतिप्रभुः // 41
text_mt: Thus, the meditation that constitutes this first means was explained to me / by the revered Śambhunātha, well pleased, and to him by the venerable master Sumati.

sanskrit_iast:
anayaiva diśānyāni dhyānānyapi samāśrayet /
anuttaropāyadhurāṃ yānyāyānti kramaṃ vinā // 42
meaning:
अनयैव दिशान्यानि ध्यानान्यपि समाश्रयेत् /
अनुत्तरोपायधुरां यान्यायान्ति क्रमं विना // 42
text_mt: In this very manner, one should also take recourse to other meditations / that lead without gradual sequence to the summit of the unexcelled means.

sanskrit_iast:
atha prāṇasya yā vṛttiḥ prāṇanādyā nirūpitā /
tadupāyatayā brūmo'nuttarapravikāsanam // 43
meaning:
अथ प्राणस्य या वृत्तिः प्राणनाद्या निरूपिता /
तदुपायतया ब्रूमोऽनुत्तरप्रविकासनम् // 43
text_mt: Now, as for the function of the vital breath described as prāṇana and so forth, / we explain the unfolding of the unexcelled using that as a means.

sanskrit_iast:
nijānande pramātraṃśamātre hṛdi purā sthitaḥ /
śūnyatāmātraviśrānternirānandaṃ vibhāvayet // 44
meaning:
निजानन्दे प्रमात्रंशमात्रे हृदि पुरा स्थितः /
शून्यतामात्रविश्रान्तेर्निरानन्दं विभावयेत् // 44
text_mt: Having first rested in the heart, in one's own bliss, in the mere portion of the knower, / one should contemplate the absence of bliss due to resting in the void alone.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇodaye prameye tu parānandaṃ vibhāvayet /
tatrānantaprameyāṃśapūraṇāpānanirvṛtaḥ // 45
meaning:
प्राणोदये प्रमेये तु परानन्दं विभावयेत् /
तत्रानन्तप्रमेयांशपूरणापाननिर्वृतः // 45
text_mt: When prāṇa arises, however, one should contemplate the supreme bliss (parānanda) in the object of knowledge; / there, filled with the boundless portions of knowables, he is delighted by apāna. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
parānandagatastiṣṭhedapānaśaśiśobhitaḥ /
tato'nantasphuranmeyasaṃghaṭṭaikāntanirvṛtaḥ // 46
meaning:
परानन्दगतस्तिष्ठेदपानशशिशोभितः /
ततोऽनन्तस्फुरन्मेयसंघट्टैकान्तनिर्वृतः // 46
text_mt: Having attained parānanda, he should abide adorned by the moon of apāna; / then, entirely satisfied by the collision with the infinitely vibrant knowables, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
samānabhūmimāgatya brahmānandamayo bhavet /
tato'pi mānameyaughakalanāgrāsatatparaḥ // 47
meaning:
समानभूमिमागत्य ब्रह्मानन्दमयो भवेत् /
ततोऽपि मानमेयौघकलनाग्रासतत्परः // 47
text_mt: and having reached the level of samāna, he becomes full of the bliss of Brahman (brahmānanda). / Then, intent upon devouring the surging movement of means of knowledge and knowables, // 47

sanskrit_iast:
udānavahnau viśrānto mahānandaṃ vibhāvayat /
tatra viśrāntimabhyetya śāmyatyasminmahārciṣi // 48
meaning:
उदानवह्नौ विश्रान्तो महानन्दं विभावयत् /
तत्र विश्रान्तिमभ्येत्य शाम्यत्यस्मिन्महार्चिषि // 48
text_mt: resting in the fire of udāna, he should contemplate the great bliss (mahānanda). / Having attained repose there, he is pacified in this great flame; // 48

sanskrit_iast:
nirupādhirmahāvyāptirvyānākhyopādhivarjitā /
tadā khalu cidānando yo jaḍānupabṛṃhitaḥ // 49
meaning:
निरुपाधिर्महाव्याप्तिर्व्यानाख्योपाधिवर्जिता /
तदा खलु चिदानन्दो यो जडानुपबृंहितः // 49
text_mt: the great pervasion, devoid of limiting adjuncts, is stripped of the conditioning called vyāna. / Then indeed occurs the bliss of consciousness (cidānanda), which is not reinforced by insentient matter; // 49

sanskrit_iast:
nahyatra saṃsthitiḥ kāpi vibhaktā jaḍarūpiṇaḥ /
yatra ko'pi vyavacchedo nāsti yadviśvataḥ sphurat // 50
meaning:
नह्यत्र संस्थितिः कापि विभक्ता जडरूपिणः /
यत्र कोऽपि व्यवच्छेदो नास्ति यद्विश्वतः स्फुरत् // 50
text_mt: for here there is no separate existence whatsoever of an insentient nature, / wherein there is no demarcation at all, and which pulses everywhere, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
yadanāhatasaṃvitti paramāmṛtabṛṃhitam /
yatrāsti bhāvanādīnāṃ na mukhyā kāpi saṃgatiḥ // 51
meaning:
यदनाहतसंवित्ति परमामृतबृंहितम् /
यत्रास्ति भावनादीनां न मुख्या कापि संगतिः // 51
text_mt: which is uninhibited consciousness, swollen with supreme nectar, / wherein contemplation and the like have no primary relevance at all. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva jagadānandamasmabhyaṃ śaṃbhurūcivān /
tatra viśrāntirādheyā hṛdayoccārayogataḥ // 52
meaning:
तदेव जगदानन्दमस्मभ्यं शंभुरूचिवान् /
तत्र विश्रान्तिराधेया हृदयोच्चारयोगतः // 52
text_mt: That very state Śambhu declared to us as the universal bliss (jagadānanda); / repose is to be established therein by means of the sounding of the heart (hṛdayoccāra). // 52

sanskrit_iast:
yā tatra samyagviśrāntiḥ sānuttaramayī sthitiḥ /
ityetaddhṛdayādyekasvabhāve'pi svadhāmani // 53
meaning:
या तत्र सम्यग्विश्रान्तिः सानुत्तरमयी स्थितिः /
इत्येतद्धृदयाद्येकस्वभावेऽपि स्वधामनि // 53
text_mt: Complete repose therein is the state consisting of the unexcelled. / Thus, although one's own abode possesses a single nature, beginning with the heart, // 53

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭprāṇoccārajaṃ rūpamatha vyāptyā taducyate /
prāṇadaṇḍaprayogena pūrvāparasamīkṛteḥ // 54
meaning:
षट्प्राणोच्चारजं रूपमथ व्याप्त्या तदुच्यते /
प्राणदण्डप्रयोगेन पूर्वापरसमीकृतेः // 54
text_mt: its form arising from the sounding of the six vital breaths is now spoken of according to its pervasion. / By employing the staff-like movement of the breath (prāṇadaṇḍa), through harmonizing the prior and subsequent, // 54

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkikāmbujālambilambikāsaudhamāśrayet /
triśūlabhūmiṃ krāntvāto nāḍitritayasaṅgatām // 55
meaning:
चतुष्किकाम्बुजालम्बिलम्बिकासौधमाश्रयेत् /
त्रिशूलभूमिं क्रान्त्वातो नाडित्रितयसङ्गताम् // 55
text_mt: one should take refuge in the palace of the uvula that hangs over the lotus of the four-pillared hall. / Then, having crossed the level of the trident connected to the triad of channels, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
icchājñānakriyāśaktisamatve praviśet sudhīḥ /
ekāṃ vikāsinīṃ bhūyastvasaṃkocāṃ vikasvarām // 56
meaning:
इच्छाज्ञानक्रियाशक्तिसमत्वे प्रविशेत् सुधीः /
एकां विकासिनीं भूयस्त्वसंकोचां विकस्वराम् // 56
text_mt: in the equality of the powers of will, knowledge, and action, the wise person should enter. / One, expanding, further uncontracted and blossoming, // 56

sanskrit_iast:
śrayedbhrūbindunādāntaśaktisopānamālikām /
tatrordhvakuṇḍalībhūmau spandanodarasundaraḥ // 57
meaning:
श्रयेद्भ्रूबिन्दुनादान्तशक्तिसोपानमालिकाम् /
तत्रोर्ध्वकुण्डलीभूमौ स्पन्दनोदरसुन्दरः // 57
text_mt: he should resort to the staircase consisting of eyebrow-center, bindu, nāda, nādānta, and śakti. / There, on the level of the upper kuṇḍalinī, lovely with the interior of vibration, // 57

sanskrit_iast:
visargastatra viśrāmyenmatsyodaradaśājuṣi /
rāsabhī vaḍavā yadvatsvadhāmānandamandiram // 58
meaning:
विसर्गस्तत्र विश्राम्येन्मत्स्योदरदशाजुषि /
रासभी वडवा यद्वत्स्वधामानन्दमन्दिरम् // 58
text_mt: creative emission should repose in that place enjoying the condition of the fish's belly; / just as a she-ass or a mare, entering into the mansion of bliss that is her own abode, // 58

sanskrit_iast:
vikāsasaṃkocamayaṃ praviśya hṛdi hṛṣyati /
tadvanmuhurlīnasṛṣṭabhāvavrātasunirbharām // 59
meaning:
विकाससंकोचमयं प्रविश्य हृदि हृष्यति /
तद्वन्मुहुर्लीनसृष्टभावव्रातसुनिर्भराम् // 59
text_mt: consisting of expansion and contraction, rejoices in her heart, / so should he resort to the dyad of Bhairava rooted in expansion and contraction, // 59

sanskrit_iast:
śrayedvikāsasaṃkocarūḍhabhairavayāmalām /
ekīkṛtamahāmūlaśūlavaisargike hṛdi // 60
meaning:
श्रयेद्विकाससंकोचरूढभैरवयामलाम् /
एकीकृतमहामूलशूलवैसर्गिके हृदि // 60
text_mt: utterly brimming with the host of entities repeatedly dissolved and emitted / in the emissive heart, wherein the great root trident has been unified. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
parasminneti viśrāntiṃ sarvāpūraṇayogataḥ /
atra tatpūrṇavṛttyaiva viśvāveśamayaṃ sthitam // 61
meaning:
परस्मिन्नेति विश्रान्तिं सर्वापूरणयोगतः /
अत्र तत्पूर्णवृत्त्यैव विश्वावेशमयं स्थितम् // 61
text_mt: He reaches repose in the supreme through filling all things; / here, through its very full activity, it abides consisting of the absorption of the universe. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśasyātmaviśrāntāvahamityeva dṛśyatām /
anuttaravimarśe prāgvyāpārādivivarjite // 62
meaning:
प्रकाशस्यात्मविश्रान्तावहमित्येव दृश्यताम् /
अनुत्तरविमर्शे प्राग्व्यापारादिविवर्जिते // 62
text_mt: In the self-repose of luminosity, let it be seen as 'I'; / in the unexcelled reflective awareness, devoid of prior activity and the rest, // 62

sanskrit_iast:
cidvimarśaparāhaṃkṛt prathamollāsinī sphuret /
tata udyogasaktena sa dvādaśakalātmanā // 63
meaning:
चिद्विमर्शपराहंकृत् प्रथमोल्लासिनी स्फुरेत् /
तत उद्योगसक्तेन स द्वादशकलात्मना // 63
text_mt: the supreme 'I'-awareness of reflective consciousness, sparkling at the very beginning, shines forth. / Then, through the sun composed of twelve digits, intent upon exertion, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
sūryeṇābhāsayedbhāvaṃ pūrayedatha carcayet /
athenduḥ ṣoḍaśakalo visargagrāsamantharaḥ // 64
meaning:
सूर्येणाभासयेद्भावं पूरयेदथ चर्चयेत् /
अथेन्दुः षोडशकलो विसर्गग्रासमन्थरः // 64
text_mt: he illuminates reality, fills it, and then reflects upon it. / Then the sixteen-digit moon, slow in devouring creative emission, // 64

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjīvanyamṛtaṃ bodhavahnau visṛjati sphuran /
icchājñānakriyāśaktisūkṣmarandhrasrugagragam // 65
meaning:
संजीवन्यमृतं बोधवह्नौ विसृजति स्फुरन् /
इच्छाज्ञानक्रियाशक्तिसूक्ष्मरन्ध्रस्रुगग्रगम् // 65
text_mt: shining, emits the reviving nectar into the fire of consciousness, / reaching the tip of the ladle that is the subtle aperture of the powers of will, knowledge, and action. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
tadevama[tada]mṛtaṃ divyaṃ saṃviddevīṣu tarpakam /
visargāmṛtametāvad bodhākhye hutabhojini // 66
meaning:
तदेवम[तद]मृतं दिव्यं संविद्देवीषु तर्पकम् /
विसर्गामृतमेतावद् बोधाख्ये हुतभोजिनि // 66
text_mt: Thus this divine nectar, gratifying the goddesses of consciousness, / this entire nectar of creative emission, if emitted into the fire-consumer called consciousness, // 66

sanskrit_iast:
visṛṣṭaṃ cedbhavetsarvaṃ hutaṃ ṣoḍhādhvamaṇḍalam /
yato'nuttaranāthasya visargaḥ kulanāyikā /
tatkṣobhaḥ kādihāntaṃ tatprasarastattvapaddhatiḥ // 67
meaning:
विसृष्टं चेद्भवेत्सर्वं हुतं षोढाध्वमण्डलम् /
यतोऽनुत्तरनाथस्य विसर्गः कुलनायिका /
तत्क्षोभः कादिहान्तं तत्प्रसरस्तत्त्वपद्धतिः // 67
