text_mt: then everything, the wheel of the sixfold path, becomes offered as oblation. / For creative emission is the mistress of Kula belonging to the unexcelled Lord; / its agitation is from ka to ha; its procession is the course of the tattvas. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
aṃa iti kuleśvaryā sahito hi kuleśitā /
paro visargaviśleṣastanmayaṃ viśvamucyate // 68
meaning:
अंअ इति कुलेश्वर्या सहितो हि कुलेशिता /
परो विसर्गविश्लेषस्तन्मयं विश्वमुच्यते // 68
text_mt: For the master of Kula together with the mistress of Kula is 'aṃ' and 'aḥ'; / the higher separation of creative emission—of that nature the universe is said to be. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
vitprāṇaguṇadehāntarbahirdravyamayīmimām /
arcayejjuhuyāddhyāyeditthaṃ saṃjīvanīṃ kalām // 69
meaning:
वित्प्राणगुणदेहान्तर्बहिर्द्रव्यमयीमिमाम् /
अर्चयेज्जुहुयाद्ध्यायेदित्थं संजीवनीं कलाम् // 69
text_mt: One should worship, sacrifice with, and meditate upon this reviving digit / consisting of external and internal substance within consciousness, breath, qualities, and the body in this way. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
ānandanāḍīyugalaspandanāvahitau sthitaḥ /
enāṃ visarganiḥṣyandasaudhabhūmiṃ prapadyate // 70
meaning:
आनन्दनाडीयुगलस्पन्दनावहितौ स्थितः /
एनां विसर्गनिःष्यन्दसौधभूमिं प्रपद्यते // 70
text_mt: Stationed attentively in the vibration of the pair of blissful channels, / he enters this palatial realm of the outpouring of creative emission. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
śākte kṣobhe kulāveśe sarvanāḍyagragocare /
vyāptau sarvātmasaṃkoce hṛdayaṃ praviśetsudhīḥ // 71
meaning:
शाक्ते क्षोभे कुलावेशे सर्वनाड्यग्रगोचरे /
व्याप्तौ सर्वात्मसंकोचे हृदयं प्रविशेत्सुधीः // 71
text_mt: In the agitation of śakti, in the absorption of Kula, at the object in the tips of all channels, / in pervasion, in the contraction of all beings, the wise person should enter the heart. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
somasūryakalājālaparasparanigharṣataḥ /
agnīṣomātmake dhāmni visargānanda unmiṣet // 72
meaning:
सोमसूर्यकलाजालपरस्परनिघर्षतः /
अग्नीषोमात्मके धाम्नि विसर्गानन्द उन्मिषेत् // 72
text_mt: From the mutual friction of the arrays of digits of moon and sun, / in the abode consisting of fire and moon, the bliss of creative emission blossoms forth. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ rahasyakathayā guptametatsvabhāvataḥ /
yoginīhṛdayaṃ tatra viśrāntaḥ syātkṛtī budhaḥ // 73
meaning:
अलं रहस्यकथया गुप्तमेतत्स्वभावतः /
योगिनीहृदयं तत्र विश्रान्तः स्यात्कृती बुधः // 73
text_mt: Enough of talking about secrets! By its very nature this is concealed, / the Heart of the Yoginīs; reposing therein, the wise person becomes accomplished. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
hānādānatiraskāravṛttau rūḍhimupāgataḥ /
abhedavṛttitaḥ paśyedviśvaṃ citicamatkṛteḥ // 74
meaning:
हानादानतिरस्कारवृत्तौ रूढिमुपागतः /
अभेदवृत्तितः पश्येद्विश्वं चितिचमत्कृतेः // 74
text_mt: Having attained stability in the state beyond rejecting and accepting, / through the operation of non-differentiation, out of the wonder of consciousness, he sees the universe. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
arthakriyārthitādainyaṃ tyaktvā bāhyāntarātmani /
kharūpe nirvṛtiṃ prāpya phullāṃ nādadaśāṃ śrayet // 75
meaning:
अर्थक्रियार्थितादैन्यं त्यक्त्वा बाह्यान्तरात्मनि /
खरूपे निर्वृतिं प्राप्य फुल्लां नाददशां श्रयेत् // 75
text_mt: Abandoning the wretched longing for pragmatic efficacy, inwardly and outwardly, / having attained bliss in the nature of space, he should resort to the blossomed state of nāda. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
vaktramantastayā samyak saṃvidaḥ pravikāsayet /
saṃvidakṣamaruccakraṃ jñeyābhinnaṃ tato bhavet // 76
meaning:
वक्त्रमन्तस्तया सम्यक् संविदः प्रविकासयेत् /
संविदक्षमरुच्चक्रं ज्ञेयाभिन्नं ततो भवेत् // 76
text_mt: Through it, he should fully expand the mouth of consciousness internally; / then the circle of consciousness, sense faculties, and vital breath becomes non-different from the knowable. // 76

sanskrit_iast:
tajjñeyaṃ saṃvidākhyena vahninā pravilīyate /
vilīnaṃ tat trikoṇe'smiñśaktivahnau vilīyate // 77
meaning:
तज्ज्ञेयं संविदाख्येन वह्निना प्रविलीयते /
विलीनं तत् त्रिकोणेऽस्मिञ्शक्तिवह्नौ विलीयते // 77
text_mt: That knowable is dissolved by the fire called consciousness; / dissolved, it is dissolved in this triangle, the fire of śakti. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
tatra saṃvedanodārabindusattāsunirvṛtaḥ /
saṃhārabījaviśrānto yogī paramayo bhavet // 78
meaning:
तत्र संवेदनोदारबिन्दुसत्तासुनिर्वृतः /
संहारबीजविश्रान्तो योगी परमयो भवेत् // 78
text_mt: Delighted therein by the noble existence of the bindu of consciousness, / reposing in the seed of dissolution, the yogi becomes identified with the Supreme. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
antarbāhye dvaye vāpi sāmānyetarasundaraḥ /
saṃvitspandastriśaktyātmā saṃkocapravikāsavān // 79
meaning:
अन्तर्बाह्ये द्वये वापि सामान्येतरसुन्दरः /
संवित्स्पन्दस्त्रिशक्त्यात्मा संकोचप्रविकासवान् // 79
text_mt: Internally, externally, or in both, beautiful in the universal and the particular, / the vibration of consciousness embodies the three powers, possessing contraction and expansion. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkocavikāso'pi tadābhāsanatastathā /
antarlakṣyo bahirdṛṣṭiḥ paramaṃ padamaśnute // 80
meaning:
असंकोचविकासोऽपि तदाभासनतस्तथा /
अन्तर्लक्ष्यो बहिर्दृष्टिः परमं पदमश्नुते // 80
text_mt: Even while devoid of contraction and expansion, through manifesting them in this manner, / with inner focus and outward gaze, he attains the supreme state. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ svātantryanirmeye vicitrārthakriyākṛti /
vimarśanaṃ viśeṣākhyaḥ spanda aunmukhyasaṃjñitaḥ // 81
meaning:
ततः स्वातन्त्र्यनिर्मेये विचित्रार्थक्रियाकृति /
विमर्शनं विशेषाख्यः स्पन्द औन्मुख्यसंज्ञितः // 81
text_mt: Then, in the sphere created by absolute autonomy, producing manifold pragmatic efficacy, / reflective awareness is the particular vibration, designated as 'directedness'. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
tatra viśrāntimāgacchedyadvīryaṃ mantramaṇḍale /
śāntyādisiddhayastattadrūpatādātmyato yataḥ // 82
meaning:
तत्र विश्रान्तिमागच्छेद्यद्वीर्यं मन्त्रमण्डले /
शान्त्यादिसिद्धयस्तत्तद्रूपतादात्म्यतो यतः // 82
text_mt: He should attain repose there, which is the potency in the circle of mantras; / for spiritual accomplishments such as pacification arise through identification with their respective forms. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
divyo yaścākṣasaṃgho'yaṃ bodhasvātantryasaṃjñakaḥ /
so'nimīlita evaitat kuryātsvātmamayaṃ jagat // 83
meaning:
दिव्यो यश्चाक्षसंघोऽयं बोधस्वातन्त्र्यसंज्ञकः /
सोऽनिमीलित एवैतत् कुर्यात्स्वात्ममयं जगत् // 83
text_mt: And this divine assembly of sense faculties, designated as the absolute autonomy of consciousness, / remaining unclosed, should render this world composed of its own Self. // 83

sanskrit_iast:
mahāsāhasasaṃyogavilīnākhilavṛttikaḥ /
puñjībhūte svaraśmyoghe nirbharībhūya tiṣṭhati // 84
meaning:
महासाहससंयोगविलीनाखिलवृत्तिकः /
पुञ्जीभूते स्वरश्म्योघे निर्भरीभूय तिष्ठति // 84
text_mt: With all operations dissolved through contact with the Great Audacity, / he abides, overflowing, in the assembled mass of his own rays. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
akiciccintakastatra spaṣṭadṛgyāti saṃvidam /
yadvisphuliṅgāḥ saṃsārabhasmadāhaikahetavaḥ // 85
meaning:
अकिचिच्चिन्तकस्तत्र स्पष्टदृग्याति संविदम् /
यद्विस्फुलिङ्गाः संसारभस्मदाहैकहेतवः // 85
text_mt: Thinking of nothing there, with clear vision, he enters consciousness, / whose sparks are the sole cause of burning the transmigration into ashes. // 85

sanskrit_iast:
taduktaṃ parameśena triśirobhairavāgame /
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mantrabhūmyāṃ praveśanam // 86
meaning:
तदुक्तं परमेशेन त्रिशिरोभैरवागमे /
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि मन्त्रभूम्यां प्रवेशनम् // 86
text_mt: That was spoken by the Supreme Lord in the Triśirobhairava scripture: / 'Hear, O Goddess, I will declare entrance into the plane of mantra: // 86

sanskrit_iast:
madhyanāḍyordhvagamanaṃ taddharmaprāptilakṣaṇam /
visargāntapadātītaṃ prāntakoṭinirūpitam // 87
meaning:
मध्यनाड्योर्ध्वगमनं तद्धर्मप्राप्तिलक्षणम् /
विसर्गान्तपदातीतं प्रान्तकोटिनिरूपितम् // 87
text_mt: The upward movement of the central channel is defined by the attainment of its characteristics; / it transcends the state at the end of creative emission and is defined at the final tip. // 87

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥpravāhasaṃrodhādūrdhvakṣepavivarjanāt /
mahāprakāśamudayajñānavyaktipradāyakam // 88
meaning:
अधःप्रवाहसंरोधादूर्ध्वक्षेपविवर्जनात् /
महाप्रकाशमुदयज्ञानव्यक्तिप्रदायकम् // 88
text_mt: By blocking the downward flow and avoiding upward expulsion, / it grants the great light and the manifestation of emergent knowledge. // 88

sanskrit_iast:
anubhūya pare dhāmni mātrāvṛttyā puraṃ viśet /
nistaraṅgāvatīrṇā sā vṛttirekā śivātmikā // 89
meaning:
अनुभूय परे धाम्नि मात्रावृत्त्या पुरं विशेत् /
निस्तरङ्गावतीर्णा सा वृत्तिरेका शिवात्मिका // 89
text_mt: Having experienced this in the supreme abode, through the movement of the measure, he should enter the city. / Devoid of waves, that descended single movement consists of Śiva; // 89

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣṣaḍdvirdviguṇitacakraṣaṭkasamujjvalā /
tatsthaṃ [tstho] vicārayet khaṃ khaṃ khasthaṃ khasthena saṃviśet // 90
meaning:
चतुष्षड्द्विर्द्विगुणितचक्रषट्कसमुज्ज्वला /
तत्स्थं [त्स्थो] विचारयेत् खं खं खस्थं खस्थेन संविशेत् // 90
text_mt: it shines brilliantly with the six chakras doubled by four, six, and two. / Standing therein, he should contemplate space: space, space, resting in space; through that which rests in space, he should enter. // 90

sanskrit_iast:
khaṃ khaṃ tyaktvā khamāruhya khasthaṃ khaṃ coccarediti /
khamadhyāsyādhikāreṇa padasthāścinmarīcayaḥ // 91
meaning:
खं खं त्यक्त्वा खमारुह्य खस्थं खं चोच्चरेदिति /
खमध्यास्याधिकारेण पदस्थाश्चिन्मरीचयः // 91
text_mt: Abandoning space after space, ascending to space, he should sound space resting in space.' / By authority over the center of space, the rays of consciousness are established in their places. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvayedbhāvamantaḥsthaṃ bhāvastho bhāvaniḥspṛhaḥ /
bhāvābhāvagatī ruddhvā bhāvābhāvāvarodhadṛk // 92
meaning:
भावयेद्भावमन्तःस्थं भावस्थो भावनिःस्पृहः /
भावाभावगती रुद्ध्वा भावाभावावरोधदृक् // 92
text_mt: Established in the state [of consciousness], free from craving for external entities, one should cultivate the inner reality, / having stopped the movement of being and non-being, beholding the cessation of being and non-being. // 92

sanskrit_iast:
ātmāṇukulamūlāni śaktirbhūtiścitī ratiḥ /
śaktitrayaṃ draṣṭṛdṛśyoparaktaṃ tadvivarjitam // 93
meaning:
आत्माणुकुलमूलानि शक्तिर्भूतिश्चिती रतिः /
शक्तित्रयं द्रष्टृदृश्योपरक्तं तद्विवर्जितम् // 93
text_mt: Self, soul, family, root, power, manifestation, consciousness, delight, / the triad of powers colored by perceiver and perceived, and that which is free of them: // 93

sanskrit_iast:
etatkhaṃ daśadhā proktamuccāroccāralakṣaṇam /
dhāmasthaṃ dhāmamadhyasthaṃ dhāmodarapuṭīkṛtam // 94
meaning:
एतत्खं दशधा प्रोक्तमुच्चारोच्चारलक्षणम् /
धामस्थं धाममध्यस्थं धामोदरपुटीकृतम् // 94
text_mt: this void is taught as tenfold, characterized by phonic enunciation upon phonic enunciation; / residing in the station, residing in the middle of the station, enclosed within the cavity of the station. // 94

sanskrit_iast:
dhāmnā tu bodhayeddhāma dhāma dhāmāntagaṃ kuru /
taddhāma dhāmagatyā tu bhedyaṃ dhāmāntamāntaram // 95
meaning:
धाम्ना तु बोधयेद्धाम धाम धामान्तगं कुरु /
तद्धाम धामगत्या तु भेद्यं धामान्तमान्तरम् // 95
text_mt: One should awaken station through station; bring the station to the end of the station; / that station, through movement from station to station, is to be pierced to the innermost end of the station. // 95

sanskrit_iast:
bhedopabhedabhedena bhedaḥ kāryastu madhyataḥ /
iti praveśopāyo'yamāṇavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ // 96
meaning:
भेदोपभेदभेदेन भेदः कार्यस्तु मध्यतः /
इति प्रवेशोपायोऽयमाणवः परिकीर्तितः // 96
text_mt: Piercing is to be effected from the middle through the division of primary and secondary divisions. / Thus this individual means of absorption has been proclaimed, // 96

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmaheśvaranāthena yo hṛtsthena mamoditaḥ /
śrībrahmayāmale coktaṃ śrīmān rāvo daśātmakaḥ // 97
meaning:
श्रीमहेश्वरनाथेन यो हृत्स्थेन ममोदितः /
श्रीब्रह्मयामले चोक्तं श्रीमान् रावो दशात्मकः // 97
text_mt: which was spoken to me by the venerable Maheśvaranātha dwelling in my heart. / And in the venerable Brahmayāmala it is taught: 'The glorious sound is tenfold: // 97

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paro hṛdyaḥ kaṇṭhyastālavya eva ca /
sarvataśca vibhuryo'sau vibhutvapadadāyakaḥ // 98
meaning:
स्थूलः सूक्ष्मः परो हृद्यः कण्ठ्यस्तालव्य एव च /
सर्वतश्च विभुर्योऽसौ विभुत्वपददायकः // 98
text_mt: gross, subtle, supreme, belonging to the heart, guttural, and palatal, / and that all-pervading [sound] everywhere, which bestows the state of omnipresence. // 98

sanskrit_iast:
jitarāvo mahāyogī saṃkrāmetparadehagaḥ /
parāṃ ca vindati vyāptiṃ pratyahaṃ hyabhyaseta tam // 99
meaning:
जितरावो महायोगी संक्रामेत्परदेहगः /
परां च विन्दति व्याप्तिं प्रत्यहं ह्यभ्यसेत तम् // 99
text_mt: The great yogin who has mastered sound can enter into another's body, / and attains supreme pervasion; one should indeed practice it every day, // 99

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadyāvadarāve sā rāvāllīyeta rāviṇī /
atra bhāvanayā dehagatopāyaiḥ pare pathi // 100
meaning:
तावद्यावदरावे सा रावाल्लीयेत राविणी /
अत्र भावनया देहगतोपायैः परे पथि // 100
text_mt: so long until that sounding [power] dissolves from sound into the soundless.' / Here, through contemplation by means rooted in the body, on the supreme path, // 100

sanskrit_iast:
vivikṣoḥ pūrṇatāsparśātprāgānandaḥ prajāyate /
tato'pi vidyudāpātasadṛśe dehavarjite // 101
meaning:
विविक्षोः पूर्णतास्पर्शात्प्रागानन्दः प्रजायते /
ततोऽपि विद्युदापातसदृशे देहवर्जिते // 101
text_mt: for one wishing to enter, bliss arises first from the contact with fullness. / Then, from absorption even for a moment in the station free from the body, // 101

sanskrit_iast:
dhāmni kṣaṇaṃ samāveśādudbhavaḥ prasphuṭaṃ plutiḥ /
jalapāṃsuvadabhyastasaṃviddehaikyahānitaḥ // 102
meaning:
धाम्नि क्षणं समावेशादुद्भवः प्रस्फुटं प्लुतिः /
जलपांसुवदभ्यस्तसंविद्देहैक्यहानितः // 102
text_mt: resembling a flash of lightning, there occurs an upward surge, distinctly a leaping up. / Through the abandonment of the unity of consciousness and body, practiced like water [mixed with] dust, // 102

sanskrit_iast:
svabalākramaṇāddehaśaithilyāt kampamāpnuyāt /
galite dehatādātmyaniścaye'ntarbhukhatvataḥ // 103
meaning:
स्वबलाक्रमणाद्देहशैथिल्यात् कम्पमाप्नुयात् /
गलिते देहतादात्म्यनिश्चयेऽन्तर्भुखत्वतः // 103
text_mt: from the surging of one's own power and the relaxation of the body, one experiences trembling. / When the conviction of identity with the body has dissolved, because of interiorization, // 103

sanskrit_iast:
nidrāyate purā yāvanna rūḍhaḥ saṃvidātmani /
tataḥ satyapade rūḍho viśvātmatvena saṃvidam // 104
meaning:
निद्रायते पुरा यावन्न रूढः संविदात्मनि /
ततः सत्यपदे रूढो विश्वात्मत्वेन संविदम् // 104
text_mt: one enters sleep at first, as long as one has not taken root in the self of consciousness. / Then, having taken root in the true state, experiencing consciousness // 104

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvidan ghūrṇate ghūrṇirmahāvyāptiryataḥ smṛtā /
ātmanyanātmābhimatau satyāmeva hyanātmani // 105
meaning:
संविदन् घूर्णते घूर्णिर्महाव्याप्तिर्यतः स्मृता /
आत्मन्यनात्माभिमतौ सत्यामेव ह्यनात्मनि // 105
text_mt: as the universal self, one whirls; for whirling is traditionally declared to be the great pervasion. / Indeed, only when there is the notion of the non-self in the Self, does the notion of Self // 105

sanskrit_iast:
ātmābhimāno dehādau bandho muktistu tallayaḥ /
ādāvanātmanyātmatve līne labdhe nijātmani // 106
meaning:
आत्माभिमानो देहादौ बन्धो मुक्तिस्तु तल्लयः /
आदावनात्मन्यात्मत्वे लीने लब्धे निजात्मनि // 106
text_mt: in the non-self such as the body constitute bondage; but liberation is its dissolution. / At first, when the state of Self has dissolved in the non-self and been attained in one's own Self, // 106

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyanātmatānāśe mahāvyāptiḥ pravartate /
ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nindrā ghūrṇiśca pañcakam // 107
meaning:
आत्मन्यनात्मतानाशे महाव्याप्तिः प्रवर्तते /
आनन्द उद्भवः कम्पो निन्द्रा घूर्णिश्च पञ्चकम् // 107
text_mt: and the non-selfhood in the Self has been destroyed, the great pervasion operates. / Bliss, upward surge, trembling, sleep, and whirling: this pentad // 107

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktamata eva śrīmālinīvijayottare /
pradarśite'sminnānandaprabhṛtau pañcake yadā // 108
meaning:
इत्युक्तमत एव श्रीमालिनीविजयोत्तरे /
प्रदर्शितेऽस्मिन्नानन्दप्रभृतौ पञ्चके यदा // 108
text_mt: has been stated for this very reason in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara. / When a yogin enters into this pentad beginning with bliss // 108

sanskrit_iast:
yogī viśettadā tattaccakreśatvaṃ haṭhādvrajet /
yathā sarveśinā bodhenākrāntāpi tanuḥ kvacit // 109
meaning:
योगी विशेत्तदा तत्तच्चक्रेशत्वं हठाद्व्रजेत् /
यथा सर्वेशिना बोधेनाक्रान्तापि तनुः क्वचित् // 109
text_mt: that has been shown, he forcibly attains mastership over the respective centers. / Just as the body, although pervaded by the consciousness that governs everything, is able // 109

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃcitkartuṃ prabhavati cakṣuṣā rūpasaṃvidam /
tathaiva cakre kutrāpi praveśātko'pi saṃbhavet // 110
meaning:
किंचित्कर्तुं प्रभवति चक्षुषा रूपसंविदम् /
तथैव चक्रे कुत्रापि प्रवेशात्कोऽपि संभवेत् // 110
text_mt: to do something somewhere, [such as] the awareness of form through the eye, / even so, from entry into a particular center, some [particular power] arises. // 110

sanskrit_iast:
ānandacakraṃ vahnyaśri kanda udbhava ucyate /
kampo hṛttālu nidrā ca ghūrṇiḥ syādūrdhvakuṇḍalī // 111
meaning:
आनन्दचक्रं वह्न्यश्रि कन्द उद्भव उच्यते /
कम्पो हृत्तालु निद्रा च घूर्णिः स्यादूर्ध्वकुण्डली // 111
text_mt: The center of bliss is triangular; the upward surge is said to be the bulb; / trembling is the heart; sleep is the palate; and whirling is the upward kuṇḍalī. // 111

sanskrit_iast:
etacca sphuṭamevoktaṃ śrīmantraiśirase mate /
evaṃ pradarśitoccāraviśrāntihṛdayaṃ param // 112
meaning:
एतच्च स्फुटमेवोक्तं श्रीमन्त्रैशिरसे मते /
एवं प्रदर्शितोच्चारविश्रान्तिहृदयं परम् // 112
text_mt: And this has been stated clearly in the venerable doctrine of the Triśirobhairava. / Thus the supreme heart of rest in phonic enunciation has been shown. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
yattadavyaktaliṅgaṃ nṛśivaśaktyavibhāgavat /
atra viśvamidaṃ līnamatrāntaḥsthaṃ ca gamyate // 113
meaning:
यत्तदव्यक्तलिङ्गं नृशिवशक्त्यविभागवत् /
अत्र विश्वमिदं लीनमत्रान्तःस्थं च गम्यते // 113
text_mt: That which is the unmanifest sign, having no differentiation between man, Śiva, and power, / in this the universe is dissolved, and in this it is understood to reside within. // 113

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ pūrṇaśaktibhairavasaṃvidaḥ /
dehagādhvasamunmeṣe samāveśastu yaḥ sphuṭaḥ // 114
meaning:
इदं तल्लक्षणं पूर्णशक्तिभैरवसंविदः /
देहगाध्वसमुन्मेषे समावेशस्तु यः स्फुटः // 114
text_mt: This is the characteristic mark of the consciousness of Bhairava with full power. / But when there is the flashing forth of the paths residing in the body, the evident absorption, // 114

sanskrit_iast:
ahantācchāditonmeṣibhāvedaṃbhāvayuk sa ca /
vyaktāvyaktamidaṃ liṅgaṃ mantravīryaṃ parāparam // 115
meaning:
अहन्ताच्छादितोन्मेषिभावेदंभावयुक् स च /
व्यक्ताव्यक्तमिदं लिङ्गं मन्त्रवीर्यं परापरम् // 115
text_mt: associated with objective entities emerging covered by I-ness— / this manifest-unmanifest sign is the supreme-and-non-supreme vitality of mantra. // 115

sanskrit_iast:
naraśaktisamunmeṣi śivarūpādvibheditam /
yannyakkṛtaśivāhantāsamāveśaṃ vibhedavat // 116
meaning:
नरशक्तिसमुन्मेषि शिवरूपाद्विभेदितम् /
यन्न्यक्कृतशिवाहन्तासमावेशं विभेदवत् // 116
text_mt: Flashing forth through man and power, differentiated from the nature of Śiva, / wherein absorption in Śiva's I-ness is suppressed, having differentiation, // 116

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣaspandarūpaṃ tad vyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ cidātmakam /
vyaktātsiddhiprasavo vyaktāvyaktāddvayaṃ vimokṣaśca /
avyaktādbalamādyaṃ parasya nānuttare tviyaṃ carcā // 117
meaning:
विशेषस्पन्दरूपं तद् व्यक्तं लिङ्गं चिदात्मकम् /
व्यक्तात्सिद्धिप्रसवो व्यक्ताव्यक्ताद्द्वयं विमोक्षश्च /
अव्यक्ताद्बलमाद्यं परस्य नानुत्तरे त्वियं चर्चा // 117
text_mt: consisting of particular vibration—that manifest sign is of the nature of consciousness. / From the manifest comes the arising of spiritual accomplishment; from the manifest-unmanifest comes both and liberation; / from the unmanifest comes the primal power of the Supreme; but in the unexcelled this inquiry does not apply. // 117

sanskrit_iast:
ātmākhyaṃ yadvyaktaṃ naraliṅgaṃ tatra viśvamarpayataḥ /
vyaktāvyaktaṃ tasmādgalite tasmiṃstadavyaktam // 118
meaning:
आत्माख्यं यद्व्यक्तं नरलिङ्गं तत्र विश्वमर्पयतः /
व्यक्ताव्यक्तं तस्माद्गलिते तस्मिंस्तदव्यक्तम् // 118
text_mt: For one who offers the universe into that manifest sign of man, called the self, / it becomes the manifest-unmanifest; when that has fallen away, it becomes the unmanifest. // 118

sanskrit_iast:
tenātmaliṅgametat parame śivaśaktyaṇusvabhāvamaye /
avyakte viśrāmyati nānuttaradhāmagā tviyaṃ carcā // 119
meaning:
तेनात्मलिङ्गमेतत् परमे शिवशक्त्यणुस्वभावमये /
अव्यक्ते विश्राम्यति नानुत्तरधामगा त्वियं चर्चा // 119
text_mt: Therefore this sign of the self comes to rest in the supreme unmanifest / whose nature consists of Śiva, power, and the soul; but this inquiry does not belong to the unexcelled station. // 119

sanskrit_iast:
ekasya spandanasyaiṣā traidhaṃ bhedavyavasthitiḥ /
atra liṅge sadā tiṣṭhet pūjāviśrāntitatparaḥ // 120
meaning:
एकस्य स्पन्दनस्यैषा त्रैधं भेदव्यवस्थितिः /
अत्र लिङ्गे सदा तिष्ठेत् पूजाविश्रान्तितत्परः // 120
text_mt: This threefold division is the arrangement of a single vibration. / One should always abide in this sign, intent upon worship and rest. // 120

sanskrit_iast:
yoginīhṛdayaṃ liṅgamidamānandasundaram /
bījayonisamāpattyā sūte kāmapi saṃvidam // 121
meaning:
योगिनीहृदयं लिङ्गमिदमानन्दसुन्दरम् /
बीजयोनिसमापत्त्या सूते कामपि संविदम् // 121
text_mt: This sign is the heart of the yoginī, lovely with bliss; / through the union of seed and womb, it generates an ineffable consciousness. // 121

sanskrit_iast:
atra prayāsavirahātsarvo'sau devatāgaṇaḥ /
ānandapūrṇe dhāmnyāste nityoditacidātmakaḥ // 122
meaning:
अत्र प्रयासविरहात्सर्वोऽसौ देवतागणः /
आनन्दपूर्णे धाम्न्यास्ते नित्योदितचिदात्मकः // 122
text_mt: Here, free from exertion, that entire host of deities / resides in the station full of bliss, of ever-risen conscious nature. // 122

sanskrit_iast:
atra bhairavanāthasya sasaṃkocavikāsikā /
bhāsate durghaṭā śaktirasaṃkocavikāsinaḥ // 123
meaning:
अत्र भैरवनाथस्य ससंकोचविकासिका /
भासते दुर्घटा शक्तिरसंकोचविकासिनः // 123
text_mt: Here shines the power of Lord Bhairava, which is difficult to accomplish, / unfolding with contraction, belonging to Him who unfolds without contraction. // 123

sanskrit_iast:
etalliṅgasamāpattivisargānandadhārayā /
siktaṃ tadeva sadviśvaṃ śaśvannavanavāyate // 124
meaning:
एतल्लिङ्गसमापत्तिविसर्गानन्दधारया /
सिक्तं तदेव सद्विश्वं शश्वन्नवनवायते // 124
text_mt: Sprinkled by the stream of the bliss of emission upon union with this sign, / this very universe continually becomes ever-new. // 124

sanskrit_iast:
anuttare'bhyupāyo'tra tādrūpyādeva varṇitaḥ /
jvaliteṣvapi dīpeṣu gharmāṃśuḥ kiṃ na bhāsate // 125
meaning:
अनुत्तरेऽभ्युपायोऽत्र ताद्रूप्यादेव वर्णितः /
ज्वलितेष्वपि दीपेषु घर्मांशुः किं न भासते // 125
text_mt: Here, an approach to the unexcelled has been described precisely on account of having its nature: / when lamps are lit, does the sun not shine? // 125

sanskrit_iast:
artheṣu tadbhogavidhau tadutthe duḥkhe sukhe vā galitābhiśaṅkam /
anāviśanto'pi nimagnacittā jānanti vṛttikṣayasaukhyamantaḥ // 126
meaning:
अर्थेषु तद्भोगविधौ तदुत्थे दुःखे सुखे वा गलिताभिशङ्कम् /
अनाविशन्तोऽपि निमग्नचित्ता जानन्ति वृत्तिक्षयसौख्यमन्तः // 126
text_mt: In the presence of objects, in the enjoyment of them, or in pleasure or pain arising from them, with doubts dispelled, / those whose minds are immersed, even without formal entry, know within the joy of the cessation of mental fluctuations. // 126

sanskrit_iast:
satyevātmani citsvabhāvamahasi svānte tathopaktiyāṃ tasmai kurvati tatpracāravivaśe satyakṣavarge'pi ca /
satsvartheṣu sukhādiṣu sphuṭataraṃ yadbhedavandhyodayaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati pūrṇaraśmivibhavastattattvamācīyatām // 127
meaning:
सत्येवात्मनि चित्स्वभावमहसि स्वान्ते तथोपक्तियां तस्मै कुर्वति तत्प्रचारविवशे सत्यक्षवर्गेऽपि च /
सत्स्वर्थेषु सुखादिषु स्फुटतरं यद्भेदवन्ध्योदयं योगी तिष्ठति पूर्णरश्मिविभवस्तत्तत्त्वमाचीयताम् // 127
text_mt: Even when the Self exists, a splendor whose nature is consciousness; when the internal organ renders service to it; when the senses, helpless in their functioning, exist; / and when objects, pleasure, and the rest exist—let that reality be practiced wherein the yogin abides, rich in full rays, with an arising evidently barren of division. // 127

sanskrit_iast:
ityuccāravidhiḥ proktaḥ karaṇaṃ pravivicyate /
taccetthaṃ triśiraḥśāstre parameśena bhāṣitam // 128
meaning:
इत्युच्चारविधिः प्रोक्तः करणं प्रविविच्यते /
तच्चेत्थं त्रिशिरःशास्त्रे परमेशेन भाषितम् // 128
text_mt: Thus the rule of phonic enunciation has been stated; the bodily posture is now thoroughly analyzed. / And it was spoken thus in the Triśirobhairava scripture by the Supreme Lord: // 128

sanskrit_iast:
grāhyagrāhakacidvyāptityāgākṣepaniveśanaiḥ /
karaṇaṃ saptadhā prāhurabhyāsaṃ bodhapūrvakam // 129
meaning:
ग्राह्यग्राहकचिद्व्याप्तित्यागाक्षेपनिवेशनैः /
करणं सप्तधा प्राहुरभ्यासं बोधपूर्वकम् // 129
text_mt: Through pervasion, abandonment, casting, and settling of the object, subject, and consciousness, / they teach bodily posture as sevenfold, a practice preceded by awakening. // 129

sanskrit_iast:
tadvyāptipūrvamākṣepe karaṇaṃ svapratiṣṭhatā /
guruvaktrācca boddhavyaṃ karaṇaṃ yadyapi sphuṭam // 130
meaning:
तद्व्याप्तिपूर्वमाक्षेपे करणं स्वप्रतिष्ठता /
गुरुवक्त्राच्च बोद्धव्यं करणं यद्यपि स्फुटम् // 130
text_mt: Bodily posture is established in itself upon casting [them] preceded by that pervasion. / Although bodily posture should be understood clearly from the mouth of the guru, // 130

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpyāgamarakṣārthaṃ tadagre varṇayiṣyate /
ukto ya eṣa uccārastatra yo'sau sphuran sthitaḥ // 131
meaning:
तथाप्यागमरक्षार्थं तदग्रे वर्णयिष्यते /
उक्तो य एष उच्चारस्तत्र योऽसौ स्फुरन् स्थितः // 131
text_mt: nonetheless it will be described ahead for the sake of preserving the tradition. / In that enunciation which has been stated, that vibrating sound which remains, // 131

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktānukṛtiprāyo dhvanirvarṇaḥ sa kathyate /
sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījaṃ ca tasya mukhyaṃ vapurviduḥ // 132
meaning:
अव्यक्तानुकृतिप्रायो ध्वनिर्वर्णः स कथ्यते /
सृष्टिसंहारबीजं च तस्य मुख्यं वपुर्विदुः // 132
text_mt: mostly imitating the unmanifest, is called a phoneme; / and they know the seed of creation and dissolution to be its principal form. // 132

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhyāsavaśādyāti kramādyogī cidātmatām /
tathā hyanacke sācke vā kādau sānte punaḥpunaḥ // 133
meaning:
तदभ्यासवशाद्याति क्रमाद्योगी चिदात्मताम् /
तथा ह्यनच्के साच्के वा कादौ सान्ते पुनःपुनः // 133
text_mt: Through the practice of that, the yogin gradually attains the nature of consciousness. / For thus, when [a consonant] without vowels or with vowels, beginning with ka and ending with sa, // 133

sanskrit_iast:
smṛte proccārite vāpi sā sā saṃvitprasūyāte /
bāhyārthasamayāpekṣā ghaṭādyā dhvanayo'pi ye // 134
meaning:
स्मृते प्रोच्चारिते वापि सा सा संवित्प्रसूयाते /
बाह्यार्थसमयापेक्षा घटाद्या ध्वनयोऽपि ये // 134
text_mt: is recollected or enunciated again and again, that particular consciousness is born. / Even those sounds such as 'pot', dependent on convention regarding external objects, // 134

sanskrit_iast:
te'pyarthabhāvanāṃ kuryurmanorājyavadātmani /
taduktaṃ parameśena bhairavo vyāpako'khile // 135
meaning:
तेऽप्यर्थभावनां कुर्युर्मनोराज्यवदात्मनि /
तदुक्तं परमेशेन भैरवो व्यापकोऽखिले // 135
text_mt: produce contemplation of the object in oneself, like a daydream. / That has been stated by the Supreme Lord: 'Bhairava is all-pervading in everything.' // 135

sanskrit_iast:
iti bhairavaśabdasya saṃtatoccāraṇācchivaḥ /
śrīmattraiśirase'pyuktaṃ mantroddhārasya pūrvataḥ // 136
meaning:
इति भैरवशब्दस्य संततोच्चारणाच्छिवः /
श्रीमत्त्रैशिरसेऽप्युक्तं मन्त्रोद्धारस्य पूर्वतः // 136
text_mt: "Thus, through the uninterrupted utterance of the word Bhairava, one becomes Śiva." / It is also stated in the venerable Traiśirasa prior to the extraction of mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtiśca smaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvabhāveṣu vastutaḥ /
mantrasvarūpaṃ tadbhāvyasvarūpāpattiyojakam // 137
meaning:
स्मृतिश्च स्मरणं पूर्वं सर्वभावेषु वस्तुतः /
मन्त्रस्वरूपं तद्भाव्यस्वरूपापत्तियोजकम् // 137
text_mt: "And memory is prior recollection in all existing entities, in truth; / it is the intrinsic nature of the mantra, bringing about absorption into the intrinsic nature of what is to be contemplated.

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtiḥ svarūpajanikā sarvabhāveṣu rañjikā /
anekākārarūpeṇa sarvatrāvasthitena tu // 138
meaning:
स्मृतिः स्वरूपजनिका सर्वभावेषु रञ्जिका /
अनेकाकाररूपेण सर्वत्रावस्थितेन तु // 138
text_mt: Memory brings forth intrinsic nature, providing delight in all existing entities; / but, residing everywhere through manifold forms,

sanskrit_iast:
svasvabhāvasya saṃprāptiḥ saṃvittiḥ paramārthataḥ /
vyaktiniṣṭhā tato viddhi sattā sā kīrtitā parā // 139
meaning:
स्वस्वभावस्य संप्राप्तिः संवित्तिः परमार्थतः /
व्यक्तिनिष्ठा ततो विद्धि सत्ता सा कीर्तिता परा // 139
text_mt: the attainment of one's own nature is, in the highest sense, consciousness; / know that from this it culminates in individual manifestation, and is celebrated as supreme existence."

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ punaḥ samayāpekṣāṃ vinā ye bījapiṇḍakāḥ /
saṃvidaṃ spandapantyete neyuḥ saṃvidupāyatām // 140
meaning:
किं पुनः समयापेक्षां विना ये बीजपिण्डकाः /
संविदं स्पन्दपन्त्येते नेयुः संविदुपायताम् // 140
text_mt: How much more, then, do these seed-syllables and cluster-syllables—which cause consciousness to vibrate / without dependence on conventional signification—lead to the state of being a means to consciousness!

sanskrit_iast:
vācyābhāvādudāsīnasaṃvitspandātsvadhāmataḥ /
prāṇollāsanirodhābhyāṃ bījapiṇḍeṣu pūrṇatā // 141
meaning:
वाच्याभावादुदासीनसंवित्स्पन्दात्स्वधामतः /
प्राणोल्लासनिरोधाभ्यां बीजपिण्डेषु पूर्णता // 141
text_mt: From the vibration of consciousness indifferent to objects because there is no designated object, from its own abode, / fullness in seed-syllables and cluster-syllables arises through the expansion and restraint of the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
sukhasītkārasatsamyaksāmyaprathamasaṃvidaḥ /
saṃvedanaṃ hi prathamaṃ sparśo'nuttarasaṃvidaḥ // 142
meaning:
सुखसीत्कारसत्सम्यक्साम्यप्रथमसंविदः /
संवेदनं हि प्रथमं स्पर्शोऽनुत्तरसंविदः // 142
text_mt: The initial awareness of the true, perfect equanimity of the blissful sound "sīt" / is indeed the first touch of unexcelled consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtkaṇṭhyoṣṭhyatridhāmāntarnitarāṃ pravikāsini /
caturdaśaḥ praveśo ya ekīkṛtatadātmakaḥ // 143
meaning:
हृत्कण्ठ्योष्ठ्यत्रिधामान्तर्नितरां प्रविकासिनि /
चतुर्दशः प्रवेशो य एकीकृततदात्मकः // 143
text_mt: When within the three abodes of the heart, throat, and lips it expands completely, / that which is the fourteenth penetration, having become unified with its nature,

sanskrit_iast:
tato visargoccārāṃśe dvādaśāntapathāvubhau /
hṛdayena sahaikadhyaṃ nayate japatatparaḥ // 144
meaning:
ततो विसर्गोच्चारांशे द्वादशान्तपथावुभौ /
हृदयेन सहैकध्यं नयते जपतत्परः // 144
text_mt: then, in the portion of the utterance of the creative emission, one intent on recitation / unites the two paths of the dvādaśānta together with the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
kandahṛtkaṇṭhatālvagrakauṇḍilīprakriyāntataḥ /
ānandamadhyanāḍyantaḥ spandanaṃ bījamāvahet // 145
meaning:
कन्दहृत्कण्ठताल्वग्रकौण्डिलीप्रक्रियान्ततः /
आनन्दमध्यनाड्यन्तः स्पन्दनं बीजमावहेत् // 145
text_mt: Through the culmination of the process of the bulb, heart, throat, tip of the palate, and Kuṇḍalinī, / vibration within the central channel of bliss brings about the seed.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhārabījaṃ khaṃ hṛtsthamoṣṭhyaṃ phullaṃ svamūrdhani /
tejastryaśraṃ tālukaṇṭhe bindurūrdhvapade sthitaḥ // 146
meaning:
संहारबीजं खं हृत्स्थमोष्ठ्यं फुल्लं स्वमूर्धनि /
तेजस्त्र्यश्रं तालुकण्ठे बिन्दुरूर्ध्वपदे स्थितः // 146
text_mt: The seed of dissolution is empty space, located in the heart; labial, blossomed on one's own head; / fire is triangular, in the palate and throat; the bindu resides in the upper plane.

sanskrit_iast:
ityenayā budho yuktyā varṇajapyaparāyaṇaḥ /
anuttaraṃ paraṃ dhāma praviśedacirāt sudhīḥ // 147
meaning:
इत्येनया बुधो युक्त्या वर्णजप्यपरायणः /
अनुत्तरं परं धाम प्रविशेदचिरात् सुधीः // 147
text_mt: By this method, the wise practitioner intent on the recitation of phonemes, / of keen intellect, will soon enter the supreme, unexcelled abode.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇaśabdena nīlādi yadvā dīkṣottare yathā /
saṃhāranragnimaruto rudrabinduyutānsmaret // 148
meaning:
वर्णशब्देन नीलादि यद्वा दीक्षोत्तरे यथा /
संहारन्रग्निमरुतो रुद्रबिन्दुयुतान्स्मरेत् // 148
text_mt: Or, by the word "phoneme," [are meant] blue and so forth, as in the Dīkṣottara: / "One should remember the winds of dissolution, man, and fire, joined with Rudra and the bindu.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye tanmayo lakṣyaṃ paśyetsaptadinādatha /
visphuliṅgāgnivannīlapītaraktādicitritam // 149
meaning:
हृदये तन्मयो लक्ष्यं पश्येत्सप्तदिनादथ /
विस्फुलिङ्गाग्निवन्नीलपीतरक्तादिचित्रितम् // 149
text_mt: Identified with that, in the heart one sees the focus of contemplation after seven days, / variegated with blue, yellow, red, and other colors like sparks of fire.

sanskrit_iast:
jājvalīti hṛdambhoje bījadīpaprabodhitam /
dīpavajjvalito bindurbhāsate vighanārkavat // 150
meaning:
जाज्वलीति हृदम्भोजे बीजदीपप्रबोधितम् /
दीपवज्ज्वलितो बिन्दुर्भासते विघनार्कवत् // 150
text_mt: It blazes intensely in the lotus of the heart, awakened by the lamp of the seed; / the bindu, blazing like a lamp, shines forth like a cloudless sun.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃbhāsātmanānena tādātmyaṃ yātyananyadhīḥ /
śivena hematāṃ yadvattāmraṃ sūtena vedhitam // 151
meaning:
स्वयंभासात्मनानेन तादात्म्यं यात्यनन्यधीः /
शिवेन हेमतां यद्वत्ताम्रं सूतेन वेधितम् // 151
text_mt: With an undivided mind, one attains identity with this self-luminous self, / just as copper pierced by mercury attains the state of gold [by the grace of] Śiva."

sanskrit_iast:
upalakṣaṇametacca sarvamantreṣu lakṣayet /
yadyatsaṃkalpasaṃbhūtaṃ varṇajālaṃ hi bhautikam // 152
meaning:
उपलक्षणमेतच्च सर्वमन्त्रेषु लक्षयेत् /
यद्यत्संकल्पसंभूतं वर्णजालं हि भौतिकम् // 152
text_mt: And this should be recognized as an illustrative indication in all mantras. / For whatever network of phonemes arises from mental construction is indeed material;

sanskrit_iast:
tat saṃvidādhikyavaśādabhautikamiva sthitam /
atastathāvidhe rūpe rūḍho rohati saṃvidi // 153
meaning:
तत् संविदाधिक्यवशादभौतिकमिव स्थितम् /
अतस्तथाविधे रूपे रूढो रोहति संविदि // 153
text_mt: yet, by the primacy of consciousness, it stands as if immaterial. / Therefore, grounded in such a form, one ascends to consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
anācchāditarūpāyāmanupādhau prasannadhīḥ /
nīle pīte sukhe duḥkhe saṃvidrūpamakhaṇḍitam // 154
meaning:
अनाच्छादितरूपायामनुपाधौ प्रसन्नधीः /
नीले पीते सुखे दुःखे संविद्रूपमखण्डितम् // 154
text_mt: One of clear mind [perceives] undivided consciousness in its unconditioned, / uncovered nature, [whether] in blue, yellow, pleasure, or pain.

sanskrit_iast:
gurubhirbhāṣitaṃ tasmādupāyeṣu vicitratā /
uccārakaraṇadhyānavarṇairebhiḥ pradarśitaḥ // 155
meaning:
गुरुभिर्भाषितं तस्मादुपायेषु विचित्रता /
उच्चारकरणध्यानवर्णैरेभिः प्रदर्शितः // 155
text_mt: Therefore, diversity among the means was declared by the gurus; / this has been demonstrated through utterance, bodily posture, meditation, and phonemes.

sanskrit_iast:
anuttarapadaprāptāvabhyupāyavidhikramaḥ /
akiṃciccintanaṃ vīryaṃ bhāvanāyāṃ ca sā punaḥ // 156
meaning:
अनुत्तरपदप्राप्तावभ्युपायविधिक्रमः /
अकिंचिच्चिन्तनं वीर्यं भावनायां च सा पुनः // 156
text_mt: In the attainment of the unexcelled plane, the sequence of the injunction of means [is as follows]: / the contemplation of nothingness is the potency within creative contemplation; and that, in turn,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāne tadapi coccāre karaṇe so'pi taddhvanau /
sa sthānakalpane bāhyamiti kramamupāśrayet // 157
meaning:
ध्याने तदपि चोच्चारे करणे सोऽपि तद्ध्वनौ /
स स्थानकल्पने बाह्यमिति क्रममुपाश्रयेत् // 157
text_mt: [is present] in meditation; and that also in utterance; that too in bodily posture; and that in sound; / that in the projection of places; one should resort to this sequence [as] external.

sanskrit_iast:
laṅghanena paro yogī mandabuddhiḥ krameṇa tu /
vīryaṃ vinā yathā ṣaṇṭhastasyāpyastyatha vā balam /
mṛtadeha iveyaṃ syādbāhyāntaḥparikalpanā // 158
meaning:
लङ्घनेन परो योगी मन्दबुद्धिः क्रमेण तु /
वीर्यं विना यथा षण्ठस्तस्याप्यस्त्यथ वा बलम् /
मृतदेह इवेयं स्याद्बाह्यान्तःपरिकल्पना // 158
text_mt: The supreme yogin [attains it] by a leap, but one of dull intellect by degrees. / For just as a eunuch is without potency, yet may have strength, / so this external and internal projection would be as in a dead body [if devoid of that potency].

sanskrit_iast: ityāṇave'nuttaratābhyupāyaḥ prokto nayaḥ spaṣṭapathena bāhyaḥ // 159
meaning: इत्याणवेऽनुत्तरताभ्युपायः प्रोक्तो नयः स्पष्टपथेन बाह्यः // 159
text_mt: Thus, in the realm of the individual means, the external method that is a means to unexcelled reality has been declared on a clear path.

sanskrit_iast: sthānaprakalpākhyatayā sphuṭastu bāhyo'bhyupāyaḥ pravivicyate'tha // 1
meaning: स्थानप्रकल्पाख्यतया स्फुटस्तु बाह्योऽभ्युपायः प्रविविच्यतेऽथ // 1
text_mt: Now, the external means, known distinctly by the designation of the projection of places, is investigated.
title: Kālatattvaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
sthānabhedastridhā proktaḥ prāṇe dehe bahistathā /
prāṇaśca pañcadhā dehe dvidhā bāhyāntaratvataḥ // 2
meaning:
स्थानभेदस्त्रिधा प्रोक्तः प्राणे देहे बहिस्तथा /
प्राणश्च पञ्चधा देहे द्विधा बाह्यान्तरत्वतः // 2
text_mt: The division of places is declared to be threefold: in the vital breath, in the body, and likewise externally. / The vital breath is fivefold; in the body it is twofold, by way of being external and internal.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ pātramakṣasūtraṃ sapustakam /
liṅgaṃ tūraṃ paṭaḥ pustaṃ pratimā mūrtireva ca // 3
meaning:
मण्डलं स्थण्डिलं पात्रमक्षसूत्रं सपुस्तकम् /
लिङ्गं तूरं पटः पुस्तं प्रतिमा मूर्तिरेव च // 3
text_mt: A maṇḍala, an altar-ground, a vessel, a rosary together with a book, / a liṅga, an instrument, a cloth, a manuscript, an image, and a sculpture—

sanskrit_iast:
ityekādaśadhā bāhyaṃ punastadbahudhā bhavet /
tatra prāṇāśrayaṃ tāvadvidhānamupadiśyate // 4
meaning:
इत्येकादशधा बाह्यं पुनस्तद्बहुधा भवेत् /
तत्र प्राणाश्रयं तावद्विधानमुपदिश्यते // 4
text_mt: thus the external is elevenfold; further, it becomes manifold. / Therein, first the method resting upon the vital breath is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
adhvā samasta evāyaṃ ṣaḍvidho'pyativistṛtaḥ /
yo vakṣyate sa ekatra prāṇe tāvatpratiṣṭhitaḥ // 5
meaning:
अध्वा समस्त एवायं षड्विधोऽप्यतिविस्तृतः /
यो वक्ष्यते स एकत्र प्राणे तावत्प्रतिष्ठितः // 5
text_mt: This entire path, though sixfold and exceedingly extensive, / which will be described, is first established in the vital breath as one.

sanskrit_iast:
adhvanaḥ kalanaṃ yattatkramākramatayā sthitam /
kramākramau hi citraikakalanā bhāvagocare // 6
meaning:
अध्वनः कलनं यत्तत्क्रमाक्रमतया स्थितम् /
क्रमाक्रमौ हि चित्रैककलना भावगोचरे // 6
text_mt: That reckoning of the path which exists by way of succession and non-succession— / for succession and non-succession are a single manifold reckoning in the domain of entities—

sanskrit_iast:
kramākramātmā kālaśca paraḥ saṃvidi vartate /
kālī nāma parā śaktiḥ saiva devasya gīyate // 7
meaning:
क्रमाक्रमात्मा कालश्च परः संविदि वर्तते /
काली नाम परा शक्तिः सैव देवस्य गीयते // 7
text_mt: and time, consisting of succession and non-succession, exists in supreme consciousness; / she is sung as the supreme power named Kālī of the divine Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
saiva saṃvidbahiḥ svātmagarbhībhūtau kramākramau /
sphuṭayantī prarohaṇa prāṇavṛttiriti sthitā // 8
meaning:
सैव संविद्बहिः स्वात्मगर्भीभूतौ क्रमाक्रमौ /
स्फुटयन्ती प्ररोहण प्राणवृत्तिरिति स्थिता // 8
text_mt: That very consciousness, clearly manifesting externally through growth / succession and non-succession which are held within its own nature, exists as the movement of the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvinmātraṃ hi yacchuddhaṃ prakāśaparamārthakam /
tanmeyamātmanaḥ projjhya viviktaṃ bhāsate nabhaḥ // 9
meaning:
संविन्मात्रं हि यच्छुद्धं प्रकाशपरमार्थकम् /
तन्मेयमात्मनः प्रोज्झ्य विविक्तं भासते नभः // 9
text_mt: For pure consciousness alone, whose ultimate reality is luminosity, / shines as empty space distinct [from everything], casting aside knowable objects from itself.

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva śūnyarūpatvaṃ saṃvidaḥ parigīyate /
neti neti vimarśena yogināṃ sā parā daśā // 10
meaning:
तदेव शून्यरूपत्वं संविदः परिगीयते /
नेति नेति विमर्शेन योगिनां सा परा दशा // 10
text_mt: That very voidness of consciousness is celebrated; / it is the supreme state of the yogins by means of the reflective awareness "not this, not this."

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva khātmā meye'sminbhedite svīkriyonmukhaḥ /
patansamucchalattvena prāṇaspandormisaṃjñitaḥ // 11
meaning:
स एव खात्मा मेयेऽस्मिन्भेदिते स्वीक्रियोन्मुखः /
पतन्समुच्छलत्त्वेन प्राणस्पन्दोर्मिसंज्ञितः // 11
text_mt: That very space-like self, oriented toward appropriation when this knowable object is differentiated, / descending in the form of a surge, is termed the wave of the vibration of the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāhuḥ kila saṃvitprākprāṇe pariṇatā tathā /
antaḥkaraṇatattvasya vāyurāśrayatāṃ gataḥ // 12
meaning:
तेनाहुः किल संवित्प्राक्प्राणे परिणता तथा /
अन्तःकरणतत्त्वस्य वायुराश्रयतां गतः // 12
text_mt: Therefore they say: consciousness indeed was first transformed into the vital breath, / and so the wind became the locus of the psychic apparatus.

sanskrit_iast:
iyaṃ sā prāṇanāśaktirāntarodyogadohadā /
spandaḥ sphurattā viśrāntirjīvo hṛtpratibhā matā // 13
meaning:
इयं सा प्राणनाशक्तिरान्तरोद्योगदोहदा /
स्पन्दः स्फुरत्ता विश्रान्तिर्जीवो हृत्प्रतिभा मता // 13
text_mt: This is that power of life, yielding the inner striving; / it is considered vibration, vibrant radiance, repose, the individual living soul, the heart, and intuitive flash.

sanskrit_iast:
sā prāṇavṛttiḥ prāṇādyai rūpaiḥ pañcabhirātmasāt /
dehaṃ yatkurute saṃvitpūrṇastenaiṣa bhāsate // 14
meaning:
सा प्राणवृत्तिः प्राणाद्यै रूपैः पञ्चभिरात्मसात् /
देहं यत्कुरुते संवित्पूर्णस्तेनैष भासते // 14
text_mt: Because consciousness appropriates the body by that movement of the vital breath / through the five forms such as prāṇa, the body shines forth filled with consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇanāvṛttitādātmyasaṃvitkhacitadehajām /
ceṣṭāṃ paśyantyato mugdhā nāstyanyaditi manvate // 15
meaning:
प्राणनावृत्तितादात्म्यसंवित्खचितदेहजाम् /
चेष्टां पश्यन्त्यतो मुग्धा नास्त्यन्यदिति मन्वते // 15
text_mt: Seeing bodily activity arising from the body intertwined with consciousness through identity with the movement of life, / the bewildered therefore think: "There is nothing else."

sanskrit_iast:
tāmeva bālamūrkhastrīprāyaveditṛsaṃśritām /
matiṃ pramāṇīkurvantaścārvākāstattvadarśinaḥ // 16
meaning:
तामेव बालमूर्खस्त्रीप्रायवेदितृसंश्रिताम् /
मतिं प्रमाणीकुर्वन्तश्चार्वाकास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः // 16
text_mt: Taking as authoritative that very notion, / which relies on knowers who are mostly children, fools, and women, the Cārvākas consider themselves knowers of reality.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ tathā bhāvanā caddārḍhyameti nirantaram /
taddehabhaṅge suptāḥ syurātādṛgvāsanākṣayāt // 17
meaning:
तेषां तथा भावना चद्दार्ढ्यमेति निरन्तरम् /
तद्देहभङ्गे सुप्ताः स्युरातादृग्वासनाक्षयात् // 17
text_mt: And if their conviction becomes firm and continuous in that way, / at the destruction of their body they would remain asleep until the destruction of that mental impression.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvāsanākṣaye tveṣāmakṣīṇaṃ vāsanāntaram /
buddhaṃ kutaścitsaṃsūte vicitrāṃ phalasampadam // 18
meaning:
तद्वासनाक्षये त्वेषामक्षीणं वासनान्तरम् /
बुद्धं कुतश्चित्संसूते विचित्रां फलसम्पदम् // 18
text_mt: When that mental impression is destroyed, another undestroyed impression / awakened by something produces a manifold store of fruit for them.

sanskrit_iast:
adārḍhyaśaṅkanātprācyavāsanātādavasthyataḥ /
anyakartavyaśaithilyātsaṃbhāvyānuśayatvataḥ // 19
meaning:
अदार्ढ्यशङ्कनात्प्राच्यवासनातादवस्थ्यतः /
अन्यकर्तव्यशैथिल्यात्संभाव्यानुशयत्वतः // 19
text_mt: Because of the fear of instability, because of the persistence of previous mental impressions, / because of the slackening of other duties, and because of probable remorse,

sanskrit_iast:
atadrūḍhānyajanatākartavyaparilopanāt /
nāstikyavāsanāmāhuḥ pāpātpāpīyasīmimām // 20
meaning:
अतद्रूढान्यजनताकर्तव्यपरिलोपनात् /
नास्तिक्यवासनामाहुः पापात्पापीयसीमिमाम् // 20
text_mt: and because it destroys the duties of other people not established in that [view], / they declare this impression of materialism to be more evil than evil.

sanskrit_iast:
alamaprastutenātha prakṛtaṃ pravivicyate /
yāvānsamasta evāyamadhvā prāṇe pratiṣṭhitaḥ // 21
meaning:
अलमप्रस्तुतेनाथ प्रकृतं प्रविविच्यते /
यावान्समस्त एवायमध्वा प्राणे प्रतिष्ठितः // 21
text_mt: Enough of what is irrelevant! Now the matter at hand is investigated: / the extent to which this entire path is established in the vital breath.

sanskrit_iast:
dvidhā ca so'dhvā kriyayā mūrtyā ca pravibhajyate /
prāṇa eva śikhā śrīmattriśirasyuditā hi sā // 22
meaning:
द्विधा च सोऽध्वा क्रियया मूर्त्या च प्रविभज्यते /
प्राण एव शिखा श्रीमत्त्रिशिरस्युदिता हि सा // 22
text_mt: And that path is divided into two: by action and by form. / The vital breath itself is the tuft, for it is declared in the venerable Triśiras.

sanskrit_iast:
baddhā yāgādikāle tuṃ niṣkalatvācchivātmikā /
yato'horātramadhye'syāścaturviṃśatidhā gatiḥ // 23
meaning:
बद्धा यागादिकाले तुं निष्कलत्वाच्छिवात्मिका /
यतोऽहोरात्रमध्येऽस्याश्चतुर्विंशतिधा गतिः // 23
text_mt: When bound at the time of sacrifice and other rites, however, it is identical with Śiva because of its divisionless nature, / since during a day and night its movement occurs twenty-fourfold. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇavikṣeparandhrākhyaśataiścitraphalapradā /
kṣapā śaśī tathāpāno nāda ekatra tiṣṭhati // 24
meaning:
प्राणविक्षेपरन्ध्राख्यशतैश्चित्रफलप्रदा /
क्षपा शशी तथापानो नाद एकत्र तिष्ठति // 24
text_mt: Bestowing diverse fruits by hundreds of what are called holes of breath emission: / night, moon, as well as apāna, and resonance remain in one place; // 24

sanskrit_iast:
jīvādityo na codgacchettuṭyardhaṃ sāndhyamīdṛśam /
ūrdhvavaktro raviścandro'dhomukho vahnirantare // 25
meaning:
जीवादित्यो न चोद्गच्छेत्तुट्यर्धं सान्ध्यमीदृशम् /
ऊर्ध्ववक्त्रो रविश्चन्द्रोऽधोमुखो वह्निरन्तरे // 25
text_mt: and the sun of the living breath does not rise—such is the twilight lasting half a tuṭi. / The sun has its face turned upward, the moon downward, with fire in between. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
mādhyāhnikī mokṣadā syādvyomamadhyasthito raviḥ /
anastamitasāro hi jantucakraprabodhakaḥ // 26
meaning:
माध्याह्निकी मोक्षदा स्याद्व्योममध्यस्थितो रविः /
अनस्तमितसारो हि जन्तुचक्रप्रबोधकः // 26
text_mt: The noon [junction] would bestow liberation, with the sun situated in the middle of space; / for its essence is unsetting, awakening the host of creatures. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
binduḥ prāṇo hyahaścaiva ravirekatra tiṣṭhati /
mahāsandhyā tṛtīyā tu supraśāntātmikā sthitā // 27
meaning:
बिन्दुः प्राणो ह्यहश्चैव रविरेकत्र तिष्ठति /
महासन्ध्या तृतीया तु सुप्रशान्तात्मिका स्थिता // 27
text_mt: The point of light, the prāṇa, the day, and the sun indeed abide together. / But the third great junction is established as having a supremely pacified nature. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ baddhā śikhā yatra tattatphalaniyojikā /
ataḥ saṃvidi sarvo'yamadhvā viśramya tiṣṭhati // 28
meaning:
एवं बद्धा शिखा यत्र तत्तत्फलनियोजिका /
अतः संविदि सर्वोऽयमध्वा विश्रम्य तिष्ठति // 28
text_mt: Thus the topknot is tied where it directs toward specific fruits. / Therefore, this whole path rests and remains in consciousness. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
amūrtāyāḥ sarvagatvānniṣkriyāyāśca saṃvidaḥ /
mūrtikriyābhāsanaṃ yatsa evādhvā maheśituḥ // 29
meaning:
अमूर्तायाः सर्वगत्वान्निष्क्रियायाश्च संविदः /
मूर्तिक्रियाभासनं यत्स एवाध्वा महेशितुः // 29
text_mt: For formless consciousness, being all-pervading and inactive, / the appearance of form and action is itself the Great Lord's path. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
adhvā krameṇa yātavye pade saṃprāptikāraṇam /
dvaitināṃ bhogyabhāvāttu prabuddhānāṃ yato'dyate // 30
meaning:
अध्वा क्रमेण यातव्ये पदे संप्राप्तिकारणम् /
द्वैतिनां भोग्यभावात्तु प्रबुद्धानां यतोऽद्यते // 30
text_mt: The path is the cause of attainment when the state to be reached is traversed by succession; / for dualists it arises as what is to be enjoyed, but for the awakened [it is otherwise]. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
iha sarvatra śabdānāmanvarthaṃ carcayedyataḥ /
uktaṃ śrīmanniśācāre saṃjñātra trividhā matā // 31
meaning:
इह सर्वत्र शब्दानामन्वर्थं चर्चयेद्यतः /
उक्तं श्रीमन्निशाचारे संज्ञात्र त्रिविधा मता // 31
text_mt: Here, in all cases, one should examine the etymological meaning of words; since / it is stated in the venerable Niśācāra: 'In this context, naming is considered threefold: // 31

sanskrit_iast:
naimittikī prasiddhā ca tathānyā pāribhāṣikī /
pūrvatve vā pradhānaṃ syāttatrāntarbhāvayettataḥ // 32
meaning:
नैमित्तिकी प्रसिद्धा च तथान्या पारिभाषिकी /
पूर्वत्वे वा प्रधानं स्यात्तत्रान्तर्भावयेत्ततः // 32
text_mt: causal, conventional, and another which is technical.' / Or, in its original state it may be primary; therefore one should subsume [the others] into that. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
ato'dhvaśabdasyokteyaṃ niruktirnoditāpi cet /
kvacitsvabuddhyā sāpyūhyā kiyallekhyaṃ hi pustake // 33
meaning:
अतोऽध्वशब्दस्योक्तेयं निरुक्तिर्नोदितापि चेत् /
क्वचित्स्वबुद्ध्या साप्यूह्या कियल्लेख्यं हि पुस्तके // 33
text_mt: Therefore this etymology of the word 'path' has been stated. Even if it is not stated / somewhere, it is to be inferred by one's own intellect; for how much can be written in a book? // 33

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kriyābhāsanaṃ yatso'dhvā kālāhva ucyate /
varṇamantrapadābhikhyamatrāste'dhvatrayaṃ sphuṭam // 34
meaning:
तत्र क्रियाभासनं यत्सोऽध्वा कालाह्व उच्यते /
वर्णमन्त्रपदाभिख्यमत्रास्तेऽध्वत्रयं स्फुटम् // 34
text_mt: Therein, the manifestation of action is called the path of time; / the triad of paths consisting of phoneme, mantra, and word clearly resides here. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
yastu mūrtyavabhāsāṃśaḥ sa deśādhvā nigadyate /
kalātattvapurābhikhyamantarbhūtamiha trayam // 35
meaning:
यस्तु मूर्त्यवभासांशः स देशाध्वा निगद्यते /
कलातत्त्वपुराभिख्यमन्तर्भूतमिह त्रयम् // 35
text_mt: That portion, however, which is the manifestation of form is called the path of space; / the triad known as kalā, tattva, and world is subsumed here. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
trikadvaye'tra pratyekaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ vapuḥ /
yato'sti tena sarvo'yamadhvā ṣaḍvidha ucyate // 36
meaning:
त्रिकद्वयेऽत्र प्रत्येकं स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं परं वपुः /
यतोऽस्ति तेन सर्वोऽयमध्वा षड्विध उच्यते // 36
text_mt: In each of these two triads there is a gross, a subtle, and a supreme form; / because this exists, this entire path is said to be sixfold. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍvidhādadhvanaḥ prācyaṃ yadetattritayaṃ punaḥ /
eṣa eva sa kālādhvā prāṇe spaṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ // 37
meaning:
षड्विधादध्वनः प्राच्यं यदेतत्त्रितयं पुनः /
एष एव स कालाध्वा प्राणे स्पष्टं प्रतिष्ठितः // 37
text_mt: Further, that former triad out of the sixfold path / is this very path of time, clearly established in the breath. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
tattavamadhyasthitātkālādanyo'yaṃ kāla ucyate /
eṣa kālo hi devasya viśvābhāsanakāriṇī // 38
meaning:
तत्तवमध्यस्थितात्कालादन्योऽयं काल उच्यते /
एष कालो हि देवस्य विश्वाभासनकारिणी // 38
text_mt: This is said to be a time different from the time that stands among the principles of existence; / for this time is the divine action power of the Lord // 38

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāśaktiḥ samastānāṃ tattvānāṃ ca paraṃ vapuḥ /
etadīśvaratattvaṃ tacchivasya vapurucyate // 39
meaning:
क्रियाशक्तिः समस्तानां तत्त्वानां च परं वपुः /
एतदीश्वरतत्त्वं तच्छिवस्य वपुरुच्यते // 39
text_mt: which brings about the manifestation of the universe, and the supreme body of all principles of existence. / This is the principle of Īśvara, and is called the body of Śiva, // 39

sanskrit_iast:
udriktābhogakāryātmaviśvaikātmyamidaṃ yataḥ /
etadīśvararūpatvaṃ paramātmani yatkila // 40
meaning:
उद्रिक्ताभोगकार्यात्मविश्वैकात्म्यमिदं यतः /
एतदीश्वररूपत्वं परमात्मनि यत्किल // 40
text_mt: since it is the identity with the universe consisting of effects in their full expanse. / That very state of being Īśvara, which belongs indeed to the supreme Self, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
tatpramātari māyīye kālatattvaṃ nigadyate /
śivādiśuddhavidyāntaṃ yacchivasya svakaṃ vapuḥ // 41
meaning:
तत्प्रमातरि मायीये कालतत्त्वं निगद्यते /
शिवादिशुद्धविद्यान्तं यच्छिवस्य स्वकं वपुः // 41
text_mt: is declared to be the principle of time in the subject subject to māyā. / What is Śiva's own body, ending with pure vidyā and beginning with Śiva, // 41

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva puṃso māyādirāgāntaṃ kañcukībhavet /
anāśritaṃ yato māyā kalāvidye sadāśivaḥ // 42
meaning:
तदेव पुंसो मायादिरागान्तं कञ्चुकीभवेत् /
अनाश्रितं यतो माया कलाविद्ये सदाशिवः // 42
text_mt: that very [body] becomes the cuirasses of the person, ending with attachment and beginning with māyā. / For Anāśrita is māyā, Sadāśiva is kalā and vidyā, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaraḥ kālaniyatī sadvidyā rāga ucyate /
anāśritaḥ śūnyamātā buddhimātā sadāśivaḥ // 43
meaning:
ईश्वरः कालनियती सद्विद्या राग उच्यते /
अनाश्रितः शून्यमाता बुद्धिमाता सदाशिवः // 43
text_mt: Īśvara is time and necessity, and Sadvidyā is said to be attachment. / Anāśrita is the knower of the void, Sadāśiva is the knower of the intellect, // 43

sanskrit_iast:
īśvaraḥ prāṇamātā ca vidyā dehapramātṛtā /
anāśrayo hi śūnyatvaṃ jñānameva hi buddhitā // 44
meaning:
ईश्वरः प्राणमाता च विद्या देहप्रमातृता /
अनाश्रयो हि शून्यत्वं ज्ञानमेव हि बुद्धिता // 44
text_mt: Īśvara is the knower of breath, and vidyā is the state of being a knower identified with the body. / For the void is indeed being without support, and the intellect is knowledge itself; // 44

sanskrit_iast:
viśvātmatā ca prāṇatvaṃ dehe vedyaikatānatā /
tena prāṇapathe viśvākalaneyaṃ virājate // 45
meaning:
विश्वात्मता च प्राणत्वं देहे वेद्यैकतानता /
तेन प्राणपथे विश्वाकलनेयं विराजते // 45
text_mt: breath is being the soul of the universe, and in the body there is absorption exclusively in the object of knowledge. / Therefore, this reckonable manifold of the universe shines forth in the movement of breath. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
yena rūpeṇa tadvacmaḥ sadbhistadavadhīyatām /
dvādaśāntāvadhāvasmindehe yadyapi sarvataḥ // 46
meaning:
येन रूपेण तद्वच्मः सद्भिस्तदवधीयताम् /
द्वादशान्तावधावस्मिन्देहे यद्यपि सर्वतः // 46
text_mt: We describe the manner in which this occurs; let it be carefully observed by the wise. / Although in this body, up to the limit of the dvādaśānta, everywhere // 46

sanskrit_iast:
otaprotātmakaḥ prāṇastathāpītthaṃ na susphuṭaḥ /
yatno jīvanamātrātmā tatparaśca dvidhā mataḥ // 47
meaning:
ओतप्रोतात्मकः प्राणस्तथापीत्थं न सुस्फुटः /
यत्नो जीवनमात्रात्मा तत्परश्च द्विधा मतः // 47
text_mt: breath is warp and woof, it is nonetheless not completely distinct in this way. / Effort is considered twofold: that which consists of mere living, and that which is beyond it. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvedyaścāpyasaṃvedyo dvidhetthaṃ bhidyate punaḥ /
sphuṭāsphuṭatvāddvaividhyaṃ pratyekaṃ paribhāvayet // 48
meaning:
संवेद्यश्चाप्यसंवेद्यो द्विधेत्थं भिद्यते पुनः /
स्फुटास्फुटत्वाद्द्वैविध्यं प्रत्येकं परिभावयेत् // 48
text_mt: It is divided again twofold into what can be experienced and what cannot be experienced; / one should consider each as two on account of being distinct or indistinct. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvedyajīvanābhikhyaprayatnaspandasundaraḥ /
prāṇaḥ kandātprabhṛtyeva tathāpyatra na susphuṭaḥ // 49
meaning:
संवेद्यजीवनाभिख्यप्रयत्नस्पन्दसुन्दरः /
प्राणः कन्दात्प्रभृत्येव तथाप्यत्र न सुस्फुटः // 49
text_mt: Breath, delightful through the vibration of effort known as perceptible life, / moves starting from the bulb itself; nevertheless, it is not completely distinct here. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
kandādhārātprabhṛtyeva vyavasthā tena kathyate /
svacchandaśāstre nāḍīnāṃ vāyvādhāratayā sphuṭam // 50
meaning:
कन्दाधारात्प्रभृत्येव व्यवस्था तेन कथ्यते /
स्वच्छन्दशास्त्रे नाडीनां वाय्वाधारतया स्फुटम् // 50
text_mt: For that reason, the arrangement of the channels is clearly explained / in the Svacchandatantra beginning from the support of the bulb, since they are supports for the wind. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi tu prayatno'sau na saṃvedyatayā sthitaḥ /
vedyayatnāttu hṛdayātprāṇacāro vibhajyate // 51
meaning:
तत्रापि तु प्रयत्नोऽसौ न संवेद्यतया स्थितः /
वेद्ययत्नात्तु हृदयात्प्राणचारो विभज्यते // 51
text_mt: Even there, however, that effort does not remain in an experienced state. / But from the heart, where effort is experienced, the course of the breath is differentiated. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
prabhoḥ śivasya yā śaktirvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrikā /
satadanyatamāvātmaprāṇau yatnavidhāyinau // 52
meaning:
प्रभोः शिवस्य या शक्तिर्वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्रिका /
सतदन्यतमावात्मप्राणौ यत्नविधायिनौ // 52
text_mt: The powers of the sovereign Lord Śiva which are Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, and Raudrī / are those very powers which perform the effort, or other ones, as self and breath. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
prabhuśaktiḥ kvacinmukhyā yathāṅgamarudīraṇe /
ātmaśaktiḥ kvacitkandasaṃkocaspandane yathā // 53
meaning:
प्रभुशक्तिः क्वचिन्मुख्या यथाङ्गमरुदीरणे /
आत्मशक्तिः क्वचित्कन्दसंकोचस्पन्दने यथा // 53
text_mt: The sovereign power is primary in some contexts, as in the impelling of the bodily winds; / the self-power is primary in some, as in the pulsating contraction of the bulb; // 53

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇaśaktiḥ kvacitprāṇacāre hārde yathā sphuṭam /
trayaṃ dvayaṃ vā mukhyaṃ syādyogināmavadhāninām // 54
meaning:
प्राणशक्तिः क्वचित्प्राणचारे हार्दे यथा स्फुटम् /
त्रयं द्वयं वा मुख्यं स्याद्योगिनामवधानिनाम् // 54
text_mt: and the breath-power is primary in some, as clearly in the cardiac movement of the breath. / For attentive yogins, three or two might be primary. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
avadhānādadṛṣṭāṃśādbalavattvādatheraṇāt /
viparyayo'pi prāṇātmaśaktīnāṃ mukhyatāṃ prati // 55
meaning:
अवधानाददृष्टांशाद्बलवत्त्वादथेरणात् /
विपर्ययोऽपि प्राणात्मशक्तीनां मुख्यतां प्रति // 55
text_mt: On account of attention, of the unperceived portion, of strength, or again of impulsion, / there is also an inversion regarding the primacy of the powers of breath and self. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
vāmā saṃsāriṇāmīśā prabhuśaktirvidhāyinī /
jyeṣṭhā tu suprabuddhānāṃ bubhutsūnāṃ ca raudrikā // 56
meaning:
वामा संसारिणामीशा प्रभुशक्तिर्विधायिनी /
ज्येष्ठा तु सुप्रबुद्धानां बुभुत्सूनां च रौद्रिका // 56
text_mt: Vāmā is the sovereign, impelling power of transmigrating souls, / whereas Jyeṣṭhā belongs to the fully awakened, and Raudrī to those who desire to know. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
vāmā saṃsāravamanā jyeṣṭhā śivamayī yataḥ /
drāvayitrī rujāṃ raudrī roddhrī cākhilakarmaṇām // 57
meaning:
वामा संसारवमना ज्येष्ठा शिवमयी यतः /
द्रावयित्री रुजां रौद्री रोद्ध्री चाखिलकर्मणाम् // 57
text_mt: For Vāmā vomits forth worldly existence, Jyeṣṭhā is composed of Śiva, / and Raudrī melts away afflictions and obstructs all actions. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyāditattvamajñātvā na mukto nāpi mocayet /
uktaṃ ca śrīyogacāre mokṣaḥ sarvaprakāśanāt // 58
meaning:
सृष्ट्यादितत्त्वमज्ञात्वा न मुक्तो नापि मोचयेत् /
उक्तं च श्रीयोगचारे मोक्षः सर्वप्रकाशनात् // 58
text_mt: Without knowing the reality of emanation and the rest, one is not liberated, nor can one liberate others. / And it is said in the venerable Yogacāra: 'Liberation comes from illuminating all things.' // 58

sanskrit_iast:
utpattisthitisaṃhārān ye na jānanti yoginaḥ /
na muktāste tadajñānabandhanaikādhivāsitāḥ // 59
meaning:
उत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारान् ये न जानन्ति योगिनः /
न मुक्तास्ते तदज्ञानबन्धनैकाधिवासिताः // 59
text_mt: Yogins who do not understand emanation, stasis, and reabsorption / are not liberated; they are steeped solely in the bondage of ignorance concerning that. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyādayaśca te sarve kālādhīnā na saṃśayaḥ /
sa ca prāṇātmakastasmāduccāraḥ kathyate sphuṭaḥ // 60
meaning:
सृष्ट्यादयश्च ते सर्वे कालाधीना न संशयः /
स च प्राणात्मकस्तस्मादुच्चारः कथ्यते स्फुटः // 60
text_mt: And all those—emanation and the rest—undoubtedly depend on time; / and that [time] consists of breath; therefore its distinct articulation is taught. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayātprāṇacāraśca nāsikyadvādaśāntataḥ /
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulo jantoḥ sarvasya svāṅgulakramāt // 61
meaning:
हृदयात्प्राणचारश्च नासिक्यद्वादशान्ततः /
षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुलो जन्तोः सर्वस्य स्वाङ्गुलक्रमात् // 61
text_mt: And the course of the breath from the heart up to the nasal dvādaśānta / measures thirty-six finger-breadths for every living being, by the standard of their own finger-breadth. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
kṣodiṣṭhe vā mahiṣṭhe vā dehe tādṛśa eva hi /
vīryamojo balaṃ spandaḥ prāṇacāraḥ samaṃ tataḥ // 62
meaning:
क्षोदिष्ठे वा महिष्ठे वा देहे तादृश एव हि /
वीर्यमोजो बलं स्पन्दः प्राणचारः समं ततः // 62
text_mt: In a body smallest or largest it is just the same; / hence virility, vigor, strength, vibration, and the course of the breath are equal. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgule cāre yadgamāgamayugmakam /
nālikātithimāsābdatatsaṅghro'tra sphuṭaṃ sthitaḥ // 63
meaning:
षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुले चारे यद्गमागमयुग्मकम् /
नालिकातिथिमासाब्दतत्सङ्घ्रोऽत्र स्फुटं स्थितः // 63
text_mt: In the movement across thirty-six finger-breadths, which constitutes the pair of going out and coming in, / the collection of hours, lunar days, months, and years clearly resides here. // 63

sanskrit_iast:
tuṭiḥ sapādāṅgulayukprāṇastāḥ ṣoḍaśocchvasan /
niḥśvasaṃścātra caṣakaḥ sapañcāṃśe'ṅgule'ṅgule // 64
meaning:
तुटिः सपादाङ्गुलयुक्प्राणस्ताः षोडशोच्छ्वसन् /
निःश्वसंश्चात्र चषकः सपञ्चांशेऽङ्गुलेऽङ्गुले // 64
text_mt: A tuṭi is a breath measuring one and a quarter finger-breadths; inhaling and / exhaling sixteen of them, a measure of time called caṣaka occurs here at every finger-breadth and a fifth. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
śvāsapraśvāsayornālī proktāhorātra ucyate /
navāṅgulāmbudhituṭau praharāste'bdhayo dinam // 65
meaning:
श्वासप्रश्वासयोर्नाली प्रोक्ताहोरात्र उच्यते /
नवाङ्गुलाम्बुधितुटौ प्रहरास्तेऽब्धयो दिनम् // 65
text_mt: The nālī of an inhalation and exhalation is taught, and the day and night is declared: / in nine finger-breadths, an ocean of tuṭis [four], there are the watches; four of them make a day. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
nirgame'ntarniśenendū tayoḥ saṃdhye tuṭerdale /
ketuḥ sūrye vidhau rāhurbhaumādervārabhāginaḥ // 66
meaning:
निर्गमेऽन्तर्निशेनेन्दू तयोः संध्ये तुटेर्दले /
केतुः सूर्ये विधौ राहुर्भौमादेर्वारभागिनः // 66
text_mt: In the outgoing and inward [breath] are the sun and moon; the two junctions are in half a tuṭi; / Ketu is in the sun, Rāhu in the moon; the shares of the weekdays of Mars and the others // 66

sanskrit_iast:
praharadvayamanyeṣāṃ grahāṇāmudayo'ntarā /
siddhirdavīyasī mokṣo'bhicāraḥ pāralaukikī // 67
meaning:
प्रहरद्वयमन्येषां ग्रहाणामुदयोऽन्तरा /
सिद्धिर्दवीयसी मोक्षोऽभिचारः पारलौकिकी // 67
text_mt: last two watches, and the rising of other planets is in between. / Spiritual accomplishment that is distant, liberation, sorcery, fruits pertaining to the other world, // 67

sanskrit_iast:
aihikī dūranaikaṭyātiśayā praharāṣṭake /
madhyāhnamadhyaniśayorabhijinmokṣabhogadā // 68
meaning:
ऐहिकी दूरनैकट्यातिशया प्रहराष्टके /
मध्याह्नमध्यनिशयोरभिजिन्मोक्षभोगदा // 68
text_mt: or mundane fruits characterized by extreme distance or proximity, occur in the eight watches; / at noon and midnight, Abhijit bestows liberation and enjoyment. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ tadanyeṣāmudayo madhyataḥ kramāt /
nāgā lokeśamūrtīśā gaṇeśā jalatattvataḥ // 69
meaning:
नक्षत्राणां तदन्येषामुदयो मध्यतः क्रमात् /
नागा लोकेशमूर्तीशा गणेशा जलतत्त्वतः // 69
text_mt: The rising of the lunar mansions (nakṣatras) and the others occurs sequentially from the center: / the serpents, the lords of the worlds, the lords of the forms, the lords of the retinues, from the water principle onward, 69

sanskrit_iast:
pradhānāntaṃ nāyakāśca vidyātattvādhināyakāḥ /
sakalādyāśca kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyaparyantā bhairavāstathā // 70
meaning:
प्रधानान्तं नायकाश्च विद्यातत्त्वाधिनायकाः /
सकलाद्याश्च कण्ठ्योष्ठ्यपर्यन्ता भैरवास्तथा // 70
text_mt: and the lords up to the Pradhāna, the overlords of the Vidyā-principle, / and the Bhairavas beginning with Sakala and extending from the guttural to the labial sounds, 70

sanskrit_iast:
śaktayaḥ pārameśvaryo vāmaśā vīranāyakāḥ /
aṣṭāvaṣṭau ye ya itthaṃ vyāpyavyāpakatājuṣaḥ // 71
meaning:
शक्तयः पारमेश्वर्यो वामशा वीरनायकाः /
अष्टावष्टौ ये य इत्थं व्याप्यव्यापकताजुषः // 71
text_mt: and the sovereign powers of the Supreme Lord, the Vāmaśās, the hero-leaders— / each of these groups of eight, possessing pervaded-and-pervader relationship in this way, 71

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlasūkṣmāḥ kramātteṣāmudayaḥ praharāṣṭake /
dine krūrāṇi saumyāni rātrau karmāṇyasaṃśayam // 72
meaning:
स्थूलसूक्ष्माः क्रमात्तेषामुदयः प्रहराष्टके /
दिने क्रूराणि सौम्यानि रात्रौ कर्माण्यसंशयम् // 72
text_mt: gross and subtle sequentially, have their rising in the eight watches. / In the daytime, [one should perform] fierce acts, and at night, gentle ones without doubt. 72

sanskrit_iast:
krūratā saumyatā vābhisandherapi nirūpitā /
dinarātrikṣaye muktiḥ sā vyāptidhyānayogataḥ // 73
meaning:
क्रूरता सौम्यता वाभिसन्धेरपि निरूपिता /
दिनरात्रिक्षये मुक्तिः सा व्याप्तिध्यानयोगतः // 73
text_mt: Fierceness or gentleness is determined also by intention. / Liberation occurs at the dissolution of day and night through the yoga of meditative absorption in pervasion. 73

sanskrit_iast:
te coktāḥ parameśena śrīmadvīrāvalīkule /
sitāsitau dīrghahrasvau dharmādharmau dinakṣape // 74
meaning:
ते चोक्ताः परमेशेन श्रीमद्वीरावलीकुले /
सितासितौ दीर्घह्रस्वौ धर्माधर्मौ दिनक्षपे // 74
text_mt: And these are declared by the Supreme Lord in the glorious Vīrāvalīkula: / 'White and black, long and short, virtue and vice, day and night— 74

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīyete yadi taddīkṣā vyāptyā dhyānena yogataḥ /
ahorātraḥ prāṇacāre kathito māsa ucyate // 75
meaning:
क्षीयेते यदि तद्दीक्षा व्याप्त्या ध्यानेन योगतः /
अहोरात्रः प्राणचारे कथितो मास उच्यते // 75
text_mt: if both are dissolved, that is initiation through pervasion, meditation, and yoga.' / The day-and-night has been explained in the movement of the breath; [now] the month is described. 75

sanskrit_iast:
dinaṃ kṛṣṇo niśā śuklaḥ pakṣau karmasu pūrvavat /
yāḥ ṣoḍaśoktāstithayastāsu ye pūrvapaścime // 76
meaning:
दिनं कृष्णो निशा शुक्लः पक्षौ कर्मसु पूर्ववत् /
याः षोडशोक्तास्तिथयस्तासु ये पूर्वपश्चिमे // 76
text_mt: Day is the dark fortnight, night is the light fortnight, regarding rites as before. / Among the sixteen lunar days (tithis) that are spoken of, the two that are the first and the last— 76

sanskrit_iast:
tayostu viśramo'rdhe'rdhe tithyaḥ pañcadaśetarāḥ /
sapāde dvyaṅgule tithyā ahorātro vibhajyate // 77
meaning:
तयोस्तु विश्रमोऽर्धेऽर्धे तिथ्यः पञ्चदशेतराः /
सपादे द्व्यङ्गुले तिथ्या अहोरात्रो विभज्यते // 77
text_mt: the rest of these two is in each half; the other lunar days are fifteen. / By a lunar day of two fingers and a quarter, the day-and-night is divided. 77

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśaviśramavaśāttāveva hi dinakṣape /
saṃvitpratikṣaṇaṃ yasmātprakāśānandayoginī // 78
meaning:
प्रकाशविश्रमवशात्तावेव हि दिनक्षपे /
संवित्प्रतिक्षणं यस्मात्प्रकाशानन्दयोगिनी // 78
text_mt: By force of luminosity and rest, they are indeed day and night, / since consciousness at every moment is endowed with luminosity and bliss. 78

sanskrit_iast:
tau klṛptau yāvati tayā tāvatyeva dinakṣape /
yāvatyeva hi saṃvittiruditoditasusphuṭā // 79
meaning:
तौ क्लृप्तौ यावति तया तावत्येव दिनक्षपे /
यावत्येव हि संवित्तिरुदितोदितसुस्फुटा // 79
text_mt: In as much as they are arranged by it, for that long indeed are day and night. / For as long as consciousness has arisen and shines fully evident, 79

sanskrit_iast:
tāvāneva kṣaṇaḥ kalpo nimeṣo vā tadastvapi /
yāvānevodayo vittervedyaikagrahatatparaḥ // 80
meaning:
तावानेव क्षणः कल्पो निमेषो वा तदस्त्वपि /
यावानेवोदयो वित्तेर्वेद्यैकग्रहतत्परः // 80
text_mt: so long is an instant, a cosmic cycle, or a twinkling of an eye—let it be whatever. / As long as the rising of awareness is intent upon grasping only the knowable, 80

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadevāstamayanaṃ veditṛsvātmacarvaṇam /
vedye ca bahirantarvā dvaye vātha dvayojjhite // 81
meaning:
तावदेवास्तमयनं वेदितृस्वात्मचर्वणम् /
वेद्ये च बहिरन्तर्वा द्वये वाथ द्वयोज्झिते // 81
text_mt: so long is setting, the relish of the knower's own self. / And in the knowable, whether external or internal, or in the duality, or in that devoid of duality, 81

sanskrit_iast:
sarvathā tanmayībhūtirdinaṃ vettṛsthatā niśā /
veditā vedyaviśrānto vettā tvantarmukhasthitiḥ // 82
meaning:
सर्वथा तन्मयीभूतिर्दिनं वेत्तृस्थता निशा /
वेदिता वेद्यविश्रान्तो वेत्ता त्वन्तर्मुखस्थितिः // 82
text_mt: becoming identified with it in every way is day; remaining in the knower is night. / The knower [as subject-experiencer] rests in the knowable, but the true knower remains facing inward. 82

sanskrit_iast:
purā vicārayanpaścātsattāmātrasvarūpakaḥ /
jāgradveditṛtā svapno vettṛbhāvaḥ purātanaḥ // 83
meaning:
पुरा विचारयन्पश्चात्सत्तामात्रस्वरूपकः /
जाग्रद्वेदितृता स्वप्नो वेत्तृभावः पुरातनः // 83
text_mt: At first deliberating, afterward having the essential nature of pure existence: / waking is the state of the experiencer; dreaming is the former state of the knower; 83

sanskrit_iast:
paraḥ suptaṃ kṣaye rātridinayosturyamadvayam /
kadācidvastuviśrāntisāmyenātmani carvaṇam // 84
meaning:
परः सुप्तं क्षये रात्रिदिनयोस्तुर्यमद्वयम् /
कदाचिद्वस्तुविश्रान्तिसाम्येनात्मनि चर्वणम् // 84
text_mt: the higher is deep sleep; upon the dissolution of night and day, there is the fourth state free of duality. / Sometimes there is relishing in the self with equal resting in the object— 84

sanskrit_iast:
vedyavedakasāmyaṃ tat sā rātridinatulyatā /
vedye viśrāntiradhikā dinadairghyāya tatra tu // 85
meaning:
वेद्यवेदकसाम्यं तत् सा रात्रिदिनतुल्यता /
वेद्ये विश्रान्तिरधिका दिनदैर्घ्याय तत्र तु // 85
text_mt: that is the equality of known and knower; that is the equivalence of night and day. / But when rest in the knowable is greater, that makes for the length of the day; 85

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnā syātsvātmaviśrāntirviparīte viparyayaḥ /
svātmautsukye prabuddhe hi vedyaviśrāntiralpikā // 86
meaning:
न्यूना स्यात्स्वात्मविश्रान्तिर्विपरीते विपर्ययः /
स्वात्मौत्सुक्ये प्रबुद्धे हि वेद्यविश्रान्तिरल्पिका // 86
text_mt: rest in one's own self would then be lesser; when reversed, the opposite occurs. / For when eagerness for one's own self is awakened, rest in the knowable is meager. 86

sanskrit_iast:
itthameva divārātrinyūnādhikyakramaṃ vadet /
yathā deheṣvahorātranyūnādhikyādi no samam // 87
meaning:
इत्थमेव दिवारात्रिन्यूनाधिक्यक्रमं वदेत् /
यथा देहेष्वहोरात्रन्यूनाधिक्यादि नो समम् // 87
text_mt: In this very manner one should state the sequence of deficiency and excess of day and night. / Just as in bodies the deficiency and excess of day and night is not uniform, 87

sanskrit_iast:
tathā pureṣvapītyevaṃ tadviśeṣeṇa noditam /
śrītraiyambakasantānavitatāmbarabhāskaraḥ // 88
meaning:
तथा पुरेष्वपीत्येवं तद्विशेषेण नोदितम् /
श्रीत्रैयम्बकसन्तानवितताम्बरभास्करः // 88
text_mt: so also in cities; thus it has not been declared with particularity. / The sun in the vast sky of the glorious Traiyambaka lineage, 88

sanskrit_iast:
dinarātrikramaṃ me śrīśaṃbhuritthamapaprathat /
śrīsantānagurustvāha sthānaṃ buddhāprabuddhayoḥ // 89
meaning:
दिनरात्रिक्रमं मे श्रीशंभुरित्थमपप्रथत् /
श्रीसन्तानगुरुस्त्वाह स्थानं बुद्धाप्रबुद्धयोः // 89
text_mt: the illustrious Sambhunātha, explained to me this sequence of day and night. / But the guru of the illustrious lineage taught the locus of the awakened and unawakened: 89

sanskrit_iast:
hṛda ārabhya yattena rātrindivavibhājanam /
tadasatsitapakṣe'ntaḥ praveśollāsabhāgini // 90
meaning:
हृद आरभ्य यत्तेन रात्रिन्दिवविभाजनम् /
तदसत्सितपक्षेऽन्तः प्रवेशोल्लासभागिनि // 90
text_mt: because the division of night and day begins from the heart, / that is incorrect, for in the bright fortnight, which partakes of inner entry and emergence, 90

sanskrit_iast:
abuddhasthānamevaitaddinatvena kathaṃ bhavet /
alaṃ vānena nedaṃ vā mama prāṅmatamatsaraḥ // 91
meaning:
अबुद्धस्थानमेवैतद्दिनत्वेन कथं भवेत् /
अलं वानेन नेदं वा मम प्राङ्मतमत्सरः // 91
text_mt: how could this place of the unawakened be the day? / But enough of this; it is not that I harbor malice toward an earlier doctrine, 91

sanskrit_iast:
heye tu darśite śiṣyāḥ satpathaikāntadarśinaḥ /
vyākhyātaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣo ya statra prāṇagataḥ śaśī // 92
meaning:
हेये तु दर्शिते शिष्याः सत्पथैकान्तदर्शिनः /
व्याख्यातः कृष्णपक्षो य स्तत्र प्राणगतः शशी // 92
text_mt: but when what is to be discarded is pointed out, disciples see solely the true path. / The dark fortnight that has been explained—there, the moon located in the outgoing breath 92

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyanātmanaikaikāṃ kalāṃ pratitithi tyajet /
dvādaśāntasamīpe tu yāsau pañcadaśī tuṭiḥ // 93
meaning:
आप्यायनात्मनैकैकां कलां प्रतितिथि त्यजेत् /
द्वादशान्तसमीपे तु यासौ पञ्चदशी तुटिः // 93
text_mt: leaves, on every lunar day, one digital division (kalā) that consists of nourishing nectar. / Now, near the twelve-finger limit, there is that fifteenth tuṭi: 93

sanskrit_iast:
sāmāvasyātra sa kṣīṇaścandraḥ prāṇārkamāviśet /
uktaṃ śrīkāmikāyāṃ ca nordhve'dhaḥ prakṛtiḥ parā /
ardhārdhe kramate māyā dvikhaṇḍā śivarūpiṇī // 94
meaning:
सामावस्यात्र स क्षीणश्चन्द्रः प्राणार्कमाविशेत् /
उक्तं श्रीकामिकायां च नोर्ध्वेऽधः प्रकृतिः परा /
अर्धार्धे क्रमते माया द्विखण्डा शिवरूपिणी // 94
text_mt: that is the new moon; here, that depleted moon enters the breath-sun. / And it is said in the venerable Kāmikā: 'Not above, not below is the supreme Prakṛti; / in each half Māyā moves, divided in two, having the form of Śiva. 94

sanskrit_iast:
candrasūryātmanā dehaṃ pūrayetpravilāpayet /
amṛtaṃ candrarūpeṇa dvidhā ṣoḍaśadhā punaḥ // 95
meaning:
चन्द्रसूर्यात्मना देहं पूरयेत्प्रविलापयेत् /
अमृतं चन्द्ररूपेण द्विधा षोडशधा पुनः // 95
text_mt: One should fill and dissolve the body by means of the moon and the sun. / The nectar is twofold in the form of the moon, and again sixteenfold. 95

sanskrit_iast:
pivanti ca surāḥ sarve daśapañca parāḥ kalāḥ /
amā śeṣaguhāntaḥsthāmāvāsyā viśvatarpiṇī // 96
meaning:
पिवन्ति च सुराः सर्वे दशपञ्च पराः कलाः /
अमा शेषगुहान्तःस्थामावास्या विश्वतर्पिणी // 96
text_mt: And all the gods drink fifteen supreme digits; / the new-moon digit (amā), residing inside the cave of the remainder, is the new moon that satisfies the universe.' 96

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kalāḥ pañcadaśa kṣīyante śaśinaḥ kramāt /
āpyāyinyamṛtābrūpatādātmyātṣoḍaśī na tu // 97
meaning:
एवं कलाः पञ्चदश क्षीयन्ते शशिनः क्रमात् /
आप्यायिन्यमृताब्रूपतादात्म्यात्षोडशी न तु // 97
text_mt: In this way, the fifteen digits of the moon diminish gradually, / but not the sixteenth, because of its identity with the nourishing immortal waters. 97

sanskrit_iast:
tatra pañcadaśī yāsau tuṭiḥ prakṣīṇacandramāḥ /
tadūrdhvagaṃ yattuṭyardhaṃ pakṣasaṃdhiḥ sa kīrtitaḥ // 98
meaning:
तत्र पञ्चदशी यासौ तुटिः प्रक्षीणचन्द्रमाः /
तदूर्ध्वगं यत्तुट्यर्धं पक्षसंधिः स कीर्तितः // 98
text_mt: There, that fifteenth tuṭi in which the moon has waned— / the half-tuṭi that goes beyond it is called the junction of the fortnights. 98

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādviśramatuṭyardhādāmāvasyaṃ purādalam /
paraṃ prātipadaṃ cārdhamiti saṃdhiḥ sa kalpyate // 99
meaning:
तस्माद्विश्रमतुट्यर्धादामावस्यं पुरादलम् /
परं प्रातिपदं चार्धमिति संधिः स कल्प्यते // 99
text_mt: From that resting half-tuṭi, the first half belongs to the new moon / and the second half to the first lunar day; thus that junction is conceived. 99

sanskrit_iast:
tatra prātipade tasmiṃstuṭyardhārdhe purādalam /
āmāvasyaṃ tithicchedātkuryātsūryagrahaṃ viśat // 100
meaning:
तत्र प्रातिपदे तस्मिंस्तुट्यर्धार्धे पुरादलम् /
आमावस्यं तिथिच्छेदात्कुर्यात्सूर्यग्रहं विशत् // 100
text_mt: There, in that first lunar day, in the first half of that half-tuṭi, / the new moon, entering, causes a solar eclipse because of the intersection of lunar days. 100

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārkamaṇḍale līnaḥ śaśī sravati yanmadhu /
taptatvāttatpibedindusahabhūḥ siṃhikāsutaḥ // 101
meaning:
तत्रार्कमण्डले लीनः शशी स्रवति यन्मधु /
तप्तत्वात्तत्पिबेदिन्दुसहभूः सिंहिकासुतः // 101
text_mt: There, dissolved into the orb of the sun, the nectar that the moon pours out, / the son of Siṃhikā [Rāhu], co-arising with the moon, drinks because it is heated. 101

sanskrit_iast:
arkaḥ pramāṇaṃ somastu meyaṃ jñānakriyātmakau /
rāhurmāyāpramātā syāttadācchādanakovidaḥ // 102
meaning:
अर्कः प्रमाणं सोमस्तु मेयं ज्ञानक्रियात्मकौ /
राहुर्मायाप्रमाता स्यात्तदाच्छादनकोविदः // 102
text_mt: The sun is the means of knowledge (pramāṇa), and the moon is the object of knowledge (meya), consisting of knowledge and action. / Rāhu is the limited knower (māyāpramātṛ), skilled in concealing them. 102

sanskrit_iast:
tata eva tamorūpo vilāpayitumakṣamaḥ /
tatsaṃghaṭṭādvayollāso mukhyo mātā vilāpakaḥ // 103
meaning:
तत एव तमोरूपो विलापयितुमक्षमः /
तत्संघट्टाद्वयोल्लासो मुख्यो माता विलापकः // 103
text_mt: Therefore, having the nature of darkness, he is unable to dissolve them; / the flashing forth of the non-dual from their collision is the principal knower, the dissolver. 103

sanskrit_iast:
arkendurāhusaṃghaṭṭāt pramāṇaṃ vedyavedakau /
advayena tatastena puṇya eṣa mahāgrahaḥ // 104
meaning:
अर्केन्दुराहुसंघट्टात् प्रमाणं वेद्यवेदकौ /
अद्वयेन ततस्तेन पुण्य एष महाग्रहः // 104
text_mt: From the conjunction of sun, moon, and Rāhu, the means of knowledge and the known and knower / are therefore unified through non-duality; this is an auspicious great eclipse. 104

sanskrit_iast:
amāvasyāṃ vināpyeṣa saṃghaṭṭaścenmahāgrahaḥ /
yathārke meṣage rāhāvaśvinīsthe'śvinīdine // 105
meaning:
अमावस्यां विनाप्येष संघट्टश्चेन्महाग्रहः /
यथार्के मेषगे राहावश्विनीस्थेऽश्विनीदिने // 105
text_mt: Even without the new moon, if this conjunction takes place, it is a great eclipse, / as when the sun is in Aries, Rāhu is in Aśvinī, on the day of Aśvinī. 105

sanskrit_iast:
āmāvāsyaṃ yadā tvardhaṃ līnaṃ prātipade dale /
pratipacca viśuddhā syāttanmokṣo dūrage vidhau // 106
meaning:
आमावास्यं यदा त्वर्धं लीनं प्रातिपदे दले /
प्रतिपच्च विशुद्धा स्यात्तन्मोक्षो दूरगे विधौ // 106
text_mt: When, however, the new-moon half is merged into the first lunar day's segment, / and the first lunar day is purified, then there is release when the moon is far away. 106

sanskrit_iast:
grāsamokṣāntare snānadhyānahomajapādikam /
laukikālaukikaṃ bhūyaḥphalaṃ syātpāralaukikam // 107
meaning:
ग्रासमोक्षान्तरे स्नानध्यानहोमजपादिकम् /
लौकिकालौकिकं भूयःफलं स्यात्पारलौकिकम् // 107
text_mt: Between the seizure and release, bathing, meditation, fire sacrifice, recitation, and so forth / yield abundant fruit, mundane, extra-mundane, and related to the next world. 107

sanskrit_iast:
grāsyagrāsakatākṣobhaprakṣaye kṣaṇamāviśan /
mokṣabhāgdhyānapūjādi kurvaṃścandrārkayorgrahe // 108
meaning:
ग्रास्यग्रासकताक्षोभप्रक्षये क्षणमाविशन् /
मोक्षभाग्ध्यानपूजादि कुर्वंश्चन्द्रार्कयोर्ग्रहे // 108
text_mt: Entering for a moment into the cessation of the agitation between seized and seizer, / one attains liberation while performing meditation, worship, and so on during the eclipse of the moon and sun. 108

sanskrit_iast:
tithiccheda ṛṇaṃ kāso vṛddhirniḥśvasanaṃ dhanam /
ayatnajaṃ yatnajaṃ tu recanādatha rodhanāt // 109
meaning:
तिथिच्छेद ऋणं कासो वृद्धिर्निःश्वसनं धनम् /
अयत्नजं यत्नजं तु रेचनादथ रोधनात् // 109
text_mt: The cutting of a lunar day is a debt, a cough; its increase is an expiration, a wealth; / [this is] effortless, but that produced by effort arises from exhalation and retention. 109

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prāṇe viśati citsūrya induṃ sudhāmayam /
ekaikadhyena bodhāṃśu kalayā paripūrayet // 110
