meaning:
एवं प्राणे विशति चित्सूर्य इन्दुं सुधामयम् /
एकैकध्येन बोधांशु कलया परिपूरयेत् // 110
text_mt: In this way, when the breath enters, the sun of consciousness / fills the nectar-filled moon by means of a single ray of awareness, digit by digit. 110

sanskrit_iast:
kramasaṃpūraṇāśāliśaśāṅkāmṛtasundarāḥ /
tuṭyaḥ pañcadaśaitāḥ syustithayaḥ sitapakṣagāḥ // 111
meaning:
क्रमसंपूरणाशालिशशाङ्कामृतसुन्दराः /
तुट्यः पञ्चदशैताः स्युस्तिथयः सितपक्षगाः // 111
text_mt: Resplendent with the moon's nectar that is full of gradual replenishment, / these fifteen tuṭis are the lunar days belonging to the bright fortnight. 111

sanskrit_iast:
antyāyāṃ pūrṇamastuṭyāṃ pūrvavatpakṣasandhitā /
indugrahaśca pratipatsandhau pūrvapraveśataḥ // 112
meaning:
अन्त्यायां पूर्णमस्तुट्यां पूर्ववत्पक्षसन्धिता /
इन्दुग्रहश्च प्रतिपत्सन्धौ पूर्वप्रवेशतः // 112
text_mt: In the final tuṭi of the full moon, as before, there is the junction of the fortnights, / and a lunar eclipse occurs at the junction of the first lunar day due to the prior entry. 112

sanskrit_iast:
aihikaṃ grahaṇe cātra sādhakānāṃ mahāphalam /
prāgvadanyadayaṃ māsaḥ prāṇacāre'bda ucyate // 113
meaning:
ऐहिकं ग्रहणे चात्र साधकानां महाफलम् /
प्राग्वदन्यदयं मासः प्राणचारेऽब्द उच्यते // 113
text_mt: And during this eclipse, there is great mundane fruit for adepts; / the rest is as before. This month is described in the movement of breath; [now] the year [is explained]. 113

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsvaṅguleṣvarko hṛdayānmakarādiṣu /
tiṣṭhanmāghāḍhikaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ kuryāttaccottarāyaṇam // 114
meaning:
षट्सु षट्स्वङ्गुलेष्वर्को हृदयान्मकरादिषु /
तिष्ठन्माघाढिकं षट्कं कुर्यात्तच्चोत्तरायणम् // 114
text_mt: At intervals of six fingers from the heart, the sun, staying in Capricorn and the rest, / makes the six months beginning with Māgha; and that is the northern solstice. 114

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkrāntitritaye vṛtte bhukte cāṣṭādaśāṅgule /
meṣaṃ prāpte ravau puṇyaṃ viṣuvatpāralaukikam // 115
meaning:
संक्रान्तित्रितये वृत्ते भुक्ते चाष्टादशाङ्गुले /
मेषं प्राप्ते रवौ पुण्यं विषुवत्पारलौकिकम् // 115
text_mt: When three transitions have elapsed and eighteen digits are traversed, / the sun reaches Aries; that meritorious equinox pertains to the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
praveśe tu tulāsthe'rke tadeva viṣuvadbhavet /
iha siddhipradaṃ caitaddakṣiṇāyanagaṃ tataḥ // 116
meaning:
प्रवेशे तु तुलास्थेऽर्के तदेव विषुवद्भवेत् /
इह सिद्धिप्रदं चैतद्दक्षिणायनगं ततः // 116
text_mt: On the incoming breath, however, when the sun is in Libra, that very [junction] is the equinox; / it grants spiritual accomplishment here in this world, and is henceforth in the southern course.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhatā prodbubhūṣiṣyadbhāvaścāthodbubhūṣutā /
udbhaviṣyattvamudbhūtiprārambho'pyudbhavasthitiḥ // 117
meaning:
गर्भता प्रोद्बुभूषिष्यद्भावश्चाथोद्बुभूषुता /
उद्भविष्यत्त्वमुद्भूतिप्रारम्भोऽप्युद्भवस्थितिः // 117
text_mt: State of being a womb, condition of having the will to emerge, and then eagerness to emerge; / futurity of emergence, commencement of emergence, and stability of emergence;

sanskrit_iast:
janma sattā pariṇatirvṛddhirhrāsaḥ kṣayaḥ kramāt /
makarādīni tenātra kriyā sūte sadṛkphalam // 118
meaning:
जन्म सत्ता परिणतिर्वृद्धिर्ह्रासः क्षयः क्रमात् /
मकरादीनि तेनात्र क्रिया सूते सदृक्फलम् // 118
text_mt: birth, existence, transformation, growth, decay, and destruction in succession: / these correspond to Capricorn and the subsequent [signs], and therefore action here yields a matching fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
āmutrike jhaṣaḥ kumbho mantrādeḥ pūrvasevane /
catuṣkaṃ kila mīnādyamantikaṃ cottarottaram // 119
meaning:
आमुत्रिके झषः कुम्भो मन्त्रादेः पूर्वसेवने /
चतुष्कं किल मीनाद्यमन्तिकं चोत्तरोत्तरम् // 119
text_mt: For otherworldly results, Capricorn and Aquarius [serve] for the preparatory practice of mantra and the like; / the tetrad beginning with Pisces is indeed close at hand and increasingly superior.

sanskrit_iast:
praveśe khalu tatraiva śāntipuṣṭyādisundaram /
karma syādaihikaṃ tacca dūradūraphalaṃ kramāt // 120
meaning:
प्रवेशे खलु तत्रैव शान्तिपुष्ट्यादिसुन्दरम् /
कर्म स्यादैहिकं तच्च दूरदूरफलं क्रमात् // 120
text_mt: During the incoming breath precisely there, action that is beneficial through pacification, nourishment, and so forth, / will pertain to this world, its fruit being increasingly distant in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
nirgame dinavṛddhiḥ syādviparīte viparyayaḥ /
varṣe'smiṃstithayaḥ pañca pratyaṅgulamiti kramaḥ // 121
meaning:
निर्गमे दिनवृद्धिः स्याद्विपरीते विपर्ययः /
वर्षेऽस्मिंस्तिथयः पञ्च प्रत्यङ्गुलमिति क्रमः // 121
text_mt: During the outgoing breath, there is the increase of the day; on the reverse, the opposite [occurs]. / In this year, there are five lunar days per digit: such is the order.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpyahorātravidhiriti sarvaṃ hi pūrvavat /
prāṇīye varṣa etasminkārtikādiṣu dakṣataḥ // 122
meaning:
तत्राप्यहोरात्रविधिरिति सर्वं हि पूर्ववत् /
प्राणीये वर्ष एतस्मिन्कार्तिकादिषु दक्षतः // 122
text_mt: There too, the rule of day and night applies; thus everything is just as before. / In this vital-breath year, beginning with Kārttika on the right,

sanskrit_iast:
pitāmahāntaṃ rudrāḥ syurdvādaśāgre'tra bhāvinaḥ /
prāṇe varṣodayaḥ prokto dvādaśābdodayo'dhunā // 123
meaning:
पितामहान्तं रुद्राः स्युर्द्वादशाग्रेऽत्र भाविनः /
प्राणे वर्षोदयः प्रोक्तो द्वादशाब्दोदयोऽधुना // 123
text_mt: there are the Rudras ending with Pitāmaha, who are to appear here at the end of twelve digits. / The rising of the year in the vital breath has been described; now that of twelve years is explained.

sanskrit_iast:
kharasāstithya ekasminnekasminnaṅgule kramāt /
dvādaśābdodaye te ca caitrādyā dvādaśoditāḥ // 124
meaning:
खरसास्तिथ्य एकस्मिन्नेकस्मिन्नङ्गुले क्रमात् /
द्वादशाब्दोदये ते च चैत्राद्या द्वादशोदिताः // 124
text_mt: There are sixty lunar days in each single digit in succession / in the rising of twelve years, and they are declared as the twelve beginning with Caitra.

sanskrit_iast:
caitre mantroditiḥ so'pi tālunyukto'dhunā punaḥ /
hṛdi caitroditistena tatra mantrodayo'pi hi // 125
meaning:
चैत्रे मन्त्रोदितिः सोऽपि तालुन्युक्तोऽधुना पुनः /
हृदि चैत्रोदितिस्तेन तत्र मन्त्रोदयोऽपि हि // 125
text_mt: The rising of the mantra takes place in Caitra, and that too was stated at the palate; now again, / the rising of Caitra is in the heart, and thus the rising of the mantra is also there.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyaṅgulaṃ tithīnāṃ tu triśate parikalpite /
sapañcāṃśāṅgule'bdaḥ syātprāṇe ṣaṣṭyabdatā punaḥ // 126
meaning:
प्रत्यङ्गुलं तिथीनां तु त्रिशते परिकल्पिते /
सपञ्चांशाङ्गुलेऽब्दः स्यात्प्राणे षष्ट्यब्दता पुनः // 126
text_mt: When three hundred [and sixty] lunar days are assigned to each digit, / a year occurs in a digit and one-fifth; then again, sixty years in the vital breath [are reckoned].

sanskrit_iast:
śatāni ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi caikaviṃśatirityayam /
vibhāgaḥ prāṇagaḥ ṣaṣṭivarṣāhorātra ucyate // 127
meaning:
शतानि षट् सहस्राणि चैकविंशतिरित्ययम् /
विभागः प्राणगः षष्टिवर्षाहोरात्र उच्यते // 127
text_mt: Twenty-one thousand and six hundred: / this division located in the vital breath is spoken of as a day and night of sixty years.

sanskrit_iast:
praharāharniśāmāsaṛtvabdaraviṣaṣṭigaḥ /
yaśchedastatra yaḥ sandhiḥ sa puṇyo dhyānapūjane // 128
meaning:
प्रहराहर्निशामासऋत्वब्दरविषष्टिगः /
यश्छेदस्तत्र यः सन्धिः स पुण्यो ध्यानपूजने // 128
text_mt: Any division occurring in watches, days, nights, months, seasons, years, and solar sixty-year cycles— / whatever junction is there, that is meritorious for meditation and worship.

sanskrit_iast:
iti prāṇodaye yo'yaṃ kālaḥ śaktyekavigrahaḥ /
viśvātmāntaḥsthitastasya bāhye rūpaṃ nirūpyate // 129
meaning:
इति प्राणोदये योऽयं कालः शक्त्येकविग्रहः /
विश्वात्मान्तःस्थितस्तस्य बाह्ये रूपं निरूप्यते // 129
text_mt: Thus, this time which consists solely of the power in the rising of the vital breath, / abiding internally as the universal self, its external form is now set forth.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭ prāṇāścaṣakasteṣāṃ ṣaṣṭirnālī ca tāstathā /
tithistattriṃśatā māsaste dvādaśa tu vatsaraḥ // 130
meaning:
षट् प्राणाश्चषकस्तेषां षष्टिर्नाली च तास्तथा /
तिथिस्तत्त्रिंशता मासस्ते द्वादश तु वत्सरः // 130
text_mt: Six breaths make a caṣaka; sixty of them make a nālī; / thirty of those make a lunar day, thirty of those a month, and twelve of those a year.

sanskrit_iast:
abdaṃ pitryastvahorātra udagdakṣiṇato'yanāt /
pitṝṇāṃ yatsvamānena varṣaṃ taddivyamucyate // 131
meaning:
अब्दं पित्र्यस्त्वहोरात्र उदग्दक्षिणतोऽयनात् /
पितॄणां यत्स्वमानेन वर्षं तद्दिव्यमुच्यते // 131
text_mt: A year is a day and night of the ancestors, through the northern and southern solstices. / What is a year by the ancestors' own measure is spoken of as divine.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ ca triśataṃ varṣāṇāmatra mānuṣam /
tacca dvādaśabhirhatvā māsasaṃkhyātra labhyate // 132
meaning:
षष्ट्यधिकं च त्रिशतं वर्षाणामत्र मानुषम् /
तच्च द्वादशभिर्हत्वा माससंख्यात्र लभ्यते // 132
text_mt: Three hundred and sixty human years here, / multiplied by twelve, yield the number of months.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ punastriṃśatā hatvāhorātrakalpanā vadet /
hatvā tāṃ caikaviṃśatyā sahasraiḥ ṣaṭśatena ca // 133
meaning:
तां पुनस्त्रिंशता हत्वाहोरात्रकल्पना वदेत् /
हत्वा तां चैकविंशत्या सहस्रैः षट्शतेन च // 133
text_mt: Multiplying that again by thirty, one may state the computation of days and nights; / and multiplying that by twenty-one thousand six hundred,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇasaṃkhyāṃ vadettatra ṣaṣṭyādyabdodayaṃ punaḥ /
uktaṃ ca gurubhiḥ śrīmadrauravādisvavṛttiṣu // 134
meaning:
प्राणसंख्यां वदेत्तत्र षष्ट्याद्यब्दोदयं पुनः /
उक्तं च गुरुभिः श्रीमद्रौरवादिस्ववृत्तिषु // 134
text_mt: one may state the number of vital breaths. The rising of sixty and other years there / has also been spoken by the gurus in their commentaries on the venerable Raurava and other works:

sanskrit_iast:
devānāṃ yadahorātraṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ sa hāyanaḥ /
śatatrayeṇa ṣaṣṭyā ca nṝṇāṃ vibudhavatsaraḥ // 135
meaning:
देवानां यदहोरात्रं मानुषाणां स हायनः /
शतत्रयेण षष्ट्या च नॄणां विबुधवत्सरः // 135
text_mt: “What is a day and night of the gods is a year of human beings; / by three hundred and sixty [human years] there is a year of the gods.”

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatsvacchandaśāstre ca tadeva matamīkṣyate /
pitṝṇāṃ tadahorātramityupakramya pṛṣṭhataḥ // 136
meaning:
श्रीमत्स्वच्छन्दशास्त्रे च तदेव मतमीक्ष्यते /
पितॄणां तदहोरात्रमित्युपक्रम्य पृष्ठतः // 136
text_mt: In the venerable Svacchandaśāstra too, that very view is seen: / having commenced with “that day and night of the ancestors,” subsequently,

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ daivastvahorātra iti hyaikyopasaṃhṛtiḥ /
tena ye guravaḥ śrīmatsvacchandoktidvayāditaḥ // 137
meaning:
एवं दैवस्त्वहोरात्र इति ह्यैक्योपसंहृतिः /
तेन ये गुरवः श्रीमत्स्वच्छन्दोक्तिद्वयादितः // 137
text_mt: there is the concluding integration: “such indeed is a divine day and night.” / Therefore, those gurus who, on the basis of two passages of the venerable Svacchanda and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
pitryaṃ varṣaṃ divyadinamūcurbhrāntā hi te mudhā /
divyārkābdasahasrāṇi yugeṣu caturāditaḥ // 138
meaning:
पित्र्यं वर्षं दिव्यदिनमूचुर्भ्रान्ता हि ते मुधा /
दिव्यार्काब्दसहस्राणि युगेषु चतुरादितः // 138
text_mt: claimed that an ancestral year is a divine day, were indeed wandering in error in vain. / Divine solar years in thousands in the four yugas, beginning with four,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikahānyā tāvadbhiḥ śataisteṣvaṣṭa saṃdhayaḥ /
caturyugaikasaptatyā manvantaste caturdaśa // 139
meaning:
एकैकहान्या तावद्भिः शतैस्तेष्वष्ट संधयः /
चतुर्युगैकसप्तत्या मन्वन्तस्ते चतुर्दश // 139
text_mt: diminishing by one each, along with that many hundreds, have eight twilight junctions in them. / By seventy-one four-yuga cycles there is a period of a Manu; of these there are fourteen.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo'hastatra cendrāḥ kramādyānti caturdaśa /
brahmāho'nte kālavahnerjvālā yojanalakṣiṇī // 140
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोऽहस्तत्र चेन्द्राः क्रमाद्यान्ति चतुर्दश /
ब्रह्माहोऽन्ते कालवह्नेर्ज्वाला योजनलक्षिणी // 140
text_mt: That is a day of Brahmā, and therein fourteen Indras pass away in succession. / At the end of Brahmā's day, the flame of the fire of time, measuring a hundred thousand leagues,

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā lokatrayaṃ dhūmāttvanyatprasvāpayettrayam /
nirayebhyaḥ purā kālavahnervyaktiryatastataḥ // 141
meaning:
दग्ध्वा लोकत्रयं धूमात्त्वन्यत्प्रस्वापयेत्त्रयम् /
निरयेभ्यः पुरा कालवह्नेर्व्यक्तिर्यतस्ततः // 141
text_mt: burns the three worlds and causes another triad to fall asleep through smoke. / Because the appearance of the fire of time occurs previously from the hells,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhuradhaḥsthito'pīśa iti śrīrauravaṃ matam /
brahmaniḥśvāsanirdhūte bhasmani svedavāriṇā // 142
meaning:
विभुरधःस्थितोऽपीश इति श्रीरौरवं मतम् /
ब्रह्मनिःश्वासनिर्धूते भस्मनि स्वेदवारिणा // 142
text_mt: the all-pervading Lord is the master even though situated below: such is the view of the venerable Raurava. / In the ashes blown away by Brahmā's expiration, the universe,

sanskrit_iast:
tadīyenāplutaṃ viśvaṃ tiṣṭhettāvanniśāgame /
tasminniśāvadhau sarve pudgalāḥ sūkṣmadehagāḥ // 143
meaning:
तदीयेनाप्लुतं विश्वं तिष्ठेत्तावन्निशागमे /
तस्मिन्निशावधौ सर्वे पुद्गलाः सूक्ष्मदेहगाः // 143
text_mt: inundated by his own water of sweat, remains for that long at the advent of night. / At that boundary of night, all embodied souls residing in the subtle body,

sanskrit_iast:
agnivegeritā loke jane syurlayakevalāḥ /
kūṣmāṇḍahāṭakādyāstu krīḍanti mahadālaye // 144
meaning:
अग्निवेगेरिता लोके जने स्युर्लयकेवलाः /
कूष्माण्डहाटकाद्यास्तु क्रीडन्ति महदालये // 144
text_mt: impelled by the force of fire, become dissolved solitaries in the Jana world; / whereas Kūṣmāṇḍa, Hāṭaka, and others sport in the realm of the Mahat.

sanskrit_iast:
niśākṣaye punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kurute tāmasāditaḥ /
svakavarṣaśatānte'sya kṣayastadvaiṣṇavaṃ dinam // 145
meaning:
निशाक्षये पुनः सृष्टिं कुरुते तामसादितः /
स्वकवर्षशतान्तेऽस्य क्षयस्तद्वैष्णवं दिनम् // 145
text_mt: At the expiration of the night, he performs creation again, beginning from the darkness. / At the end of his own hundred years comes his dissolution; that is a day of Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
rātriśca tāvatītyevaṃ viṣṇurudraśatābhidhāḥ /
kramātsvasvaśatānteṣu naśyantyatrāṇḍalopataḥ // 146
meaning:
रात्रिश्च तावतीत्येवं विष्णुरुद्रशताभिधाः /
क्रमात्स्वस्वशतान्तेषु नश्यन्त्यत्राण्डलोपतः // 146
text_mt: and the night is of equal length. In this manner, those named hundreds of Viṣṇus and Rudras / perish in succession at the end of their respective hundreds, through the dissolution of the Cosmic Egg.

sanskrit_iast:
abādyavyaktatattvānteṣvitthaṃ varṣaśataṃ kramāt /
dinarātrivibhāgaḥ syāt svasvāyuḥśatamānataḥ // 147
meaning:
अबाद्यव्यक्ततत्त्वान्तेष्वित्थं वर्षशतं क्रमात् /
दिनरात्रिविभागः स्यात् स्वस्वायुःशतमानतः // 147
text_mt: Thus, up to the end of the unmanifest tattva beginning with water, in succession, a century of years / constitutes the division of day and night according to the measure of a hundred of their own respective lifespans.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇaḥ pralayollāsasahasraistu rasāgnibhiḥ /
avyaktastheṣu rudreṣu dinaṃ rātriśca tāvatī // 148
meaning:
ब्रह्मणः प्रलयोल्लाससहस्रैस्तु रसाग्निभिः /
अव्यक्तस्थेषु रुद्रेषु दिनं रात्रिश्च तावती // 148
text_mt: By thirty-six thousand dissolutions and manifestations of Brahmā, / there is a day for the Rudras residing in the unmanifest, and the night is of equal length.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā śrīkaṇṭha eva syātsākṣātsaṃhārakṛtprabhuḥ /
sarve rudrāstathā mūle māyāgarbhādhikāriṇaḥ // 149
meaning:
तदा श्रीकण्ठ एव स्यात्साक्षात्संहारकृत्प्रभुः /
सर्वे रुद्रास्तथा मूले मायागर्भाधिकारिणः // 149
text_mt: Then Śrīkaṇṭha alone is the sovereign who directly effects dissolution. / Likewise, all the Rudras at the root, who have jurisdiction within the womb of māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktākhye hyāviriñcācchrīkaṇṭhena sahāsate /
nivṛttādhaḥsthakarmā hi brahmā tatrādhare dhiyaḥ // 150
meaning:
अव्यक्ताख्ये ह्याविरिञ्चाच्छ्रीकण्ठेन सहासते /
निवृत्ताधःस्थकर्मा हि ब्रह्मा तत्राधरे धियः // 150
text_mt: dwell together with Śrīkaṇṭha in that which is called the unmanifest, up to the abode of Brahmā. / For Brahmā, whose work in the lower realms has ceased, remains there below with his mind,

sanskrit_iast:
na bhoktā jño'dhikāre tu vṛtta eva śivībhavet /
sa eṣo'vāntaralayastatkṣaye sṛṣṭirucyate // 151
meaning:
न भोक्ता ज्ञोऽधिकारे तु वृत्त एव शिवीभवेत् /
स एषोऽवान्तरलयस्तत्क्षये सृष्टिरुच्यते // 151
text_mt: not being an experiencer; when his tenure as an agent has elapsed, he becomes Śiva. / This is the intermediate dissolution; at its termination, creation is spoken of.

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkhyavedādisaṃsiddhāñchrīkaṇṭhastadaharmukhe /
sṛjatyeva punastena na samyaṅmuktirīdṛśī // 152
meaning:
सांख्यवेदादिसंसिद्धाञ्छ्रीकण्ठस्तदहर्मुखे /
सृजत्येव पुनस्तेन न सम्यङ्मुक्तिरीदृशी // 152
text_mt: At the morning of that day, Śrīkaṇṭha certainly creates anew / those perfected in Sāṅkhya, Veda, and so forth; therefore, such is not complete liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pradhāne yadahorātraṃ tajjaṃ varṣaśataṃ vibhoḥ /
śrīkaṇṭhasyāyuretacca dinaṃ kañcukavāsinām // 153
meaning:
प्रधाने यदहोरात्रं तज्जं वर्षशतं विभोः /
श्रीकण्ठस्यायुरेतच्च दिनं कञ्चुकवासिनाम् // 153
text_mt: What is a day and night in Pradhāna, a century of years arising from that / is the lifespan of the all-pervading Śrīkaṇṭha; and this is a day for the dwellers of the cuirass.

sanskrit_iast:
tatkramānniyatiḥ kālo rāgo vidyā kaletyamī /
yāntyanyonyaṃ layaṃ teṣāmāyurgāhanikaṃ dinam // 154
meaning:
तत्क्रमान्नियतिः कालो रागो विद्या कलेत्यमी /
यान्त्यन्योन्यं लयं तेषामायुर्गाहनिकं दिनम् // 154
text_mt: In that order, these—restriction, time, attachment, limited knowledge, and limited agency— / undergo dissolution mutually; their lifespan is a day of Gahaneśa.

sanskrit_iast:
taddinaprakṣaye viśvaṃ māyāyāṃ pravilīyate /
kṣīṇāyāṃ niśi tāvatyāṃ gahaneśaḥ sṛjetpunaḥ // 155
meaning:
तद्दिनप्रक्षये विश्वं मायायां प्रविलीयते /
क्षीणायां निशि तावत्यां गहनेशः सृजेत्पुनः // 155
text_mt: At the dissolution of that day, the universe dissolves into māyā. / When the night of equal length has expired, the Lord of Gahana creates anew.

sanskrit_iast:
evamavyaktakālaṃ tu parārdhairdaśabhirjahi /
māyāhastāvatī rātrirbhavetpralaya eṣa saḥ // 156
meaning:
एवमव्यक्तकालं तु परार्धैर्दशभिर्जहि /
मायाहस्तावती रात्रिर्भवेत्प्रलय एष सः // 156
text_mt: Thus, multiply the time of the unmanifest by ten parārdhas; / that is a day of māyā, and the night is of equal length: this is that dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
māyākālaṃ parārdhānāṃ guṇayitvā śatena tu /
aiśvaro divaso nādaḥ prāṇātmātra sṛjejjagat // 157
meaning:
मायाकालं परार्धानां गुणयित्वा शतेन तु /
ऐश्वरो दिवसो नादः प्राणात्मात्र सृजेज्जगत् // 157
text_mt: Having multiplied the time of māyā by a hundred parārdhas, / there is a day of Īśvara; here the phonic resonance, identical with vital breath, creates the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatī caiśvarī rātriryatra prāṇaḥ praśāmyati /
prāṇagarbhasthamapyatra viśvaṃ sauṣumnavartmanā // 158
meaning:
तावती चैश्वरी रात्रिर्यत्र प्राणः प्रशाम्यति /
प्राणगर्भस्थमप्यत्र विश्वं सौषुम्नवर्त्मना // 158
text_mt: And of equal length is the night of Īśvara, in which the vital breath comes to rest. / Although situated in the womb of the vital breath, the universe here, through the path of the suṣumnā,

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇe brahmavile śānte saṃvidyāpyavaśiṣyate /
aṃśāṃśikāto'pyetasyāḥ sūkṣmasūkṣmataro layaḥ // 159
meaning:
प्राणे ब्रह्मविले शान्ते संविद्याप्यवशिष्यते /
अंशांशिकातोऽप्येतस्याः सूक्ष्मसूक्ष्मतरो लयः // 159
text_mt: when the vital breath has come to rest in the aperture of Brahmā, remains reposing in consciousness. / Even from this fractional state, there is an increasingly subtle dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇayitvaiśvaraṃ kālaṃ parārdhānāṃ śatena tu /
sādāśivaṃ dinaṃ rātrirmahāpralaya eva ca // 160
meaning:
गुणयित्वैश्वरं कालं परार्धानां शतेन तु /
सादाशिवं दिनं रात्रिर्महाप्रलय एव च // 160
text_mt: Having multiplied the time of Īśvara by a hundred parārdhas, / there is a day and night of Sadāśiva, and that is the great dissolution itself.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaḥ svakālānte bindvardhendunirodhikāḥ /
ākramya nāde līyeta gṛhītvā sacarācaram // 161
meaning:
सदाशिवः स्वकालान्ते बिन्द्वर्धेन्दुनिरोधिकाः /
आक्रम्य नादे लीयेत गृहीत्वा सचराचरम् // 161
text_mt: At the end of his own time, having taken up the moving and the unmoving, / Sadāśiva, traversing the bindu, the crescent moon, and the nirodhikā, dissolves into the nāda.

sanskrit_iast:
nādo nādāntavṛttyā tu bhittvā brahmabilaṃ haṭhāt /
śaktitattve layaṃ yāti nijakālaparikṣaye // 162
meaning:
नादो नादान्तवृत्त्या तु भित्त्वा ब्रह्मबिलं हठात् /
शक्तितत्त्वे लयं याति निजकालपरिक्षये // 162
text_mt: The nāda, however, by operating as nādānta, violently piercing the aperture of Brahmā, / dissolves into the level of power at the exhaustion of its own time.

sanskrit_iast:
etāvacchaktitattve tu vijñeyaṃ khalvaharniśam /
śaktiḥ svakālavilaye vyāpinyāṃ līyate punaḥ // 163
meaning:
एतावच्छक्तितत्त्वे तु विज्ञेयं खल्वहर्निशम् /
शक्तिः स्वकालविलये व्यापिन्यां लीयते पुनः // 163
text_mt: Just this much is indeed to be known as day and night on the level of power. / Power, at the dissolution of its own time, dissolves in turn into Vyāpinī.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpinyā taddivārātraṃ līyate sāpyanāśrite /
parārdhakoṭyā hatvāpi śaktikālamanāśrite // 164
meaning:
व्यापिन्या तद्दिवारात्रं लीयते साप्यनाश्रिते /
परार्धकोट्या हत्वापि शक्तिकालमनाश्रिते // 164
text_mt: That day and night belongs to Vyāpinī; she too dissolves into Anāśrita. / Even having multiplied the time of power by a crore of parārdhas,

sanskrit_iast:
dinaṃ rātriśca tatkāle parārdhaguṇite'pi ca /
so'pi yāti layaṃ sāmyasaṃjñe sāmanase pade // 165
meaning:
दिनं रात्रिश्च तत्काले परार्धगुणितेऽपि च /
सोऽपि याति लयं साम्यसंज्ञे सामनसे पदे // 165
text_mt: there is a day and a night in Anāśrita; and when that time is multiplied by a parārdha, / that too dissolves into the abode called Sameness, which is endowed with mind (sāmanasa).

sanskrit_iast:
sa kālaḥ sāmyasaṃjñaḥ syānnityo'kalyaḥ kalātmakaḥ /
yattatsāmanasaṃ rūpaṃ tatsāmyaṃ brahma viśvagam // 166
meaning:
स कालः साम्यसंज्ञः स्यान्नित्योऽकल्यः कलात्मकः /
यत्तत्सामनसं रूपं तत्साम्यं ब्रह्म विश्वगम् // 166
text_mt: That time, called Sameness, is eternal, free of parts, and composed of parts. / What is of that nature endowed with mind—that Sameness is the all-pervading Brahman.

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ sāmanasātkālānnimeṣonmeṣamātrataḥ /
tuṭyādikaṃ parārdhāntaṃ sūte saivātra niṣṭhitam // 167
meaning:
अतः सामनसात्कालान्निमेषोन्मेषमात्रतः /
तुट्यादिकं परार्धान्तं सूते सैवात्र निष्ठितम् // 167
text_mt: Therefore, from that time endowed with mind, from a mere blinking and opening [of the eyes], / that very [power] brings forth what is fixed here, beginning with the tuṭi and ending with the parārdha:

sanskrit_iast:
daśaśatasahasramayutaṃ lakṣaniyutakoṭi sārbudaṃ vṛndam /
kharvanikharve śaṃkhābjajaladhimadhyāntamatha parārdhaṃ ca // 168
meaning:
दशशतसहस्रमयुतं लक्षनियुतकोटि सार्बुदं वृन्दम् /
खर्वनिखर्वे शंखाब्जजलधिमध्यान्तमथ परार्धं च // 168
text_mt: Ten, a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand (ayuta), a hundred thousand (lakṣa), a million (niyuta), ten million (koṭi), an arbuda, a vṛnda, / a kharva, a nikharva, a śaṅkha, a padma, a jaladhi, a madhya, an anta, and then a parārdha.

sanskrit_iast:
ityekasmātprabhṛti hi daśadhā daśadhā krameṇa kalayitvā /
ekādiparārdhānteṣvaṣṭādaśasu sthitiṃ brūyāt // 169
meaning:
इत्येकस्मात्प्रभृति हि दशधा दशधा क्रमेण कलयित्वा /
एकादिपरार्धान्तेष्वष्टादशसु स्थितिं ब्रूयात् // 169
text_mt: Having counted thus, tenfold by tenfold in succession from one, / one should state their persistence through the eighteen places, beginning with one and ending with a parārdha.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāra ete pralayā mukhyāḥ sargāśca tatkalāḥ /
bhūmūlanaiśaśaktisthāstadevāṇḍacatuṣṭayam // 170
meaning:
चत्वार एते प्रलया मुख्याः सर्गाश्च तत्कलाः /
भूमूलनैशशक्तिस्थास्तदेवाण्डचतुष्टयम् // 170
text_mt: These four are the principal dissolutions and emanations are their parts; / they reside in the earth, the root, the nocturnal (māyā), and power—that very [set] is the tetrad of cosmic eggs.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnirbhuvi saṃhartā māyānte kālatattvarāṭ /
śrīkaṇṭho mūla ekatra sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ // 171
meaning:
कालाग्निर्भुवि संहर्ता मायान्ते कालतत्त्वराट् /
श्रीकण्ठो मूल एकत्र सृष्टिसंहारकारकः // 171
text_mt: Kālāgni is the destroyer on earth; at the end of māyā is the king of the principle of time; / in the root is Śrīkaṇṭha, operating as the single agent of emission and dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
tallayo vāntarastasmādekaḥ sṛṣṭilayeśitā /
śrīmānaghoraḥ śaktyante saṃhartā sṛṣṭikṛcca saḥ // 172
meaning:
तल्लयो वान्तरस्तस्मादेकः सृष्टिलयेशिता /
श्रीमानघोरः शक्त्यन्ते संहर्ता सृष्टिकृच्च सः // 172
text_mt: His dissolution is intermediate; therefore, one is the lord of emission and dissolution: / the glorious Aghora at the end of power is the destroyer and the agent of emission.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsṛṣṭau sṛṣṭisaṃhārā niḥsaṃkhyā jagatāṃ yataḥ /
antarbhūtāstataḥ śāktī mahāsṛṣṭirudāhṛtā // 173
meaning:
तत्सृष्टौ सृष्टिसंहारा निःसंख्या जगतां यतः /
अन्तर्भूतास्ततः शाक्ती महासृष्टिरुदाहृता // 173
text_mt: Because within his emission innumerable emissions and dissolutions of worlds / are included, therefore the emission pertaining to power is declared the great emission.

sanskrit_iast:
laye brahmā harī rudraśatānyaṣṭakapañcakam /
ityanyonyaṃ kramādyānti layaṃ māyāntake'dhvani // 174
meaning:
लये ब्रह्मा हरी रुद्रशतान्यष्टकपञ्चकम् /
इत्यन्योन्यं क्रमाद्यान्ति लयं मायान्तकेऽध्वनि // 174
text_mt: In dissolution, Brahmā, Hari, the hundreds of Rudras, the forty [deities]— / these, in succession, dissolve into each other in the path that ends in māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
māyātattvalaye tvete prayānti paramaṃ padam /
māyordhve ye sitādhvasthāsteṣāṃ paraśive layaḥ // 175
meaning:
मायातत्त्वलये त्वेते प्रयान्ति परमं पदम् /
मायोर्ध्वे ये सिताध्वस्थास्तेषां परशिवे लयः // 175
text_mt: At the dissolution of the principle of māyā, however, these go to the supreme abode; / the dissolution of those who reside in the pure path above māyā occurs in Paraśiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpyaupādhikādbhedāllaye bhedaṃ pare viduḥ /
evaṃ tāttveśvare varge līne sṛṣṭau punaḥ pare // 176
meaning:
तत्राप्यौपाधिकाद्भेदाल्लये भेदं परे विदुः /
एवं तात्त्वेश्वरे वर्गे लीने सृष्टौ पुनः परे // 176
text_mt: Even there, because of extrinsic difference, the higher know a difference in dissolution. / In this way, when the group of lords of principles is dissolved, then, in the next emission,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsādhakāḥ śiveṣṭā vā tatsthānamadhiśerate /
brāhmī nāma parasyaiva śaktistāṃ yatra pātayet // 177
meaning:
तत्साधकाः शिवेष्टा वा तत्स्थानमधिशेरते /
ब्राह्मी नाम परस्यैव शक्तिस्तां यत्र पातयेत् // 177
text_mt: adepts dedicated to them or favored by Śiva occupy their places. / The power of the Supreme alone is named Brāhmī; wherever he casts it,

sanskrit_iast:
sa brahmā viṣṇurudrādyā vaiṣṇavyāderataḥ kramāt /
śaktimantaṃ vihāyānyaṃ śaktiḥ kiṃ yāti nedṛśam // 178
meaning:
स ब्रह्मा विष्णुरुद्राद्या वैष्णव्यादेरतः क्रमात् /
शक्तिमन्तं विहायान्यं शक्तिः किं याति नेदृशम् // 178
text_mt: he is Brahmā; similarly Viṣṇu, Rudra, and the rest from Vaiṣṇavī and the others in succession. / Does power, leaving aside the possessor of power, go to another? It is not so.

sanskrit_iast:
chāditaprathitāśeṣa śaktirekaḥ śivastathā /
evaṃ visṛṣṭipralayāḥ prāṇa ekatra niṣṭhitāḥ // 179
meaning:
छादितप्रथिताशेष शक्तिरेकः शिवस्तथा /
एवं विसृष्टिप्रलयाः प्राण एकत्र निष्ठिताः // 179
text_mt: Śiva is one, whose entire power is concealed and expanded. / Thus emission and dissolution are grounded in prāṇa as a single whole.

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi saṃvidi saṃvicca cinmātre jñeyavarjite /
cinmātrameva devī ca sā parā parameśvarī // 180
meaning:
सोऽपि संविदि संविच्च चिन्मात्रे ज्ञेयवर्जिते /
चिन्मात्रमेव देवी च सा परा परमेश्वरी // 180
text_mt: That [prāṇa] too is in consciousness, and consciousness is in pure consciousness devoid of objects of knowledge; / and pure consciousness alone is the Goddess, the supreme Parameśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭātriṃśaṃ ca tattattvaṃ hṛdayaṃ tatparāparam /
tena saṃvittvamevaitatspandamānaṃ svabhāvataḥ // 181
meaning:
अष्टात्रिंशं च तत्तत्त्वं हृदयं तत्परापरम् /
तेन संवित्त्वमेवैतत्स्पन्दमानं स्वभावतः // 181
text_mt: And that is the thirty-eighth principle, the Heart, both supreme and non-supreme. / Because of this, it is precisely consciousness that vibrates by its own nature.

sanskrit_iast:
layodayā iti prāṇe ṣaṣṭyabdodayakīrtanam /
icchāmātrapratiṣṭheyaṃ kriyāvaicitryacarcanā // 182
meaning:
लयोदया इति प्राणे षष्ट्यब्दोदयकीर्तनम् /
इच्छामात्रप्रतिष्ठेयं क्रियावैचित्र्यचर्चना // 182
text_mt: Thus the rising of dissolutions and emissions is the proclamation of the rising of sixty years within the prāṇa. / This examination of the manifold diversity of action is grounded in will alone.

sanskrit_iast:
kālaśaktistato bāhye naitasyā niyataṃ vapuḥ /
svapnasvapne tathā svapne supte saṃkalpagocare // 183
meaning:
कालशक्तिस्ततो बाह्ये नैतस्या नियतं वपुः /
स्वप्नस्वप्ने तथा स्वप्ने सुप्ते संकल्पगोचरे // 183
text_mt: The power of time is thus external; it has no fixed form: / in dream-within-dream, likewise in dream, in deep sleep, in the realm of mental conception,

sanskrit_iast:
samādhau viśvasaṃhārasṛṣṭikramavivecane /
mito'pi kila kālāṃśo vitatatvena bhāsate // 184
meaning:
समाधौ विश्वसंहारसृष्टिक्रमविवेचने /
मितोऽपि किल कालांशो विततत्वेन भासते // 184
text_mt: in meditative absorption, and in the discerning of the succession of the universe's dissolution and emission, / even a measured portion of time appears as extended.

sanskrit_iast:
pramātrabhede bhede'tha citro vitatimāpyasau /
evaṃ prāṇe yathā kālaḥ kriyāvaicitryaśaktijaḥ // 185
meaning:
प्रमात्रभेदे भेदेऽथ चित्रो विततिमाप्यसौ /
एवं प्राणे यथा कालः क्रियावैचित्र्यशक्तिजः // 185
text_mt: When there is a distinction of subjects or a distinction [of states], this [time] has a diverse extension. / Just as time in the prāṇa arises from the power of manifold action,

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpāne'pi hṛdayānmūlapīṭhavisarpiṇi /
mūlābhidhamahāpīṭhasaṅkocapravikāsayoḥ // 186
meaning:
तथापानेऽपि हृदयान्मूलपीठविसर्पिणि /
मूलाभिधमहापीठसङ्कोचप्रविकासयोः // 186
text_mt: so also in the apāna, extending from the heart to the root-seat; / in the contraction and expansion of the great seat called the root,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādyanāśritāntānāṃ cinute sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtī /
śaśvadyadyapyapāno'ya mitthaṃ vahati kiṃtvasau // 187
meaning:
ब्रह्माद्यनाश्रितान्तानां चिनुते सृष्टिसंहृती /
शश्वद्यद्यप्यपानोऽय मित्थं वहति किंत्वसौ // 187
text_mt: it gathers the emissions and dissolutions of [the levels] from Brahmā to Anāśrita. / Even though this apāna flows incessantly in this manner, nevertheless,

sanskrit_iast:
avedyayatno yatnena yogibhiḥ samupāsyate /
hṛtkandānandasaṃkocavikāsadvādaśāntagāḥ // 188
meaning:
अवेद्ययत्नो यत्नेन योगिभिः समुपास्यते /
हृत्कन्दानन्दसंकोचविकासद्वादशान्तगाः // 188
text_mt: its effortless effort is meditated upon by yogins with exertion; / extending to the twelve ends of contraction and expansion of the heart-bulb's bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādayo'nāśritāntāḥ sevyante'tra suyogibhiḥ /
ete ca parameśānaśaktitvādviśvavartinaḥ // 189
meaning:
ब्रह्मादयोऽनाश्रितान्ताः सेव्यन्तेऽत्र सुयोगिभिः /
एते च परमेशानशक्तित्वाद्विश्ववर्तिनः // 189
text_mt: the levels from Brahmā to Anāśrita are served here by good yogins. / And these, being powers of the Supreme Lord, abide in the universe;

sanskrit_iast:
dehamapyaśnuvānāstatkāraṇānīti kāmike /
bālyayauvanavṛddhatvanidhaneṣu punarbhave // 190
meaning:
देहमप्यश्नुवानास्तत्कारणानीति कामिके /
बाल्ययौवनवृद्धत्वनिधनेषु पुनर्भवे // 190
text_mt: pervading the body as well, they are its primary causes, as stated in the Kāmika: / in childhood, youth, old age, death, rebirth,

sanskrit_iast:
muktau ca dehe brahmādyāḥ ṣaḍadhiṣṭhānakāriṇaḥ /
tasyānte tu parā devī yatra yukto na jāyate // 191
meaning:
मुक्तौ च देहे ब्रह्माद्याः षडधिष्ठानकारिणः /
तस्यान्ते तु परा देवी यत्र युक्तो न जायते // 191
text_mt: and liberation in the body, the six beginning with Brahmā exercise superintendence; / at its end is the supreme Goddess, joined to whom one is not reborn.

sanskrit_iast:
anena jñātamātreṇa dīkṣānugrahakṛdbhavet /
samastakāraṇollāsapade suvidite yataḥ // 192
meaning:
अनेन ज्ञातमात्रेण दीक्षानुग्रहकृद्भवेत् /
समस्तकारणोल्लासपदे सुविदिते यतः // 192
text_mt: By the mere knowledge of this, one becomes an agent of initiation and grace, / because when the abode of the flash of all primary causes is thoroughly known,

sanskrit_iast:
akāraṇaṃ śivaṃ vindedyattadviśvasya kāraṇam /
adhovaktraṃ tvidaṃ dvaitakalaṅkaikāntaśātanam // 193
meaning:
अकारणं शिवं विन्देद्यत्तद्विश्वस्य कारणम् /
अधोवक्त्रं त्विदं द्वैतकलङ्कैकान्तशातनम् // 193
text_mt: one finds causeless Śiva, who is the cause of the universe. / This downward-facing mouth, however, completely destroys the taint of duality,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīyate tadupāsāyāṃ yenordhvādharaḍambaraḥ /
atrāpānodaye prāgvatṣaṣṭyabdodayayojanām // 194
meaning:
क्षीयते तदुपासायां येनोर्ध्वाधरडम्बरः /
अत्रापानोदये प्राग्वत्षष्ट्यब्दोदययोजनाम् // 194
text_mt: by which the pomp of upper and lower diminishes through its worship. / Here, in the rising of apāna, as before, one should perform the coordination

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatkurvīta tuṭyāderyuktāṅgulavibhāgataḥ /
evaṃ samāne'pi vidhiḥ sa hi hārdīṣu nāḍiṣu // 195
meaning:
यावत्कुर्वीत तुट्यादेर्युक्ताङ्गुलविभागतः /
एवं समानेऽपि विधिः स हि हार्दीषु नाडिषु // 195
text_mt: of the rising of the sixty years from the tuṭi onwards, according to the proper division of digits. / The same rule applies to the samāna: for moving in the channels of the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃcaransarvatodikkaṃ daśadhaiva vibhāvyate /
daśa mukhyā mahānāḍīḥ pūrayanneṣa tadgatāḥ // 196
meaning:
संचरन्सर्वतोदिक्कं दशधैव विभाव्यते /
दश मुख्या महानाडीः पूरयन्नेष तद्गताः // 196
text_mt: it is conceived as ten-fold, going in every direction. / Filling the ten principal great channels, and traversing

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍyantaraśritā nāḍīḥ krāmandehe samasthitiḥ /
aṣṭāsu digdaleṣveṣa krāmaṃstaddikpateḥ kramāt // 197
meaning:
नाड्यन्तरश्रिता नाडीः क्रामन्देहे समस्थितिः /
अष्टासु दिग्दलेष्वेष क्रामंस्तद्दिक्पतेः क्रमात् // 197
text_mt: the subsidiary channels resting within them, it is situated equally in the body. / Moving through the eight petals of the directions, following the regent of each direction,

sanskrit_iast:
ceṣṭitānyanukurvāṇo raudraḥ saumyaśca bhāsate /
sa eva nāḍītritaye vāmadakṣiṇamadhyage // 198
meaning:
चेष्टितान्यनुकुर्वाणो रौद्रः सौम्यश्च भासते /
स एव नाडीत्रितये वामदक्षिणमध्यगे // 198
text_mt: imitating their activities, it shines forth as fierce and gentle. / That very [samāna], moving in the triad of channels—left, right, and middle—

sanskrit_iast:
indvarkāgnimaye mukhye caraṃstiṣṭhatyaharniśam /
sārdhanālīdvayaṃ prāṇaśatāni nava yatsthitam // 199
meaning:
इन्द्वर्काग्निमये मुख्ये चरंस्तिष्ठत्यहर्निशम् /
सार्धनालीद्वयं प्राणशतानि नव यत्स्थितम् // 199
text_mt: which are principal and composed of the moon, the sun, and fire, abides day and night. / That which abides for two and a half nālīs is nine hundred prāṇas;

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadvahannahorātraṃ caturviṃśatidhā caret /
viṣuvadvāsare prātaḥ sāṃśāṃ nālīṃ sa madhyagaḥ // 200
meaning:
तावद्वहन्नहोरात्रं चतुर्विंशतिधा चरेत् /
विषुवद्वासरे प्रातः सांशां नालीं स मध्यगः // 200
text_mt: flowing for that duration, it moves through day and night twenty-four times. / On the day of the equinox, in the morning, centered in the middle channel for a nālī with its fraction,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmetarodaksavyānyairyāvatsaṃkrāntipañcakam /
evaṃ kṣīṇāsu pādonacaturdaśasu nāliṣu // 201
meaning:
वामेतरोदक्सव्यान्यैर्यावत्संक्रान्तिपञ्चकम् /
एवं क्षीणासु पादोनचतुर्दशसु नालिषु // 201
text_mt: it moves through the five transitions by means of the left, right, northern, and southern [channels]. / When thirteen and three-quarter nālīs have thus passed,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyāhne dakṣaviṣuvannavaprāṇaśatīṃ vahet /
dakṣodaganyodagdakṣaiḥ punaḥ saṃkrāntipañcakam // 202
meaning:
मध्याह्ने दक्षविषुवन्नवप्राणशतीं वहेत् /
दक्षोदगन्योदग्दक्षैः पुनः संक्रान्तिपञ्चकम् // 202
text_mt: at midday the southern equinox bears nine hundred prāṇas. / Then through southern, northern, intermediate, northern, and southern, there are again five transitions,

sanskrit_iast:
navāsuśatamekaikaṃ tato viṣuvaduttaram /
pañcake pañcake'tīte saṃkrānterviṣuvadbahiḥ // 203
meaning:
नवासुशतमेकैकं ततो विषुवदुत्तरम् /
पञ्चके पञ्चकेऽतीते संक्रान्तेर्विषुवद्बहिः // 203
text_mt: each consisting of nine hundred breaths; from that arises the northern equinox. / When each group of five transitions has passed, an equinox occurs externally;

sanskrit_iast:
yadvattathāntaḥ saṅkrāntirnavaprāṇaśatāni sā /
evaṃ rātrāvapītyevaṃ viṣuvaddivasātsamāt // 204
meaning:
यद्वत्तथान्तः सङ्क्रान्तिर्नवप्राणशतानि सा /
एवं रात्रावपीत्येवं विषुवद्दिवसात्समात् // 204
text_mt: just as it is outside, so internally the transition consists of nine hundred prāṇas. / In this way it is at night also; thus, starting from the day of the equinox,

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhyāharniśāvṛddhihrāsasaṅkrāntigo'pyasau /
rātryantadinapūrvāṃśau madhyāhno divasakṣayaḥ // 205
meaning:
आरभ्याहर्निशावृद्धिह्राससङ्क्रान्तिगोऽप्यसौ /
रात्र्यन्तदिनपूर्वांशौ मध्याह्नो दिवसक्षयः // 205
text_mt: it undergoes the transitions of increase and decrease of day and night: / the end of the night and the early part of the day, midday, the decline of day,

sanskrit_iast:
sa śarvaryudayo madhyamudakto viṣutedṛśī /
vyāptau viṣeryato vṛttiḥ sāmyaṃ ca vyāptirucyate // 206
meaning:
स शर्वर्युदयो मध्यमुदक्तो विषुतेदृशी /
व्याप्तौ विषेर्यतो वृत्तिः साम्यं च व्याप्तिरुच्यते // 206
text_mt: the arrival of night, and its midpoint: the equinox is seen to be of such a nature. / For the root viṣ- denotes pervasion, and equality is said to be pervasion.

sanskrit_iast:
tadarhati ca yaḥ kālo viṣuvattadihoditaḥ /
viṣuvatprabhṛti hrāsavṛddhī ye dinarātrige // 207
meaning:
तदर्हति च यः कालो विषुवत्तदिहोदितः /
विषुवत्प्रभृति ह्रासवृद्धी ये दिनरात्रिगे // 207
text_mt: And the time corresponding to that is here called the equinox. / From the equinox onward, the decrease and increase occurring in day and night

sanskrit_iast:
tatkrameṇaiva saṃkrāntihrāsavṛddhī divāniśoḥ /
itthaṃ samānamaruto varṣadvayavikalpanam // 208
meaning:
तत्क्रमेणैव संक्रान्तिह्रासवृद्धी दिवानिशोः /
इत्थं समानमरुतो वर्षद्वयविकल्पनम् // 208
text_mt: occur by that very sequence of transition, decrease, and increase of day and night. / Thus is the conceptual differentiation of two years in the samāna breath.

sanskrit_iast:
cāra ekatra nahyatra śvāsapraśvāsacarcanam /
samāne'pi tuṭeḥ pūrvaṃ yāvatṣaṣṭyabdagocaram // 209
meaning:
चार एकत्र नह्यत्र श्वासप्रश्वासचर्चनम् /
समानेऽपि तुटेः पूर्वं यावत्षष्ट्यब्दगोचरम् // 209
text_mt: Its movement is in a single place; here there is indeed no consideration of inhalation and exhalation. / Even in the samāna, from before a tuṭi up to the scope of sixty years,

sanskrit_iast:
kālasaṃkhyā susūkṣmaikacāragā gaṇyate budhaiḥ /
saṃdhyāpūrvāhṇamadhyāhnamadhyarātrādi yatkila // 210
meaning:
कालसंख्या सुसूक्ष्मैकचारगा गण्यते बुधैः /
संध्यापूर्वाह्णमध्याह्नमध्यरात्रादि यत्किल // 210
text_mt: the reckoning of time traversing an extremely subtle single movement is computed by the wise. / The twilight, morning, noon, midnight, and so on that are known

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥsaṃkrāntigaṃ grāhyaṃ tanmukhyaṃ tatphaloditeḥ /
uktaḥ samānagaḥ kāla udāne tu nirūpyate // 211
meaning:
अन्तःसंक्रान्तिगं ग्राह्यं तन्मुख्यं तत्फलोदितेः /
उक्तः समानगः काल उदाने तु निरूप्यते // 211
text_mt: are to be understood as occurring in the internal transition; that is primary, because of the arising of its fruit. / The time occurring in the samāna has been described; but in the udāna it is now examined.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇavyāptau yaduktaṃ tadudāne'pyatra kevalam /
nāsāśaktyantayoḥ sthāne brahmarandhrordhvadhāmanī // 212
meaning:
प्राणव्याप्तौ यदुक्तं तदुदानेऽप्यत्र केवलम् /
नासाशक्त्यन्तयोः स्थाने ब्रह्मरन्ध्रोर्ध्वधामनी // 212
text_mt: What was stated regarding the pervasion of prāṇa applies also to the udāna; only here, / in place of the nostril and the limit of power, are the opening of Brahmā and the upper abode.

sanskrit_iast:
tenodāne'tra hṛdayānmūrdhanyadvādaśāntagam /
tuṭyādiṣaṣṭivarṣāntaṃ viśvaṃ kālaṃ vicārayet // 213
meaning:
तेनोदानेऽत्र हृदयान्मूर्धन्यद्वादशान्तगम् /
तुट्यादिषष्टिवर्षान्तं विश्वं कालं विचारयेत् // 213
text_mt: Therefore, in the udāna, from the heart up to the cranial limit of twelve fingers, / one should contemplate all time beginning with a tuṭi and ending with sixty years.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāne tu viśvātmamaye vyāpake kramavarjite /
sūkṣmasūkṣmocchaladrūpamātraḥ kālo vyavasthitaḥ // 214
meaning:
व्याने तु विश्वात्ममये व्यापके क्रमवर्जिते /
सूक्ष्मसूक्ष्मोच्छलद्रूपमात्रः कालो व्यवस्थितः // 214
text_mt: In the vyāna, however, which consists of the nature of all things, is pervasive, and devoid of sequence, / time is established merely as an extremely subtle emergent form.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭiḥ pravilayaḥ sthemā saṃhāro'nugraho yataḥ /
kramātprāṇādike kāle taṃ taṃ tatrāśrayettataḥ // 215
meaning:
सृष्टिः प्रविलयः स्थेमा संहारोऽनुग्रहो यतः /
क्रमात्प्राणादिके काले तं तं तत्राश्रयेत्ततः // 215
text_mt: Because emission, dissolution, stasis, reabsorption, and grace / occur sequentially in the time of prāṇa and the rest, therefore one should resort to each of them there.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇacāre'tra yo varṇapadamantrodayaḥ sthitaḥ /
yatnajo'yatnajaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paraḥ sthūlaḥ sa kathyate // 216
meaning:
प्राणचारेऽत्र यो वर्णपदमन्त्रोदयः स्थितः /
यत्नजोऽयत्नजः सूक्ष्मः परः स्थूलः स कथ्यते // 216
text_mt: The arising of phonemes, words, and mantras that resides in this movement of prāṇa, / produced with effort, produced effortlessly, subtle, supreme, and gross, is now declared.

sanskrit_iast:
eko nādātmako varṇaḥ sarvavarṇāvibhāgavān /
so'nastamitarūpatvādanāhata ihoditaḥ // 217
meaning:
एको नादात्मको वर्णः सर्ववर्णाविभागवान् /
सोऽनस्तमितरूपत्वादनाहत इहोदितः // 217
text_mt: The single phoneme consisting of resonance, free of differentiation into all the [individual] phonemes, / is here called the unstruck because of its never-setting nature.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tu bhairavasadbhāvo mātṛsadbhāva eṣa saḥ /
parā saikākṣarā devī yatra līnaṃ carācaram // 218
meaning:
स तु भैरवसद्भावो मातृसद्भाव एष सः /
परा सैकाक्षरा देवी यत्र लीनं चराचरम् // 218
text_mt: That indeed is the reality of Bhairava; that is the reality of the Mother; / that is the supreme Goddess of a single phoneme in whom the moving and unmoving are dissolved.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvārṇatrayamekaikaṃ ravyaṅgulamathetarat /
praveśa iti ṣaḍvarṇāḥ sūryendupathagāḥ kramāt // 219
meaning:
ह्रस्वार्णत्रयमेकैकं रव्यङ्गुलमथेतरत् /
प्रवेश इति षड्वर्णाः सूर्येन्दुपथगाः क्रमात् // 219
text_mt: The three short vowels, each one twelve fingers, then the other [three] / in the entry: thus are the six phonemes traversing the paths of the sun and moon in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
ikārokārayorādisandhau saṃdhyakṣaradvayam /
e+o iti praveśe tu ai+au iti dvayaṃ viduḥ // 220
meaning:
इकारोकारयोरादिसन्धौ संध्यक्षरद्वयम् /
ए+ओ इति प्रवेशे तु ऐ+औ इति द्वयं विदुः // 220
text_mt: At the initial juncture of the vowels ‘i’ and ‘u’ are the two diphthongs / ‘e’ and ‘o’; but upon the entry they know the two as ‘ai’ and ‘au’.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇṭhārṇāni praveśe tu dvādaśāntalalāṭayoḥ /
gale hṛdi ca bindvarṇavisargau paritaḥsthitau // 221
meaning:
षण्ठार्णानि प्रवेशे तु द्वादशान्तललाटयोः /
गले हृदि च बिन्द्वर्णविसर्गौ परितःस्थितौ // 221
text_mt: The neuter vowels are in the entry at the limit of twelve fingers and the forehead; / at the throat and in the heart, the anusvāra phoneme and the creative emission are situated round about.

sanskrit_iast:
kādipañcakamādyasya varṇasyāntaḥ sadoditam /
evaṃ sasthānavarṇānāmantaḥ sā sārṇasantatiḥ // 222
meaning:
कादिपञ्चकमाद्यस्य वर्णस्यान्तः सदोदितम् /
एवं सस्थानवर्णानामन्तः सा सार्णसन्ततिः // 222
text_mt: The group of five beginning with ‘ka’ is ever arisen within the first phoneme; / likewise, within the phonemes sharing the same place of articulation, is that succession of phonemes.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdyeṣa prāṇarūpastu sakāro jīvanātmakaḥ /
binduḥ prakāśo hārṇaśca pūraṇātmatayā sthitaḥ // 223
meaning:
हृद्येष प्राणरूपस्तु सकारो जीवनात्मकः /
बिन्दुः प्रकाशो हार्णश्च पूरणात्मतया स्थितः // 223
text_mt: This ‘sa’-phoneme, which is the nature of the vital breath in the heart, consists of living; / the bindu is luminosity, and the ‘ha’-phoneme stands as consisting of repletion.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaḥ paro'yamudayo varṇānāṃ sūkṣma ucyate /
praveśe ṣoḍaśaunmukhye ravayaḥ ṣaṇṭhavarjitāḥ // 224
meaning:
उक्तः परोऽयमुदयो वर्णानां सूक्ष्म उच्यते /
प्रवेशे षोडशौन्मुख्ये रवयः षण्ठवर्जिताः // 224
text_mt: This supreme arising of phonemes has been taught; the subtle one is now stated: / in the entry there are sixteen, and in the directed outward state twelve, excluding the neuter vowels.

sanskrit_iast:
tadevendvarkamatrānye varṇāḥ sūkṣmodayastvayam /
kālo'rdhamātraḥ kādīnāṃ trayastriṃśata ucyate // 225
meaning:
तदेवेन्द्वर्कमत्रान्ये वर्णाः सूक्ष्मोदयस्त्वयम् /
कालोऽर्धमात्रः कादीनां त्रयस्त्रिंशत उच्यते // 225
text_mt: That alone is the moon and the sun here; the remaining phonemes are this subtle arising: / the time of the thirty-three phonemes beginning with ‘ka’ is stated to be half a mora.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrā hrasvāḥ pañca dīrghāṣṭakaṃ dvistriḥ plutaṃ tu lṝ /
ekāśītimimāmardhamātrāṇāmāha no guruḥ // 226
meaning:
मात्रा ह्रस्वाः पञ्च दीर्घाष्टकं द्विस्त्रिः प्लुतं तु लॄ /
एकाशीतिमिमामर्धमात्राणामाह नो गुरुः // 226
text_mt: The short vowels have one mora, the eight long have two, the prolated ‘lṝ’ has three: / our guru taught this eighty-one of half-moras,

sanskrit_iast:
yadvaśādbhagavānekāśītikaṃ mantramabhyadhāt /
ekāśītipadā devī śaktiḥ proktā śivātmikā // 227
meaning:
यद्वशाद्भगवानेकाशीतिकं मन्त्रमभ्यधात् /
एकाशीतिपदा देवी शक्तिः प्रोक्ता शिवात्मिका // 227
text_mt: by virtue of which the Lord declared the mantra of eighty-one [units]; / the divine śakti identical with Śiva is spoken of as having eighty-one words.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmātaṅge tathā dharmasaṃghātātmā śivo yataḥ /
tathā tathā parāmarśaśakticakreśvaraḥ prabhuḥ // 228
meaning:
श्रीमातङ्गे तथा धर्मसंघातात्मा शिवो यतः /
तथा तथा परामर्शशक्तिचक्रेश्वरः प्रभुः // 228
text_mt: So too in the venerable Mātaṅga, since Śiva consists of the collection of qualities, / and in that very way the Lord is the sovereign of the wheel of the powers of apprehension,

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlaikāśītipadajaparāmarśairvibhāvyate /
tata eva parāmarśo yāvatyekaḥ samāpyate // 229
meaning:
स्थूलैकाशीतिपदजपरामर्शैर्विभाव्यते /
तत एव परामर्शो यावत्येकः समाप्यते // 229
text_mt: he is conceived through the gross apprehensions arising from the eighty-one words. / For that very reason, as far as a single apprehension extends to completion,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvattatpadamuktaṃ no suptiṅniyamayāntritam /
ekāśītipadodāravimarśaktamabṛṃhitaḥ // 230
meaning:
तावत्तत्पदमुक्तं नो सुप्तिङ्नियमयान्त्रितम् /
एकाशीतिपदोदारविमर्शक्तमबृंहितः // 230
text_mt: that much is said to be a ‘word’, not constrained by the rules of nominal and verbal endings; / expanded by the noble reflective awareness of eighty-one words,

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlopāyaḥ paropāyastveṣa mātrākṛto layaḥ /
ardhamātrā nava nava syuścaturṣu caturṣu yat // 231
meaning:
स्थूलोपायः परोपायस्त्वेष मात्राकृतो लयः /
अर्धमात्रा नव नव स्युश्चतुर्षु चतुर्षु यत् // 231
text_mt: this gross means is the supreme means, a dissolution effected through moras; / because nine half-moras each occur in every four

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguleṣviti ṣaṭtriṃśatyekāśītipadodayaḥ /
aṅgule navabhāgena vibhakte navamāśakāḥ // 232
meaning:
अङ्गुलेष्विति षट्त्रिंशत्येकाशीतिपदोदयः /
अङ्गुले नवभागेन विभक्ते नवमाशकाः // 232
text_mt: fingers: thus in thirty-six [fingers] is the arising of eighty-one words. / When a finger is divided into nine parts, the ninths

sanskrit_iast:
vedā mātrārdhamanyattu dvicatuḥṣaṅguṇaṃ trayam /
evamaṅgularandhrāṃśacatuṣkadvayagaṃ laghu // 233
meaning:
वेदा मात्रार्धमन्यत्तु द्विचतुःषङ्गुणं त्रयम् /
एवमङ्गुलरन्ध्रांशचतुष्कद्वयगं लघु // 233
text_mt: are four for half a mora; but the other three are two-, four-, and sixfold [that]. / Thus a short vowel occurs in twice four parts of a ninth of a finger;

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghaṃ plutaṃ kramāddvitriguṇamardhaṃ tato'pi hal /
kṣakārastryardhamātrātmā mātrikaḥ satathāntarā // 234
meaning:
दीर्घं प्लुतं क्रमाद्द्वित्रिगुणमर्धं ततोऽपि हल् /
क्षकारस्त्र्यर्धमात्रात्मा मात्रिकः सतथान्तरा // 234
text_mt: the long and prolated are respectively twice and thrice that, and a consonant is half of it; / the phoneme ‘kṣa’ consists of three half-moras, having a mora, and likewise between

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāntāvardhamātrāsya tasmiṃstu kalite sati /
aṅgulārdhe'dribhāgena tvardhamātrā purā punaḥ // 235
meaning:
विश्रान्तावर्धमात्रास्य तस्मिंस्तु कलिते सति /
अङ्गुलार्धेऽद्रिभागेन त्वर्धमात्रा पुरा पुनः // 235
text_mt: the rests there is its half-mora; but when that is calculated, / there is half a mora previously in the seventh part of half a finger, and again,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣakāraḥ sarvasaṃyogagrahaṇātmā tu sarvagaḥ /
sarvavarṇodayādyantasandhiṣūdayabhāgvibhuḥ // 236
meaning:
क्षकारः सर्वसंयोगग्रहणात्मा तु सर्वगः /
सर्ववर्णोदयाद्यन्तसन्धिषूदयभाग्विभुः // 236
text_mt: the phoneme ‘kṣa’, whose essence is the grasping of all conjuncts, is all-pervading; / that all-pervasive phoneme participates in arising at the initial and final junctions of the arising of all phonemes.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśake cāre varṇānāmudayaḥ phale /
krūre saumye vilomena hādi yāvadapaścimam // 237
meaning:
इत्थं षट्त्रिंशके चारे वर्णानामुदयः फले /
क्रूरे सौम्ये विलोमेन हादि यावदपश्चिमम् // 237
text_mt: Thus in a movement of thirty-six [fingers] is the arising of phonemes in fruit; / in the fierce and the gentle [movements] in reverse order from ‘ha’ down to the very first.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdyakāro dvādaśānte hakārastadidaṃ viduḥ /
ahamātmakamadvaitaṃ yaḥ prakāśātmaviśramaḥ // 238
meaning:
हृद्यकारो द्वादशान्ते हकारस्तदिदं विदुः /
अहमात्मकमद्वैतं यः प्रकाशात्मविश्रमः // 238
text_mt: In the heart is the phoneme ‘a’, and at the limit of twelve fingers is the phoneme ‘ha’; thus they know this / non-duality whose nature is ‘I’ (aham), which is the rest consisting of luminosity.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktyavibhāgena mātraikāśītikā tviyam /
dvāsaptatāvaṅguleṣu dviguṇatvena saṃsaret // 239
meaning:
शिवशक्त्यविभागेन मात्रैकाशीतिका त्वियम् /
द्वासप्ततावङ्गुलेषु द्विगुणत्वेन संसरेत् // 239
text_mt: Through the non-differentiation of Śiva and śakti, this eighty-one-mora [movement], / by being doubled, would circulate through seventy-two fingers.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaḥ sūkṣmodayastraidhaṃ dvidhoktastu parodayaḥ /
atha sthūlodayo'rṇānāṃ bhaṇyate guruṇoditaḥ // 240
meaning:
उक्तः सूक्ष्मोदयस्त्रैधं द्विधोक्तस्तु परोदयः /
अथ स्थूलोदयोऽर्णानां भण्यते गुरुणोदितः // 240
text_mt: The subtle arising has been spoken of as threefold, and the supreme arising has been taught as twofold; / now the gross arising of the phonemes, taught by the guru, is recited:

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikamardhapraharaṃ dine vargāṣṭakodayaḥ /
rātrau ca hrāsavṛddhyatra kecidāhurna ke'pi tu // 241
meaning:
एकैकमर्धप्रहरं दिने वर्गाष्टकोदयः /
रात्रौ च ह्रासवृद्ध्यत्र केचिदाहुर्न केऽपि तु // 241
text_mt: The arising of the eight classes occurs for half a watch each in the day, / and at night; here some speak of decrease and increase, but some do not.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa vargodayo rātrau divā cāpyardhayāmagaḥ /
prāṇatrayodaśaśatī pañcāśadadhikā ca sā // 242
meaning:
एष वर्गोदयो रात्रौ दिवा चाप्यर्धयामगः /
प्राणत्रयोदशशती पञ्चाशदधिका च सा // 242
text_mt: This arising of classes at night and during the day occurs in half a watch: / that is thirteen hundred and fifty breaths.

sanskrit_iast:
adhyardhā kila saṃkrāntirvarge varge divāniśoḥ /
tadaikye tūdayaścāraśatānāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ // 243
meaning:
अध्यर्धा किल संक्रान्तिर्वर्गे वर्गे दिवानिशोः /
तदैक्ये तूदयश्चारशतानां सप्तविंशतिः // 243
text_mt: In each class, day and night, there is indeed one and a half transitions; / in their union, the movement is the arising of twenty-seven hundred [breaths].

sanskrit_iast:
nava vargāṃstu ye prāhusteṣāṃ prāṇaśatī svīn[viḥ] /
satribhāgaiva saṃkrāntirvarge pratyekamucyate // 244
meaning:
नव वर्गांस्तु ये प्राहुस्तेषां प्राणशती स्वीन्[विः] /
सत्रिभागैव संक्रान्तिर्वर्गे प्रत्येकमुच्यते // 244
text_mt: For those who speak of nine classes, however, the breaths are twelve hundred; / in each class a transition with a third part is stated.

sanskrit_iast:
aharniśaṃ tadaikye tu śatānāṃ śruticakṣuṣī /
sthūlo vargodayaḥ so'yamathārṇodaya ucyate // 245
meaning:
अहर्निशं तदैक्ये तु शतानां श्रुतिचक्षुषी /
स्थूलो वर्गोदयः सोऽयमथार्णोदय उच्यते // 245
text_mt: In their union, day and night, there are twenty-four hundred [breaths]. / That is the gross arising of classes; now the arising of phonemes is stated:

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikavarṇe prāṇānāṃ dviśataṃ ṣoḍaśādhikam /
bahiścaṣakaṣaṭtriṃśaddina itthaṃ tathāniśi // 246
meaning:
एकैकवर्णे प्राणानां द्विशतं षोडशाधिकम् /
बहिश्चषकषट्त्रिंशद्दिन इत्थं तथानिशि // 246
text_mt: For each single phoneme there are two hundred and sixteen breaths / and thirty-six caṣakas externally; thus in the day and so at night.

sanskrit_iast:
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tatra raudraṃ śāktamathottaram /
yāmalasthitiyoge tu rudraśaktyavibhāgitā // 247
meaning:
शतमष्टोत्तरं तत्र रौद्रं शाक्तमथोत्तरम् /
यामलस्थितियोगे तु रुद्रशक्त्यविभागिता // 247
text_mt: There, one hundred and eight are terrible, and the next belong to śakti; / but in the union of the state of the dyad, there is non-differentiation of Rudra and śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
dinarātryavibhāge tu dṛgvahnyabdhyasucāraṇāḥ /
sapañcamāṃśā nāḍī ca bahirvarṇodayaḥ smṛtaḥ // 248
meaning:
दिनरात्र्यविभागे तु दृग्वह्न्यब्ध्यसुचारणाः /
सपञ्चमांशा नाडी च बहिर्वर्णोदयः स्मृतः // 248
text_mt: In the non-differentiation of day and night, the movements of breath are four hundred and thirty-two, / and a nāḍī with a fifth part is remembered as the external arising of a phoneme.

sanskrit_iast:
iti pañcāśikā seyaṃ varṇānāṃ paricarcitā /
ekonāṃ ye tu tāmāhustanmataṃ saṃpracakṣmahe // 249
meaning:
इति पञ्चाशिका सेयं वर्णानां परिचर्चिता /
एकोनां ये तु तामाहुस्तन्मतं संप्रचक्ष्महे // 249
text_mt: Thus has this set of fifty phonemes been discussed; / as for those who speak of forty-nine, we now set forth their view:

sanskrit_iast:
vedāścārāḥ pañcamāṃśanyūnaṃ cārārdhamekaśaḥ /
varṇe'dhikaṃ taddviguṇamavibhāge divāniśoḥ // 250
meaning:
वेदाश्चाराः पञ्चमांशन्यूनं चारार्धमेकशः /
वर्णेऽधिकं तद्द्विगुणमविभागे दिवानिशोः // 250
text_mt: Four movements, plus half a movement minus one-fifth, individually / in addition for each phoneme; twice that in the non-differentiation of day and night.

sanskrit_iast: sthūlo varṇodayaḥ so'yaṃ purā sūkṣmo nigadyate // 251
meaning: स्थूलो वर्णोदयः सोऽयं पुरा सूक्ष्मो निगद्यते // 251
text_mt: That is the gross arising of phonemes; the subtle one was stated earlier.

sanskrit_iast: iti kālatattvamuditaṃ śāstramukhāgamanijānubhavasiddham // 252
meaning: इति कालतत्त्वमुदितं शास्त्रमुखागमनिजानुभवसिद्धम् // 252
text_mt: Thus the principle of time has been expounded, established from the mouth of the scriptures, the Agamas, and personal experience.

sanskrit_iast: atha paramarahasyo'yaṃ cakrāṇāṃ bhaṇyate'bhyudayaḥ // 1
meaning: अथ परमरहस्योऽयं चक्राणां भण्यतेऽभ्युदयः // 1
text_mt: Now this supreme secret, the rising of the wheels, is declared.
title: Cakrodayaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
ityayatnajamākhyātaṃ yatnajaṃ tu nigadyate /
bījapiṇḍātmakaṃ sarvaṃ saṃvidaḥ spandanātmatām // 2
meaning:
इत्ययत्नजमाख्यातं यत्नजं तु निगद्यते /
बीजपिण्डात्मकं सर्वं संविदः स्पन्दनात्मताम् // 2
text_mt: Thus that which arises without effort has been explained; now, however, that which arises from effort is told, / which, consisting entirely of seed and cluster, brings about the dynamic vibration of consciousness // 2

sanskrit_iast:
vidadhatparasaṃvittāvupāya iti varṇitam /
yathāraghaṭṭacakrāgraghaṭīyantraughavāhanam // 3
meaning:
विदधत्परसंवित्तावुपाय इति वर्णितम् /
यथारघट्टचक्राग्रघटीयन्त्रौघवाहनम् // 3
text_mt: and is described as a means to supreme consciousness. / Just as the movement of the series of buckets at the rim of a waterwheel // 3

sanskrit_iast:
ekānusaṃdhiyatnena citraṃ yantrodayaṃ bhajet /
ekānusaṃdhānabalājjāte mantrodaye'niśam // 4
meaning:
एकानुसंधियत्नेन चित्रं यन्त्रोदयं भजेत् /
एकानुसंधानबलाज्जाते मन्त्रोदयेऽनिशम् // 4
text_mt: engages in a varied operation through the single effort of intention, / so when the rising of mantra occurs incessantly through the force of single intention, // 4

sanskrit_iast:
tanmantradevatā yatnāttādātmyena prasīdati /
khe rasaikākṣi nityotthe tadardhaṃ dvikapiṇḍake // 5
meaning:
तन्मन्त्रदेवता यत्नात्तादात्म्येन प्रसीदति /
खे रसैकाक्षि नित्योत्थे तदर्धं द्विकपिण्डके // 5
text_mt: the deity of that mantra is graciously revealed through effort by way of identity. / In the sky [of the heart], in the constant rising [of breath], it is twenty-one thousand six hundred; half of that is for a two-letter cluster; // 5

sanskrit_iast:
trike sapta sahasrāṇi dviśatītyudayo mataḥ /
catuṣke tu sahasrāṇi pañca caiva catuḥśatī // 6
meaning:
त्रिके सप्त सहस्राणि द्विशतीत्युदयो मतः /
चतुष्के तु सहस्राणि पञ्च चैव चतुःशती // 6
text_mt: for a triad, the rising is taught to be seven thousand two hundred; / but for a tetrad, it is five thousand four hundred; // 6

sanskrit_iast:
pañcārṇe'bdhisahasrāṇi triśatī viṃśatistathā /
ṣaṭke sahasratritayaṃ ṣaṭśatī codayo bhavet // 7
meaning:
पञ्चार्णेऽब्धिसहस्राणि त्रिशती विंशतिस्तथा /
षट्के सहस्रत्रितयं षट्शती चोदयो भवेत् // 7
text_mt: for a five-syllable [mantra], it is four thousand three hundred and twenty; / in a hexad, the rising would be three thousand six hundred; // 7

sanskrit_iast:
saptake trisahasraṃ tu ṣaḍaśītyadhikaṃ smṛtam /
śataistu saptaviṃśatyā varṇāṣṭakavikalpite // 8
meaning:
सप्तके त्रिसहस्रं तु षडशीत्यधिकं स्मृतम् /
शतैस्तु सप्तविंशत्या वर्णाष्टकविकल्पिते // 8
text_mt: in a heptad, it is recorded as three thousand and eighty-six; / and with twenty-seven hundred when arranged as an eight-syllable [mantra]; // 8

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatiśatyā tu navārṇeṣūdayo bhavet /
adhiṣaṣṭyekaviṃśatyā śatānāṃ daśavarṇake // 9
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिशत्या तु नवार्णेषूदयो भवेत् /
अधिषष्ट्येकविंशत्या शतानां दशवर्णके // 9
text_mt: in nine-syllable [mantras] the rising would be twenty-four hundred; / in a ten-syllable [mantra], it is twenty-one hundred and sixty; // 9

sanskrit_iast:
ekānnaviṃśatiśataṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ śivārṇake /
aṣṭādaśa śatāni syurudayo dvādaśārṇake // 10
meaning:
एकान्नविंशतिशतं चतुःषष्टिः शिवार्णके /
अष्टादश शतानि स्युरुदयो द्वादशार्णके // 10
text_mt: in an eleven-syllable [mantra], it is nineteen hundred and sixty-four; / in a twelve-syllable [mantra], there would be eighteen hundred risings; // 10

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśārṇe dvāṣaṣṭyā śatāni kila ṣoḍaśa /
tricatvāriṃśatā pañcadaśeti bhuvanārṇake // 11
meaning:
त्रयोदशार्णे द्वाषष्ट्या शतानि किल षोडश /
त्रिचत्वारिंशता पञ्चदशेति भुवनार्णके // 11
text_mt: in a thirteen-syllable [mantra], indeed, sixteen hundred and sixty-two; / in a fourteen-syllable [mantra], fifteen hundred and forty-three; // 11

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśaśatī khābdhiḥ syātpañcadaśavarṇake /
trayodaśaśatī sārdhā ṣoḍaśārṇe tu kathyate // 12
meaning:
चतुर्दशशती खाब्धिः स्यात्पञ्चदशवर्णके /
त्रयोदशशती सार्धा षोडशार्णे तु कथ्यते // 12
text_mt: in a fifteen-syllable [mantra], it would be fourteen hundred and forty; / but in a sixteen-syllable [mantra], it is said to be thirteen hundred and fifty; // 12

sanskrit_iast:
śatadvādaśikā saptadaśārṇe saikasaptatiḥ /
aṣṭādaśārṇe vijñeyā śatadvādaśikā budhaiḥ // 13
meaning:
शतद्वादशिका सप्तदशार्णे सैकसप्ततिः /
अष्टादशार्णे विज्ञेया शतद्वादशिका बुधैः // 13
text_mt: in a seventeen-syllable [mantra], it is twelve hundred and seventy-one; / in an eighteen-syllable [mantra], it should be known by the wise as twelve hundred; // 13

sanskrit_iast:
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyāke cakre navaśatī bhavet /
saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyāte tūdayo'ṣṭaśatātmakaḥ // 14
meaning:
चतुर्विंशतिसंख्याके चक्रे नवशती भवेत् /
सप्तविंशतिसंख्याते तूदयोऽष्टशतात्मकः // 14
text_mt: in a wheel of twenty-four, there would be nine hundred; / but in one reckoned as twenty-seven, the rising consists of eight hundred; // 14

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśake mahācakre ṣaṭśatī pañcasaptatiḥ /
dvicaturviṃśake cakre sārdhāṃ śatacatuṣṭayīm // 15
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशके महाचक्रे षट्शती पञ्चसप्ततिः /
द्विचतुर्विंशके चक्रे सार्धां शतचतुष्टयीम् // 15
text_mt: in the great wheel of thirty-two, it is six hundred and seventy-five; / in a wheel of forty-eight, four hundred and fifty: // 15

sanskrit_iast:
udayaṃ piṇḍayogajñaḥ piṇḍamantreṣu lakṣayet /
catuṣpañcāśake cakre śatānāṃ tu catuṣṭayam // 16
meaning:
उदयं पिण्डयोगज्ञः पिण्डमन्त्रेषु लक्षयेत् /
चतुष्पञ्चाशके चक्रे शतानां तु चतुष्टयम् // 16
text_mt: the knower of the union of clusters should observe this rising in cluster-mantras; / but in a wheel of fifty-four, it is four hundred; // 16

sanskrit_iast:
saptatriṃśatsahārdhena triśatyaṣṭāṣṭake bhavet /
ardhamardhatribhāgaśca ṣaṭṣaṣṭirdviśatī bhavet // 17
meaning:
सप्तत्रिंशत्सहार्धेन त्रिशत्यष्टाष्टके भवेत् /
अर्धमर्धत्रिभागश्च षट्षष्टिर्द्विशती भवेत् // 17
text_mt: in a sixty-four-[syllable wheel], it would be three hundred and thirty-seven and a half; / and two hundred and sixty-six and two-thirds; // 17

sanskrit_iast:
ekāśītipade cakre udayaḥ prāṇacāragaḥ /
cakre tu ṣaṇṇavatyākhye sapādā dviśatī bhavet // 18
meaning:
एकाशीतिपदे चक्रे उदयः प्राणचारगः /
चक्रे तु षण्णवत्याख्ये सपादा द्विशती भवेत् // 18
text_mt: in a wheel of eighty-one positions, the rising relates to the movement of vital breath; / while in the wheel called ninety-six, it would be two hundred and twenty-five; // 18

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśatastūdayo bhavet /
krameṇetthamidaṃ cakraṃ ṣaṭkṛtvo dviguṇaṃ yadā // 19
meaning:
अष्टोत्तरशते चक्रे द्विशतस्तूदयो भवेत् /
क्रमेणेत्थमिदं चक्रं षट्कृत्वो द्विगुणं यदा // 19
text_mt: in a wheel of one hundred and eight, the rising would be two hundred. / When this wheel, in this progressive manner, is doubled six times, // 19

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi dviguṇe'ṣṭāṃśasyārdhamadhyardhamekakam /
tato'pi sūkṣmakuśalairardhārdhādiprakalpane // 20
meaning:
ततोऽपि द्विगुणेऽष्टांशस्यार्धमध्यर्धमेककम् /
ततोऽपि सूक्ष्मकुशलैरर्धार्धादिप्रकल्पने // 20
text_mt: and then doubled beyond that, [the movement is] one, one and a half, of half of an eighth part; / and beyond that, when conceived by those skilled in the subtle as half-of-a-half and so on, // 20

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgaṣoḍaśakasthityā sūkṣmaścāro'bhilakṣyate /
evaṃ prayatnasaṃruddhaprāṇacārasya yoginaḥ // 21
meaning:
भागषोडशकस्थित्या सूक्ष्मश्चारोऽभिलक्ष्यते /
एवं प्रयत्नसंरुद्धप्राणचारस्य योगिनः // 21
text_mt: the subtle movement is observed to abide as a sixteenth part. / For the yogin whose movement of vital breath is restrained by effort in this way, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
krameṇa prāṇacārasya grāsa evopajāyate /
prāṇagrāsakramāvāptakālasaṃkarṣaṇasthitiḥ // 22
meaning:
क्रमेण प्राणचारस्य ग्रास एवोपजायते /
प्राणग्रासक्रमावाप्तकालसंकर्षणस्थितिः // 22
text_mt: there arises gradually the devourment of the movement of vital breath. / Having attained the state of the drawing together of time through the gradual devourment of breath, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvidekaiva pūrṇā syājjñānabhedavyapohanāt /
tathā hi prāṇacārasya navasyānudaye sati // 23
meaning:
संविदेकैव पूर्णा स्याज्ज्ञानभेदव्यपोहनात् /
तथा हि प्राणचारस्य नवस्यानुदये सति // 23
text_mt: consciousness alone becomes full, because the differentiation of cognition is eliminated. / For when a new movement of vital breath does not arise, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
na kālabhedajanito jñānabhedaḥ prakalpate /
saṃvedyabhedānna jñānaṃ bhinnaṃ śikharivṛttavat // 24
meaning:
न कालभेदजनितो ज्ञानभेदः प्रकल्पते /
संवेद्यभेदान्न ज्ञानं भिन्नं शिखरिवृत्तवत् // 24
text_mt: no differentiation of cognition produced by the differentiation of time is constructed. / Cognition is not divided by the division of knowable objects, as with the cognition of a mountain. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
kālastu bhedakastasya sa tu sūkṣmaḥ kṣaṇo mataḥ /
saukṣmyasya cāvadhirjñānaṃ yāvattiṣṭhati sa kṣaṇaḥ // 25
meaning:
कालस्तु भेदकस्तस्य स तु सूक्ष्मः क्षणो मतः /
सौक्ष्म्यस्य चावधिर्ज्ञानं यावत्तिष्ठति स क्षणः // 25
text_mt: Time, however, is what divides it; and that [time] is held to be the subtle instant. / And the limit of subtleness is the instant for which a cognition endures; // 25

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā na sa nirvaktuṃ nipuṇairapi pāryate /
jñānaṃ kiyadbhavettāvattadabhāvo na bhāsate // 26
meaning:
अन्यथा न स निर्वक्तुं निपुणैरपि पार्यते /
ज्ञानं कियद्भवेत्तावत्तदभावो न भासते // 26
text_mt: otherwise, even the skilled are not able to define it. / As long as a cognition may endure, its absence does not appear; // 26

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāvaśca no tāvadyāvattatrākṣavartmani /
arthe vātmapradeśe vā na saṃyogavibhāgitā // 27
meaning:
तदभावश्च नो तावद्यावत्तत्राक्षवर्त्मनि /
अर्थे वात्मप्रदेशे वा न संयोगविभागिता // 27
text_mt: and its absence does not occur as long as there is no conjunction or disjunction / in the pathway of the sense-faculties, in the object, or in a region of oneself. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
sā cedudayate spandamayī tatprāṇagā dhruvam /
bhavedeva tataḥ prāṇaspandābhāve na sā bhavet // 28
meaning:
सा चेदुदयते स्पन्दमयी तत्प्राणगा ध्रुवम् /
भवेदेव ततः प्राणस्पन्दाभावे न सा भवेत् // 28
text_mt: If that [conjunction or disjunction] arises, consisting of dynamic vibration, it must surely reside in vital breath; / therefore, in the absence of the dynamic vibration of vital breath, it would not exist. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāvānna vijñānābhāvaḥ saivaṃ tu saiva dhīḥ /
na cāsau vastuto dīrghā kālabhedavyapohanāt // 29
meaning:
तदभावान्न विज्ञानाभावः सैवं तु सैव धीः /
न चासौ वस्तुतो दीर्घा कालभेदव्यपोहनात् // 29
text_mt: In its absence, there is no absence of cognition; rather, the intellect remains just that. / Nor is this [cognition] in reality prolonged, because the differentiation of time has been eliminated; // 29

sanskrit_iast:
vastuto hyata eveyaṃ kālaṃ saṃvinna saṃspṛśet /
ata ekaiva saṃvittirnānārūpe tathātathā // 30
meaning:
वस्तुतो ह्यत एवेयं कालं संविन्न संस्पृशेत् /
अत एकैव संवित्तिर्नानारूपे तथातथा // 30
text_mt: for this very reason, in reality, consciousness does not touch time. / Therefore, consciousness is only one, though experiencing variously // 30

sanskrit_iast:
vindānā nirvikalpāpi vikalpo bhāvagocare /
spandāntaraṃ na yāvattaduditaṃ tāvadeva saḥ // 31
meaning:
विन्दाना निर्विकल्पापि विकल्पो भावगोचरे /
स्पन्दान्तरं न यावत्तदुदितं तावदेव सः // 31
text_mt: in diverse forms, and even though non-conceptual, it is a conceptual construct in the realm of entities. / As long as another dynamic vibration has not arisen, for that long alone // 31

sanskrit_iast:
tāvāneko vikalpaḥ syādvividhaṃ vastu kalpayan /
ye tvitthaṃ na vidusteṣāṃ vikalpo nopapadyate // 32
meaning:
तावानेको विकल्पः स्याद्विविधं वस्तु कल्पयन् /
ये त्वित्थं न विदुस्तेषां विकल्पो नोपपद्यते // 32
text_mt: it remains a single conceptual construct constructing various things. / But for those who do not understand it thus, a conceptual construct is not tenable; // 32

sanskrit_iast:
sa hyeko na bhavetkaścit trijagatyāpi jātucit /
śabdārūṣaṇayā jñānaṃ vikalpaḥ kila kathyate // 33
meaning:
स ह्येको न भवेत्कश्चित् त्रिजगत्यापि जातुचित् /
शब्दारूषणया ज्ञानं विकल्पः किल कथ्यते // 33
text_mt: for no single [construct] would ever exist even in the three worlds. / A cognition is said to be a conceptual construct because it is permeated by words, // 33

sanskrit_iast:
sā ca syātkramikaivetthaṃ kiṃ kathaṃ ko vikalpayet /
ghaṭa ityapi neyānsyādvikalpaḥ kā kathā sthitau // 34
meaning:
सा च स्यात्क्रमिकैवेत्थं किं कथं को विकल्पयेत् /
घट इत्यपि नेयान्स्याद्विकल्पः का कथा स्थितौ // 34
text_mt: and that [verbalisation] must occur only in succession; thus, what would anyone conceptualise, and how? / Even ‘pot’ would not be this [single] conceptual construct—what to say of its continuity? // 34

sanskrit_iast:
na vikalpaśca ko'pyasti yo mātrāmātraniṣṭhitaḥ /
na ca jñānasamūho'sti teṣāmayugapatsthiteḥ // 35
meaning:
न विकल्पश्च कोऽप्यस्ति यो मात्रामात्रनिष्ठितः /
न च ज्ञानसमूहोऽस्ति तेषामयुगपत्स्थितेः // 35
text_mt: And there is no conceptual construct that rests on merely a single instant; / nor is there an aggregate of cognitions, because they do not exist simultaneously. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
tenāstaṅgata evaiṣa vyavahāro vikalpajaḥ /
tasmātspandāntaraṃ yāvannodiyāttāvadekakam // 36
meaning:
तेनास्तङ्गत एवैष व्यवहारो विकल्पजः /
तस्मात्स्पन्दान्तरं यावन्नोदियात्तावदेककम् // 36
text_mt: Therefore, this conventional transaction born of conceptual constructs would completely vanish. / Hence, as long as another dynamic vibration does not arise, for that long a single // 36

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānaṃ tadvikalpātmadharmakoṭīrapi spṛśet /
ekāśītipadodāraśaktyāmarśātmakastataḥ // 37
meaning:
विज्ञानं तद्विकल्पात्मधर्मकोटीरपि स्पृशेत् /
एकाशीतिपदोदारशक्त्यामर्शात्मकस्ततः // 37
text_mt: cognition, though of the nature of a conceptual construct, touches even millions of properties. / Therefore, the conceptual construct whose nature is the reflective awareness of power, sublime with eighty-one positions, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpaḥ śivatādāyī pūrvameva nirūpitaḥ /
yathā karṇau nartayāmītyevaṃ yatnāttathā bhavet // 38
meaning:
विकल्पः शिवतादायी पूर्वमेव निरूपितः /
यथा कर्णौ नर्तयामीत्येवं यत्नात्तथा भवेत् // 38
text_mt: which bestows the state of Śiva, has already been explained. / Just as [one thinks] ‘I will move my ears’ and it happens thus through effort, // 38

sanskrit_iast:
cakracāragatādyatnāttadvattaccakragaiva dhīḥ /
japahomārcanādīnāṃ prāṇasāmyamato vidhiḥ // 39
meaning:
चक्रचारगताद्यत्नात्तद्वत्तच्चक्रगैव धीः /
जपहोमार्चनादीनां प्राणसाम्यमतो विधिः // 39
text_mt: so through the initial effort directed toward the movement of the wheel, the intellect conforms to that wheel. / Therefore the rule for recitation, oblations, worship, and the like is the equilibrium of vital breath. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāmate kuṇḍalinīśaktiḥ prāṇasamonmanā /
uktaṃ ca yoginīkaule tadetatparameśinā // 40
meaning:
सिद्धामते कुण्डलिनीशक्तिः प्राणसमोन्मना /
उक्तं च योगिनीकौले तदेतत्परमेशिना // 40
text_mt: In the Siddhāmata, the kuṇḍalinī power is the Unminded equal to vital breath. / And this was stated by the Supreme Lord in the Yoginīkaula: // 40

sanskrit_iast:
padamantrākṣare cakre vibhāgaṃ śaktitattvagam /
padeṣu kṛtvā mantrajño japādau phalabhāgbhavet // 41
meaning:
पदमन्त्राक्षरे चक्रे विभागं शक्तितत्त्वगम् /
पदेषु कृत्वा मन्त्रज्ञो जपादौ फलभाग्भवेत् // 41
text_mt: ‘Having made the division pertaining to the principle of power in the wheel of words, mantras, and syllables, / into words, the knower of mantra partakes of the fruit in recitation and the like. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
dvitrisaptāṣṭasaṃkhyātaṃ lopayecchatikodayam /
iti śaktisthitā mantrā vidyā vā cakranāyakāḥ // 42
meaning:
द्वित्रिसप्ताष्टसंख्यातं लोपयेच्छतिकोदयम् /
इति शक्तिस्थिता मन्त्रा विद्या वा चक्रनायकाः // 42
text_mt: One should cause the rising of hundreds counted as two, three, seven, and eight to vanish; / thus mantras abiding in power, or vidyās, the lords of the wheel, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
padapiṇḍasvarūpeṇa jñātvā yojyāḥ sadā priye /
nityodaye mahātattve udayasthe sadāśive // 43
meaning:
पदपिण्डस्वरूपेण ज्ञात्वा योज्याः सदा प्रिये /
नित्योदये महातत्त्वे उदयस्थे सदाशिवे // 43
text_mt: having been understood in the nature of word and cluster, should always be united, O beloved, / in the constantly rising great principle, in Sadāśiva who abides in the rising. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
ayuktāḥ śaktimārge tu na japtāścodayena ye /
te na siddhyanti yatnena japtāḥ koṭiśatairapi // 44
meaning:
अयुक्ताः शक्तिमार्गे तु न जप्ताश्चोदयेन ये /
ते न सिद्ध्यन्ति यत्नेन जप्ताः कोटिशतैरपि // 44
text_mt: Those which are not united on the path of power and not recited with the rising / do not succeed through effort, even when recited hundreds of millions of times. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
mālāmantreṣu sarveṣu mānaso japa ucyate /
upāṃśurvā śaktyudayaṃ teṣāṃ na parikalpayet // 45
meaning:
मालामन्त्रेषु सर्वेषु मानसो जप उच्यते /
उपांशुर्वा शक्त्युदयं तेषां न परिकल्पयेत् // 45
text_mt: Mental recitation is taught for all rosary-mantras, / or whispered; one should not construct a rising of power for them. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
padamantreṣu sarveṣu yāvattatpadaśaktigam /
śakyate satataṃ yuktaistāvajjapyaṃ tu sādhakaiḥ // 46
meaning:
पदमन्त्रेषु सर्वेषु यावत्तत्पदशक्तिगम् /
शक्यते सततं युक्तैस्तावज्जप्यं तु साधकैः // 46
text_mt: In all word-mantras, as far as it reaches the power of that word, / adepts should recite as long as they are able, being constantly united; // 46

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatī teṣu vai saṃkhyā padeṣu padasaṃjñitā /
tāvantamudayaṃ kṛtvā tripadoktyāditaḥ kramāt // 47
meaning:
तावती तेषु वै संख्या पदेषु पदसंज्ञिता /
तावन्तमुदयं कृत्वा त्रिपदोक्त्यादितः क्रमात् // 47
text_mt: that is indeed the number in them designated by the word “pada”; / having performed that rising, gradually, beginning with the pronunciation of three words, // 47

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśākhye dvādaśite cakre sārdhaṃ śataṃ bhavet /
udayastaddhi sacatuścatvāriṃśacchataṃ bhavet // 48
meaning:
द्वादशाख्ये द्वादशिते चक्रे सार्धं शतं भवेत् /
उदयस्तद्धि सचतुश्चत्वारिंशच्छतं भवेत् // 48
text_mt: in the wheel called twelve, divided into twelve, there would be one hundred and fifty; / that rising would indeed be one hundred and forty-four.’ // 48

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśākhye dvādaśite dvānavatyadhike śate /
cārārdhena samaṃ proktaṃ śataṃ dvādaśakādhikam // 49
meaning:
षोडशाख्ये द्वादशिते द्वानवत्यधिके शते /
चारार्धेन समं प्रोक्तं शतं द्वादशकाधिकम् // 49
text_mt: In the twelvefold [division] of the sixteen-spoked [wheel], it is one hundred ninety-two; / along with half a movement, it is stated to be one hundred twelve.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśākhye ṣoḍaśite bhaveccaturaśītigaḥ /
udayo dviśataṃ taddhi ṣaṭpañcāśatsamuttaram // 50
meaning:
षोडशाख्ये षोडशिते भवेच्चतुरशीतिगः /
उदयो द्विशतं तद्धि षट्पञ्चाशत्समुत्तरम् // 50
text_mt: In the sixteenfold [division] of the sixteen-spoked [wheel], the rising consists of eighty-four; / that indeed becomes two hundred fifty-six.

sanskrit_iast:
cārāṣṭabhāgāṃstrīnatra kathayantyadhikānbudhāḥ /
aṣṭāṣṭake dvādaśite pādārdhaṃ viṃśatiṃ vasūn // 51
meaning:
चाराष्टभागांस्त्रीनत्र कथयन्त्यधिकान्बुधाः /
अष्टाष्टके द्वादशिते पादार्धं विंशतिं वसून् // 51
text_mt: Here the wise declare three eighths of a movement as surplus. / In the twelvefold [division] of the sixty-four [wheel], there are eight, twenty, and half a quarter [820.5];

sanskrit_iast:
udayaḥ saptaśatikā sāṣṭā ṣaṣṭiryato hi saḥ /
eṣa cakrodayaḥ proktaḥ sādhakānāṃ hitāvahaḥ // 52
meaning:
उदयः सप्तशतिका साष्टा षष्टिर्यतो हि सः /
एष चक्रोदयः प्रोक्तः साधकानां हितावहः // 52
text_mt: for the rising is seven hundred sixty-eight. / This rising of the wheels has been proclaimed, bringing benefit to adepts.

sanskrit_iast:
niruddhya mānasīrvṛttīścakre viśrāntimāgataḥ /
vyutthāya yāvadviśrāmyettāvaccārodayo hyayam // 53
meaning:
निरुद्ध्य मानसीर्वृत्तीश्चक्रे विश्रान्तिमागतः /
व्युत्थाय यावद्विश्राम्येत्तावच्चारोदयो ह्ययम् // 53
text_mt: Having restrained the mental activities, one arrives at rest in the wheel; / emerging, for as long as one rests, just so long indeed is this rising of the movement.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe samudaye tvatra praveśaikātmyanirgamāḥ /
traya ityata evoktaḥ siddhau madhyodayo varaḥ // 54
meaning:
पूर्णे समुदये त्वत्र प्रवेशैकात्म्यनिर्गमाः /
त्रय इत्यत एवोक्तः सिद्धौ मध्योदयो वरः // 54
text_mt: In the complete rising, however, there are here three: entry, absorption, and egress; / for this very reason it is taught that in achieving accomplishment, the middle rising is best.

sanskrit_iast:
ādyantodayanirmuktā madhyamodayasaṃyutāḥ /
mantravidyācakragaṇāḥ siddhibhājo bhavanti hi // 55
meaning:
आद्यन्तोदयनिर्मुक्ता मध्यमोदयसंयुताः /
मन्त्रविद्याचक्रगणाः सिद्धिभाजो भवन्ति हि // 55
text_mt: Free from the initial and final risings, and endowed with the middle rising, / the assemblies of the wheels of mantras and vidyās indeed partake of accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
mantracakrodayajñastu vidyācakrodayārthavit /
kṣipraṃ siddhyediti proktaṃ śrīmaddviṃśatike trike // 56
meaning:
मन्त्रचक्रोदयज्ञस्तु विद्याचक्रोदयार्थवित् /
क्षिप्रं सिद्ध्येदिति प्रोक्तं श्रीमद्द्विंशतिके त्रिके // 56
text_mt: One who knows the rising of the mantra-wheel, however, and knows the meaning of the rising of the vidyā-wheel / is said to achieve spiritual accomplishment swiftly in the venerable Triṃśikā-Trika.

sanskrit_iast:
dvistriścaturvā mātrābhirvidyāṃ vā cakrameva vā /
tattvodayayutaṃ nityaṃ pṛthagbhūtaṃ japetsadā // 57
meaning:
द्विस्त्रिश्चतुर्वा मात्राभिर्विद्यां वा चक्रमेव वा /
तत्त्वोदययुतं नित्यं पृथग्भूतं जपेत्सदा // 57
text_mt: Whether by two, three, or four measures (mātrā), the vidyā or the wheel / should always be recited individually, united constantly with the rising of the principles (tattva).

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍākṣarapadairmantramekaikaṃ śaktitattvagam /
bahvakṣarastu yo mantro vidyā vā cakrameva vā // 58
meaning:
पिण्डाक्षरपदैर्मन्त्रमेकैकं शक्तितत्त्वगम् /
बह्वक्षरस्तु यो मन्त्रो विद्या वा चक्रमेव वा // 58
text_mt: The mantra consisting of a single cluster of syllables reaches into the principle of power (śaktitattva); / but the mantra consisting of many syllables, or a vidyā, or a wheel,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktisthaṃ naiva taṃ tatra vibhāgastvoṃnamontagaḥ /
asmiṃstattvodaye tasmādahorātrastriśastriśaḥ // 59
meaning:
शक्तिस्थं नैव तं तत्र विभागस्त्वोंनमोन्तगः /
अस्मिंस्तत्त्वोदये तस्मादहोरात्रस्त्रिशस्त्रिशः // 59
text_mt: does not abide purely in power, for the division terminates in 'oṃ namaḥ'. / In this rising of the principles, therefore, day and night are divided threefold, threefold;

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajyate vibhāgaśca punareva triśastriśaḥ /
pūrvodaye tu viśramya dvitīyenollasedyadā // 60
meaning:
विभज्यते विभागश्च पुनरेव त्रिशस्त्रिशः /
पूर्वोदये तु विश्रम्य द्वितीयेनोल्लसेद्यदा // 60
text_mt: and each division is once again divided threefold, threefold. / Resting in the prior rising, when it blazes forth through the second,

sanskrit_iast:
viśeccārdhardhikāyogāttadoktārdhodayo bhavet /
yadā pūrṇodayātmā tu samaḥ kālastrike sphuret // 61
meaning:
विशेच्चार्धर्धिकायोगात्तदोक्तार्धोदयो भवेत् /
यदा पूर्णोदयात्मा तु समः कालस्त्रिके स्फुरेत् // 61
text_mt: and enters by the junction of increasing halves, then occurs the stated half-rising. / When, however, time shines uniform as the essence of the complete rising in the Trika,

sanskrit_iast:
praveśaviśrāntyullāse syātsvatryaṃśodayastadā /
etyeṣa kālavibhavaḥ prāṇa eva pratiṣṭhitaḥ // 62
meaning:
प्रवेशविश्रान्त्युल्लासे स्यात्स्वत्र्यंशोदयस्तदा /
एत्येष कालविभवः प्राण एव प्रतिष्ठितः // 62
text_mt: in entry, rest, and blazing forth, then there occurs the rising of its own three parts. / In this way, this majesty of time is grounded solely in the breath.

sanskrit_iast:
sa spade khe sa taccityāṃ tenāsyāṃ viśvaniṣṭhiatiḥ /
ataḥ saṃvitpratiṣṭhānau yato viśvalayodayau // 63
meaning:
स स्पदे खे स तच्चित्यां तेनास्यां विश्वनिष्ठिअतिः /
अतः संवित्प्रतिष्ठानौ यतो विश्वलयोदयौ // 63
text_mt: That [breath] is in pulsation (spanda), that in the void (kha), that in consciousness; through that, the universe is established in this [consciousness]. / Therefore, the dissolution and rising of the universe are grounded in consciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyante'dhvani tatspandāsaṃkhyātā vāstavī tataḥ /
uktaṃ śrīmālinītantre gātre yatraiva kutracit // 64
meaning:
शक्त्यन्तेऽध्वनि तत्स्पन्दासंख्याता वास्तवी ततः /
उक्तं श्रीमालिनीतन्त्रे गात्रे यत्रैव कुत्रचित् // 64
text_mt: hence, at the end of power on the path, its pulsation is countless and real. / In the venerable Mālinītantra it is stated: wherever in the body

sanskrit_iast:
vikāra upajāyeta tattattvaṃ tattvamuttamam /
prāṇe pratiṣṭhitaḥ kālastadāviṣṭā ca yattanuḥ // 65
meaning:
विकार उपजायेत तत्तत्त्वं तत्त्वमुत्तमम् /
प्राणे प्रतिष्ठितः कालस्तदाविष्टा च यत्तनुः // 65
