text_mt: a modification arises, that principle is the supreme principle. / Time is established in the breath, and the body is pervaded by it;

sanskrit_iast:
dehe pratiṣṭhitasyāsya tato rūpaṃ nirūpyate /
citspandaprāṇavṛttīnāmantyā yā sthūlatā suṣiḥ // 66
meaning:
देहे प्रतिष्ठितस्यास्य ततो रूपं निरूप्यते /
चित्स्पन्दप्राणवृत्तीनामन्त्या या स्थूलता सुषिः // 66
text_mt: therefore its form as grounded in the body is now described. / The ultimate grossness, the hollow cavity, of the pulsations of consciousness and the activities of breath,

sanskrit_iast:
sā nāḍīrūpatāmetya dehaṃ saṃtānayedimam /
śrīsvacchande'ta evoktaṃ yathā parṇaṃ svatantubhiḥ // 67
meaning:
सा नाडीरूपतामेत्य देहं संतानयेदिमम् /
श्रीस्वच्छन्देऽत एवोक्तं यथा पर्णं स्वतन्तुभिः // 67
text_mt: assuming the form of channels (nāḍī), weaves this body together. / Therefore in the venerable Svacchanda it is said: just as a leaf is pervaded by its own veins,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptaṃ tadvattanurdvāradvāribhāvena nāḍibhiḥ /
pādāṅguṣṭhādikordhvasthabrahmakuṇḍalikāntagaḥ // 68
meaning:
व्याप्तं तद्वत्तनुर्द्वारद्वारिभावेन नाडिभिः /
पादाङ्गुष्ठादिकोर्ध्वस्थब्रह्मकुण्डलिकान्तगः // 68
text_mt: so the body is pervaded by the channels in the relation of gateways and that which passes through them. / Ranging from the big toe and the like up to the high-seated brahmakuṇḍalikā,

sanskrit_iast:
kālaḥ samastaścaturaśītāvevāṅguleṣvitaḥ /
dvādaśāntāvadhiṃ kiṃcitsūkṣmakālasthitiṃ viduḥ // 69
meaning:
कालः समस्तश्चतुरशीतावेवाङ्गुलेष्वितः /
द्वादशान्तावधिं किंचित्सूक्ष्मकालस्थितिं विदुः // 69
text_mt: the entirety of time extends precisely over eighty-four finger-breadths. / Beyond this, extending up to the dvādaśānta, they know the subtle state of time to be somewhat [different].

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇṇavatyāmadhaḥ ṣaḍdvikramāccāṣṭottaraṃ śatam /
atra madhyamasaṃcāriprāṇodayalayāntare // 70
meaning:
षण्णवत्यामधः षड्द्विक्रमाच्चाष्टोत्तरं शतम् /
अत्र मध्यमसंचारिप्राणोदयलयान्तरे // 70
text_mt: In ninety-six [finger-breadths], downwards, in the order of six and two, it is one hundred and eight. / Here, within the interval of the rising and dissolution of the breath moving in the central channel,

sanskrit_iast:
viśve sṛṣṭilayāste tu citrā vāyvantarakramāt /
ityeṣa sūkṣmaparimarśanaśīlanīyaścakrodayo'nubhavaśāstradṛśā mayoktaḥ // 71
meaning:
विश्वे सृष्टिलयास्ते तु चित्रा वाय्वन्तरक्रमात् /
इत्येष सूक्ष्मपरिमर्शनशीलनीयश्चक्रोदयोऽनुभवशास्त्रदृशा मयोक्तः // 71
text_mt: the diverse emissions and dissolutions of the universe take place according to the succession of internal winds. / In this manner, this rising of the wheels, which is to be practiced through subtle reflective awareness, has been expounded by me through the vision of experiential scriptures.

sanskrit_iast: deśādhvano'pyatha samāsavikāsayogātsaṃgīyate vidhirayaṃ śivaśāstradṛṣṭaḥ // 1
meaning: देशाध्वनोऽप्यथ समासविकासयोगात्संगीयते विधिरयं शिवशास्त्रदृष्टः // 1
text_mt: Next, this rule regarding the spatial path seen in Śiva's scriptures is proclaimed through the conjunction of synthesis and expansion.
title: Deśādhvaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
vicārito'yaṃ kālādhvā kriyāśaktimayaḥ prabhoḥ /
mūrtivaicitryajastajjo deśādhvātha nirūpyate // 2
meaning:
विचारितोऽयं कालाध्वा क्रियाशक्तिमयः प्रभोः /
मूर्तिवैचित्र्यजस्तज्जो देशाध्वाथ निरूप्यते // 2
text_mt: This temporal path, consisting of the Lord's power of action, has been examined; / now the spatial path, born from it and produced from the diversity of forms, is described.

sanskrit_iast:
adhvā samasta evāyaṃ cinmātre saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ /
yattatra nahi viśrāntaṃ tannabhaḥkusumāyate // 3
meaning:
अध्वा समस्त एवायं चिन्मात्रे संप्रतिष्ठितः /
यत्तत्र नहि विश्रान्तं तन्नभःकुसुमायते // 3
text_mt: This entire path is grounded solely in pure consciousness. / Whatever does not rest therein is like a flower in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃviddvāreṇa tatsṛṣṭe śūnye dhiyi marutsu ca /
nāḍīcakrānucakreṣu bahirdehe'dhvasaṃsthitiḥ // 4
meaning:
संविद्द्वारेण तत्सृष्टे शून्ये धियि मरुत्सु च /
नाडीचक्रानुचक्रेषु बहिर्देहेऽध्वसंस्थितिः // 4
text_mt: Through consciousness, the path is situated in the void, the intellect, the winds created by it, / in the channels, wheels, and subsidiary wheels, and externally in the body.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādhvaivaṃ nirūpyo'yaṃ yatastatprakriyākramam /
anusaṃdadhadeva drāg yogī bhairavatāṃ vrajet // 5
meaning:
तत्राध्वैवं निरूप्योऽयं यतस्तत्प्रक्रियाक्रमम् /
अनुसंदधदेव द्राग् योगी भैरवतां व्रजेत् // 5
text_mt: There, this path is to be investigated in such a manner because, by continuously contemplating its orderly scheme, / the yogi rapidly attains the state of Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
didṛkṣayaiva sarvārthān yadā vyāpyāvatiṣṭhate /
tadā kiṃ bahunoktena ityuktaṃ spandaśāsane // 6
meaning:
दिदृक्षयैव सर्वार्थान् यदा व्याप्यावतिष्ठते /
तदा किं बहुनोक्तेन इत्युक्तं स्पन्दशासने // 6
text_mt: As is stated in the teachings on Spanda: 'When one stands pervading all things merely by the desire to perceive [them], / then what is the use of speaking much?'

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā samastamadhvānaṃ tadīśeṣu vilāpayet /
tān dehaprāṇadhīcakre pūrvavad gālayetkramāt // 7
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा समस्तमध्वानं तदीशेषु विलापयेत् /
तान् देहप्राणधीचक्रे पूर्ववद् गालयेत्क्रमात् // 7
text_mt: Having known the entire path, one should dissolve it into its lords; / these one should gradually dissolve, as before, into the wheel of body, breath, and intellect.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamastaṃ svasaṃvittau sā saṃvidbharitātmikā /
upāsyamānā saṃsārasāgarapralayānalaḥ // 8
meaning:
तत्समस्तं स्वसंवित्तौ सा संविद्भरितात्मिका /
उपास्यमाना संसारसागरप्रलयानलः // 8
text_mt: All that is [then dissolved] into one's own consciousness; that consciousness, full in its essence, / when contemplated, is the fire of cosmic dissolution for the ocean of cyclic existence (saṃsāra).

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmahīkṣottare caitānadhveśān gururabravīt /
brahmānantātpradhānāntaṃ viṣṇuḥ puṃsaḥ kalāntagam // 9
meaning:
श्रीमहीक्षोत्तरे चैतानध्वेशान् गुरुरब्रवीत् /
ब्रह्मानन्तात्प्रधानान्तं विष्णुः पुंसः कलान्तगम् // 9
text_mt: And in the venerable Mahīkṣottara the guru declared these lords of the path: / Brahmā from Ananta up to Pradhāna; Viṣṇu ranges from the soul up to kalā;

sanskrit_iast:
rudro granthau ca māyāyāmīśaḥ sādākhyagocare /
anāśritaḥ śivastasmādvyāptā tadvyāpakaḥ paraḥ // 10
meaning:
रुद्रो ग्रन्थौ च मायायामीशः सादाख्यगोचरे /
अनाश्रितः शिवस्तस्माद्व्याप्ता तद्व्यापकः परः // 10
text_mt: Rudra is in the knot and in Māyā; Īśa is in the sphere of Sadāśiva; / Śiva is Anāśrita; beyond that is the supreme pervader which encompasses it.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śivatvamāpannamiti matvā nyarūpyata /
na prakriyāparaṃ jñānamiti svacchandaśāsane // 11
meaning:
एवं शिवत्वमापन्नमिति मत्वा न्यरूप्यत /
न प्रक्रियापरं ज्ञानमिति स्वच्छन्दशासने // 11
text_mt: Having considered that it has thus attained Śiva-hood, it was determined; / for in the doctrine of the Svacchanda it is said: 'Knowledge is not superior to the cosmic order (prakriyā).'

sanskrit_iast:
triśiraḥśāsane bodho mūlamadhyāgrakalpitaḥ /
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṃrambhaḥ smṛtirbhedavikalpanā // 12
meaning:
त्रिशिरःशासने बोधो मूलमध्याग्रकल्पितः /
षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वसंरम्भः स्मृतिर्भेदविकल्पना // 12
text_mt: In the teachings of the Triśirobhairava, consciousness is conceived as root, middle, and tip: / the energetic arousal of the thirty-six principles is memory and differentiated conceptualisation.

sanskrit_iast:
avyāhatavibhāgo'smibhāvo mūlaṃ tu bodhagam /
samastatattvabhāvo'yaṃ svātmanyevāvibhāgakaḥ // 13
meaning:
अव्याहतविभागोऽस्मिभावो मूलं तु बोधगम् /
समस्ततत्त्वभावोऽयं स्वात्मन्येवाविभागकः // 13
text_mt: The unimpeded sense of 'I am' is the root belonging to consciousness; / this existence of all principles is undivided within one's own self alone.

sanskrit_iast:
bodhamadhyaṃ bhavetkiṃcidādhārādheyalakṣaṇam /
tattvabhedavibhāgena svabhāvasthitilakṣaṇam // 14
meaning:
बोधमध्यं भवेत्किंचिदाधाराधेयलक्षणम् /
तत्त्वभेदविभागेन स्वभावस्थितिलक्षणम् // 14
text_mt: The middle of consciousness has the character of somewhat [distinguished] container and contained; / it is characterised by abiding in one's own nature through the differentiation of principles.

sanskrit_iast:
bodhāgraṃ tattu vidbodhaṃ nistaraṅgaṃ bṛhatsukham /
saṃvidekātmatānītabhūtabhāvapurādikaḥ // 15
meaning:
बोधाग्रं तत्तु विद्बोधं निस्तरङ्गं बृहत्सुखम् /
संविदेकात्मतानीतभूतभावपुरादिकः // 15
text_mt: The tip of consciousness, however, is pure awakening, wave-free, immense bliss, / in which physical elements, states, worlds, and the like are brought into identity with consciousness;

sanskrit_iast:
avyavacchinnasaṃvittirbhairavaḥ parameśvaraḥ /
śrīdevyāyāmale coktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasundaram // 16
meaning:
अव्यवच्छिन्नसंवित्तिर्भैरवः परमेश्वरः /
श्रीदेव्यायामले चोक्तं षट्त्रिंशत्तत्त्वसुन्दरम् // 16
text_mt: it is unfragmented consciousness, Bhairava, the Supreme Lord. / And in the venerable Devyāyāmala it is stated: 'Beautiful with the thirty-six principles,

sanskrit_iast:
adhvānaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ dhyāyansadyaḥ śivamayo bhavet /
yadyapyamuṣya nāthasya saṃvittyanatirekiṇaḥ // 17
meaning:
अध्वानं षड्विधं ध्यायन्सद्यः शिवमयो भवेत् /
यद्यप्यमुष्य नाथस्य संवित्त्यनतिरेकिणः // 17
text_mt: meditating on the sixfold path, one immediately becomes identical with Śiva.' / Although for this Lord, who does not transcend consciousness

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇasyordhvādimadhyāntavyavasthā nāsti vāstavī /
tathāpi pratipattṝṇāṃ pratipādayitustathā // 18
meaning:
पूर्णस्योर्ध्वादिमध्यान्तव्यवस्था नास्ति वास्तवी /
तथापि प्रतिपत्तॄणां प्रतिपादयितुस्तथा // 18
text_mt: and is full, there is no real arrangement of above, middle, end, and so forth, / nevertheless, for learners as well as for the teacher,

sanskrit_iast:
svasvarūpānusāreṇa madhyāditvādikalpanāḥ /
tataḥ pramātṛsaṃkalpaniyamāt pārthivaṃ viduḥ // 19
meaning:
स्वस्वरूपानुसारेण मध्यादित्वादिकल्पनाः /
ततः प्रमातृसंकल्पनियमात् पार्थिवं विदुः // 19
text_mt: conceptions such as middle and the rest are made according to their own nature. / Therefore, by the restriction of the knower's intention, they know the earthly

sanskrit_iast:
tattvaṃ sarvāntarālasthaṃ yatsarvāvaraṇairvṛtam /
tadatra pārthive tattve kathyate bhuvanasthitiḥ // 20
meaning:
तत्त्वं सर्वान्तरालस्थं यत्सर्वावरणैर्वृतम् /
तदत्र पार्थिवे तत्त्वे कथ्यते भुवनस्थितिः // 20
text_mt: principle to be situated in the interior of all, covered by all envelopes. / Now, the arrangement of worlds in this earthly principle is explained.

sanskrit_iast:
netā kaṭāharudrāṇāmanantaḥ kāmasevinām /
potārūḍho jalasyāntarmadyapānavighūrṇitaḥ // 21
meaning:
नेता कटाहरुद्राणामनन्तः कामसेविनाम् /
पोतारूढो जलस्यान्तर्मद्यपानविघूर्णितः // 21
text_mt: The leader of the Kaṭāha-Rudras, Ananta, of those who pursue desires, / mounted on a boat in the midst of the water, reelingly drunk from drinking wine,

sanskrit_iast:
sa devaṃ bhairavaṃ dhyāyan nāgaiśca parivāritaḥ /
kālāgrerbhuvanaṃ cordhve koṭiyojanamucchritam // 22
meaning:
स देवं भैरवं ध्यायन् नागैश्च परिवारितः /
कालाग्रेर्भुवनं चोर्ध्वे कोटियोजनमुच्छ्रितम् // 22
text_mt: he, surrounded by serpents, meditates on the god Bhairava; / and above is the world of Kālāgni, rising to a height of one crore yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
lokānāṃ bhasmasādbhāvabhayānnordhva sa vīkṣate /
sa ca vyāptāpi viśvasya yasmātpluṣyannimāṃ bhuvam // 23
meaning:
लोकानां भस्मसाद्भावभयान्नोर्ध्व स वीक्षते /
स च व्याप्तापि विश्वस्य यस्मात्प्लुष्यन्निमां भुवम् // 23
text_mt: For fear of turning the worlds to ashes, he does not look upward; / and even though he permeates the universe, because scorching this earth

sanskrit_iast:
narakebhyaḥ purā vyaktastenāsau tadadho mataḥ /
daśa koṭyo vibhorjvālā tadardha śūnyamūrdhvataḥ // 24
meaning:
नरकेभ्यः पुरा व्यक्तस्तेनासौ तदधो मतः /
दश कोट्यो विभोर्ज्वाला तदर्ध शून्यमूर्ध्वतः // 24
text_mt: he was manifested before the hells, therefore he is considered to be below them. / The lord's flame is ten crores [of leagues]; half of that, above, is empty space.

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhve narakādhīśāḥ kramādduḥkhaikavedanāḥ /
śdho madhye tadūrdhve ca sthitā bhedāntarairvṛtāḥ // 25
meaning:
तदूर्ध्वे नरकाधीशाः क्रमाद्दुःखैकवेदनाः /
श्धो मध्ये तदूर्ध्वे च स्थिता भेदान्तरैर्वृताः // 25
text_mt: Above that are the lords of hell, whose sole experience in succession is suffering; / stationed below, in the middle, and above it, surrounded by further divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
avīcikumbhīpākākhyarauravāsteṣvanukramāt /
ekādaśaikādaśa ca daśetyantaḥ śarāgni tat // 26
meaning:
अवीचिकुम्भीपाकाख्यरौरवास्तेष्वनुक्रमात् /
एकादशैकादश च दशेत्यन्तः शराग्नि तत् // 26
text_mt: Among them, in succession, are those named Avīci, Kumbhīpāka, and Raurava: / eleven, eleven, and ten, so within them are thirty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekameṣāmekonā koṭirucchritirantaram /
lakṣamatra khavedāsyasaṃkhyānāmantarā sthitiḥ // 27
meaning:
प्रत्येकमेषामेकोना कोटिरुच्छ्रितिरन्तरम् /
लक्षमत्र खवेदास्यसंख्यानामन्तरा स्थितिः // 27
text_mt: The height of each of these is one crore minus one [hundred thousand leagues]; the interval between them / is a hundred thousand; here, the interval between those numbering forty [hells] is situated.

sanskrit_iast:
kūṣmāṇḍa ūrdhve lakṣonakoṭisthānastadīśitā /
śāstraviruddhācaraṇāt kṛṣṇaṃ ye karma vidadhate // 28
meaning:
कूष्माण्ड ऊर्ध्वे लक्षोनकोटिस्थानस्तदीशिता /
शास्त्रविरुद्धाचरणात् कृष्णं ये कर्म विदधते // 28
text_mt: Above is Kūṣmāṇḍa, their ruler, whose realm is one crore minus a hundred thousand [leagues]. / Those who, through conduct opposed to scripture, perform black karma,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra bhīmairlokapuruṣaiḥ pīḍyante bhogaparyantam /
ye sakṛdapi parameśaṃ śivamekāgreṇa cetasā śaraṇam // 29
meaning:
तत्र भीमैर्लोकपुरुषैः पीड्यन्ते भोगपर्यन्तम् /
ये सकृदपि परमेशं शिवमेकाग्रेण चेतसा शरणम् // 29
text_mt: are tormented there by terrifying men of that realm until the completion of their experience. / Those who even once, with a concentrated mind, go for refuge to the supreme Lord Śiva

sanskrit_iast:
yānti na te narakayujaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ teṣāṃ sukhālpatādāyi /
sahasranavakotsedhamekāntaramatha kramāt // 30
meaning:
यान्ति न ते नरकयुजः कृष्णं तेषां सुखाल्पतादायि /
सहस्रनवकोत्सेधमेकान्तरमथ क्रमात् // 30
text_mt: do not meet hell; their black [karma] yields only a slight amount of pleasure. / Next, in succession, [each] having a height of nine thousand [leagues], with an interval of one [thousand] between each,

sanskrit_iast:
pātālāṣṭakamekaikamaṣṭame hāṭakaḥ prabhuḥ /
pratilokaṃ niyuktātmā śrīkaṇṭho haṭhato bahūḥ // 31
meaning:
पातालाष्टकमेकैकमष्टमे हाटकः प्रभुः /
प्रतिलोकं नियुक्तात्मा श्रीकण्ठो हठतो बहूः // 31
text_mt: is the group of eight netherworlds, one after another; in the eighth is the sovereign Hāṭaka. / Śrīkaṇṭha, who has appointed himself in each world, forcibly

sanskrit_iast:
siddhīrdadātyasāvevaṃ śrīmadrauravaśāsane /
vratino ye cikarmasthā niṣiddhācārakāriṇaḥ // 32
meaning:
सिद्धीर्ददात्यसावेवं श्रीमद्रौरवशासने /
व्रतिनो ये चिकर्मस्था निषिद्धाचारकारिणः // 32
text_mt: grants many spiritual accomplishments: thus [it is taught] in the venerable Raurava teaching. / Those vow-holders who, established in ritual acts, perform prohibited conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitā api ye luptasamayā naca kurvate /
prāyaścittāṃstathā tatsthā vāmācārasya dūṣakāḥ // 33
meaning:
दीक्षिता अपि ये लुप्तसमया नच कुर्वते /
प्रायश्चित्तांस्तथा तत्स्था वामाचारस्य दूषकाः // 33
text_mt: and those who, though initiated, have broken their rules and do not perform / expiations; likewise, those stationed there who slander the Vāma conduct;

sanskrit_iast:
devāgnidravyavṛttyaṃśajīvinaścottamasthitāḥ /
adhaḥsthagāruḍādyanyamantrasevāparāyaṇāḥ // 34
meaning:
देवाग्निद्रव्यवृत्त्यंशजीविनश्चोत्तमस्थिताः /
अधःस्थगारुडाद्यन्यमन्त्रसेवापरायणाः // 34
text_mt: those who live on the portions of livelihoods or wealth of the deities and the fire, and those established in the highest [ranks] / who are devoted to serving other mantras such as the lower Gāruḍa mantras:

sanskrit_iast:
te hāṭakavibhoragre kiṅkarā vividhātmakāḥ /
te tu tatrāpi deveśaṃ bhaktyā cetparyupāsate // 35
meaning:
ते हाटकविभोरग्रे किङ्करा विविधात्मकाः /
ते तु तत्रापि देवेशं भक्त्या चेत्पर्युपासते // 35
text_mt: they become various kinds of servants before the sovereign Hāṭaka. / But if, even there, they worship the Lord of gods with devotion,

sanskrit_iast:
tadīśatattve līyante kramācca parame śive /
anyathā ye tu vartante tadbhoganiratātmakāḥ // 36
meaning:
तदीशतत्त्वे लीयन्ते क्रमाच्च परमे शिवे /
अन्यथा ये तु वर्तन्ते तद्भोगनिरतात्मकाः // 36
text_mt: they dissolve into the reality of the Lord, and gradually into supreme Śiva. / Those, however, who behave otherwise, whose souls are devoted to the enjoyments of that [realm],

sanskrit_iast:
te kālavahnisaṃtāpadīnākrandaparāyaṇāḥ /
guṇatattve nilīyante tataḥ sṛṣṭimukhe punaḥ // 37
meaning:
ते कालवह्निसंतापदीनाक्रन्दपरायणाः /
गुणतत्त्वे निलीयन्ते ततः सृष्टिमुखे पुनः // 37
text_mt: devoted to wretched wailing from the torment of the fire of time, / dissolve into the reality of the qualities; thereafter, at the beginning of creation, again

sanskrit_iast:
pātyante mātṛbhirghorayātanaughapurassaram /
adhamādhamadeheṣu nijakarmānurūpataḥ // 38
meaning:
पात्यन्ते मातृभिर्घोरयातनौघपुरस्सरम् /
अधमाधमदेहेषु निजकर्मानुरूपतः // 38
text_mt: they are cast down by the Mothers, preceded by a multitude of terrible tortures, / into the lowest of low bodies, in accordance with their own karma.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣānteṣu tatrāpi kecinmantravidaḥ kramāt /
mucyante'nye tu badhyante pūrvakṛtyānusārataḥ // 39
meaning:
मानुषान्तेषु तत्रापि केचिन्मन्त्रविदः क्रमात् /
मुच्यन्तेऽन्ये तु बध्यन्ते पूर्वकृत्यानुसारतः // 39
text_mt: Among them, ending in humans, some who know mantras are gradually / liberated; others, however, are bound according to their past deeds.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa gaṇavṛttānto nāmnā hulahulādinā /
proktaṃ bhagavatā śrīmadānandādhikaśāsane // 40
meaning:
इत्येष गणवृत्तान्तो नाम्ना हुलहुलादिना /
प्रोक्तं भगवता श्रीमदानन्दाधिकशासने // 40
text_mt: Thus this account of the attendants, with names such as Hulahula and the rest, / was declared by the Blessed One in the venerable teaching of Ānandādhika.

sanskrit_iast:
pātālordhve sahasrāṇi viṃśatirbhūkaṭāhakaḥ /
siddhātantre tu pātālapṛṣṭhe yakṣīsamāvṛtam // 41
meaning:
पातालोर्ध्वे सहस्राणि विंशतिर्भूकटाहकः /
सिद्धातन्त्रे तु पातालपृष्ठे यक्षीसमावृतम् // 41
text_mt: Above the netherworlds is the caldron of the earth, twenty thousand [leagues]. / In the Siddhātantra, however, upon the back of the netherworld, surrounded by Yakṣīs,

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrakālyāḥ puraṃ yatra tābhiḥ krīḍanti sādhakāḥ /
tatastamastaptabhūmistataḥśūnyaṃ tato'hayaḥ // 42
meaning:
भद्रकाल्याः पुरं यत्र ताभिः क्रीडन्ति साधकाः /
ततस्तमस्तप्तभूमिस्ततःशून्यं ततोऽहयः // 42
text_mt: is the city of Bhadrakālī, where adepts sport with them. / Thence is the dark region, the heated ground, thence empty space, thence the horse-faced fire;

sanskrit_iast:
etāni yātanāsthānaṃ gurumantrādidūṣiṇām /
tato bhūmyūrdhva [madhya] to meruḥ sahasrāṇi sa ṣoḍaśa // 43
meaning:
एतानि यातनास्थानं गुरुमन्त्रादिदूषिणाम् /
ततो भूम्यूर्ध्व [मध्य] तो मेरुः सहस्राणि स षोडश // 43
text_mt: these are the places of torture for abusers of gurus, mantras, and the like. / Thence, [in the middle] above the earth, is Meru; sixteen thousand [leagues]

sanskrit_iast:
magnastanmūlavistārastaddvayenordhvavistṛtiḥ /
sahasrābdhivasūcchrāyo haimaḥ sarvāmarālayaḥ // 44
meaning:
मग्नस्तन्मूलविस्तारस्तद्द्वयेनोर्ध्वविस्तृतिः /
सहस्राब्धिवसूच्छ्रायो हैमः सर्वामरालयः // 44
text_mt: is it sunken; its base has that [same] breadth; its upper width is twice that. / Its height is eighty-four thousand [leagues]; it is golden, the abode of all immortals.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyordhvādhaḥ samudvṛttaśarāvacaturaśrakaḥ /
bhairavīyaṃ ca talliṅgaṃ dharaṇī cāsya pīṭhikā // 45
meaning:
मध्योर्ध्वाधः समुद्वृत्तशरावचतुरश्रकः /
भैरवीयं च तल्लिङ्गं धरणी चास्य पीठिका // 45
text_mt: In the middle, top, and bottom, it is like a saucer turned upward, four-cornered. / And that is the liṅga of Bhairava, and the earth is its pedestal.

sanskrit_iast:
sarve devā nilīnā hi tatra tatpūjitaṃ sadā /
madhye merusabhā dhātustadīśadiśi ketanam // 46
meaning:
सर्वे देवा निलीना हि तत्र तत्पूजितं सदा /
मध्ये मेरुसभा धातुस्तदीशदिशि केतनम् // 46
text_mt: For all the gods are dissolved there; that is worshipped eternally. / In the center is the assembly of the Creator on Meru; in the northeast direction is the residence,

sanskrit_iast:
jyotiṣkaśikharaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śrīkaṇṭhāṃśaśca sa prabhuḥ /
avaruhya sahasrāṇi manovatyāścaturdaśa // 47
meaning:
ज्योतिष्कशिखरं शंभोः श्रीकण्ठांशश्च स प्रभुः /
अवरुह्य सहस्राणि मनोवत्याश्चतुर्दश // 47
text_mt: the peak of light, of Śambhu, and that lord is a portion of Śrīkaṇṭha. / Having descended fourteen thousand [leagues] from Manovatī,

sanskrit_iast:
cakravāṭaścaturdikko meruratra tu lokapāḥ /
amarāvatikendrasya pūrvasyāṃ dakṣiṇena tām // 48
meaning:
चक्रवाटश्चतुर्दिक्को मेरुरत्र तु लोकपाः /
अमरावतिकेन्द्रस्य पूर्वस्यां दक्षिणेन ताम् // 48
text_mt: there is the circular mountain range in the four directions; but here on Meru are the world-protectors. / Amarāvatikā of Indra is in the east; to the south of it

sanskrit_iast:
atsaraḥsiddhasādhyāstāmuttareṇa vināyakāḥ /
tejovatī svadiśyagneḥ purī tāṃ paścimena tu // 49
meaning:
अत्सरःसिद्धसाध्यास्तामुत्तरेण विनायकाः /
तेजोवती स्वदिश्यग्नेः पुरी तां पश्चिमेन तु // 49
text_mt: are the Apsarases, Siddhas, and Sādhyas; to the north of it are the Vināyakas. / Tejovatī, the city of Agni, is in his own direction; to the west of it

sanskrit_iast:
viśvedevā viśvakarmā kramāttadanugāśca ye /
yāmyāṃ saṃyamanī tāṃ tu paścimena kramāt sthitāḥ // 50
meaning:
विश्वेदेवा विश्वकर्मा क्रमात्तदनुगाश्च ये /
याम्यां संयमनी तां तु पश्चिमेन क्रमात् स्थिताः // 50
text_mt: are the Viśvedevas, Viśvakarman, and those who follow him in succession. / In the southern [direction] is Saṃyamanī; to the west of it are situated in succession

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛnandā svasaṃkhyātā rudrāstatsādhakāstathā /
kṛṣṇāṅgārā nirṛtiśca tāṃ pūrveṇa piśācakāḥ // 51
meaning:
मातृनन्दा स्वसंख्याता रुद्रास्तत्साधकास्तथा /
कृष्णाङ्गारा निरृतिश्च तां पूर्वेण पिशाचकाः // 51
text_mt: the Mothers, the Nandās, the Rudras of their own number, and their adepts. / Kṛṣṇāṅgārā of Nirṛti is [in the southwest]; to the east of it are the Piśācas,

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣāṃsi siddhagandharvāstūttareṇottareṇa tām /
vāruṇī śuddhavatyākhyā bhūtaugho dakṣiṇena tām // 52
meaning:
रक्षांसि सिद्धगन्धर्वास्तूत्तरेणोत्तरेण ताम् /
वारुणी शुद्धवत्याख्या भूतौघो दक्षिणेन ताम् // 52
text_mt: the Rākṣasas, Siddhas, and Gandharvas; further and further north of it / is the [city] of Varuṇa named Śuddhavatī; to the south of it is the host of spirits;

sanskrit_iast:
uttareṇottareṇaināṃ vasuvidyādharāḥ kramāt /
vāyorgandhavatī tasyā dakṣiṇe kinnarāḥ punaḥ // 53
meaning:
उत्तरेणोत्तरेणैनां वसुविद्याधराः क्रमात् /
वायोर्गन्धवती तस्या दक्षिणे किन्नराः पुनः // 53
text_mt: further and further north of this are the Vasus and Vidyādharas in succession. / Gandhavatī is of Vāyu; to the south of it, further,

sanskrit_iast:
vīṇāsarasvatī devī nāradastumburustathā /
mahodayendorguhyāḥ syuḥ paścime'syāḥ punaḥ punaḥ // 54
meaning:
वीणासरस्वती देवी नारदस्तुम्बुरुस्तथा /
महोदयेन्दोर्गुह्याः स्युः पश्चिमेऽस्याः पुनः पुनः // 54
text_mt: are the Goddess Sarasvatī of the lute, Nārada, and Tumburu. / Mahodayā is of the Moon; Guhyakas are repeatedly to the west of it;

sanskrit_iast:
kuberaḥ karmadevāśca tathā tatsādhakā api /
yaśasvinī maheśasya tasyāḥ paścimato hariḥ // 55
meaning:
कुबेरः कर्मदेवाश्च तथा तत्साधका अपि /
यशस्विनी महेशस्य तस्याः पश्चिमतो हरिः // 55
text_mt: Kubera and the ritual gods, and likewise their adepts. / Yaśasvinī is of Maheśa; to the west of it is Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe brahmāśvinau dhanvantariḥ kramāt /
mairave cakravāṭe'sminnevaṃ mukhyāḥ puro'ṣṭadhā // 56
meaning:
दक्षिणे दक्षिणे ब्रह्माश्विनौ धन्वन्तरिः क्रमात् /
मैरवे चक्रवाटेऽस्मिन्नेवं मुख्याः पुरोऽष्टधा // 56
text_mt: further and further to the south are Brahmā, the two Aśvins, and Dhanvantari, in order. / Thus, in this enclosure on Meru, the chief cities are eightfold.

sanskrit_iast:
antarālagatāstvanyāḥ punaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ /
iṣṭāpūrtaratāḥ puṇye varṣeye bhārate narāḥ // 57
meaning:
अन्तरालगतास्त्वन्याः पुनः षड्विंशतिः स्मृताः /
इष्टापूर्तरताः पुण्ये वर्षेये भारते नराः // 57
text_mt: The others situated in the intermediate spaces, moreover, are remembered as twenty-six. / Humans in the holy realm of Bhārata who are devoted to sacrificial and charitable works,

sanskrit_iast:
te merugāḥ sakṛcchambhuṃ ye vārcanti yathocitam /
meroḥ pradakṣiṇāpyodagdikṣu viṣkambhaparvatāḥ // 58
meaning:
ते मेरुगाः सकृच्छम्भुं ये वार्चन्ति यथोचितम् /
मेरोः प्रदक्षिणाप्योदग्दिक्षु विष्कम्भपर्वताः // 58
text_mt: they go to Meru, as do those who worship Śambhu suitably even once. / In the south, west, and north directions of Meru are the supporting mountains:

sanskrit_iast:
mandaro gandhamādaśca vipulo'tha supārśvakaḥ /
sitapītanīlaraktāste kramātpādaparvatāḥ // 59
meaning:
मन्दरो गन्धमादश्च विपुलोऽथ सुपार्श्वकः /
सितपीतनीलरक्तास्ते क्रमात्पादपर्वताः // 59
text_mt: Mandara, Gandhamādana, Vipula, and Supārśva; / white, yellow, blue, and red respectively, they are the foot-mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
etairbhuvamavaṣṭabhya merustiṣṭhati niścalaḥ /
caitrarathanandanākhye vaiśrājaṃ pitṛvanaṃ vanānyāhuḥ // 60
meaning:
एतैर्भुवमवष्टभ्य मेरुस्तिष्ठति निश्चलः /
चैत्ररथनन्दनाख्ये वैश्राजं पितृवनं वनान्याहुः // 60
text_mt: Supporting the earth with these, Meru stands motionless. / The forests, they say, are named Caitraratha, Nandana, Vaiśrāja, and Pitṛvana;

sanskrit_iast:
raktodamānasasitaṃ bhadraṃ caitaccatuṣṭayaṃ sarasām /
vṛkṣāḥ kadambajambvaśvatthanyagrodhakāḥ kramaśaḥ // 61
meaning:
रक्तोदमानससितं भद्रं चैतच्चतुष्टयं सरसाम् /
वृक्षाः कदम्बजम्ब्वश्वत्थन्यग्रोधकाः क्रमशः // 61
text_mt: Raktoda, Mānasa, Sita, and Bhadra—this is the group of four lakes. / The trees are the Kadamba, Jambu, Aśvattha, and Nyagrodha in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣu ca caturṣvacaleṣu trayaṃ trayaṃ kramaśa etadāmnātam /
mervadho lavaṇābdhyantaṃ jambudvīpaḥ samantataḥ // 62
meaning:
एषु च चतुर्ष्वचलेषु त्रयं त्रयं क्रमश एतदाम्नातम् /
मेर्वधो लवणाब्ध्यन्तं जम्बुद्वीपः समन्ततः // 62
text_mt: And on these four mountains, this triad [of forest, lake, and tree] is traditionally handed down in succession. / Below Meru, ending at the salt ocean, on all sides is Jambudvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣamātraḥ sa navadhā jāto maryādaparvataiḥ /
niṣadho hemakūṭaśca himavāndakṣiṇe trayaḥ // 63
meaning:
लक्षमात्रः स नवधा जातो मर्यादपर्वतैः /
निषधो हेमकूटश्च हिमवान्दक्षिणे त्रयः // 63
text_mt: Measuring a hundred thousand [leagues], it is divided into nine parts by the boundary mountains. / Niṣadha, Hemakūṭa, and Himavat are three to the south:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ sahasranavatistadaśītiriti kramāt /
nīlaḥ śvetastriśṛṅgaśca tāvantaḥ savyataḥ punaḥ // 64
meaning:
लक्षं सहस्रनवतिस्तदशीतिरिति क्रमात् /
नीलः श्वेतस्त्रिशृङ्गश्च तावन्तः सव्यतः पुनः // 64
text_mt: one hundred thousand, ninety thousand, and eighty [thousand leagues in length] respectively. / Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgin are of the same dimensions, further to the left.

sanskrit_iast:
meroḥ ṣaḍete maryādācalāḥ pūrvāparāyatāḥ /
pūrvato mālyavānpaścādgandhamādanasaṃjñitaḥ // 65
meaning:
मेरोः षडेते मर्यादाचलाः पूर्वापरायताः /
पूर्वतो माल्यवान्पश्चाद्गन्धमादनसंज्ञितः // 65
text_mt: These six boundary mountains of Meru extend from east to west. / In the east is Mālyavat; in the west is the one named Gandhamādana.

sanskrit_iast:
savyottarāyatau tau tu catustriṃśatsahasrakau /
aṣṭāvete tato'pyanyau dvau dvau pūrvādiṣu kramāt // 66
meaning:
सव्योत्तरायतौ तौ तु चतुस्त्रिंशत्सहस्रकौ /
अष्टावेते ततोऽप्यन्यौ द्वौ द्वौ पूर्वादिषु क्रमात् // 66
text_mt: Those two, extending south and north, are thirty-four thousand [leagues]. / These are eight; and besides them, two by two in succession in the east and other directions,

sanskrit_iast:
jāṭharaḥ kūṭahimavadyātrajārudhiśṛṅgiṇaḥ /
evaṃ sthito vibhāgo'tra varṣasiddhyai nirūpyate // 67
meaning:
जाठरः कूटहिमवद्यात्रजारुधिशृङ्गिणः /
एवं स्थितो विभागोऽत्र वर्षसिद्ध्यै निरूप्यते // 67
text_mt: are Jāṭhara, Kūṭahimavat, Yātra, Jārudhi, and Śṛṅgin. / Thus the division situated here is described for the determination of the realms.

sanskrit_iast:
samantāccakravāṭādho'narkendu caturaśrakam /
sahasranavavistīrṇamilākhyaṃ trimukhāyuṣam // 68
meaning:
समन्ताच्चक्रवाटाधोऽनर्केन्दु चतुरश्रकम् /
सहस्रनवविस्तीर्णमिलाख्यं त्रिमुखायुषम् // 68
text_mt: All around below the circular mountain range, devoid of sun and moon, four-cornered, / extending nine thousand [leagues], is the [realm] named Ilā, whose life-span is three thousand [years].

sanskrit_iast:
meroḥ paścimato gandhamādo yastasya paścime /
ketumālaṃ kulādrīṇāṃ saptakena vibhūṣitam // 69
meaning:
मेरोः पश्चिमतो गन्धमादो यस्तस्य पश्चिमे /
केतुमालं कुलाद्रीणां सप्तकेन विभूषितम् // 69
text_mt: West of Meru is Gandhamādana; to the west of that / is Ketumāla, adorned with the seven family mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
meroḥ pūrva mālyavānyo bhadrāśvastasya pūrvataḥ /
sahasradaśakāyustatsapañcakulaparvatam // 70
meaning:
मेरोः पूर्व माल्यवान्यो भद्राश्वस्तस्य पूर्वतः /
सहस्रदशकायुस्तत्सपञ्चकुलपर्वतम् // 70
text_mt: To the east of Meru is Mālyavān, and east of that is Bhadrāśva; / its [inhabitants'] lifespan is ten thousand [years], and it is endowed with five clan-mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapaścimataḥ savyottarataśca kramādime /
dvātriṃśacca catustriṃśatsahasrāṇi nirūpite // 71
meaning:
पूर्वपश्चिमतः सव्योत्तरतश्च क्रमादिमे /
द्वात्रिंशच्च चतुस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि निरूपिते // 71
text_mt: East and west, and then south and north, in order, these / are described as measuring thirty-two and thirty-four thousand [yojanas].

sanskrit_iast:
merorudak śṛṅgavānyastadbahiḥ kuruvarṣakam /
cāpavannavasāhasramāyustatra trayodaśa // 72
meaning:
मेरोरुदक् शृङ्गवान्यस्तद्बहिः कुरुवर्षकम् /
चापवन्नवसाहस्रमायुस्तत्र त्रयोदश // 72
text_mt: North of Meru is Śṛṅgavān, and beyond that lies Kuruvarṣa; / bow-shaped, measuring nine thousand [yojanas], lifespan there is thirteen [thousand years].

sanskrit_iast:
kuruvarṣasyottare'tha vāyavye'bdhau kramāccharāḥ /
daśa ceti sahasrāṇi dvīpau candro'tha bhadrakaḥ // 73
meaning:
कुरुवर्षस्योत्तरेऽथ वायव्येऽब्धौ क्रमाच्छराः /
दश चेति सहस्राणि द्वीपौ चन्द्रोऽथ भद्रकः // 73
text_mt: North of Kuruvarṣa, in the northwestern ocean, measuring in order five / and ten thousand [yojanas], are two islands: Candra and Bhadraka.

sanskrit_iast:
yau śvetaśṛṅgiṇau merorvāme madhye hiraṇmayam /
tayornavakavistīrṇamāyuścārdhatrayodaśa // 74
meaning:
यौ श्वेतशृङ्गिणौ मेरोर्वामे मध्ये हिरण्मयम् /
तयोर्नवकविस्तीर्णमायुश्चार्धत्रयोदश // 74
text_mt: To the left of Meru are Śveta and Śṛṅgī, between which lies Hiraṇmaya; / its extent is nine [thousand yojanas], and the lifespan is twelve and a half [thousand years].

sanskrit_iast:
tatra vai vāmataḥ śvetanīlayo ramyako'ntare /
sahasranavavistīrṇamāyurdvādaśa tāni ca // 75
meaning:
तत्र वै वामतः श्वेतनीलयो रम्यकोऽन्तरे /
सहस्रनवविस्तीर्णमायुर्द्वादश तानि च // 75
text_mt: There, on the left between Śveta and Nīla, is Ramyaka; / its extent is nine thousand [yojanas], and lifespan is twelve of them [i.e., twelve thousand years].

sanskrit_iast:
merordakṣiṇato hemaniṣadhau yau tadantare /
haryākhyaṃ navasāhasraṃ tatsahasrādhikāyuṣam // 76
meaning:
मेरोर्दक्षिणतो हेमनिषधौ यौ तदन्तरे /
हर्याख्यं नवसाहस्रं तत्सहस्राधिकायुषम् // 76
text_mt: South of Meru are Hema and Niṣadha; between them / lies the realm named Hari, measuring nine thousand [yojanas], with a lifespan a thousand years longer than that [i.e., ten thousand].

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva dakṣiṇe hemahimavaddvitayāntare /
kainnaraṃ navasāhasraṃ tatsahasrādhikāyuṣam // 77
meaning:
तत्रैव दक्षिणे हेमहिमवद्द्वितयान्तरे /
कैन्नरं नवसाहस्रं तत्सहस्राधिकायुषम् // 77
text_mt: Right there to the south, between the pair Hema and Himavat, / lies Kinnara, measuring nine thousand [yojanas], with a lifespan a thousand years longer than that.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiva dakṣiṇe merorhimavānyasya dakṣiṇe /
bhārataṃ navasāhasraṃ cāpavatkarmabhogabhūḥ // 78
meaning:
तत्रैव दक्षिणे मेरोर्हिमवान्यस्य दक्षिणे /
भारतं नवसाहस्रं चापवत्कर्मभोगभूः // 78
text_mt: Right there to the south of Meru is Himavat, south of which / lies Bhārata, measuring nine thousand [yojanas], bow-shaped, a land of action and enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
ilāvṛtaṃ ketubhadraṃ kuruhairaṇyaramyakam /
harikinnaravarṣe ca bhogabhūrna tu karmabhūḥ // 79
meaning:
इलावृतं केतुभद्रं कुरुहैरण्यरम्यकम् /
हरिकिन्नरवर्षे च भोगभूर्न तु कर्मभूः // 79
text_mt: Ilāvṛta, Ketumāla, Bhadra, Kuru, Hairaṇya, Ramyaka, / and the realms of Hari and Kinnara are lands of enjoyment, not lands of action.

sanskrit_iast:
atra bāhulyataḥ karmabhūbhāvo'trāpyakarmaṇām /
paśūnāṃ karmasaṃskāraḥ syāttādṛgdṛḍhasaṃskṛteḥ // 80
meaning:
अत्र बाहुल्यतः कर्मभूभावोऽत्राप्यकर्मणाम् /
पशूनां कर्मसंस्कारः स्यात्तादृग्दृढसंस्कृतेः // 80
text_mt: Here [in Bhārata], for the most part, is the nature of a land of action; yet even here, bound souls devoid of rites / may possess karmic impressions due to firmly rooted latent tendencies of such a kind.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbhavantyapyasaṃskārā bhārate'nyatra cāpi hi /
dṛḍhaprāktanasaṃskārādīśecchātaḥ śubhāśubham // 81
meaning:
संभवन्त्यप्यसंस्कारा भारतेऽन्यत्र चापि हि /
दृढप्राक्तनसंस्कारादीशेच्छातः शुभाशुभम् // 81
text_mt: Even those devoid of impressions arise in Bhārata and elsewhere too; / by the Lord's will, auspicious and inauspicious [fruits] arise from firm past impressions.

sanskrit_iast:
sthānāntare'pi karmāsti dṛṣṭaṃ tacca purātane /
tatra tretā sadā kālo bhārate tu caturyugam // 82
meaning:
स्थानान्तरेऽपि कर्मास्ति दृष्टं तच्च पुरातने /
तत्र त्रेता सदा कालो भारते तु चतुर्युगम् // 82
text_mt: In other places too action exists, as seen in ancient tradition; / there, the time is always Tretā[-yuga], but in Bhārata there are four world-ages.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārate navakhaṇḍaṃ ca sāmudreṇāmbhasātra ca /
sthalaṃ pañcaśatī tadvajjalaṃ ceti vibhajyate // 83
meaning:
भारते नवखण्डं च सामुद्रेणाम्भसात्र च /
स्थलं पञ्चशती तद्वज्जलं चेति विभज्यते // 83
text_mt: And Bhārata has nine divisions, separated by ocean waters; / the dry land is five hundred [yojanas], and likewise the water is divided.

sanskrit_iast:
indraḥ kaśerustāmrābho nāgīyaḥ prāggabhastimān /
saumyagāndharvavārāhāḥ kanyākhyaṃ cāsamudrataḥ // 84
meaning:
इन्द्रः कशेरुस्ताम्राभो नागीयः प्राग्गभस्तिमान् /
सौम्यगान्धर्ववाराहाः कन्याख्यं चासमुद्रतः // 84
text_mt: Indra, Kaśeru, Tāmra, Nāga, and to the east Gabhastimat, / Saumya, Gāndharva, Vārāha, and the realm named Kanyā, up to the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyādvīpe ca navame dakṣiṇenābdhimadhyagāḥ /
upadvīpāḥ ṣaṭ kulādrisaptakena vibhūṣite // 85
meaning:
कन्याद्वीपे च नवमे दक्षिणेनाब्धिमध्यगाः /
उपद्वीपाः षट् कुलाद्रिसप्तकेन विभूषिते // 85
text_mt: And in Kanyādvīpa, the ninth, situated in the middle of the southern ocean / are six sub-islands, adorned with seven clan-mountains:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgayavamalayaśaṅkuḥ kumudavarāhau ca malayago'gastya /
tatraiva ca trikūṭe laṅkā ṣaḍamī hyupadvīpāḥ // 86
meaning:
अङ्गयवमलयशङ्कुः कुमुदवराहौ च मलयगोऽगस्त्य /
तत्रैव च त्रिकूटे लङ्का षडमी ह्युपद्वीपाः // 86
text_mt: Aṅga, Yava, Malaya, Śaṅku, Kumuda, and Varāha; Agastya resides on Malaya, / and right there on Trikūṭa is Laṅkā; these indeed are the six sub-islands.

sanskrit_iast:
dvīpopadvīpagāḥ prāyo mlecchā nānāvidhā janāḥ /
muktākāñcanaratnāḍhyā iti śrīruruśāsane // 87
meaning:
द्वीपोपद्वीपगाः प्रायो म्लेच्छा नानाविधा जनाः /
मुक्ताकाञ्चनरत्नाढ्या इति श्रीरुरुशासने // 87
text_mt: Those who inhabit these islands and sub-islands are mostly barbarians of diverse kinds, / rich in pearls, gold, and gems—thus it is taught in the venerable Rurutantra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhārate yatkṛtaṃ karma kṣapitaṃ vāpyavīcitaḥ /
śivāntaṃ tena muktirvā kanyākhye tu viśeṣataḥ // 88
meaning:
भारते यत्कृतं कर्म क्षपितं वाप्यवीचितः /
शिवान्तं तेन मुक्तिर्वा कन्याख्ये तु विशेषतः // 88
text_mt: Karma performed or exhausted in Bhārata leads to anywhere from Avīci / up to Śiva, or to liberation, and especially so in the division named Kanyā.

sanskrit_iast:
mahākālādikā rudrakoṭiratraiva bhārate /
gaṅgādipañcaśatikā janma tenātra durlabham // 89
meaning:
महाकालादिका रुद्रकोटिरत्रैव भारते /
गङ्गादिपञ्चशतिका जन्म तेनात्र दुर्लभम् // 89
text_mt: The crore of Rudras beginning with Mahākāla resides right here in Bhārata, / along with the five hundred [holy rivers] beginning with the Gaṅgā; therefore, birth here is hard to attain.

sanskrit_iast:
anyavarṣeṣu paśuvad bhogātkarmātivāhanam /
prāpyaṃ manorathātītamapi bhāratajanmanām // 90
meaning:
अन्यवर्षेषु पशुवद् भोगात्कर्मातिवाहनम् /
प्राप्यं मनोरथातीतमपि भारतजन्मनाम् // 90
text_mt: In other realms, karmic exhaustion occurs through enjoyment, like animals; / but for those born in Bhārata, even what lies beyond wishful imagination can be attained.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāvarṇāśramācārasukhaduḥkhavicitratā /
kanyādvīpe yatastena karmabhūḥ seyamuttamā // 91
meaning:
नानावर्णाश्रमाचारसुखदुःखविचित्रता /
कन्याद्वीपे यतस्तेन कर्मभूः सेयमुत्तमा // 91
text_mt: Because there is a manifold variety of pleasures, pains, classes, life-stages, and customs / in Kanyādvīpa, this is the supreme land of action.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsā sitāsitānyatra kurvatāṃ kila siddhyataḥ /
parāparau svarnirayāviti rauravavārtike // 92
meaning:
पुंसा सितासितान्यत्र कुर्वतां किल सिद्ध्यतः /
परापरौ स्वर्निरयाविति रौरववार्तिके // 92
text_mt: For persons performing light and dark deeds here, / heaven and hell, higher and lower, are accomplished—so says the Rauravavārttika.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ meroradho jambūrabhito yaḥ sa vistarāt /
syāt saptadaśadhā khaṇḍairnavabhistu samāsataḥ // 93
meaning:
एवं मेरोरधो जम्बूरभितो यः स विस्तरात् /
स्यात् सप्तदशधा खण्डैर्नवभिस्तु समासतः // 93
text_mt: Thus, below Meru and all around it is the Jambū [continent], which in detail / consists of seventeen divisions, but concisely of nine.

sanskrit_iast:
manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasyāsan sutā daśa tatastrayaḥ /
prāvrajannatha jambvākhye rājā yo'gnīdhranāmakaḥ // 94
meaning:
मनोः स्वायंभुवस्यासन् सुता दश ततस्त्रयः /
प्राव्रजन्नथ जम्ब्वाख्ये राजा योऽग्नीध्रनामकः // 94
text_mt: Manu Svāyambhuva had ten sons; of them, three / renounced; then the one who became king over the continent named Jambū was named Āgnīdhra.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyābhavannava sutāstato'yaṃ navakhaṇḍakaḥ /
nābhiryo navamastasya naptā bharata ārṣabhiḥ // 95
meaning:
तस्याभवन्नव सुतास्ततोऽयं नवखण्डकः /
नाभिर्यो नवमस्तस्य नप्ता भरत आर्षभिः // 95
text_mt: He had nine sons, and thence came these nine divisions; / the ninth was Nābhi, whose grandson was Bharata, son of Ṛṣabha.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāṣṭau tanayāḥ sākaṃ kanyayā navamo'ṃśakaḥ /
bhuktaistairnavadhā tasmāllakṣayojanamātrakāt // 96
meaning:
तस्याष्टौ तनयाः साकं कन्यया नवमोऽंशकः /
भुक्तैस्तैर्नवधा तस्माल्लक्षयोजनमात्रकात् // 96
text_mt: He had eight sons along with a daughter, as the ninth share; / it was enjoyed by them in nine parts, from that [continent] measuring one hundred thousand yojanas.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaikamātro lavaṇastadbāhye'sya puro'drayaḥ /
ṛṣabho dundubhirdhūmraḥ kaṅkadroṇendavo hyudak // 97
meaning:
लक्षैकमात्रो लवणस्तद्बाह्येऽस्य पुरोऽद्रयः /
ऋषभो दुन्दुभिर्धूम्रः कङ्कद्रोणेन्दवो ह्युदक् // 97
text_mt: The Salt Ocean measures one hundred thousand [yojanas]; beyond it, facing it, are mountains: / Ṛṣabha, Dundubhi, Dhūmra, Kaṅka, Droṇa, and Indu to the north,

sanskrit_iast:
varāhanandanāśokāḥ paścāt sahabalāhakau /
dakṣiṇa cakramainākau vāḍavo'ntastayoḥ sthitaḥ // 98
meaning:
वराहनन्दनाशोकाः पश्चात् सहबलाहकौ /
दक्षिण चक्रमैनाकौ वाडवोऽन्तस्तयोः स्थितः // 98
text_mt: Varāha, Nandana, and Aśoka to the west, together with Balāhaka; / to the south are Cakra and Maināka, between which the submarine fire resides.

sanskrit_iast:
abdherdakṣiṇataḥ khākṣisahasrātikramād giriḥ /
vidyutvāṃstrisahasrocchridāyāmo'tra phalāśinaḥ // 99
meaning:
अब्धेर्दक्षिणतः खाक्षिसहस्रातिक्रमाद् गिरिः /
विद्युत्वांस्त्रिसहस्रोच्छ्रिदायामोऽत्र फलाशिनः // 99
text_mt: South of the ocean, crossing twenty-five thousand [yojanas], is the mountain / Vidyutvān, three thousand [yojanas] in height and extent; here fruit-eaters reside,

sanskrit_iast:
maladigdhā dīrghakeśaśmaśravo gosadharmakāḥ /
nagnāḥ saṃvatsarāśītijīvinastṛṇabhojinaḥ // 100
meaning:
मलदिग्धा दीर्घकेशश्मश्रवो गोसधर्मकाः /
नग्नाः संवत्सराशीतिजीविनस्तृणभोजिनः // 100
text_mt: smeared with dirt, with long hair and beards, behaving like cattle, / naked, living for eighty years, and grazing on grass.

sanskrit_iast:
niryantrāṇi sadā tatra dvārāṇi bilasiddhaye /
ityetad gurubhirgītaṃ śrīmadrauravaśāsane // 101
meaning:
निर्यन्त्राणि सदा तत्र द्वाराणि बिलसिद्धये /
इत्येतद् गुरुभिर्गीतं श्रीमद्रौरवशासने // 101
text_mt: Always unobstructed there are the doors to the accomplishment of subterranean realms— / this is sung by the gurus in the venerable teachings of the Rauravatantra.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ ya eṣa lavaṇasamudraḥ pratipāditaḥ /
tadbahiḥ ṣaḍamī dvīpāḥ pratyekaṃ svārṇavairvṛtāḥ // 102
meaning:
इत्थं य एष लवणसमुद्रः प्रतिपादितः /
तद्बहिः षडमी द्वीपाः प्रत्येकं स्वार्णवैर्वृताः // 102
text_mt: Thus has been explained this Salt Ocean; / beyond it are these six continents, each surrounded by its own ocean,

sanskrit_iast:
kramadviguṇitāḥ ṣaḍbhirmanuputrairadhiṣṭhitāḥ /
śākakuśakrauñcāḥ śalmaligomedhābjamiti ṣaḍdvīpāḥ /
kṣīradadhisarpiraikṣavamadirāmadhurāmbukāḥ ṣaḍambudhayaḥ // 103
meaning:
क्रमद्विगुणिताः षड्भिर्मनुपुत्रैरधिष्ठिताः /
शाककुशक्रौञ्चाः शल्मलिगोमेधाब्जमिति षड्द्वीपाः /
क्षीरदधिसर्पिरैक्षवमदिरामधुराम्बुकाः षडम्बुधयः // 103
text_mt: doubling successively in size, governed by six sons of Manu: / Śāka, Kuśa, Krauñca, Śālmali, Gomeda, and Abja are the six continents; / milk, curd, clarified butter, sugarcane juice, liquor, and sweet water are the six oceans.

sanskrit_iast:
medhātithirvapuṣmāñjyotiṣmāndyutimatā havī rājā /
saṃvara iti śākādiṣu jambudvīpe nyarūpi cāgnīdhraḥ // 104
meaning:
मेधातिथिर्वपुष्माञ्ज्योतिष्मान्द्युतिमता हवी राजा /
संवर इति शाकादिषु जम्बुद्वीपे न्यरूपि चाग्नीध्रः // 104
text_mt: Medhātithi, Vapuṣmān, Jyotiṣmān, Dyutimān, King Havya, / and Saṃvara [rule] Śāka and the rest, while Āgnīdhra was described in Jambūdvīpa.

sanskrit_iast:
girisaptakaparikalpitatāvatkhaṇḍāstu pañca śākādyāḥ /
puṣkarasaṃjño dvidalo hariyamavaruṇendavo'tra pūrvādau // 105
meaning:
गिरिसप्तकपरिकल्पिततावत्खण्डास्तु पञ्च शाकाद्याः /
पुष्करसंज्ञो द्विदलो हरियमवरुणेन्दवोऽत्र पूर्वादौ // 105
text_mt: The five continents beginning with Śāka have as many divisions made by seven mountains; / the one named Puṣkara has two halves; here, in the east and other quarters, are Hari, Yama, Varuṇa, and Indu.

sanskrit_iast:
tripañcāśacca lakṣāṇi dvikoṭyayutapañcakam /
svādvarṇavāntaṃ mervardhādyojananāmiyaṃ pramā // 106
meaning:
त्रिपञ्चाशच्च लक्षाणि द्विकोट्ययुतपञ्चकम् /
स्वाद्वर्णवान्तं मेर्वर्धाद्योजननामियं प्रमा // 106
text_mt: Two crores, fifty-three lakhs, / and fifty thousand yojanas: / this is the measurement up to the sweet-water ocean from the midpoint of Meru.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamajaladherbāhye haimī bhūḥ koṭidaśakamatha lakṣam /
ucchrityā vistārādayutaṃ loketarācalaḥ kathitaḥ // 107
meaning:
सप्तमजलधेर्बाह्ये हैमी भूः कोटिदशकमथ लक्षम् /
उच्छ्रित्या विस्तारादयुतं लोकेतराचलः कथितः // 107
text_mt: Beyond the seventh ocean is the golden land of one hundred million [yojanas]; / then the Lokāloka mountain is described, one hundred thousand [yojanas] in height and ten thousand in width.

sanskrit_iast:
lokālokadigaṣṭaka saṃsthaṃ rudrāṣṭakaṃ salokeśam /
kevalamityapi kecillokālokāntare ravirna bahiḥ // 108
meaning:
लोकालोकदिगष्टक संस्थं रुद्राष्टकं सलोकेशम् /
केवलमित्यपि केचिल्लोकालोकान्तरे रविर्न बहिः // 108
text_mt: The eight Rudras along with the world-guardians dwell in the eight directions of Lokāloka; / some say they dwell alone; the sun remains inside Lokāloka, not outside.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛdevapathāvasyodagdakṣiṇagau svajātpare vīthyau /
bhānoruttaradakṣiṇamayanadvayametadeva kathayanti // 109
meaning:
पितृदेवपथावस्योदग्दक्षिणगौ स्वजात्परे वीथ्यौ /
भानोरुत्तरदक्षिणमयनद्वयमेतदेव कथयन्ति // 109
text_mt:
The paths of the ancestors and the gods run north and south of it, in avenues beyond its own course; / this very [movement] they call the two solstices of the sun, northern and southern.
“For all [beings], Meru is the north, and Lokāloka is the south.”

sanskrit_iast: udayāstamayāvitthaṃ sūryasya paribhāvayet // 110
meaning: उदयास्तमयावित्थं सूर्यस्य परिभावयेत् // 110
text_mt: In this manner one should contemplate the sunrise and sunset.

sanskrit_iast:
ardharātro'marāvatyāṃ yāmyāyāmastameva ca /
madhyandinaṃ tadvāruṇyāṃ saumye sūryodayaḥ smṛtaḥ // 111
meaning:
अर्धरात्रोऽमरावत्यां याम्यायामस्तमेव च /
मध्यन्दिनं तद्वारुण्यां सौम्ये सूर्योदयः स्मृतः // 111
text_mt: When it is midnight in Amarāvatī, it is sunset in the southern [city]; / likewise, it is midday in the western, and sunrise is taught to be in the northern.

sanskrit_iast:
udayo yo'marāvatyāṃ so'rdharātro yamālaye /
ke'staṃ saumye ca madhyāhna itthaṃ sūryagatāgate // 112
meaning:
उदयो योऽमरावत्यां सोऽर्धरात्रो यमालये /
केऽस्तं सौम्ये च मध्याह्न इत्थं सूर्यगतागते // 112
text_mt: What is sunrise in Amarāvatī is midnight in the abode of Yama, / sunset in [the western city], and midday in the northern: such are the sun's movements.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcatriṃ śatkoṭisaṃkhyā lakṣāṇyekonaviṃśatiḥ /
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi dhvāntaṃ lokācalādbahiḥ // 113
meaning:
पञ्चत्रिं शत्कोटिसंख्या लक्षाण्येकोनविंशतिः /
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि ध्वान्तं लोकाचलाद्बहिः // 113
text_mt: Thirty-five crores, / nineteen lakhs, / and forty thousand [yojanas] of darkness extend beyond the world-mountain [Lokāloka].

sanskrit_iast:
saptasāgaramānastu garbhodākhyaḥ samudrarāṭ /
lokālokasya parato yadgarbhe nikhilaiva bhūḥ // 114
meaning:
सप्तसागरमानस्तु गर्भोदाख्यः समुद्रराट् /
लोकालोकस्य परतो यद्गर्भे निखिलैव भूः // 114
text_mt:
saptasāgaramānastu garbhodākhyaḥ samudrarāṭ
lokālokasya parato yadgarbhe nikhilaiva bhūḥ // 114

sanskrit_iast:
siddhātantre'tra garbhābdhestīre kauśeyasaṃjñitam /
maṇḍalaṃ garuḍastatra siddhapakṣasamāvṛtaḥ // 115
meaning:
सिद्धातन्त्रेऽत्र गर्भाब्धेस्तीरे कौशेयसंज्ञितम् /
मण्डलं गरुडस्तत्र सिद्धपक्षसमावृतः // 115
text_mt:
siddhātantre@tra garbhābdhestīre kauśeyasaṃjñitam
maṇḍalaṃ garuḍastatra siddhapakṣasamāvṛtaḥ // 115

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍantiṃ parvatāgre te nava cātra kulādrayaḥ /
tata uṣṇodakāstriṃśannadyaḥpātālagāstataḥ // 116
meaning:
क्रीडन्तिं पर्वताग्रे ते नव चात्र कुलाद्रयः /
तत उष्णोदकास्त्रिंशन्नद्यःपातालगास्ततः // 116
text_mt:
krīḍantiṃ parvatāgre te nava cātra kulādrayaḥ
tata uṣṇodakāstriṃśannadyaḥpātālagāstataḥ // 116

sanskrit_iast:
caturdiṅnaimirodyānaṃ yoginīsevitaṃ sadā /
tato merustato nāgā meghā hemāṇḍakaṃ tataḥ // 117
meaning:
चतुर्दिङ्नैमिरोद्यानं योगिनीसेवितं सदा /
ततो मेरुस्ततो नागा मेघा हेमाण्डकं ततः // 117
text_mt:
caturdiṅnaimirodyānaṃ yoginīsevitaṃ sadā
tato merustato nāgā meghā hemāṇḍakaṃ tataḥ // 117

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo'ṇḍakaṭāhena merorardhena koṭayaḥ /
pañcāśadevaṃ daśasu dicu bhūrlokasaṃjñitam // 118
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोऽण्डकटाहेन मेरोरर्धेन कोटयः /
पञ्चाशदेवं दशसु दिचु भूर्लोकसंज्ञितम् // 118
text_mt:
brahmaṇo@ṇḍakaṭāhena merorardhena koṭayaḥ
pañcāśadevaṃ daśasu dicu bhūrlokasaṃjñitam // 118

sanskrit_iast:
paśukhagamṛgatarumānuṣasarīsṛpaiḥ ṣaḍbhireṣa bhūrlokaḥ /
vyāptaḥ piśācarakṣogandharvāṇāṃ sayakṣāṇām // 119
meaning:
पशुखगमृगतरुमानुषसरीसृपैः षड्भिरेष भूर्लोकः /
व्याप्तः पिशाचरक्षोगन्धर्वाणां सयक्षाणाम् // 119
text_mt:
paśukhagamṛgatarumānuṣasarīsṛpaiḥ ṣaḍbhireṣa bhūrlokaḥ
vyāptaḥ piśācarakṣogandharvāṇāṃ sayakṣāṇām // 119

sanskrit_iast:
vidyābhṛtāṃ ca kiṃ vā bahunā sarvasya bhūtasargasya /
abhimānato yatheṣṭaṃ bhogasthānaṃ nivāsaśca // 120
meaning:
विद्याभृतां च किं वा बहुना सर्वस्य भूतसर्गस्य /
अभिमानतो यथेष्टं भोगस्थानं निवासश्च // 120
text_mt:
vidyābhṛtāṃ ca kiṃ vā bahunā sarvasya bhūtasargasya
abhimānato yatheṣṭaṃ bhogasthānaṃ nivāsaśca // 120

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvarlokastathā tvārkāllakṣamekaṃ tadantare /
daśa vāyupathāste ca pratyekamayutāntarāḥ // 121
meaning:
भुवर्लोकस्तथा त्वार्काल्लक्षमेकं तदन्तरे /
दश वायुपथास्ते च प्रत्येकमयुतान्तराः // 121
text_mt:
bhuvarlokastathā tvārkāllakṣamekaṃ tadantare
daśa vāyupathāste ca pratyekamayutāntarāḥ // 121

sanskrit_iast:
ādyo vāyupathastatra vitataḥ paricarcyate /
pañcāśadyojanordhve syādṛtarddhirnāma mārutaḥ // 122
meaning:
आद्यो वायुपथस्तत्र विततः परिचर्च्यते /
पञ्चाशद्योजनोर्ध्वे स्यादृतर्द्धिर्नाम मारुतः // 122
text_mt:
ādyo vāyupathastatra vitataḥ paricarcyate
pañcāśadyojanordhve syādṛtarddhirnāma mārutaḥ // 122

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyakaḥ sa jantūnāṃ tataḥ prācetaso bhavet /
pañcāśadyojanādūrdhva tasmādūrdhva śatena tu // 123
meaning:
आप्यायकः स जन्तूनां ततः प्राचेतसो भवेत् /
पञ्चाशद्योजनादूर्ध्व तस्मादूर्ध्व शतेन तु // 123
text_mt:
āpyāyakaḥ sa jantūnāṃ tataḥ prācetaso bhavet
pañcāśadyojanādūrdhva tasmādūrdhva śatena tu // 123

sanskrit_iast:
senānīvāyuratraite mūkameghāstaḍinmucaḥ /
ye mahyāḥ krośamātreṇa tiṣṭhanti jalavarṣiṇaḥ // 124
meaning:
सेनानीवायुरत्रैते मूकमेघास्तडिन्मुचः /
ये मह्याः क्रोशमात्रेण तिष्ठन्ति जलवर्षिणः // 124
text_mt:
senānīvāyuratraite mūkameghāstaḍinmucaḥ
ye mahyāḥ krośamātreṇa tiṣṭhanti jalavarṣiṇaḥ // 124

sanskrit_iast:
tebhya ūrdhva śatānmeghā bhekādiprāṇivarṣiṇaḥ /
pañcāśadūrdhvamogho'tra viṣavāripravarṣiṇaḥ // 125
meaning:
तेभ्य ऊर्ध्व शतान्मेघा भेकादिप्राणिवर्षिणः /
पञ्चाशदूर्ध्वमोघोऽत्र विषवारिप्रवर्षिणः // 125
text_mt:
tebhya ūrdhva śatānmeghā bhekādiprāṇivarṣiṇaḥ
pañcāśadūrdhvamogho@tra viṣavāripravarṣiṇaḥ // 125

sanskrit_iast:
meghāḥ skandodbhavāścānye piśācā oghamārute /
tataḥ pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ syurmeghā mārakasaṃjñakāḥ // 126
meaning:
मेघाः स्कन्दोद्भवाश्चान्ये पिशाचा ओघमारुते /
ततः पञ्चाशदूर्ध्वं स्युर्मेघा मारकसंज्ञकाः // 126
text_mt:
meghāḥ skandodbhavāścānye piśācā oghamārute
tataḥ pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ syurmeghā mārakasaṃjñakāḥ // 126

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthāne mahādevajanmānaste vināyakāḥ /
ye haranti kṛtaṃ karma narāṇāmakṛtātmanām // 127
meaning:
तत्र स्थाने महादेवजन्मानस्ते विनायकाः /
ये हरन्ति कृतं कर्म नराणामकृतात्मनाम् // 127
text_mt:
tatra sthāne mahādevajanmānaste vināyakāḥ
ye haranti kṛtaṃ karma narāṇāmakṛtātmanām // 127

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ vajrāṅko vāyuratropalāmbudāḥ /
vidyādharādhamāścātra vajrāṅke saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ // 128
meaning:
पञ्चाशदूर्ध्वं वज्राङ्को वायुरत्रोपलाम्बुदाः /
विद्याधराधमाश्चात्र वज्राङ्के संप्रतिष्ठिताः // 128
text_mt:
pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ vajrāṅko vāyuratropalāmbudāḥ
vidyādharādhamāścātra vajrāṅke saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ // 128

sanskrit_iast:
ye vidyāpauruṣe ye ca śmaśānādiprasādhane /
mṛtāstatsiddhisiddhāste vajrāṃke maruti sthitāḥ // 129
meaning:
ये विद्यापौरुषे ये च श्मशानादिप्रसाधने /
मृतास्तत्सिद्धिसिद्धास्ते वज्रांके मरुति स्थिताः // 129
text_mt:
ye vidyāpauruṣe ye ca śmaśānādiprasādhane
mṛtāstatsiddhisiddhāste vajrāṃke maruti sthitāḥ // 129

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ vajrāṃkādvaidyuto'śanivarṣiṇaḥ /
abdā apsarasaścātra ye ca puṇyakṛto narāḥ // 130
meaning:
पञ्चाशदूर्ध्वं वज्रांकाद्वैद्युतोऽशनिवर्षिणः /
अब्दा अप्सरसश्चात्र ये च पुण्यकृतो नराः // 130
text_mt:
pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ vajrāṃkādvaidyuto@śanivarṣiṇaḥ
abdā apsarasaścātra ye ca puṇyakṛto narāḥ // 130

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgau vahnau jale ye ca saṃgrāme cānivartinaḥ /
gograhe vadhyamokṣe vā mṛtāste vaidyute sthitāḥ // 131
meaning:
भृगौ वह्नौ जले ये च संग्रामे चानिवर्तिनः /
गोग्रहे वध्यमोक्षे वा मृतास्ते वैद्युते स्थिताः // 131
text_mt:
bhṛgau vahnau jale ye ca saṃgrāme cānivartinaḥ
gograhe vadhyamokṣe vā mṛtāste vaidyute sthitāḥ // 131

sanskrit_iast:
vaidyutādraivatastāvāṃstatra puṣṭivahāmbudāḥ /
ūrdhvaṃ ca rogāmbumucaḥ saṃvartāstadanantare // 132
meaning:
वैद्युताद्रैवतस्तावांस्तत्र पुष्टिवहाम्बुदाः /
ऊर्ध्वं च रोगाम्बुमुचः संवर्तास्तदनन्तरे // 132
text_mt:
vaidyutādraivatastāvāṃstatra puṣṭivahāmbudāḥ
ūrdhvaṃ ca rogāmbumucaḥ saṃvartāstadanantare // 132

sanskrit_iast:
rocanāñjanabhasmādisiddhāstatraiva raivate /
krodhodakamucāṃ sthānaṃ viṣāvartaḥ sa mārutaḥ // 133
meaning:
रोचनाञ्जनभस्मादिसिद्धास्तत्रैव रैवते /
क्रोधोदकमुचां स्थानं विषावर्तः स मारुतः // 133
text_mt:
rocanāñjanabhasmādisiddhāstatraiva raivate
krodhodakamucāṃ sthānaṃ viṣāvartaḥ sa mārutaḥ // 133

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ tatraiva durdinābdā hutāśajāḥ /
vidyādharaviśeṣāśca tathā ye parameśvaram // 134
meaning:
पञ्चाशदूर्ध्वं तत्रैव दुर्दिनाब्दा हुताशजाः /
विद्याधरविशेषाश्च तथा ये परमेश्वरम् // 134
text_mt:
pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ tatraiva durdinābdā hutāśajāḥ
vidyādharaviśeṣāśca tathā ye parameśvaram // 134

sanskrit_iast:
gāndharveṇa sadārcanti viṣāvarte'tha te sthitāḥ /
viṣāvartācchatādūrdhva durjayaḥ śvāsasaṃbhavaḥ // 135
meaning:
गान्धर्वेण सदार्चन्ति विषावर्तेऽथ ते स्थिताः /
विषावर्ताच्छतादूर्ध्व दुर्जयः श्वाससंभवः // 135
text_mt:
gāndharveṇa sadārcanti viṣāvarte@tha te sthitāḥ
viṣāvartācchatādūrdhva durjayaḥ śvāsasaṃbhavaḥ // 135

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇo'tra sthitā meghāḥ pralaye vātakāriṇaḥ /
puṣkarābdā vāyugamā gandharvāśca parāvahe // 136
meaning:
ब्रह्मणोऽत्र स्थिता मेघाः प्रलये वातकारिणः /
पुष्कराब्दा वायुगमा गन्धर्वाश्च परावहे // 136
text_mt:
brahmaṇo@tra sthitā meghāḥ pralaye vātakāriṇaḥ
puṣkarābdā vāyugamā gandharvāśca parāvahe // 136

sanskrit_iast:
jīmūtameghāstatsaṃjñāstathā vidyādharottamāḥ /
ye ca rūpavratā lokā āvahe te pratiṣṭhitāḥ // 137
meaning:
जीमूतमेघास्तत्संज्ञास्तथा विद्याधरोत्तमाः /
ये च रूपव्रता लोका आवहे ते प्रतिष्ठिताः // 137
text_mt:
jīmūtameghāstatsaṃjñāstathā vidyādharottamāḥ
ye ca rūpavratā lokā āvahe te pratiṣṭhitāḥ // 137

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvahe tvīśakṛtāḥ prajāhitakarāmbudāḥ /
mahāparivahe meghāḥ kapālotthā maheśituḥ // 138
meaning:
महावहे त्वीशकृताः प्रजाहितकराम्बुदाः /
महापरिवहे मेघाः कपालोत्था महेशितुः // 138
text_mt:
mahāvahe tvīśakṛtāḥ prajāhitakarāmbudāḥ
mahāparivahe meghāḥ kapālotthā maheśituḥ // 138

sanskrit_iast:
mahāparivahānto'yamṛtarddheḥ prāṅmarutpathaḥ /
agnikanyā mātaraśca rudraśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitāḥ // 139
meaning:
महापरिवहान्तोऽयमृतर्द्धेः प्राङ्मरुत्पथः /
अग्निकन्या मातरश्च रुद्रशक्त्या त्वधिष्ठिताः // 139
text_mt:
mahāparivahānto@yamṛtarddheḥ prāṅmarutpathaḥ
agnikanyā mātaraśca rudraśaktyā tvadhiṣṭhitāḥ // 139

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīye tatpare siddhacāraṇā nijakarmajāḥ /
turye devāyudhānyaṣṭau diggajāḥ pañcame punaḥ // 140
meaning:
द्वितीये तत्परे सिद्धचारणा निजकर्मजाः /
तुर्ये देवायुधान्यष्टौ दिग्गजाः पञ्चमे पुनः // 140
text_mt:
dvitīye tatpare siddhacāraṇā nijakarmajāḥ
turye devāyudhānyaṣṭau diggajāḥ pañcame punaḥ // 140

sanskrit_iast:

dakṣastu navame brahmaśaktyā samadhiti[ni]ṣṭhitaḥ // 141
meaning:
षष्ठे गरुत्मानन्यस्मिङ्गङ्गान्यत्र वृषो विभुः /
दक्षस्तु नवमे ब्रह्मशक्त्या समधिति[नि]ष्ठितः // 141
text_mt:
ṣaṣṭhe garutmānanyasmiṅgaṅgānyatra vṛṣo vibhuḥ
dakṣastu navame brahmaśaktyā samadhiti[ni]ṣṭhitaḥ // 141

sanskrit_iast:
daśame vasavo rudrā ādityāśca marutpathe /
navayojanasāhasro vigraho'rkasya maṇḍalam // 142
meaning:
दशमे वसवो रुद्रा आदित्याश्च मरुत्पथे /
नवयोजनसाहस्रो विग्रहोऽर्कस्य मण्डलम् // 142
text_mt:
daśame vasavo rudrā ādityāśca marutpathe
navayojanasāhasro vigraho@rkasya maṇḍalam // 142

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇaṃ jñānaśaktiḥ sā tapatyarkatayā prabhoḥ /
svarlokastu bhuvarlokāddhruvāntaṃ paribhāṣyate // 143
meaning:
त्रिगुणं ज्ञानशक्तिः सा तपत्यर्कतया प्रभोः /
स्वर्लोकस्तु भुवर्लोकाद्ध्रुवान्तं परिभाष्यते // 143
text_mt:
triguṇaṃ jñānaśaktiḥ sā tapatyarkatayā prabhoḥ
svarlokastu bhuvarlokāddhruvāntaṃ paribhāṣyate // 143

sanskrit_iast:
sūryāllakṣeṇa śītāṃśuḥ kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya sā /
candrāllakṣeṇa nākṣatraṃ tato lakṣadvayena tu // 144
meaning:
सूर्याल्लक्षेण शीतांशुः क्रियाशक्तिः शिवस्य सा /
चन्द्राल्लक्षेण नाक्षत्रं ततो लक्षद्वयेन तु // 144
text_mt:
sūryāllakṣeṇa śītāṃśuḥ kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya sā
candrāllakṣeṇa nākṣatraṃ tato lakṣadvayena tu // 144

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ bhaumataḥ sūryasutānte pañcakaṃ viduḥ /
saurāllakṣeṇa saptarṣivargastasmāddhruvastathā // 145
meaning:
प्रत्येकं भौमतः सूर्यसुतान्ते पञ्चकं विदुः /
सौराल्लक्षेण सप्तर्षिवर्गस्तस्माद्ध्रुवस्तथा // 145
text_mt:
pratyekaṃ bhaumataḥ sūryasutānte pañcakaṃ viduḥ
saurāllakṣeṇa saptarṣivargastasmāddhruvastathā // 145

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaivāpararūpeṇa brahmasthāne dhruvo'calaḥ /
medhībhūto vimānānāṃ sarveṣāmupari dhruvaḥ // 146
meaning:
ब्रह्मैवापररूपेण ब्रह्मस्थाने ध्रुवोऽचलः /
मेधीभूतो विमानानां सर्वेषामुपरि ध्रुवः // 146
text_mt:
brahmaivāpararūpeṇa brahmasthāne dhruvo@calaḥ
medhībhūto vimānānāṃ sarveṣāmupari dhruvaḥ // 146

sanskrit_iast:
atra baddhāni sarvāṇyapyūhyante'nilamaṇḍale /
svassapta mārutaskandhā āmeghādyāḥ pradhānataḥ // 147
meaning:
अत्र बद्धानि सर्वाण्यप्यूह्यन्तेऽनिलमण्डले /
स्वस्सप्त मारुतस्कन्धा आमेघाद्याः प्रधानतः // 147
text_mt:
atra baddhāni sarvāṇyapyūhyante@nilamaṇḍale
svassapta mārutaskandhā āmeghādyāḥ pradhānataḥ // 147

sanskrit_iast:
itaśca kratuhotrādi kṛtvā jñānavivarjitāḥ /
svaryānti tatkṣaye lokaṃ mānuṣyaṃ puṇyaśeṣataḥ // 148
meaning:
इतश्च क्रतुहोत्रादि कृत्वा ज्ञानविवर्जिताः /
स्वर्यान्ति तत्क्षये लोकं मानुष्यं पुण्यशेषतः // 148
text_mt:
itaśca kratuhotrādi kṛtvā jñānavivarjitāḥ
svaryānti tatkṣaye lokaṃ mānuṣyaṃ puṇyaśeṣataḥ // 148

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ bhūmerdhruvāntaṃ syāllakṣāṇi daśa pañca ca /
dve koṭī pañca cāśītirlakṣāṇi svargato mahān // 149
meaning:
एवं भूमेर्ध्रुवान्तं स्याल्लक्षाणि दश पञ्च च /
द्वे कोटी पञ्च चाशीतिर्लक्षाणि स्वर्गतो महान् // 149
text_mt:
evaṃ bhūmerdhruvāntaṃ syāllakṣāṇi daśa pañca ca
dve koṭī pañca cāśītirlakṣāṇi svargato mahān // 149

sanskrit_iast:
mārkaṇḍādyā ṛṣimunisiddhāstatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
nivartitādhikārāśca devā mahati saṃsthitāḥ // 150
meaning:
मार्कण्डाद्या ऋषिमुनिसिद्धास्तत्र प्रतिष्ठिताः /
निवर्तिताधिकाराश्च देवा महति संस्थिताः // 150
text_mt:
mārkaṇḍādyā ṛṣimunisiddhāstatra pratiṣṭhitāḥ
nivartitādhikārāśca devā mahati saṃsthitāḥ // 150

sanskrit_iast:
mahāntarāle tatrānye tvadhikārabhujo janāḥ /
aṣṭau koṭyo mahallokājjano'tra kapilādayaḥ // 151
meaning:
महान्तराले तत्रान्ये त्वधिकारभुजो जनाः /
अष्टौ कोट्यो महल्लोकाज्जनोऽत्र कपिलादयः // 151
text_mt:
mahāntarāle tatrānye tvadhikārabhujo janāḥ
aṣṭau koṭyo mahallokājjano@tra kapilādayaḥ // 151

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhanti sādhyāstatraiva bahavaḥ sukhabhāginaḥ /
janāttaporkakoṭyo'tra sanakādyā mahādhiyaḥ // 152
meaning:
तिष्ठन्ति साध्यास्तत्रैव बहवः सुखभागिनः /
जनात्तपोर्ककोट्योऽत्र सनकाद्या महाधियः // 152
text_mt:
tiṣṭhanti sādhyāstatraiva bahavaḥ sukhabhāginaḥ
janāttaporkakoṭyo@tra sanakādyā mahādhiyaḥ // 152

sanskrit_iast:
prajāpatīnāṃ tatrādhikāro brahmātmajanmanām /
brahmālayastu tapasaḥ satyaḥ ṣoḍaśa koṭayaḥ // 153
meaning:
प्रजापतीनां तत्राधिकारो ब्रह्मात्मजन्मनाम् /
ब्रह्मालयस्तु तपसः सत्यः षोडश कोटयः // 153
text_mt:
prajāpatīnāṃ tatrādhikāro brahmātmajanmanām
brahmālayastu tapasaḥ satyaḥ ṣoḍaśa koṭayaḥ // 153

sanskrit_iast:
tatra sthitaḥ sa svayambhūrviśvamāviṣkarotyadaḥ /
satye vedāstathā cānye karmadhyānena bhāvitāḥ // 154
meaning:
तत्र स्थितः स स्वयम्भूर्विश्वमाविष्करोत्यदः /
सत्ये वेदास्तथा चान्ये कर्मध्यानेन भाविताः // 154
text_mt:
tatra sthitaḥ sa svayambhūrviśvamāviṣkarotyadaḥ
satye vedāstathā cānye karmadhyānena bhāvitāḥ // 154

sanskrit_iast:
ānandaniṣṭhāstatrordhvekoṭirvairiñcamāsanam /
brahmāsanātkoṭiyugmaṃ puraṃ viṣṇornirūpitam // 155
meaning:
आनन्दनिष्ठास्तत्रोर्ध्वेकोटिर्वैरिञ्चमासनम् /
ब्रह्मासनात्कोटियुग्मं पुरं विष्णोर्निरूपितम् // 155
text_mt:
ānandaniṣṭhāstatrordhvekoṭirvairiñcamāsanam
brahmāsanātkoṭiyugmaṃ puraṃ viṣṇornirūpitam // 155

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānapūjājapairviṣṇorbhaktā gacchanti tatpadam /
vaiṣṇavātsaptakoṭībhirbhuvanaṃ parameśituḥ // 156
meaning:
ध्यानपूजाजपैर्विष्णोर्भक्ता गच्छन्ति तत्पदम् /
वैष्णवात्सप्तकोटीभिर्भुवनं परमेशितुः // 156
text_mt:
dhyānapūjājapairviṣṇorbhaktā gacchanti tatpadam
vaiṣṇavātsaptakoṭībhirbhuvanaṃ parameśituḥ // 156

sanskrit_iast:
rudrasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārakarturbrahmāṇḍavartmani /
dīkṣājñānavihīnā ye liṅgārādhanatatparāḥ // 157
meaning:
रुद्रस्य सृष्टिसंहारकर्तुर्ब्रह्माण्डवर्त्मनि /
दीक्षाज्ञानविहीना ये लिङ्गाराधनतत्पराः // 157
text_mt:
rudrasya sṛṣṭisaṃhārakarturbrahmāṇḍavartmani
dīkṣājñānavihīnā ye liṅgārādhanatatparāḥ // 157

sanskrit_iast:
te yāntyaṇḍāntare raudraṃ puraṃ nādhaḥ kadācana /
tatsthāḥ sarve śivaṃ yānti rudrāḥ śrīkaṇṭhadīkṣitāḥ // 158
meaning:
ते यान्त्यण्डान्तरे रौद्रं पुरं नाधः कदाचन /
तत्स्थाः सर्वे शिवं यान्ति रुद्राः श्रीकण्ठदीक्षिताः // 158
text_mt:
te yāntyaṇḍāntare raudraṃ puraṃ nādhaḥ kadācana
tatsthāḥ sarve śivaṃ yānti rudrāḥ śrīkaṇṭhadīkṣitāḥ // 158

sanskrit_iast:
adhikārakṣaye sākaṃ rudrakanyāgaṇena te /
puraṃ puraṃ ca rudrordhvamuttarottaravṛddhitaḥ // 159
meaning:
अधिकारक्षये साकं रुद्रकन्यागणेन ते /
पुरं पुरं च रुद्रोर्ध्वमुत्तरोत्तरवृद्धितः // 159
text_mt:
When their term of office is exhausted, together with the host of Rudra-maidens,
they [proceed] from city to city above the Rudras through progressive ascent. // 159

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍādhaśca rudrordhva daṇḍapāṇeḥ puraṃ sa ca /
śivecchayā dṛṇātyaṇḍaṃ mokṣamārga karoti ca // 160
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डाधश्च रुद्रोर्ध्व दण्डपाणेः पुरं स च /
शिवेच्छया दृणात्यण्डं मोक्षमार्ग करोति च // 160
text_mt:
Below the cosmic egg of Brahmā and above the Rudras is the city of Daṇḍapāṇi; and he,
by Śiva's will, pierces the cosmic egg and prepares the path to liberation. // 160

sanskrit_iast:
śarvarudrau bhīmabhavāvugro devo mahānatha /
īśāna iti bhūrlokāt sapta lokeśvarāḥ śivāḥ // 161
meaning:
शर्वरुद्रौ भीमभवावुग्रो देवो महानथ /
ईशान इति भूर्लोकात् सप्त लोकेश्वराः शिवाः // 161
text_mt:
Śarva, Rudra, Bhīma, Bhava, Ugra, Mahādeva, and then
Īśāna—these seven, starting from Bhūrloka, are the benevolent lords of the worlds. // 161

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlairviśeṣairārabdhāḥ sapta lokāḥ pare punaḥ /
sūkṣmairiti guruścaiva rurau samyaṅnyarūpayat // 162
meaning:
स्थूलैर्विशेषैरारब्धाः सप्त लोकाः परे पुनः /
सूक्ष्मैरिति गुरुश्चैव रुरौ सम्यङ्न्यरूपयत् // 162
text_mt:
The seven worlds are constituted by the gross specific [elements], but the higher ones
by subtle ones—so the guru explained thoroughly in the Raurava. // 162

sanskrit_iast:
ye brahmaṇādisarge svaśarīrānnirmitāḥ prabhūtākhyāḥ /
sthūlāḥ pañca viśeṣāḥ saptāmī tanmayā lokāḥ // 163
meaning:
ये ब्रह्मणादिसर्गे स्वशरीरान्निर्मिताः प्रभूताख्याः /
स्थूलाः पञ्च विशेषाः सप्तामी तन्मया लोकाः // 163
text_mt:
Those five gross specific [elements] termed 'elements' (prabhūta), created by Brahmā and others from their own bodies at the beginning of creation—
these seven worlds consist of them. // 163

sanskrit_iast:
parato liṅgādhāraiḥ sūkṣmaistanmātrajairmahābhūtaiḥ /
lokānāmāvaraṇairviṣṭabhya parasperaṇa gandhādyaiḥ // 164
meaning:
परतो लिङ्गाधारैः सूक्ष्मैस्तन्मात्रजैर्महाभूतैः /
लोकानामावरणैर्विष्टभ्य परस्पेरण गन्धाद्यैः // 164
text_mt:
Beyond that, [the worlds are constituted] by the subtle gross elements born of the subtle elements, which are the receptacles of subtle bodies;
supporting each other through smell and the other [qualities] as the coverings of the worlds. // 164

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnerdaṇḍapāṇyantamaṣṭānavatikoṭayaḥ /
ata ūrdhvaṃ kaṭāho'ṇḍe sa ghanaḥ koṭiyojanam // 165
meaning:
कालाग्नेर्दण्डपाण्यन्तमष्टानवतिकोटयः /
अत ऊर्ध्वं कटाहोऽण्डे स घनः कोटियोजनम् // 165
text_mt:
From Kālāgni up to Daṇḍapāṇi is ninety-eight crores [of yojanas].
Above this, the hemisphere of the cosmic egg is solid, one crore of yojanas [thick]. // 165

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśatkoṭayaścordhvaṃ bhūpṛṣṭhādadharaṃ tathā /
evaṃ koṭiśataṃ bhūḥ syāt sauvarṇastaṇḍulastataḥ // 166
meaning:
पञ्चाशत्कोटयश्चोर्ध्वं भूपृष्ठादधरं तथा /
एवं कोटिशतं भूः स्यात् सौवर्णस्तण्डुलस्ततः // 166
text_mt:
Fifty crores [extend] upward from the surface of the earth, and likewise below.
Thus the earth measures one hundred crores; beyond that is the golden grain. // 166

sanskrit_iast:
śatarudrāvadhirhuphaṭ bhedayettattu duḥśamam /
pratidikkaṃ daśa daśetyevaṃ rudraśataṃ bahiḥ // 167
meaning:
शतरुद्रावधिर्हुफट् भेदयेत्तत्तु दुःशमम् /
प्रतिदिक्कं दश दशेत्येवं रुद्रशतं बहिः // 167
text_mt:
Reaching up to the hundred Rudras, 'huṃ phaṭ' pierces that which is difficult to subdue.
Ten in each direction: thus a hundred Rudras dwell outside, // 167

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇḍādhārakaṃ tacca svaprabhāveṇa sarvataḥ /
aṇḍasvarūpaṃ gurubhiścoktaṃ śrīrauravādiṣu // 168
meaning:
ब्रह्माण्डाधारकं तच्च स्वप्रभावेण सर्वतः /
अण्डस्वरूपं गुरुभिश्चोक्तं श्रीरौरवादिषु // 168
text_mt:
supporting the cosmic egg everywhere by their own power.
The nature of the cosmic egg has also been explained by the teachers in the venerable Raurava and other scriptures: // 168

sanskrit_iast:
vyakterabhimukhībhūtaḥ pracyutaḥ śaktirūpataḥ /
āvāpavānanirbhakto vastupiṇḍo'ṇḍa ucyate // 169
meaning:
व्यक्तेरभिमुखीभूतः प्रच्युतः शक्तिरूपतः /
आवापवाननिर्भक्तो वस्तुपिण्डोऽण्ड उच्यते // 169
text_mt:
'Turned toward manifestation, fallen from the condition of power,
having internal differentiation and undivided—such an aggregate of entities is called a cosmic egg.' // 169

sanskrit_iast:
tamoleśānuviddhasya kapālaṃ sattvamuttaram /
rajo'nuviddhaṃ nirmṛṣṭaṃ sattvamasyādharaṃ tamaḥ // 170
meaning:
तमोलेशानुविद्धस्य कपालं सत्त्वमुत्तरम् /
रजोऽनुविद्धं निर्मृष्टं सत्त्वमस्याधरं तमः // 170
text_mt:
Its upper hemisphere is sattva touched by a trace of tamas;
its lower hemisphere is tamas, wiped clean [yet] touched by rajas and sattva. // 170

sanskrit_iast:
vastupiṇḍa iti proktaṃ śivaśaktisamūhabhāk /
aṇḍaḥ syāditi tadvyaktau saṃmukhībhāva ucyate // 171
meaning:
वस्तुपिण्ड इति प्रोक्तं शिवशक्तिसमूहभाक् /
अण्डः स्यादिति तद्व्यक्तौ संमुखीभाव उच्यते // 171
text_mt:
It is called an 'aggregate of entities' because it comprises the collection of Śiva's powers;
that it 'would be a cosmic egg' means it is oriented toward its manifestation. // 171

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi śivamagnānāṃ śaktīnāmaṇḍatā bhavet /
tadartha vākyamaparaṃ tā hi na cyutaśaktitaḥ // 172
meaning:
तथापि शिवमग्नानां शक्तीनामण्डता भवेत् /
तदर्थ वाक्यमपरं ता हि न च्युतशक्तितः // 172
text_mt:
Even so, powers merged in Śiva could be considered a cosmic egg;
for that purpose another phrase [is given]: 'they indeed have not fallen from the condition of power.' // 172

sanskrit_iast:
tanvakṣādau mā prasāṅkṣīdaṇḍateti padāntaram /
tanvakṣādiṣu naivāste kasyāpyāvāpanaṃ yataḥ // 173
meaning:
तन्वक्षादौ मा प्रसाङ्क्षीदण्डतेति पदान्तरम् /
तन्वक्षादिषु नैवास्ते कस्याप्यावापनं यतः // 173
text_mt:
Lest the nature of a cosmic egg be erroneously applied to the body, sense organs, and so on, there is another word:
for in the body, sense organs, and so forth, there is no internal differentiation whatsoever. // 173

sanskrit_iast:
tanvakṣasamudāyatve kathamekatvamityataḥ /
anirbhakta iti proktaṃ sājātyaparidarśakam // 174
meaning:
तन्वक्षसमुदायत्वे कथमेकत्वमित्यतः /
अनिर्भक्त इति प्रोक्तं साजात्यपरिदर्शकम् // 174
text_mt:
To answer how oneness exists when there is an aggregate of bodies, organs, and so on,
it is said to be 'undivided', indicating a common genus. // 174

sanskrit_iast:
vināpi vastupiṇḍākhyapadenaikaikaśo bhavet /
tattveṣvaṇḍasvabhāvatvaṃ nanvevamapi kiṃ na tat // 175
meaning:
विनापि वस्तुपिण्डाख्यपदेनैकैकशो भवेत् /
तत्त्वेष्वण्डस्वभावत्वं नन्वेवमपि किं न तत् // 175
text_mt:
[Objection:] Even without the term 'aggregate of entities', each principle individually
would possess the nature of a cosmic egg. Indeed, even so, why is it not that? // 175

sanskrit_iast:
guṇatanmātrabhūtaughamaye tattve prasajyate /
ucyate vastuśabdena tanvakṣabhuvanātmakam // 176
meaning:
गुणतन्मात्रभूतौघमये तत्त्वे प्रसज्यते /
उच्यते वस्तुशब्देन तन्वक्षभुवनात्मकम् // 176
text_mt:
It would apply to a principle consisting of the guṇas, subtle elements, and gross elements.
[Reply:] By the word 'entity' (vastu) is meant that which consists of body, organs, and worlds; // 176

sanskrit_iast:
rūpamuktaṃ yatastena tatsamūho'ṇḍa ucyate /
bhavecca tatsamūhatvaṃ patyurviśvavapurbhṛtaḥ // 177
meaning:
रूपमुक्तं यतस्तेन तत्समूहोऽण्ड उच्यते /
भवेच्च तत्समूहत्वं पत्युर्विश्ववपुर्भृतः // 177
text_mt:
since that form has been stated, their aggregate is called a cosmic egg.
And that status of an aggregate would also belong to the Lord who bears the cosmic form; // 177

sanskrit_iast:
tadartha bhedakānyanyānyupāttānīti darśitam /
tāvanmātrāsvavasthāsu māyādhīne'dhvamaṇḍale // 178
meaning:
तदर्थ भेदकान्यन्यान्युपात्तानीति दर्शितम् /
तावन्मात्रास्ववस्थासु मायाधीनेऽध्वमण्डले // 178
text_mt:
for that reason other distinguishing terms have been adopted—this has been shown.
In such states alone, within the circle of the path dependent on Māyā, // 178

sanskrit_iast:
mā bhūdaṇḍatvamityāhuranye bhedakayojanam /
itthamuktaviriñcāṇḍamṛto rudrāḥ śataṃ hi yat // 179
meaning:
मा भूदण्डत्वमित्याहुरन्ये भेदकयोजनम् /
इत्थमुक्तविरिञ्चाण्डमृतो रुद्राः शतं हि यत् // 179
text_mt:
lest there be egg-nature—so say others explaining the application of the distinguishing attributes.
Thus, outside the described cosmic egg of Brahmā, there are indeed a hundred Rudras; // 179

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ sve patayo rudrā ekādaśa mahārciṣaḥ /
ananto'tha kapālyāgniryamanairṛtakau balaḥ // 180
meaning:
तेषां स्वे पतयो रुद्रा एकादश महार्चिषः /
अनन्तोऽथ कपाल्याग्निर्यमनैरृतकौ बलः // 180
text_mt:
their own lords are eleven Rudras of great radiance:
Ananta, then Kapālī, Agni, Yama, Nirṛti, Bala, // 180

sanskrit_iast:
śīghro nidhīśo vidyeśaḥ śambhuḥ savīrabhadrakaḥ /
madhu madhukṛtaḥ kadambaṃ kesarajālāni yadvadāvṛṇate // 181
meaning:
शीघ्रो निधीशो विद्येशः शम्भुः सवीरभद्रकः /
मधु मधुकृतः कदम्बं केसरजालानि यद्वदावृणते // 181
text_mt:
Śīghra, Nidhīśa, Vidyeśa, Śambhu, together with Vīrabhadra.
Just as the filaments enclose the sweet kadamba blossom that produces honey, // 181

sanskrit_iast:
tadvatte śivarudrā brahmāṇḍamasaṃkhyaparivārāḥ /
śarāṣṭaniyutaṃ koṭirityeṣāṃ sanniveśanam // 182
meaning:
तद्वत्ते शिवरुद्रा ब्रह्माण्डमसंख्यपरिवाराः /
शराष्टनियुतं कोटिरित्येषां सन्निवेशनम् // 182
text_mt:
so these Rudras of Śiva, having countless retinues, surround the cosmic egg;
their disposition is five times eight lakhs, one crore. // 182

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭhādhiṣṭhitāste ca sṛjanti saṃharanti ca /
īśvaratvaṃ diviṣadāmiti rauravavārtike // 183
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठाधिष्ठितास्ते च सृजन्ति संहरन्ति च /
ईश्वरत्वं दिविषदामिति रौरववार्तिके // 183
text_mt:
And presided over by Śrīkaṇṭha, they create and dissolve;
such is the lordship over the celestials, according to the Rauravavārttika. // 183

sanskrit_iast:
siddhātantre tu hemāṇḍācchatakoṭerbahiḥ śatam /
aṇḍānāṃ kramaśo dvidviguṇaṃ rūpyādiyojitam // 184
meaning:
सिद्धातन्त्रे तु हेमाण्डाच्छतकोटेर्बहिः शतम् /
अण्डानां क्रमशो द्विद्विगुणं रूप्यादियोजितम् // 184
text_mt:
In the Siddhātantra, however, outside the hundred crores of the golden egg, there are a hundred
cosmic eggs, sequentially doubled in size, made of silver and so on. // 184

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu krameṇa brahmāṇaḥ saṃsyurdviguṇajīvitāḥ /
kṣīyante kramaśaste ca tadante tattvamammayam // 185
meaning:
तेषु क्रमेण ब्रह्माणः संस्युर्द्विगुणजीविताः /
क्षीयन्ते क्रमशस्ते च तदन्ते तत्त्वमम्मयम् // 185
text_mt:
In them, in succession, there are Brahmās whose lifespans are doubled;
they are destroyed in turn, and at their end is the water principle. // 185

sanskrit_iast:
dharāto'tra jalādi syāduttarottarataḥ kramāt /
daśadhāhaṅkṛtāntaṃ dhīstasyāḥ syācchatadhā tataḥ // 186
meaning:
धरातोऽत्र जलादि स्यादुत्तरोत्तरतः क्रमात् /
दशधाहङ्कृतान्तं धीस्तस्याः स्याच्छतधा ततः // 186
text_mt:
From the earth here, water and the rest proceed upward in succession:
[the sphere of water] ten times [the earth], intellect up to egoity ten times [that], and beyond that [prakṛti] a hundred times; // 186

sanskrit_iast:
sahasradhā vyaktamataḥ pauṃsnaṃ daśasahasradhā /
niyatirlakṣadhā tasmāttasyāstu daśalakṣadhā // 187
meaning:
सहस्रधा व्यक्तमतः पौंस्नं दशसहस्रधा /
नियतिर्लक्षधा तस्मात्तस्यास्तु दशलक्षधा // 187
text_mt:
then the unmanifest a thousand times; the self ten thousand times;
niyati a hundred thousand times; and above that [rāga] ten hundred thousand times; // 187

sanskrit_iast:
kalāntaṃ koṭidhā tasmānmāyā viddaśakoṭidhā /
īśvaraḥ śatakoṭiḥ syāttasmātkoṭisahasradhā // 188
meaning:
कलान्तं कोटिधा तस्मान्माया विद्दशकोटिधा /
ईश्वरः शतकोटिः स्यात्तस्मात्कोटिसहस्रधा // 188
text_mt:
up to kalā a crore of times; from that, Māyā a crore; knowledge ten crores;
Īśvara a hundred crores; and beyond that [Sadāśiva] a thousand crores; // 188

sanskrit_iast:
sādākhyaṃ vyaśnute tacca śaktirvṛndena saṃkhyayā /
vyāpinī sarvamadhvānaṃ vyāpyadevī vyavasthitā // 189
meaning:
सादाख्यं व्यश्नुते तच्च शक्तिर्वृन्देन संख्यया /
व्यापिनी सर्वमध्वानं व्याप्यदेवी व्यवस्थिता // 189
text_mt:
it pervades the Sadāśiva principle; and Śakti, with her multitudes,
as the all-pervading goddess, Vyāpinī, stands pervading the entire path. // 189

sanskrit_iast:
aprameyaṃ tataḥ śuddhaṃ śivatattvaṃ paraṃ viduḥ /
jalādeḥ śivatattvāntaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ kenacicchivāt // 190
meaning:
अप्रमेयं ततः शुद्धं शिवतत्त्वं परं विदुः /
जलादेः शिवतत्त्वान्तं न दृष्टं केनचिच्छिवात् // 190
text_mt:
Beyond that, they know the immeasurable, pure Śiva principle to be supreme.
From water up to the Śiva principle, nothing has been seen by anyone except from Śiva; // 190

sanskrit_iast:
ṛte tataḥ śivajñānaṃ paramaṃ mokṣakāraṇam /
tathā cāha mahādevaḥ śrīmatsvacchandaśāsane // 191
meaning:
ऋते ततः शिवज्ञानं परमं मोक्षकारणम् /
तथा चाह महादेवः श्रीमत्स्वच्छन्दशासने // 191
text_mt:
therefore knowledge of Śiva is the supreme cause of liberation.
And so the Great God declared in the venerable Svacchandaśāsana: // 191

sanskrit_iast:
nānyathā mokṣamāyāti paśurjñānaśatairapi /
śivajñānaṃ na bhavati dīkṣāmaprāpya śāṅkarīm // 192
meaning:
नान्यथा मोक्षमायाति पशुर्ज्ञानशतैरपि /
शिवज्ञानं न भवति दीक्षामप्राप्य शाङ्करीम् // 192
text_mt:
'The bound soul does not attain liberation otherwise, even through hundreds of teachings;
knowledge of Śiva does not arise without receiving the initiation of Śaṅkara.' // 192

sanskrit_iast:
prāktanī pārameśī sā pauruṣeyī ca sā punaḥ /
śatarudrordhvato bhadrakālyā nīlaprabhaṃ jayam // 193
meaning:
प्राक्तनी पारमेशी सा पौरुषेयी च सा पुनः /
शतरुद्रोर्ध्वतो भद्रकाल्या नीलप्रभं जयम् // 193
text_mt:
That [initiation] is primordial, belonging to the Supreme Lord, and it is also human.
Above the hundred Rudras is Jayā, the city of Bhadrakālī of blue lustre. // 193

sanskrit_iast:
na yajñadānatapasā prāpyaṃ kālyāḥ puraṃ jayam /
tadbhaktāstatra gacchanti tanmaṇḍalasudīkṣitāḥ // 194
meaning:
न यज्ञदानतपसा प्राप्यं काल्याः पुरं जयम् /
तद्भक्तास्तत्र गच्छन्ति तन्मण्डलसुदीक्षिताः // 194
text_mt:
Jayā, the city of Kālī, is not to be attained by sacrifice, gifts, or austerity;
her devotees go there, well-initiated in her maṇḍala. // 194

sanskrit_iast:
nirbījadīkṣayā mokṣaṃ dadāti parameśvarī /
vidyeśāvaraṇe dīkṣāṃ yāvatīṃ kurute nṛṇām // 195
meaning:
निर्बीजदीक्षया मोक्षं ददाति परमेश्वरी /
विद्येशावरणे दीक्षां यावतीं कुरुते नृणाम् // 195
text_mt:
Through seedless initiation, the Supreme Goddess grants liberation;
to whatever extent she performs initiation for men within the retinue of the Lord of Knowledge, // 195

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatīṃ gatimāyānti bhuvane'tra niveśitāḥ /
tataḥ koṭyā vīrabhadro yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ // 196
meaning:
तावतीं गतिमायान्ति भुवनेऽत्र निवेशिताः /
ततः कोट्या वीरभद्रो युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः // 196
text_mt:
to that extent they attain the destination, established in this realm.
Beyond that, at a distance of a crore, is Vīrabhadra, radiant as the fire of cosmic dissolution. // 196

sanskrit_iast:
vijayākhyaṃ puraṃ cāsya ye smaranto maheśvaram /
jaleṣu maruṣu cāgnau śiraśchedena vā mṛtāḥ // 197
meaning:
विजयाख्यं पुरं चास्य ये स्मरन्तो महेश्वरम् /
जलेषु मरुषु चाग्नौ शिरश्छेदेन वा मृताः // 197
text_mt:
And his city is called Vijayā; those who, remembering the Great Lord,
have died in water, in deserts, in fire, or by decapitation, // 197

sanskrit_iast:
te yānti bodhamaiśānaṃ vīrabhadraṃ mahādyutim /
vairabhadrordhvataḥ koṭirviṣkambhādvistṛtaṃ tridhā // 198
meaning:
ते यान्ति बोधमैशानं वीरभद्रं महाद्युतिम् /
वैरभद्रोर्ध्वतः कोटिर्विष्कम्भाद्विस्तृतं त्रिधा // 198
text_mt:
attain the divine consciousness, Vīrabhadra of great splendour.
Above Vīrabhadra's [city], one crore in diameter, extended threefold, // 198

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṇḍaṃ sālilaṃ tvaṇḍaṃ śakracāpākṛti sthitam /
ā vīrabhadrabhuvanādbhadrakālyālayāttathā // 199
meaning:
रुद्राण्डं सालिलं त्वण्डं शक्रचापाकृति स्थितम् /
आ वीरभद्रभुवनाद्भद्रकाल्यालयात्तथा // 199
text_mt:
is the cosmic egg of Rudra, the watery egg, situated in the shape of Indra's bow [a rainbow],
extending from the world of Vīrabhadra and the abode of Bhadrakālī, // 199

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśabhiranyaiśca bhuvanairupaśobhitam /
tato bhuvaḥ sahādreḥ pūrgandhatanmātradhāraṇāt // 200
meaning:
त्रयोदशभिरन्यैश्च भुवनैरुपशोभितम् /
ततो भुवः सहाद्रेः पूर्गन्धतन्मात्रधारणात् // 200
text_mt:
adorned with thirteen other worlds.
Beyond that is the city of Earth with the mountain: by holding the subtle element of smell, // 200

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtā gacchanti tāṃ bhūmiṃ dharitryāḥ paramāṃ budhāḥ /
abdheḥ puraṃ tatastvāpyaṃ rasatanmātradhāraṇāt // 201
meaning:
मृता गच्छन्ति तां भूमिं धरित्र्याः परमां बुधाः /
अब्धेः पुरं ततस्त्वाप्यं रसतन्मात्रधारणात् // 201
text_mt:
the wise, upon dying, go to that supreme land of the Earth.
Then is the city of the Ocean, watery, [attained] by holding the subtle element of taste. // 201

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śriyaḥ puraṃ rudrakrīḍāvataraṇeṣvatha /
prayāgādau śrīgirau ca viśeṣānmaraṇena tat // 202
meaning:
ततः श्रियः पुरं रुद्रक्रीडावतरणेष्वथ /
प्रयागादौ श्रीगिरौ च विशेषान्मरणेन तत् // 202
text_mt:
Then is the city of Śrī; and in the places of descent for Rudra's play,
at Prayāga and elsewhere, and especially through dying on Śrīparvata, [that city is attained]. // 202

sanskrit_iast:
sārasvataṃ puraṃ tasmācchabdabrahmavidāṃ padam /
rudrocitāstā mukhyatvādrudrebhyo'nyāstathā sthitāḥ // 203
meaning:
सारस्वतं पुरं तस्माच्छब्दब्रह्मविदां पदम् /
रुद्रोचितास्ता मुख्यत्वाद्रुद्रेभ्योऽन्यास्तथा स्थिताः // 203
text_mt:
Beyond that is the city of Sarasvatī, the abode of those who know the sound-Brahman;
those suitable for Rudras, being foremost, are situated distinct from the [ordinary] Rudras. // 203

sanskrit_iast:
pureṣu bahudhā gaṅgā devādau śrīḥ sarasvatī /
lakulādyamareśāntā aṣṭāvapsu surādhipāḥ // 204
meaning:
पुरेषु बहुधा गङ्गा देवादौ श्रीः सरस्वती /
लकुलाद्यमरेशान्ता अष्टावप्सु सुराधिपाः // 204
text_mt: In the cities the Gaṅgā flows in many streams; in heaven and elsewhere dwell Śrī and Sarasvatī; / and the eight lords of the gods, beginning with Lakulin and ending with Amareśa, reside in the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu taijasaṃ tattvaṃ śivāgneratra saṃsthitiḥ /
te cainaṃ vahnimāyānti vāhnīṃ ye dhāraṇāṃ śritāḥ // 205
meaning:
ततस्तु तैजसं तत्त्वं शिवाग्नेरत्र संस्थितिः /
ते चैनं वह्निमायान्ति वाह्नीं ये धारणां श्रिताः // 205
text_mt: Then, however, is the element of fire; here is the dwelling of the fire of Śiva. / And those who have relied upon the concentration on fire attain this fire. // 205

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavādiharīndvantaṃ taijase nāyakāṣṭakam /
prāṇasya bhuvanaṃ vāyordaśadhā daśadhā tu tat // 206
meaning:
भैरवादिहरीन्द्वन्तं तैजसे नायकाष्टकम् /
प्राणस्य भुवनं वायोर्दशधा दशधा तु तत् // 206
text_mt: In the fiery [element] there is an octad of rulers beginning with Bhairava and ending with Harīndu. / The realm of wind, of prāṇa, however, is tenfold and tenfold. // 206

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā tyaktvātha vā prāṇān kṛtvā tatraiva dhāraṇām /
taṃ viśanti mahātmāno vāyubhūtāḥ khamūrtayaḥ // 207
meaning:
ध्यात्वा त्यक्त्वाथ वा प्राणान् कृत्वा तत्रैव धारणाम् /
तं विशन्ति महात्मानो वायुभूताः खमूर्तयः // 207
text_mt: Having meditated, or else having abandoned the vital breaths, performing concentration right there, / the great-souled ones enter it, having become wind, forms of space. // 207

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmādigayaparyantamaṣṭakaṃ vāyutattvagam /
khatattve bhuvanaṃ vyomnaḥ prāpyaṃ tadvyomadhāraṇāt // 208
meaning:
भीमादिगयपर्यन्तमष्टकं वायुतत्त्वगम् /
खतत्त्वे भुवनं व्योम्नः प्राप्यं तद्व्योमधारणात् // 208
text_mt: The octad beginning with Bhīma and ending with Gaya belongs to the element of wind. / In the element of space is the realm of ether, attainable by concentration on that ether. // 208

sanskrit_iast:
vastrāpadāntaṃ sthāṇvādi vyomatattve surāṣṭakam /
adīkṣitā ye bhūteṣu śivatattvābhimāninaḥ // 209
meaning:
वस्त्रापदान्तं स्थाण्वादि व्योमतत्त्वे सुराष्टकम् /
अदीक्षिता ये भूतेषु शिवतत्त्वाभिमानिनः // 209
text_mt: The octad of gods beginning with Sthāṇu and ending with Vastrāpada is in the element of space. / Those uninitiated who identify with the principle of Śiva among the elements, // 209

sanskrit_iast:
