jñānahīnā api prauḍhadhāraṇāste'ṇḍato bahiḥ /
dharābdhitejo'nilakhapuragā dīkṣitāśca vā // 210
meaning:
ज्ञानहीना अपि प्रौढधारणास्तेऽण्डतो बहिः /
धराब्धितेजोऽनिलखपुरगा दीक्षिताश्च वा // 210
text_mt: though devoid of knowledge, having fully developed concentration, outside the egg [of Brahmā], / go to the cities of earth, water, fire, wind, and space; or those initiated // 210

sanskrit_iast:
tāvatsaṃskārayogārthaṃ na paraṃ padamīhitum /
tathāvidhāvatāreṣu mṛtāścāyataneṣu ye // 211
meaning:
तावत्संस्कारयोगार्थं न परं पदमीहितुम् /
तथाविधावतारेषु मृताश्चायतनेषु ये // 211
text_mt: merely for the sake of purification, without striving for the supreme state, / and those who die in sanctuaries during such incarnations, // 211

sanskrit_iast:
tatpadaṃ te samāsādya kramādyānti śivātmatām /
punaḥ punaridaṃ coktaṃ śrīmaddevyākhyayāmale // 212
meaning:
तत्पदं ते समासाद्य क्रमाद्यान्ति शिवात्मताम् /
पुनः पुनरिदं चोक्तं श्रीमद्देव्याख्ययामले // 212
text_mt: having attained that state, gradually attain the nature of Śiva. / And this has been stated again and again in the venerable Devyākhyayāmala. // 212

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkāmikāyāṃ kaśmīravarṇane coktavānvibhuḥ /
sureśvarīmahādhāmni ye mriyante ca tatpure // 213
meaning:
श्रीकामिकायां कश्मीरवर्णने चोक्तवान्विभुः /
सुरेश्वरीमहाधाम्नि ये म्रियन्ते च तत्पुरे // 213
text_mt: And in the venerable Kāmikā, in the description of Kashmir, the all-pervading Lord has spoken: / 'Those who die in the great abode of Sureśvarī and in that city, // 213

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇādyāḥ saṅkarāntāḥ paśavaḥ sthāvarāntagāḥ /
rudrajātaya evaite ityāha bhagavāñchivaḥ // 214
meaning:
ब्राह्मणाद्याः सङ्करान्ताः पशवः स्थावरान्तगाः /
रुद्रजातय एवैते इत्याह भगवाञ्छिवः // 214
text_mt: whether Brahmins down to mixed castes, animals, down to immovable beings, / are indeed of the lineage of Rudra'—thus spoke the blessed Śiva. // 214

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśāvaraṇādūrdhvamahaṅkārādadhaḥ priye /
tanmātrādimano'ntānāṃ purāṇi śivaśāsane // 215
meaning:
आकाशावरणादूर्ध्वमहङ्कारादधः प्रिये /
तन्मात्रादिमनोऽन्तानां पुराणि शिवशासने // 215
text_mt: Above the enclosure of space, and below the ego, O dear one, / are the cities of [the principles] beginning with the subtle elements and ending with the mind, according to the teaching of Śiva. // 215

sanskrit_iast:
pañcavarṇayutaṃ gandhatanmātramaṇḍalaṃ mahat /
ācchādya yojanānekakoṭibhiḥ sthitamantarā // 216
meaning:
पञ्चवर्णयुतं गन्धतन्मात्रमण्डलं महत् /
आच्छाद्य योजनानेककोटिभिः स्थितमन्तरा // 216
text_mt: The great orb of the subtle element of odor, endowed with five colors, / having covered many crores of leagues, is situated within. // 216

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ rasādimātrāṇāṃ maṇḍalāni svavarṇata /
śarvo bhavaḥ paśupatirīśo bhīma iti kramāt // 217
meaning:
एवं रसादिमात्राणां मण्डलानि स्ववर्णत /
शर्वो भवः पशुपतिरीशो भीम इति क्रमात् // 217
text_mt: In the same way are the orbs of the subtle elements of taste and the rest, according to their own colors. / Śarva, Bhava, Paśupati, Īśa, and Bhīma, in succession, // 217

sanskrit_iast:
tanmātreśā yadicchātaḥ śabdādyāḥ khādikāriṇaḥ /
tataḥ sūryenduvedānāṃ maṇḍalāni vibhurmahān // 218
meaning:
तन्मात्रेशा यदिच्छातः शब्दाद्याः खादिकारिणः /
ततः सूर्येन्दुवेदानां मण्डलानि विभुर्महान् // 218
text_mt: are the lords of the subtle elements, by whose will sound and the rest bring forth ether and the others. / Then are the orbs of the sun, moon, and Vedas; the all-pervading, the Great, // 218

sanskrit_iast:
ugraścetyeṣu patayastebhyo'rkendū sayājakau /
ityaṣṭau tanavaḥ śaṃbhoryāḥ parāḥ parikīrtitāḥ // 219
meaning:
उग्रश्चेत्येषु पतयस्तेभ्योऽर्केन्दू सयाजकौ /
इत्यष्टौ तनवः शंभोर्याः पराः परिकीर्तिताः // 219
text_mt: and Ugra are the lords in these; beyond them are the sun and the moon together with the sacrificer. / Thus are the eight cosmic forms of Śambhu which are proclaimed as supreme. // 219

sanskrit_iast:
aparā brahmaṇo'ṇḍe tā vyāpya sarvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ /
kalpe kalpe prasūyante dharādyāstābhya eva tu // 220
meaning:
अपरा ब्रह्मणोऽण्डे ता व्याप्य सर्वं व्यवस्थिताः /
कल्पे कल्पे प्रसूयन्ते धराद्यास्ताभ्य एव तु // 220
text_mt: The lower ones, having pervaded everything in the egg of Brahmā, are established; / in aeon after aeon, earth and the others are born from these alone. // 220

sanskrit_iast:
tato vāgādikarmākṣayuktaṃ karaṇamaṇḍalam /
agnīndraviṣṇumitrāḥ sabrahmāṇasteṣu nāyakāḥ // 221
meaning:
ततो वागादिकर्माक्षयुक्तं करणमण्डलम् /
अग्नीन्द्रविष्णुमित्राः सब्रह्माणस्तेषु नायकाः // 221
text_mt: Then comes the sphere of the organs of action, beginning with speech; / Agni, Indra, Viṣṇu, and Mitra, together with Brahmā, are the chiefs among them. // 221

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśamaṇḍalaṃ tasmācchrutaṃ buddhyakṣapañcakam /
digvidyudarkavaruṇabhuvaḥ śrotrādidevatāḥ // 222
meaning:
प्रकाशमण्डलं तस्माच्छ्रुतं बुद्ध्यक्षपञ्चकम् /
दिग्विद्युदर्कवरुणभुवः श्रोत्रादिदेवताः // 222
text_mt: Beyond that is the realm of light, taught as the five organs of sense; / the directions, lightning, sun, Varuṇa, and earth are the deities of hearing and the rest. // 222

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśamaṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ sthitaṃ pañcārthamaṇḍalam /
manomaṇḍalametasmāt somenādhiṣṭhitaṃ yataḥ // 223
meaning:
प्रकाशमण्डलादूर्ध्वं स्थितं पञ्चार्थमण्डलम् /
मनोमण्डलमेतस्मात् सोमेनाधिष्ठितं यतः // 223
text_mt: Above the realm of light is situated the realm of the five sense-objects. / Beyond this is the realm of the mind, because it is presided over by Soma; // 223

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyadeveṣvadhiṣṭhātā sāmyaiśvaryasukhātmakaḥ /
manodevastato divyaḥ somo vibhurudīritaḥ // 224
meaning:
बाह्यदेवेष्वधिष्ठाता साम्यैश्वर्यसुखात्मकः /
मनोदेवस्ततो दिव्यः सोमो विभुरुदीरितः // 224
text_mt: he is the presiding deity among the external gods, consisting of equanimity, sovereignty, and bliss. / Therefore the god of mind is said to be the divine, all-pervasive Soma. // 224

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi sakalākṣāṇāṃ yonerbuddhyakṣajanmanaḥ /
sthūlādicchagalāntāṣṭayuktaṃ cāhaṅkṛteḥ puram // 225
meaning:
ततोऽपि सकलाक्षाणां योनेर्बुद्ध्यक्षजन्मनः /
स्थूलादिच्छगलान्ताष्टयुक्तं चाहङ्कृतेः पुरम् // 225
text_mt: Beyond that, the source of all the sense-organs, which gives birth to the senses of cognition, / is the city of ego, endowed with an octad beginning with Sthūla and ending with Chagala. // 225

sanskrit_iast:
buddhitattvaṃ tato devayonyaṣṭakapurādhipam /
paiśācaprabhṛtibrāhmaparyantaṃ tacca kīrtitam // 226
meaning:
बुद्धितत्त्वं ततो देवयोन्यष्टकपुराधिपम् /
पैशाचप्रभृतिब्राह्मपर्यन्तं तच्च कीर्तितम् // 226
text_mt: Then comes the principle of intellect, master of the cities of the eight classes of divine beings; / and that is proclaimed as beginning with the Paiśāca and extending up to the Brāhma. // 226

sanskrit_iast:
etāni devayonīnāṃ sthānānyeva purāṇyataḥ /
avatīryātmajanmānaṃ dhyāyantaḥ saṃbhavanti te // 227
meaning:
एतानि देवयोनीनां स्थानान्येव पुराण्यतः /
अवतीर्यात्मजन्मानं ध्यायन्तः संभवन्ति ते // 227
text_mt: These are indeed the abodes of the divine classes, for the cities; / having descended, meditating upon their own origin, they are born. // 227

sanskrit_iast:
parameśaniyogācca codyamānāśca māyayā /
niyāmitā niyatyā ca brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ // 228
meaning:
परमेशनियोगाच्च चोद्यमानाश्च मायया /
नियामिता नियत्या च ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः // 228
text_mt: Impelled by the command of the Supreme Lord, spurred on by māyā, / and regulated by necessity (niyati), they [manifest] from Brahmā, whose birth is the unmanifest. // 228

sanskrit_iast:
vyajyante tena sargādau nāmarūpairanekadhā /
svāṃśanaiva mahātmāno na tyajanti svaketanam // 229
meaning:
व्यज्यन्ते तेन सर्गादौ नामरूपैरनेकधा /
स्वांशनैव महात्मानो न त्यजन्ति स्वकेतनम् // 229
text_mt: They are manifested by him at the beginning of creation in manifold ways through name and form; / yet the great-souled ones, through their own portion, do not abandon their own abode. // 229

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca śivatanāvidamadhikārapadasthitena guruṇā naḥ /
aṣṭānāṃ devānāṃ śaktyāvirbhāvayonayo hyetāḥ // 230
meaning:
उक्तं च शिवतनाविदमधिकारपदस्थितेन गुरुणा नः /
अष्टानां देवानां शक्त्याविर्भावयोनयो ह्येताः // 230
text_mt: And this has been stated in the Śivatanu by our guru, who is established in the station of authority: / 'These are indeed the birth-sources for the manifestation of the powers of the eight gods. // 230

sanskrit_iast:
tanubhogāḥ punareṣāmadhaḥ prabhūtātmakāḥ proktāḥ /
catvāriṃśattulyopabhogadeśādhikāni bhuvanāni // 231
meaning:
तनुभोगाः पुनरेषामधः प्रभूतात्मकाः प्रोक्ताः /
चत्वारिंशत्तुल्योपभोगदेशाधिकानि भुवनानि // 231
text_mt: Again, their bodily enjoyments, consisting of physical elements, are declared below. / There are forty worlds, along with additional areas of equal enjoyment; // 231

sanskrit_iast:
sādhanabhedātkevalamaṣṭakapañcakatayoktāni /
etāni bhaktiyogaprāṇatyāgādigamyāni // 232
meaning:
साधनभेदात्केवलमष्टकपञ्चकतयोक्तानि /
एतानि भक्तियोगप्राणत्यागादिगम्यानि // 232
text_mt: they are stated as a pentad of octads merely through the distinction of practices, / and these are attainable through devotion, yoga, abandonment of the vital breaths, and the like. // 232

sanskrit_iast:
teṣūmāpatireva prabhuḥ svatantrendriyo vikaraṇātmā /
taratamayogena tato'pi devayonyaṣṭakaṃ lakṣyaṃ tu // 233
meaning:
तेषूमापतिरेव प्रभुः स्वतन्त्रेन्द्रियो विकरणात्मा /
तरतमयोगेन ततोऽपि देवयोन्यष्टकं लक्ष्यं तु // 233
text_mt: Among them, Umāpati alone is the lord, whose sense-organs are autonomous, who is devoid of instruments. / And beyond that, through graded degrees, the octad of classes of gods is to be recognized, // 233

sanskrit_iast:
lokānāmakṣāṇi ca viṣayaparicchittikaraṇāni /
gandhādermahadantādekādhikyena jātamaiśvaryam // 234
meaning:
लोकानामक्षाणि च विषयपरिच्छित्तिकरणानि /
गन्धादेर्महदन्तादेकाधिक्येन जातमैश्वर्यम् // 234
text_mt: and the sense-organs of the beings, which are instruments for delimiting sense-objects. / The sovereignty born from odor and the rest up to the intellect increases by one degree each, // 234

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādyātmakamasminpaiśācādye viriñcānte /
jñātvaivaṃ śodhayedbuddhiṃ sārdhaṃ puryaṣṭakendriyaiḥ // 235
meaning:
अणिमाद्यात्मकमस्मिन्पैशाचाद्ये विरिञ्चान्ते /
ज्ञात्वैवं शोधयेद्बुद्धिं सार्धं पुर्यष्टकेन्द्रियैः // 235
text_mt: consisting of powers such as atomicity, in this [series] beginning with the Paiśāca and ending with Viriñca. / Knowing thus, one should purify the intellect together with the senses of the subtle body (puryaṣṭaka).' // 235

sanskrit_iast:
krodheśāṣṭakamānīlaṃ saṃvartādyaṃ tato viduḥ /
tejoṣṭakaṃ balādhyakṣaprabhṛtikrodhanāṣtakāt // 236
meaning:
क्रोधेशाष्टकमानीलं संवर्ताद्यं ततो विदुः /
तेजोष्टकं बलाध्यक्षप्रभृतिक्रोधनाष्तकात् // 236
text_mt: Then, they know the bluish octad of Krodheśas, beginning with Saṃvarta, / and the fiery octad beginning with Balādhyakṣa, from the octad of Krodhanas. // 236

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtādi tato buddhau yogāṣṭakamudāhṛtam /
svacchandaśāsane tattu mūle śrīpūrvaśāsane // 237
meaning:
अकृतादि ततो बुद्धौ योगाष्टकमुदाहृतम् /
स्वच्छन्दशासने तत्तु मूले श्रीपूर्वशासने // 237
text_mt: Then, in the intellect, the octad of yoga beginning with Akṛta is declared. / That is stated in the teaching of the Svacchanda, but in the root venerable Pūrva-śāsana, // 237

sanskrit_iast:
yogāṣṭakapade yattu some śraikaṇṭhameva ca /
tato māyāpuraṃ bhūyaḥ śrīkaṇṭhasya ca kathyate // 238
meaning:
योगाष्टकपदे यत्तु सोमे श्रैकण्ठमेव च /
ततो मायापुरं भूयः श्रीकण्ठस्य च कथ्यते // 238
text_mt: in the station of the octad of yoga, there is [the city] belonging to Soma and Śrīkaṇṭha. / Then the city of Māyā and that of Śrīkaṇṭha are mentioned again. // 238

sanskrit_iast:
tena dvitīyaṃ bhuvanaṃ tayoḥ pratyekamucyate /
tatra māyāpuraṃ devyā yayā viśvamadhiṣṭhitam // 239
meaning:
तेन द्वितीयं भुवनं तयोः प्रत्येकमुच्यते /
तत्र मायापुरं देव्या यया विश्वमधिष्ठितम् // 239
text_mt: By this, a second realm is spoken of for each of the two. / There the city of Māyā belongs to the Goddess by whom the universe is presided over. // 239

sanskrit_iast:
pratikalpaṃ nāmabhedairbhaṇyate sā maheśvarī /
umāpateḥ puraṃ paścānmātṛbhiḥ parivāritam // 240
meaning:
प्रतिकल्पं नामभेदैर्भण्यते सा महेश्वरी /
उमापतेः पुरं पश्चान्मातृभिः परिवारितम् // 240
text_mt: In every aeon that Great Goddess is spoken of by various names. / Next is the city of Umāpati, surrounded by the Mothers. // 240

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭha eva parayā mūrtyomāpatirucyate /
brāhmyaiśī skandajā hārī vārāhyaindrī saviccikā [carcikā] // 241
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठ एव परया मूर्त्योमापतिरुच्यते /
ब्राह्म्यैशी स्कन्दजा हारी वाराह्यैन्द्री सविच्चिका [चर्चिका] // 241
text_mt: It is Śrīkaṇṭha himself who is called Umāpati through his supreme form. / Brāhmī, Aiśī, Skandajā, Hārī, Vārāhī, Aindrī, together with Carcikā, // 241

sanskrit_iast:
pītā śuklā pītanīle nīlā śuklāruṇā kramāt /
agnīśasaumyayāmyāpyapūrvanairṛtagāstu tāḥ // 242
meaning:
पीता शुक्ला पीतनीले नीला शुक्लारुणा क्रमात् /
अग्नीशसौम्ययाम्याप्यपूर्वनैरृतगास्तु ताः // 242
text_mt: are, in order, yellow, white, yellow-and-black, black, white, and red; / and they are situated in the southeast, northeast, northwest, south, west, east, and southwest. // 242

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśena mānuṣe loke dhātrā tā hyavatāritāḥ /
svacchandāstāḥ parāścānyāḥ pare vyomni vyavasthitāḥ // 243
meaning:
अंशेन मानुषे लोके धात्रा ता ह्यवतारिताः /
स्वच्छन्दास्ताः पराश्चान्याः परे व्योम्नि व्यवस्थिताः // 243
text_mt: By a portion, they were brought down into the mortal world by the Creator; / but the transcendent Svacchandā goddesses and others are established in the supreme ether. // 243

sanskrit_iast:
svacchandaṃ tā niṣevante saptadheyamumā yataḥ /
umāpatipurasyordhva sthitaṃ mūrtyaṣṭakaṃ param // 244
meaning:
स्वच्छन्दं ता निषेवन्ते सप्तधेयमुमा यतः /
उमापतिपुरस्योर्ध्व स्थितं मूर्त्यष्टकं परम् // 244
text_mt: They attend upon Svacchanda, since this Umā is sevenfold. / Above the city of Umāpati is situated the supreme octad of cosmic forms, // 244

sanskrit_iast:
śarvādikaṃ yasya sṛṣṭirdharādyā yājakāntataḥ /
tābhya īśānamūrtiryā sā merau saṃpratiṣṭhitā // 245
meaning:
शर्वादिकं यस्य सृष्टिर्धराद्या याजकान्ततः /
ताभ्य ईशानमूर्तिर्या सा मेरौ संप्रतिष्ठिता // 245
text_mt: beginning with Śarva, whose creation extends from earth up to the sacrificer. / Among them, the cosmic form of Īśāna is established on Mount Meru, // 245

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭhaḥ sphaṭikādrau sā vyāptā tanvaṣṭakairjagat /
ye yogaṃ saguṇaṃ śambhoḥ saṃyatāḥ paryupāsate // 246
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठः स्फटिकाद्रौ सा व्याप्ता तन्वष्टकैर्जगत् /
ये योगं सगुणं शम्भोः संयताः पर्युपासते // 246
text_mt: and Śrīkaṇṭha on the Crystal Mountain; she has pervaded the world with the eight cosmic forms. / Those who, self-controlled, worship the yoga of Śambhu with attributes, // 246

sanskrit_iast:
tanmaṇḍalaṃ vā dṛṣṭvaiva muktadvaitā hṛtatrayāḥ /
guṇānāmādharauttaryācchuddhāśuddhatvasaṃsthiteḥ // 247
meaning:
तन्मण्डलं वा दृष्ट्वैव मुक्तद्वैता हृतत्रयाः /
गुणानामाधरौत्तर्याच्छुद्धाशुद्धत्वसंस्थितेः // 247
text_mt: or who, freed from duality and relieved of the three [impurities], merely gaze upon that mandala— / owing to the lower and higher nature of the qualities and the status of purity and impurity, // 247

sanskrit_iast:
tāratamyācca yogasya bhedātphalavicitratā /
tato bhogaphalāvāptibhedādbhedo'yamucyate // 248
meaning:
तारतम्याच्च योगस्य भेदात्फलविचित्रता /
ततो भोगफलावाप्तिभेदाद्भेदोऽयमुच्यते // 248
text_mt: and owing to the graded hierarchy of yoga, there is a variety of results. / Therefore, this differentiation is explained on the basis of the different attainments of enjoyment and fruit. // 248

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtyaṣṭakopariṣṭāttu suśivā dvādaśoditāḥ /
vāmādyekaśivāntāste kuṅkumābhāḥ sutejasaḥ // 249
meaning:
मूर्त्यष्टकोपरिष्टात्तु सुशिवा द्वादशोदिताः /
वामाद्येकशिवान्तास्ते कुङ्कुमाभाः सुतेजसः // 249
text_mt: Above the octad of forms, however, twelve Suśivas are declared; / beginning with Vāma and ending with Ekaśiva, they have the luster of saffron and are full of brilliance. // 249

sanskrit_iast:
tadūrdhva vīrabhadrākhyo maṇḍalādhipatiḥ sthitaḥ /
yatta [sta] tsāyujyamāpannaḥ sa tena saha modate // 250
meaning:
तदूर्ध्व वीरभद्राख्यो मण्डलाधिपतिः स्थितः /
यत्त [स्त] त्सायुज्यमापन्नः स तेन सह मोदते // 250
text_mt: Above that is situated the lord of the mandala named Vīrabhadra; / having attained union with him, one rejoices with him.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pyaṅguṣṭhamātrāntaṃ mahādevāṣṭakaṃ bhavet /
buddhitattvamidaṃ proktaṃ devayonyaṣṭakāditaḥ // 251
meaning:
ततोऽप्यङ्गुष्ठमात्रान्तं महादेवाष्टकं भवेत् /
बुद्धितत्त्वमिदं प्रोक्तं देवयोन्यष्टकादितः // 251
text_mt: Above that also, up to the measure of a thumb, is the group of eight Mahādevas. / This is taught as the principle of intellect (buddhitattva), beginning from the eight wombs of divine beings.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevāṣṭakānte tad yogāṣṭakamihoditam /
tatra śraikaṇṭhamuktaṃ yat tasyaivomāpatistathā // 252
meaning:
महादेवाष्टकान्ते तद् योगाष्टकमिहोदितम् /
तत्र श्रैकण्ठमुक्तं यत् तस्यैवोमापतिस्तथा // 252
text_mt: At the end of the group of eight Mahādevas, the group of eight yogas is proclaimed here. / In that context, that which was spoken of as Śrīkaṇṭha is likewise the Lord of Umā (Umāpati).

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtayaḥ suśivā vīro mahādevāṣṭakaṃ vapuḥ /
upariṣṭāddhiyo'dhaśca prakṛterguṇasaṃjñitam // 253
meaning:
मूर्तयः सुशिवा वीरो महादेवाष्टकं वपुः /
उपरिष्टाद्धियोऽधश्च प्रकृतेर्गुणसंज्ञितम् // 253
text_mt: The forms, the Suśivas, the Vīra, the eightfold Mahādeva are [the intellect's] form. / Above the intellect and below Prakṛti is that known as the principle of the qualities (guṇatattva).

sanskrit_iast:
tattvaṃ tatra tu saṃkṣubdhā guṇāḥ prasuvate dhiyam /
na vaiṣamyamanāpannaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryasūtaye // 254
meaning:
तत्त्वं तत्र तु संक्षुब्धा गुणाः प्रसुवते धियम् /
न वैषम्यमनापन्नं कारणं कार्यसूतये // 254
text_mt: There, the agitated qualities generate the intellect. / A cause that has not attained imbalance cannot produce an effect.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇasāmyatmikā tena prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavet /
nanvevaṃ sāpi saṃkṣobhaṃ vinā tānviṣamānguṇān // 255
meaning:
गुणसाम्यत्मिका तेन प्रकृतिः कारणं भवेत् /
नन्वेवं सापि संक्षोभं विना तान्विषमान्गुणान् // 255
text_mt: Therefore Prakṛti, consisting of the equilibrium of qualities, must be the cause. / [Objection:] Surely, even so, without agitation, how could it produce those imbalanced qualities?

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṃ suvīta tatrādye kṣobhe syādanavasthitiḥ /
sāṃkhyasya doṣa evāyaṃ yadi vā tena te guṇāḥ // 256
meaning:
कथं सुवीत तत्राद्ये क्षोभे स्यादनवस्थितिः /
सांख्यस्य दोष एवायं यदि वा तेन ते गुणाः // 256
text_mt: [If so,] an infinite regress would arise regarding the initial agitation. / [Reply:] This is only a fault for the Sāṃkhya; or rather, according to him, those qualities

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktamiṣṭāḥ sāmyaṃ tu saṅgamātraṃ na cetarat /
asmākaṃ tu svatantreśatathecchākṣobhasaṃgatam // 257
meaning:
अव्यक्तमिष्टाः साम्यं तु सङ्गमात्रं न चेतरत् /
अस्माकं तु स्वतन्त्रेशतथेच्छाक्षोभसंगतम् // 257
text_mt: are held to be the unmanifest (avyakta), while equilibrium is mere contact and nothing else. / For us, however, it is united with the agitation [caused by] the will of the autonomous Lord as it is.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktaṃ buddhitattvasya kāraṇaṃ kṣobhitā guṇāḥ /
nanu tattveśvarecchāto yaḥ kṣobhaḥ prakṛteḥ purā // 258
meaning:
अव्यक्तं बुद्धितत्त्वस्य कारणं क्षोभिता गुणाः /
ननु तत्त्वेश्वरेच्छातो यः क्षोभः प्रकृतेः पुरा // 258
text_mt: The unmanifest is the cause of the intellect-principle, [namely,] the agitated qualities. / [Objection:] Surely, the agitation of Prakṛti that arises earlier from the will of the Lord of principles

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva buddhitattvaṃ syāt kimanyaiḥ kalpitairguṇaiḥ /
naitatkāraṇatārūpaparāmarśāvarodhi yat // 259
meaning:
तदेव बुद्धितत्त्वं स्यात् किमन्यैः कल्पितैर्गुणैः /
नैतत्कारणतारूपपरामर्शावरोधि यत् // 259
text_mt: must be the intellect-principle itself; what need is there for other postulated qualities? / [Reply:] This is not so, because another agitation, which prevents the apprehension of [merely] being a cause,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣobhāntaraṃ tataḥ kārya bījocchūnāṅkurādivat /
kramāttamorajaḥsattve gurūṇāṃ paṅktayaḥ sthitāḥ // 260
meaning:
क्षोभान्तरं ततः कार्य बीजोच्छूनाङ्कुरादिवत् /
क्रमात्तमोरजःसत्त्वे गुरूणां पङ्क्तयः स्थिताः // 260
text_mt: is the effect after that, just like the seed, the swollen [seed], and the sprout. / In succession, in tamas, rajas, and sattva, there are lines of gurus,

sanskrit_iast:
tisro dvātriṃśadekātastriṃśadapyekaviṃśatiḥ /
svajñanayogabalataḥ krīḍanto daiśikottamāḥ // 261
meaning:
तिस्रो द्वात्रिंशदेकातस्त्रिंशदप्येकविंशतिः /
स्वज्ञनयोगबलतः क्रीडन्तो दैशिकोत्तमाः // 261
text_mt: three [in number]: thirty-two, thirty-one, and also twenty-one, / eminent masters sporting through the power of their own knowledge and yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
trinetrāḥ pāśanirmuktāste'trānugrahakāriṇaḥ /
buddheśca guṇaparyantamubhe saptādhike śate // 262
meaning:
त्रिनेत्राः पाशनिर्मुक्तास्तेऽत्रानुग्रहकारिणः /
बुद्धेश्च गुणपर्यन्तमुभे सप्ताधिके शते // 262
text_mt: Three-eyed, freed from bonds, they bestow grace here. / From the intellect up to the qualities, both [the number of Rudras] and the worlds are one hundred and seven;

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṇāṃ bhuvanānāṃ ca mukhyato'nye tadantare /
yogāṣṭakaṃ guṇaskandhe proktaṃ śivatanau punaḥ // 263
meaning:
रुद्राणां भुवनानां च मुख्यतोऽन्ये तदन्तरे /
योगाष्टकं गुणस्कन्धे प्रोक्तं शिवतनौ पुनः // 263
text_mt: these are the principal [worlds] of the Rudras, and others are within them. / The group of eight yogas is taught in the shoulder of qualities (guṇaskandha), whereas in the body of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
yonīratītya gauṇe skandhe syuryogadātāraḥ /
akṛtakṛtavibhuviriñcā harirguhaḥ kramavaśāttato devī // 264
meaning:
योनीरतीत्य गौणे स्कन्धे स्युर्योगदातारः /
अकृतकृतविभुविरिञ्चा हरिर्गुहः क्रमवशात्ततो देवी // 264
text_mt: transcending the wombs, in the qualitative shoulder, there are the bestowal-granters of yoga: / Akṛta, Kṛta, Vibhu, Viriñca, Hari, Guha, and then in due order the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
karaṇānyaṇimādiguṇāḥ kāryāṇi pratyayaprapañcaśca /
avyaktādutpannā guṇāśca sattvādayo'mīṣām // 265
meaning:
करणान्यणिमादिगुणाः कार्याणि प्रत्ययप्रपञ्चश्च /
अव्यक्तादुत्पन्ना गुणाश्च सत्त्वादयोऽमीषाम् // 265
text_mt: The instruments, the qualities such as lightness (aṇimā), the effects, the expansion of cognitive states, / and the qualities such as sattva arisen from the unmanifest—for all these,

sanskrit_iast:
dharmajñānavirāgānaiśvaryaṃ tatphalāni vividhāni /
yacchanti guṇebhyo'mī puruṣebhyo yogadātāraḥ // 266
meaning:
धर्मज्ञानविरागानैश्वर्यं तत्फलानि विविधानि /
यच्छन्ति गुणेभ्योऽमी पुरुषेभ्यो योगदातारः // 266
text_mt: virtue, knowledge, dispassion, sovereignty, and their diverse fruits / are bestowed from the qualities upon the puruṣas by these bestowers of yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tebhyaḥ parato bhuvanaṃ sattvādiguṇāsanasya devasya /
sakalajagadekamāturbhartuḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthasya // 267
meaning:
तेभ्यः परतो भुवनं सत्त्वादिगुणासनस्य देवस्य /
सकलजगदेकमातुर्भर्तुः श्रीकण्ठनाथस्य // 267
text_mt: Beyond them is the world of the God whose seat is the qualities such as sattva, / the lord of the sole mother of all universe, the venerable lord Śrīkaṇṭha,

sanskrit_iast:
yenomāguhanīlabrahmaṛbhukṣakṛtākṛtādibhuvaneṣu /
graharūpiṇyā śaktyā prābhvyādhiṣṭhāni bhūtāni // 268
meaning:
येनोमागुहनीलब्रह्मऋभुक्षकृताकृतादिभुवनेषु /
ग्रहरूपिण्या शक्त्या प्राभ्व्याधिष्ठानि भूतानि // 268
text_mt: by whom, in the worlds of Umā, Guha, Nīla, Brahmā, Indra, Kṛtākṛta, and the rest, / through his power in the form of the planets, beings are presided over with preeminent majesty;

sanskrit_iast:
upasaṃjihīrṣuriha yaścaturānanapaṅkajaṃ samāviśya /
dagdhvā caturo lokāñjanalokānnirmiṇoti punaḥ // 269
meaning:
उपसंजिहीर्षुरिह यश्चतुराननपङ्कजं समाविश्य /
दग्ध्वा चतुरो लोकाञ्जनलोकान्निर्मिणोति पुनः // 269
text_mt: who here, wishing to dissolve [the universe], enters the lotus of the four-faced [Brahmā], / and having burnt the four worlds, creates them again from the Janaloka;

sanskrit_iast:
yasyecchātaḥ sattvādiguṇaśarīrā visṛjati rudrāṇī /
anukalpo rudrāṇyā vedī tatrejyate'nukalpena // 270
meaning:
यस्येच्छातः सत्त्वादिगुणशरीरा विसृजति रुद्राणी /
अनुकल्पो रुद्राण्या वेदी तत्रेज्यतेऽनुकल्पेन // 270
text_mt: by whose will Rudrāṇī, having a body of the qualities such as sattva, creates. / The secondary ritual (anukalpa) belongs to Rudrāṇī; the altar is worshipped there by means of the secondary ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
paśupatirindropendraviriñcairatha tadupalambhato devaiḥ /
gandharvayakṣarākṣasapitṛmunibhiścitritāstathā yāgāḥ // 271
meaning:
पशुपतिरिन्द्रोपेन्द्रविरिञ्चैरथ तदुपलम्भतो देवैः /
गन्धर्वयक्षराक्षसपितृमुनिभिश्चित्रितास्तथा यागाः // 271
text_mt: The sacrifices are made manifold by Paśupati, Indra, Upendra, Viriñci, and then, through obtaining that, by the gods, / Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, ancestors, and sages.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇānāṃ yatparaṃ sāmyaṃ tadavyaktaṃ guṇordhvataḥ /
krodheśacaṇḍasaṃvartā jyotiḥpiṅgalasūrakau // 272
meaning:
गुणानां यत्परं साम्यं तदव्यक्तं गुणोर्ध्वतः /
क्रोधेशचण्डसंवर्ता ज्योतिःपिङ्गलसूरकौ // 272
text_mt: The supreme equilibrium of the qualities is the unmanifest (avyakta), above the qualities. / Krodheśa, Caṇḍa, Saṃvarta, Jyotiḥ, Piṅgala, Sūraka,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāntakaikavīrau ca śikhodaścāṣṭa tatra te /
gahanaṃ puruṣanidhānaṃ prakṛtirmūlaṃ pradhānamavyaktam // 273
meaning:
पञ्चान्तकैकवीरौ च शिखोदश्चाष्ट तत्र ते /
गहनं पुरुषनिधानं प्रकृतिर्मूलं प्रधानमव्यक्तम् // 273
text_mt: Pañcāntaka, Ekavīra, and Śikhoda—these are the eight there. / Gahana ('abyss'), Puruṣanidhāna ('resting-place of the puruṣa'), Prakṛti, Mūla ('root'), Pradhāna, Avyakta ('unmanifest'),

sanskrit_iast:
guṇakāraṇamityete māyāprabhavasya paryāyāḥ /
yāvantaḥ kṣetrajñāḥ sahajāgantukamalopadigdhacitaḥ // 274
meaning:
गुणकारणमित्येते मायाप्रभवस्य पर्यायाः /
यावन्तः क्षेत्रज्ञाः सहजागन्तुकमलोपदिग्धचितः // 274
text_mt: and Guṇakāraṇa ('cause of qualities')—these are synonyms for what arises from Māyā. / As many knowers of the field (kṣetrajña) as there are whose consciousness is smeared with innate and adventitious impurities,

sanskrit_iast:
te sarve'tra vinihitā rudrāśca tadutthabhogabhujaḥ /
mūḍhavivṛttavilīnaiḥ karaṇaiḥ kecittu vikaraṇakāḥ // 275
meaning:
ते सर्वेऽत्र विनिहिता रुद्राश्च तदुत्थभोगभुजः /
मूढविवृत्तविलीनैः करणैः केचित्तु विकरणकाः // 275
text_mt: they are all placed here, along with the Rudras who experience the enjoyments arising therefrom. / Some possess deluded, outward-turned, or dissolved instruments, while others are entirely instrumentless (vikaraṇa).

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtādhiṣṭhānatayā kṛtyāśaktāni mūḍhāni /
pratiniyataviṣayabhāñji sphuṭāni śāstre vivṛttāni // 276
meaning:
अकृताधिष्ठानतया कृत्याशक्तानि मूढानि /
प्रतिनियतविषयभाञ्जि स्फुटानि शास्त्रे विवृत्तानि // 276
text_mt: Because they have not formed an abode, they are incapable of activity: [such instruments are] deluded. / Those that relate to determinate objects are clearly distinguished in the scripture as outward-turned.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagnāni mahāpralaye sṛṣṭau notpāditāni līnāni /
icchādhīnāni punarvikaraṇasaṃjñāni kāryamapyevam // 277
meaning:
भग्नानि महाप्रलये सृष्टौ नोत्पादितानि लीनानि /
इच्छाधीनानि पुनर्विकरणसंज्ञानि कार्यमप्येवम् // 277
text_mt: Broken in the great dissolution and not brought forth in creation, they are dissolved. / Again, those dependent on the will are called instrumentless; the effect is likewise.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃstattve tuṣṭinavakaṃ siddhayo'ṣṭau ca tatpuraḥ /
tāvatya evāṇimādibhuvanāṣṭakameva ca // 278
meaning:
पुंस्तत्त्वे तुष्टिनवकं सिद्धयोऽष्टौ च तत्पुरः /
तावत्य एवाणिमादिभुवनाष्टकमेव च // 278
text_mt: In the puruṣa-principle there is the group of nine contentments (tuṣṭi) and eight spiritual accomplishments (siddhi) before it; / there are just as many [worlds], and also the group of eight worlds of aṇimā and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
atattve tattvabuddhyā yaḥ santoṣastuṣṭiratra sā /
heye'pyādeyadhīḥ siddhiḥ tathā coktaṃ hi kāpilaiḥ // 279
meaning:
अतत्त्वे तत्त्वबुद्ध्या यः सन्तोषस्तुष्टिरत्र सा /
हेयेऽप्यादेयधीः सिद्धिः तथा चोक्तं हि कापिलैः // 279
text_mt: Satisfaction with the notion that what is non-reality is reality is 'contentment' (tuṣṭi) here; / the notion that what should be abandoned is to be adopted is 'accomplishment' (siddhi); for it is said thus by the followers of Kapila:

sanskrit_iast:
ādhyātmikāścatasraḥ prakṛtyupādānakālabhāgyākhyāḥ /
pañca viṣayoparamato'rjanarakṣāsaṅgasaṃkṣayavighātaiḥ // 280
meaning:
आध्यात्मिकाश्चतस्रः प्रकृत्युपादानकालभाग्याख्याः /
पञ्च विषयोपरमतोऽर्जनरक्षासङ्गसंक्षयविघातैः // 280
text_mt: 'Four are internal, named nature, means, time, and fortune; / five are from cessation regarding objects, through the afflictions of acquisition, preservation, attachment, decay, and injury.

sanskrit_iast:
ūhaḥ śabdo'dhyayanaṃ duḥkhavighātāstrayaḥ suhṛtprāptiḥ /
dānaṃ ca siddhayo'ṣṭau siddheḥ pūrvo'ṅkuśastrividhaḥ // 281
meaning:
ऊहः शब्दोऽध्ययनं दुःखविघातास्त्रयः सुहृत्प्राप्तिः /
दानं च सिद्धयोऽष्टौ सिद्धेः पूर्वोऽङ्कुशस्त्रिविधः // 281
text_mt: Reasoning, oral instruction, study, the three suppressions of suffering, acquisition of friends, / and gifting are the eight accomplishments; the threefold previous [set] is the curb on accomplishment.'

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādyūrdhvatastisraḥ paṅktayo guruśiṣyagāḥ /
tatrāpi triguṇacchāyāyogāt tritvamudāhṛtam // 282
meaning:
अणिमाद्यूर्ध्वतस्तिस्रः पङ्क्तयो गुरुशिष्यगाः /
तत्रापि त्रिगुणच्छायायोगात् त्रित्वमुदाहृतम् // 282
text_mt: Above the worlds of aṇimā and the rest are three lines comprising gurus and disciples; / there too, because of the combination of the reflection of the three qualities, a triad is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍīvidyāṣṭakaṃ cordhvaṃ paṅktīnāṃ syādiḍādikam /
puṃsi nādamayī śaktiḥ prasarākhyā ca yatsthitā // 283
meaning:
नाडीविद्याष्टकं चोर्ध्वं पङ्क्तीनां स्यादिडादिकम् /
पुंसि नादमयी शक्तिः प्रसराख्या च यत्स्थिता // 283
text_mt: Above the lines is the group of eight sciences of subtle channels (nāḍīvidyāṣṭaka), beginning with Iḍā; / because the power consisting of sound (nāda) and named expansion resides in the puruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
na hyakartā pumānkartuḥ kāraṇatvaṃ ca saṃsthitam /
akartaryapi vā puṃsi sahakāritayā sthite // 284
meaning:
न ह्यकर्ता पुमान्कर्तुः कारणत्वं च संस्थितम् /
अकर्तर्यपि वा पुंसि सहकारितया स्थिते // 284
text_mt: For the puruṣa is not a non-agent, and the causality of the agent is established; / or, even if the puruṣa is a non-agent, since he stands as an auxiliary,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣakāryātmataiṣṭavyānyathā satkāryahānitaḥ /
tasmāttathāvidhe kārye yā śaktiḥ puruṣasya sā // 285
meaning:
शेषकार्यात्मतैष्टव्यान्यथा सत्कार्यहानितः /
तस्मात्तथाविधे कार्ये या शक्तिः पुरुषस्य सा // 285
text_mt: the nature of the remaining effect must be accepted [to be in him], otherwise the doctrine of the pre-existent effect (satkārya) would be ruined. / Therefore, with respect to such an effect, that power of the puruṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvanti rūpāṇyādāya pūrṇatāmadhigacchati /
nāḍyaṣṭakordhve kathitaṃ vigrahāṣṭakamucyate // 286
meaning:
तावन्ति रूपाण्यादाय पूर्णतामधिगच्छति /
नाड्यष्टकोर्ध्वे कथितं विग्रहाष्टकमुच्यते // 286
text_mt: taking on so many forms, attains completeness. / Above the eight subtle channels is declared what is called the group of eight bodily forms (vigrahāṣṭaka).

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ heturduḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ ca vijñānasādhyakaraṇāni /
sādhanamiti vigrahatāyugaṣṭakaṃ bhavati puṃstattve // 287
meaning:
कार्यं हेतुर्दुःखं सुखं च विज्ञानसाध्यकरणानि /
साधनमिति विग्रहतायुगष्टकं भवति पुंस्तत्त्वे // 287
text_mt: Effect, cause, pain, pleasure, and the cognitive instruments that bring about knowledge, / and the means—thus there is an eightfold pair of bodily forms in the puruṣa-principle.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvanaṃ dehadharmāṇāṃ daśānāṃ vigrahāṣṭakāt /
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmākalkākrudho guroḥ // 288
meaning:
भुवनं देहधर्माणां दशानां विग्रहाष्टकात् /
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्माकल्काक्रुधो गुरोः // 288
text_mt: From the eight bodily forms arises the world of the ten bodily duties: / non-violence, truth, non-stealing, celibacy, guilelessness, freedom from anger, service to the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrūṣāśaucasantoṣā ṛjuteti daśoditāḥ /
puṃstattva eva gandhāntaṃ sthitaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ punaḥ // 289
meaning:
शुश्रूषाशौचसन्तोषा ऋजुतेति दशोदिताः /
पुंस्तत्त्व एव गन्धान्तं स्थितं षोडशकं पुनः // 289
text_mt: purity, contentment, and uprightness—these are taught as the ten. / In the puruṣa-principle itself, there is situated the group of sixteen ending with smell;

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhya dehapāśākhyaṃ puraṃ buddhiguṇāstataḥ /
tatraivāṣṭāvahaṃkārastridhā kāmādikāstathā // 290
meaning:
आरभ्य देहपाशाख्यं पुरं बुद्धिगुणास्ततः /
तत्रैवाष्टावहंकारस्त्रिधा कामादिकास्तथा // 290
text_mt: beginning with the city named the bond of the body, then the qualities of the intellect, / there too eight [dispositions], egoity of three kinds, and likewise passion and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśā āgantukagāṇeśavaidyeśvarabheditāḥ /
trividhāste sthitāḥ puṃsi mokṣamārgoparodhakāḥ // 291
meaning:
पाशा आगन्तुकगाणेशवैद्येश्वरभेदिताः /
त्रिविधास्ते स्थिताः पुंसि मोक्षमार्गोपरोधकाः // 291
text_mt: The bonds are divided into adventitious, pertaining to Gaṇeśa, and pertaining to Vaidyeśvara; / standing in three ways within the puruṣa, they block the path to liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yatkiṃcitparamādvaitasaṃvitsvātantryasundarāt /
parācchivāduktarūpādanyattatpāśa ucyate // 292
meaning:
यत्किंचित्परमाद्वैतसंवित्स्वातन्त्र्यसुन्दरात् /
पराच्छिवादुक्तरूपादन्यत्तत्पाश उच्यते // 292
text_mt: Whatever is other than the supreme Śiva described as having that nature, / beautiful through the absolute autonomy of supreme non-dual consciousness, is called a bond.

sanskrit_iast:
tadevaṃ puṃstvamāpanne pūrṇe'pi parameśvare /
tatsvarūpāparijñānaṃ citraṃ hi puruṣāstataḥ // 293
meaning:
तदेवं पुंस्त्वमापन्ने पूर्णेऽपि परमेश्वरे /
तत्स्वरूपापरिज्ञानं चित्रं हि पुरुषास्ततः // 293
text_mt: Thus, even though the Supreme Lord is full, when He attains the status of puruṣa, / there is non-recognition of His own true nature; wondrous indeed are the puruṣas thenceforward!

sanskrit_iast:
uktānuktāstu ye pāśāḥ paratantroktalakṣaṇāḥ /
te puṃsi sarve tāṃstatra śodhayanmucyate bhavāt // 294
meaning:
उक्तानुक्तास्तु ये पाशाः परतन्त्रोक्तलक्षणाः /
ते पुंसि सर्वे तांस्तत्र शोधयन्मुच्यते भवात् // 294
text_mt: The bonds—both stated and unstated—whose characteristics are taught in other tantras, / are all present in the puruṣa; by purifying them there, one is freed from worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsa ūrdhva tu niyatistatrasthāḥ śaṃkarā daśa /
hemābhāḥ susitāḥ kālatattve tu daśa te śivāḥ // 295
meaning:
पुंस ऊर्ध्व तु नियतिस्तत्रस्थाः शंकरा दश /
हेमाभाः सुसिताः कालतत्त्वे तु दश ते शिवाः // 295
text_mt: Above the puruṣa, however, is niyati; situated there are ten Śaṅkaras / with golden luster, whereas in the tattva of kāla there are ten extremely white Śivas.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭiḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ pratyekaṃ parivāriṇaḥ /
rāge vīreśabhuvanaṃ gurvantevāsināṃ puram // 296
meaning:
कोटिः षोडशसाहस्रं प्रत्येकं परिवारिणः /
रागे वीरेशभुवनं गुर्वन्तेवासिनां पुरम् // 296
text_mt: Each of them has an entourage of one crore sixteen thousand. / In rāga is the world of Vīreśa, the city of gurus and their disciples.

sanskrit_iast:
puraṃ cāśuddhavidyāyāṃ syācchaktinavakojjvalam /
manonmanyantagāstāśca vāmādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ // 297
meaning:
पुरं चाशुद्धविद्यायां स्याच्छक्तिनवकोज्ज्वलम् /
मनोन्मन्यन्तगास्ताश्च वामाद्याः परिकीर्तिताः // 297
text_mt: In aśuddhavidyā there is a city blazing with nine powers; / they are proclaimed to be Vāmā and the others, ending with Manonmanī.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāyāṃ syānmahādevatrayasya puramuttamam /
tato māyā tripuṭikā mukhyato'nantakoṭibhiḥ // 298
meaning:
कलायां स्यान्महादेवत्रयस्य पुरमुत्तमम् /
ततो माया त्रिपुटिका मुख्यतोऽनन्तकोटिभिः // 298
text_mt: In kalā is the supreme city of the three Mahādevas. / Beyond that is māyā, consisting of three folds, primarily with endless crores [of worlds],

sanskrit_iast:
ākrāntā sā bhagabilaiḥ proktaṃ śaivyāṃ tanau punaḥ /
aṅguṣṭhamātraparyantaṃ mahādevāṣṭakaṃ niśi // 299
meaning:
आक्रान्ता सा भगबिलैः प्रोक्तं शैव्यां तनौ पुनः /
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रपर्यन्तं महादेवाष्टकं निशि // 299
text_mt: pervaded by the apertures of the womb (bhagabila). In the Śaiva body, moreover, / an octad of Mahādevas reaching only up to the measure of a thumb is taught in the Night (niśi).

sanskrit_iast:
cakrāṣṭakādhipatyena tathā śrīmālinīmate /
vāmādyāḥ puruṣādau ye proktāḥ śrīpūrvaśāsane // 300
meaning:
चक्राष्टकाधिपत्येन तथा श्रीमालिनीमते /
वामाद्याः पुरुषादौ ये प्रोक्ताः श्रीपूर्वशासने // 300
text_mt: Likewise, in the venerable Mālinīmata, through lordship over an octad of cakras, / the powers beginning with Vāmā that were taught in the revered Pūrvaśāsana at the level of puruṣa and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
te māyātattva evoktāstanau śaivyāmanantataḥ /
kapālavratinaḥ svāṅgahotāraḥ kaṣṭatāpasāḥ // 301
meaning:
ते मायातत्त्व एवोक्तास्तनौ शैव्यामनन्ततः /
कपालव्रतिनः स्वाङ्गहोतारः कष्टतापसाः // 301
text_mt: are declared to be in the māyātattva itself. In the Śaiva body, starting from Ananta, / the Kapālavratins, those who offer their own limbs, austere ascetics,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhayāḥ khaḍgadhārāvratāstattattvavedinaḥ /
kramāttattattvamāyānti yatreśo'nanta ucyate // 302
meaning:
सर्वाभयाः खड्गधाराव्रतास्तत्तत्त्ववेदिनः /
क्रमात्तत्तत्त्वमायान्ति यत्रेशोऽनन्त उच्यते // 302
text_mt: those devoid of fear, those observing the razor's edge vow, and those who know their respective realities, / gradually reach those respective tattvas where Ananta is said to be the lord.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca tasya parataḥ sthānamanantādhipasya devasya /
sthitivilayasargakarturguhābhagadvārapālasya // 303
meaning:
उक्तं च तस्य परतः स्थानमनन्ताधिपस्य देवस्य /
स्थितिविलयसर्गकर्तुर्गुहाभगद्वारपालस्य // 303
text_mt: And it is declared that beyond him is the abode of the god who is the lord of Ananta, / the agent of maintenance, dissolution, and emission, the guardian of the door to the womb of the cave (guhā).

sanskrit_iast:
dharmānaṇimādiguṇāñjñānāni tapaḥsukhāni yogāṃśca /
māyābilātpradatte puṃsāṃ niṣkṛṣya niṣkṛṣya // 304
meaning:
धर्मानणिमादिगुणाञ्ज्ञानानि तपःसुखानि योगांश्च /
मायाबिलात्प्रदत्ते पुंसां निष्कृष्य निष्कृष्य // 304
text_mt: He bestows upon bound souls righteousness, qualities such as anima, kinds of knowledge, / the joys of austerity, and yogas, extracting them one by one from the chasm of māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
tacchaktīddhasvabalā guhādhikārāndhakāraguṇadīpāḥ /
sarve'nantapramukhā dīpyante śatabhavapramukhāntāḥ // 305
meaning:
तच्छक्तीद्धस्वबला गुहाधिकारान्धकारगुणदीपाः /
सर्वेऽनन्तप्रमुखा दीप्यन्ते शतभवप्रमुखान्ताः // 305
text_mt: With their own power ignited by his power, like lamps to the darkness of cosmic office in the cave, / all [the lords] headed by Ananta down to those headed by Śatabhava blaze forth.

sanskrit_iast:
so'vyaktamadhiṣṭhāya prakaroti jaganniyogataḥ śambhoḥ /
śuddhāśuddhasroto'dhikārahetuḥ śivo yasmāt // 306
meaning:
सोऽव्यक्तमधिष्ठाय प्रकरोति जगन्नियोगतः शम्भोः /
शुद्धाशुद्धस्रोतोऽधिकारहेतुः शिवो यस्मात् // 306
text_mt: Presiding over the unmanifest (avyakta), he creates the universe by the command of Śambhu, / because Śiva is the cause of cosmic office over both the pure and impure streams.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaguṇayoge tasmin mahati pade ye pratiṣṭhitāḥ prathamam /
te'nantāderjagataḥ sargasthitivilayakartāraḥ // 307
meaning:
शिवगुणयोगे तस्मिन् महति पदे ये प्रतिष्ठिताः प्रथमम् /
तेऽनन्तादेर्जगतः सर्गस्थितिविलयकर्तारः // 307
text_mt: Those who were established in the beginning in that great state endowed with the qualities of Śiva / are the agents of emission, maintenance, and dissolution of the universe, beginning with Ananta.

sanskrit_iast:
māyābilamidamuktaṃ paratastu guhā jagadyoniḥ /
utpattyā teṣvasyāḥ patiśaktikṣobhamanuvidhīyamāneṣu // 308
meaning:
मायाबिलमिदमुक्तं परतस्तु गुहा जगद्योनिः /
उत्पत्त्या तेष्वस्याः पतिशक्तिक्षोभमनुविधीयमानेषु // 308
text_mt: This has been described as the chasm of māyā; beyond it, however, is the cave (guhā), the womb of the universe. / By their arising in these [cavities], when they submit to the stirring of the Lord's power,

sanskrit_iast:
yonivivareṣu nānākāmasamṛddheṣu bhagasaṃjñā /
kāmayate patirenāmicchānuvidhāyinīṃ yadā devīm // 309
meaning:
योनिविवरेषु नानाकामसमृद्धेषु भगसंज्ञा /
कामयते पतिरेनामिच्छानुविधायिनीं यदा देवीम् // 309
text_mt: the term 'bhaga' applies to the apertures of the womb abundant with various desires. / When the Lord desires this goddess who conforms to his will,

sanskrit_iast:
pratibhagamavyaktādyāḥ prajāstadāsyāḥ prajāyante /
teṣāmatisūkṣmāṇāmetāvattvaṃ na varṇyate vidhiṣu // 310
meaning:
प्रतिभगमव्यक्ताद्याः प्रजास्तदास्याः प्रजायन्ते /
तेषामतिसूक्ष्माणामेतावत्त्वं न वर्ण्यते विधिषु // 310
text_mt: then in every womb are born her progeny, beginning with the unmanifest. / Because they are exceedingly subtle, their precise measure is not described in the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
avavarakāṇyekasminyadvatsāle bahūni baddhāni /
yonibilānyekasmiṃstadvanmāyāśiraḥsāle // 311
meaning:
अववरकाण्येकस्मिन्यद्वत्साले बहूनि बद्धानि /
योनिबिलान्येकस्मिंस्तद्वन्मायाशिरःसाले // 311
text_mt: Just as many inner chambers are constructed within a single surrounding wall, / so are the apertures of the womb within the single wall at the summit of māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāpaṭalaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kuḍyaiḥ pihitāḥ parasparamadṛśyāḥ /
nivasanti tatra rudrāḥ sukhinaḥ pratibilamasaṃkhyātāḥ // 312
meaning:
मायापटलैः सूक्ष्मैः कुड्यैः पिहिताः परस्परमदृश्याः /
निवसन्ति तत्र रुद्राः सुखिनः प्रतिबिलमसंख्याताः // 312
text_mt: Concealed by subtle veils of māyā as walls, invisible to one another, / innumerably happy Rudras reside there in each aperture.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāne sāyujyagatāḥ sāmīpyagatāḥ pare salokasthāḥ /
pratibhuvanamevamayaṃ nivāsināṃ gurubhiruddiṣṭaḥ // 313
meaning:
स्थाने सायुज्यगताः सामीप्यगताः परे सलोकस्थाः /
प्रतिभुवनमेवमयं निवासिनां गुरुभिरुद्दिष्टः // 313
text_mt: Some have attained union with the abode, some proximity, and others dwell in the same realm; / this has been taught by the gurus for the inhabitants in each world.

sanskrit_iast:
api sarvasiddhavācaḥ kṣīyerandīrghakālamudgīrṇāḥ /
na punaryonyānantyāducyante srotasāṃ saṃkhyāḥ // 314
meaning:
अपि सर्वसिद्धवाचः क्षीयेरन्दीर्घकालमुद्गीर्णाः /
न पुनर्योन्यानन्त्यादुच्यन्ते स्रोतसां संख्याः // 314
text_mt: Even the words of all the Siddhas uttered over an immense time would be exhausted, / yet the numbers of streams would still not be told, due to the endlessness of the wombs.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānnirayādyekaṃ yatproktaṃ dvārapālaparyantam /
srotastenānyānyapi tulyavidhānāni vedyāni // 315
meaning:
तस्मान्निरयाद्येकं यत्प्रोक्तं द्वारपालपर्यन्तम् /
स्रोतस्तेनान्यान्यपि तुल्यविधानानि वेद्यानि // 315
text_mt: Therefore, through that single stream that has been described, extending from hell up to the gatekeeper, / the other streams should also be known to possess similar arrangements.

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktakale guhayā prakṛtikalābhyāṃ vikāra ātmīyaḥ /
otaḥ proto vyāptaḥ kalitaḥ pūrṇaḥ parikṣiptaḥ // 316
meaning:
अव्यक्तकले गुहया प्रकृतिकलाभ्यां विकार आत्मीयः /
ओतः प्रोतो व्याप्तः कलितः पूर्णः परिक्षिप्तः // 316
text_mt: In avyakta and kalā, through the cave and by means of prakṛti and kalā, its own transformation / is woven warp and woof, pervaded, configured, completed, and encompassed.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye puṭatrayaṃ tasyā rudrāḥ ṣaḍadhare'ntare /
eka ūrdhve ca pañceti dvādaśaite nirūpitāḥ // 317
meaning:
मध्ये पुटत्रयं तस्या रुद्राः षडधरेऽन्तरे /
एक ऊर्ध्वे च पञ्चेति द्वादशैते निरूपिताः // 317
text_mt: In the middle of it is a triad of folds: six Rudras below, in the interior / one, and five above; thus these twelve have been set forth:

sanskrit_iast:
gahanāsādhyau hariharadaśeśvarau trikalagopatī ṣaḍime /
madhye'nantaḥ kṣemo dvijeśavidyeśaviśvaśivāḥ // 318
meaning:
गहनासाध्यौ हरिहरदशेश्वरौ त्रिकलगोपती षडिमे /
मध्येऽनन्तः क्षेमो द्विजेशविद्येशविश्वशिवाः // 318
text_mt: Gahana, Asādhya, Hari, Hara, Daśeśvara, and Trikalagopati—these are the six [below]; / in the center is Ananta; Kṣema, Dvijīśa, Vidyeśa, and Viśvaśiva

sanskrit_iast:
iti pañca teṣu pañcasu ṣaṭsu ca puṭageṣu tatparāvṛttyā /
parivarttate sthitiḥ kila devo'nantastu sarvathā madhye // 319
meaning:
इति पञ्च तेषु पञ्चसु षट्सु च पुटगेषु तत्परावृत्त्या /
परिवर्त्तते स्थितिः किल देवोऽनन्तस्तु सर्वथा मध्ये // 319
text_mt: are the five. Through their rotation in those five and six folds, / their stability is said to alternate, while Lord Ananta remains entirely in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvādharagakapālakapuṭaṣaṭkayugena tatparāvṛttyā /
madhyato'ṣṭābhirdiksthairvyāpto granthirmataṅgaśāstroktaḥ // 320
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाधरगकपालकपुटषट्कयुगेन तत्परावृत्त्या /
मध्यतोऽष्टाभिर्दिक्स्थैर्व्याप्तो ग्रन्थिर्मतङ्गशास्त्रोक्तः // 320
text_mt: Encompassed by the pair of sixfold skull-bowls above and below through their alternation, / and in the middle by eight located in the directions, is the knot (granthi) taught in the Mataṅgaśāstra.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsāraśāsane punareṣā ṣaṭpuṭatayā vinirdiṣṭā /
granthyākhyamidaṃ tattvaṃ māyākāryaṃ tato māyā // 321
meaning:
श्रीसारशासने पुनरेषा षट्पुटतया विनिर्दिष्टा /
ग्रन्थ्याख्यमिदं तत्त्वं मायाकार्यं ततो माया // 321
text_mt: In the venerable Sāraśāsana, however, this is taught as having six folds. / This tattva known as the knot is the effect of māyā, and beyond it is māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
māyātattvaṃ vibhu kila gahanamarūpaṃ samastavilayapadam /
tatra na bhuvanavibhāgo yukto granthāvasau tasmāt // 322
meaning:
मायातत्त्वं विभु किल गहनमरूपं समस्तविलयपदम् /
तत्र न भुवनविभागो युक्तो ग्रन्थावसौ तस्मात् // 322
text_mt: The māyātattva is indeed all-pervading, fathomless, formless, the place of total dissolution; / a division into worlds is not appropriate there, hence it is placed in the knot.

sanskrit_iast:
māyātattvādhipatiḥ so'nantaḥ samuditānvicāryāṇūn /
yugapatkṣobhayati niśāṃ sā sūte saṃpuṭairanantaiḥ svaiḥ // 323
meaning:
मायातत्त्वाधिपतिः सोऽनन्तः समुदितान्विचार्याणून् /
युगपत्क्षोभयति निशां सा सूते संपुटैरनन्तैः स्वैः // 323
text_mt: Lord Ananta, the master of māyātattva, having examined all the souls assembled together, / agitates the Night (niśā) simultaneously; through her endless folds, she gives birth.

sanskrit_iast:
tena kalādidharāntaṃ yaduktamāvaraṇajālamakhilaṃ tat /
niḥsaṃkhyaṃ ca vicitraṃ māyaivaikā tvabhinneyam // 324
meaning:
तेन कलादिधरान्तं यदुक्तमावरणजालमखिलं तत् /
निःसंख्यं च विचित्रं मायैवैका त्वभिन्नेयम् // 324
text_mt: Therefore, that entire network of coverings described from kalā down to earth, / both countless and diverse, is nothing but this single, undivided māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre ca dharāvyaktātmakaṃ dvayam /
asaṃkhyātaṃ niśāśaktisaṃjñaṃ tvekasvarūpakam // 325
meaning:
उक्तं श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे च धराव्यक्तात्मकं द्वयम् /
असंख्यातं निशाशक्तिसंज्ञं त्वेकस्वरूपकम् // 325
text_mt: And it is declared in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra: 'The pair consisting of earth and avyakta / is countless, yet designated as the Night power (niśāśakti), possessing a single nature.'

sanskrit_iast:
pāśāḥ puroktāḥ praṇavāḥ pañcamānāṣṭakaṃ muneḥ /
kulaṃ yoniśca vāgīśī yasyāṃ jāto na jāyate // 326
meaning:
पाशाः पुरोक्ताः प्रणवाः पञ्चमानाष्टकं मुनेः /
कुलं योनिश्च वागीशी यस्यां जातो न जायते // 326
text_mt: The bonds previously mentioned are the Praṇavas, the sage's five measures, the eightfold set, / the family (kula), the womb, and the mistress of speech (Vāgīśī), born from whom one is not born again.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣākāle'dharādhvasthaśuddhau yaccādharādhvagam /
anantasya samīpe tu tatsarvaṃ pariniṣṭhitam // 327
meaning:
दीक्षाकालेऽधराध्वस्थशुद्धौ यच्चाधराध्वगम् /
अनन्तस्य समीपे तु तत्सर्वं परिनिष्ठितम् // 327
text_mt: At the time of initiation, whatever belongs to the lower path in the purification of what abides in the lower path, / all of that is situated in the proximity of Ananta.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhyo dātā damano dhyāno bhasmeti bindavaḥ pañca /
pañcārthaguhyarudrāṅkuśahṛdayalakṣaṇaṃ ca savyūham // 328
meaning:
साध्यो दाता दमनो ध्यानो भस्मेति बिन्दवः पञ्च /
पञ्चार्थगुह्यरुद्राङ्कुशहृदयलक्षणं च सव्यूहम् // 328
text_mt: Sādhya, Dātā, Damana, Dhyāna, and Bhasman are the five points (bindu); / and the group comprising the secret Rudrāṅkuśahṛdaya of the five matters along with their array,

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣādarśau cetyaṣṭakametatpramāṇānām /
aluptavibhavāḥ sarve māyātattvādhikāriṇaḥ // 329
meaning:
आकर्षादर्शौ चेत्यष्टकमेतत्प्रमाणानाम् /
अलुप्तविभवाः सर्वे मायातत्त्वाधिकारिणः // 329
text_mt: and the two, Ākarṣa and Ādarśa—this makes eight authorities. / Possessing undiminished majesty, all these are presiding officers over māyātattva.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāmayaśarīrāste bhogaṃ svaṃ paribhuñjate /
pralayānte hyanantena saṃhṛtāste tvaharmukhe // 330
meaning:
मायामयशरीरास्ते भोगं स्वं परिभुञ्जते /
प्रलयान्ते ह्यनन्तेन संहृतास्ते त्वहर्मुखे // 330
text_mt: Endowed with bodies formed of māyā, they enjoy their own experiences. / At the end of cosmic dissolution, they are withdrawn by Ananta, but at the dawn of the cosmic day,

sanskrit_iast:
anyānantaprasādena vibudhā api taṃ param /
suptabuddhaṃ manyamānāḥ svatantrammanyatājaḍāḥ // 331
meaning:
अन्यानन्तप्रसादेन विबुधा अपि तं परम् /
सुप्तबुद्धं मन्यमानाः स्वतन्त्रम्मन्यताजडाः // 331
text_mt: by the grace of another Ananta, even these wise beings, regarding that supreme one / as a sleeper or an awakened one, being dull with self-conceit,

sanskrit_iast:
svātmānameva jānanti hetuṃ māyāntarālagāḥ /
ataḥ paraṃ sthitā māyā devī jantuvimohinī // 332
meaning:
स्वात्मानमेव जानन्ति हेतुं मायान्तरालगाः /
अतः परं स्थिता माया देवी जन्तुविमोहिनी // 332
text_mt: consider themselves alone to be the cause, abiding within the interior of māyā. / Beyond this stands the goddess Māyā, who deludes living beings.

sanskrit_iast:
devadevasya sā śaktiratidurghaṭakāritā /
nirvairaparipanthinyā tayā bhramitabuddhayaḥ // 333
meaning:
देवदेवस्य सा शक्तिरतिदुर्घटकारिता /
निर्वैरपरिपन्थिन्या तया भ्रमितबुद्धयः // 333
text_mt: She is the power of the God of gods, who brings about the most difficult feats; / with her intellects bewildered by her who opposes without enmity,

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ tattvamidaṃ neti vivadantīha vādinaḥ /
gurudevāgniśāstreṣu ye na bhaktā narādhamāḥ // 334
meaning:
इदं तत्त्वमिदं नेति विवदन्तीह वादिनः /
गुरुदेवाग्निशास्त्रेषु ये न भक्ता नराधमाः // 334
text_mt: disputants argue here, saying 'this is the true principle' or 'this is not.' / Those lowest of men who have no devotion toward guru, deity, fire, and scriptures—

sanskrit_iast:
satpathaṃ tānparityājya sotpathaṃ nayati dhruvam /
asadyuktivicārajñāñchuṣkatarkāvalambinaḥ // 335
meaning:
सत्पथं तान्परित्याज्य सोत्पथं नयति ध्रुवम् /
असद्युक्तिविचारज्ञाञ्छुष्कतर्कावलम्बिनः // 335
text_mt: she certainly makes them abandon the true path and leads them to the wrong path. / Those who cling to dry logic, skilled in examining fallacious arguments,

sanskrit_iast:
bhramayatyeva tānmāyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā /
śivadīkṣāsinā cchinnā śivajñānāsinā tathā // 336
meaning:
भ्रमयत्येव तान्माया ह्यमोक्षे मोक्षलिप्सया /
शिवदीक्षासिना च्छिन्ना शिवज्ञानासिना तथा // 336
text_mt: māyā continually confuses in what is non-liberation through their desire for liberation. / Once severed by the sword of Śaiva initiation as well as the sword of Śaiva knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
na prarohetpunarnānyo hetustacchedanaṃ prati /
mahāmāyordhvataḥ śuddhā mahāvidyātha mātṛkā // 337
meaning:
न प्ररोहेत्पुनर्नान्यो हेतुस्तच्छेदनं प्रति /
महामायोर्ध्वतः शुद्धा महाविद्याथ मातृका // 337
text_mt: she does not sprout again; there is no other cause for severing her. / Above Mahāmāyā is the pure Mahāvidyā, and then Mātṛkā.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgīśvarī ca tatrasthaṃ vāmādinavasatpuram /
vāmā jyeṣṭhā raudrī kālī kalavikaraṇībalavikārike tathā // 338
meaning:
वागीश्वरी च तत्रस्थं वामादिनवसत्पुरम् /
वामा ज्येष्ठा रौद्री काली कलविकरणीबलविकारिके तथा // 338
text_mt: And Vāgīśvarī, and situated there the nine true cities of Vāmā and the rest: / Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Kalavikaraṇī, and Balavikārikā;

sanskrit_iast:
mathanī damanī manonmanī ca tridṛśaḥ pītāḥ samastāstāḥ /
saptakoṭyo mukhyamantrā vidyātattve'tra saṃsthitāḥ // 339
meaning:
मथनी दमनी मनोन्मनी च त्रिदृशः पीताः समस्तास्ताः /
सप्तकोट्यो मुख्यमन्त्रा विद्यातत्त्वेऽत्र संस्थिताः // 339
text_mt: Mathanī, Damanī, and Manonmanī—all three-eyed and yellow. / In this Vidyātattva are situated seventy million principal mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikārbudalakṣāṃśāḥ padmākārapurā iha /
vidyārājñyastriguṇyādyāḥ sapta saptārbudeśvarāḥ // 340
meaning:
एकैकार्बुदलक्षांशाः पद्माकारपुरा इह /
विद्याराज्ञ्यस्त्रिगुण्याद्याः सप्त सप्तार्बुदेश्वराः // 340
text_mt: each having one hundred-thousandth portion of ten million [souls], having cities shaped like lotuses. / The queens of Vidyā, beginning with Triguṇyā, are seven, rulers over seventy million.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyātattvordhvamaiśaṃ tu tattvaṃ tatra kramordhvagam /
śikhaṇḍyādyamanantāntaṃ purāṣṭakayutaṃ puram // 341
meaning:
विद्यातत्त्वोर्ध्वमैशं तु तत्त्वं तत्र क्रमोर्ध्वगम् /
शिखण्ड्याद्यमनन्तान्तं पुराष्टकयुतं पुरम् // 341
text_mt: Above the level of Vidyā is the level of Īśa; there, rising in order, / is the city endowed with the group of eight cities, beginning with Śikhaṇḍin and ending with Ananta:

sanskrit_iast:
śikhaṇḍī śrīgalo mūrtirekanetraikarudrakau /
śivottamaḥ sūkṣmarudro'nanto vidyeśvarāṣṭakam // 342
meaning:
शिखण्डी श्रीगलो मूर्तिरेकनेत्रैकरुद्रकौ /
शिवोत्तमः सूक्ष्मरुद्रोऽनन्तो विद्येश्वराष्टकम् // 342
text_mt: Śikhaṇḍī, Śrīgaḷa, Mūrti, Ekanetra, Ekarudraka, / Śivottama, Sūkṣmarudra, and Ananta—the eight Lords of Vidyā (Vidyeśvaras),

sanskrit_iast:
kramādūrdhvordhvasaṃsthānaṃ saptānāṃ nāyako vibhuḥ /
ananta eva dhyeyaśca pūjyaścāpyuttarottaraḥ // 343
meaning:
क्रमादूर्ध्वोर्ध्वसंस्थानं सप्तानां नायको विभुः /
अनन्त एव ध्येयश्च पूज्यश्चाप्युत्तरोत्तरः // 343
text_mt: residing higher and higher in succession. The all-pervading leader of the seven / is Ananta; he is to be meditated upon and worshipped, each higher one exceeding the previous.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyamantreśvarāṇāṃ yat sārdhaṃ koṭitrayaṃ sthitam /
tannāyakā ime tena vidyeśāścakravartinaḥ // 344
meaning:
मुख्यमन्त्रेश्वराणां यत् सार्धं कोटित्रयं स्थितम् /
तन्नायका इमे तेन विद्येशाश्चक्रवर्तिनः // 344
text_mt: The thirty-five million principal lords of mantras that exist— / these are their leaders, and for that reason these Lords of Vidyā are sovereign emperors.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca gurubhiritthaṃ śivatanvādyeṣu śāsaneṣvetat /
bhagabilaśatakalitaguhāmūrdhāsanago'ṣṭaśaktiyugdevaḥ // 345
meaning:
उक्तं च गुरुभिरित्थं शिवतन्वाद्येषु शासनेष्वेतत् /
भगबिलशतकलितगुहामूर्धासनगोऽष्टशक्तियुग्देवः // 345
text_mt: And so it has been stated by the gurus in the scriptures such as the Śivatanu: / 'The God, seated on a throne above a cave marked with a hundred openings of the vulva, united with eight powers,

sanskrit_iast:
gahanādyaṃ nirayāntaṃ sṛjati ca rudrāṃśca viniyuṅkte /
uddharati manonmanyā puṃsasteṣveva bhavati madhyasthaḥ // 346
meaning:
गहनाद्यं निरयान्तं सृजति च रुद्रांश्च विनियुङ्क्ते /
उद्धरति मनोन्मन्या पुंसस्तेष्वेव भवति मध्यस्थः // 346
text_mt: creates [the world] from Gahana down to the hells, commissions the Rudras, / redeems souls by means of Manonmanī, and remains neutral among them.

sanskrit_iast:
te tenodastacitaḥ paratattvālocane'bhiniviśante /
sa punaradhaḥ pathavartiṣvadhikṛta evāṇuṣu śivena // 347
meaning:
ते तेनोदस्तचितः परतत्त्वालोचनेऽभिनिविशन्ते /
स पुनरधः पथवर्तिष्वधिकृत एवाणुषु शिवेन // 347
text_mt: With their consciousness raised by him, they enter into the contemplation of the supreme reality. / He, however, is commissioned by Śiva over the bound souls who reside on the lower path.

sanskrit_iast:
avasitapativiniyogaḥ sārdhamanekātmamantrakoṭībhiḥ /
nirvātyanantanāthastaddhāmāviśati sūkṣmarudrastu // 348
meaning:
अवसितपतिविनियोगः सार्धमनेकात्ममन्त्रकोटीभिः /
निर्वात्यनन्तनाथस्तद्धामाविशति सूक्ष्मरुद्रस्तु // 348
text_mt: When the Lord's commission is completed, together with crores of mantras consisting of manifold souls, / Anantanātha attains liberation, and Sūkṣmarudra enters his abode.

sanskrit_iast:
anugṛhyāṇumapūrvaṃ sthāpayati patiḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ sthāne /
ityaṣṭau paripāṭyā yāvaddhāmāni yāti gururekaḥ // 349
meaning:
अनुगृह्याणुमपूर्वं स्थापयति पतिः शिखण्डिनः स्थाने /
इत्यष्टौ परिपाट्या यावद्धामानि याति गुरुरेकः // 349
text_mt: Having graced a new bound soul, the Lord installs him in the place of Śikhaṇḍin.' / In this manner, as one guru proceeds through the eight abodes in order,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadasaṃkhyātānāṃ jantūnāṃ nirvṛtiṃ kurute /
te'ṣṭāvapi śaktyaṣṭakayogāmalajalaruhāsanāsīnāḥ // 350
meaning:
तावदसंख्यातानां जन्तूनां निर्वृतिं कुरुते /
तेऽष्टावपि शक्त्यष्टकयोगामलजलरुहासनासीनाः // 350
text_mt: so he effects the liberation of countless living beings. / All eight of them, seated on immaculate lotus thrones by union with the eight powers,

sanskrit_iast:
ālokayanti devaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ kāraṇaṃ paramam /
taṃ bhagavantamanantaṃ dhyāyantaḥ svahṛdi kāraṇaṃ śāntam // 351
meaning:
आलोकयन्ति देवं हृदयस्थं कारणं परमम् /
तं भगवन्तमनन्तं ध्यायन्तः स्वहृदि कारणं शान्तम् // 351
text_mt: gaze upon the God residing in the heart, the supreme cause. / Meditating upon that Lord Ananta, the tranquil cause, within their own hearts,

sanskrit_iast:
saptānudhyāyantyapi mantrāṇāṃ koṭayaḥ śuddhāḥ /
māyādiravīcyanto bhavastvanantādirucyate'pyabhavaḥ // 352
meaning:
सप्तानुध्यायन्त्यपि मन्त्राणां कोटयः शुद्धाः /
मायादिरवीच्यन्तो भवस्त्वनन्तादिरुच्यतेऽप्यभवः // 352
text_mt: the seven crores of pure mantras also meditate upon him. / Transmigratory existence (bhava) is from Māyā down to the Avīci hell; but non-transmigratory existence (abhava) is said to begin with Ananta,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśuddhaguṇādhīkārāntaḥ so'pyeṣa heyaśca /
atrāpi yato dṛṣṭānugrāhyāṇāṃ niyojyatā śaivī // 353
meaning:
शिवशुद्धगुणाधीकारान्तः सोऽप्येष हेयश्च /
अत्रापि यतो दृष्टानुग्राह्याणां नियोज्यता शैवी // 353
text_mt: ending with the sphere of authority of Śiva's pure qualities; yet even this is to be abandoned, / because even here the Śaiva commissioning of visible recipients of grace is observed,

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭā ca tannivṛttirhyabhavastvadhare na bhūyate yasmāt /
patyurapasarpati yataḥ kāraṇatā kāryatā ca siddhebhyaḥ // 354
meaning:
इष्टा च तन्निवृत्तिर्ह्यभवस्त्वधरे न भूयते यस्मात् /
पत्युरपसर्पति यतः कारणता कार्यता च सिद्धेभ्यः // 354
text_mt: and its cessation is desired; for in the lower [realm] non-transmigratory existence does not occur, / because the Lord's state of being a cause and the state of being an effect depart from the perfected beings.

sanskrit_iast:
kañcukavacchivasiddhau tāvatibhavasaṃjñayātimadhyasthau /
dharmajñānavirāgaiśyacatuṣṭayapuraṃ tu yat // 355
meaning:
कञ्चुकवच्छिवसिद्धौ तावतिभवसंज्ञयातिमध्यस्थौ /
धर्मज्ञानविरागैश्यचतुष्टयपुरं तु यत् // 355
text_mt: In the state of Śiva's perfection, [both] are like a cuirass; they stand completely intermediate under the designation 'transmigratory existence' and 'non-existence'. / As for the city of the fourfold Dharma, Jñāna, Vairāgya, and Aiśvarya,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpāvaraṇasaṃjñaṃ tattattve'sminnaiśvare viduḥ /
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrīti bhuvanatrayaśobhitam // 356
meaning:
रूपावरणसंज्ञं तत्तत्त्वेऽस्मिन्नैश्वरे विदुः /
वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्रीति भुवनत्रयशोभितम् // 356
text_mt: known by the name Rūpāvaraṇa, they recognize it in this tattva of Īśvara. / Adorned with the triad of worlds—Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, and Raudrī—

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmāvaraṇamākhyātamīśatattve gurūttamaiḥ /
aiśātsādāśivaṃ jñānakriyāyugalamaṇḍitam // 357
meaning:
सूक्ष्मावरणमाख्यातमीशतत्त्वे गुरूत्तमैः /
ऐशात्सादाशिवं ज्ञानक्रियायुगलमण्डितम् // 357
text_mt: the Sūkṣmāvaraṇa has been declared in the Īśatattva by the best of gurus. / Beyond the Aiśa is the Sādāśiva, adorned with the pair of knowledge and action;

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhāvaraṇamityāhuruktā śuddhāvṛteḥ param /
vidyāvṛtistato bhāvābhāvaśaktidvayojjvalā // 358
meaning:
शुद्धावरणमित्याहुरुक्ता शुद्धावृतेः परम् /
विद्यावृतिस्ततो भावाभावशक्तिद्वयोज्ज्वला // 358
text_mt: they call it the Śuddhāvaraṇa. Beyond the Śuddhāvṛti is said to be / the Vidyāvṛti; after that, radiant with the two powers of existence and non-existence,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyāvṛtiḥ pramāṇākhyā tataḥ śāstre nirūpitā /
śaktyāvṛtestu tejasvidhruveśābhyāmalaṅkṛtam // 359
meaning:
शक्त्यावृतिः प्रमाणाख्या ततः शास्त्रे निरूपिता /
शक्त्यावृतेस्तु तेजस्विध्रुवेशाभ्यामलङ्कृतम् // 359
text_mt: the Śaktyāvṛti named Pramāṇa is expounded in the scripture. / Beyond the Śaktyāvṛti is the Tejasvyāvaraṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
tejasvyāvaraṇaṃ vedapurā mānāvṛtistataḥ /
mānāvṛteḥ suśuddhāvṛtpuratritayaśobhitā // 360
meaning:
तेजस्व्यावरणं वेदपुरा मानावृतिस्ततः /
मानावृतेः सुशुद्धावृत्पुरत्रितयशोभिता // 360
text_mt: adorned by Tejasvin and Dhruveśa. Then is the Mānāvṛti having four cities; / beyond the Mānāvṛti is the Suśuddhāvṛt, adorned with a triad of cities.

sanskrit_iast:
suśuddhāvaraṇādūrdhva śaivamekapuraṃ bhavet /
śivāvṛterūrdhvamāhurmokṣāvaraṇasaṃjñitam // 361
meaning:
सुशुद्धावरणादूर्ध्व शैवमेकपुरं भवेत् /
शिवावृतेरूर्ध्वमाहुर्मोक्षावरणसंज्ञितम् // 361
text_mt: Above the Suśuddhāvaraṇa there is a single Śaiva city. / Above the Śivāvṛti they speak of that which is named Mokṣāvaraṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāṃ mokṣāvṛtau rudrā ekādaśa nirūpitāḥ /
mokṣāvaraṇatastvekapuramāvaraṇaṃ dhruvam // 362
meaning:
अस्यां मोक्षावृतौ रुद्रा एकादश निरूपिताः /
मोक्षावरणतस्त्वेकपुरमावरणं ध्रुवम् // 362
text_mt: In this Mokṣāvṛti, eleven Rudras are described. / Beyond the Mokṣāvaraṇa is the Dhruvāvaraṇa consisting of one city.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhve dhruvāvṛtericchāvaraṇaṃ tatra te śivāḥ /
īśvarecchāgṛhāntasthāstatpuraṃ caikamucyate // 363
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वे ध्रुवावृतेरिच्छावरणं तत्र ते शिवाः /
ईश्वरेच्छागृहान्तस्थास्तत्पुरं चैकमुच्यते // 363
text_mt: Above the Dhruvāvṛti is the Icchāvaraṇa; there those Śivas / reside inside the abode of the will of Īśvara, and its city is said to be one.

sanskrit_iast:
icchāvṛteḥ prabuddhākhyaṃ digrudrāṣṭakacarcitam /
prabuddhāvaraṇādūrdhva samayāvaraṇaṃ mahat // 364
meaning:
इच्छावृतेः प्रबुद्धाख्यं दिग्रुद्राष्टकचर्चितम् /
प्रबुद्धावरणादूर्ध्व समयावरणं महत् // 364
text_mt: Beyond the Icchāvṛti is that named Prabuddha, attended by the eight Rudras of the directions. / Above the Prabuddhāvaraṇa is the great Samayāvaraṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvanaiḥ pañcabhirgarbhīkṛtānantasamāvṛti /
sāmayātsauśivaṃ tatra sādākhyaṃ bhuvanaṃ mahat // 365
meaning:
भुवनैः पञ्चभिर्गर्भीकृतानन्तसमावृति /
सामयात्सौशिवं तत्र सादाख्यं भुवनं महत् // 365
text_mt: an infinite enclosure encompassing five worlds. / Beyond the Sāmaya is the Sauśiva; there is the great world called Sādākhya.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminsadāśivo devastasya savyāpasavyayoḥ /
jñānakriye parecchā tu śaktirutsaṅgagāminī // 366
meaning:
तस्मिन्सदाशिवो देवस्तस्य सव्यापसव्ययोः /
ज्ञानक्रिये परेच्छा तु शक्तिरुत्सङ्गगामिनी // 366
text_mt: In it is the god Sadāśiva; on his right and left / are knowledge and action, while the power of supreme will rests upon his lap.

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyādipañcakṛtyāni kurute sa tayecchayā /
pañca brahmāṇyaṅgaṣaṭkaṃ sakalādyaṣṭakaṃ śivāḥ // 367
meaning:
सृष्ट्यादिपञ्चकृत्यानि कुरुते स तयेच्छया /
पञ्च ब्रह्माण्यङ्गषट्कं सकलाद्यष्टकं शिवाः // 367
text_mt: Through that will he performs the fivefold acts of creation and the rest. / The five Brahmans, the six auxiliary limbs, the group of eight beginning with Sakala, the Śivas,

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṣṭādaśa rudrāśca taireva suśivo vṛtaḥ /
sadyo vāmāghorau puruṣeśau brahmapañcakaṃ hṛdayam // 368
meaning:
दशाष्टादश रुद्राश्च तैरेव सुशिवो वृतः /
सद्यो वामाघोरौ पुरुषेशौ ब्रह्मपञ्चकं हृदयम् // 368
text_mt: and the ten and eighteen Rudras: by them alone Suśiva is surrounded. / Sadyo[jāta], Vāma, Aghora, and the two Puruṣas (Tatpuruṣa and Īśāna) are the five Brahmans. The heart,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhaśikhāvarmadṛgastramaṅgāni ṣaṭ prāhuḥ /
sakalākalaśūnyaiḥ saha kalāḍhyakhamalaṅkṛte kṣapaṇamantyam // 369
meaning:
मूर्धशिखावर्मदृगस्त्रमङ्गानि षट् प्राहुः /
सकलाकलशून्यैः सह कलाढ्यखमलङ्कृते क्षपणमन्त्यम् // 369
text_mt: head, crest, armour, eye, and weapon are called the six limbs. / Along with Sakala, Akala, and Śūnya, the space endowed with kalās is adorned, and the final is Kṣapaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhyauṣṭhyamaṣṭamaṃ kila sakalāṣṭakametadāmnātam /
oṃ kāraśivau dīpto hetvīśadaśeśakau suśivakālau // 370
meaning:
कण्ठ्यौष्ठ्यमष्टमं किल सकलाष्टकमेतदाम्नातम् /
ओं कारशिवौ दीप्तो हेत्वीशदशेशकौ सुशिवकालौ // 370
text_mt: the eighth is indeed Kaṇṭhyauṣṭhya—this is handed down as the Sakalāṣṭaka. / Oṅkāra and Śiva, Dīpta, Hetvīśa and Daśeśaka, Suśiva and Kāla,

sanskrit_iast:
sūkṣmasutejaḥśarvāḥ śivāḥ daśaite'tra pūrvādeḥ /
vijayo niḥśvāsaśca svāyambhuvo vahnivīrarauravakāḥ // 371
meaning:
सूक्ष्मसुतेजःशर्वाः शिवाः दशैतेऽत्र पूर्वादेः /
विजयो निःश्वासश्च स्वायम्भुवो वह्निवीररौरवकाः // 371
text_mt: Sūkṣma, Sutejas, and Śarva—these are the ten Śivas here, beginning from the east. / Vijaya and Niḥśvāsa, Svāyambhuva, the Vahnivīras, Rauravaka,

sanskrit_iast:
mukuṭavisarenduvinduprodgītā lalitasiddharudrau ca /
santānaśivau parakiraṇapārameśā iti smṛtā rudrāḥ // 372
meaning:
मुकुटविसरेन्दुविन्दुप्रोद्गीता ललितसिद्धरुद्रौ च /
सन्तानशिवौ परकिरणपारमेशा इति स्मृता रुद्राः // 372
text_mt: Mukuṭa, Visara, Indu, Vindu, Prodgīta, Lalitarudra and Siddharudra, / Santāna and Śiva, Parakiraṇa and Pārameśa—these are remembered as the [eighteen] Rudras.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeteṣāṃ jñānāni viduḥ svatulyanāmāni /
mantramunikoṭiparivṛta matha vibhuvāmādirudratacchaktiyutam // 373
meaning:
सर्वेषामेतेषां ज्ञानानि विदुः स्वतुल्यनामानि /
मन्त्रमुनिकोटिपरिवृत मथ विभुवामादिरुद्रतच्छक्तियुतम् // 373
text_mt: They recognize that the knowledge-revelations of all of these bear names identical to their own. / Surrounded by tens of millions of mantras and sages, endowed with the all-pervading Rudras—Vāmā and the rest—and their powers,

sanskrit_iast:
tārādiśaktijuṣṭaṃ suśivāsanamatisitakajamasaṃkhyadalam /
yaḥ śaktirudravargaḥ parivāre viṣṭare ca suśivasya // 374
meaning:
तारादिशक्तिजुष्टं सुशिवासनमतिसितकजमसंख्यदलम् /
यः शक्तिरुद्रवर्गः परिवारे विष्टरे च सुशिवस्य // 374
text_mt: enjoyed by powers beginning with Tārā, is the throne of Suśiva: an exceedingly white lotus of countless petals. / The host of powers and Rudras that forms the retinue and throne of Suśiva—

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekamasya nijanijaparivāre parārdhakoṭayo'saṃkhyāḥ /
māyāmalanirmuktāḥ kevalamadhikāramātrasaṃrūḍhāḥ // 375
meaning:
प्रत्येकमस्य निजनिजपरिवारे परार्धकोटयोऽसंख्याः /
मायामलनिर्मुक्ताः केवलमधिकारमात्रसंरूढाः // 375
text_mt: each one of them has in its own retinue countless quadrillions [of attendants]. / Liberated from the impurity of Māyā, established merely in cosmic office,

sanskrit_iast:
suśivāvaraṇe rudrāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvaśaktisampūrṇāḥ /
adhikārabandhavilaye śāntāḥ śivarūpiṇo punarbhavinaḥ // 376
meaning:
सुशिवावरणे रुद्राः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वशक्तिसम्पूर्णाः /
अधिकारबन्धविलये शान्ताः शिवरूपिणो पुनर्भविनः // 376
text_mt: the Rudras in the enclosure of Suśiva are omniscient and full of all powers. / Upon the dissolution of the bond of office, peaceful, of the nature of Śiva, they are not reborn.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhve bindvāvṛtirdīptā tatra tatra padmaṃ śaśiprabham /
śāntyatītaḥ śivastatra tacchaktyutsaṅgabhūṣitaḥ // 377
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वे बिन्द्वावृतिर्दीप्ता तत्र तत्र पद्मं शशिप्रभम् /
शान्त्यतीतः शिवस्तत्र तच्छक्त्युत्सङ्गभूषितः // 377
text_mt: Above is the radiant Bindvāvṛti; there is a lotus shining like the moon. / Śāntyatīta Śiva is there, adorned by his power sitting upon his lap,

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttyādikalāvargaparivārasamāvṛtaḥ /
asaṃkhyarudratacchaktipurakoṭibhirāvṛtaḥ // 378
meaning:
निवृत्त्यादिकलावर्गपरिवारसमावृतः /
असंख्यरुद्रतच्छक्तिपुरकोटिभिरावृतः // 378
text_mt: surrounded by the retinue of the groups of kalās beginning with Nivṛtti, / enveloped by millions of cities of countless Rudras and their powers.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanmataṅgaśāstre ca layākhyaṃ tattvamuttamam /
pāribhāṣikamityetannāmnā bindurihocyate // 379
meaning:
श्रीमन्मतङ्गशास्त्रे च लयाख्यं तत्त्वमुत्तमम् /
पारिभाषिकमित्येतन्नाम्ना बिन्दुरिहोच्यते // 379
text_mt: And in the venerable Mataṅga treatise, the supreme principle named Laya / is conventionally referred to here by the name Bindu.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmūrtimayaṃ śubhraṃ yattatsakalaniṣkalam /
tasminbhogaḥ samuddiṣṭa ityatredaṃ ca varṇitam // 380
meaning:
चतुर्मूर्तिमयं शुभ्रं यत्तत्सकलनिष्कलम् /
तस्मिन्भोगः समुद्दिष्ट इत्यत्रेदं च वर्णितम् // 380
text_mt: That which consists of four forms, luminous, which is both Sakala and Niṣkala: / in it experiential enjoyment is taught; thus this has been described here.

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttyādeḥ susūkṣmatvāddharādyārabdhadehatā /
mātuḥ sphūrjanmahājñānalīnatvānna vibhāvyate // 381
meaning:
निवृत्त्यादेः सुसूक्ष्मत्वाद्धराद्यारब्धदेहता /
मातुः स्फूर्जन्महाज्ञानलीनत्वान्न विभाव्यते // 381
text_mt: Because Nivṛtti and the others are extremely subtle, the condition of having a body formed from earth and the rest / is not perceived, since the knower is absorbed in flaming great knowledge. // 381

sanskrit_iast:
udrikta taijasatvena hemno bhūparamāṇavaḥ /
yathā pṛthaṅna bhāntyevamūrdhvādhorudradehagāḥ // 382
meaning:
उद्रिक्त तैजसत्वेन हेम्नो भूपरमाणवः /
यथा पृथङ्न भान्त्येवमूर्ध्वाधोरुद्रदेहगाः // 382
text_mt: Just as the earth-atoms in gold do not appear separate, / because the fiery nature is predominant, so too for those residing in the bodies of the Rudras above and below. // 382

sanskrit_iast:
bindūrdhve'rdhenduretasya kalā jyotsnā ca tadvatī /
kāntiḥ prabhā ca vimalā pañcaitā rodhikāstataḥ // 383
meaning:
बिन्दूर्ध्वेऽर्धेन्दुरेतस्य कला ज्योत्स्ना च तद्वती /
कान्तिः प्रभा च विमला पञ्चैता रोधिकास्ततः // 383
text_mt: Above the Bindu is the half-moon (Ardhendu); its Kalās are Jyotsnā and Tadvatī, / Kānti, Prabhā, and Vimalā: these are five; next is Rodhikā. // 383

sanskrit_iast:
rundhanī rodhanī roddhrī jñānabodhā tamopahā /
etāḥ pañca kalāḥ prāhurnirodhinyāṃ gurūttamāh // 384
meaning:
रुन्धनी रोधनी रोद्ध्री ज्ञानबोधा तमोपहा /
एताः पञ्च कलाः प्राहुर्निरोधिन्यां गुरूत्तमाह् // 384
text_mt: Rundhanī, Rodhanī, Roddhrī, Jñānabodhā, and Tamopahā: / the best of gurus state these five Kalās to be in Nirodhinī. // 384

sanskrit_iast:
ardhamātraḥ smṛto bindurvyomarūpī catuṣkalaḥ /
tadardhamardhacandrastadaṣṭāṃśena nirodhikā // 385
meaning:
अर्धमात्रः स्मृतो बिन्दुर्व्योमरूपी चतुष्कलः /
तदर्धमर्धचन्द्रस्तदष्टांशेन निरोधिका // 385
text_mt: The Bindu is taught as having half a mora, possessing the form of space and having four Kalās. / Half of that is Ardhacandra; by an eighth part thereof is Nirodhikā. // 385

sanskrit_iast:
hetūnbrahmādikān runddhe rodhikāṃ tāṃ tyajettataḥ /
nirodhikāmimāṃ bhittvā sādākhyaṃ bhuvanaṃ param // 386
meaning:
हेतून्ब्रह्मादिकान् रुन्द्धे रोधिकां तां त्यजेत्ततः /
निरोधिकामिमां भित्त्वा सादाख्यं भुवनं परम् // 386
text_mt: She obstructs the causal deities such as Brahmā; one should therefore abandon that Rodhikā. / Having pierced this Nirodhikā, [there is] the supreme realm of Sadākhya, // 386

sanskrit_iast:
pararūpeṇa yatrāste pañcamantramahātanuḥ /
ityardhendunirodhyantabindvāvṛtyūrdhvato mahān // 387
meaning:
पररूपेण यत्रास्ते पञ्चमन्त्रमहातनुः /
इत्यर्धेन्दुनिरोध्यन्तबिन्द्वावृत्यूर्ध्वतो महान् // 387
text_mt: where He resides in supreme form, whose great body consists of the five Mantras. / Thus, above the enclosure of the Bindu that ends with Ardhendu and Nirodhī, [resides] the great // 387

sanskrit_iast:
nādaḥ kiñjalkasadṛśo mahadbhiḥ puruṣairvṛtaḥ /
catvāri bhuvanānyatra dikṣu madhye ca pañcamam // 388
meaning:
नादः किञ्जल्कसदृशो महद्भिः पुरुषैर्वृतः /
चत्वारि भुवनान्यत्र दिक्षु मध्ये च पञ्चमम् // 388
text_mt: Nāda, resembling a lotus filament, surrounded by great beings (puruṣas). / There are four realms here in the cardinal directions, and a fifth in the center. // 388

sanskrit_iast:
indhikā dīpikā caiva rodhikā mocikordhvagā /
madhye'tra padmaṃ tatrordhvagāmī tacchaktibhirvṛtaḥ // 389
meaning:
इन्धिका दीपिका चैव रोधिका मोचिकोर्ध्वगा /
मध्येऽत्र पद्मं तत्रोर्ध्वगामी तच्छक्तिभिर्वृतः // 389
text_mt: Indhikā, Dīpikā, Rodhikā, Mocikā, and Ūrdhvagā. / Here in the center is a lotus; upon it is Ūrdhvagāmin, surrounded by His powers. // 389

sanskrit_iast:
nādordhvatastu sauṣumnaṃ tatra tacchaktibhṛtprabhuḥ /
tadīśaḥ piṅgalelābhyāṃ vṛtaḥ savyāpasavyayoḥ // 390
meaning:
नादोर्ध्वतस्तु सौषुम्नं तत्र तच्छक्तिभृत्प्रभुः /
तदीशः पिङ्गलेलाभ्यां वृतः सव्यापसव्ययोः // 390
text_mt: Above Nāda is the Suṣumnā realm; there the Lord resides bearing His powers, / the Lord of that realm, flanked by Piṅgalā and Iḍā to the right and the left. // 390

sanskrit_iast:
yā prabhoraṅkagā devī suṣumnā śaśisaprabhā /
grathito'dhvā tayā sarva ūrdhvaścādhastanastathā // 391
meaning:
या प्रभोरङ्कगा देवी सुषुम्ना शशिसप्रभा /
ग्रथितोऽध्वा तया सर्व ऊर्ध्वश्चाधस्तनस्तथा // 391
text_mt: The Goddess on the Lord's lap is Suṣumnā, possessing the splendor of the moon; / by Her the entire path—both upper and lower—is woven together. // 391

sanskrit_iast:
nādaḥsuṣumnādhārastu bhittvā viśvamidaṃ jagat /
adhaḥśaktyā vinirgacchedūrdhvaśaktyā ca mūrdhataḥ // 392
meaning:
नादःसुषुम्नाधारस्तु भित्त्वा विश्वमिदं जगत् /
अधःशक्त्या विनिर्गच्छेदूर्ध्वशक्त्या च मूर्धतः // 392
text_mt: Nāda, supported by Suṣumnā, having pierced this entire universe, / would issue forth by the lower power, and from the crown of the head by the upper power. // 392

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍyā brahmabile līnaḥ so'vyaktadhvanirakṣaraḥ /
nadansarveṣu bhūteṣu śivaśaktyā hyadhiṣṭhitaḥ // 393
meaning:
नाड्या ब्रह्मबिले लीनः सोऽव्यक्तध्वनिरक्षरः /
नदन्सर्वेषु भूतेषु शिवशक्त्या ह्यधिष्ठितः // 393
text_mt: Absorbed in the opening of Brahmā (brahmabila) via the channel, it is unmanifest, imperishable sound, / resounding in all beings, presided over indeed by Śiva's power. // 393

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumnordhve brahmabilasaṃjñayāvaraṇaṃ tridṛk /
tatra brahmā sitaḥ śūlī pañcāsyaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ // 394
meaning:
सुषुम्नोर्ध्वे ब्रह्मबिलसंज्ञयावरणं त्रिदृक् /
तत्र ब्रह्मा सितः शूली पञ्चास्यः शशिशेखरः // 394
text_mt: Above Suṣumnā is the enclosure named the opening of Brahmā, having three eyes; / there resides white Brahmā, holding a trident, five-faced, moon-crested. // 394

sanskrit_iast:
tasyotsaṅge parā devī brahmāṇī mokṣamārgagā /
roddhrī dātrī ca mokṣasya tāṃ bhittvā cordhvakuṇḍalī // 395
meaning:
तस्योत्सङ्गे परा देवी ब्रह्माणी मोक्षमार्गगा /
रोद्ध्री दात्री च मोक्षस्य तां भित्त्वा चोर्ध्वकुण्डली // 395
text_mt: On His lap is the supreme Goddess Brahmāṇī, situated on the path of liberation, / who both obstructs and grants liberation. Piercing Her, [there is] Ūrdhvakuṇḍalī. // 395

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiḥ suptāhisadṛśī sā viśvādhāra ucyate /
tasyāṃ sūkṣmā susūkṣmā ca tathānye amṛtāmite // 396
meaning:
शक्तिः सुप्ताहिसदृशी सा विश्वाधार उच्यते /
तस्यां सूक्ष्मा सुसूक्ष्मा च तथान्ये अमृतामिते // 396
text_mt: The power resembles a sleeping serpent; She is called the support of the universe. / In Her reside Sūkṣmā and Susūkṣmā, and likewise the other two, Amṛtā and Amitā. // 396

sanskrit_iast:
madhyato vyāpinī tasyāṃ vyāpīśo vyāpinīdharaḥ /
śaktitattvamidaṃ yasya prapañco'yaṃ dharāntakaḥ // 397
meaning:
मध्यतो व्यापिनी तस्यां व्यापीशो व्यापिनीधरः /
शक्तितत्त्वमिदं यस्य प्रपञ्चोऽयं धरान्तकः // 397
text_mt: In the middle is Vyāpinī; in Her is Vyāpīśa, the bearer of Vyāpinī. / This is the tattva of Śakti, whose expansion terminates with earth. // 397

sanskrit_iast:
śivatattvaṃ tatastatra caturdikkaṃ vyavasthitāḥ /
vyāpī vyomātmako'nanto'nāthastacchaktibhāginaḥ // 398
meaning:
शिवतत्त्वं ततस्तत्र चतुर्दिक्कं व्यवस्थिताः /
व्यापी व्योमात्मकोऽनन्तोऽनाथस्तच्छक्तिभागिनः // 398
text_mt: Above that is Śivatattva; there, stationed in the four directions, / are Vyāpin, the space-formed Ananta, and Anātha, who share His power. // 398

sanskrit_iast:
madhye tvanāśritaṃ tatra devadevo hyanāśritaḥ /
tacchaktyutsaṅgabhṛtsūryaśatakoṭisamaprabhaḥ // 399
meaning:
मध्ये त्वनाश्रितं तत्र देवदेवो ह्यनाश्रितः /
तच्छक्त्युत्सङ्गभृत्सूर्यशतकोटिसमप्रभः // 399
text_mt: In the center, however, is Anāśrita; there the God of gods, indeed Anāśrita, / holds His power upon His lap, possessing a splendor equal to a billion suns. // 399

sanskrit_iast:
śivatattvordhvataḥ śaktiḥ parā sā samanāhvayā /
sarveṣāṃ kāraṇānāṃ sā kartṛbhūtā vyavasthitā // 400
meaning:
शिवतत्त्वोर्ध्वतः शक्तिः परा सा समनाह्वया /
सर्वेषां कारणानां सा कर्तृभूता व्यवस्थिता // 400
text_mt: Above Śivatattva is the supreme power named Samanā; / She is established as the active agent of all causal deities. // 400

sanskrit_iast:
bibhartyaṇḍānyanekāni śivena samadhiṣṭhitā /
tadārūḍhaḥ śivaḥ kṛtyapañcakaṃ kurute prabhuḥ // 401
meaning:
बिभर्त्यण्डान्यनेकानि शिवेन समधिष्ठिता /
तदारूढः शिवः कृत्यपञ्चकं कुरुते प्रभुः // 401
text_mt: Presided over by Śiva, She sustains many cosmic eggs. / Mounted upon Her, Lord Śiva performs the fivefold cosmic act. // 401

sanskrit_iast:
samanā karaṇaṃ tasya hetukarturmahośituḥ /
anāśritaṃ tu vyāpāre nimittaṃ heturucyate // 402
meaning:
समना करणं तस्य हेतुकर्तुर्महोशितुः /
अनाश्रितं तु व्यापारे निमित्तं हेतुरुच्यते // 402
text_mt: Samanā is the instrument of that supreme Lord who is the causal agent; / while Anāśrita is stated to be the prompting cause (hetu) in the activity. // 402

sanskrit_iast:
tayādhitiṣṭhati vibhuḥ kāraṇānāṃ tu pañcakam /
anāśrito'nāthamayamanantaṃ khavapuḥ sadā // 403
meaning:
तयाधितिष्ठति विभुः कारणानां तु पञ्चकम् /
अनाश्रितोऽनाथमयमनन्तं खवपुः सदा // 403
text_mt: Through Her the all-pervading Lord presides over the pentad of causal deities; / Anāśrita, composed of Anātha, is Ananta, ever having space as His body. // 403

sanskrit_iast:
sa vyāpinaṃ prerayati svaśaktyā karaṇena tu /
karmarūpā sthitā māyā yadadhaḥ śaktikuṇḍalī // 404
meaning:
स व्यापिनं प्रेरयति स्वशक्त्या करणेन तु /
कर्मरूपा स्थिता माया यदधः शक्तिकुण्डली // 404
text_mt: He impels Vyāpin by means of His own power, the instrument; / while Māyā stands in the form of the object, beneath which is Śaktikuṇḍalī. // 404

sanskrit_iast:
nādabindvādikaṃ kāryamityādijagadudbhavaḥ /
yatsadāśivaparyantaṃ pārthivādyaṃ ca śāsane // 405
meaning:
नादबिन्द्वादिकं कार्यमित्यादिजगदुद्भवः /
यत्सदाशिवपर्यन्तं पार्थिवाद्यं च शासने // 405
text_mt: The effect is Nāda, Bindu, and so on; thus proceeds the origination of the world. / In the teaching, whatever begins with the earth element and extends up to Sadāśiva // 405

sanskrit_iast:
tatsarva prākṛtaṃ proktaṃ vināśotpattisaṃyutam /
atha sakalabhuvanamānaṃ yanmahyaṃ nigaditaṃ nijairgurubhiḥ // 406
meaning:
तत्सर्व प्राकृतं प्रोक्तं विनाशोत्पत्तिसंयुतम् /
अथ सकलभुवनमानं यन्मह्यं निगदितं निजैर्गुरुभिः // 406
text_mt: is all declared to be material (prākṛta), accompanied by origination and destruction. / Now the extent of all the worlds that was imparted to me by my own gurus // 406

sanskrit_iast:
tadvakṣyate samāsādbuddhau yenāśu saṅkrāmet /
aṇḍasyāntaranantaḥ kālaḥ kūṣmāṇḍahāṭakau brahmaharī // 407
meaning:
तद्वक्ष्यते समासाद्बुद्धौ येनाशु सङ्क्रामेत् /
अण्डस्यान्तरनन्तः कालः कूष्माण्डहाटकौ ब्रह्महरी // 407
text_mt: will be stated concisely so that it may enter quickly into the intellect: / within the egg are Ananta, Kāla, Kūṣmāṇḍa, Hāṭaka, Brahmā, and Hari; // 407

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāḥ śataṃ savīraṃ bahirnivṛttistu sāṣṭaśatabhuvanā syāt /
jalatejaḥsamīranabho'haṃkṛddhīmūlasaptake pratyekam // 408
meaning:
रुद्राः शतं सवीरं बहिर्निवृत्तिस्तु साष्टशतभुवना स्यात् /
जलतेजःसमीरनभोऽहंकृद्धीमूलसप्तके प्रत्येकम् // 408
text_mt: outside are a hundred Rudras together with the heroes (vīras). Nivṛtti comprises one hundred and eight worlds: / in the seven, namely water, fire, wind, space, egoity, intellect, and the root [prakṛti], each has // 408

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭau ṣaṭpañcāśadbhuvanā tena pratiṣṭheti kalā kathitā /
atra prāhuḥ śodhyānaṣṭau kecinnijāṣṭakādhipatīn // 409
meaning:
अष्टौ षट्पञ्चाशद्भुवना तेन प्रतिष्ठेति कला कथिता /
अत्र प्राहुः शोध्यानष्टौ केचिन्निजाष्टकाधिपतीन् // 409
text_mt: eight [worlds]; thus the Kalā called Pratiṣṭhā is said to consist of fifty-six worlds. / Here some say that only eight—the lords of their respective octads—are to be purified, // 409

sanskrit_iast:
anye tu samastānāṃ śodhyatvaṃ varṇayanti bhuvanānām /
śrībhūtirājamiśrā guravaḥ prāhuḥ punarbahī rudraśatam // 410
meaning:
अन्ये तु समस्तानां शोध्यत्वं वर्णयन्ति भुवनानाम् /
श्रीभूतिराजमिश्रा गुरवः प्राहुः पुनर्बही रुद्रशतम् // 410
