vedyasattāṃ bahirbhūtāmanapekṣyaiva sarvataḥ // 255
meaning:
पदं च तत्समापत्ति पदस्थं योगिनो विदुः /
वेद्यसत्तां बहिर्भूतामनपेक्ष्यैव सर्वतः // 255
text_mt: And that sphere is meditative absorption; yogins know it as ‘abiding in the sphere’ (padastha). / Completely disregarding the reality of objects of knowledge as existing outside, // 255

sanskrit_iast:
vedye svātantryabhāg jñānaṃ svapnaṃ vyāptitayā bhajet /
mānabhūmiriyaṃ mukhyā svapno hyāmarśanātmakaḥ // 256
meaning:
वेद्ये स्वातन्त्र्यभाग् ज्ञानं स्वप्नं व्याप्तितया भजेत् /
मानभूमिरियं मुख्या स्वप्नो ह्यामर्शनात्मकः // 256
text_mt: Knowledge sharing in absolute autonomy over the object of knowledge resorts to dream as a pervading state. / This is the primary level of the means of knowledge, for dream consists of reflective appraisal. // 256

sanskrit_iast:
vedyacchāyo'vabhāso hi meye'dhiṣṭhānamucyate /
yattvadhiṣṭhātṛbhūtādeḥ pūrvoktasya vapurdhruvam // 257
meaning:
वेद्यच्छायोऽवभासो हि मेयेऽधिष्ठानमुच्यते /
यत्त्वधिष्ठातृभूतादेः पूर्वोक्तस्य वपुर्ध्रुवम् // 257
text_mt: The manifestation bearing the shadow of the object of knowledge is indeed called the ‘basis’ regarding the object. / But that unchanging nature of the previously mentioned conscious controller of the elements and so forth, // 257

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ viśvasya tattūṣṇīṃbhūtaṃ sauṣuptamucyate /
anubhūtau vikalpe ca yo'sau draṣṭā sa eva hi // 258
meaning:
बीजं विश्वस्य तत्तूष्णींभूतं सौषुप्तमुच्यते /
अनुभूतौ विकल्पे च योऽसौ द्रष्टा स एव हि // 258
text_mt: Which is the seed of the universe and has become silent, is called deep sleep. / For he who is the witness in direct experience and in conceptualization is the very same [one]. // 258

sanskrit_iast:
na bhāvagrahaṇaṃ tena suṣṭhu suptatvamucyate /
tatsāmyāllaukikīṃ nidrāṃ suṣuptaṃ manvate budhāḥ // 259
meaning:
न भावग्रहणं तेन सुष्ठु सुप्तत्वमुच्यते /
तत्साम्याल्लौकिकीं निद्रां सुषुप्तं मन्वते बुधाः // 259
text_mt: Therefore, there is no grasping of entities; this is called being ‘soundly asleep’. / By analogy with this, the wise consider conventional slumber to be deep sleep. // 259

sanskrit_iast:
bījabhāvo'thāgrahaṇaṃ sāmyaṃ tūṣṇīṃsvabhāvatā /
mukhyā mātṛdaśā seyaṃ suṣuptākhyā nigadyate // 260
meaning:
बीजभावोऽथाग्रहणं साम्यं तूष्णींस्वभावता /
मुख्या मातृदशा सेयं सुषुप्ताख्या निगद्यते // 260
text_mt: The condition of being the seed, non-grasping, equality, and having a silent nature— / this is said to be that primary state of the subject, designated as deep sleep. // 260

sanskrit_iast:
rūpakatvācca rūpaṃ tattādātmyaṃ yoginaḥ punaḥ /
rūpasthaṃ tatsamāpattyaudāsīnyaṃ rūpiṇāṃ viduḥ // 261
meaning:
रूपकत्वाच्च रूपं तत्तादात्म्यं योगिनः पुनः /
रूपस्थं तत्समापत्त्यौदासीन्यं रूपिणां विदुः // 261
text_mt: And because it is an agent of differentiation, it is ‘form’ (rūpa); yogins know identity with it / as ‘abiding in form’ (rūpastha), which, through absorption in it, is indifference regarding differentiated entities. // 261

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṃkhyānavataḥ kāpi vedyasaṃkocanātra yat /
nāsti tena mahāvyāptiriyaṃ tadanusārataḥ // 262
meaning:
प्रसंख्यानवतः कापि वेद्यसंकोचनात्र यत् /
नास्ति तेन महाव्याप्तिरियं तदनुसारतः // 262
text_mt: Because for one possessing higher contemplation there is here no limitation whatever by objects of knowledge, / this is therefore the ‘great pervasion’ in accordance with that. // 262

sanskrit_iast:
udāsīnasya tasyāpi vedyaṃ yena caturvidham /
bhūtādi tadupādhyutthamatra bhedacatuṣṭayam // 263
meaning:
उदासीनस्य तस्यापि वेद्यं येन चतुर्विधम् /
भूतादि तदुपाध्युत्थमत्र भेदचतुष्टयम् // 263
text_mt: Because the object of knowledge even for that indifferent one is fourfold, / the fourfold distinction here arises from its conditioning adjuncts such as the elements: // 263

sanskrit_iast:
uditaṃ vipulaṃ śāntaṃ suprasannamathāparam /
yattu pramātmakaṃ rūpaṃ pramāturupari sthitam // 264
meaning:
उदितं विपुलं शान्तं सुप्रसन्नमथापरम् /
यत्तु प्रमात्मकं रूपं प्रमातुरुपरि स्थितम् // 264
text_mt: The arisen, the extensive, the quiescent, and then the exceedingly serene. / But the form that consists of the means of knowledge, standing above the knower, // 264

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇatāgamanaunmukhyamaudāsīnyātparicyutiḥ /
tatturyamucyate śaktisamāveśo hyasau mataḥ // 265
meaning:
पूर्णतागमनौन्मुख्यमौदासीन्यात्परिच्युतिः /
तत्तुर्यमुच्यते शक्तिसमावेशो ह्यसौ मतः // 265
text_mt: Turning toward the attainment of fullness, slipping away from indifference— / that is called the fourth [state, turya]; for it is considered absorption in power. // 265

sanskrit_iast:
sā saṃvitsvaprakāśā tu kaiściduktā prameyataḥ /
mānānmātuśca bhinnaiva tadarthaṃ tritayaṃ yataḥ // 266
meaning:
सा संवित्स्वप्रकाशा तु कैश्चिदुक्ता प्रमेयतः /
मानान्मातुश्च भिन्नैव तदर्थं त्रितयं यतः // 266
text_mt: That consciousness, however, is self-luminous, though stated by some to be distinct from the object of knowledge, / from the means of knowledge, and from the knower, since the triad exists for its sake. // 266

sanskrit_iast:
meyaṃ māne mātari tat so'pi tasyāṃ mitau sphuṭam /
viśrāmyatīti saivaiṣā devī viśvaikajīvitam // 267
meaning:
मेयं माने मातरि तत् सोऽपि तस्यां मितौ स्फुटम् /
विश्राम्यतीति सैवैषा देवी विश्वैकजीवितम् // 267
text_mt: The object rests in the means of knowledge, that in the knower, and he rests clearly in that cognition. / Thus, this very Goddess is the sole life of the universe. // 267

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ dṛśāhamityaṃśatrayamuttīrya vartate /
dvāramātrāśritopāyā paśyāmītyanupāyikā // 268
meaning:
रूपं दृशाहमित्यंशत्रयमुत्तीर्य वर्तते /
द्वारमात्राश्रितोपाया पश्यामीत्यनुपायिका // 268
text_mt: Transcending the threefold portion of ‘object of sight’, ‘seeing’, and ‘I’, she endures; / having a means based solely on a gateway, she is without means in the sense of ‘I see’. // 268

sanskrit_iast:
pramātṛtā svatantratvarūpā seyaṃ prakāśate /
saṃvitturīyarūpaivaṃ prakāśātmā svayaṃ ca sā // 269
meaning:
प्रमातृता स्वतन्त्रत्वरूपा सेयं प्रकाशते /
संवित्तुरीयरूपैवं प्रकाशात्मा स्वयं च सा // 269
text_mt: This subjectivity shines forth consisting of absolute autonomy; / in this way, consciousness is the fourth form, and it is itself luminous by nature. // 269

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamāveśatādātmye mātṛtvaṃ bhavati sphuṭam /
tatsamāveśoparāgānmānatvaṃ meyatā punaḥ // 270
meaning:
तत्समावेशतादात्म्ये मातृत्वं भवति स्फुटम् /
तत्समावेशोपरागान्मानत्वं मेयता पुनः // 270
text_mt: In identity with absorption into it, subjectivity becomes manifest; / from the coloring of absorption into it comes the status of means of knowledge, and the status of object of knowledge, moreover, // 270

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamāveśanaikaṭyāttrayaṃ tattadanugrahāt /
vedyādibhedagalanāduktā seyamanāmayā // 271
meaning:
तत्समावेशनैकट्यात्त्रयं तत्तदनुग्रहात् /
वेद्यादिभेदगलनादुक्ता सेयमनामया // 271
text_mt: Arises from proximity to absorption into it; that triad exists by its grace. / Because the differentiation of object of knowledge and so forth dissolves, this [state] is called untainted. // 271

sanskrit_iast:
mātrādyanugrahādā(dhā)nātsavyāpāreti bhaṇyate /
jāgradādyapi devasya śaktitvena vyavasthitam // 272
meaning:
मात्राद्यनुग्रहादा(धा)नात्सव्यापारेति भण्यते /
जाग्रदाद्यपि देवस्य शक्तित्वेन व्यवस्थितम् // 272
text_mt: It is said to be ‘active’ because it bestows grace upon the knower and the rest. / Even the waking state and the rest are established as powers of the Lord. // 272

sanskrit_iast:
aparaṃ parāparaṃ ca dvidhā tatsā parā tviyam /
rūpakatvādudāsīnāccyuteyaṃ pūrṇatonmukhī // 273
meaning:
अपरं परापरं च द्विधा तत्सा परा त्वियम् /
रूपकत्वादुदासीनाच्च्युतेयं पूर्णतोन्मुखी // 273
text_mt: They are of two kinds: lower and intermediate; but this [fourth] is the supreme [power]. / Having fallen away from the indifferent [state] because it is differentiating, and turning toward fullness, // 273

sanskrit_iast:
daśā tasyāṃ samāpattī rūpātītaṃ tu yoginaḥ /
pūrṇataunmukhyayogitvādviśvaṃ paśyati tanmayaḥ // 274
meaning:
दशा तस्यां समापत्ती रूपातीतं तु योगिनः /
पूर्णतौन्मुख्ययोगित्वाद्विश्वं पश्यति तन्मयः // 274
text_mt: When absorption occurs in that state, yogins call it ‘transcending form’ (rūpātīta). / Because he is joined with turning toward fullness, he who is identified with it perceives the universe. // 274

sanskrit_iast:
prasaṃkhyātā pracayatasteneyaṃ pracayo matā /
naitasyāmaparā turyadaśā saṃbhāvyate kila // 275
meaning:
प्रसंख्याता प्रचयतस्तेनेयं प्रचयो मता /
नैतस्यामपरा तुर्यदशा संभाव्यते किल // 275
text_mt: It is gathered up by the contemplator, and therefore this is considered ‘accumulation’ (pracaya). / Indeed, in this state no other fourth state can be conceived. // 275

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvinna kila vedyā sā vittvenaiva hi bhāsate /
jāgradādyāstu saṃbhāvyāstisro'syāḥ prāgdaśā yataḥ // 276
meaning:
संविन्न किल वेद्या सा वित्त्वेनैव हि भासते /
जाग्रदाद्यास्तु संभाव्यास्तिस्रोऽस्याः प्राग्दशा यतः // 276
text_mt: For consciousness is certainly not an object of knowledge; it shines forth only as cognition. / The three states, however, beginning with waking, may be conceived, since they precede it. // 276

sanskrit_iast:
tritayānugrahātseyaṃ tenoktā trikaśāsane /
manonmanamanantaṃ ca sarvārthamiti bhedataḥ // 277
meaning:
त्रितयानुग्रहात्सेयं तेनोक्ता त्रिकशासने /
मनोन्मनमनन्तं च सर्वार्थमिति भेदतः // 277
text_mt: Therefore, through grace upon the triad, it is taught in the Trika tradition / according to its divisions as ‘supra-mental’ (manonmana), ‘infinite’ (ananta), and ‘all-objective’ (sarvārtha). // 277

sanskrit_iast:
yattu pūrṇānavacchinnavapurānandanirbharam /
turyātītaṃ tu tatprāhustadeva paramaṃ padam // 278
meaning:
यत्तु पूर्णानवच्छिन्नवपुरानन्दनिर्भरम् /
तुर्यातीतं तु तत्प्राहुस्तदेव परमं पदम् // 278
text_mt: That, however, whose form is full, undivided, and filled with bliss, / they call ‘beyond the fourth’ (turyātīta); that alone is the supreme abode. // 278

sanskrit_iast:
nātra yogasya sadbhāvo bhāvanāderabhāvataḥ /
aprameye'paricchinne svatantre bhāvyatā kutaḥ // 279
meaning:
नात्र योगस्य सद्भावो भावनादेरभावतः /
अप्रमेयेऽपरिच्छिन्ने स्वतन्त्रे भाव्यता कुतः // 279
text_mt: Here there is no existence of yoga, because of the absence of contemplative cultivation and the like. / In the unmeasurable, undivided, and autonomous, how could there be an object of contemplation? // 279

sanskrit_iast:
yogādyabhāvatastena nāmāsminnādiśadvibhuḥ /
prasaṃkhyānabalāttvetadrūpaṃ pūrṇatvayogataḥ // 280
meaning:
योगाद्यभावतस्तेन नामास्मिन्नादिशद्विभुः /
प्रसंख्यानबलात्त्वेतद्रूपं पूर्णत्वयोगतः // 280
text_mt: Therefore, because of the absence of yoga and the like, the All-pervading Lord assigned no name to it. / Yet by the power of higher contemplation, this form, through its connection with fullness, // 280

sanskrit_iast:
anuttarādiha proktaṃ mahāpracayasaṃjñitam /
pūrṇatvādeva bhedānāmasyāṃ saṃbhāvanā na hi // 281
meaning:
अनुत्तरादिह प्रोक्तं महाप्रचयसंज्ञितम् /
पूर्णत्वादेव भेदानामस्यां संभावना न हि // 281
text_mt: Is taught here beginning with the unexcelled, named the ‘great accumulation’ (mahāpracaya). / Precisely because of fullness, no distinctions can be conceived within it. // 281

sanskrit_iast:
tannirāsāya naitasyāṃ bheda ukto viśeṣaṇam /
satatoditamityetatsarvavyāpitvasūcakam // 282
meaning:
तन्निरासाय नैतस्यां भेद उक्तो विशेषणम् /
सततोदितमित्येतत्सर्वव्यापित्वसूचकम् // 282
text_mt: To refute them, no distinguishing qualification is spoken of in it. / The expression ‘ever-arisen’ indicates its all-pervasiveness. // 282

sanskrit_iast:
na hyeka eva bhavati bhedaḥ kvacana kaścana /
turyātīte bheda ekaḥ satatodita ityayam // 283
meaning:
न ह्येक एव भवति भेदः क्वचन कश्चन /
तुर्यातीते भेद एकः सततोदित इत्ययम् // 283
text_mt: For not even a single distinction exists anywhere at all. / To say that in the state beyond the fourth there is one distinction, namely ‘ever-arisen’, // 283

sanskrit_iast:
mūḍhavādastena siddhamavibheditvamasya tu /
śrīpūrvaśāstre tenoktaṃ padasthamaparaṃ viduḥ // 284
meaning:
मूढवादस्तेन सिद्धमविभेदित्वमस्य तु /
श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे तेनोक्तं पदस्थमपरं विदुः // 284
text_mt: Is the assertion of fools; therefore, its lack of distinction is established. / Hence in the Śrīpūrva treatise it is said: ‘They know the inferior as abiding in the sphere; // 284

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāstatpatayaḥ seśā rūpasthamiti kīrtyate /
rūpātītaṃ parā śaktiḥ savyāpārāpyanāmayā // 285
meaning:
मन्त्रास्तत्पतयः सेशा रूपस्थमिति कीर्त्यते /
रूपातीतं परा शक्तिः सव्यापाराप्यनामया // 285
text_mt: The mantras and their lords along with the rulers are proclaimed as abiding in form; / transcending form is the supreme power, which is active though untainted; // 285

sanskrit_iast:
niṣprapañco nirābhāsaḥ śuddhaḥ svātmanyavasthitaḥ /
sarvātītaḥ śivo jñeyo yaṃ viditvā vimucyate // 286
meaning:
निष्प्रपञ्चो निराभासः शुद्धः स्वात्मन्यवस्थितः /
सर्वातीतः शिवो ज्ञेयो यं विदित्वा विमुच्यते // 286
text_mt: Free from worldly manifoldness, devoid of appearance, pure, resting in his own self, / transcending all, Śiva should be known, by knowing whom one is liberated.’ // 286

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīsumatiprajñācandrikāśāntatāmasaḥ /
śrīśaṃbhunāthaḥ sadbhāvaṃ jāgradādau nyarūpayat // 287
meaning:
इति श्रीसुमतिप्रज्ञाचन्द्रिकाशान्ततामसः /
श्रीशंभुनाथः सद्भावं जाग्रदादौ न्यरूपयत् // 287
text_mt: Thus Śrī Śambhunātha, whose darkness was pacified by the moonlight of the wisdom of the venerable Sumati, / expounded the true reality in the waking state and the rest. // 287

sanskrit_iast:
anye tu kathayantyeṣāṃ bhaṅgīmanyādṛśīṃ śritāḥ /
yadrūpaṃ jāgradādīnāṃ tadidānīṃ nirūpyate // 288
meaning:
अन्ये तु कथयन्त्येषां भङ्गीमन्यादृशीं श्रिताः /
यद्रूपं जाग्रदादीनां तदिदानीं निरूप्यते // 288
text_mt: Others, however, explain this by adopting a different manner. / That form of the waking state and the others is now expounded. // 288

sanskrit_iast:
tatrākṣavṛttimāśritya bāhyākāragraho hi yaḥ /
tajjāgratsphuṭamāsīnamanubandhi punaḥ punaḥ // 289
meaning:
तत्राक्षवृत्तिमाश्रित्य बाह्याकारग्रहो हि यः /
तज्जाग्रत्स्फुटमासीनमनुबन्धि पुनः पुनः // 289
text_mt: There, that which is the grasping of external forms by relying on the operation of the sense organs / is the waking state, clearly seated, recurring again and again. // 289

sanskrit_iast:
ātmasaṃkalpanirmāṇaṃ svapno jāgradviparyayaḥ /
layākalasya bhogo'sau malakarmavaśānnatu // 290
meaning:
आत्मसंकल्पनिर्माणं स्वप्नो जाग्रद्विपर्ययः /
लयाकलस्य भोगोऽसौ मलकर्मवशान्नतु // 290
text_mt: Dream is the construction of one's own imagination, the reverse of waking. / That is the experience of the soul dissolved in subtle matter (layākala) through the force of impurity and karma, but // 290

sanskrit_iast:
sthirībhavenniśābhāvātsuptaṃ saukhyādyavedane /
jñānākalasya malataḥ kevalādbhogamātrataḥ // 291
meaning:
स्थिरीभवेन्निशाभावात्सुप्तं सौख्याद्यवेदने /
ज्ञानाकलस्य मलतः केवलाद्भोगमात्रतः // 291
text_mt: It cannot become stable due to the absence of night; deep sleep is the non-cognition of pleasure and the like / for the knower free of instruments (jñānākala), arising solely from impurity, consisting of pure experience. // 291

sanskrit_iast:
bhedavantaḥ svato'bhinnāścikīrṣyante jaḍājaḍāḥ /
turye tatra sthitā mantratannāthādhīśvarāstrayaḥ // 292
meaning:
भेदवन्तः स्वतोऽभिन्नाश्चिकीर्ष्यन्ते जडाजडाः /
तुर्ये तत्र स्थिता मन्त्रतन्नाथाधीश्वरास्त्रयः // 292
text_mt: Differentiated yet inherently non-different, both insentient and sentient, are sought to be created; / the three—mantras, their masters, and sovereign lords—are situated there in the fourth [state], // 292

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadbhairavabodhāntaḥpraveśanasahiṣṇavaḥ /
bhāvā vigaladātmīyasārāḥ svayamabhedinaḥ // 293
meaning:
यावद्भैरवबोधान्तःप्रवेशनसहिष्णवः /
भावा विगलदात्मीयसाराः स्वयमभेदिनः // 293
text_mt: Until the entities, capable of entering within the consciousness of Bhairava, / their own essence dissolving away, and themselves devoid of differentiation, // 293

sanskrit_iast:
turyātītapade saṃsyuriti pañcadaśātmake /
yasya yadyatsphuṭaṃ rūpaṃ tajjāgraditi manyatām // 294
meaning:
तुर्यातीतपदे संस्युरिति पञ्चदशात्मके /
यस्य यद्यत्स्फुटं रूपं तज्जाग्रदिति मन्यताम् // 294
text_mt: Are unified in the state beyond the fourth. Thus, within that which consists of fifteen aspects, / whatever clear form belongs to whatever state, that should be considered waking; // 294

sanskrit_iast:
yadevāsthiramābhāti sapūrvaṃ svapna īdṛśaḥ /
asphuṭaṃ tu yadābhāti suptaṃ tattatpuro'pi yat // 295
meaning:
यदेवास्थिरमाभाति सपूर्वं स्वप्न ईदृशः /
अस्फुटं तु यदाभाति सुप्तं तत्तत्पुरोऽपि यत् // 295
text_mt: Whatever shines forth as unstable, accompanied by what preceded it, is dream of such a kind; / but that which shines forth unmanifest, whatever was prior to it, is deep sleep; // 295

sanskrit_iast:
trayasyāsyānusaṃdhistu yadvaśādupajāyate /
sraksūtrakalpaṃ tatturyaṃ sarvabhedeṣu gṛhyatām // 296
meaning:
त्रयस्यास्यानुसंधिस्तु यद्वशादुपजायते /
स्रक्सूत्रकल्पं तत्तुर्यं सर्वभेदेषु गृह्यताम् // 296
text_mt: Whereas that by virtue of which the synthesis of this triad arises, / comparable to the string of a garland, should be understood as the fourth [state] among all distinctions. // 296

sanskrit_iast:
yattvadvaitabharollāsadrāvitāśeṣabhedakam /
turyātītaṃ tu tatprāhuritthaṃ sarvatra yojayet // 297
meaning:
यत्त्वद्वैतभरोल्लासद्राविताशेषभेदकम् /
तुर्यातीतं तु तत्प्राहुरित्थं सर्वत्र योजयेत् // 297
text_mt: But that which dissolves all differentiation through the brilliance of the weight of non-duality, / they call the beyond-the-fourth; thus one should apply it everywhere. // 297

sanskrit_iast:
layākale tu svaṃ rūpaṃ jāgrattatpūrvavṛtti tu /
svapnādīti kramaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatrānusaredbudhaḥ // 298
meaning:
लयाकले तु स्वं रूपं जाग्रत्तत्पूर्ववृत्ति तु /
स्वप्नादीति क्रमं सर्वं सर्वत्रानुसरेद्बुधः // 298
text_mt: In the case of the knower dissolved in voidness, one's own form is waking, while the state prior to that / is dreaming and the rest; in this way the wise person should trace the entire order everywhere. // 298

sanskrit_iast:
ekatrāpi prabhau pūrṇe citturyātītamucyate /
ānandasturyamicchaiva bījabhūmiḥ suṣuptatā // 299
meaning:
एकत्रापि प्रभौ पूर्णे चित्तुर्यातीतमुच्यते /
आनन्दस्तुर्यमिच्छैव बीजभूमिः सुषुप्तता // 299
text_mt: Even in the single, full Lord, consciousness is called beyond-the-fourth, / bliss is the fourth, will itself is the ground of the seed, [namely] deep sleep, // 299

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaśaktiḥ svapna uktaḥ kriyāśaktistu jāgṛtiḥ /
na caivamupacāraḥ syātsarvaṃ tatraiva vastutaḥ // 300
meaning:
ज्ञानशक्तिः स्वप्न उक्तः क्रियाशक्तिस्तु जागृतिः /
न चैवमुपचारः स्यात्सर्वं तत्रैव वस्तुतः // 300
text_mt: the power of knowledge is said to be dreaming, and the power of action is waking. / Nor is this a mere metaphor; in reality everything resides right there. // 300

sanskrit_iast:
na cenna kvāpi mukhyatvaṃ nopacāro'pi tatkvacit /
etacchrīpūrvaśāstre ca sphuṭamuktaṃ maheśinā // 301
meaning:
न चेन्न क्वापि मुख्यत्वं नोपचारोऽपि तत्क्वचित् /
एतच्छ्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे च स्फुटमुक्तं महेशिना // 301
text_mt: If not, there would be no primary meaning anywhere, nor any metaphor anywhere either; / and this was stated clearly by the Great Lord in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra. // 301

sanskrit_iast:
tatra svarūpaṃ śaktiśca sakalaśceti tattrayam /
iti jāgradavastheyaṃ bhede pañcadaśātmake // 302
meaning:
तत्र स्वरूपं शक्तिश्च सकलश्चेति तत्त्रयम् /
इति जाग्रदवस्थेयं भेदे पञ्चदशात्मके // 302
text_mt: There, one's own form, the power, and the embodied soul constitute that triad: / this is the waking state in the fifteenfold division. // 302

sanskrit_iast:
akalau svapnasauṣupte turyaṃ mantrādivargabhāk /
turyātītaṃ śaktiśaṃbhū trayodaśābhidhe punaḥ // 303
meaning:
अकलौ स्वप्नसौषुप्ते तुर्यं मन्त्रादिवर्गभाक् /
तुर्यातीतं शक्तिशंभू त्रयोदशाभिधे पुनः // 303
text_mt: The two instrumentless knowers are dreaming and deep sleep; the fourth belongs to the class of Mantras and the rest; / beyond-the-fourth is Śakti and Śambhu. But in the thirteenfold division, // 303

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ jāgradanyattu prāgvatpralayakevale /
svaṃ jāgratsvapnasupte dve turyādyatra ca pūrvavat // 304
meaning:
स्वरूपं जाग्रदन्यत्तु प्राग्वत्प्रलयकेवले /
स्वं जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुप्ते द्वे तुर्याद्यत्र च पूर्ववत् // 304
text_mt: one's own form is waking, and the rest is as before. In the knower isolated in cosmic dissolution, / one's own form is waking, the two are dreaming and deep sleep, and the fourth and beyond are here as before. // 304

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānākalabhede'pi svaṃ mantrā mantranāyakāḥ /
tadīśāḥ śaktiśaṃbhvitthaṃ pañca syurjāgradādayaḥ // 305
meaning:
विज्ञानाकलभेदेऽपि स्वं मन्त्रा मन्त्रनायकाः /
तदीशाः शक्तिशंभ्वित्थं पञ्च स्युर्जाग्रदादयः // 305
text_mt: In the division of the knower free of instruments as well, one's own form, Mantras, the lords of Mantras, / their rulers, and Śakti-Śambhu—thus waking and the others would be five. // 305

sanskrit_iast:
saptabhede tu mantrākhye svaṃ mantreśā maheśvarāḥ /
śaktiḥ śaṃbhuśca pañcoktā avasthā jāgradādayaḥ // 306
meaning:
सप्तभेदे तु मन्त्राख्ये स्वं मन्त्रेशा महेश्वराः /
शक्तिः शंभुश्च पञ्चोक्ता अवस्था जाग्रदादयः // 306
text_mt: In the sevenfold division designated as Mantra, one's own form, the lords of Mantras, the great lords, / Śakti, and Śambhu are stated to be the five states, waking and the rest. // 306

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpaṃ mantramāheśī śaktirmantramaheśvaraḥ /
śaktiḥ śaṃbhurimāḥ pañca mantreśe pañcabhedake // 307
meaning:
स्वरूपं मन्त्रमाहेशी शक्तिर्मन्त्रमहेश्वरः /
शक्तिः शंभुरिमाः पञ्च मन्त्रेशे पञ्चभेदके // 307
text_mt: One's own form, the great lordly power of Mantra, the great lord of Mantra, / Śakti, and Śambhu—these are the five in the fivefold lord of Mantra. // 307

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ kriyā jñānamicchā ca śaṃbhuratra ca pañcamī /
maheśabhede trividhe jāgradādi nirūpitam // 308
meaning:
स्वं क्रिया ज्ञानमिच्छा च शंभुरत्र च पञ्चमी /
महेशभेदे त्रिविधे जाग्रदादि निरूपितम् // 308
text_mt: One's own form, action, knowledge, will, and Śambhu as fifth here: / waking and the rest have been explained in the threefold division of the great Lord. // 308

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpārādādhipatyācca taddhānyā prerakatvataḥ /
icchānivṛtteḥ svasthatvācchiva eko'pi pañcadhā // 309
ityeṣa darśito'smābhistattvādhvā vistarādatha /
meaning:
व्यापारादाधिपत्याच्च तद्धान्या प्रेरकत्वतः /
इच्छानिवृत्तेः स्वस्थत्वाच्छिव एकोऽपि पञ्चधा // 309
इत्येष दर्शितोऽस्माभिस्तत्त्वाध्वा विस्तरादथ /
text_mt:
Through activity, through lordship, through the cessation thereof, through impelling, / through the cessation of will, and through resting in oneself, Śiva, though single, is fivefold. // 309
Thus this path of principles has been shown by us at length. Now:

sanskrit_iast: kalādhvā vakṣyate śrīmacchāṃbhavājñānusārataḥ // 1
meaning: कलाध्वा वक्ष्यते श्रीमच्छांभवाज्ञानुसारतः // 1
text_mt: The path of parts will be explained according to the venerable command of Śambhu. // 1b
title: Kalādipradarśana

sanskrit_iast:
yathā pūrvoktabhuvanamadhye nijanijaṃ gaṇam /
anuyatparato bhinnaṃ tattvaṃ nāmeti bhaṇyate // 2
meaning:
यथा पूर्वोक्तभुवनमध्ये निजनिजं गणम् /
अनुयत्परतो भिन्नं तत्त्वं नामेति भण्यते // 2
text_mt: Just as that which conforms to its respective group amid the previously stated worlds / and is distinguished from another is declared by the name 'principle', // 2

sanskrit_iast:
tathā teṣvapi tattveṣu svavarge'nugamātmakam /
vyāvṛttaṃ paravargācca kaleti śivaśāsane // 3
meaning:
तथा तेष्वपि तत्त्वेषु स्ववर्गेऽनुगमात्मकम् /
व्यावृत्तं परवर्गाच्च कलेति शिवशासने // 3
text_mt: so too, among those principles, that which conforms to its own group / and is excluded from another group is a part in the teaching of Śiva. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
kecidāhuḥ punaryāsau śaktirantaḥ susūkṣmikā /
tattvānāṃ sā kaletyuktā dharaṇyāṃ dhārikā yathā // 4
meaning:
केचिदाहुः पुनर्यासौ शक्तिरन्तः सुसूक्ष्मिका /
तत्त्वानां सा कलेत्युक्ता धरण्यां धारिका यथा // 4
text_mt: Others, however, say: that power which is extremely subtle within / the principles is called a part, as the supporting power in the earth. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
atra pakṣadvaye vastu na bhinnaṃ bhāsate yataḥ /
anugāmi na sāmānyamiṣṭaṃ naiyāyikādivat // 5
meaning:
अत्र पक्षद्वये वस्तु न भिन्नं भासते यतः /
अनुगामि न सामान्यमिष्टं नैयायिकादिवत् // 5
text_mt: On these two views, reality does not appear as differentiated, because / an enduring universal is not accepted [here], as it is by the Naiyāyikas and others. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
anye vadanti dīkṣādau sukhasaṃgrahaṇārthataḥ /
śivena kalpito vargaḥ kaleti samayāśrayaḥ // 6
meaning:
अन्ये वदन्ति दीक्षादौ सुखसंग्रहणार्थतः /
शिवेन कल्पितो वर्गः कलेति समयाश्रयः // 6
text_mt: Others say: for the purpose of easy comprehension during initiation and the like, / the group constructed by Śiva is a part, having conventional designation as its basis. // 6

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaśca devadevena samayo'paramārthatām /
na gacchatīti nāsatyo na cānyasamayodayaḥ // 7
meaning:
कृतश्च देवदेवेन समयोऽपरमार्थताम् /
न गच्छतीति नासत्यो न चान्यसमयोदयः // 7
text_mt: And a convention established by the God of gods does not reach / unreality, so it is not untrue, nor does another convention arise. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttiḥ pṛthivītattve pratiṣṭhāvyaktagocare /
vidyā niśānte śāntā ca śaktyante'ṇḍamidaṃ catuḥ // 8
meaning:
निवृत्तिः पृथिवीतत्त्वे प्रतिष्ठाव्यक्तगोचरे /
विद्या निशान्ते शान्ता च शक्त्यन्तेऽण्डमिदं चतुः // 8
text_mt: Nivṛtti is in the earth principle, Pratiṣṭhā pertains to the unmanifest, / Vidyā reaches the end of night, and Śāntā reaches the end of Śakti: this is the fourfold egg. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
śāntātītā śive tattve kalātītaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ /
nahyatra vargīkaraṇaṃ samayaḥ kalanāpi vā // 9
meaning:
शान्तातीता शिवे तत्त्वे कलातीतः परः शिवः /
नह्यत्र वर्गीकरणं समयः कलनापि वा // 9
text_mt: Śāntātītā is in the Śiva principle; supreme Śiva is beyond parts. / For here grouping, convention, or division // 9

sanskrit_iast:
yujyate sarvatodikkaṃ svātantryollāsadhāmani /
svātantryāttu nijaṃ rūpaṃ boddhṛdharmādavicyutam // 10
meaning:
युज्यते सर्वतोदिक्कं स्वातन्त्र्योल्लासधामनि /
स्वातन्त्र्यात्तु निजं रूपं बोद्धृधर्मादविच्युतम् // 10
text_mt: is not appropriate in the abode where absolute autonomy blazes in every direction. / Yet out of absolute autonomy, without deviating from the nature of the knower, // 10

sanskrit_iast:
upadeśatadāveśaparamārthatvasiddhaye /
bodhyatāmānayandevaḥ sphuṭameva vibhāvyate // 11
meaning:
उपदेशतदावेशपरमार्थत्वसिद्धये /
बोध्यतामानयन्देवः स्फुटमेव विभाव्यते // 11
text_mt: in order to accomplish the ultimate reality of instruction and absorption therein, / the God brings [His] own form into the state of being known, and is clearly conceived. // 11

sanskrit_iast:
yato'taḥ śivatattve'pi kalāsaṃgatirucyate /
aṇḍaṃ ca nāma bhuvanavibhāgasthitikāraṇam // 12
meaning:
यतोऽतः शिवतत्त्वेऽपि कलासंगतिरुच्यते /
अण्डं च नाम भुवनविभागस्थितिकारणम् // 12
text_mt: Therefore, association with a part is stated even in the Śiva principle. / And an egg is the cause of the persistence of the division of worlds; // 12

sanskrit_iast:
prāhurāvaraṇaṃ tacca śaktyantaṃ yāvadasti hi /
yadyapi prāk śivākhye'pi tattve bhuvanapaddhatiḥ // 13
meaning:
प्राहुरावरणं तच्च शक्त्यन्तं यावदस्ति हि /
यद्यपि प्राक् शिवाख्येऽपि तत्त्वे भुवनपद्धतिः // 13
text_mt: they declare it to be an envelope, and it indeed extends up to the end of Śakti. / Although the series of worlds was previously stated // 13

sanskrit_iast:
uktā tathāpyapratighe nāsminnāvṛtisaṃbhavaḥ /
nanvevaṃ dharaṇīṃ muktvā śaktau prakṛtimāyayoḥ // 14
meaning:
उक्ता तथाप्यप्रतिघे नास्मिन्नावृतिसंभवः /
नन्वेवं धरणीं मुक्त्वा शक्तौ प्रकृतिमाययोः // 14
text_mt: even in the principle named Śiva, nevertheless in this unimpeded [realm] no envelopment is possible. / Now, if it is thus, except for the earth, in Śakti, Prakṛti, and Māyā, // 14

sanskrit_iast:
api cāpratighatve'pi kathamaṇḍasya saṃbhavaḥ /
atrāsmadguravaḥ prāhuryatpṛthivyādipañcakam // 15
meaning:
अपि चाप्रतिघत्वेऽपि कथमण्डस्य संभवः /
अत्रास्मद्गुरवः प्राहुर्यत्पृथिव्यादिपञ्चकम् // 15
text_mt: since there is unobstructedness, how is the occurrence of an egg possible? / To this our gurus replied: as for the pentad beginning with earth, // 15

sanskrit_iast:
pratyakṣamidamābhāti tato'nyannāsti kiṃcana /
meyatve sthūlasūkṣmatvānmānatve karaṇatvataḥ // 16
meaning:
प्रत्यक्षमिदमाभाति ततोऽन्यन्नास्ति किंचन /
मेयत्वे स्थूलसूक्ष्मत्वान्मानत्वे करणत्वतः // 16
text_mt: this appears perceptible, and there is nothing whatever other than that. / In its state as object of knowledge, due to grossness and subtlety; in its state as means of knowledge, due to being an instrument; // 16

sanskrit_iast:
kartṛtollāsataḥ kartṛbhāve sphuṭatayoditam /
triṃśattattvaṃ vibhedātma tadabhedo niśā matā // 17
meaning:
कर्तृतोल्लासतः कर्तृभावे स्फुटतयोदितम् /
त्रिंशत्तत्त्वं विभेदात्म तदभेदो निशा मता // 17
text_mt: and in the state of subject, through the flash of agency: it is clearly proclaimed / as the thirtyfold principle consisting of differentiation; its non-differentiation is considered to be night. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
kāryatvakaraṇatvādivibhāgagalane sati /
vikāsotkasvatantratve śivāntaṃ pañcakaṃ jaguḥ // 18
meaning:
कार्यत्वकरणत्वादिविभागगलने सति /
विकासोत्कस्वतन्त्रत्वे शिवान्तं पञ्चकं जगुः // 18
text_mt: When the division into effect, instrument, and so forth melts away, / and there is autonomous reality eager for expansion, they proclaimed the pentad ending with Śiva. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatkālottarādau ca kathitaṃ bhūyasā tathā /
pañcaitāni tu tattvāni yairvyāptamakhilaṃ jagat // 19
meaning:
श्रीमत्कालोत्तरादौ च कथितं भूयसा तथा /
पञ्चैतानि तु तत्त्वानि यैर्व्याप्तमखिलं जगत् // 19
text_mt: And in the venerable Kālottara and other texts it is repeatedly stated thus: / 'These are the five principles by which the entire universe is pervaded.' // 19

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamantratanau tena sadyojātādi bhaṇyate /
īśānāntaṃ tatra tatra dharādigaganāntakam // 20
meaning:
पञ्चमन्त्रतनौ तेन सद्योजातादि भण्यते /
ईशानान्तं तत्र तत्र धरादिगगनान्तकम् // 20
text_mt: Therefore, in the body of the five mantras, Sadyojāta and the rest are recited / ending with Īśāna, right there ending with space from earth onward. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
śivatattvamataḥ śūnyātiśūnyaṃ syādanāśri[vṛ]tam /
yattu sarvāvibhāgātma svatantraṃ bodhasundaram // 21
meaning:
शिवतत्त्वमतः शून्यातिशून्यं स्यादनाश्रि[वृ]तम् /
यत्तु सर्वाविभागात्म स्वतन्त्रं बोधसुन्दरम् // 21
text_mt: Therefore the Śiva principle would be the void beyond the void, unclad. / But that which is devoid of all division, autonomous, beautiful with consciousness, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
saptatriṃśaṃ tu tatprāhustattvaṃ paraśivābhidham /
tasyāpyuktanayādvedyabhāve'tra parikalpite // 22
meaning:
सप्तत्रिंशं तु तत्प्राहुस्तत्त्वं परशिवाभिधम् /
तस्याप्युक्तनयाद्वेद्यभावेऽत्र परिकल्पिते // 22
text_mt: they call that the thirty-seventh principle, named Paraśiva. / When, by the stated reasoning, the condition of an object of knowledge is conceptualized even for that, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
yadāste hyanavacchinnaṃ tadaṣṭātriṃśamucyate /
na cānavasthā hyevaṃ syāddṛśyatāṃ hi mahātmabhiḥ // 23
meaning:
यदास्ते ह्यनवच्छिन्नं तदष्टात्रिंशमुच्यते /
न चानवस्था ह्येवं स्याद्दृश्यतां हि महात्मभिः // 23
text_mt: that which abides uncircumscribed is called the thirty-eighth. / Nor would there be infinite regress in this way; let it indeed be seen by the great-souled! // 23

sanskrit_iast:
yadvedyaṃ kiṃcidābhāti tatkṣaye yatprakāśate /
tattattvamiti nirṇītaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ hṛdi bhāsate // 24
meaning:
यद्वेद्यं किंचिदाभाति तत्क्षये यत्प्रकाशते /
तत्तत्त्वमिति निर्णीतं षट्त्रिंशं हृदि भासते // 24
text_mt: Whatever object of knowledge appears, that which shines upon its destruction / is ascertained as the principle; it shines in the heart as the thirty-sixth. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
tatkiṃ na kiṃcidvā kiṃcidityākāṅkṣāvaśe vapuḥ /
cidānandasvatantraikarūpaṃ taditi deśane // 25
meaning:
तत्किं न किंचिद्वा किंचिदित्याकाङ्क्षावशे वपुः /
चिदानन्दस्वतन्त्रैकरूपं तदिति देशने // 25
text_mt: 'Is that nothing, or something?': due to this inquiry, when it is taught / that its form consists solely of consciousness, bliss, and autonomy, // 25

sanskrit_iast:
saptatriṃśaṃ samābhāti tatrākāṅkṣā ca nāparā /
taccāpi klṛptavedyatvaṃ yatra bhāti sa cinmayaḥ // 26
meaning:
सप्तत्रिंशं समाभाति तत्राकाङ्क्षा च नापरा /
तच्चापि क्लृप्तवेद्यत्वं यत्र भाति स चिन्मयः // 26
text_mt: the thirty-seventh shines forth, and regarding that there is no further inquiry. / And when even that appears having an assumed objectivity, that which consists of consciousness // 26

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭātriṃśattamaḥ so'pi bhāvanāyopadiśyate /
yadi nāma tataḥ saptatriṃśa eva punarbhavet // 27
meaning:
अष्टात्रिंशत्तमः सोऽपि भावनायोपदिश्यते /
यदि नाम ततः सप्तत्रिंश एव पुनर्भवेत् // 27
text_mt: is the thirty-eighth; even that is taught for contemplative absorption. / If indeed it were to arise from that, it would simply be the thirty-seventh again, // 27

sanskrit_iast:
avibhāgasvatantratvacinmayatvādidharmatā /
samaiva vedyīkaraṇaṃ kevalaṃ tvadhikaṃ yataḥ // 28
meaning:
अविभागस्वतन्त्रत्वचिन्मयत्वादिधर्मता /
समैव वेद्यीकरणं केवलं त्वधिकं यतः // 28
text_mt: because the properties such as indivisibility, autonomy, and consisting of consciousness / are completely identical; only the making [it] an object of knowledge is additional. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
dharāyāṃ guṇatattvānte māyānte kramaśaḥ sthitāḥ /
gandho raso rūpamantaḥ sūkṣmabhāvakrameṇa tu // 29
meaning:
धरायां गुणतत्त्वान्ते मायान्ते क्रमशः स्थिताः /
गन्धो रसो रूपमन्तः सूक्ष्मभावक्रमेण तु // 29
text_mt: In earth, up to the end of the principle of the qualities, and up to the end of Māyā, there abide successively / smell, taste, and form, in the order of inner subtlety. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
iti sthite naye śaktitattvānte'pyasti saukṣmyabhāk /
sparśaḥ ko'pi sadā yasmai yoginaḥ spṛhayālavaḥ // 30
meaning:
इति स्थिते नये शक्तितत्त्वान्तेऽप्यस्ति सौक्ष्म्यभाक् /
स्पर्शः कोऽपि सदा यस्मै योगिनः स्पृहयालवः // 30
text_mt: This doctrine being established, even up to the end of the Śakti principle there is a subtle / touch of some kind, for which yogins are always longing. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
tatsparśānte tu saṃvittiḥ śuddhacidvyomarūpiṇī /
yasyāṃ rūḍhaḥ samabhyeti svaprakāśātmikāṃ parām // 31
meaning:
तत्स्पर्शान्ते तु संवित्तिः शुद्धचिद्व्योमरूपिणी /
यस्यां रूढः समभ्येति स्वप्रकाशात्मिकां पराम् // 31
text_mt: At the end of that touch, however, is consciousness in the form of the pure ether of consciousness, / established in which one attains the supreme, self-luminous state. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
ato vindurato nādo rūpamasmādato rasaḥ /
ityuktaṃ kṣobhakatvena spande sparśastu no tathā // 32
meaning:
अतो विन्दुरतो नादो रूपमस्मादतो रसः /
इत्युक्तं क्षोभकत्वेन स्पन्दे स्पर्शस्तु नो तथा // 32
text_mt: Therefore, 'from the drop, sound; from this, form; from this, taste'— / this was stated in terms of agitation in the Spanda [system], but touch is not so. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
mataṃ caitanmaheśasya śrīpūrve yadabhāṣata /
dhārikāpyāyinī boddhrī pavitrī cāvakāśadā // 33
meaning:
मतं चैतन्महेशस्य श्रीपूर्वे यदभाषत /
धारिकाप्यायिनी बोद्ध्री पवित्री चावकाशदा // 33
text_mt: And this doctrine of the Great Lord was spoken in the revered Pūrva (Mālinīvijayottara): / Supporting, nourishing, knowing, purifying, and space-giving, // 33

sanskrit_iast:
ebhiḥ śabdairvyavaharan nivṛttyādernijaṃ vapuḥ /
pañcatattvavidhiḥ proktastritattvamadhunocyate // 34
meaning:
एभिः शब्दैर्व्यवहरन् निवृत्त्यादेर्निजं वपुः /
पञ्चतत्त्वविधिः प्रोक्तस्त्रितत्त्वमधुनोच्यते // 34
text_mt: expressing with these words the essential forms of Nivṛtti and the rest, / the rule of five principles was taught. Now the threefold principle is spoken of: // 34

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānākalaparyantamātmā vidyeśvarāntakam /
śeṣe śivastritattve syādekatattve śivaḥ param // 35
meaning:
विज्ञानाकलपर्यन्तमात्मा विद्येश्वरान्तकम् /
शेषे शिवस्त्रितत्त्वे स्यादेकतत्त्वे शिवः परम् // 35
text_mt: The soul [extends] up to the knower free of instruments; up to the lord of knowledge, [the principle of power]; / and in the remainder Śiva exists in the threefold principle; but in the single principle, only Śiva. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
imau bhedāvubhau tattvabhedamātrakṛtāviti /
tattvādhvaivāyamitthaṃ ca na ṣaḍadhvasthiteḥ kṣatiḥ // 36
meaning:
इमौ भेदावुभौ तत्त्वभेदमात्रकृताविति /
तत्त्वाध्वैवायमित्थं च न षडध्वस्थितेः क्षतिः // 36
text_mt: These two divisions are produced merely by the division of principles; / therefore this is just the path of principles, and thus there is no damage to the reality of the sixfold path. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛt pumānyatiḥ kālo māyā vidyeśasauśivau /
śivaśca navatattve'pi vidhau tattvādhvarūpatā // 37
meaning:
प्रकृत् पुमान्यतिः कालो माया विद्येशसौशिवौ /
शिवश्च नवतत्त्वेऽपि विधौ तत्त्वाध्वरूपता // 37
text_mt: Prakṛti, Puruṣa, Niyati, Kāla, Māyā, the lord of knowledge along with Śiva, / and Śiva: even in the ninefold principle rule, it has the nature of the path of principles. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
evamaṣṭādaśākhye'pi vidhau nyāyaṃ vadetsudhīḥ /
yatra yatra hi bhogecchā tatprādhānyopayogataḥ // 38
meaning:
एवमष्टादशाख्येऽपि विधौ न्यायं वदेत्सुधीः /
यत्र यत्र हि भोगेच्छा तत्प्राधान्योपयोगतः // 38
text_mt: Likewise, the wise person should state the reasoning in the rule called the eighteenfold. / For wherever there is a desire for enjoyment, through the utility of its primacy // 38

sanskrit_iast:
anyāntarbhāvanātaśca dīkṣānantavibhedabhāk /
tena ṣaṭtriṃśato yāvadekatattvavidhirbhavet // 39
meaning:
अन्यान्तर्भावनातश्च दीक्षानन्तविभेदभाक् /
तेन षट्त्रिंशतो यावदेकतत्त्वविधिर्भवेत् // 39
text_mt: and through the inclusion of others, initiation partakes of endless divisions; / by this, up from thirty-six down to the rule of a single principle may exist. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
tattvādhvaiva sa devena prokto vyāsasamāsataḥ /
ekatattvavidhiścaiṣa suprabuddhaṃ guruṃ prati // 40
meaning:
तत्त्वाध्वैव स देवेन प्रोक्तो व्याससमासतः /
एकतत्त्वविधिश्चैष सुप्रबुद्धं गुरुं प्रति // 40
text_mt: That very path of principles has been spoken by the God in expansion and contraction; / and this rule of a single principle is taught with respect to a well-awakened guru // 40

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaṃ ca gatabhogāśamuditaḥ śaṃbhunā yataḥ /
bhedaṃ visphārya visphārya śaktyā svacchandarūpayā // 41
meaning:
शिष्यं च गतभोगाशमुदितः शंभुना यतः /
भेदं विस्फार्य विस्फार्य शक्त्या स्वच्छन्दरूपया // 41
text_mt: and a disciple whose longing for enjoyment is gone by Śambhu, because, / expanding and expanding diversity through His freely willing power, // 41

sanskrit_iast:
svātmanyabhinne bhagavānnityaṃ viśramayan sthitaḥ /
itthaṃ tryātmādhvano bhedaḥ sthūlasūkṣmaparatvataḥ // 42
meaning:
स्वात्मन्यभिन्ने भगवान्नित्यं विश्रमयन् स्थितः /
इत्थं त्र्यात्माध्वनो भेदः स्थूलसूक्ष्मपरत्वतः // 42
text_mt: the Lord remains perpetually resting within His undivided Self. / Thus the division of the threefold path according to gross, subtle, and supreme states, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
meyabhāgagataḥ proktaḥ puratattvakalātmakaḥ /
adhunā mātṛbhāgasthaṃ rūpaṃ tredhā nirūpyate // 43
meaning:
मेयभागगतः प्रोक्तः पुरतत्त्वकलात्मकः /
अधुना मातृभागस्थं रूपं त्रेधा निरूप्यते // 43
text_mt: residing in the portion of the object of knowledge and consisting of worlds, principles, and kalās, has been stated. / Now the form residing in the portion of the subject is explained in three ways. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
yatpramāṇātmakaṃ rūpamadhvano mātṛbhāgagam /
padaṃ hyavagamātmatvasamāveśāttaducyate // 44
meaning:
यत्प्रमाणात्मकं रूपमध्वनो मातृभागगम् /
पदं ह्यवगमात्मत्वसमावेशात्तदुच्यते // 44
text_mt: That form of the path consisting of the means of knowledge, which resides in the subject's portion, / is indeed called a word (pada), because of immersion into the nature of understanding. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva ca padaṃ mantraḥ prakṣobhātpracyutaṃ yadā /
guptabhāṣī yato mātā tūṣṇīṃbhūto vyavasthitaḥ // 45
meaning:
तदेव च पदं मन्त्रः प्रक्षोभात्प्रच्युतं यदा /
गुप्तभाषी यतो माता तूष्णींभूतो व्यवस्थितः // 45
text_mt: And that very word is a mantra when it has fallen away from agitation; / for the knowing subject remains silent, whispering secretly; // 45

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi na vimarśātma rūpaṃ tyajati tena saḥ /
pramāṇātmavimarśātmā mānavatkṣobhabhāṅnatu // 46
meaning:
तथापि न विमर्शात्म रूपं त्यजति तेन सः /
प्रमाणात्मविमर्शात्मा मानवत्क्षोभभाङ्नतु // 46
text_mt: nonetheless, he does not abandon his reflective nature; therefore, / being of the reflective nature of the means of knowledge, he is not subject to agitation like an ordinary measurement. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāṇāṃ ca padānāṃ ca tenoktaṃ trikaśāsane /
abhinnameva svaṃ rūpaṃ niḥspandakṣobhite param // 47
meaning:
मन्त्राणां च पदानां च तेनोक्तं त्रिकशासने /
अभिन्नमेव स्वं रूपं निःस्पन्दक्षोभिते परम् // 47
text_mt: Therefore it is said in the Trika teaching that the essential nature / of mantras and of words is identical; the difference is only in the unmoving and the agitated. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
audāsīnyaparityāge prakṣobhānavarohaṇe /
varṇādhvā mātṛbhāge syāt pūrvaṃ yā kathitā pramā // 48
meaning:
औदासीन्यपरित्यागे प्रक्षोभानवरोहणे /
वर्णाध्वा मातृभागे स्यात् पूर्वं या कथिता प्रमा // 48
text_mt: When abandonment of indifference occurs, without descending into agitation, / the path of phonemes comes to be in the subject's portion. The valid cognition previously spoken of, // 48

sanskrit_iast:
sā tu pūrṇasvarūpatvādavibhāgamayī yataḥ /
tata ekaikavarṇatvaṃ tattve tattve kṣamāditaḥ // 49
meaning:
सा तु पूर्णस्वरूपत्वादविभागमयी यतः /
तत एकैकवर्णत्वं तत्त्वे तत्त्वे क्षमादितः // 49
text_mt: being undivided because of its full nature, / and having on that account assigned one phoneme to each principle, beginning with earth, // 49

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā śaive pare proktāḥ ṣoḍaśārṇā visargataḥ /
tatra śaktiparispandastāvān prāk ca nirūpitaḥ // 50
meaning:
कृत्वा शैवे परे प्रोक्ताः षोडशार्णा विसर्गतः /
तत्र शक्तिपरिस्पन्दस्तावान् प्राक् च निरूपितः // 50
text_mt: sixteen phonemes are stated up to the supreme Śiva, by way of creative emission. / The vibration of power therein is of such extent, and has been explained earlier. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkalayyocyate sarvamadhunā sukhasaṃvide /
padamantravarṇamekaṃ puraṣoḍaśakaṃ dhareti ca nivṛttiḥ /
tattvārṇamagninayanaṃ rasaśarapuramastramantrapadamanyā // 51
meaning:
संकलय्योच्यते सर्वमधुना सुखसंविदे /
पदमन्त्रवर्णमेकं पुरषोडशकं धरेति च निवृत्तिः /
तत्त्वार्णमग्निनयनं रसशरपुरमस्त्रमन्त्रपदमन्या // 51
text_mt: Summarising it, all is now stated for ease of understanding: / Nivṛtti has one word, mantra, and phoneme, sixteen worlds, and earth; / the next has twenty-three principles and phonemes, fifty-six worlds, and the astra mantra and word; // 51

sanskrit_iast:
munitattvārṇaṃ dvikapadamantraṃ vasvakṣibhuvanamaparakalā /
agnyarṇatattvamekakapadamantraṃ sainyabhuvanamiti turyā // 52
meaning:
मुनितत्त्वार्णं द्विकपदमन्त्रं वस्वक्षिभुवनमपरकला /
अग्न्यर्णतत्त्वमेककपदमन्त्रं सैन्यभुवनमिति तुर्या // 52
text_mt: the other kalā has seven principles and phonemes, two words and mantras, and twenty-eight worlds; / the fourth has three phonemes and principles, one word and mantra, and eighteen worlds; // 52

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśa varṇāḥ padamantratattvamekaṃ ca śāntyatīteyam /
abhinavaguptenāryātrayamuktaṃ saṃgrahāya śiṣyebhyaḥ // 53
meaning:
षोडश वर्णाः पदमन्त्रतत्त्वमेकं च शान्त्यतीतेयम् /
अभिनवगुप्तेनार्यात्रयमुक्तं संग्रहाय शिष्येभ्यः // 53
text_mt: Śāntyatītā has sixteen phonemes, and one word, mantra, and principle. / This triad of āryā verses has been spoken by Abhinavagupta as a summary for disciples. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
so'yaṃ samasta evādhvā bhairavābhedavṛttimān /
tatsvātantryātsvatantratvamaśnuvāno'vabhāsate // 54
meaning:
सोऽयं समस्त एवाध्वा भैरवाभेदवृत्तिमान् /
तत्स्वातन्त्र्यात्स्वतन्त्रत्वमश्नुवानोऽवभासते // 54
text_mt: This entire path, functioning non-differently from Bhairava, / shines forth attaining autonomy by virtue of His absolute autonomy. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
tathāhi mātṛrūpastho mantrādhveti nirūpitaḥ /
tathāhi cidvimarśena grastā vācyadaśā yadā // 55
meaning:
तथाहि मातृरूपस्थो मन्त्राध्वेति निरूपितः /
तथाहि चिद्विमर्शेन ग्रस्ता वाच्यदशा यदा // 55
text_mt: Thus the path of mantras is explained as residing in the form of the knowing subject. / For when the state of the denoted object is swallowed up by consciousness's reflection, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
śivajñānakriyāyattamananatrāṇatatparā /
aśeṣaśaktipaṭalīlīlālāmpaṭyapāṭavāt // 56
meaning:
शिवज्ञानक्रियायत्तमननत्राणतत्परा /
अशेषशक्तिपटलीलीलालाम्पट्यपाटवात् // 56
text_mt: intent on contemplating and protecting, dependent on the knowledge and action of Śiva, / through the expert passion for the play of the multitude of all powers, // 56

sanskrit_iast:
cyutā mānamayādrūpāt saṃvinmantrādhvatāṃ gatā /
pramāṇarūpatāmetya prayātyadhvā padātmatām // 57
meaning:
च्युता मानमयाद्रूपात् संविन्मन्त्राध्वतां गता /
प्रमाणरूपतामेत्य प्रयात्यध्वा पदात्मताम् // 57
text_mt: fallen from the form consisting of measurement, consciousness becomes the path of mantras; / attaining the nature of the means of knowledge, the path reaches the state of words. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
tathā hi māturviśrāntirvarṇānsaṃghaṭya tānbahūn /
saṃghaṭṭanaṃ ca kramikaṃ saṃjalpātmakameva tat // 58
meaning:
तथा हि मातुर्विश्रान्तिर्वर्णान्संघट्य तान्बहून् /
संघट्टनं च क्रमिकं संजल्पात्मकमेव तत् // 58
text_mt: For the rest of the subject consists of assembling those many phonemes, / and that combination is successive, consisting precisely of inner speech; // 58

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpasya svakaṃ rūpaṃ bhogāveśamayaṃ sphuṭam /
ataḥ pramāṇatārūpaṃ padamasmadgururjagau // 59
meaning:
विकल्पस्य स्वकं रूपं भोगावेशमयं स्फुटम् /
अतः प्रमाणतारूपं पदमस्मद्गुरुर्जगौ // 59
text_mt: it is clearly the intrinsic form of conceptual construction, consisting of immersion in enjoyment. / Hence our guru declared the word to be the form of the means of knowledge. // 59

sanskrit_iast: pramāṇarūpatāveśamaparityajya meyatām // 60
meaning: प्रमाणरूपतावेशमपरित्यज्य मेयताम् // 60
text_mt: Without abandoning immersion in the nature of the means of knowledge, moving into objecthood, // 60

sanskrit_iast:
gacchankalanayā yogādadhvā proktaḥ kalātmakaḥ /
śuddhe prameyatāyoge sūkṣmasthūlatvabhāgini // 61
meaning:
गच्छन्कलनया योगादध्वा प्रोक्तः कलात्मकः /
शुद्धे प्रमेयतायोगे सूक्ष्मस्थूलत्वभागिनि // 61
text_mt: the path, through its connection with impulsion (kalanā), is declared to consist of kalās. / When connected with pure objecthood, partaking of subtlety and grossness, // 61

sanskrit_iast:
tattvādhvabhuvanādhvatve krameṇānusaredguruḥ /
prameyamānamātṝṇāṃ yadrūpamupari sthitam // 62
meaning:
तत्त्वाध्वभुवनाध्वत्वे क्रमेणानुसरेद्गुरुः /
प्रमेयमानमातॄणां यद्रूपमुपरि स्थितम् // 62
text_mt: the guru should pursue respectively the paths of principles and worlds. / That form which stands above the object, the means, and the subjects of knowledge // 62

sanskrit_iast:
pramātmātra sthito'dhvāyaṃ varṇātmā dṛśyatāṃ kila /
ucchalatsaṃvidāmātraviśrāntyāsvādayoginaḥ // 63
meaning:
प्रमात्मात्र स्थितोऽध्वायं वर्णात्मा दृश्यतां किल /
उच्छलत्संविदामात्रविश्रान्त्यास्वादयोगिनः // 63
text_mt: is the subject of valid cognition here: let this path consisting of phonemes indeed be seen! / Possessing the experience of resting in consciousness as the pure knowing subject, brimming forth, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
sarvābhidhānasāmarthyādaniyantritaśaktayaḥ /
sṛṣṭāḥ svātmasahotthe'rthe dharāparyantabhāgini // 64
meaning:
सर्वाभिधानसामर्थ्यादनियन्त्रितशक्तयः /
सृष्टाः स्वात्मसहोत्थेऽर्थे धरापर्यन्तभागिनि // 64
text_mt: their powers unrestricted because of their capacity to name everything, / projected into objects co-emerging with oneself, extending as far as earth, // 64

sanskrit_iast:
āmṛśantaḥ svacidbhūmau tāvato'rthānabhedataḥ /
varṇaughāste pramārūpāṃ satyāṃ bibhrati saṃvidam // 65
meaning:
आमृशन्तः स्वचिद्भूमौ तावतोऽर्थानभेदतः /
वर्णौघास्ते प्रमारूपां सत्यां बिभ्रति संविदम् // 65
text_mt: reflecting upon so many objects non-differently within the ground of their own consciousness, / those multitudes of phonemes bear true consciousness, consisting of valid cognition. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
bālāstiryakpramātāro ye'pyasaṃketabhāginaḥ /
te'pyakṛtrimasaṃskārasārāmenāṃ svasaṃvidam // 66
meaning:
बालास्तिर्यक्प्रमातारो येऽप्यसंकेतभागिनः /
तेऽप्यकृत्रिमसंस्कारसारामेनां स्वसंविदम् // 66
text_mt: Even children and animal knowers who do not partake of conventions, / relying on this consciousness of their own, whose essence is uncontrived latent impressions, // 66

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnabhinnāmupāśritya yānti citrāṃ pramātṛtām /
asyā cākṛtrimānantavarṇasaṃvidi rūḍhatām // 67
meaning:
भिन्नभिन्नामुपाश्रित्य यान्ति चित्रां प्रमातृताम् /
अस्या चाकृत्रिमानन्तवर्णसंविदि रूढताम् // 67
text_mt: differentiated, attain manifold states of knower; / and when conventions attain rootedness in this uncontrived consciousness of endless phonemes, // 67

sanskrit_iast:
saṃketā yānti cette'pi yāntyasaṃketavṛttitām /
anayā tu vinā sarve saṃketā bahuśaḥ kṛtāḥ // 68
meaning:
संकेता यान्ति चेत्तेऽपि यान्त्यसंकेतवृत्तिताम् /
अनया तु विना सर्वे संकेता बहुशः कृताः // 68
text_mt: they too arrive at the function of unconventionality. / But without this, all conventions, although made many times, // 68

sanskrit_iast:
aviśrāntatayā kuryuranavasthāṃ duruttarām /
bālo vyutpādyate yena tatra saṃketamārgaṇāt // 69
meaning:
अविश्रान्ततया कुर्युरनवस्थां दुरुत्तराम् /
बालो व्युत्पाद्यते येन तत्र संकेतमार्गणात् // 69
text_mt: due to a lack of resting, would produce a vicious regress hard to overcome. / For in the way a child is taught, by seeking convention there, // 69

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulyādeśane'pyasya nāvikalpā tathā matiḥ /
vikalpaḥ śabdamūlaśca śabdaḥ saṃketajīvitaḥ // 70
meaning:
अङ्गुल्यादेशनेऽप्यस्य नाविकल्पा तथा मतिः /
विकल्पः शब्दमूलश्च शब्दः संकेतजीवितः // 70
text_mt: even when pointing with a finger, his mind is not non-conceptual; / and conceptual construction is rooted in speech, while speech has convention as its life. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
tenānanto hyamāyīyo yo varṇagrāma īdṛśaḥ /
saṃvidvimarśasacivaḥ sadaiva sa hi jṛmbhate // 71
meaning:
तेनानन्तो ह्यमायीयो यो वर्णग्राम ईदृशः /
संविद्विमर्शसचिवः सदैव स हि जृम्भते // 71
text_mt: Therefore, the endless, non-illusory collection of phonemes of this kind, / assisted by consciousness's reflection, is ever blossoming forth; // 71

sanskrit_iast:
yata eva ca māyīyā varṇāḥ sūtiṃ vitenire /
ye ca māyīyavarṇeṣu vīryatvena nirūpitāḥ // 72
meaning:
यत एव च मायीया वर्णाः सूतिं वितेनिरे /
ये च मायीयवर्णेषु वीर्यत्वेन निरूपिताः // 72
text_mt: and precisely from which the phonemes belonging to Māyā have extended their generation; / and those which are described as the virility within the phonemes of Māyā, // 72

sanskrit_iast:
saṃketanirapekṣāste prameti parigṛhyatām /
tathā hi paravākyeṣu śruteṣvāvriyate nijā // 73
meaning:
संकेतनिरपेक्षास्ते प्रमेति परिगृह्यताम् /
तथा हि परवाक्येषु श्रुतेष्वाव्रियते निजा // 73
text_mt: independent of conventions: let these be recognized as valid cognition. / For when the words of another are heard, if one's own valid cognition is obscured, // 73

sanskrit_iast:
pramā yasya jaḍo'sau no tatrārthe'bhyeti mātṛtām /
śukavatsa paṭhatyeva paraṃ tatkramitaikabhāk // 74
meaning:
प्रमा यस्य जडोऽसौ नो तत्रार्थेऽभ्येति मातृताम् /
शुकवत्स पठत्येव परं तत्क्रमितैकभाक् // 74
text_mt: he is inert and does not attain the state of knower with respect to that object; / like a parrot, he merely recites, partaking only of its succession. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
svātantryalābhataḥ svākyapramālābhe tu boddhṛtā /
yasya hi svapramābodho vipakṣodbhedanigrahāt // 75
meaning:
स्वातन्त्र्यलाभतः स्वाक्यप्रमालाभे तु बोद्धृता /
यस्य हि स्वप्रमाबोधो विपक्षोद्भेदनिग्रहात् // 75
text_mt: However, in the attainment of one's own valid cognition from the attainment of autonomy, the state of knower arises. / For he whose awareness of his own valid cognition [shines] due to the suppression of the emergence of opponents, // 75

sanskrit_iast:
vākyādivarṇapuñje sve sa pramātā vaśībhavet /
yathā yathā cākṛtakaṃ tadrūpamatiricyate // 76
meaning:
वाक्यादिवर्णपुञ्जे स्वे स प्रमाता वशीभवेत् /
यथा यथा चाकृतकं तद्रूपमतिरिच्यते // 76
text_mt: that knowing subject becomes a master over his collection of phonemes, such as sentences. / And in whatever degree that uncontrived form excels, // 76

sanskrit_iast:
tathā tathā camatkāratāratamyaṃ vibhāvyate /
ādyāmāyīyavarṇāntarnimagne cottarottare // 77
meaning:
तथा तथा चमत्कारतारतम्यं विभाव्यते /
आद्यामायीयवर्णान्तर्निमग्ने चोत्तरोत्तरे // 77
text_mt: in that degree the graduation of aesthetic wonder is realized. / When successive conventions are submerged within the primary, non-illusory phonemes, // 77

sanskrit_iast:
sakete pūrvapūrvāṃśamajjane pratibhābhidaḥ /
ādyodrekamahattve'pi pratibhātmani niṣṭhitāḥ // 78
meaning:
सकेते पूर्वपूर्वांशमज्जने प्रतिभाभिदः /
आद्योद्रेकमहत्त्वेऽपि प्रतिभात्मनि निष्ठिताः // 78
text_mt: due to the immersion of previous parts, distinctions of intuitive flash [arise], / established in the self of intuitive flash, even while the initial surge is immense. // 78

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaṃ kavitvavaktṛtvaśālitāṃ yānti sarvataḥ /
yāvaddhāmani saṃketanikārakalanojjhite // 79
meaning:
ध्रुवं कवित्ववक्तृत्वशालितां यान्ति सर्वतः /
यावद्धामनि संकेतनिकारकलनोज्झिते // 79
text_mt: They unfailingly attain poetic power and eloquence everywhere, / as long as in that abode freed from the affliction of conventions // 79

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāntaścinmaye kiṃ kiṃ na vetti kurute na vā /
ata eva hi vāksiddhau varṇānāṃ samupāsyatā // 80
meaning:
विश्रान्तश्चिन्मये किं किं न वेत्ति कुरुते न वा /
अत एव हि वाक्सिद्धौ वर्णानां समुपास्यता // 80
text_mt: resting in the nature of consciousness, what does one not know or what does one not accomplish? / Precisely for this reason, the phonemes are to be worshipped for the attainment of speech, // 80

sanskrit_iast:
sarvajñatvādisiddhau vā kā siddhiryā na tanmayī /
taduktaṃ varadena śrīsiddhayogīśvarīmate // 81
meaning:
सर्वज्ञत्वादिसिद्धौ वा का सिद्धिर्या न तन्मयी /
तदुक्तं वरदेन श्रीसिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते // 81
text_mt: or for the attainment of omniscience and the like; for what spiritual accomplishment is not composed of that? / That was stated by the boon-giver in the venerable Siddhayogīśvarīmata: // 81

sanskrit_iast:
tena guptena guptāste śeṣā varṇāstviti sphuṭam /
evaṃ māmātṛmānatvameyatvairyo'vabhāsate // 82
meaning:
तेन गुप्तेन गुप्तास्ते शेषा वर्णास्त्विति स्फुटम् /
एवं मामातृमानत्वमेयत्वैर्योऽवभासते // 82
text_mt: "Hidden by that hidden [phoneme], the remaining phonemes indeed [exist]"—this is clear. / Thus, that path which manifests as the measure, the measurer, the measuring, and the measured, // 82

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍvidhaḥ svavapuḥśuddhau śuddhiṃ so'dhvādhigacchati /
ekena vapuṣā śuddhau tatraivānyaprakāratām // 83
meaning:
षड्विधः स्ववपुःशुद्धौ शुद्धिं सोऽध्वाधिगच्छति /
एकेन वपुषा शुद्धौ तत्रैवान्यप्रकारताम् // 83
text_mt: sixfold, attains purification through the purification of its own form. / In purifying through one form, within that very [form] the nature of the others // 83

sanskrit_iast:
antarbhāvyācarecchuddhimanusaṃdhānavān guruḥ /
anantarbhāvaśaktau tu sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmaṃ tu śodhayet // 84
meaning:
अन्तर्भाव्याचरेच्छुद्धिमनुसंधानवान् गुरुः /
अनन्तर्भावशक्तौ तु सूक्ष्मं सूक्ष्मं तु शोधयेत् // 84
text_mt: having subsumed, the attentive guru should perform the purification. / But if unable to subsume, one should purify subtly, level by level. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
tadviśuddhaṃ bījabhāvāt sūte nottarasaṃtatim /
śodhanaṃ bahudhā tattadbhogaprāptyekatānatā // 85
meaning:
तद्विशुद्धं बीजभावात् सूते नोत्तरसंततिम् /
शोधनं बहुधा तत्तद्भोगप्राप्त्येकतानता // 85
text_mt: That, once purified, does not generate a subsequent series owing to its seed-like nature. / Purification is manifold: one-pointed absorption in obtaining those respective enjoyments, // 85

sanskrit_iast:
tadādhipatyaṃ tattyāgastacchivātmatvavedanam /
tallīnatā tannirāsaḥ sarvaṃ caitatkramākramāt // 86
meaning:
तदाधिपत्यं तत्त्यागस्तच्छिवात्मत्ववेदनम् /
तल्लीनता तन्निरासः सर्वं चैतत्क्रमाक्रमात् // 86
text_mt: lordship over them, abandonment of them, the cognition of their identity with Śiva, / absorption in them, and their eradication—all this through succession and non-succession. // 86

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva ca te mantrāḥ śodhakāścitrarūpiṇaḥ /
siddhāntavāmadakṣādau citrāṃ śuddhiṃ vitanvate // 87
meaning:
अत एव च ते मन्त्राः शोधकाश्चित्ररूपिणः /
सिद्धान्तवामदक्षादौ चित्रां शुद्धिं वितन्वते // 87
text_mt: For this very reason, those purifying mantras, having diverse forms, / bring about diverse purifications in Siddhānta, Vāma, Dakṣiṇa, and so forth. // 87

sanskrit_iast:
anuttaratrikānāmakramamantrāstu ye kila /
te sarve sarvadāḥ kintu kasyācit kvāpi mukhyatā // 88
meaning:
अनुत्तरत्रिकानामक्रममन्त्रास्तु ये किल /
ते सर्वे सर्वदाः किन्तु कस्याचित् क्वापि मुख्यता // 88
text_mt: However, the mantras of non-succession of the unexcelled Trika / are indeed all-bestowing, but a particular one has prominence somewhere. // 88

sanskrit_iast:
ataḥ śodhakabhāvena śāstre śrīpūrvasaṃjñite /
parāparādimantrāṇāmadhvanyuktā vyavasthitiḥ // 89
meaning:
अतः शोधकभावेन शास्त्रे श्रीपूर्वसंज्ञिते /
परापरादिमन्त्राणामध्वन्युक्ता व्यवस्थितिः // 89
text_mt: Therefore, in the scripture named the venerable Pūrva, / the arrangement of the Parā, Aparā, and other mantras in the path is declared as purifying. // 89

sanskrit_iast:
śodhakatvaṃ ca mālinyā devīnāṃ tritayasya ca /
devatrayasya vaktrāṇāmaṅgānāmaṣṭakasya ca // 90
meaning:
शोधकत्वं च मालिन्या देवीनां त्रितयस्य च /
देवत्रयस्य वक्त्राणामङ्गानामष्टकस्य च // 90
text_mt: And the role of purifier belongs to the Mālinī, to the triad of goddesses, / to the triad of gods, to the faces, and to the octad of limbs. // 90

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ vātibahunā dvāravāstvādhāragurukrame /
lokapāstravidhau mantrān muktvā sarvaṃ viśodhakam // 91
meaning:
किं वातिबहुना द्वारवास्त्वाधारगुरुक्रमे /
लोकपास्त्रविधौ मन्त्रान् मुक्त्वा सर्वं विशोधकम् // 91
text_mt: Or why say too much? In the sequence of the door, the site, the support, and the guru, / and in the rite of the world-protectors and weapons, except for the mantras, everything is a purifier. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
yaccaitadadhvanaḥ proktaṃ śodhyatvaṃ śoddhṛtā ca yā /
sā svātantryācchivābhede yuktetyuktaṃ ca śāsane // 92
meaning:
यच्चैतदध्वनः प्रोक्तं शोध्यत्वं शोद्धृता च या /
सा स्वातन्त्र्याच्छिवाभेदे युक्तेत्युक्तं च शासने // 92
text_mt: And as for this purifiability and purifier-nature spoken of regarding the path, / that is appropriate due to absolute autonomy within non-difference from Śiva, as stated in the teaching; // 92

sanskrit_iast:
sarvametadvibhātyeva parameśitari dhruve /
pratibimbasvarūpeṇa na tu bāhyatayā yataḥ // 93
meaning:
सर्वमेतद्विभात्येव परमेशितरि ध्रुवे /
प्रतिबिम्बस्वरूपेण न तु बाह्यतया यतः // 93
text_mt: since all this shines forth within the unchanging Supreme Lord alone / in the form of a reflection, and not as something external. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
cidvyomnyeva śive tattaddehādimatirīdṛśī /
bhinnā saṃsāriṇāṃ rajjau sarpasragvīcibuddhivat // 94
meaning:
चिद्व्योम्न्येव शिवे तत्तद्देहादिमतिरीदृशी /
भिन्ना संसारिणां रज्जौ सर्पस्रग्वीचिबुद्धिवत् // 94
text_mt: In the ether of consciousness alone, in Śiva, such a notion of diverse bodies and so forth, / fragmented, occurs to transmigrating beings, like the cognition of a snake, a garland, or a ripple in a rope. // 94

sanskrit_iast:
yataḥ prāgdehamaraṇasiddhāntaḥ svapnagocaraḥ /
dehāntarādirmaraṇe kīdṛgvā dehasaṃbhavaḥ // 95
meaning:
यतः प्राग्देहमरणसिद्धान्तः स्वप्नगोचरः /
देहान्तरादिर्मरणे कीदृग्वा देहसंभवः // 95
text_mt: For the settled view of the death of a previous body is a domain of dream; / at death, another body and so forth—what sort of emergence of a body could there be? // 95

sanskrit_iast:
svapne'pi pratibhāmātrasāmānyaprathanābalāt /
viśeṣāḥ pratibhāsante na bhāvyante'pi te yathā // 96
meaning:
स्वप्नेऽपि प्रतिभामात्रसामान्यप्रथनाबलात् /
विशेषाः प्रतिभासन्ते न भाव्यन्तेऽपि ते यथा // 96
text_mt: Even in a dream, by the force of the manifestation of a mere general intuitive flash, / particulars appear, although they are not even contemplated as such. // 96

sanskrit_iast:
śālagrāmopalāḥ keciccitrākṛtibhṛto yathā /
tathā māyādibhūmyantalekhācitrahṛdaścitaḥ // 97
meaning:
शालग्रामोपलाः केचिच्चित्राकृतिभृतो यथा /
तथा मायादिभूम्यन्तलेखाचित्रहृदश्चितः // 97
text_mt: Just as certain Śālagrāma stones bear variegated forms, / so the heart of consciousness is variegated by delineations from Māyā down to the earth. // 97

sanskrit_iast:
nagarārṇavaśailādyāstadicchānuvidhāyinaḥ /
na svayaṃ sadasanto no kāraṇākāraṇātmakāḥ // 98
meaning:
नगरार्णवशैलाद्यास्तदिच्छानुविधायिनः /
न स्वयं सदसन्तो नो कारणाकारणात्मकाः // 98
text_mt: Cities, oceans, mountains, and the like conform to His will; / they are not intrinsically existent or non-existent, nor of the nature of cause or non-cause. // 98

sanskrit_iast:
niyateścirarūḍhāyāḥ samucchedātpravartanāt /
arūḍhāyāḥ svatantro'yaṃ sthitaścidvyomabhairavaḥ // 99
meaning:
नियतेश्चिररूढायाः समुच्छेदात्प्रवर्तनात् /
अरूढायाः स्वतन्त्रोऽयं स्थितश्चिद्व्योमभैरवः // 99
text_mt: By uprooting long-established restriction and instituting / what is unestablished, this Bhairava, the ether of consciousness, stands independent. // 99

sanskrit_iast:
ekacinmātrasaṃpūrṇabhairavābhedabhāgini /
evamasmītyanāmarśo bhedako bhāvamaṇḍale // 100
meaning:
एकचिन्मात्रसंपूर्णभैरवाभेदभागिनि /
एवमस्मीत्यनामर्शो भेदको भावमण्डले // 100
text_mt: In that which shares non-difference with Bhairava, full of the single, pure consciousness, / the non-awareness "thus I am" is the differentiator in the circle of entities. // 100

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapramāṇairno siddhaṃ svapne kartrantaraṃ yathā /
svasaṃvidaḥ svasiddhāyāstathā sarvatra buddhyatām // 101
meaning:
सर्वप्रमाणैर्नो सिद्धं स्वप्ने कर्त्रन्तरं यथा /
स्वसंविदः स्वसिद्धायास्तथा सर्वत्र बुद्ध्यताम् // 101
text_mt: Just as by all means of knowledge no other agent is established in a dream / apart from one's own self-established consciousness, so should it be understood everywhere. // 101

sanskrit_iast:
cittacitrapurodyāne krīḍedevaṃ hi vetti yaḥ /
ahameva sthito bhūtabhāvatattvapurairiti // 102
meaning:
चित्तचित्रपुरोद्याने क्रीडेदेवं हि वेत्ति यः /
अहमेव स्थितो भूतभावतत्त्वपुरैरिति // 102
text_mt: Indeed, one who knows thus may play in the garden of the variegated city of the mind: / "I alone abide in the form of the cities of the elements, entities, and principles." // 102

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ jāto mṛto'smīti janmamṛtyuvicitratāḥ /
ajanmanyamṛtau bhānti cittabhittau svanirmitāḥ // 103
meaning:
एवं जातो मृतोऽस्मीति जन्ममृत्युविचित्रताः /
अजन्मन्यमृतौ भान्ति चित्तभित्तौ स्वनिर्मिताः // 103
text_mt: "Thus was I born, I am dead"—these variegations of birth and death / appear on the canvas of the mind, self-fashioned, within the birthless and deathless. // 103

sanskrit_iast:
parehasaṃvidāmātraṃ paralokehalokate /
vastutaḥ saṃvido deśaḥ kālo vā naiva kiṃcana // 104
meaning:
परेहसंविदामात्रं परलोकेहलोकते /
वस्तुतः संविदो देशः कालो वा नैव किंचन // 104
text_mt: The states of other-world and this-world are mere consciousness of 'there' and 'here'; / in reality, there is no space or time whatsoever for consciousness. // 104

sanskrit_iast:
abhaviṣyadayaṃ sargo mūrtaścenna tu cinmayaḥ /
tadavekṣyata tanmadhyāt kenaiko'pi dharādharaḥ // 105
meaning:
अभविष्यदयं सर्गो मूर्तश्चेन्न तु चिन्मयः /
तदवेक्ष्यत तन्मध्यात् केनैकोऽपि धराधरः // 105
text_mt: If this creation were material and not composed of consciousness, / then by whom could even a single mountain have been seen within it? // 105

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtatanmātravargāderādhārādheyatākrame /
ante saṃvinmayī śaktiḥ śivarūpaiva dhāriṇī // 106
meaning:
भूततन्मात्रवर्गादेराधाराधेयताक्रमे /
अन्ते संविन्मयी शक्तिः शिवरूपैव धारिणी // 106
text_mt: In the sequence of container and contained among the groups of elements, subtle elements, and so forth, / ultimately the power consisting of consciousness, being of the very nature of Śiva, is the support. // 106

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātpratītirevetthaṃ kartrī dhartrī ca sā śivaḥ /
tato bhāvāstatra bhāvāḥ śaktirādhārikā tataḥ // 107
meaning:
तस्मात्प्रतीतिरेवेत्थं कर्त्री धर्त्री च सा शिवः /
ततो भावास्तत्र भावाः शक्तिराधारिका ततः // 107
text_mt: Therefore, manifestation alone is thus the agent and the support, and that is Śiva. / From that arise entities; in that are entities; and thence power is the foundational support. // 107

sanskrit_iast:
sāṃkalpikaṃ nirādhāramapi naiva patatyadhaḥ /
svādhāraśaktau viśrāntaṃ viśvamitthaṃ vimṛśyatām // 108
meaning:
सांकल्पिकं निराधारमपि नैव पतत्यधः /
स्वाधारशक्तौ विश्रान्तं विश्वमित्थं विमृश्यताम् // 108
text_mt: Even a conceptualized object, though baseless, does not fall down; / resting in the power that is its own support, let the universe thus be contemplated. // 108

sanskrit_iast:
asyā ghanāhamityādirūḍhireva dharāditā /
yāvadante cidasmīti nirvṛttā bhairavātmatā // 109
meaning:
अस्या घनाहमित्यादिरूढिरेव धरादिता /
यावदन्ते चिदस्मीति निर्वृत्ता भैरवात्मता // 109
text_mt: The very crystallization of this [consciousness] such as "I am solid" is the state of earth and the rest, / until finally, as "I am consciousness," the nature of Bhairava is realized. // 109

sanskrit_iast:
maṇāvindrāyudhe bhāsa iva nīlādayaḥ śive /
paramārthata eṣāṃ tu nodayo na vyayaḥ kvacit // 110
meaning:
मणाविन्द्रायुधे भास इव नीलादयः शिवे /
परमार्थत एषां तु नोदयो न व्ययः क्वचित् // 110
text_mt: Like colors such as blue in a jewel or a rainbow, [these] appearances are in Śiva; / in the ultimate sense, however, there is never any arising or passing away of them. // 110

sanskrit_iast:
deśe kāle'tra vā sṛṣṭirityetadasamañjasam /
cidātmanā hi devena sṛṣṭirdikkālayorapi // 111
meaning:
देशे कालेऽत्र वा सृष्टिरित्येतदसमञ्जसम् /
चिदात्मना हि देवेन सृष्टिर्दिक्कालयोरपि // 111
text_mt: "Creation occurs here in space or in time"—this is incongruous; / for space and time are also creations by the Lord whose nature is consciousness. // 111

sanskrit_iast:
jāgarābhimate sārdhahastatritayagocare /
prahare ca pṛthak svapnāścitradikkālamāninaḥ // 112
meaning:
जागराभिमते सार्धहस्तत्रितयगोचरे /
प्रहरे च पृथक् स्वप्नाश्चित्रदिक्कालमानिनः // 112
text_mt: Within the three and a half cubits deemed the waking state / and within a single three-hour watch, diverse dreams imagine varied space and time. // 112

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva kṣaṇaṃ nāma na kiṃcidapi manmahe /
kriyākṣaṇe vāpyekasmin bahvyaḥ saṃsyurdrutāḥ kriyāḥ // 113
meaning:
अत एव क्षणं नाम न किंचिदपि मन्महे /
क्रियाक्षणे वाप्येकस्मिन् बह्व्यः संस्युर्द्रुताः क्रियाः // 113
text_mt: Precisely for this reason, we do not consider a "moment" to be anything [objective]; / or even in a single moment of action, there can be many rapid actions. // 113

sanskrit_iast:
tena ye bhāvasaṃkocaṃ kṣaṇāntaṃ pratipedire /
te nūnamenayā nāḍyā śūnyadṛṣṭyavalambinaḥ // 114
meaning:
तेन ये भावसंकोचं क्षणान्तं प्रतिपेदिरे /
ते नूनमेनया नाड्या शून्यदृष्ट्यवलम्बिनः // 114
text_mt: Therefore, those who accepted the contraction of entities down to a moment, / surely, through this channel, resorted to the view of the void. // 114

sanskrit_iast:
tadya eṣa sato bhāvāñ śūnyīkartuṃ tathāsataḥ /
sphuṭīkartuṃ svatantratvādīśaḥ so'smatprabhuḥ śivaḥ // 115
meaning:
तद्य एष सतो भावाञ् शून्यीकर्तुं तथासतः /
स्फुटीकर्तुं स्वतन्त्रत्वादीशः सोऽस्मत्प्रभुः शिवः // 115
text_mt: Therefore, he who is able through absolute autonomy to void existent entities / and likewise to make clear the non-existent, he is our Lord, Śiva. // 115

sanskrit_iast:
taditthaṃ parameśāno viśvarūpaḥ pragīyate /
na tu bhinnasya kasyāpi dharāderupapannatā // 116
meaning:
तदित्थं परमेशानो विश्वरूपः प्रगीयते /
न तु भिन्नस्य कस्यापि धरादेरुपपन्नता // 116
text_mt: Thus the Supreme Lord is celebrated as having the form of the universe; / no reality of any distinct earth or the like can be established. // 116

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ caitatpuraiveti na bhūyaḥ pravivicyate /
bhūyobhiścāpi bāhyārthadūṣaṇaiḥ pravyaramyata // 117
meaning:
उक्तं चैतत्पुरैवेति न भूयः प्रविविच्यते /
भूयोभिश्चापि बाह्यार्थदूषणैः प्रव्यरम्यत // 117
text_mt: And this has already been stated earlier, so it is not analyzed further; / and an end has been made to extensive refutations of external objects. // 117

sanskrit_iast: taditthameṣa nirṇītaḥ kalādervistaro'dhvanaḥ // 118
meaning: तदित्थमेष निर्णीतः कलादेर्विस्तरोऽध्वनः // 118
text_mt: Thus has this extent of the path consisting of kalā and the rest been ascertained. // 118

sanskrit_iast: athādhvano'sya prakṛta upayogaḥ prakāśyate // 1
meaning: अथाध्वनोऽस्य प्रकृत उपयोगः प्रकाश्यते // 1
text_mt: Now, the present practical application of this path is elucidated. // 1b
title: Adhvopayogaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
itthamadhvā samasto'yaṃ yathā saṃvidi saṃsthitaḥ /
taddvārā śūnyadhīprāṇanāḍīcakratanuṣvatho // 2
meaning:
इत्थमध्वा समस्तोऽयं यथा संविदि संस्थितः /
तद्द्वारा शून्यधीप्राणनाडीचक्रतनुष्वथो // 2
text_mt: Thus, this entire path, as it resides in consciousness, / and through that in the void, intellect, vital breath, the network of channels, and the body, // 2

sanskrit_iast:
bahiśca liṅgamūrtyagnisthaṇḍilādiṣu sarvataḥ /
tathā sthitaḥ samastaśca vyastaścaiṣa kramākramāt // 3
meaning:
बहिश्च लिङ्गमूर्त्यग्निस्थण्डिलादिषु सर्वतः /
तथा स्थितः समस्तश्च व्यस्तश्चैष क्रमाक्रमात् // 3
text_mt: and externally, everywhere in the liṅga, the image, the fire, the altar, and so forth— / thus it abides as both collective and individual, through succession and non-succession. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
āsaṃvittattvamābāhyaṃ yo'yamadhvā vyavasthitaḥ /
tatra tatrocitaṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ svātantryeṇa bhāsayet // 4
meaning:
आसंवित्तत्त्वमाबाह्यं योऽयमध्वा व्यवस्थितः /
तत्र तत्रोचितं रूपं स्वं स्वातन्त्र्येण भासयेत् // 4
text_mt: This path, which is established from the principle of consciousness down to the external realm, / should manifest through absolute autonomy its appropriate form in each corresponding place. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ sarvatra rūpaṃ ca tasyāpi na na bhāsate /
nahyavaccheditāṃ kvāpi svapne'pi viṣahāmahe // 5
meaning:
सर्वं सर्वत्र रूपं च तस्यापि न न भासते /
नह्यवच्छेदितां क्वापि स्वप्नेऽपि विषहामहे // 5
text_mt: And its universal form everywhere does not fail to shine forth; / for we do not tolerate limitation anywhere, even in a dream. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ viśvādhvasaṃpūrṇaṃ kālavyāpāracitritam /
deśakālamayaspandasadma dehaṃ vilokayet // 6
meaning:
एवं विश्वाध्वसंपूर्णं कालव्यापारचित्रितम् /
देशकालमयस्पन्दसद्म देहं विलोकयेत् // 6
text_mt: Thus one should view the body filled with the entire path, variegated by the operation of time, / the abode of the vibration consisting of space and time. // 6

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vilokyamāno'sau viśvāntardevatāmayaḥ /
dhyeyaḥ pūjyaśca tarpyaśca tadāviṣṭo vimucyate // 7
meaning:
तथा विलोक्यमानोऽसौ विश्वान्तर्देवतामयः /
ध्येयः पूज्यश्च तर्प्यश्च तदाविष्टो विमुच्यते // 7
text_mt: Viewed in this way, it is composed of the deities within the universe, / to be meditated upon, worshipped, and propitiated; possessed of that, one is liberated. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ ghaṭaṃ paṭaṃ liṅgaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ pustakaṃ jalam /
yadvā kiṃcitkvacitpaśyettatra tanmayatāṃ vrajet // 8
meaning:
इत्थं घटं पटं लिङ्गं स्थण्डिलं पुस्तकं जलम् /
यद्वा किंचित्क्वचित्पश्येत्तत्र तन्मयतां व्रजेत् // 8
text_mt: In this way, whether one sees a pot, a cloth, a liṅga, an altar, a book, water, / or whatever thing anywhere, one should enter into identity with it. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārpaṇaṃ hi vastūnāmabhedenārcanaṃ matam /
tathā saṃpūrṇarūpatvānusaṃdhirdhyānamucyate // 9
meaning:
तत्रार्पणं हि वस्तूनामभेदेनार्चनं मतम् /
तथा संपूर्णरूपत्वानुसंधिर्ध्यानमुच्यते // 9
text_mt: For offering objects into it non-differently is held to be worship; / likewise, the continuous contemplation of its replete nature is spoken of as meditation. // 9

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇatvānusaṃdhānamakampaṃ dārḍhyamānayan /
tathāntarjalpayogena vimṛśañjapabhājanam // 10
meaning:
संपूर्णत्वानुसंधानमकम्पं दार्ढ्यमानयन् /
तथान्तर्जल्पयोगेन विमृशञ्जपभाजनम् // 10
text_mt: Bringing that contemplation of completeness to unshakeable firmness, / and likewise contemplating through internal dialogue, one becomes an adept in recitation. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārpitānāṃ bhāvānāṃ svakabhedavilāpanam /
kurvaṃstadraśmisadbhāvaṃ dadyāddhomakriyāparaḥ // 11
meaning:
तत्रार्पितानां भावानां स्वकभेदविलापनम् /
कुर्वंस्तद्रश्मिसद्भावं दद्याद्धोमक्रियापरः // 11
text_mt: Dissolving the separate existence of the entities offered therein, / making them into the reality of its rays, devoted to the rite of oblation, he would offer [them]. // 11

sanskrit_iast:
tathaivaṃkurvataḥ sarvaṃ samabhāvena paśyataḥ /
niṣkampatā vrataṃ śuddhaṃ sāmyaṃ nandiśikhoditam // 12
meaning:
तथैवंकुर्वतः सर्वं समभावेन पश्यतः /
निष्कम्पता व्रतं शुद्धं साम्यं नन्दिशिखोदितम् // 12
text_mt: And likewise for one acting thus, seeing everything with an even vision, / that unshakeable state is the pure observance, the equanimity taught in the Nandiśikhā. // 12

sanskrit_iast:
tathārcanajapadhyānahomavratavidhikramāt /
paripūrṇāṃ sthitiṃ prāhuḥ samādhiṃ guravaḥ purā // 13
meaning:
तथार्चनजपध्यानहोमव्रतविधिक्रमात् /
परिपूर्णां स्थितिं प्राहुः समाधिं गुरवः पुरा // 13
text_mt: Thus, through the procedure of worship, recitation, meditation, oblation, and observance, / the masters of old declared that replete condition to be absorption. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
atra pūjājapādyeṣu bahirantardvayasthitau /
dravyaughe na vidhiḥ ko'pi na kāpi pratiṣiddhatā // 14
meaning:
अत्र पूजाजपाद्येषु बहिरन्तर्द्वयस्थितौ /
द्रव्यौघे न विधिः कोऽपि न कापि प्रतिषिद्धता // 14
text_mt: Here, in worship, recitation, and so on, whether resting externally or internally, / among the multitude of substances there is no positive injunction, nor is anything prohibited. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
kalpanāśuddhisaṃdhyādernopayogo'tra kaścana /
uktaṃ śrītrikasūtre ca jāyate yajanaṃ prati // 15
meaning:
कल्पनाशुद्धिसंध्यादेर्नोपयोगोऽत्र कश्चन /
उक्तं श्रीत्रिकसूत्रे च जायते यजनं प्रति // 15
text_mt: Here, constructed purifications, twilight worship, and the like have no utility whatsoever; / and it is said in the Śrītrikasūtra regarding sacrifice: // 15

sanskrit_iast:
avidhijño vidhijñaścetyevamādi suvistaram /
yadā yathā yena yatra svā samvittiḥ prasīdati // 16
meaning:
अविधिज्ञो विधिज्ञश्चेत्येवमादि सुविस्तरम् /
यदा यथा येन यत्र स्वा सम्वित्तिः प्रसीदति // 16
text_mt: ‘One who knows the rules and one who does not know the rules,’ and so on in full detail. / When, how, by whatever means, and wherever one’s own consciousness is satisfied, // 16

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tathā tena tatra tattadbhogyaṃ vidhiśca saḥ /
laukikālaukikaṃ sarvaṃ tenātra viniyojayet // 17
meaning:
तदा तथा तेन तत्र तत्तद्भोग्यं विधिश्च सः /
लौकिकालौकिकं सर्वं तेनात्र विनियोजयेत् // 17
text_mt: then, thus, by that means, and there, that is the object of enjoyment, and that is the rule; / therefore, one should employ everything worldly and unworldly herein. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkampatve sakampastu kampaṃ nirhrāsayedbalāt /
yathā yenābhyupāyena kramādakramato'pi vā // 18
meaning:
निष्कम्पत्वे सकम्पस्तु कम्पं निर्ह्रासयेद्बलात् /
यथा येनाभ्युपायेन क्रमादक्रमतोऽपि वा // 18
text_mt: One who wavers in unshakeability, however, should forcefully diminish that wavering / by whatever means, gradually or all at once. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
vicikitsā galatyantastathāsau yatnavānbhavet /
dhīkarmākṣagatā devīrniṣiddhaireva tarpayet // 19
meaning:
विचिकित्सा गलत्यन्तस्तथासौ यत्नवान्भवेत् /
धीकर्माक्षगता देवीर्निषिद्धैरेव तर्पयेत् // 19
text_mt: He should make effort in such a way that doubt melts away internally; / he should gratify the goddesses residing in the senses of intellect and action with precisely what is prohibited, // 19

sanskrit_iast:
vīravrataṃ cābhinandediti bhargaśikhāvacaḥ /
tathāhi śaṅkā mālinyaṃ glāniḥ saṃkoca ityadaḥ // 20
meaning:
वीरव्रतं चाभिनन्देदिति भर्गशिखावचः /
तथाहि शङ्का मालिन्यं ग्लानिः संकोच इत्यदः // 20
text_mt: and should welcome the observance of heroes: such is the teaching of the Bhargaśikhā. / For suspicion, taint, dejection, and contraction—these // 20

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārakārāgārāntaḥ sthūlasthūṇāghaṭāyate /
mantrā varṇasvabhāvā ye dravyaṃ yatpāñcabhautikam // 21
meaning:
संसारकारागारान्तः स्थूलस्थूणाघटायते /
मन्त्रा वर्णस्वभावा ये द्रव्यं यत्पाञ्चभौतिकम् // 21
text_mt: form thick pillars within the prison-house of cyclic existence. / As for mantras, they are of the nature of phonemes; as for substance, it is made of the five elements; // 21

sanskrit_iast:
yaccidātma prāṇijātaṃ tatra kaḥ saṃkaraḥ katham /
saṃkarābhāvataḥ keyaṃ śaṅkā tasyāmapi sphuṭam // 22
meaning:
यच्चिदात्म प्राणिजातं तत्र कः संकरः कथम् /
संकराभावतः केयं शङ्का तस्यामपि स्फुटम् // 22
text_mt: and as for the multitude of living beings, its essence is consciousness—what pollution could be there, and how? / Because of the absence of pollution, what is this doubt? Even with regard to it, clearly, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
na śaṅketa tathā śaṅkā vilīyetāvahelayā /
śrīsarvācāravīrālīniśācarakramādiṣu // 23
meaning:
न शङ्केत तथा शङ्का विलीयेतावहेलया /
श्रीसर्वाचारवीरालीनिशाचरक्रमादिषु // 23
text_mt: one should not doubt, so that doubt dissolves effortlessly. / In the scriptures such as the venerable Sarvācāra, Vīrāvalī, Niśācarakrama, and others, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
śāstreṣu vitataṃ caitattatra tatrocyate yataḥ /
śaṅkayā jāyate glāniḥ śaṅkayā vighnabhājanam // 24
meaning:
शास्त्रेषु विततं चैतत्तत्र तत्रोच्यते यतः /
शङ्कया जायते ग्लानिः शङ्कया विघ्नभाजनम् // 24
text_mt: this is set forth extensively, because it is stated in various places: / ‘Through doubt dejection arises; through doubt one becomes a vessel for obstacles.’ // 24

sanskrit_iast:
uvācotpaladevaśca śrīmānasmadgurorguruḥ /
sarvāśaṅkāśaniṃ mārgaṃ numo māheśvaraṃ tviti // 25
anuttarapadāptaye tadidamāṇavaṃ darśitābhyupāyamativistarānnanu vidāṃkurudhvaṃ budhāḥ /
meaning:
उवाचोत्पलदेवश्च श्रीमानस्मद्गुरोर्गुरुः /
सर्वाशङ्काशनिं मार्गं नुमो माहेश्वरं त्विति // 25
अनुत्तरपदाप्तये तदिदमाणवं दर्शिताभ्युपायमतिविस्तरान्ननु विदांकुरुध्वं बुधाः /
text_mt:
And the venerable Utpaladeva, the guru of our guru, said: / ‘We praise the path of Maheśvara, the thunderbolt against all doubt.’ // 25
Therefore, O wise ones, understand this individual means displayed in great detail for the attainment of the unexcelled state!

sanskrit_iast: athādhikṛtibhāhanaṃ ka iha vā kathaṃ vetyalaṃ vivecayitumucyate vividhaśaktipātakramaḥ // 1
meaning: अथाधिकृतिभाहनं क इह वा कथं वेत्यलं विवेचयितुमुच्यते विविधशक्तिपातक्रमः // 1
text_mt: Now, the succession of diverse descents of power is expounded in order to thoroughly discern who in this world is qualified for this [knowledge], or how. // 1b
title: Śaktipātapradarśana

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kecidiha prāhuḥ śaktipāta imaṃ vidhim /
taṃ pradarśya nirākṛtya svamataṃ darśayiṣyate // 2
meaning:
तत्र केचिदिह प्राहुः शक्तिपात इमं विधिम् /
तं प्रदर्श्य निराकृत्य स्वमतं दर्शयिष्यते // 2
text_mt: Here, some state this rule regarding the descent of power; / setting it forth and refuting it, [our] own doctrine will be shown. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
tatredaṃ dṛśyamānaṃ satsukhaduḥkhavimohabhāk /
viṣamaṃ sattathābhūtaṃ samaṃ hetuṃ prakalpayet // 3
meaning:
तत्रेदं दृश्यमानं सत्सुखदुःखविमोहभाक् /
विषमं सत्तथाभूतं समं हेतुं प्रकल्पयेत् // 3
text_mt: Here, this [world] being experienced, partaking of pleasure, pain, and delusion, / being varied, one should postulate an unvaried cause of such a nature. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
so'vyaktaṃ tacca sattvādinānārūpamacetanam /
ghaṭādivatkāryamiti hetureko'sya sā niśā // 4
meaning:
सोऽव्यक्तं तच्च सत्त्वादिनानारूपमचेतनम् /
घटादिवत्कार्यमिति हेतुरेकोऽस्य सा निशा // 4
text_mt: That is the unmanifest, and that is insentient, having manifold forms like sattva and the rest; / being an effect like a pot or the like, it has a single cause, which is that night [māyā]. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
sā jaḍā kāryatādrūpyātkāryaṃ cāsyāṃ sadeva hi /
kalādidharaṇīprāntaṃ jāḍyātsā sūtaye'kṣamā // 5
meaning:
सा जडा कार्यताद्रूप्यात्कार्यं चास्यां सदेव हि /
कलादिधरणीप्रान्तं जाड्यात्सा सूतयेऽक्षमा // 5
text_mt: It is insentient because it has the nature of an effect, and the effect in it is indeed existent, / ending from the parts up to the earth; on account of insentience, it is incapable of giving birth. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
teneśaḥ kṣobhayedenāṃ kṣobho'syāḥ sūtiyogyatā /
