puṃsaḥ prati ca sā bhogyaṃ sūte'nādīn pṛthagvidhān // 6
meaning:
तेनेशः क्षोभयेदेनां क्षोभोऽस्याः सूतियोग्यता /
पुंसः प्रति च सा भोग्यं सूतेऽनादीन् पृथग्विधान् // 6
text_mt: Therefore the Lord agitates it; its agitation is its capacity to give birth, / and for the soul it gives birth to beginningless, distinct kinds of objects of enjoyment. // 6

sanskrit_iast:
puṃsaśca nirviśeṣatve muktāṇūn prati kiṃ na tat /
nimittaṃ karmasaṃskāraḥ sa ca teṣu na vidyate // 7
meaning:
पुंसश्च निर्विशेषत्वे मुक्ताणून् प्रति किं न तत् /
निमित्तं कर्मसंस्कारः स च तेषु न विद्यते // 7
text_mt: And the soul being without distinction, why does that not [occur] for liberated souls? / The cause is the impression of karma, and that does not exist in them. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
iti cetkarmasaṃskārābhāvasteṣāṃ kutaḥ kila /
na bhogādanyakarmāṃśaprasaṅgo hi duratyayaḥ // 8
meaning:
इति चेत्कर्मसंस्काराभावस्तेषां कुतः किल /
न भोगादन्यकर्मांशप्रसङ्गो हि दुरत्ययः // 8
text_mt: If it is argued thus, whence indeed is the absence of the impression of karma in them? / Not from experiencing [it], for the consequence of other portions of karma is unavoidable. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
yugapatkarmaṇāṃ bhogo naca yuktaḥ krameṇa hi /
phaledyatkarma tatkasmātsvaṃ rūpaṃ saṃtyajetkvacit // 9
meaning:
युगपत्कर्मणां भोगो नच युक्तः क्रमेण हि /
फलेद्यत्कर्म तत्कस्मात्स्वं रूपं संत्यजेत्क्वचित् // 9
text_mt: Nor is the simultaneous experience of karmas appropriate, for karma which / bears fruit in succession—why would it ever abandon its own nature? // 9

sanskrit_iast:
jñānātkarmakṣayaścettatkuta īśvaracoditāt /
dharmādyadi kutaḥ so'pi karmataścettaducyatām // 10
meaning:
ज्ञानात्कर्मक्षयश्चेत्तत्कुत ईश्वरचोदितात् /
धर्माद्यदि कुतः सोऽपि कर्मतश्चेत्तदुच्यताम् // 10
text_mt: If the destruction of karma is from knowledge, whence is that? If from righteousness prompted by the Lord, / whence is that? If from karma, then let that be explained. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
nahi karmāsti tādṛkṣaṃ yena jñānaṃ pravartate /
karmajatve ca tajjñānaṃ phalarāśau pateddhruvam // 11
meaning:
नहि कर्मास्ति तादृक्षं येन ज्ञानं प्रवर्तते /
कर्मजत्वे च तज्ज्ञानं फलराशौ पतेद्ध्रुवम् // 11
text_mt: For there is no such karma by which knowledge is set in motion; / and if born of karma, that knowledge would certainly fall into the pile of fruits. // 11

sanskrit_iast:
anyakarmaphalaṃ prācyaṃ karmarāśiṃ ca kiṃ dahet /
īśasya dveṣarāgādiśūnyasyāpi kathaṃ kvacit // 12
meaning:
अन्यकर्मफलं प्राच्यं कर्मराशिं च किं दहेत् /
ईशस्य द्वेषरागादिशून्यस्यापि कथं क्वचित् // 12
text_mt: And why would the fruit of another karma burn away the previous mass of karma? / Even for the Lord, who is devoid of aversion, attachment, and the like, how in any case // 12

sanskrit_iast:
tathābhisaṃdhirnānyatra bhedahetorabhāvataḥ /
nanvitthaṃ pradahejjñānaṃ karmajālāni karma hi // 13
meaning:
तथाभिसंधिर्नान्यत्र भेदहेतोरभावतः /
नन्वित्थं प्रदहेज्ज्ञानं कर्मजालानि कर्म हि // 13
text_mt: could there be such an intention elsewhere, given the absence of a cause for differentiation? / ‘Well, knowledge burns the webs of karma in this way: for karma, // 13

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānasahakārīdaṃ sūte svargādikaṃ phalam /
ajñānaṃ jñānato naśyedanyakarmaphalādapi // 14
meaning:
अज्ञानसहकारीदं सूते स्वर्गादिकं फलम् /
अज्ञानं ज्ञानतो नश्येदन्यकर्मफलादपि // 14
text_mt: with ignorance as its auxiliary, gives birth to fruit such as heaven; / ignorance is destroyed by knowledge, and even by the fruit of another karma, // 14

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsādikaṃ cānyadduṣṭakarmaphalaṃ bhavet /
niṣphalīkurute duṣṭaṃ karmetyaṅgīkṛtaṃ kila // 15
meaning:
उपवासादिकं चान्यद्दुष्टकर्मफलं भवेत् /
निष्फलीकुरुते दुष्टं कर्मेत्यङ्गीकृतं किल // 15
text_mt: such as fasting and the like, which is the fruit of bad karma; / it is accepted, surely, that it makes bad karma fruitless.’ // 15

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānamiti yatproktaṃ jñānābhāvaḥ sa cetsa kim /
prāgabhāvo'thavā dhvaṃsa ādye kiṃ sarvasaṃvidām // 16
meaning:
अज्ञानमिति यत्प्रोक्तं ज्ञानाभावः स चेत्स किम् /
प्रागभावोऽथवा ध्वंस आद्ये किं सर्वसंविदाम् // 16
text_mt: If that which is called ignorance is the absence of knowledge, what is it? / Is it prior non-existence or destruction? In the first case, is it [the absence] of all cognitions, // 16

sanskrit_iast:
kasyāpi vātha jñānasya prācyaḥ pakṣastvasaṃbhavī /
na kiṃcidyasya vijñānamudapādi tathāvidhaḥ // 17
meaning:
कस्यापि वाथ ज्ञानस्य प्राच्यः पक्षस्त्वसंभवी /
न किंचिद्यस्य विज्ञानमुदपादि तथाविधः // 17
text_mt: or of some particular knowledge? The first view is impossible: / there is no soul in this beginningless existence for whom no knowledge of any kind // 17

sanskrit_iast:
nāṇurasti bhave hyasminnanādau ko'nvayaṃ kramaḥ /
bhāvinaḥ prāgabhāvaśca jñānasyeti sthite sati // 18
meaning:
नाणुरस्ति भवे ह्यस्मिन्ननादौ कोऽन्वयं क्रमः /
भाविनः प्रागभावश्च ज्ञानस्येति स्थिते सति // 18
text_mt: has arisen—what sequence would this be? / If it is established that [ignorance] is the prior non-existence of future knowledge, // 18

sanskrit_iast:
muktāṇorapi so'styeva janmataḥ prāgasau naca /
jñānaṃ bhāvi vimukte'sminniti ceccarcyatāmidam // 19
meaning:
मुक्ताणोरपि सोऽस्त्येव जन्मतः प्रागसौ नच /
ज्ञानं भावि विमुक्तेऽस्मिन्निति चेच्चर्च्यतामिदम् // 19
text_mt: that certainly exists even for a liberated soul prior to birth; / if it is said that future knowledge does not exist in this liberated one, let this be examined: // 19

sanskrit_iast:
kasmājjñānaṃ na bhāvyatra nanu dehādyajanmataḥ /
tatkasmātkarmaṇaḥ kṣaiṇyāttatkuto'jñānahānitaḥ // 20
meaning:
कस्माज्ज्ञानं न भाव्यत्र ननु देहाद्यजन्मतः /
तत्कस्मात्कर्मणः क्षैण्यात्तत्कुतोऽज्ञानहानितः // 20
text_mt: Why would knowledge not be future here? ‘Surely because of the non-birth of the body and the rest.’ / From what is that? ‘From the exhaustion of karma.’ From what is that? ‘From the cessation of ignorance.’ // 20

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānasya kathaṃ hāniḥ prāgabhāve hi saṃvidaḥ /
ajñānaṃ prāgabhāvo'sau na bhāvyutpattyasaṃbhavāt // 21
meaning:
अज्ञानस्य कथं हानिः प्रागभावे हि संविदः /
अज्ञानं प्रागभावोऽसौ न भाव्युत्पत्त्यसंभवात् // 21
text_mt: How is there cessation of ignorance? For when there is prior non-existence of consciousness, / that prior non-existence is ignorance, and it cannot occur because of the impossibility of arising. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
kasmānna bhāvi tajjñānaṃ nanu dehādyajanmataḥ /
ityeṣa sarvapakṣaghno niśitaścakrakabhramaḥ // 22
meaning:
कस्मान्न भावि तज्ज्ञानं ननु देहाद्यजन्मतः /
इत्येष सर्वपक्षघ्नो निशितश्चक्रकभ्रमः // 22
text_mt: Why is that knowledge not future? ‘Surely because of the non-birth of the body and the rest.’ / This is a sharp circular argument that destroys all positions. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
atha pradhvaṃsa evedamajñānaṃ tatsadā sthitam /
muktāṇuṣviti teṣvastu māyākāryavijṛmbhitam // 23
meaning:
अथ प्रध्वंस एवेदमज्ञानं तत्सदा स्थितम् /
मुक्ताणुष्विति तेष्वस्तु मायाकार्यविजृम्भितम् // 23
text_mt: Now, if this ignorance is simply destruction, that remains constantly / in liberated souls; so let them have the expansion of the effects of māyā. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
athājñānaṃ nahyabhāvo mithyājñānaṃ tu tanmatam /
tadeva karmaṇāṃ svasminkartavye sahakāraṇam // 24
meaning:
अथाज्ञानं नह्यभावो मिथ्याज्ञानं तु तन्मतम् /
तदेव कर्मणां स्वस्मिन्कर्तव्ये सहकारणम् // 24
text_mt: Now, if ignorance is not non-existence, but rather is held to be false knowledge, / and that alone is the auxiliary cause of karmas in their own operation, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
vaktavyaṃ tarhi kiṃ karma yadā sūte svakaṃ phalam /
tadaiva mithyājñānena satā hetutvamāpyate // 25
meaning:
वक्तव्यं तर्हि किं कर्म यदा सूते स्वकं फलम् /
तदैव मिथ्याज्ञानेन सता हेतुत्वमाप्यते // 25
text_mt: then it must be stated: when karma gives birth to its fruit, / is causality obtained only then by existing false knowledge? // 25

sanskrit_iast:
atha yasminkṣaṇe karma kṛtaṃ tatra svarūpasat /
mithyājñānaṃ yadi tatastādṛśātkamarṇaḥ phalam // 26
meaning:
अथ यस्मिन्क्षणे कर्म कृतं तत्र स्वरूपसत् /
मिथ्याज्ञानं यदि ततस्तादृशात्कमर्णः फलम् // 26
text_mt: Or if false knowledge is real in its own nature at the moment karma is performed, / and then from such karma fruit arises: // 26

sanskrit_iast:
prākpakṣe pralaye vṛtte prācyasṛṣṭipravartane /
dehādyabhāvānno mithyājñānasya kvāpi saṃbhavaḥ // 27
meaning:
प्राक्पक्षे प्रलये वृत्ते प्राच्यसृष्टिप्रवर्तने /
देहाद्यभावान्नो मिथ्याज्ञानस्य क्वापि संभवः // 27
text_mt: On the former view, when dissolution has occurred, upon the initiation of a subsequent creation, / because of the absence of the body and the rest, false knowledge cannot occur anywhere. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
uttarasminpunaḥ pakṣe yadā yadyena yatra vā /
kriyate karma tatsarvamajñānasacivaṃ tadā // 28
meaning:
उत्तरस्मिन्पुनः पक्षे यदा यद्येन यत्र वा /
क्रियते कर्म तत्सर्वमज्ञानसचिवं तदा // 28
text_mt: On the latter view, on the other hand, whenever, whatever, by whomsoever, or wherever / action is performed, all of it is then assisted by ignorance. // 28

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyamiti kasyāpi na karmaprakṣayo bhavet /
yadyapi jñānavānbhūtvā vidhatte karma kiṃcana // 29
meaning:
अवश्यमिति कस्यापि न कर्मप्रक्षयो भवेत् /
यद्यपि ज्ञानवान्भूत्वा विधत्ते कर्म किंचन // 29
text_mt: Inevitably, then, no one's karma would ever be eradicated; / even if, having acquired knowledge, one performs some action, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
viphalaṃ syāttu tatpūrvakarmarāśau tu kā gatiḥ /
atha pralayakāle 'pi citsvabhāvatvayogataḥ // 30
meaning:
विफलं स्यात्तु तत्पूर्वकर्मराशौ तु का गतिः /
अथ प्रलयकाले ऽपि चित्स्वभावत्वयोगतः // 30
text_mt: and that [action] were fruitless, what would become of the accumulation of prior karma? / If [it is argued that] even at the time of dissolution, by virtue of having the nature of consciousness, // 30

sanskrit_iast:
aṇūnā saṃbhavatyeva jñānaṃ mithyeti tatkutaḥ /
svabhāvāditi cenmukte śive vā kiṃ tathā nahi // 31
meaning:
अणूना संभवत्येव ज्ञानं मिथ्येति तत्कुतः /
स्वभावादिति चेन्मुक्ते शिवे वा किं तथा नहि // 31
text_mt: false knowledge indeed occurs in bound souls, then from what [does it arise]? / If [it is answered], "from their inherent nature," why then does this not apply to the liberated soul or Śiva? // 31

sanskrit_iast:
yaccādarśanamākhyātaṃ nimittaṃ pariṇāmini /
pradhāne taddhi saṃkīrṇavaivittayobhayayogataḥ // 32
meaning:
यच्चादर्शनमाख्यातं निमित्तं परिणामिनि /
प्रधाने तद्धि संकीर्णवैवित्तयोभययोगतः // 32
text_mt: And as for the non-discrimination spoken of as the cause in transforming / primal nature, that is indeed because of the conjunction of both indiscriminate and discriminate knowledge: // 32

sanskrit_iast:
darśanāya pumarthaikayogyatāsacivaṃ dhiyaḥ /
ārabhya sate dharaṇīparyantaṃ tatra yaccitaḥ // 33
meaning:
दर्शनाय पुमर्थैकयोग्यतासचिवं धियः /
आरभ्य सते धरणीपर्यन्तं तत्र यच्चितः // 33
text_mt: assisted by its sole fitness for the human purpose [that leads] to discriminative knowledge, / from intellect down to the earth; and in that regard, consciousness's // 33

sanskrit_iast:
buddhivṛttyaviśiṣṭatvaṃ puṃsprayāśarprasādataḥ /
prakāśanāddhiyo'rthena saha bhogaḥ sa bhaṇyate // 34
meaning:
बुद्धिवृत्त्यविशिष्टत्वं पुंस्प्रयाशर्प्रसादतः /
प्रकाशनाद्धियोऽर्थेन सह भोगः स भण्यते // 34
text_mt: indistinctness from the modifications of the intellect—because of the illumination of the intellect together with its object / by grace of the exertion of the self—that is termed enjoyment. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
buddhirevāsmi vikṛtidharmikānyastu ko'pyasau /
madvilakṣaṇa ekātmetyevaṃ vaivi yasaṃvidi // 35
meaning:
बुद्धिरेवास्मि विकृतिधर्मिकान्यस्तु कोऽप्यसौ /
मद्विलक्षण एकात्मेत्येवं वैवि यसंविदि // 35
text_mt: When there is distinctive consciousness such that: "I am the intellect itself, which possesses the quality of transformation, / but that other is someone distinct from me, a singular self," // 35

sanskrit_iast:
pumarthasya kṛtatvena sahakāriviyogataḥ /
taṃ pumāṃsaṃ prati naiva sūte kiṃtvanyameva hi // 36
meaning:
पुमर्थस्य कृतत्वेन सहकारिवियोगतः /
तं पुमांसं प्रति नैव सूते किंत्वन्यमेव हि // 36
text_mt: since the human purpose is accomplished, through the cessation of the auxiliary factor, / [primal nature] no longer generates [experience] for that self, but only for another. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
atra puṃso'tha mūlasya dharmo'darśanatā dvayoḥ /
athaveti vikalpo'yamāstāmetattu bhaṇyatām // 37
meaning:
अत्र पुंसोऽथ मूलस्य धर्मोऽदर्शनता द्वयोः /
अथवेति विकल्पोऽयमास्तामेतत्तु भण्यताम् // 37
text_mt: Here, whether non-discrimination is a quality of the self, or of the root [nature], or of both— / let this alternative rest; let this [rather] be stated: // 37

sanskrit_iast:
bhogo vivekaparyanta iti yattatra ko'vadhiḥ /
vivekalābhe nikhilasūtidṛgyadi sāpi kim // 38
meaning:
भोगो विवेकपर्यन्त इति यत्तत्र कोऽवधिः /
विवेकलाभे निखिलसूतिदृग्यदि सापि किम् // 38
text_mt: As for the statement that "enjoyment lasts until discrimination," what is the limit there? / If, when discrimination is obtained, all manifest production is perceived, then is it even so // 38

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyena viśeṣairvā prācye syādekajanmataḥ /
uttare na kadācitsyādbhāvikālasya yogataḥ // 39
meaning:
सामान्येन विशेषैर्वा प्राच्ये स्यादेकजन्मतः /
उत्तरे न कदाचित्स्याद्भाविकालस्य योगतः // 39
text_mt: in a general way, or through particular aspects? In the former case, it would occur in a single birth; / in the latter, it would never occur, on account of future time. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
kaiścideva viśeṣaiścetsarveṣāṃ yugapadbhavet /
viveko'nādisaṃyogātkā hyanyonyaṃ vicitratā // 40
meaning:
कैश्चिदेव विशेषैश्चेत्सर्वेषां युगपद्भवेत् /
विवेकोऽनादिसंयोगात्का ह्यन्योन्यं विचित्रता // 40
text_mt: If [it were to occur] through just some particular aspects, discrimination would arise / for all [souls] simultaneously from their beginningless conjunction; for what distinct diversity would there be between them? // 40

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsāṃkhyadṛśāpīdamajñānaṃ naiva yujyate /
ajñānena vinā bandhamokṣau naiva vyavasthayā // 41
meaning:
तस्मात्सांख्यदृशापीदमज्ञानं नैव युज्यते /
अज्ञानेन विना बन्धमोक्षौ नैव व्यवस्थया // 41
text_mt: Therefore, even according to the Sāṅkhya view, this ignorance is not tenable. / Without ignorance, bondage and liberation are by no means properly established // 41

sanskrit_iast:
yujyete tacca kathitayuktibhirnopapadyate /
bhāyākarmāṇudevecchāsadbhāve'pi sthite tataḥ // 42
meaning:
युज्येते तच्च कथितयुक्तिभिर्नोपपद्यते /
भायाकर्माणुदेवेच्छासद्भावेऽपि स्थिते ततः // 42
text_mt: as systematic, nor does that [ignorance] hold according to the stated arguments. / Even if the existence of illusion, karma, the soul, and the divine will remains established, therefore, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
na bandhamokṣayoryogo bhedahetorasaṃbhavāt /
tasmādajñānaśabdena jñatvakartṛtvadharmaṇām // 43
meaning:
न बन्धमोक्षयोर्योगो भेदहेतोरसंभवात् /
तस्मादज्ञानशब्देन ज्ञत्वकर्तृत्वधर्मणाम् // 43
text_mt: the conjunction of bondage and liberation is impossible, because a cause of difference does not exist. / Therefore, by the word "ignorance," a wise person must state that // 43

sanskrit_iast:
cidaṇūnāmāvaraṇaṃ kiṃcidvācyaṃ vipaścitā /
āvāraṇātmanā siddhaṃ tatsvarūpādabhedavat // 44
meaning:
चिदणूनामावरणं किंचिद्वाच्यं विपश्चिता /
आवारणात्मना सिद्धं तत्स्वरूपादभेदवत् // 44
text_mt: it is a certain covering of the conscious souls that possess the qualities of knowing and acting. / It is established as an obstruction, as it were non-different from its own nature; // 44

sanskrit_iast:
bhede pramāṇābhāvācca tadekaṃ nikhilātmasu /
tacca kasmātprasūtaṃ syānmāyātaścetkathaṃ nu sā // 45
meaning:
भेदे प्रमाणाभावाच्च तदेकं निखिलात्मसु /
तच्च कस्मात्प्रसूतं स्यान्मायातश्चेत्कथं नु सा // 45
text_mt: and because there is no proof of difference, it is one in all souls. / And from what could it arise? If from māyā, how indeed could she // 45

sanskrit_iast:
kvacideva suvītaitanna tu muktātmanītyayam /
prācyaḥ paryanuyogaḥ syānnimittaṃ cenna labhyate // 46
meaning:
क्वचिदेव सुवीतैतन्न तु मुक्तात्मनीत्ययम् /
प्राच्यः पर्यनुयोगः स्यान्निमित्तं चेन्न लभ्यते // 46
text_mt: generate it only in some, and not in the liberated soul? / This would be the same prior objection, if no cause is found. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
utpattyabhāvatastena nityaṃ naca vinaśyati /
tata evaikatāyāṃ cānyātmasādhāraṇatvataḥ // 47
meaning:
उत्पत्त्यभावतस्तेन नित्यं नच विनश्यति /
तत एवैकतायां चान्यात्मसाधारणत्वतः // 47
text_mt: Therefore, from the absence of origination, it is eternal and does not perish; / for that very reason, in its oneness, it is common to other souls. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
na vāvastvarthakāritvānna cittatsaṃvṛtitvataḥ /
na caitenātmanāṃ yogo hetumāṃstadasaṃbhavāt // 48
meaning:
न वावस्त्वर्थकारित्वान्न चित्तत्संवृतित्वतः /
न चैतेनात्मनां योगो हेतुमांस्तदसंभवात् // 48
text_mt: Nor is it unreal, because it exercises causal efficacy; nor is it conscious, because it obscures that; / nor does the conjunction of souls with it have a cause, because that is impossible. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
tenaikaṃ vastu sannityaṃ nityasaṃbaddhamātmabhiḥ /
jaḍaṃ malaṃ tadajñānaṃ saṃsārāṅkurakāraṇam // 49
meaning:
तेनैकं वस्तु सन्नित्यं नित्यसंबद्धमात्मभिः /
जडं मलं तदज्ञानं संसाराङ्कुरकारणम् // 49
text_mt: Therefore, impurity is a single, real, eternal entity, eternally bound to souls, / insentient, [called] ignorance, the cause of the sprout of saṃsāra. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
tasya roddhrī yadā śaktirudāste śivaraśmibhiḥ /
tadāṇuḥ spṛśyate spṛṣṭaḥ svake jñānakriye sphuṭe // 50
meaning:
तस्य रोद्ध्री यदा शक्तिरुदास्ते शिवरश्मिभिः /
तदाणुः स्पृश्यते स्पृष्टः स्वके ज्ञानक्रिये स्फुटे // 50
text_mt: When its obstructing power becomes indifferent through the rays of Śiva, / then the soul is touched; once touched, he enters into his own distinct knowing and acting, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
samāviśedayaṃ sūryakānto'rkeṇeva coditaḥ /
roddhryāśca śaktermādhyasthyatāratamyavaśakramāat // 51
meaning:
समाविशेदयं सूर्यकान्तोऽर्केणेव चोदितः /
रोद्ध्र्याश्च शक्तेर्माध्यस्थ्यतारतम्यवशक्रमाअत् // 51
text_mt: like a sun-gem stimulated by the sun. / And through the succession determined by the degrees of indifference of the obstructing power, // 51

sanskrit_iast:
vicitratvamataḥ prāhurabhivyaktau svasaṃvidaḥ /
sa eṣa śaktipātākhyaḥ śāstreṣu paribhāṣyate // 52
meaning:
विचित्रत्वमतः प्राहुरभिव्यक्तौ स्वसंविदः /
स एष शक्तिपाताख्यः शास्त्रेषु परिभाष्यते // 52
text_mt: they speak of diversity in the manifestation of one's own consciousness. / This very [process] is designated in the scriptures as the descent of power. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
atrocyate malastāvaditthameṣa na yujyate /
iti pūrvāhṇike proktaṃ punaruktau tu kiṃ phalam // 53
meaning:
अत्रोच्यते मलस्तावदित्थमेष न युज्यते /
इति पूर्वाह्णिके प्रोक्तं पुनरुक्तौ तु किं फलम् // 53
text_mt: To this, it is replied: First of all, impurity conceived in this way is untenable; / this has been explained in a prior lesson, so what is the point of repetition? // 53

sanskrit_iast:
malasya pākaḥ ko 'yaṃ syānnāśaśceditarātmanām /
sa eko mala ityukternairmalyamanuṣajyate // 54
meaning:
मलस्य पाकः को ऽयं स्यान्नाशश्चेदितरात्मनाम् /
स एको मल इत्युक्तेर्नैर्मल्यमनुषज्यते // 54
text_mt: What would this "ripening" of impurity be? If it is destruction, / then because it was stated that impurity is one, purity would inevitably follow for all other souls. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
atha pratyātmaniyato'nādiśca prāgabhāvavat /
malo naśyettathāpyeṣa nāśo yadi sahetukaḥ // 55
meaning:
अथ प्रत्यात्मनियतोऽनादिश्च प्रागभाववत् /
मलो नश्येत्तथाप्येष नाशो यदि सहेतुकः // 55
text_mt: If [you say that] impurity is restricted to each soul and beginningless, like prior non-existence, / and yet perishes, even so, if this destruction has a cause, // 55

sanskrit_iast:
hetuḥ karmeśvarecchā vā karma tāvanna tādṛśam /
īśvarecchā svatantrā ca kvacideva tathaiva kim // 56
meaning:
हेतुः कर्मेश्वरेच्छा वा कर्म तावन्न तादृशम् /
ईश्वरेच्छा स्वतन्त्रा च क्वचिदेव तथैव किम् // 56
text_mt: the cause would be either karma or the will of the Lord. Karma, first of all, is not of such a kind; / and the will of the Lord is autonomous, so why would it be thus only in some cases? // 56

sanskrit_iast:
ahetuko'sya nāśaścetprāgevaiṣa vinaśyatu /
kṣaṇāntaraṃ sadṛk sūte iti cetsthirataiva sā // 57
meaning:
अहेतुकोऽस्य नाशश्चेत्प्रागेवैष विनश्यतु /
क्षणान्तरं सदृक् सूते इति चेत्स्थिरतैव सा // 57
text_mt: If its destruction is uncaused, let it perish right from the start! / If [it is argued that] it generates a similar subsequent moment, that is simply permanence. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
na ca nityasya bhāvasya hetvanāyattajanmanaḥ /
nāśo dṛṣṭaḥ prāgabhāvastvavastviti tathāstu saḥ // 58
meaning:
न च नित्यस्य भावस्य हेत्वनायत्तजन्मनः /
नाशो दृष्टः प्रागभावस्त्ववस्त्विति तथास्तु सः // 58
text_mt: Nor has destruction ever been seen of an eternal real entity whose birth is independent of causes; / but prior non-existence is a non-entity, so let that be so. // 58

sanskrit_iast:
athāsya pāko nāmaiṣa svaśaktipratibaddhatā /
sarvānprati tathaiṣa syādruddhaśaktirviṣāgnivat // 59
meaning:
अथास्य पाको नामैष स्वशक्तिप्रतिबद्धता /
सर्वान्प्रति तथैष स्याद्रुद्धशक्तिर्विषाग्निवत् // 59
text_mt: Now, if this so-called "ripening" of it is the obstruction of its own power, / it would be likewise obstructed in its power toward everyone, like poison or fire; // 59

sanskrit_iast:
punarudbhūtaśaktau ca svakāryaṃ syādviṣāgnivat /
muktā api na muktāḥ syuḥ śaktiṃ cāsya na manmahe // 60
meaning:
पुनरुद्भूतशक्तौ च स्वकार्यं स्याद्विषाग्निवत् /
मुक्ता अपि न मुक्ताः स्युः शक्तिं चास्य न मन्महे // 60
text_mt: and when its power arises again, its effect would occur, as with poison or fire; / even the liberated would not be liberated, and we do not accept that it has power. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
roddhrīti cetkasya nṛṇāṃ jñatvakartṛtvayoryadi /
sadbhāvamātrādroddhṛtve śivamuktāṇvasaṃbhavaḥ // 61
meaning:
रोद्ध्रीति चेत्कस्य नृणां ज्ञत्वकर्तृत्वयोर्यदि /
सद्भावमात्राद्रोद्धृत्वे शिवमुक्ताण्वसंभवः // 61
text_mt: If [it is called] "obstructing," of what? If of men's knowing and acting, / then if it were an obstructor by its mere existence, Śiva, the liberated soul, and the bound soul would be impossible. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
saṃnidhānātiriktaṃ ca na kiṃcitkurute malaḥ /
ātmanā pariṇāmitvādanityatvaprasaṅgataḥ // 62
meaning:
संनिधानातिरिक्तं च न किंचित्कुरुते मलः /
आत्मना परिणामित्वादनित्यत्वप्रसङ्गतः // 62
text_mt: And impurity produces nothing apart from [its] proximity, / because of the undesirable consequence of its changing and being non-eternal by itself. // 62

sanskrit_iast:
jñatvakartṛtvamātraṃ ca pudgalā na tadāśrayāḥ /
taccedāvāritaṃ hanta rūpanāśaḥ prasajyate // 63
meaning:
ज्ञत्वकर्तृत्वमात्रं च पुद्गला न तदाश्रयाः /
तच्चेदावारितं हन्त रूपनाशः प्रसज्यते // 63
text_mt: Moreover, souls are simply knowing and acting; they are not the substrata of them. / If that is covered, alas, the destruction of their very nature would follow! // 63

sanskrit_iast:
āvāraṇaṃ cādṛśyatvaṃ na ca tadvastuno'nyatām /
karoti ghaṭavajjñānaṃ nāvarītuṃ ca śakyate // 64
meaning:
आवारणं चादृश्यत्वं न च तद्वस्तुनोऽन्यताम् /
करोति घटवज्ज्ञानं नावरीतुं च शक्यते // 64
text_mt: And covering is being invisible, and that does not make an entity something else, / like a pot; nor can knowledge be covered. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
jñānenāvaraṇīyena tadevāvaraṇaṃ katham /
na jñāyate tathā ca syādāvṛtirnāmamātrataḥ // 65
meaning:
ज्ञानेनावरणीयेन तदेवावरणं कथम् /
न ज्ञायते तथा च स्यादावृतिर्नाममात्रतः // 65
text_mt: How could that very covering not be known by the knowledge that is to be covered? / And so covering would exist in name only. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
roddhryāśca śakteḥ kastasya pratibandhaka īśvaraḥ /
yadyapekṣāvirahitastatra prāgdattamuttaram // 66
meaning:
रोद्ध्र्याश्च शक्तेः कस्तस्य प्रतिबन्धक ईश्वरः /
यद्यपेक्षाविरहितस्तत्र प्राग्दत्तमुत्तरम् // 66
text_mt: And as for the obstructing power: who is its preventer? If it is the Lord / without dependence [on anything], the answer has already been given previously to that. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
karmasāmyamapekṣyātha tasyecchā saṃpravartate /
tasyāpi rūpaṃ vaktavyaṃ samatā karmaṇāṃ hi kā // 67
meaning:
कर्मसाम्यमपेक्ष्याथ तस्येच्छा संप्रवर्तते /
तस्यापि रूपं वक्तव्यं समता कर्मणां हि का // 67
text_mt: If His will operates in dependence on the equalization of karma, / the nature of that too must be explained; for what is the equality of karmas? // 67

sanskrit_iast:
bhogaparyāyamāhātmyātkāle kvāpi phalaṃ prati /
virodhātkarmaṇī ruddhe tiṣṭhataḥ sāmyamīdṛśam // 68
meaning:
भोगपर्यायमाहात्म्यात्काले क्वापि फलं प्रति /
विरोधात्कर्मणी रुद्धे तिष्ठतः साम्यमीदृशम् // 68
text_mt: If, by the power of the cycle of enjoyment, two karmas stand mutually blocked at some time / regarding their fruit due to conflict, such is equality. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca kālāṃśakaṃ devaḥ sarvajño vīkṣya taṃ malam /
runddhe lakṣyaḥ sa kālaśca sukhaduḥkhādivarjanaiḥ // 69
meaning:
तं च कालांशकं देवः सर्वज्ञो वीक्ष्य तं मलम् /
रुन्द्धे लक्ष्यः स कालश्च सुखदुःखादिवर्जनैः // 69
text_mt: And the omniscient God, perceiving that portion of time, blocks that impurity; / and that time is indicated by the cessation of pleasure, pain, and the rest. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
naitatkramikasaṃśuddhavyāmiśrākārakarmabhiḥ /
tathaiva deye svaphale keyamanyonyaroddhṛtā // 70
meaning:
नैतत्क्रमिकसंशुद्धव्यामिश्राकारकर्मभिः /
तथैव देये स्वफले केयमन्योन्यरोद्धृता // 70
text_mt: This is not so. When karmas that are successive, purely good, or mixed / must yield their own fruit just as they are, what is this mutual obstruction? // 70

sanskrit_iast:
rodhe tayośca jātyāyurapi na syādataḥ patet /
deho bhogadayoreva nirodha iti cennanu // 71
meaning:
रोधे तयोश्च जात्यायुरपि न स्यादतः पतेत् /
देहो भोगदयोरेव निरोध इति चेन्ननु // 71
text_mt: And if the two are obstructed, there would not even be birth and lifespan; hence the body / would fall. If it is objected that there is obstruction only of the two [karmas] giving enjoyment, surely: // 71

sanskrit_iast:
jātyāyuṣpradakarmāṃśasaṃnidhau yadi śaṃkaraḥ /
malaṃ runddhe bhogadātuḥ karmaṇaḥ kiṃ bibheti saḥ // 72
meaning:
जात्यायुष्प्रदकर्मांशसंनिधौ यदि शंकरः /
मलं रुन्द्धे भोगदातुः कर्मणः किं बिभेति सः // 72
text_mt: If Śaṃkara blocks impurity in the presence of the portion of karma that bestows birth and lifespan, / does He fear the karma that bestows enjoyment? // 72

sanskrit_iast:
śataśo'pi hlādatāpaśūnyāṃ saṃcinvate daśām /
na ca bhaktirasāveśamiti bhūmnā vilokitam // 73
meaning:
शतशोऽपि ह्लादतापशून्यां संचिन्वते दशाम् /
न च भक्तिरसावेशमिति भूम्ना विलोकितम् // 73
text_mt: Even hundreds of times, people experience a state devoid of both joy and torment, / and yet no immersion in the rasa of devotion is seen to occur frequently.

sanskrit_iast:
athāpi kālamāhātmyamapekṣya parameśvaraḥ /
tathā karoti vaktavyaṃ kālo'sau kīdṛśastviti // 74
meaning:
अथापि कालमाहात्म्यमपेक्ष्य परमेश्वरः /
तथा करोति वक्तव्यं कालोऽसौ कीदृशस्त्विति // 74
text_mt: Moreover, if the Supreme Lord acts thus in dependence upon the power of time, / it must be explained: what kind of time is this?

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ cānādirayaṃ bhogaḥ karmānādi sapudgalam /
tataśca bhogaparyāyakālaḥ sarvasya niḥsamaḥ // 75
meaning:
किं चानादिरयं भोगः कर्मानादि सपुद्गलम् /
ततश्च भोगपर्यायकालः सर्वस्य निःसमः // 75
text_mt: Furthermore, this enjoyment is beginningless; karma together with the individual soul is beginningless; / and therefore, the time of the cycle of enjoyment is unequal for everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
ādimattve hi kasyāpi vargādasmādbhavediyam /
vaicitrī bhuktametena kalpametena tu dvayam // 76
meaning:
आदिमत्त्वे हि कस्यापि वर्गादस्माद्भवेदियम् /
वैचित्री भुक्तमेतेन कल्पमेतेन तु द्वयम् // 76
text_mt: For if it had a beginning, this diversity might arise from this group: / 'A kalpa was experienced by this one, but two [kalpas] by that one;

sanskrit_iast:
iyato bhogaparyāyātsyātsāmyaṃ karmaṇāmiti /
anena nayabījena manye vaicitryakāraṇam // 77
meaning:
इयतो भोगपर्यायात्स्यात्साम्यं कर्मणामिति /
अनेन नयबीजेन मन्ये वैचित्र्यकारणम् // 77
text_mt: from such a cycle of enjoyment, an equality of karmas would arise.' / Because of this principle, I think that the cause of diversity

sanskrit_iast:
jagataḥ karma yatklaptaṃ tattathā nāvakalpate /
anādimalasaṃcchannā aṇavo dṛkkriyātmanā // 78
meaning:
जगतः कर्म यत्क्लप्तं तत्तथा नावकल्पते /
अनादिमलसंच्छन्ना अणवो दृक्क्रियात्मना // 78
text_mt: of the universe, which is assumed to be karma, is not logically tenable in that way. / Covered by beginningless impurity, souls, in their nature of vision and action,

sanskrit_iast:
sarve tulyāḥ kathaṃ citrāṃ śritāḥ karmaparamparām /
bhogalolikayā cetsā vicitreti kuto nanu // 79
meaning:
सर्वे तुल्याः कथं चित्रां श्रिताः कर्मपरम्पराम् /
भोगलोलिकया चेत्सा विचित्रेति कुतो ननु // 79
text_mt: are all equal; how did they resort to a variegated succession of karmas? / If it is said: 'through the craving for enjoyment', why, indeed, is that [craving] variegated?

sanskrit_iast:
anādi karmasaṃskāravaicitryāditi cetpunaḥ /
vācyaṃ tadeva vaicitryaṃ kuto niyatirāgayoḥ // 80
meaning:
अनादि कर्मसंस्कारवैचित्र्यादिति चेत्पुनः /
वाच्यं तदेव वैचित्र्यं कुतो नियतिरागयोः // 80
text_mt: If it is claimed that it is due to the diversity of beginningless karmic impressions, then again / it must be stated whence arises that very diversity of niyati and rāga.

sanskrit_iast:
mahimā cedayaṃ tau kiṃ nāsamañjasyabhāginau /
īśvarecchānapekṣā tu bhedaheturna kalpate // 81
meaning:
महिमा चेदयं तौ किं नासमञ्जस्यभागिनौ /
ईश्वरेच्छानपेक्षा तु भेदहेतुर्न कल्पते // 81
text_mt: If this is their intrinsic power, would they not both be subject to inconsistency? / But an explanation without reference to the will of the Lord cannot account for differentiation.

sanskrit_iast:
athānāditvamātreṇa yuktihīnena sādhyate /
vyavastheyamalaṃ tarhi malenāstu vṛthāmunā // 82
meaning:
अथानादित्वमात्रेण युक्तिहीनेन साध्यते /
व्यवस्थेयमलं तर्हि मलेनास्तु वृथामुना // 82
text_mt: Now, if this orderly arrangement is established merely by beginninglessness devoid of reasoning, / then enough of this useless impurity!

sanskrit_iast:
tathāhi karma tāvanno yāvanmāyā na pudgale /
vyāpriyeta na cāhetustadvṛttistanmito malaḥ // 83
meaning:
तथाहि कर्म तावन्नो यावन्माया न पुद्गले /
व्याप्रियेत न चाहेतुस्तद्वृत्तिस्तन्मितो मलः // 83
text_mt: To explain: karma does not exist until māyā / operates in the individual soul; and its operation is not uncaused, so impurity is assumed on that account.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ ca kalpite māyākārye karmaṇi hetutām /
anādi karma cedgacchetkiṃ malasyopakalpanam // 84
meaning:
इत्थं च कल्पिते मायाकार्ये कर्मणि हेतुताम् /
अनादि कर्म चेद्गच्छेत्किं मलस्योपकल्पनम् // 84
text_mt: And in this way, if beginningless karma should become the cause / in karma assumed to be an effect of māyā, why imagine impurity?

sanskrit_iast:
nanu mābhūnmalastarhi citrākāreṣu karmasu /
santatyāvartamāneṣu vyavasthā na prakalpate // 85
meaning:
ननु माभून्मलस्तर्हि चित्राकारेषु कर्मसु /
सन्तत्यावर्तमानेषु व्यवस्था न प्रकल्पते // 85
text_mt: Objection: let there be no impurity; but then among karmas of diverse forms / revolving continuously, an orderly arrangement cannot be established.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau madhye ca citratvātkarmaṇāṃ na yathā samaḥ /
ātmākāro'pi ko'pyeṣa bhāvikāle tathā bhavet // 86
meaning:
आदौ मध्ये च चित्रत्वात्कर्मणां न यथा समः /
आत्माकारोऽपि कोऽप्येष भाविकाले तथा भवेत् // 86
text_mt: Because karmas are diverse in the beginning and in the middle, just as there is no uniform / state of the self, so too would it be in future time.

sanskrit_iast:
itthamucchinna evāyaṃ bandhamokṣādikaḥ kramaḥ /
ajñānādbandhanaṃ mokṣo jñānāditi parīkṣitam // 87
meaning:
इत्थमुच्छिन्न एवायं बन्धमोक्षादिकः क्रमः /
अज्ञानाद्बन्धनं मोक्षो ज्ञानादिति परीक्षितम् // 87
text_mt: In this way, this order of bondage, liberation, and so forth is completely severed. / [Answer:] It has been examined that bondage is from ignorance, and liberation is from knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
virodhe svaphale caite karmaṇī samaye kvacit /
udāsāte yadi tataḥ karmaitatpratibudhyatām // 88
meaning:
विरोधे स्वफले चैते कर्मणी समये क्वचित् /
उदासाते यदि ततः कर्मैतत्प्रतिबुध्यताम् // 88
text_mt: If at some time, in opposition regarding their own fruits, these two karmas / become neutral, then let this karma be understood [as neutral].

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktinipātasya ko'vakāśastu tāvatā /
kvāpi kāle tayoretadaudāsīnyaṃ yadā tataḥ // 89
meaning:
शिवशक्तिनिपातस्य कोऽवकाशस्तु तावता /
क्वापि काले तयोरेतदौदासीन्यं यदा ततः // 89
text_mt: What room, however, is there on that account for the descent of the power of Śiva? / When at some time this neutrality occurs between the two, from that point,

sanskrit_iast:
kālāntare tayostadvadvirodhasyānivṛttitaḥ /
ataśca na phaletānte tābhyāṃ karmāntaraṇi ca // 90
meaning:
कालान्तरे तयोस्तद्वद्विरोधस्यानिवृत्तितः /
अतश्च न फलेतान्ते ताभ्यां कर्मान्तरणि च // 90
text_mt: at another time, their opposition does not cease in the same way; / and therefore at the end they would not bear fruit, and other karmas,

sanskrit_iast:
ruddhāni prāptakālatvādgatābhyāmupabhogyatām /
evaṃ sadaiva vārtāyāṃ dehapāte tathaiva ca // 91
meaning:
रुद्धानि प्राप्तकालत्वाद्गताभ्यामुपभोग्यताम् /
एवं सदैव वार्तायां देहपाते तथैव च // 91
text_mt: obstructed because their time had arrived, having become objects of experience— / this being the case continually, at the fall of the body, just in that way,

sanskrit_iast:
jāte vimokṣa ityāstāṃ śaktipātādikalpanā /
athodāsīnatatkarmadvayayogakṣaṇāntare // 92
meaning:
जाते विमोक्ष इत्यास्तां शक्तिपातादिकल्पना /
अथोदासीनतत्कर्मद्वययोगक्षणान्तरे // 92
text_mt: once liberation had arisen, let the assumption of the descent of power and so forth be abandoned! / Now, in the subsequent moment after the conjunction of those two neutral karmas,

sanskrit_iast:
karmāntaraṃ phalaṃ sūte tatkṣaṇe'pi tathā na kim /
kṣaṇāntare'tha te eva pratibandhavivarjite // 93
meaning:
कर्मान्तरं फलं सूते तत्क्षणेऽपि तथा न किम् /
क्षणान्तरेऽथ ते एव प्रतिबन्धविवर्जिते // 93
text_mt: another karma produces fruit; why not in that very moment as well? / Or if in another moment those two very [karmas], devoid of obstruction,

sanskrit_iast:
phalataḥ pratibandhasya varjanaṃ kiṃkṛtaṃ tayoḥ /
karmasāmyaṃ svarūpeṇa na ca tattāratamyabhāk // 94
meaning:
फलतः प्रतिबन्धस्य वर्जनं किंकृतं तयोः /
कर्मसाम्यं स्वरूपेण न च तत्तारतम्यभाक् // 94
text_mt: bear fruit, what caused their freedom from obstruction? / Karmic equality is intrinsic, and it does not possess gradations.

sanskrit_iast:
na śiveccheti tatkārye śaktipāte na tadbhavet /
tirobhāvaśca nāmāyaṃ sa kasmādudbhavetpunaḥ // 95
meaning:
न शिवेच्छेति तत्कार्ये शक्तिपाते न तद्भवेत् /
तिरोभावश्च नामायं स कस्मादुद्भवेत्पुनः // 95
text_mt: It is not the will of Śiva; therefore, that [will] cannot exist in its effect, the descent of power. / And this so-called concealment—from what would it arise again?

sanskrit_iast:
karmasāmyena yatkṛtyaṃ prāgevaitatkṛtaṃ kila /
hetutve ceśvarecchāyā vācyaṃ pūrvavadeva tu // 96
meaning:
कर्मसाम्येन यत्कृत्यं प्रागेवैतत्कृतं किल /
हेतुत्वे चेश्वरेच्छाया वाच्यं पूर्ववदेव तु // 96
text_mt: What was to be done through karmic equality had indeed already been done before. / And if the will of the Lord is the cause, it must be stated just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
etenānye'pi ye'pekṣyā īśecchāyāṃ prakalpitāḥ /
dhvastāste'pi hi nityānyahetvahetvādidūṣaṇāt // 97
meaning:
एतेनान्येऽपि येऽपेक्ष्या ईशेच्छायां प्रकल्पिताः /
ध्वस्तास्तेऽपि हि नित्यान्यहेत्वहेत्वादिदूषणात् // 97
text_mt: By this, other factors that have been postulated as requisites for the Lord's will / are also destroyed, due to defects such as eternal or non-eternal causes and non-causes.

sanskrit_iast:
vairāgyaṃ bhogavairasyaṃ dharmaḥ ko'pi vivekitā /
satsaṅgaḥ parameśānapūjādyabhyāsanityatā // 98
meaning:
वैराग्यं भोगवैरस्यं धर्मः कोऽपि विवेकिता /
सत्सङ्गः परमेशानपूजाद्यभ्यासनित्यता // 98
text_mt: Detachment, distaste for enjoyment, some religious merit, discriminative discernment, / association with the good, constancy in the practice of worship of the Supreme Lord and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
āpatprāptistannirīkṣā dehe kiṃcicca lakṣaṇam /
śāstrasevā bhogasaṃghapūrṇatā jñānamaiśvaram // 99
meaning:
आपत्प्राप्तिस्तन्निरीक्षा देहे किंचिच्च लक्षणम् /
शास्त्रसेवा भोगसंघपूर्णता ज्ञानमैश्वरम् // 99
text_mt: falling into calamity, inspecting it, some bodily sign, / study of scriptures, fullness of the host of enjoyments, divine knowledge—

sanskrit_iast:
ityapekṣyaṃ yadīśasya dūṣyametacca pūrvavat /
vyabhicāraśca sāmastyavyastatvābhyāṃ svarūpataḥ // 100
meaning:
इत्यपेक्ष्यं यदीशस्य दूष्यमेतच्च पूर्ववत् /
व्यभिचारश्च सामस्त्यव्यस्तत्वाभ्यां स्वरूपतः // 100
text_mt: if these are what is required by the Lord, this is refutable just as before, / and because of their inconsistency, whether taken collectively or individually in their essential nature,

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyānupraveśaścānupapattiśca bhūyasī /
tasmānna manmahe ko'yaṃ śaktipātavidheḥ kramaḥ // 101
meaning:
अन्योन्यानुप्रवेशश्चानुपपत्तिश्च भूयसी /
तस्मान्न मन्महे कोऽयं शक्तिपातविधेः क्रमः // 101
text_mt: their mutual interpenetration, and abundant logical untenability. / Therefore, we do not accept this: what is this sequential rule for the descent of power?

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ bhrāntiviṣāveśamūrcchānirmokadāyinīm /
śrīśaṃbhuvadanodgīrṇāṃ vacmyāgamamahauṣadhīm // 102
meaning:
इत्थं भ्रान्तिविषावेशमूर्च्छानिर्मोकदायिनीम् /
श्रीशंभुवदनोद्गीर्णां वच्म्यागममहौषधीम् // 102
text_mt: Thus I declare the great medicine of the scriptures, uttered from the mouth of venerable Śambhu, / which grants release from the swoon caused by the entry of the poison of delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
devaḥ svatantraścidrūpaḥ prakāśātmā svabhāvataḥ /
rūpapracchādanakrīḍāyogādaṇuranekakaḥ // 103
meaning:
देवः स्वतन्त्रश्चिद्रूपः प्रकाशात्मा स्वभावतः /
रूपप्रच्छादनक्रीडायोगादणुरनेककः // 103
text_mt: The Lord is autonomous, of the nature of consciousness, luminous by His own nature; / through connection with the play of concealing His nature, He becomes many an individual soul.

sanskrit_iast:
sa svayaṃ kalpitākāravikalpātmakakarmabhiḥ /
badhnātyātmānameveha svātantryāditi varṇitam // 104
meaning:
स स्वयं कल्पिताकारविकल्पात्मककर्मभिः /
बध्नात्यात्मानमेवेह स्वातन्त्र्यादिति वर्णितम् // 104
text_mt: Through karmas consisting of conceptual constructs whose forms are imagined by Himself, / He binds Himself alone here out of His absolute autonomy; so it has been described.

sanskrit_iast:
svātantryamahimaivāyaṃ devasya yadasau punaḥ /
svaṃ rūpaṃ pariśuddhaṃ satspṛśatyapyaṇutāmayaḥ // 105
meaning:
स्वातन्त्र्यमहिमैवायं देवस्य यदसौ पुनः /
स्वं रूपं परिशुद्धं सत्स्पृशत्यप्यणुतामयः // 105
text_mt: This is the very majesty of the Lord's absolute autonomy: that He, / though full of individuality, again touches His own nature which is utterly pure.

sanskrit_iast:
na vācyaṃ tu kathaṃ nāma kasmiṃścitpuṃsyasau tathā /
nahi nāma pumānkaścidyasminparyanuyujyate // 106
meaning:
न वाच्यं तु कथं नाम कस्मिंश्चित्पुंस्यसौ तथा /
नहि नाम पुमान्कश्चिद्यस्मिन्पर्यनुयुज्यते // 106
text_mt: It should not be asked, however: 'Why indeed [does He act] thus in a certain person?' / For there is indeed no person concerning whom a question could be raised.

sanskrit_iast:
deva eva tathāsau cet svarūpaṃ cāsya tādṛśam /
tādṛkprathāsvabhāvasya svabhāve kānuyojyatā // 107
meaning:
देव एव तथासौ चेत् स्वरूपं चास्य तादृशम् /
तादृक्प्रथास्वभावस्य स्वभावे कानुयोज्यता // 107
text_mt: If that [person] is the Lord Himself thus, and His nature is such, / what questioning can there be regarding the nature of one whose nature is such manifestation?

sanskrit_iast:
āhāsmatparameṣṭhī ca śivadṛṣṭau gurūttamaḥ /
pañcaprakārakṛtyoktiśivatvānnijakarmaṇe // 108
meaning:
आहास्मत्परमेष्ठी च शिवदृष्टौ गुरूत्तमः /
पञ्चप्रकारकृत्योक्तिशिवत्वान्निजकर्मणे // 108
text_mt: And our supreme guru, the most excellent master, said in the Śivadṛṣṭi: / 'Because of His Śiva-nature, expressed as fivefold activity, for His own action

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttasya nimittānāmapareṣāṃ kva mārgaṇam /
channasvarūpatābhāse puṃsi yadyādṛśaṃ phalam // 109
meaning:
प्रवृत्तस्य निमित्तानामपरेषां क्व मार्गणम् /
छन्नस्वरूपताभासे पुंसि यद्यादृशं फलम् // 109
text_mt: where is the search for other causes when He has engaged in it?' / In a person whose nature appears concealed, whatever kind of fruit [arises],

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāṇoḥ sata evāsti svātantryaṃ karmatohi tat /
īśvarasya ca yā svātmatirodhitsā nimittatām // 110
meaning:
तत्राणोः सत एवास्ति स्वातन्त्र्यं कर्मतोहि तत् /
ईश्वरस्य च या स्वात्मतिरोधित्सा निमित्तताम् // 110
text_mt: there exists the absolute autonomy of the soul alone, because it arises from karma; / and the Lord's desire to conceal Himself, which assumes causality,

sanskrit_iast:
sābhyeti karmamalayorato'nādivyavasthitiḥ /
tirodhiḥ pūrṇarūpasyāpūrṇatvaṃ tacca pūraṇam // 111
meaning:
साभ्येति कर्ममलयोरतोऽनादिव्यवस्थितिः /
तिरोधिः पूर्णरूपस्यापूर्णत्वं तच्च पूरणम् // 111
text_mt: attains the status of karma and impurity; hence the beginningless orderly arrangement. / Concealment is the incompleteness of that which has a complete nature, and that fullness [becomes limited]

sanskrit_iast:
prati bhinnena bhāvena spṛhāto lolikā malaḥ /
viśuddhasvaprakāśātmaśivarūpatayā vinā // 112
meaning:
प्रति भिन्नेन भावेन स्पृहातो लोलिका मलः /
विशुद्धस्वप्रकाशात्मशिवरूपतया विना // 112
text_mt: towards differentiated entities through desire; therefore, craving is impurity. / Without the form of Śiva, whose nature is pure self-luminosity,

sanskrit_iast:
na kiṃcidyujyate tena heturatra maheśvaraḥ /
itthaṃ sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsatraye māyāmapekṣate // 113
meaning:
न किंचिद्युज्यते तेन हेतुरत्र महेश्वरः /
इत्थं सृष्टिस्थितिध्वंसत्रये मायामपेक्षते // 113
text_mt: nothing is possible; therefore, the Great Lord is the cause in this case. / In this way, with regard to the triad of emission, maintenance, and destruction, He relies on māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtyai malaṃ tathā karma śivecchaiveti susthitam /
yattu kasmiṃścana śivaḥ svena rūpeṇa bhāsate // 114
meaning:
कृत्यै मलं तथा कर्म शिवेच्छैवेति सुस्थितम् /
यत्तु कस्मिंश्चन शिवः स्वेन रूपेण भासते // 114
text_mt: and for His activities, upon impurity and karma—thus it is well established that it is solely Śiva's will. / But that Śiva shines in His own nature in a certain person—

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsya nāṇuge tāvadapekṣye malakarmaṇī /
aṇusvarūpatāhānau tadgataṃ hetutāṃ katham // 115
meaning:
तत्रास्य नाणुगे तावदपेक्ष्ये मलकर्मणी /
अणुस्वरूपताहानौ तद्गतं हेतुतां कथम् // 115
text_mt: in that case, His impurity and karma belonging to the individual soul are not to be depended upon at all; / when the individual soul's nature is destroyed, how could that which belongs to it become a cause?

sanskrit_iast:
vrajenmāyānapekṣatvamata evopapādayet /
tena śuddhaḥ svaprakāśaḥ śiva evātra kāraṇam // 116
meaning:
व्रजेन्मायानपेक्षत्वमत एवोपपादयेत् /
तेन शुद्धः स्वप्रकाशः शिव एवात्र कारणम् // 116
text_mt: Hence, He would demonstrate independence from māyā. / Therefore, pure, self-luminous Śiva alone is the cause in this matter.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca svācchandyamātreṇa tāratamyaprakāśakaḥ /
kulajātivapuṣkarmavayonuṣṭhānasaṃpadaḥ // 117
meaning:
स च स्वाच्छन्द्यमात्रेण तारतम्यप्रकाशकः /
कुलजातिवपुष्कर्मवयोनुष्ठानसंपदः // 117
text_mt: And He, merely through His absolute freedom, manifests gradations [of that descent]. / Without dependence upon clan, caste, body, karma, age, or wealth of ritual performance,

sanskrit_iast:
anapekṣya śive bhaktiḥ śaktipāto'phalārthinām /
yā phalārthitayā bhaktiḥ sā karmādyamapekṣate // 118
meaning:
अनपेक्ष्य शिवे भक्तिः शक्तिपातोऽफलार्थिनाम् /
या फलार्थितया भक्तिः सा कर्माद्यमपेक्षते // 118
text_mt: devotion to Śiva is the descent of power for those who do not desire fruit. / That devotion which has desire for fruit depends upon karma and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
tato'tra syātphale bhedo nāpavarge tvasau tathā /
bhogāpavargadvitayābhisaṃdhāturapi sphuṭam // 119
meaning:
ततोऽत्र स्यात्फले भेदो नापवर्गे त्वसौ तथा /
भोगापवर्गद्वितयाभिसंधातुरपि स्फुटम् // 119
text_mt: therefore, there may be difference in fruit in that case, but not so in liberation, / clearly even for one who aims at both enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgbhāge'pekṣate karma citratvānnottare punaḥ /
anābhāsitarūpo'pi tadābhāsitayeva yat // 120
meaning:
प्राग्भागेऽपेक्षते कर्म चित्रत्वान्नोत्तरे पुनः /
अनाभासितरूपोऽपि तदाभासितयेव यत् // 120
text_mt: Karma depends on it in the prior stage, but due to variety not in the subsequent stage; / because even one whose nature is not manifested appears as though manifested by it. // 120

sanskrit_iast:
sthitvā mantrādi saṃgṛhya tyajetso'sya tirobhavaḥ /
śrīsāraśāstre bhagavānvastvetatsamabhāṣata // 121
meaning:
स्थित्वा मन्त्रादि संगृह्य त्यजेत्सोऽस्य तिरोभवः /
श्रीसारशास्त्रे भगवान्वस्त्वेतत्समभाषत // 121
text_mt: Remaining [in worldly existence], grasping mantra and the rest, he may abandon it: this is his concealment. / In the venerable Sāraśāstra, the Lord explained this reality:

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādharmātmakairbhāvairanekairveṣṭayetsvayam /
asandehaṃ svamātmānamavīcyādiśivāntake // 122
meaning:
धर्माधर्मात्मकैर्भावैरनेकैर्वेष्टयेत्स्वयम् /
असन्देहं स्वमात्मानमवीच्यादिशिवान्तके // 122
text_mt: "He envelops Himself, undoubtedly, with manifold states / consisting of merit and demerit, extending from Avīci up to Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvacchaktisamūhena sa eva tu viveṣṭayet /
svayaṃ badhnāti deveśaḥ svayaṃ caiva vimuñcati // 123
meaning:
तद्वच्छक्तिसमूहेन स एव तु विवेष्टयेत् /
स्वयं बध्नाति देवेशः स्वयं चैव विमुञ्चति // 123
text_mt: In the same way, He alone indeed envelops Himself with the host of powers; / the Lord of gods binds Himself, and He alone liberates Himself.

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ bhoktā svayaṃ jñātā svayaṃ caivopalakṣayet /
svayaṃ bhuktiśca muktiśca svayaṃ devī svayaṃ prabhuḥ // 124
meaning:
स्वयं भोक्ता स्वयं ज्ञाता स्वयं चैवोपलक्षयेत् /
स्वयं भुक्तिश्च मुक्तिश्च स्वयं देवी स्वयं प्रभुः // 124
text_mt: He alone is the enjoyer, He alone the knower, and He alone observes; / He alone is enjoyment and liberation, He alone the Goddess, He alone the Lord.

sanskrit_iast:
svayamekākṣarā caiva yathoṣmā kṛṣṇavartmanaḥ /
vastūktamatra svātantryātsvātmarūpaprakāśanam // 125
meaning:
स्वयमेकाक्षरा चैव यथोष्मा कृष्णवर्त्मनः /
वस्तूक्तमत्र स्वातन्त्र्यात्स्वात्मरूपप्रकाशनम् // 125
text_mt: And She is inherently monosyllabic, just like the heat of fire." / What is stated here as reality is the illumination of one's own nature through absolute autonomy.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanniśākule'pyuktaṃ mithyābhāvitacetasaḥ /
malamāyāvicāreṇa kliśyante svalpabuddhayaḥ // 126
meaning:
श्रीमन्निशाकुलेऽप्युक्तं मिथ्याभावितचेतसः /
मलमायाविचारेण क्लिश्यन्ते स्वल्पबुद्धयः // 126
text_mt: In the venerable Niśākula it is also stated: "Those whose minds are falsely conditioned, / being of little intelligence, suffer through the consideration of impurity and māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
sphaṭikopalago reṇuḥ kiṃ tasya kurutāṃ priye /
vyomnīva nīlaṃ hi malaṃ malaśaṃkāṃ tatastyajet // 127
meaning:
स्फटिकोपलगो रेणुः किं तस्य कुरुतां प्रिये /
व्योम्नीव नीलं हि मलं मलशंकां ततस्त्यजेत् // 127
text_mt: O dear one, what does the dust on a crystal stone do to it? / For impurity is like blueness in the sky; therefore one should abandon the fear of impurity."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmānvidyāguruścāha pramāṇastutidarśane /
dharmādharmavyāptivināśāntarakāle śakteḥ pāto gāhanikairyaḥ pratipannaḥ // 128
meaning:
श्रीमान्विद्यागुरुश्चाह प्रमाणस्तुतिदर्शने /
धर्माधर्मव्याप्तिविनाशान्तरकाले शक्तेः पातो गाहनिकैर्यः प्रतिपन्नः // 128
text_mt: And the venerable Vidyāguru said in the Pramāṇastutidarśana: / "The descent of power that is accepted by the profound thinkers at the time following the destruction of the pervasion of merit and demerit—

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ svecchātaḥ saṃgiramāṇāḥ stavakādyāḥ svātantryaṃ tattvayyanapekṣaṃ kathayeyuḥ /
tāratamyaprakāśo yastīvramadhyamamandatāḥ // 129
meaning:
तं स्वेच्छातः संगिरमाणाः स्तवकाद्याः स्वातन्त्र्यं तत्त्वय्यनपेक्षं कथयेयुः /
तारतम्यप्रकाशो यस्तीव्रमध्यममन्दताः // 129
text_mt: those such as praise-singers, proclaiming it according to their own wish, / would describe that as an absolute autonomy in You that is independent [of conditions]." / As for the degrees of manifestation—intense, middling, and mild—

sanskrit_iast:
tā eva śaktipātasya pratyekaṃ traidhamāsthitāḥ /
tīvratīvraḥ śaktipāto dehapātavaśātsvayam // 130
meaning:
ता एव शक्तिपातस्य प्रत्येकं त्रैधमास्थिताः /
तीव्रतीव्रः शक्तिपातो देहपातवशात्स्वयम् // 130
text_mt: these threefold states belong individually to the descent of power. / An intensely intense descent of power, through the fall of the body, spontaneously

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣapradastadaivānyakāle vā tāratamyataḥ /
madhyatīvrātpunaḥ sarvamajñānaṃ vinivartate // 131
meaning:
मोक्षप्रदस्तदैवान्यकाले वा तारतम्यतः /
मध्यतीव्रात्पुनः सर्वमज्ञानं विनिवर्तते // 131
text_mt: bestows liberation at that very moment, or at another time according to degrees. / From the middling-intense, moreover, all ignorance turns away,

sanskrit_iast:
svayameva yato vetti bandhamokṣatayātmatām /
tatprātibhaṃ mahājñānaṃ śāstrācāryānapekṣi yat. // 132
meaning:
स्वयमेव यतो वेत्ति बन्धमोक्षतयात्मताम् /
तत्प्रातिभं महाज्ञानं शास्त्राचार्यानपेक्षि यत्. // 132
text_mt: since by oneself alone one knows the selfhood consisting of bondage and liberation. / That is the great intuitive knowledge that does not depend on scripture or master.

sanskrit_iast:
pratibhācandrikāśāntadhvāntaścācāryacandramāḥ /
tamastāpau hanti dṛśaṃ visphāryānandanirbharām // 133
meaning:
प्रतिभाचन्द्रिकाशान्तध्वान्तश्चाचार्यचन्द्रमाः /
तमस्तापौ हन्ति दृशं विस्फार्यानन्दनिर्भराम् // 133
text_mt: And the moon-like master, whose darkness has been stilled by the moonlight of intuitive flash, / dispels darkness and torment, opening wide a vision overflowing with bliss.

sanskrit_iast:
sa śiṣṭaḥ karmakartṛtvācchiṣyo'nyaḥ karmabhāvataḥ /
śiṣṭaḥ sarvatra ca smārtapadakālakulādiṣu // 134
meaning:
स शिष्टः कर्मकर्तृत्वाच्छिष्योऽन्यः कर्मभावतः /
शिष्टः सर्वत्र च स्मार्तपदकालकुलादिषु // 134
text_mt: He is the instructed master (śiṣṭa) through his role as agent of action; the other is the disciple (śiṣya) through his role as object of action. / And the instructed master is [recognised] everywhere in traditional law, prosody, astrology, Kula, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ śāstrārthapratibhāpariniṣṭhitaḥ /
yanmūlaṃ śāsanaṃ tena na riktaḥ ko'pi jantukaḥ // 135
meaning:
उक्तः स्वयंभूः शास्त्रार्थप्रतिभापरिनिष्ठितः /
यन्मूलं शासनं तेन न रिक्तः कोऽपि जन्तुकः // 135
text_mt: He is called self-born (svayaṃbhū), established in the intuitive flash of scriptural meaning. / Because teaching has that as its root, no living being is destitute [of it].

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi tāratamyotthamānantyaṃ dārḍhyakamprate /
yuktiḥ śāstraṃ gururvādo'bhyāsa ityādyapekṣate // 136
meaning:
तत्रापि तारतम्योत्थमानन्त्यं दार्ढ्यकम्प्रते /
युक्तिः शास्त्रं गुरुर्वादोऽभ्यास इत्याद्यपेक्षते // 136
text_mt: There too, an infinity arises from degrees of difference, regarding firmness and wavering; / [one] requires reasoning, scripture, a guru, debate, practice, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kampamānaṃ hi vijñānaṃ svayameva punarvrajet /
kasyāpi dārḍhyamanyasya yuktyādyaiḥ kevaletaraiḥ // 137
meaning:
कम्पमानं हि विज्ञानं स्वयमेव पुनर्व्रजेत् /
कस्यापि दार्ढ्यमन्यस्य युक्त्याद्यैः केवलेतरैः // 137
text_mt: For wavering knowledge may indeed spontaneously regain / firmness for someone; for another, only through reasoning and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yathā parāpekṣātānavaṃ prātibhe bhavet /
tathā tathā gururasau śreṣṭho vijñānapāragaḥ // 138
meaning:
यथा यथा परापेक्षातानवं प्रातिभे भवेत् /
तथा तथा गुरुरसौ श्रेष्ठो विज्ञानपारगः // 138
text_mt: To the extent that there is diminution of dependence on others in what is intuitive, / to that extent is this guru supreme, having crossed to the further shore of knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
anyataḥ śikṣitānantajñāno'pi pratibhābalāt /
yadvetti tatra tatrāsya śivatā jyāyasī ca sā // 139
meaning:
अन्यतः शिक्षितानन्तज्ञानोऽपि प्रतिभाबलात् /
यद्वेत्ति तत्र तत्रास्य शिवता ज्यायसी च सा // 139
text_mt: Even if infinite knowledge is learned from another, that which he knows / by the power of intuitive flash—in that and that respect, his Śivahood is superior.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāsya samayitvādikramo nāpyabhiṣecanam /
na santānādi no vidyāvrataṃ prātibhavartmanaḥ // 140
meaning:
न चास्य समयित्वादिक्रमो नाप्यभिषेचनम् /
न सन्तानादि नो विद्याव्रतं प्रातिभवर्त्मनः // 140
text_mt: And for him there is no progression of being an initiate into the rule and so forth, nor consecration; / there is no lineage and the like, nor vow of knowledge, for one on the intuitive path.

sanskrit_iast:
ādividvānmahādevastenaiṣo'dhiṣṭhito yataḥ /
saṃskārāstadadhiṣṭhānasiddhyai tattasya tu svataḥ // 141
meaning:
आदिविद्वान्महादेवस्तेनैषोऽधिष्ठितो यतः /
संस्कारास्तदधिष्ठानसिद्ध्यै तत्तस्य तु स्वतः // 141
text_mt: Because he is presided over by the primordial knower, the Great God Himself; / the purificatory rites are for the attainment of that presiding [grace], but that belongs to him naturally.

sanskrit_iast:
devībhirdīkṣitastena sabhaktiḥ śivaśāsane /
dṛḍhatākampratābhedaiḥ so'pi svayamatha vratāt // 142
meaning:
देवीभिर्दीक्षितस्तेन सभक्तिः शिवशासने /
दृढताकम्प्रताभेदैः सोऽपि स्वयमथ व्रतात् // 142
text_mt: Therefore, initiated by the Goddesses, he is devoted to the teaching of Śiva. / Even he, according to the distinctions of firmness and wavering, spontaneously or from a vow,

sanskrit_iast:
tapojapādergurutaḥ svasaṃskāraṃ prakalpayet /
yato vājasineyākhya uktaṃ siñcetsvayaṃ tanum // 143
meaning:
तपोजपादेर्गुरुतः स्वसंस्कारं प्रकल्पयेत् /
यतो वाजसिनेयाख्य उक्तं सिञ्चेत्स्वयं तनुम् // 143
text_mt: from ascetic practice, recitation, and so forth, or from a guru, may arrange his own purification; / for in the text called Vājasineya it is said: "One should sprinkle one's own body."

sanskrit_iast:
ityādyupakramaṃ yāvadante tatpariniṣṭhitam /
abhiṣikto bhavedevaṃ na bāhyakalaśāmbubhiḥ // 144
meaning:
इत्याद्युपक्रमं यावदन्ते तत्परिनिष्ठितम् /
अभिषिक्तो भवेदेवं न बाह्यकलशाम्बुभिः // 144
text_mt: Beginning with such [rites], culminating in what is fully accomplished at the end, / one becomes consecrated in this manner, not by external waters of a pot.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsarvavīraśrībrahmayāmalādau ca tattathā /
nirūpitaṃ maheśena kiyadvā likhyatāmidam // 145
meaning:
श्रीसर्ववीरश्रीब्रह्मयामलादौ च तत्तथा /
निरूपितं महेशेन कियद्वा लिख्यतामिदम् // 145
text_mt: And in the venerable Sarvavīra, the venerable Brahmayāmala, and other texts, it is likewise / determined by the Great Lord; how much of this can be written down?

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ prātibhavijñānaṃ kiṃ kiṃ kasya na sādhayet /
yatprātibhādvā sarvaṃ cetyūce śeṣamahāmuniḥ // 146
meaning:
इत्थं प्रातिभविज्ञानं किं किं कस्य न साधयेत् /
यत्प्रातिभाद्वा सर्वं चेत्यूचे शेषमहामुनिः // 146
text_mt: In this way, what could intuitive knowledge not accomplish, and for whom? / As the great sage Śeṣa said: "Or from the intuitive flash, everything."

sanskrit_iast:
anye tvāhurakāmasya prātibho gururīdṛśaḥ /
sāmagrījanyatā kāmye tenārimansaṃskṛto guruḥ // 147
meaning:
अन्ये त्वाहुरकामस्य प्रातिभो गुरुरीदृशः /
सामग्रीजन्यता काम्ये तेनारिमन्संस्कृतो गुरुः // 147
text_mt: Others, however, say: such an intuitive guru belongs [only] to one free of desires; / for a desire-prompted [goal], there is dependence on the totality of causes, and therefore in this [case] an initiated guru [is needed].

sanskrit_iast:
niyatermahimā naiva phale sādhye nivartate /
abhiṣiktaścīrṇavidyāvratastena phalapradaḥ // 148
meaning:
नियतेर्महिमा नैव फले साध्ये निवर्तते /
अभिषिक्तश्चीर्णविद्याव्रतस्तेन फलप्रदः // 148
text_mt: The majesty of the cosmic order (niyati) does not cease when a result is to be accomplished; / therefore, one who is consecrated and has observed the vow of knowledge is the bestower of results.

sanskrit_iast:
asadetaditi prāhurguravastattvadarśinaḥ /
śrīsomānandakalyāṇabhavabhūtipurogamāḥ // 149
meaning:
असदेतदिति प्राहुर्गुरवस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः /
श्रीसोमानन्दकल्याणभवभूतिपुरोगमाः // 149
text_mt: The gurus who perceive the truth, led by the venerable Somānanda, / Kalyāṇa, and Bhavabhūti, have declared: "This is untrue."

sanskrit_iast:
tathāhi trīśikāśāstravivṛtau te'bhyadhurbudhāḥ /
sāṃsiddhikaṃ yadvijñānaṃ taccintāratnamucyate // 150
meaning:
तथाहि त्रीशिकाशास्त्रविवृतौ तेऽभ्यधुर्बुधाः /
सांसिद्धिकं यद्विज्ञानं तच्चिन्तारत्नमुच्यते // 150
text_mt: For thus those wise ones explained in the commentary on the Trīśikā treatise: / "That knowledge which is innate is called the wish-fulfilling jewel;

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāve tadarthaṃ tadāhṛtaṃ jñānamādṛtam /
evaṃ yo veda tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī // 151
meaning:
तदभावे तदर्थं तदाहृतं ज्ञानमादृतम् /
एवं यो वेद तत्त्वेन तस्य निर्वाणगामिनी // 151
text_mt: in its absence, knowledge acquired for its sake is respected. / Whoever knows thus in truth, for him there is an initiation

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣā bhavatyasandigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā /
adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kaścidvetti tattvataḥ // 152
meaning:
दीक्षा भवत्यसन्दिग्धा तिलाज्याहुतिवर्जिता /
अदृष्टमण्डलोऽप्येवं यः कश्चिद्वेत्ति तत्त्वतः // 152
text_mt: that leads to liberation, undoubted, devoid of oblations of sesame and ghee. / Even one who has not seen the maṇḍala, who knows thus in truth,

sanskrit_iast:
sa siddhibhāgbhavennityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣitaḥ /
avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati // 153
meaning:
स सिद्धिभाग्भवेन्नित्यं स योगी स च दीक्षितः /
अविधिज्ञो विधानज्ञो जायते यजनं प्रति // 153
text_mt: always shares in spiritual accomplishment; he is a yogin and he is initiated. / One ignorant of rules becomes a knower of rules with respect to worship."

sanskrit_iast:
ityādibhistrīśikoktairvākyairmāheśvaraiḥ sphuṭam /
jñānaṃ dīkṣādisaṃskārasatattvamiti varṇitam // 154
meaning:
इत्यादिभिस्त्रीशिकोक्तैर्वाक्यैर्माहेश्वरैः स्फुटम् /
ज्ञानं दीक्षादिसंस्कारसतत्त्वमिति वर्णितम् // 154
text_mt: By such statements spoken in the Trīśikā, uttered by the Great Lord, it is clearly / described that knowledge is the true reality of the purificatory rites such as initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānopāyastu dīkṣādikriyā jñānaviyoginām /
ityetadadhunaivāstā svaprastāve bhaviṣyati // 155
meaning:
ज्ञानोपायस्तु दीक्षादिक्रिया ज्ञानवियोगिनाम् /
इत्येतदधुनैवास्ता स्वप्रस्तावे भविष्यति // 155
text_mt: Action such as initiation, on the other hand, is a means to knowledge for those devoid of knowledge. / Let this stand for now; it will be treated in its proper occasion.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśāstrapramāṇāderapyupāyatvamaṃjasā /
pratibhā paramevaiṣā sarvakāmadughā yataḥ // 156
meaning:
गुरुशास्त्रप्रमाणादेरप्युपायत्वमंजसा /
प्रतिभा परमेवैषा सर्वकामदुघा यतः // 156
text_mt: Even the fact that the guru, scriptures, pramāṇa, and the rest are means is straight away [due to this]; / for this intuitive flash is the supreme cow that yields all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
upāyayogakramato nirupāyamathākramam /
yadrūpaṃ tatparaṃ tattvaṃ tatra tatra suniścitam // 157
meaning:
उपाययोगक्रमतो निरुपायमथाक्रमम् /
यद्रूपं तत्परं तत्त्वं तत्र तत्र सुनिश्चितम् // 157
text_mt: Whether that supreme reality is without means through the succession of yoga using means, / or non-successive, it is well ascertained in each case.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu prātibhabāhyātmasaṃskāradvayasundaraḥ /
ukto'nanyopakāryatvātsa sākṣādvarado guruḥ // 158
meaning:
यस्तु प्रातिभबाह्यात्मसंस्कारद्वयसुन्दरः /
उक्तोऽनन्योपकार्यत्वात्स साक्षाद्वरदो गुरुः // 158
text_mt: He, however, who is adorned with the two purifications—intuitive and external-internal—/ is declared to be the guru who directly bestows boons, because he cannot be benefited by another.

sanskrit_iast:
svamuktimātre kasyāpi yāvadviśvavimocane /
pratibhodeti khadyotaratnatārendusūryavat // 159
meaning:
स्वमुक्तिमात्रे कस्यापि यावद्विश्वविमोचने /
प्रतिभोदेति खद्योतरत्नतारेन्दुसूर्यवत् // 159
text_mt: For someone, intuition arises merely for his own liberation; for another, up to the liberation of the universe, / like a firefly, a jewel, a star, the moon, or the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prātibhasaṃvittyai śāstramasmatkṛtaṃ tvidam /
yo'bhyasyetsa gururnaiva vastvarthā hi viḍambakāḥ // 160
meaning:
ततः प्रातिभसंवित्त्यै शास्त्रमस्मत्कृतं त्विदम् /
योऽभ्यस्येत्स गुरुर्नैव वस्त्वर्था हि विडम्बकाः // 160
text_mt: Therefore, whoever studies this treatise composed by us for the sake of intuitive consciousness / is a guru, not those who are pretenders regarding the true purpose.

sanskrit_iast:
paropajīvitābuddhyā sarva itthaṃ na bhāsate /
taduktyā na vinā vetti śaktipātasya māndyataḥ // 161
meaning:
परोपजीविताबुद्ध्या सर्व इत्थं न भासते /
तदुक्त्या न विना वेत्ति शक्तिपातस्य मान्द्यतः // 161
text_mt: Because of the mentality of relying on others, not everything shines forth in this way; / without his instruction, one does not know, due to the sluggishness of the descent of power.

sanskrit_iast:
sphuṭametacca śāstreṣu teṣu teṣu nirūpyate /
kiraṇāyāṃ tathoktaṃ ca gurutaḥ śāstrataḥ svataḥ // 162
meaning:
स्फुटमेतच्च शास्त्रेषु तेषु तेषु निरूप्यते /
किरणायां तथोक्तं च गुरुतः शास्त्रतः स्वतः // 162
text_mt: And this is clearly set forth in various scriptures. / In the Kiraṇa it is likewise stated: "From the guru, from scripture, and from oneself."

sanskrit_iast:
jñānayogyāstathā keciccaryāyogyāstathāpare /
śrīmannandiśikhātantre vitatyaitannirūpitam // 163
meaning:
ज्ञानयोग्यास्तथा केचिच्चर्यायोग्यास्तथापरे /
श्रीमन्नन्दिशिखातन्त्रे वितत्यैतन्निरूपितम् // 163
text_mt: Likewise, some are fit for knowledge, and others are fit for ritual conduct; / this has been set forth at length in the venerable Nandiśikhātantra.

sanskrit_iast:
praśnottaramukheneti tadabhagnaṃ nirūpyate /
anirdeśyaḥ śivastatra ko'bhyupāyo nirūpyatām // 164
meaning:
प्रश्नोत्तरमुखेनेति तदभग्नं निरूप्यते /
अनिर्देश्यः शिवस्तत्र कोऽभ्युपायो निरूप्यताम् // 164
text_mt: It is set forth there unbroken by way of question and answer: / "Śiva is indescribable; in that regard, let the means be explained."

sanskrit_iast:
iti praśne kṛte devyā śrīmāñchaṃbhurnyarūpayam /
upāyo'tra vivekaikaḥ sa hi heyaṃ vihāpayan // 165
meaning:
इति प्रश्ने कृते देव्या श्रीमाञ्छंभुर्न्यरूपयम् /
उपायोऽत्र विवेकैकः स हि हेयं विहापयन् // 165
text_mt: When this question was posed by the Goddess, the venerable Śambhu explained: / "The unique means here is discernment alone, for it, causing what is to be abandoned to be discarded,

sanskrit_iast:
dadātyasya ca suśroṇi prātibhaṃ jñānamuttamam /
yadā pratibhayā yuktastadā muktaśca mocayet // 166
meaning:
ददात्यस्य च सुश्रोणि प्रातिभं ज्ञानमुत्तमम् /
यदा प्रतिभया युक्तस्तदा मुक्तश्च मोचयेत् // 166
text_mt: And it gives to him, O fair-hipped one, supreme intuitive knowledge. / When endowed with the intuitive flash, then, being liberated, he can liberate [others].

sanskrit_iast:
paraśaktinipātena dhvastamāyāmalaḥ pumān /
nanu prāgdīkṣayā mokṣo'dhunā tu prātibhātkatham // 167
meaning:
परशक्तिनिपातेन ध्वस्तमायामलः पुमान् /
ननु प्राग्दीक्षया मोक्षोऽधुना तु प्रातिभात्कथम् // 167
text_mt: [Such] a person has the impurity of māyā destroyed by the descent of the supreme power. / [The Goddess asks:] 'Surely liberation was previously said to come from initiation; how now does it come from intuitive [knowledge]?'

sanskrit_iast:
iti devyā kṛte praśne prāvartata vibhorvacaḥ /
dīkṣayā mucyate jantuḥ prātibhena tathā priye // 168
meaning:
इति देव्या कृते प्रश्ने प्रावर्तत विभोर्वचः /
दीक्षया मुच्यते जन्तुः प्रातिभेन तथा प्रिये // 168
text_mt: When this question was posed by the Goddess, the speech of the All-Pervading Lord commenced: / 'A living creature is liberated through initiation, and likewise through intuitive [knowledge], O beloved.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvāyattā tu sā dīkṣā badhyabandhanamokṣaṇe /
prātibho'sya svabhāvastu kevalībhāvasiddhidaḥ // 169
meaning:
गुर्वायत्ता तु सा दीक्षा बध्यबन्धनमोक्षणे /
प्रातिभोऽस्य स्वभावस्तु केवलीभावसिद्धिदः // 169
text_mt: That initiation, however, depends on a guru for releasing the bound one from bondage, / but intuitive [knowledge] is one's own nature, bestowing the accomplishment of the state of absolute isolation.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalasya dhruvaṃ muktiḥ paratattvena sā nanu /
nṛśaktiśivamuktaṃ hi tattvatrayamidaṃ tvayā // 170
meaning:
केवलस्य ध्रुवं मुक्तिः परतत्त्वेन सा ननु /
नृशक्तिशिवमुक्तं हि तत्त्वत्रयमिदं त्वया // 170
text_mt: Surely the liberation of the isolated one is firmly [established] through the supreme reality; / for this triad of principles—man, power, and Śiva—has indeed been spoken by you.

sanskrit_iast:
nā badhyo bandhane śaktiḥ karaṇaṃ kartṛtāṃ spṛśat /
śivaḥ karteti tatproktaṃ sarvaṃ gurvāgamādaṇoḥ // 171
meaning:
ना बध्यो बन्धने शक्तिः करणं कर्तृतां स्पृशत् /
शिवः कर्तेति तत्प्रोक्तं सर्वं गुर्वागमादणोः // 171
text_mt: Man is bound in bondage; power is the instrument touching agency; / Śiva is the agent: all this has been declared from the guru's transmission to the bound soul.

sanskrit_iast:
punarvivekāduktaṃ taduttarottaramucyatām /
kathaṃ vivekaḥ kiṃ vāsya devadeva vivicyate // 172
meaning:
पुनर्विवेकादुक्तं तदुत्तरोत्तरमुच्यताम् /
कथं विवेकः किं वास्य देवदेव विविच्यते // 172
text_mt: Again, it was stated [to arise] from discernment; let what is further and further beyond be told: / How does discernment arise, or what of him is discerned, O God of gods?'

sanskrit_iast:
ityukte parameśānyā jagādādiguruḥ śivaḥ /
śivāditattvatritayaṃ tadāgamavaśādguroḥ // 173
meaning:
इत्युक्ते परमेशान्या जगादादिगुरुः शिवः /
शिवादितत्त्वत्रितयं तदागमवशाद्गुरोः // 173
text_mt: When this was spoken by the Supreme Mistress, Śiva, the primordial guru, declared: / 'The triad of principles beginning with Śiva, established through the transmission of that guru,

sanskrit_iast:
adhrottaragairvākyaiḥ siddhaṃ prātibhatāṃ vrajet /
dīkṣāsicchinnapāśatvādbhāvanābhāvitasya hi // 174
meaning:
अध्रोत्तरगैर्वाक्यैः सिद्धं प्रातिभतां व्रजेत् /
दीक्षासिच्छिन्नपाशत्वाद्भावनाभावितस्य हि // 174
text_mt: through statements relating to lower and higher, attains intuitive nature. / For of one cultivated through contemplation, whose bonds are severed by the sword of initiation,

sanskrit_iast:
vikāsaṃ tattvamāyāti prātibhaṃ tadudāhṛtam /
bhasmacchannāgnivatsphauṭyaṃ prātibhe gauravāgamāt // 175
meaning:
विकासं तत्त्वमायाति प्रातिभं तदुदाहृतम् /
भस्मच्छन्नाग्निवत्स्फौट्यं प्रातिभे गौरवागमात् // 175
text_mt: the reality comes to expansion; that is declared to be intuitive [knowledge]. / Like fire covered by ashes, clarity in intuitive [knowledge] arises from the guru's transmission.

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ kāloptasaṃsiktaṃ yathā vardheta tattathā /
yogayāgajapairuktairguruṇā prātibhaṃ sphuṭet // 176
meaning:
बीजं कालोप्तसंसिक्तं यथा वर्धेत तत्तथा /
योगयागजपैरुक्तैर्गुरुणा प्रातिभं स्फुटेत् // 176
text_mt: Just as a seed sown and watered in proper season will grow, even so / intuitive [knowledge] bursts forth through yoga, sacrifice, and recitation taught by the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
viveko'tīndriyastveṣa yadāyāti vivecanam /
paśupāśapatijñānaṃ svayaṃ nirbhāsate tadā // 177
meaning:
विवेकोऽतीन्द्रियस्त्वेष यदायाति विवेचनम् /
पशुपाशपतिज्ञानं स्वयं निर्भासते तदा // 177
text_mt: When this discernment, which is beyond the senses, comes to realization, / then the knowledge of the bound soul, the bond, and the Lord shines forth of itself.

sanskrit_iast:
prātibhe tu samāyāte jñānamanyattu sendriyam /
vāgakṣiśrutigamyaṃ cāpyanyāpekṣaṃ varānane // 178
meaning:
प्रातिभे तु समायाते ज्ञानमन्यत्तु सेन्द्रियम् /
वागक्षिश्रुतिगम्यं चाप्यन्यापेक्षं वरानने // 178
text_mt: When intuitive [knowledge] has arisen, other knowledge involving the senses, / accessible through speech, eye, and ear, and dependent on other [factors], O fair-faced one,

sanskrit_iast:
tattyajedbuddhimāsthāya pradīpaṃ tu yathā divā /
prādurbhūtavivekasya syāccidindriyagocare // 179
meaning:
तत्त्यजेद्बुद्धिमास्थाय प्रदीपं तु यथा दिवा /
प्रादुर्भूतविवेकस्य स्याच्चिदिन्द्रियगोचरे // 179
text_mt: one should abandon, having relied on intellect, just like a lamp by day. / For one in whom discernment has manifested, within the domain of consciousness and the senses

sanskrit_iast:
dūrācchrutyādivedhādivṛddhikrīḍāvicitritā /
sarvabhāvavivekāttu sarvabhāvaparāṅmukhaḥ // 180
meaning:
दूराच्छ्रुत्यादिवेधादिवृद्धिक्रीडाविचित्रिता /
सर्वभावविवेकात्तु सर्वभावपराङ्मुखः // 180
text_mt: [such abilities as] hearing from afar, piercing, and other powers may appear, variegated with playful display; / yet from discernment of all existents, turning away from all existents,

sanskrit_iast:
krīḍāsu suviraktātmā śivabhāvaikabhāvitaḥ /
māhātmyametatsuśroṇi prātibhasya vidhīyate // 181
meaning:
क्रीडासु सुविरक्तात्मा शिवभावैकभावितः /
माहात्म्यमेतत्सुश्रोणि प्रातिभस्य विधीयते // 181
text_mt: his self entirely detached from playful displays, cultivated solely in the state of Śiva— / this, O fair-hipped one, is proclaimed to be the majesty of intuitive [knowledge].

sanskrit_iast:
svacchāyādarśavatpaśyedbahirantargataṃ śivam /
heyopādeyatattvajñastadā dhyāyennijāṃ citim // 182
meaning:
स्वच्छायादर्शवत्पश्येद्बहिरन्तर्गतं शिवम् /
हेयोपादेयतत्त्वज्ञस्तदा ध्यायेन्निजां चितिम् // 182
text_mt: Like one's reflection in a mirror, he sees Śiva existing inside and outside; / knowing the reality of what is to be avoided and what is to be adopted, he then contemplates his own consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhijālaṃ hi kathitaṃ parapratyayakāraṇam /
ihaiva siddhāḥ kāyānte mucyeranniti bhāvanāt // 183
meaning:
सिद्धिजालं हि कथितं परप्रत्ययकारणम् /
इहैव सिद्धाः कायान्ते मुच्येरन्निति भावनात् // 183
text_mt: For the web of spiritual accomplishments has been declared to be the cause of conviction in others; / through [such] contemplation, 'Those accomplished here in this very life are liberated at the end of the body.'

sanskrit_iast:
parabhāvanadārḍhyāttu jīvanmukto nigadyate /
etatte prātibhe bhede lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam // 184
meaning:
परभावनदार्ढ्यात्तु जीवन्मुक्तो निगद्यते /
एतत्ते प्रातिभे भेदे लक्षणं समुदाहृतम् // 184
text_mt: Through firmness in the supreme contemplation, however, he is called liberated while living. / This is declared to you as the defining characteristic of the intuitive variety.

sanskrit_iast:
śāpānugrahakāryeṣu tathābhyāsena śaktayā /
teṣūdāsīnatāyāṃ tu mucyate mocayetparān // 185
meaning:
शापानुग्रहकार्येषु तथाभ्यासेन शक्तया /
तेषूदासीनतायां तु मुच्यते मोचयेत्परान् // 185
text_mt: With respect to acts of cursing and grace, likewise through practice endowed with power, / but upon indifference toward them, he is liberated and liberates others.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtendriyādiyogena baddho'ṇuḥ saṃsareddhruvam /
sa eva pratibhāyuktaḥ śaktitattvaṃ nigadyate // 186
meaning:
भूतेन्द्रियादियोगेन बद्धोऽणुः संसरेद्ध्रुवम् /
स एव प्रतिभायुक्तः शक्तितत्त्वं निगद्यते // 186
text_mt: Bound through connection with the elements, senses, and the rest, the bound soul inevitably transmigrates; / that very [soul], endowed with the intuitive flash, is called the principle of power.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpātāveśato muktaḥ śiva eva bhavārṇavāt /
nanvācāryātsendriyaṃ tajjñānamuktamatīndriyam // 187
meaning:
तत्पातावेशतो मुक्तः शिव एव भवार्णवात् /
नन्वाचार्यात्सेन्द्रियं तज्ज्ञानमुक्तमतीन्द्रियम् // 187
text_mt: Liberated from the ocean of transmigratory existence through the descent and immersion of that [power], he is Śiva himself.' / [The Goddess asks:] 'Surely that knowledge from the master was said to involve the senses, while that beyond the senses

sanskrit_iast:
vivekajaṃ ca tadbuddhyā tatkathaṃ syānnirindriyam /
iti pṛṣṭo'bhyadhātsvāntadhiyorjāḍyaikavāsanāt // 188
meaning:
विवेकजं च तद्बुद्ध्या तत्कथं स्यान्निरिन्द्रियम् /
इति पृष्टोऽभ्यधात्स्वान्तधियोर्जाड्यैकवासनात् // 188
text_mt: is born of discernment through the intellect; how then could it be devoid of senses?' / Asked thus, he replied: 'From the latent impression consisting purely of dullness of the inner sense and intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣatvaṃ pravivekena tacchittau bhāsakaḥ śivaḥ /
saṃskāraḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ paratā parikīrtitā // 189
meaning:
अक्षत्वं प्रविवेकेन तच्छित्तौ भासकः शिवः /
संस्कारः सर्वभावानां परता परिकीर्तिता // 189
text_mt: arises sensory nature; through thorough discernment, upon their cessation, Śiva is the illuminator. / The refinement of all entities is proclaimed to be transcendence.

sanskrit_iast:
manobuddhī na bhinne tu kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare /
viveke kāraṇe hyete prabhuśaktyupavṛṃhite // 190
meaning:
मनोबुद्धी न भिन्ने तु कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे /
विवेके कारणे ह्येते प्रभुशक्त्युपवृंहिते // 190
text_mt: Mind and intellect are not separate in some other cause; / for when discernment is the cause, these two are augmented by the Lord's power.

sanskrit_iast:
na manobuddhihīnastu jñānasyādhigamaḥ priye /
parabhāvāttu tatsūkṣmaṃ śaktitattvaṃ nigadyate // 191
meaning:
न मनोबुद्धिहीनस्तु ज्ञानस्याधिगमः प्रिये /
परभावात्तु तत्सूक्ष्मं शक्तितत्त्वं निगद्यते // 191
text_mt: The apprehension of knowledge does not occur devoid of mind and intellect, O beloved; / yet through its supreme nature, that subtle [reality] is called the principle of power.

sanskrit_iast:
vivekaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ śuddhabhāvānmahāśayaḥ /
buddhitattvaṃ tu triguṇamuttamādhamamadhyamam // 192
meaning:
विवेकः सर्वभावानां शुद्धभावान्महाशयः /
बुद्धितत्त्वं तु त्रिगुणमुत्तमाधममध्यमम् // 192
text_mt: Discernment of all entities belongs to the high-minded one through pure being. / The intellect-principle, however, consists of the three qualities—superior, inferior, and intermediate;

sanskrit_iast:
aṇimādigataṃ cāpi bandhakaṃ jaḍamindriyam /
nanu prātibhato muktau dīkṣayā kiṃ śivādhvare // 193
meaning:
अणिमादिगतं चापि बन्धकं जडमिन्द्रियम् /
ननु प्रातिभतो मुक्तौ दीक्षया किं शिवाध्वरे // 193
text_mt: and the insentient sense-organ pertaining to [powers like] atomicity and the rest is a binder. / [The Goddess asks:] 'Surely, if liberation comes from the intuitive [faculty], what is the use of initiation in the Śaiva sacrifice?'

sanskrit_iast:
ūce'jñānā hi dīkṣāyāṃ bālavāliśayoṣitaḥ /
pāśacchedādvimucyante prabuddhyante śivādhvare // 194
meaning:
ऊचेऽज्ञाना हि दीक्षायां बालवालिशयोषितः /
पाशच्छेदाद्विमुच्यन्ते प्रबुद्ध्यन्ते शिवाध्वरे // 194
text_mt: He replied: 'Ignorant ones—children, the foolish, and women— / are freed from the cutting of bonds and awakened in the Śaiva sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāddīkṣā bhavatyeṣu kāraṇatvena sundari /
dīkṣayā pāśamokṣe tu śuddhabhāvādvivekajam // 195
meaning:
तस्माद्दीक्षा भवत्येषु कारणत्वेन सुन्दरि /
दीक्षया पाशमोक्षे तु शुद्धभावाद्विवेकजम् // 195
text_mt: Therefore initiation serves as the cause for them, O beautiful woman; / but upon the release of bonds through initiation, that which is born of discernment [arises] from pure being.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa paṭhito granthaḥ svayaṃ ye boddhumakṣamāḥ /
teṣāṃ śivoktisaṃvādādbodho dārḍhyaṃ vrajediti // 196
meaning:
इत्येष पठितो ग्रन्थः स्वयं ये बोद्धुमक्षमाः /
तेषां शिवोक्तिसंवादाद्बोधो दार्ढ्यं व्रजेदिति // 196
text_mt: Thus this text has been cited so that those who are unable to understand on their own / may find that their understanding attains firmness through agreement with the words of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanniśāṭane cātmaguruśāstravaśāttridhā /
jñānaṃ mukhyaṃ svopalabdhi vikalpārṇavatāraṇam // 197
meaning:
श्रीमन्निशाटने चात्मगुरुशास्त्रवशात्त्रिधा /
ज्ञानं मुख्यं स्वोपलब्धि विकल्पार्णवतारणम् // 197
text_mt: And in the venerable Niśāṭana [it is said]: 'Knowledge is threefold, depending on self, guru, and scripture; / primary is self-realization, crossing over the ocean of conceptual constructs.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrātmabhūtadravyāśadivyatattvādigocarā /
śaṃkā vikalpamūlā hi śāmyetsvapratyayāditi // 198
meaning:
मन्त्रात्मभूतद्रव्याशदिव्यतत्त्वादिगोचरा /
शंका विकल्पमूला हि शाम्येत्स्वप्रत्ययादिति // 198
text_mt: Doubt concerning mantras, the self, elemental substances, celestial principles, and the like, / being rooted in conceptual constructs, is stilled by one's own conviction.'

sanskrit_iast:
enamevārthamantaḥsthaṃ gṛhītvā mālinīmate /
evamasyātmanaḥ kāle kasmiṃścidyogyatāvaśāt // 199
meaning:
एनमेवार्थमन्तःस्थं गृहीत्वा मालिनीमते /
एवमस्यात्मनः काले कस्मिंश्चिद्योग्यतावशात् // 199
text_mt: Grasping this very internal meaning, [it is said] in the Mālinīvijayottara: / 'Thus, at some time, by force of suitability, to this soul

sanskrit_iast:
śaivī saṃbadhyate śaktiḥ śāntā muktiphalapradā /
tatsaṃbandhāttataḥ kaścittatkṣaṇādapavṛjyate // 200
meaning:
शैवी संबध्यते शक्तिः शान्ता मुक्तिफलप्रदा /
तत्संबन्धात्ततः कश्चित्तत्क्षणादपवृज्यते // 200
text_mt: the power of Śiva connects—tranquil and bestowing the fruit of liberation; / from connection with that, someone is instantly liberated.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tīvratīvrākhyaviṣayaṃ bhāṣate punaḥ /
ajñānena sahaikatvaṃ kasyacidvinivartate // 201
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तीव्रतीव्राख्यविषयं भाषते पुनः /
अज्ञानेन सहैकत्वं कस्यचिद्विनिवर्तते // 201
text_mt: Having said this, [the text] again speaks concerning the category called 'extremely intense': / 'The unity [of the soul] with ignorance ceases for a certain person;

sanskrit_iast:
rudraśaktisamāviṣṭaḥ sa yiyāsuḥ śivecchayā /
bhuktimuktiprasiddhyarthaṃ nīyate sadguruṃ prati // 202
meaning:
रुद्रशक्तिसमाविष्टः स यियासुः शिवेच्छया /
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रसिद्ध्यर्थं नीयते सद्गुरुं प्रति // 202
text_mt: possessed by the power of Rudra, wishing to go by Śiva's will, / he is led to a true guru for the sake of accomplishing enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tamārādhya tatastuṣṭāddīkṣāmāsādya śāṅkarīm /
tatkṣaṇādvopabhogādvā dehapātācchivaṃ vrajet // 203
meaning:
तमाराध्य ततस्तुष्टाद्दीक्षामासाद्य शाङ्करीम् /
तत्क्षणाद्वोपभोगाद्वा देहपाताच्छिवं व्रजेत् // 203
text_mt: Having propitiated him and obtained from him, when pleased, the Śaiva initiation, / he reaches Śiva either instantly, or through enjoyment, or at the fall of the body.'

sanskrit_iast:
asyārthā ātmanaḥ kācitkalanāmarśanātmikā /
svaṃ rūpaṃ prati yā saiva ko'pi kāla ihoditaḥ // 204
meaning:
अस्यार्था आत्मनः काचित्कलनामर्शनात्मिका /
स्वं रूपं प्रति या सैव कोऽपि काल इहोदितः // 204
text_mt: The meaning of this is: a certain impulse consisting of reflective awareness on the part of the soul / toward its own nature is said here to be a certain 'time'.

sanskrit_iast:
yogyatā śivatādātmyayogārhatvamihocyate /
pūrvaṃ kiṃ na tathā kasmāttadaiveti na saṃgatam // 205
meaning:
योग्यता शिवतादात्म्ययोगार्हत्वमिहोच्यते /
पूर्वं किं न तथा कस्मात्तदैवेति न संगतम् // 205
text_mt: 'Suitability' is stated here to be fitness for union in identity with Śiva. / [Objection:] 'Why was it not so previously? Why only then?' This is not tenable,

sanskrit_iast:
tathābhāsanamujjhitvā na hi kālo'sti kaścana /
svātantryāttu tathābhāse kālaśaktirvijṛmbhatām // 206
meaning:
तथाभासनमुज्झित्वा न हि कालोऽस्ति कश्चन /
स्वातन्त्र्यात्तु तथाभासे कालशक्तिर्विजृम्भताम् // 206
text_mt: for there is no time whatsoever apart from shining forth in that manner; / but from absolute autonomy, when it shines forth thus, let the power of time unfold.

sanskrit_iast:
natu paryanuyuktyai sā śive tanmahimoditā /
nanu śaivī mahāśaktiḥ saṃbaddhaivātmabhiḥ sthitā /
satyaṃ sācchādanātmā tu śāntā tveṣā svarūpadṛk // 207
meaning:
नतु पर्यनुयुक्त्यै सा शिवे तन्महिमोदिता /
ननु शैवी महाशक्तिः संबद्धैवात्मभिः स्थिता /
सत्यं साच्छादनात्मा तु शान्ता त्वेषा स्वरूपदृक् // 207
text_mt: It is not [subject] to cross-examination; in Śiva it is proclaimed as His majesty. / [Objection:] 'Surely the great power of Śiva stays eternally connected with souls?' / True, but it is concealing in nature, whereas this tranquil [power] perceives the essential nature.

sanskrit_iast: kṣobho hi bheda evaikyaṃ praśamastanmayī tataḥ // 208
meaning: क्षोभो हि भेद एवैक्यं प्रशमस्तन्मयी ततः // 208
text_mt: For agitation is indeed differentiation, whereas peace is oneness; therefore [she] consists of that [oneness].

sanskrit_iast:
tayā śāntyā tu saṃbaddhaḥ sthitaḥ śaktisvarūpabhāk /
tyaktāṇubhāvo bhavati śivastacchaktidārḍhyataḥ // 209
meaning:
तया शान्त्या तु संबद्धः स्थितः शक्तिस्वरूपभाक् /
त्यक्ताणुभावो भवति शिवस्तच्छक्तिदार्ढ्यतः // 209
text_mt: Connected with that tranquil [power], abiding as one sharing the essential nature of power, / his state of being a bound soul abandoned, he becomes Śiva through the firmness of that power.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi tāratamyādivaśācchīghracirāditaḥ /
dehapāto bhavedasya yadvā kāṣṭhāditulyatā // 210
meaning:
तत्रापि तारतम्यादिवशाच्छीघ्रचिरादितः /
देहपातो भवेदस्य यद्वा काष्ठादितुल्यता // 210
