text_mt: Even there, due to gradations and the like, sooner or later, / the fall of his body occurs, or else a state resembling a piece of wood.

sanskrit_iast:
samastavyavahāreṣu parācīnitacetanaḥ /
tīvratīvramahāśaktisamāviṣṭaḥ sa sidhyati // 211
meaning:
समस्तव्यवहारेषु पराचीनितचेतनः /
तीव्रतीव्रमहाशक्तिसमाविष्टः स सिध्यति // 211
text_mt: With his consciousness turned away from all ordinary activity, / possessed by the exceedingly intense great power, he attains spiritual accomplishment. // 211

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prāgviṣayo grantha iyānanyatra tu sphuṭam /
granthāntaraṃ madhyatīvraśaktipātāṃśasūcakam // 212
meaning:
एवं प्राग्विषयो ग्रन्थ इयानन्यत्र तु स्फुटम् /
ग्रन्थान्तरं मध्यतीव्रशक्तिपातांशसूचकम् // 212
text_mt: So much is the passage concerning the preceding topic; but elsewhere, clearly, / another passage indicates the subdivision of the medium-intense descent of power. // 212

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānarūpatā puṃsi bodhaḥ saṃkocite hṛdi /
saṃkoce vinivṛtte tu svasvabhāvaḥ prakāśate // 213
meaning:
अज्ञानरूपता पुंसि बोधः संकोचिते हृदि /
संकोचे विनिवृत्ते तु स्वस्वभावः प्रकाशते // 213
text_mt: Consciousness in a person takes the form of ignorance when the heart is contracted; / but when contraction has ceased, his own essential nature shines forth. // 213

sanskrit_iast:
rudraśaktisamāviṣṭa ityanenāsya varṇyate /
cihnavargo ya ukto'tra rudre bhaktiḥ suniścalā // 214
meaning:
रुद्रशक्तिसमाविष्ट इत्यनेनास्य वर्ण्यते /
चिह्नवर्गो य उक्तोऽत्र रुद्रे भक्तिः सुनिश्चला // 214
text_mt: By the statement 'possessed by the power of Rudra,' there is described / the set of signs stated here: unwavering devotion to Rudra, // 214

sanskrit_iast:
mantrasiddhiḥ sarvatattvavaśitvaṃ kṛtyasaṃpadaḥ /
kavitvaṃ sarvaśāstrārthaboddhṛtvamiti tatkramāt // 215
meaning:
मन्त्रसिद्धिः सर्वतत्त्ववशित्वं कृत्यसंपदः /
कवित्वं सर्वशास्त्रार्थबोद्धृत्वमिति तत्क्रमात् // 215
text_mt: Attainment of mantras, mastery over all principles of reality, successful completion of undertakings, / poetic capacity, and comprehension of the meaning of all scriptures, in that order. // 215

sanskrit_iast:
svatāratamyayogātsyādeṣāṃ vyastasamastatā /
tatrāpi bhuktau muktau ca prādhānyaṃ carcayedbudhaḥ // 216
meaning:
स्वतारतम्ययोगात्स्यादेषां व्यस्तसमस्तता /
तत्रापि भुक्तौ मुक्तौ च प्राधान्यं चर्चयेद्बुधः // 216
text_mt: Through their own gradation, these may be separate or combined; / even then, the wise person should examine whether enjoyment or liberation is primary. // 216

sanskrit_iast:
sa ityanto grantha eṣa dvitīyaviṣayaḥ sphuṭaḥ /
anyastu mandatīvrākhyaśaktipātavidhiṃ prati // 217
meaning:
स इत्यन्तो ग्रन्थ एष द्वितीयविषयः स्फुटः /
अन्यस्तु मन्दतीव्राख्यशक्तिपातविधिं प्रति // 217
text_mt: This passage ending with 'he' clearly concerns the second category; / but another concerns the rule for the descent of power called slow-intense. // 217

sanskrit_iast:
mandatīvrācchaktibalādyiyāsāsyopajāyate /
śivecchāvaśayogena sadguruṃ prati so'pi ca // 218
meaning:
मन्दतीव्राच्छक्तिबलाद्यियासास्योपजायते /
शिवेच्छावशयोगेन सद्गुरुं प्रति सोऽपि च // 218
text_mt: From the force of the slow-intense power, a desire to go is born in him / toward a true guru, through the power of Śiva's will; and he too // 218

sanskrit_iast:
atraiva lakṣitaḥ śāstre yaduktaṃ parameṣṭhinā /
yaḥ punaḥ sarvatattvāni vettyetāni yathārthataḥ // 219
meaning:
अत्रैव लक्षितः शास्त्रे यदुक्तं परमेष्ठिना /
यः पुनः सर्वतत्त्वानि वेत्त्येतानि यथार्थतः // 219
text_mt: Is characterized right in this scripture, as stated by the Supreme Lord: / 'Whoever truly knows all these principles of reality, // 219

sanskrit_iast:
sa gururmatsamaḥ prokto mantravīryaprakāśakaḥ /
dṛṣṭāḥ saṃbhāvitāstena spṛṣṭāśca prītacetasā // 220
meaning:
स गुरुर्मत्समः प्रोक्तो मन्त्रवीर्यप्रकाशकः /
दृष्टाः संभावितास्तेन स्पृष्टाश्च प्रीतचेतसा // 220
text_mt: He is declared to be a guru equal to myself, revealing the potency of mantras. / Seen, honored, and touched by him with a joyful mind, // 220

sanskrit_iast:
narāḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyante saptajanmakṛtairapi /
ye punardīkṣitāstena prāṇinaḥ śivacoditāḥ // 221
meaning:
नराः पापैः प्रमुच्यन्ते सप्तजन्मकृतैरपि /
ये पुनर्दीक्षितास्तेन प्राणिनः शिवचोदिताः // 221
text_mt: Men are freed even from sins accumulated across seven lifetimes. / Those living beings who are initiated by him, impelled by Śiva, // 221

sanskrit_iast:
te yatheṣṭaṃ phalaṃ prāpya padaṃ gacchantyanāmayam /
kiṃ tattvaṃ tattvavedī ka ityāmarśanayogataḥ // 222
meaning:
ते यथेष्टं फलं प्राप्य पदं गच्छन्त्यनामयम् /
किं तत्त्वं तत्त्ववेदी क इत्यामर्शनयोगतः // 222
text_mt: Attain their desired fruit and go to the sorrowless abode.' / Through contemplation such as 'What is the true reality? Who knows reality?', // 222

sanskrit_iast:
pratibhānātsuḥṛtsaṅgādgurau jigamiṣurbhavet /
evaṃ jigamiṣāyogādācāryaḥ prāpyate sa ca // 223
meaning:
प्रतिभानात्सुःऋत्सङ्गाद्गुरौ जिगमिषुर्भवेत् /
एवं जिगमिषायोगादाचार्यः प्राप्यते स च // 223
text_mt: From intuitive flash or through companionship with good friends, he becomes one wishing to go to a guru; / thus, through that desire to go, a master is found. And he, // 223

sanskrit_iast:
tāratamyādiyogena saṃsiddhaḥ saṃskṛto'pi ca /
prāgbhedabhāgī jhaṭiti kramātsāmastyatoṃśataḥ // 224
meaning:
तारतम्यादियोगेन संसिद्धः संस्कृतोऽपि च /
प्राग्भेदभागी झटिति क्रमात्सामस्त्यतोंशतः // 224
text_mt: Through gradations and the like, is spontaneously perfected or consecrated, / possessing the former distinctions, all at once or gradually, wholly or in part. // 224

sanskrit_iast:
ityādibhedabhinno hi gurorlābha ihoditaḥ /
tasmāddīkṣāṃ sa labhate sadya eva śivapradām // 225
meaning:
इत्यादिभेदभिन्नो हि गुरोर्लाभ इहोदितः /
तस्माद्दीक्षां स लभते सद्य एव शिवप्रदाम् // 225
text_mt: Differentiated by such divisions, the finding of a guru is declared here; / from him he receives initiation that instantly bestows Śivahood, // 225

sanskrit_iast:
jñānarūpāṃ yathā vetti sarvameva yathārthataḥ /
jīvanmuktaḥ śivībhūtastadaivāsau nigadyate // 226
meaning:
ज्ञानरूपां यथा वेत्ति सर्वमेव यथार्थतः /
जीवन्मुक्तः शिवीभूतस्तदैवासौ निगद्यते // 226
text_mt: Consisting of knowledge, so that he knows everything truly as it is; / he is then indeed proclaimed to be liberated while living, having become Śiva. // 226

sanskrit_iast:
dehasaṃbandhitāpyasya śivatāyai yataḥ sphuṭā /
asyāṃ bhedo hi kathanātsaṅgamādavalokanāt // 227
meaning:
देहसंबन्धिताप्यस्य शिवतायै यतः स्फुटा /
अस्यां भेदो हि कथनात्सङ्गमादवलोकनात् // 227
text_mt: For even his connection with a body is clearly for the purpose of Śivahood. / In this [initiation], distinction indeed arises from instruction, contact, gazing, // 227

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrātsaṃkramaṇātsāmyacaryāsaṃdarśanāccaroḥ /
mantramudrādimāhātmyātsamastavyastabhedataḥ // 228
meaning:
शास्त्रात्संक्रमणात्साम्यचर्यासंदर्शनाच्चरोः /
मन्त्रमुद्रादिमाहात्म्यात्समस्तव्यस्तभेदतः // 228
text_mt: From scripture, transmission, observance of equanimity, the sight of the sacred offering, / from the majesty of mantras and mudrās, differentiated collectively or separately, // 228

sanskrit_iast:
kriyayā vāntarākārarūpaprāṇapraveśataḥ /
tadā ca dehasaṃstho'pi sa mukta iti bhaṇyate // 229
meaning:
क्रियया वान्तराकाररूपप्राणप्रवेशतः /
तदा च देहसंस्थोऽपि स मुक्त इति भण्यते // 229
text_mt: Or by ritual action, or by penetration through the vital breath in an internal form; / and then, even while residing in the body, he is said to be liberated. // 229

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca śāstrayoḥ śrīmadratnamālāgamākhyayoḥ /
yasminkāle tu guruṇā nirvikalpaṃ prakāśitam // 230
meaning:
उक्तं च शास्त्रयोः श्रीमद्रत्नमालागमाख्ययोः /
यस्मिन्काले तु गुरुणा निर्विकल्पं प्रकाशितम् // 230
text_mt: And it is said in the two scriptures named the venerable Ratnamālā and Āgama: / 'At the very moment when the non-conceptual is revealed by the guru, // 230

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiva kila mukto'sau yantraṃ tiṣṭhati kevalam /
prārabdhṛkarmasaṃbandhāddehasya sukhiduḥkhite // 231
meaning:
तदैव किल मुक्तोऽसौ यन्त्रं तिष्ठति केवलम् /
प्रारब्धृकर्मसंबन्धाद्देहस्य सुखिदुःखिते // 231
text_mt: At that very moment, indeed, he is liberated; the body remains merely as an apparatus.' / Because of connection with prārabdha karma, the body's experiences of pleasure and pain // 231

sanskrit_iast:
na viśaṅketa tacca śrīgamaśāstre nirūpitam /
avidyopāsito deho hyanyajanmasamudbhuvā // 232
meaning:
न विशङ्केत तच्च श्रीगमशास्त्रे निरूपितम् /
अविद्योपासितो देहो ह्यन्यजन्मसमुद्भुवा // 232
text_mt: Should not cause doubt; and that is explained in the venerable Gamāśāstra: / 'The body, sustained by nescience, through karma born of another birth— // 232

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇā tena bādhyante jñānino'pi kalevare /
jātyāyurbhogadasyaikapraghaṭṭakatayā sthitiḥ // 233
meaning:
कर्मणा तेन बाध्यन्ते ज्ञानिनोऽपि कलेवरे /
जात्यायुर्भोगदस्यैकप्रघट्टकतया स्थितिः // 233
text_mt: By that karma, even the wise are afflicted in the body. / The status of that which yields birth, lifespan, and enjoyment exists as a single continuum.' // 233

sanskrit_iast:
uktaikavacanāddhiśca yatastenetisaṃgatiḥ /
abhyāsayuktisaṃkrāntivedhaghaṭṭanarodhataḥ // 234
meaning:
उक्तैकवचनाद्धिश्च यतस्तेनेतिसंगतिः /
अभ्यासयुक्तिसंक्रान्तिवेधघट्टनरोधतः // 234
text_mt: Because of the stated singular number and the particle 'hi' ('for'), the connection is made through 'by that.' / By means of practice, application, transmission, piercing, obstruction, // 234

sanskrit_iast:
hutervā mantrasāmarthyātpāśacchedaprayogataḥ /
sadyonirvāṇadāṃ kuryātsadyaḥprāṇaviyojikām // 235
meaning:
हुतेर्वा मन्त्रसामर्थ्यात्पाशच्छेदप्रयोगतः /
सद्योनिर्वाणदां कुर्यात्सद्यःप्राणवियोजिकाम् // 235
text_mt: Or oblation, or through the power of mantra, or the application of severing bonds, / he should perform [the initiation] that grants instant liberation, instantly separating the vital breaths. // 235

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tveṣo'sti niyama āsanne maraṇakṣaṇe /
tāṃ kuryānnānyathārabdhṛ karma yasmānna śuddhyati // 236
meaning:
तत्र त्वेषोऽस्ति नियम आसन्ने मरणक्षणे /
तां कुर्यान्नान्यथारब्धृ कर्म यस्मान्न शुद्ध्यति // 236
text_mt: There, however, this restriction holds: he should perform it when the moment of death is near, / not otherwise, since prārabdha karma is not purged. // 236

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca pūrvamevaitanmaṃtrasāmarthyayogataḥ /
prāṇairviyojito'pyeṣa bhuṅkte śeṣaphalaṃ yataḥ // 237
meaning:
उक्तं च पूर्वमेवैतन्मंत्रसामर्थ्ययोगतः /
प्राणैर्वियोजितोऽप्येष भुङ्क्ते शेषफलं यतः // 237
text_mt: And this has already been stated: through the efficacy of mantra, / even though separated from the vital breaths, he experiences the remaining fruit, because // 237

sanskrit_iast:
tajjanmaśeṣaṃ vividhamativāhya tataḥ sphuṭam /
karmāntaranirodhena śīghramevāpavṛjyate // 238
meaning:
तज्जन्मशेषं विविधमतिवाह्य ततः स्फुटम् /
कर्मान्तरनिरोधेन शीघ्रमेवापवृज्यते // 238
text_mt: Having clearly spent that diverse remainder of life, / through the blocking of further karma, he is very quickly liberated. // 238

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātprāṇaharīṃ dīkṣāṃ nājñātvā maraṇakṣaṇam /
vidadhyātparameśājñālaṅghanaikaphalā hi sā // 239
meaning:
तस्मात्प्राणहरीं दीक्षां नाज्ञात्वा मरणक्षणम् /
विदध्यात्परमेशाज्ञालङ्घनैकफला हि सा // 239
text_mt: Therefore, without knowing the moment of death, he should not perform / the initiation that takes life; for that has as its sole fruit the transgression of the Supreme Lord's command. // 239

sanskrit_iast:
ekastriko'yaṃ nirṇītaḥ śaktipāte'pyathāparaḥ /
tīvramadhye tu dīkṣāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhām // 240
meaning:
एकस्त्रिकोऽयं निर्णीतः शक्तिपातेऽप्यथापरः /
तीव्रमध्ये तु दीक्षायां कृतायां न तथा दृढाम् // 240
text_mt: This first triad of the descent of power has thus been determined. Now the next: / in the intense-medium, when initiation is performed, he does not know so firmly // 240

sanskrit_iast:
svātmano vetti śivatāṃ dehānte tu śivo bhavet /
uktaṃ ca niśisaṃcārayogasaṃcāraśāstrayoḥ // 241
meaning:
स्वात्मनो वेत्ति शिवतां देहान्ते तु शिवो भवेत् /
उक्तं च निशिसंचारयोगसंचारशास्त्रयोः // 241
text_mt: His own Śivahood, but at the end of the body he becomes Śiva. / And it is said in the Niśisaṃcāra and the Yogasaṃcāra scriptures: // 241

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpāttu tanau sthitvā dahānte śivatāṃ vrajet /
madhyamadhye śaktipāte śivalābhotsuko'pi san // 242
meaning:
विकल्पात्तु तनौ स्थित्वा दहान्ते शिवतां व्रजेत् /
मध्यमध्ये शक्तिपाते शिवलाभोत्सुकोऽपि सन् // 242
text_mt: 'Remaining in the body due to conceptual thought, at the end of the body he attains Śivahood.' / In the medium-medium descent of power, even though eager for the attainment of Śiva, // 242

sanskrit_iast:
bubhukṣuryatra yuktastadbhuktvā dehakṣaye śivaḥ /
mandamadhye tu tatraiva tattve kvāpi niyojitaḥ // 243
meaning:
बुभुक्षुर्यत्र युक्तस्तद्भुक्त्वा देहक्षये शिवः /
मन्दमध्ये तु तत्रैव तत्त्वे क्वापि नियोजितः // 243
text_mt: Desiring enjoyment, having enjoyed that to which he was joined, he becomes Śiva at the destruction of the body. / In the slow-medium, however, united with some principle of reality right there, // 243

sanskrit_iast:
dehānte tattvagaṃ bhogaṃ bhuktvā paścācchivaṃ vrajet /
tatrāpi tāratamyasya saṃbhavācciraśīghratā // 244
meaning:
देहान्ते तत्त्वगं भोगं भुक्त्वा पश्चाच्छिवं व्रजेत् /
तत्रापि तारतम्यस्य संभवाच्चिरशीघ्रता // 244
text_mt: Having enjoyed the experience belonging to that principle at the end of the body, he later attains Śiva. / There too, because variation is possible, there is slowness or quickness, // 244

sanskrit_iast:
bahvalpabhogayogaśca dehabhūmālpatākramaḥ /
tīvramande madhyamande mandamande bubhukṣutā // 245
meaning:
बह्वल्पभोगयोगश्च देहभूमाल्पताक्रमः /
तीव्रमन्दे मध्यमन्दे मन्दमन्दे बुभुक्षुता // 245
text_mt: The combination of greater or lesser enjoyment, and the sequence of more or fewer bodies. / In the intense-slow, medium-slow, and slow-slow, the desire for enjoyment // 245

sanskrit_iast:
kramānmukhyātimātreṇa vidhinaityantataḥ śivam /
anye yiyāsurityādigranthaṃ prāggranthasaṃgatam // 246
meaning:
क्रमान्मुख्यातिमात्रेण विधिनैत्यन्ततः शिवम् /
अन्ये यियासुरित्यादिग्रन्थं प्राग्ग्रन्थसंगतम् // 246
text_mt: Gradually leads to Śiva through predominantly transcendent means in the end. / Others connect the passage beginning with 'wishing to go' with the previous text, // 246

sanskrit_iast:
kurvanti madhyatīvrākhyaśaktisaṃpātagocaram /
yadā pratibhayāviṣṭo'pyeṣa saṃvādayojanām // 247
meaning:
कुर्वन्ति मध्यतीव्राख्यशक्तिसंपातगोचरम् /
यदा प्रतिभयाविष्टोऽप्येष संवादयोजनाम् // 247
text_mt: Making it pertain to the descent of power called medium-intense: / when, even though possessed by intuitive flash, he, desiring to achieve harmony, // 247

sanskrit_iast:
icchanyiyāsurbhavati tadā nīyeta sadgurum /
na sarvaḥ pratibhāviṣṭaḥ śaktyā nīyeta sadgurum // 248
meaning:
इच्छन्यियासुर्भवति तदा नीयेत सद्गुरुम् /
न सर्वः प्रतिभाविष्टः शक्त्या नीयेत सद्गुरुम् // 248
text_mt: Wishes to go, he is then led to a true guru. / Not everyone possessed by intuitive flash is led to a true guru by power; // 248

sanskrit_iast:
iti brūte yiyāsutvaṃ vaktavyaṃ nānyathā dhruvam /
rudraśaktisamāviṣṭo nīyate sadguruṃ prati // 249
meaning:
इति ब्रूते यियासुत्वं वक्तव्यं नान्यथा ध्रुवम् /
रुद्रशक्तिसमाविष्टो नीयते सद्गुरुं प्रति // 249
text_mt: So one says: the desire to go must certainly be stated otherwise. / One possessed by the power of Rudra is led to a true guru; // 249

sanskrit_iast:
tena prāptavivekotthajñānasaṃpūrṇamānasaḥ /
dārḍhyasaṃvādarūḍhyāderyiyāsurbhavati sphuṭam // 250
meaning:
तेन प्राप्तविवेकोत्थज्ञानसंपूर्णमानसः /
दार्ढ्यसंवादरूढ्यादेर्यियासुर्भवति स्फुटम् // 250
text_mt: By that, with a mind filled with knowledge arisen from attained discrimination, / he clearly becomes one wishing to go, for the sake of confirmation, harmony, and firm establishment. // 250

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ nandiśikhātantre prācyaṣaṭke maheśinā /
abhilāṣaḥ śive deve paśūnāṃ bhavate tadā // 251
meaning:
उक्तं नन्दिशिखातन्त्रे प्राच्यषट्के महेशिना /
अभिलाषः शिवे देवे पशूनां भवते तदा // 251
text_mt: It is said by the Great Lord in the early hexad of the Nandiśikhātantra: / 'Desire for Lord Śiva arises in bound souls then, // 251

sanskrit_iast:
yadā śaivābhimānena yuktā vai paramāṇavaḥ /
tadaiva te vimuktāstu dīkṣitā guruṇā yataḥ // 252
meaning:
यदा शैवाभिमानेन युक्ता वै परमाणवः /
तदैव ते विमुक्तास्तु दीक्षिता गुरुणा यतः // 252
text_mt: When the ultimate souls are indeed endowed with Śaiva self-identification. / At that very moment they are liberated, having been initiated by the guru, because // 252

sanskrit_iast:
prāptimātrācca te siddhasādhyā iti hi gamyate /
tamārādhyeti tu grantho mandatīvraikagocaraḥ // 253
meaning:
प्राप्तिमात्राच्च ते सिद्धसाध्या इति हि गम्यते /
तमाराध्येति तु ग्रन्थो मन्दतीव्रैकगोचरः // 253
text_mt: It is understood that from the mere encounter their ends are accomplished.' / But the text 'having worshipped him' pertains exclusively to the slow-intense. // 253

sanskrit_iast:
navadhā śaktipāto'yaṃ śaṃbhunāthena varṇitaḥ /
idaṃ sāramiha jñeyaṃ paripūrṇacidātmanaḥ // 254
meaning:
नवधा शक्तिपातोऽयं शंभुनाथेन वर्णितः /
इदं सारमिह ज्ञेयं परिपूर्णचिदात्मनः // 254
text_mt: This ninefold descent of power was described by Śambhunātha. / This essential truth should be known here: for the self of full consciousness, // 254

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśaḥ paramaḥ śaktipāto'vacchedavarjitaḥ /
tathāvidho'pi bhogāṃśāvacchedenopalakṣitaḥ // 255
meaning:
प्रकाशः परमः शक्तिपातोऽवच्छेदवर्जितः /
तथाविधोऽपि भोगांशावच्छेदेनोपलक्षितः // 255
text_mt: Luminosity is the supreme descent of power, free from limitation. / Even though of that nature, when characterized by the limitation of a portion of enjoyment, // 255

sanskrit_iast:
aparaḥ śaktipāto'sau paryante śivatāpradaḥ /
ubhayatrāpi karmādermāyāntarvartino yataḥ // 256
meaning:
अपरः शक्तिपातोऽसौ पर्यन्ते शिवताप्रदः /
उभयत्रापि कर्मादेर्मायान्तर्वर्तिनो यतः // 256
text_mt: This other descent of power bestows Śivahood in the end; / because in both cases, karma and the rest abide within māyā. // 256

sanskrit_iast:
nāsti vyāpāra ityevaṃ nirapekṣaḥ sa sarvataḥ /
tena māyāntarāle ye rudrā ye ca tadūrdhvataḥ // 257
meaning:
नास्ति व्यापार इत्येवं निरपेक्षः स सर्वतः /
तेन मायान्तराले ये रुद्रा ये च तदूर्ध्वतः // 257
text_mt: 'There is no activity': thus he is entirely independent. / Thereby, the Rudras who are within māyā and those who are above it [are transcended].

sanskrit_iast:
svādhikārakṣaye taistairbhairavībhūyate haṭhāt /
ye māyayā hyanākrāntāste karmādyanapekṣiṇaḥ // 258
meaning:
स्वाधिकारक्षये तैस्तैर्भैरवीभूयते हठात् /
ये मायया ह्यनाक्रान्तास्ते कर्माद्यनपेक्षिणः // 258
text_mt: Upon the exhaustion of their particular offices, they are forcibly transformed into Bhairava. / For those who are not overcome by Māyā do not depend on karma and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktipātavaśādeva tāṃ tāṃ siddhimupāśritāḥ /
nanu pūjājapadhyānaśaṃkarāsevanādibhiḥ // 259
meaning:
शक्तिपातवशादेव तां तां सिद्धिमुपाश्रिताः /
ननु पूजाजपध्यानशंकरासेवनादिभिः // 259
text_mt: Solely by the force of the descent of power have they resorted to this or that spiritual accomplishment. / [Objection:] Surely, through worship, recitation, meditation, service to Śaṅkara, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
te mantrāditvamāpannāḥ kathaṃ karmānapekṣiṇaḥ /
maivaṃ tathāvidhottīrṇaśivadhyānajapādiṣu // 260
meaning:
ते मन्त्रादित्वमापन्नाः कथं कर्मानपेक्षिणः /
मैवं तथाविधोत्तीर्णशिवध्यानजपादिषु // 260
text_mt: they attain the state of mantras and so on—how then do they not depend on karma? / [Reply:] Not so! Whence comes in the first place the very engagement of these [beings]

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttireva prathamameṣāṃ kasmādvivicyatām /
karmatatsāmyavairāgyamalapākādi dūṣitam // 261
meaning:
प्रवृत्तिरेव प्रथममेषां कस्माद्विविच्यताम् /
कर्मतत्साम्यवैराग्यमलपाकादि दूषितम् // 261
text_mt: in meditation, recitation, and so on directed toward such a transcendent Śiva? Let this be examined! / [The theories of] karma, the balance of karmas, dispassion, the ripening of impurity, and the like have [already] been refuted.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvarecchā nimittaṃ cecchaktipātaikahetutā /
japādikā kriyāśaktirevetthaṃ natu karma tat // 262
meaning:
ईश्वरेच्छा निमित्तं चेच्छक्तिपातैकहेतुता /
जपादिका क्रियाशक्तिरेवेत्थं नतु कर्म तत् // 262
text_mt: If the will of the Lord is the cause, then the descent of power is the sole cause. / Recitation and the like are in this way nothing other than the power of action, not karma.

sanskrit_iast:
karma tallokarūḍhaṃ hi yadbhogamavaraṃ dadat /
tirodhatte bhoktṛrūpaṃ saṃjñāyā tu na no bharaḥ // 263
meaning:
कर्म तल्लोकरूढं हि यद्भोगमवरं ददत् /
तिरोधत्ते भोक्तृरूपं संज्ञाया तु न नो भरः // 263
text_mt: For that is conventionally called 'karma' in worldly usage which, bestowing inferior enjoyment, / conceals the nature of the experiencer. But we do not insist on a mere name.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ bhogotkatā kasmāditi ceddattamuttaram /
citrākāraprakāśo'yaṃ svatantraḥ parameśvaraḥ // 264
meaning:
तेषां भोगोत्कता कस्मादिति चेद्दत्तमुत्तरम् /
चित्राकारप्रकाशोऽयं स्वतन्त्रः परमेश्वरः // 264
text_mt: If it is asked, 'Why is there among them an intensity of enjoyment?', the answer has [already] been given: / this supreme Lord is independent, manifesting in manifold forms.

sanskrit_iast:
svātantryāttu tirobhāvabandho bhoge'sya bhoktṛtām /
puṣṇansvaṃ rūpameva syānmalakarmādivarjitam // 265
meaning:
स्वातन्त्र्यात्तु तिरोभावबन्धो भोगेऽस्य भोक्तृताम् /
पुष्णन्स्वं रूपमेव स्यान्मलकर्मादिवर्जितम् // 265
text_mt: Out of absolute autonomy, however, the bond of concealment, nourishing his state of being an experiencer in enjoyment, / becomes his very own nature, devoid of impurity, karma, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ seyaṃ kriyāśaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī /
bandhayitrīti tatkarma kathyate rūpalopakṛt // 266
meaning:
उक्तं सेयं क्रियाशक्तिः शिवस्य पशुवर्तिनी /
बन्धयित्रीति तत्कर्म कथ्यते रूपलोपकृत् // 266
text_mt: It has been said: this very power of action of Śiva, abiding in the bound soul, / is the binder; therefore it is called karma, causing the loss of [one's true] form.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātā sā ca kriyāśaktiḥ sadyaḥ siddhyupapādikā /
avicchinnasvātmasaṃvitprathā siddhirihocyate // 267
meaning:
ज्ञाता सा च क्रियाशक्तिः सद्यः सिद्ध्युपपादिका /
अविच्छिन्नस्वात्मसंवित्प्रथा सिद्धिरिहोच्यते // 267
text_mt: And when that power of action is known, it instantly brings about spiritual accomplishment. / Here, spiritual accomplishment is said to be the uninterrupted expansion of the consciousness of one's own self.

sanskrit_iast:
sā bhogamokṣasvātantryamahālakṣmīrihākṣayā /
viṣṇvādirūpatā deve yā kācitsā nijātmanā // 268
meaning:
सा भोगमोक्षस्वातन्त्र्यमहालक्ष्मीरिहाक्षया /
विष्ण्वादिरूपता देवे या काचित्सा निजात्मना // 268
text_mt: It is the imperishable Great Fortune of the absolute autonomy of enjoyment and liberation. / Whatever state of being Viṣṇu and others there is in the Lord, by its very nature,

sanskrit_iast:
bhedayogavaśānmāyāpadamadhyavyavasthitā /
tena tadrūpatāyogācchaktipātaḥ sthito'pi san // 269
meaning:
भेदयोगवशान्मायापदमध्यव्यवस्थिता /
तेन तद्रूपतायोगाच्छक्तिपातः स्थितोऽपि सन् // 269
text_mt: due to the presence of differentiation, is situated in the midst of the plane of Māyā. / Therefore, because of association with that form, even though the descent of power is present,

sanskrit_iast:
tāvantaṃ bhogamādhatte paryante śivatāṃ natu /
yathā svātantryato rājāpyanugṛhṇāti kaṃcana // 270
meaning:
तावन्तं भोगमाधत्ते पर्यन्ते शिवतां नतु /
यथा स्वातन्त्र्यतो राजाप्यनुगृह्णाति कंचन // 270
text_mt: it confers only that much enjoyment, but not the state of Śiva at the end. / Just as a king, out of absolute autonomy, bestows grace upon someone,

sanskrit_iast:
īśaśaktisamāveśāttathā viṣṇvādayo'pyalam /
māyāgarbhādhikārīyaśaktipātavaśāttataḥ // 271
meaning:
ईशशक्तिसमावेशात्तथा विष्ण्वादयोऽप्यलम् /
मायागर्भाधिकारीयशक्तिपातवशात्ततः // 271
text_mt: so also Viṣṇu and the others are empowered by the penetration of the Lord's power. / Consequently, by the power of the descent of power pertaining to the office-holders within the womb of Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
ko'pi pradhānapuruṣavivekī prakṛtergataḥ /
utkṛṣṭāttata evāśu ko'pi buddhā vivekitām // 272
meaning:
कोऽपि प्रधानपुरुषविवेकी प्रकृतेर्गतः /
उत्कृष्टात्तत एवाशु कोऽपि बुद्धा विवेकिताम् // 272
text_mt: someone who discriminates between Pradhāna and the Puruṣa moves beyond Prakṛti; / from that exalted [state], someone, swiftly having realized discrimination through the intellect,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣaṇātpuṃsaḥ kalāyāśca puṃmāyāntaravedakaḥ /
kalāśrayasyāpyatyantaṃ karmaṇo vinivartanāt // 273
meaning:
क्षणात्पुंसः कलायाश्च पुंमायान्तरवेदकः /
कलाश्रयस्याप्यत्यन्तं कर्मणो विनिवर्तनात् // 273
text_mt: discerns instantly the distinction between the Puruṣa and Kalā, and between the Puruṣa and Māyā, / because of the complete cessation of karma, even that supported by Kalā.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānākalaḥ prāktanastu karmī tasyāśrayasthiteḥ /
sa paraṃ prakṛterbudhne sṛṣṭiṃ nāyāti jātucit // 274
meaning:
ज्ञानाकलः प्राक्तनस्तु कर्मी तस्याश्रयस्थितेः /
स परं प्रकृतेर्बुध्ने सृष्टिं नायाति जातुचित् // 274
text_mt: He is a knower free of instruments; but the former [discriminator] is bound by karma, because of abiding in its locus. / He, however, never enters creation at the base of Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
māyādhare tu sṛjyetānanteśena pracodanāt /
vijñānākalatāṃ prāptaḥ kevalādadhikārataḥ // 275
meaning:
मायाधरे तु सृज्येतानन्तेशेन प्रचोदनात् /
विज्ञानाकलतां प्राप्तः केवलादधिकारतः // 275
text_mt: Under the realm of Māyā, however, he may be emanated by the impulsion of the Lord Ananta. / One who has attained the status of a knower free of instruments, from the office of mere

sanskrit_iast:
malānmantratadīśādibhāvameti sadā śivāt /
patyuḥ parasmādyastveṣa śaktipātaḥ sa vai malāt // 276
meaning:
मलान्मन्त्रतदीशादिभावमेति सदा शिवात् /
पत्युः परस्माद्यस्त्वेष शक्तिपातः स वै मलात् // 276
text_mt: impurity, attains the state of mantra, lord of mantra, and so forth, from Sadāśiva. / But that descent of power which comes from the supreme Lord, the Master, truly

sanskrit_iast:
ajñānākhyādviyokteti śivabhāvaprakāśakaḥ /
nānyena śivabhāvo hi kenacitsaṃprakāśate // 277
meaning:
अज्ञानाख्याद्वियोक्तेति शिवभावप्रकाशकः /
नान्येन शिवभावो हि केनचित्संप्रकाशते // 277
text_mt: disjoins from the impurity called ignorance, and manifests the state of Śiva. / For the state of Śiva is not revealed by any other means.

sanskrit_iast:
svacchandaśāstre tenoktaṃ vādināṃ tu śatatrayam /
triṣaṣṭyabhyadhikaṃ bhrāntaṃ vaiṣṇavādyaṃ niśāntare // 278
meaning:
स्वच्छन्दशास्त्रे तेनोक्तं वादिनां तु शतत्रयम् /
त्रिषष्ट्यभ्यधिकं भ्रान्तं वैष्णवाद्यं निशान्तरे // 278
text_mt: Therefore it is said in the Svacchanda Tantra that the three hundred and sixty-three / disputants—the Vaiṣṇavas and the rest—are deluded in different systems.

sanskrit_iast:
śivajñānaṃ kevalaṃ ca śivatāpattidāyakam /
śivatāpattiparyantaḥ śaktipātaśca carcyate // 279
meaning:
शिवज्ञानं केवलं च शिवतापत्तिदायकम् /
शिवतापत्तिपर्यन्तः शक्तिपातश्च चर्च्यते // 279
text_mt: And the knowledge of Śiva alone is the giver of the attainment of Śivahood; / and the descent of power culminating in the attainment of Śivahood is [now] being examined.

sanskrit_iast:
anyathā kiṃ hi tatsyādyacchaivyā śaktyānadhiṣṭhitam /
teneha vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ nādhikāraḥ kathaṃcana // 280
meaning:
अन्यथा किं हि तत्स्याद्यच्छैव्या शक्त्यानधिष्ठितम् /
तेनेह वैष्णवादीनां नाधिकारः कथंचन // 280
text_mt: Otherwise, what indeed could exist that is not presided over by the power of Śiva? / Therefore, Vaiṣṇavas and the rest have no qualification whatsoever here.

sanskrit_iast:
te hi bhedaikavṛttitvādabhede dūravarjitāḥ /
svātantryāttu maheśasya te'pi cecchivatonmukhāḥ // 281
meaning:
ते हि भेदैकवृत्तित्वादभेदे दूरवर्जिताः /
स्वातन्त्र्यात्तु महेशस्य तेऽपि चेच्छिवतोन्मुखाः // 281
text_mt: For they, functioning solely in difference, are far removed from non-duality. / But out of the absolute autonomy of the Great Lord, if even they become turned toward Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇā saṃskriyāstyeṣāṃ liṅgoddhṛtyātha dīkṣayā /
duṣṭādhivāsavigame puṣpaiḥ kumbho'dhivāsyate // 282
meaning:
द्विगुणा संस्क्रियास्त्येषां लिङ्गोद्धृत्याथ दीक्षया /
दुष्टाधिवासविगमे पुष्पैः कुम्भोऽधिवास्यते // 282
text_mt: their purificatory rite is twofold: by the extraction of the insignia, and then by initiation. / When a bad odor is removed, a jar is perfumed with flowers:

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇo'sya sa saṃskāro netthaṃ śuddhe ghaṭe vidhiḥ /
itthaṃ śrīśaktipāto'yaṃ nirapekṣa ihoditaḥ // 283
meaning:
द्विगुणोऽस्य स संस्कारो नेत्थं शुद्धे घटे विधिः /
इत्थं श्रीशक्तिपातोऽयं निरपेक्ष इहोदितः // 283
text_mt: its purification is twofold; such a rule does not apply to a clean vessel. / Thus this noble descent of power is here declared to be independent.

sanskrit_iast:
anayaiva diśā neyaṃ mataṅgakiraṇādikam /
granthagauravabhītyā tu tallikhitvā na yojitam // 284
meaning:
अनयैव दिशा नेयं मतङ्गकिरणादिकम् /
ग्रन्थगौरवभीत्या तु तल्लिखित्वा न योजितम् // 284
text_mt: Along this very line should texts such as the Mataṅga and the Kiraṇa be interpreted; / but out of fear of swelling the book, they are not cited and applied here.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇe'pi ca tasyaiva prasādādbhaktiriṣyate /
yayā yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ tadbhāvagatamānasāḥ // 285
meaning:
पुराणेऽपि च तस्यैव प्रसादाद्भक्तिरिष्यते /
यया यान्ति परां सिद्धिं तद्भावगतमानसाः // 285
text_mt: And even in the Purāṇa, devotion is accepted [as arising] from His grace alone, / by which those whose minds have entered His nature attain supreme spiritual accomplishment.

sanskrit_iast:
evakāreṇa karmādisāpekṣatvaṃ niṣidhyate /
prasādo nirmalībhāvastena saṃpūrṇarūpatā // 286
meaning:
एवकारेण कर्मादिसापेक्षत्वं निषिध्यते /
प्रसादो निर्मलीभावस्तेन संपूर्णरूपता // 286
text_mt: By the word 'alone' (eva), dependence on karma and the rest is negated. / Grace is purification; thereby complete fullness of nature [is attained].

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanā tena hi śivaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇaḥ prakāśate /
śivībhāvamahāsiddhisparśavandhye tu kutracit // 287
meaning:
आत्मना तेन हि शिवः स्वयं पूर्णः प्रकाशते /
शिवीभावमहासिद्धिस्पर्शवन्ध्ये तु कुत्रचित् // 287
text_mt: For by that self, Śiva Himself shines forth as full. / But where [devotion] is devoid of the touch of the great spiritual accomplishment of becoming Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavādau hi yā bhaktirnāsau kevalataḥ śivāt /
śivo bhavati tatraiṣa kāraṇaṃ na tu kevalaḥ // 288
meaning:
वैष्णवादौ हि या भक्तिर्नासौ केवलतः शिवात् /
शिवो भवति तत्रैष कारणं न तु केवलः // 288
text_mt: namely, the devotion found among Vaiṣṇavas and others, it does not come from Śiva alone. / Śiva is indeed a cause there, but not the sole cause,

sanskrit_iast:
nirmalaścāpi tu prāptāvacchitkarmādyapekṣakaḥ /
yayā yānti parāṃ siddhimityasyedaṃ tu jīvitam // 289
meaning:
निर्मलश्चापि तु प्राप्तावच्छित्कर्माद्यपेक्षकः /
यया यान्ति परां सिद्धिमित्यस्येदं तु जीवितम् // 289
text_mt: and not pure, but rather dependent on karma and the rest limited to what has been attained. / This indeed is the core meaning of [the verse ending], 'by which they attain supreme spiritual accomplishment.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmānutpaladevaścāpyasmākaṃ paramo guruḥ /
śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptamīśa na karoṣi karhicit // 290
meaning:
श्रीमानुत्पलदेवश्चाप्यस्माकं परमो गुरुः /
शक्तिपातसमये विचारणं प्राप्तमीश न करोषि कर्हिचित् // 290
text_mt: And the illustrious Utpaladeva, our supreme guru, [said]: / 'At the time of the descent of power, O Lord, You never make any deliberation that has been occasioned [by conditions].

sanskrit_iast:
adya māṃ prati kimāgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase /
karhicitprāptaśabdābhyāmanapekṣitvamūcivān // 291
meaning:
अद्य मां प्रति किमागतं यतः स्वप्रकाशनविधौ विलम्बसे /
कर्हिचित्प्राप्तशब्दाभ्यामनपेक्षित्वमूचिवान् // 291
text_mt: What has happened toward me today, that You delay in the act of revealing Yourself?' / By the two words 'never' (karhicit) and 'occasioned' (prāpta), he stated independence,

sanskrit_iast:
durlabhatvamarāgitvaṃ śaktipātavidhau vibhoḥ /
aparārdhena tasyaiva śaktipātasya citratām // 292
meaning:
दुर्लभत्वमरागित्वं शक्तिपातविधौ विभोः /
अपरार्धेन तस्यैव शक्तिपातस्य चित्रताम् // 292
text_mt: the rarity, and the impartiality of the All-pervading Lord in the act of the descent of power; / and by the second half [of the verse], the variegated nature of that very descent of power,

sanskrit_iast:
vyavadhānacirakṣiprabhedādyairupavarṇitaiḥ /
śrīmatāpyaniruddhena śaktimunmīlinīṃ vibhoḥ // 293
meaning:
व्यवधानचिरक्षिप्रभेदाद्यैरुपवर्णितैः /
श्रीमताप्यनिरुद्धेन शक्तिमुन्मीलिनीं विभोः // 293
text_mt: described through differences of intervention, delay, swiftness, and so forth. / Even by the illustrious Aniruddha, explaining the unfolding power of the All-pervading Lord

sanskrit_iast:
vyācakṣāṇena mātaṅge varṇitā nirapekṣatā /
sthāvarānte'pi devasya svarūponmīlanātmikā // 294
meaning:
व्याचक्षाणेन मातङ्गे वर्णिता निरपेक्षता /
स्थावरान्तेऽपि देवस्य स्वरूपोन्मीलनात्मिका // 294
text_mt: in the Mataṅga, this independence was described: / reaching even to immovable beings, the Lord's power, consisting in the unfolding of His own nature,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiḥ patantī sāpekṣā na kvāpīti suvistarāt /
evaṃ vicitre'pyetasmiñchaktipāte sthite sati // 295
meaning:
शक्तिः पतन्ती सापेक्षा न क्वापीति सुविस्तरात् /
एवं विचित्रेऽप्येतस्मिञ्छक्तिपाते स्थिते सति // 295
text_mt: falls without depending on anything anywhere, as [stated] at great length. / Thus, though this descent of power is manifold,

sanskrit_iast:
tāratamyādibhirbhedaiḥ samayyādivicitratā /
kaścidrudrāśatāmātrāpādanāttatprasādataḥ // 296
meaning:
तारतम्यादिभिर्भेदैः समय्यादिविचित्रता /
कश्चिद्रुद्राशतामात्रापादनात्तत्प्रसादतः // 296
text_mt: there is diversity among initiates into the rule and the rest through gradations and other distinctions. / One, through being brought merely to the state of a Rudra, by his grace

sanskrit_iast:
śivatvaṃ kramaśo gacchet samayī yo nirūpyate /
kaścicchuddhādhvabandhaḥ san putrakaḥ śīghramakramāt // 297
meaning:
शिवत्वं क्रमशो गच्छेत् समयी यो निरूप्यते /
कश्चिच्छुद्धाध्वबन्धः सन् पुत्रकः शीघ्रमक्रमात् // 297
text_mt: may gradually attain Śivahood; he is defined as an initiate into the rule. / Another, being bound to the pure path, is a spiritual son swiftly without succession.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogavyavadhinā ko'pi sādhakaściraśīghrataḥ /
kaścitsaṃpūrṇakartavyaḥ kṛtyapañcakabhāgini // 298
meaning:
भोगव्यवधिना कोऽपि साधकश्चिरशीघ्रतः /
कश्चित्संपूर्णकर्तव्यः कृत्यपञ्चकभागिनि // 298
text_mt: Another, an adept, through the intervention of enjoyment, [attains it] either slowly or swiftly. / Another, who has completed all duties, participating in the fivefold activity,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpe sthito guruḥ so'pi bhogamokṣādibhedabhāk /
samayyādicatuṣkasya samāsavyāsayogataḥ // 299
meaning:
रूपे स्थितो गुरुः सोऽपि भोगमोक्षादिभेदभाक् /
समय्यादिचतुष्कस्य समासव्यासयोगतः // 299
text_mt: abiding in that form, is a guru; he too shares in the distinctions of enjoyment, liberation, and so forth. / Through the combination of brief and detailed forms of this tetrad of initiate into the rule and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
kramākramādibhirbhedaiḥ śaktipātasya citratā /
kramikaḥ śaktipātaśca siddhānte vāmake tataḥ // 300
meaning:
क्रमाक्रमादिभिर्भेदैः शक्तिपातस्य चित्रता /
क्रमिकः शक्तिपातश्च सिद्धान्ते वामके ततः // 300
text_mt: and through distinctions of succession, non-succession, and so on, there is diversity in the descent of power. / The descent of power is successive in the Siddhānta, and then in the Vāma,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣe mate kule kaule ṣaḍardhe hṛdaye tataḥ /
ullaṅghanavaśādvāpi jhaṭityakramameva vā // 301
meaning:
दक्षे मते कुले कौले षडर्धे हृदये ततः /
उल्लङ्घनवशाद्वापि झटित्यक्रममेव वा // 301
text_mt: then in the Dakṣiṇa, the Mata, the Kula, the Kaula, the Trika, and the Hṛdaya; / or else, by virtue of transcendence, it occurs instantly and without succession.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrībhairavakule pañcadīkṣāsusaṃskṛtaḥ /
gururullaṅghitādhaḥsthasrotā vai trikaśāstragaḥ // 302
meaning:
उक्तं श्रीभैरवकुले पञ्चदीक्षासुसंस्कृतः /
गुरुरुल्लङ्घिताधःस्थस्रोता वै त्रिकशास्त्रगः // 302
text_mt: It is stated in the Śrībhairavakula: 'Purified by the five initiations, / a guru who has transcended the lower streams is truly grounded in the Trika scriptures.'

sanskrit_iast:
jñānācārādibhedena hyuttarādharatā vibhuḥ /
śāstreṣvadīdṛśacchrīmatsarvācārahṛdādiṣu // 303
meaning:
ज्ञानाचारादिभेदेन ह्युत्तराधरता विभुः /
शास्त्रेष्वदीदृशच्छ्रीमत्सर्वाचारहृदादिषु // 303
text_mt: Through differences of knowledge, conduct, and the like, the All-pervading Lord has shown / a hierarchy of higher and lower in scriptures such as the noble Sarvācārahṛdaya.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmamārgābhiṣiktastu daiśikaḥ paratattvavit /
tathāpi bhairave tantre punaḥ saṃskāramarhati // 304
meaning:
वाममार्गाभिषिक्तस्तु दैशिकः परतत्त्ववित् /
तथापि भैरवे तन्त्रे पुनः संस्कारमर्हति // 304
text_mt: Even a preceptor consecrated in the path of Vāma, knowing the supreme reality, / nevertheless requires a further consecration in the Bhairava Tantra.

sanskrit_iast:
śaivavaimalasiddhāntā ārhatāḥ kārukāśca ye /
sarve te paśavo jñeyā bhairave mātṛmaṇḍale // 305
meaning:
शैववैमलसिद्धान्ता आर्हताः कारुकाश्च ये /
सर्वे ते पशवो ज्ञेया भैरवे मातृमण्डले // 305
text_mt: Those of the Śaiva Siddhānta, the Vaimalas, the Jainas, and the Kārukas— / all of them are to be known as bound souls in the Bhairava circle of mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
kulakālīvidhau coktaṃ vaiṣṇavānā viśeṣataḥ /
bhasmaniṣṭhāprapannānāmityādau naiva yogyatā // 306
meaning:
कुलकालीविधौ चोक्तं वैष्णवाना विशेषतः /
भस्मनिष्ठाप्रपन्नानामित्यादौ नैव योग्यता // 306
text_mt: And in the Kulakālīvidhi it is stated: 'Especially for Vaiṣṇavas, / for those devoted to ashes, and so forth, there is no qualification whatsoever.'

sanskrit_iast:
svacchandaśāstre saṃkṣepāduktaṃ ca śrīmaheśinā /
anyaśāstrarato yastu nāsau siddhiphalapradaḥ // 307
meaning:
स्वच्छन्दशास्त्रे संक्षेपादुक्तं च श्रीमहेशिना /
अन्यशास्त्ररतो यस्तु नासौ सिद्धिफलप्रदः // 307
text_mt: In the Svacchandaśāstra, too, it has been stated concisely by the venerable supreme Lord: / 'One who is attached to another scripture does not grant the fruit of spiritual accomplishment.'

sanskrit_iast:
samayyādikramāllabdhābhiṣeko hi gururmataḥ /
sa ca śaktivaśāditthaṃ vaiṣṇavādiṣu ko'nvayaḥ // 308
meaning:
समय्यादिक्रमाल्लब्धाभिषेको हि गुरुर्मतः /
स च शक्तिवशादित्थं वैष्णवादिषु कोऽन्वयः // 308
text_mt: For a guru is regarded as one who has attained consecration through the order of the initiate into the rule and the rest; / and that occurs by virtue of [divine] power. What connection, then, is there in Vaiṣṇavas and the like?

sanskrit_iast:
chadmāpaśravaṇādyaistu tajjñānaṃ gṛhṇato bhavet /
prāyaścittamatastādṛgadhikāryatra kiṃ bhavet // 309
meaning:
छद्मापश्रवणाद्यैस्तु तज्ज्ञानं गृह्णतो भवेत् /
प्रायश्चित्तमतस्तादृगधिकार्यत्र किं भवेत् // 309
text_mt: For those who receive that knowledge through deceit, eavesdropping, and the like, / expiation is prescribed. How then could such a person become an authority here?

sanskrit_iast:
phalākāṅkṣāyutaḥ śiṣyastadekāyattasiddhikaḥ /
dhruvaṃ pacyeta narake prāyaścittyupasevanāt // 310
meaning:
फलाकाङ्क्षायुतः शिष्यस्तदेकायत्तसिद्धिकः /
ध्रुवं पच्येत नरके प्रायश्चित्त्युपसेवनात् // 310
text_mt: A disciple seeking results whose spiritual accomplishments depend solely upon him / would surely burn in hell on account of serving one who requires expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
tirobhāvaprakāro'yaṃ yattādṛśi niyojitaḥ /
gurau śivena tadbhaktiḥ śaktipāto'sya nocyate // 311
meaning:
तिरोभावप्रकारोऽयं यत्तादृशि नियोजितः /
गुरौ शिवेन तद्भक्तिः शक्तिपातोऽस्य नोच्यते // 311
text_mt: This is a mode of concealment: that he is directed by Śiva / to such a guru. Devotion to him is not called the descent of power upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
yadātu vaicitryavaśājjānīyāttasya tādṛśam /
viparītapravṛttatvaṃ jñānaṃ tasmādupāharet // 312
meaning:
यदातु वैचित्र्यवशाज्जानीयात्तस्य तादृशम् /
विपरीतप्रवृत्तत्वं ज्ञानं तस्मादुपाहरेत् // 312
text_mt: When, however, by virtue of diversity [of karma], he recognizes such a perverse tendency in him, / he should take away the knowledge from him;

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ ca tyajetpāpavṛttiṃ bhavettu jñānatatparaḥ /
yathā caurādgṛhītvārthaṃ taṃ nigṛhṇāti bhūpatiḥ // 313
meaning:
तं च त्यजेत्पापवृत्तिं भवेत्तु ज्ञानतत्परः /
यथा चौराद्गृहीत्वार्थं तं निगृह्णाति भूपतिः // 313
text_mt: and he should abandon that sinful man and become intent upon knowledge, / just as a king, having confiscated the wealth from a thief, punishes him.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavādestathā śaivaṃ jñānamāhṛtya sanmatiḥ /
sa hi bhedaikavṛttitvaṃ śivajñāne śrute'pyalam // 314
meaning:
वैष्णवादेस्तथा शैवं ज्ञानमाहृत्य सन्मतिः /
स हि भेदैकवृत्तित्वं शिवज्ञाने श्रुतेऽप्यलम् // 314
text_mt: Similarly, having gathered the Śaiva knowledge from a Vaiṣṇava or the like, a man of noble intellect [should abandon him]; / for although he has heard the Śaiva knowledge, he is entirely absorbed in dualistic conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
nojjhatīti dṛḍhaṃ vāmādhiṣṭhitastatpaśūttamaḥ /
śivenaiva tirobhāvya sthāpito niyaterbalāt // 315
meaning:
नोज्झतीति दृढं वामाधिष्ठितस्तत्पशूत्तमः /
शिवेनैव तिरोभाव्य स्थापितो नियतेर्बलात् // 315
text_mt: and does not firmly abandon it; being possessed by Vāmā, he is the highest of bound souls, / concealed by Śiva himself and established [there] by the force of necessity.

sanskrit_iast:
kathaṅkāraṃ patipadaṃ prayātu paratantritaḥ /
svacchandaśāstre proktaṃ ca vaiṣṇavādiṣu ye ratāḥ // 316
meaning:
कथङ्कारं पतिपदं प्रयातु परतन्त्रितः /
स्वच्छन्दशास्त्रे प्रोक्तं च वैष्णवादिषु ये रताः // 316
text_mt: How could one who is subservient to others attain the state of the Lord? / And it is stated in the Svacchandaśāstra: 'Those who are devoted to Vaiṣṇava teachings and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
bhramayatyeva tānmāyā hyamokṣe mokṣalipsayā /
vaiṣṇavādiḥ śaivaśāstraṃ melayannijaśāsane // 317
meaning:
भ्रमयत्येव तान्माया ह्यमोक्षे मोक्षलिप्सया /
वैष्णवादिः शैवशास्त्रं मेलयन्निजशासने // 317
text_mt: Māyā verily deludes, through their desire for liberation in that which is not liberation.' / A Vaiṣṇava or the like who mixes the Śaiva scripture into his own teaching

sanskrit_iast:
dhruvaṃ saṃśayamāpanna ubhayabhraṣṭatāṃ vrajet /
svadṛṣṭau paradṛṣṭau ca samayollaṅghanādasau // 318
meaning:
ध्रुवं संशयमापन्न उभयभ्रष्टतां व्रजेत् /
स्वदृष्टौ परदृष्टौ च समयोल्लङ्घनादसौ // 318
text_mt: surely falls into doubt and meets with downfall from both, / because he transgresses the pledge both in his own doctrine and in the other doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyavāyaṃ yato'bhyeti carettannedṛśaṃ kramam /
uktaṃ śrīmadgahvare ca parameśena tādṛśam // 319
meaning:
प्रत्यवायं यतोऽभ्येति चरेत्तन्नेदृशं क्रमम् /
उक्तं श्रीमद्गह्वरे च परमेशेन तादृशम् // 319
text_mt: Since he incurs adverse consequences, he should not follow such a path. / And similarly it has been stated by the supreme Lord in the venerable Gahvara:

sanskrit_iast:
nānyaśāstrābhiyuktaṣu śivajñānaṃ prakāśate /
tanna saiddhāntiko vāme nāsau dakṣe sa no mate // 320
meaning:
नान्यशास्त्राभियुक्तषु शिवज्ञानं प्रकाशते /
तन्न सैद्धान्तिको वामे नासौ दक्षे स नो मते // 320
text_mt: 'The knowledge of Śiva does not shine forth in those engaged in other scriptures.' / Therefore, one belonging to the Siddhānta has no authority in Vāma, nor he in Dakṣiṇa, nor he in Mata,

sanskrit_iast:
kulakaule trike nāsau pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ paratra tu /
avacchinno'navacchedaṃ no vettyānantyasaṃsthitaḥ // 321
meaning:
कुलकौले त्रिके नासौ पूर्वः पूर्वः परत्र तु /
अवच्छिन्नोऽनवच्छेदं नो वेत्त्यानन्त्यसंस्थितः // 321
text_mt: nor he in Kula, Kaula, and Trika. Each preceding one has no authority in what is subsequent; / being limited, he does not know the unlimited, [whereas] one abiding in infinity

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃsahastato'dhaḥstha ūrdhvastho'dhikṛto guruḥ /
svātmīyādharasaṃsparśātprāṇayannadharāḥ kriyāḥ // 322
meaning:
सर्वंसहस्ततोऽधःस्थ ऊर्ध्वस्थोऽधिकृतो गुरुः /
स्वात्मीयाधरसंस्पर्शात्प्राणयन्नधराः क्रियाः // 322
text_mt: bears all. Therefore, a guru situated above is authorized over what is below; / animating lower rites through the touch of what belongs to his own lower [path],

sanskrit_iast:
saphalīkurute yattadūrdhvastho gururuttamaḥ /
adhaḥsthadṛkstho'pyetādṛggurusevī bhavetsa yaḥ // 323
meaning:
सफलीकुरुते यत्तदूर्ध्वस्थो गुरुरुत्तमः /
अधःस्थदृक्स्थोऽप्येतादृग्गुरुसेवी भवेत्स यः // 323
text_mt: he brings them to fruition; hence a guru situated above is supreme. / Even if one is situated in a lower view, if he becomes a follower of such a guru,

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛkśaktinipāteddho yo drāgūrdhvamimaṃ nayet /
tattadgirinadīprāyāvacchinne kṣetrapīṭhake // 324
meaning:
तादृक्शक्तिनिपातेद्धो यो द्रागूर्ध्वमिमं नयेत् /
तत्तद्गिरिनदीप्रायावच्छिन्ने क्षेत्रपीठके // 324
text_mt: he is kindled by such a descent of power as quickly leads him higher. / In sacred fields and seats demarcated by respective mountains and rivers,

sanskrit_iast:
uttarottaravijñāne nādhikāryadharo'dharaḥ /
uttarottaramācāryaṃ vidannapyadharo'dharaḥ // 325
meaning:
उत्तरोत्तरविज्ञाने नाधिकार्यधरोऽधरः /
उत्तरोत्तरमाचार्यं विदन्नप्यधरोऽधरः // 325
text_mt: each lower one has no authority in each subsequent knowledge. / Even if he knows the higher master, each lower one,

sanskrit_iast:
kurvannadhikriyāṃ śāstralaṅghī nigrahabhājanam /
śaktipātabalādeva jñānayogyavicitratā // 326
meaning:
कुर्वन्नधिक्रियां शास्त्रलङ्घी निग्रहभाजनम् /
शक्तिपातबलादेव ज्ञानयोग्यविचित्रता // 326
text_mt: if he assumes an authority [beyond his level], transgresses the scripture and becomes an object of reprimand. / The diversity of capacity for knowledge arises solely from the strength of the descent of power.

sanskrit_iast:
śrautaṃ cintāmayaṃ dvyātma bhāvanāmayameva ca /
jñānaṃ taduttaraṃ jyāyo yato mokṣaikakāraṇam // 327
meaning:
श्रौतं चिन्तामयं द्व्यात्म भावनामयमेव च /
ज्ञानं तदुत्तरं ज्यायो यतो मोक्षैककारणम् // 327
text_mt: Knowledge is twofold: based on scriptures, and consisting of contemplation; / and that which consists of creative meditation is the highest, because it is the sole cause of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
tattvebhya uddhṛtiṃ kvāpi yojanaṃ sakale'kale /
kathaṃ kuryādvinā jñānaṃ bhāvanāmayamuttamam // 328
meaning:
तत्त्वेभ्य उद्धृतिं क्वापि योजनं सकलेऽकले /
कथं कुर्याद्विना ज्ञानं भावनामयमुत्तमम् // 328
text_mt: How could one perform the extraction from the principles, or somewhere their integration into the composite or simple, / without the supreme knowledge that consists of creative meditation?

sanskrit_iast:
yogī tu prāptatattattvasiddhirapyuttame pade /
sadāśivādye svabhyastajñānitvādeva yojakaḥ // 329
meaning:
योगी तु प्राप्ततत्तत्त्वसिद्धिरप्युत्तमे पदे /
सदाशिवाद्ये स्वभ्यस्तज्ञानित्वादेव योजकः // 329
text_mt: A yogin, however, even though he has attained the spiritual accomplishments of various principles, is an integrator in the supreme state— / in the Sadāśiva level and above—only by virtue of possessing well-practiced knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
adhareṣu ca tattveṣu yā siddhiryogajāsya sā /
vimocanāyāṃ nopāyaḥ sthitāpi dhanadāravat // 330
meaning:
अधरेषु च तत्त्वेषु या सिद्धिर्योगजास्य सा /
विमोचनायां नोपायः स्थितापि धनदारवत् // 330
text_mt: And whatever spiritual accomplishment born of yoga he has in the lower principles, / that, though present, is no means for liberation, like wealth and women.

sanskrit_iast:
yastūtpannasamastādhvasiddhiḥ sahi sadāśivaḥ /
sākṣādeṣa kathaṃ martyānmocayedgurutāṃ vrajan // 331
meaning:
यस्तूत्पन्नसमस्ताध्वसिद्धिः सहि सदाशिवः /
साक्षादेष कथं मर्त्यान्मोचयेद्गुरुतां व्रजन् // 331
text_mt: He, however, who has attained the spiritual accomplishment of the entire path is himself Sadāśiva / in visible form. How could he, having attained guruhood, fail to liberate mortals?

sanskrit_iast:
tenoktaṃ mālinītantre vicārya jñānayogite /
yataśca mokṣadaḥ proktaḥ svabhyastajñānavānbudhaiḥ // 332
meaning:
तेनोक्तं मालिनीतन्त्रे विचार्य ज्ञानयोगिते /
यतश्च मोक्षदः प्रोक्तः स्वभ्यस्तज्ञानवान्बुधैः // 332
text_mt: Therefore it was stated in the Mālinītantra after examining the possession of knowledge and yoga; / and because one endowed with well-practiced knowledge is declared by the wise to be the bestower of liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsvabhyastavijñānataivaikaṃ gurulakṣaṇam /
vibhāgastveṣa me proktaḥ śaṃbhunāthena darśyate // 333
meaning:
तस्मात्स्वभ्यस्तविज्ञानतैवैकं गुरुलक्षणम् /
विभागस्त्वेष मे प्रोक्तः शंभुनाथेन दर्श्यते // 333
text_mt: possessing well-practiced knowledge is indeed the sole characteristic of a guru. / This classification, however, stated by me, is being shown by Śambhunātha.

sanskrit_iast:
mokṣajñānaparaḥ kuryādguruṃ svabhyastavedanam /
anyaṃ tyajetprāptamapi tathācoktaṃ śivena tat // 334
meaning:
मोक्षज्ञानपरः कुर्याद्गुरुं स्वभ्यस्तवेदनम् /
अन्यं त्यजेत्प्राप्तमपि तथाचोक्तं शिवेन तत् // 334
text_mt: One intent upon the knowledge of liberation should adopt a guru whose knowledge is well-practiced; / he should abandon any other, even if already attained. And so it was stated by Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
āmodārthī yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpātpuṣpāntaraṃ vrajet /
vijñānārthī tathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ vrajet // 335
meaning:
आमोदार्थी यथा भृङ्गः पुष्पात्पुष्पान्तरं व्रजेत् /
विज्ञानार्थी तथा शिष्यो गुरोर्गुर्वन्तरं व्रजेत् // 335
text_mt: 'Just as a bee in search of fragrance moves from flower to flower, / so a disciple in search of knowledge should move from guru to guru.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktihīnaṃ guruṃ prāpya mokṣajñāne kathaṃ śrayet /
naṣṭamūle drume devi kutaḥ puṣpaphalādikam // 336
meaning:
शक्तिहीनं गुरुं प्राप्य मोक्षज्ञाने कथं श्रयेत् /
नष्टमूले द्रुमे देवि कुतः पुष्पफलादिकम् // 336
text_mt: Having found a guru devoid of power, how could one resort to him for the knowledge of liberation? / When a tree has lost its roots, O goddess, whence can come flowers, fruits, and the like?'

sanskrit_iast:
uttarottaramutkarṣalakṣmīṃ paśyannapi sthitaḥ /
adhame yaḥ pade tasmātko'nyaḥ syāddaivadagdhakaḥ // 337
meaning:
उत्तरोत्तरमुत्कर्षलक्ष्मीं पश्यन्नपि स्थितः /
अधमे यः पदे तस्मात्कोऽन्यः स्याद्दैवदग्धकः // 337
text_mt: Even when perceiving the splendor of successively higher excellence, whoever remains / in a lower state—who else could be more cursed by fate than he?

sanskrit_iast:
yastu bhogaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca vāñchedvijñānameva ca /
svabhyastajñāninaṃ yogasiddhaṃ sa gurumāśrayet // 338
meaning:
यस्तु भोगं च मोक्षं च वाञ्छेद्विज्ञानमेव च /
स्वभ्यस्तज्ञानिनं योगसिद्धं स गुरुमाश्रयेत् // 338
text_mt: He, however, who desires both enjoyment and liberation, and knowledge as well, / should take refuge in a guru who possesses well-practiced knowledge and is perfected in yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
tadabhāve tu vijñānamokṣayorjñāninaṃ śrayet /
bhuktyaṃśe yoginaṃ yastatphalaṃ dātuṃ bhavetkṣamaḥ // 339
meaning:
तदभावे तु विज्ञानमोक्षयोर्ज्ञानिनं श्रयेत् /
भुक्त्यंशे योगिनं यस्तत्फलं दातुं भवेत्क्षमः // 339
text_mt: In the absence of such a one, he should resort to a knower for knowledge and liberation, / and, for the part of enjoyment, to a yogin who is capable of granting that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
phaladānākṣame yoginyapāyaikopadeśini /
varaṃ jñānī yo'bhyupāyaṃ diśedapica mocayet // 340
meaning:
फलदानाक्षमे योगिन्यपायैकोपदेशिनि /
वरं ज्ञानी योऽभ्युपायं दिशेदपिच मोचयेत् // 340
text_mt: When a yogin is incapable of giving the fruit and teaches only destructive practices, / better is a knower who points out the proper means and also liberates.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānī na pūrṇa evaiko yadi hyaṃśāṃśikākramāt /
jñānānyādāya vijñānaṃ kurvītākhaṇḍamaṇḍalam // 341
meaning:
ज्ञानी न पूर्ण एवैको यदि ह्यंशांशिकाक्रमात् /
ज्ञानान्यादाय विज्ञानं कुर्वीताखण्डमण्डलम् // 341
text_mt: If a single knower is not complete, then by receiving knowledges / through a gradual succession of portions, one should make one's knowledge an unbroken circle.

sanskrit_iast:
tenāsaṃkhyāngurūnkuryātpūraṇāya svasaṃvidaḥ /
dhanyastu pūrṇavijñānaṃ jñānārthī labhate gurum // 342
meaning:
तेनासंख्यान्गुरून्कुर्यात्पूरणाय स्वसंविदः /
धन्यस्तु पूर्णविज्ञानं ज्ञानार्थी लभते गुरुम् // 342
text_mt: For this reason, one should resort to countless gurus for the completion of one's consciousness; / but fortunate is the seeker of knowledge who finds a guru of complete knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāgurvāgamasrotaḥpratibhāmātramiśritam /
kṛtvā jñānārṇavaṃ svābhirvipruṅgiḥ plāvayenna kim // 343
meaning:
नानागुर्वागमस्रोतःप्रतिभामात्रमिश्रितम् /
कृत्वा ज्ञानार्णवं स्वाभिर्विप्रुङ्गिः प्लावयेन्न किम् // 343
text_mt: Having made an ocean of knowledge mingled only with the intuitive flash flowing from the traditions of diverse gurus, / why would one not inundate [the world] with one's own droplets?

sanskrit_iast:
ā tapanānmoṭakāntaṃ yasya me'sti gurukramaḥ /
tasya me sarvaśiṣyasya nopadeśadaridratā // 344
meaning:
आ तपनान्मोटकान्तं यस्य मेऽस्ति गुरुक्रमः /
तस्य मे सर्वशिष्यस्य नोपदेशदरिद्रता // 344
text_mt: 'For me, whose lineage of gurus extends from Tapana up to Moṭaka, / for me, who am a disciple of all, there is no poverty of instruction.'

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatā kallaṭenetthaṃ guruṇā tu nyarūpyata /
ahamapyata evādhaḥśāstradṛṣṭikutūhalāt // 345
meaning:
श्रीमता कल्लटेनेत्थं गुरुणा तु न्यरूप्यत /
अहमप्यत एवाधःशास्त्रदृष्टिकुतूहलात् // 345
text_mt: Thus indeed it was explained by the venerable guru Kallaṭa. / For this very reason, out of curiosity about the views of lower scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
tārkikaśrautabauddhārhadvaiṣṇavādīnnaseviṣi /
lokādhyātmātimārgādikarmayogavidhānataḥ // 346
meaning:
तार्किकश्रौतबौद्धार्हद्वैष्णवादीन्नसेविषि /
लोकाध्यात्मातिमार्गादिकर्मयोगविधानतः // 346
text_mt: I too served logicians, Vedāntins, Buddhists, Jainas, Vaiṣṇavas, and others, / following the injunctions of common, spiritual, and trans-path disciplines and rituals.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃbodhotkarṣabāhulyātkramotkṛṣṭānvibhāvayet /
śrīpūrvaśāstre praṣṭāro munayo nāradādayaḥ // 347
meaning:
संबोधोत्कर्षबाहुल्यात्क्रमोत्कृष्टान्विभावयेत् /
श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे प्रष्टारो मुनयो नारदादयः // 347
text_mt: One should contemplate those who are progressively higher by the abundance of the excellence of their awakening. / In the venerable Pūrvaśāstra, the questioning sages, Nārada and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvaiṣṇavāḥ saugatāśca siddhāntādividastataḥ /
kramāttrikārthavijñānacandrotsukitadṛṣṭayaḥ // 348
meaning:
प्राग्वैष्णवाः सौगताश्च सिद्धान्तादिविदस्ततः /
क्रमात्त्रिकार्थविज्ञानचन्द्रोत्सुकितदृष्टयः // 348
text_mt: were initially Vaiṣṇavas, then Buddhists, then knowers of the Siddhānta and the like, / whose vision was progressively eager for the moon of knowledge of the meaning of Trika.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānna gurubhūyastve viśaṅketa kadācana /
gurvantararate mūḍhe āgamāntarasevake // 349
meaning:
तस्मान्न गुरुभूयस्त्वे विशङ्केत कदाचन /
गुर्वन्तररते मूढे आगमान्तरसेवके // 349
text_mt: Therefore, one should never doubt the multiplicity of gurus. / For a fool who takes pleasure in an inferior guru and serves another scripture,

sanskrit_iast:
pratyavāyo ya āmnātaḥ sa itthamiti gṛhyatām /
yo yatra śāstre'dhikṛtaḥ sa tatra gururucyate // 350
meaning:
प्रत्यवायो य आम्नातः स इत्थमिति गृह्यताम् /
यो यत्र शास्त्रेऽधिकृतः स तत्र गुरुरुच्यते // 350
text_mt: the spiritual obstacle taught [in the scriptures] should be understood in this way: / he who is authorized in a given scripture is called the guru in that system;

sanskrit_iast:
tatrānadhikṛto yastu tadgurvantaramucyate /
yathā tanmaṇḍalāsīno maṇḍalāntarabhūpatim // 351
meaning:
तत्रानधिकृतो यस्तु तद्गुर्वन्तरमुच्यते /
यथा तन्मण्डलासीनो मण्डलान्तरभूपतिम् // 351
text_mt: he, however, who is not authorized therein is called 'another guru.' / Just as someone dwelling in a kingdom, wishing to conquer his own realm,

sanskrit_iast:
svamaṇḍalajigīṣuḥ sansevamāno vinaśyati /
tathottarottarajñānasiddhiprepsuḥ samāśrayan // 352
meaning:
स्वमण्डलजिगीषुः सन्सेवमानो विनश्यति /
तथोत्तरोत्तरज्ञानसिद्धिप्रेप्सुः समाश्रयन् // 352
text_mt: perishes if he serves the king of another realm, / so one who desires spiritual accomplishment through ever-higher knowledge, if he resorts

sanskrit_iast:
adharādharamācāryaṃ vināśamadhigacchati /
evamevordhvavartiṣṇorāgamātsiddhivāñchakaḥ // 353
meaning:
अधराधरमाचार्यं विनाशमधिगच्छति /
एवमेवोर्ध्ववर्तिष्णोरागमात्सिद्धिवाञ्छकः // 353
text_mt: to a lower and lower master, meets destruction. / In just this way, one who desires spiritual accomplishment from a higher-ranking scripture,

sanskrit_iast:
māyīyaśāstranirato vināśaṃ pratipadyate /
uktaṃ ca śrīmadānande karma saṃśritya bhāvataḥ // 354
meaning:
मायीयशास्त्रनिरतो विनाशं प्रतिपद्यते /
उक्तं च श्रीमदानन्दे कर्म संश्रित्य भावतः // 354
text_mt: if devoted to a scripture belonging to Māyā, meets with destruction. / And it is stated in the venerable Ānanda[gahvara]: 'Resorting earnestly to a ritual action,

sanskrit_iast:
jugupsate tattasmiṃśca viphale'nyatsamāśrayet /
dināddinaṃ hrasaṃstvevaṃ pacyate rauravādiṣu // 355
meaning:
जुगुप्सते तत्तस्मिंश्च विफलेऽन्यत्समाश्रयेत् /
दिनाद्दिनं ह्रसंस्त्वेवं पच्यते रौरवादिषु // 355
text_mt: one despises that [system], and when that fails, one resorts to another. / Declining thus day by day, one is cooked in the Raurava and other hells.'

sanskrit_iast:
yastūrdhvordhvapathaprepsuradharaṃ gurumāgamam /
jihāsecchaktipātena sa dhanyaḥ pronmukhīkṛtaḥ // 356
meaning:
यस्तूर्ध्वोर्ध्वपथप्रेप्सुरधरं गुरुमागमम् /
जिहासेच्छक्तिपातेन स धन्यः प्रोन्मुखीकृतः // 356
text_mt: He, on the other hand, who, desiring an ever-higher path, wishes to abandon / a lower guru and scripture by virtue of a descent of power, is blessed and oriented upward.

sanskrit_iast:
ata eveha śāstreṣu śaiveṣveva nirūpyate /
śāstrāntarārthānāśvastānprati saṃskārako vidhiḥ // 357
meaning:
अत एवेह शास्त्रेषु शैवेष्वेव निरूप्यते /
शास्त्रान्तरार्थानाश्वस्तान्प्रति संस्कारको विधिः // 357
text_mt: For this very reason, in the Śaiva scriptures alone is set forth / a transformative ritual procedure for those who have gained trust in the doctrines of other scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
ataścāpyuttamaṃ śaivaṃ yo'nyatra patitaḥ sahi /
ihānugrāhya ūrdhvordhvaṃ netastu patitaḥ kvacit // 358
meaning:
अतश्चाप्युत्तमं शैवं योऽन्यत्र पतितः सहि /
इहानुग्राह्य ऊर्ध्वोर्ध्वं नेतस्तु पतितः क्वचित् // 358
text_mt: And for this reason, Śaivism is supreme: one who has fallen elsewhere / is to be graced here, but one brought higher and higher here is never fallen anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva hi sarvajñairbrahmaviṣṇvādibhirnije /
na śāsane samāmnātaṃ liṅgoddhārādi kiṃcana // 359
meaning:
अत एव हि सर्वज्ञैर्ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिभिर्निजे /
न शासने समाम्नातं लिङ्गोद्धारादि किंचन // 359
text_mt: Indeed, for this very reason, nothing such as the extraction of the insignia / is taught by the omniscient Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and others in their own doctrine.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ viṣṇvādayaḥ śaivaparamārthaikavedinaḥ /
kāṃścitprati tathādikṣuste mohādvimatiṃ śritāḥ // 360
meaning:
इत्थं विष्ण्वादयः शैवपरमार्थैकवेदिनः /
कांश्चित्प्रति तथादिक्षुस्ते मोहाद्विमतिं श्रिताः // 360
text_mt: Thus Viṣṇu and others, who know solely the ultimate reality of Śiva, / initiated certain individuals in that manner, having resorted to divergence out of delusion.

sanskrit_iast:
tathāvidhāmeva matiṃ satyasaṃsparśanākṣamām /
dṛṣṭvaiṣāṃ brahmaviṣṇvādyairbuddhairapi tathoditam // 361
ityeṣa yuktyāgamataḥ śaktipāto vivecitaḥ /
meaning:
तथाविधामेव मतिं सत्यसंस्पर्शनाक्षमाम् /
दृष्ट्वैषां ब्रह्मविष्ण्वाद्यैर्बुद्धैरपि तथोदितम् // 361
इत्येष युक्त्यागमतः शक्तिपातो विवेचितः /
text_mt:
Seeing that their intellect was precisely of that kind, incapable of contacting the truth, / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and even the Buddhas spoke in that way.
In this way, the descent of power has been analyzed through reasoning and scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
tirobhāvasvarūpaṃ tu kathyamānaṃ vivicyatām /
svabhāvāt parameśāno niyatyaniyatikramam // 1
meaning:
तिरोभावस्वरूपं तु कथ्यमानं विविच्यताम् /
स्वभावात् परमेशानो नियत्यनियतिक्रमम् // 1
text_mt: Now let the essential nature of concealment, as it is being explained, be discerned: / By his nature, the Supreme Lord, [freely] touching
title: Dīkṣopakramaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
spṛśanprakāśate yena tataḥ svacchanda ucyate /
niyatiṃ karmaphalayorāśrityaiṣa maheśvaraḥ // 2
meaning:
स्पृशन्प्रकाशते येन ततः स्वच्छन्द उच्यते /
नियतिं कर्मफलयोराश्रित्यैष महेश्वरः // 2
text_mt: the succession of necessity and non-necessity, shines forth; therefore he is called Autonomous. / Having resorted to necessity with regard to action and its fruit, this Great Lord

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānvidhatte'vāntarasthitīn /
mahāsarge punaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārānantyaśālini // 3
meaning:
सृष्टिसंस्थितिसंहारान्विधत्तेऽवान्तरस्थितीन् /
महासर्गे पुनः सृष्टिसंहारानन्त्यशालिनि // 3
text_mt: brings about emanation, stasis, and dissolution, which are intermediate states. / In the great creation, moreover, which is endowed with an endlessness of emanation and dissolution,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaḥ sa devo viśvātmā niyatityāgataḥ prabhuḥ /
avāntare yā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiścātrāpyayantritam // 4
meaning:
एकः स देवो विश्वात्मा नियतित्यागतः प्रभुः /
अवान्तरे या च सृष्टिः स्थितिश्चात्राप्ययन्त्रितम् // 4
text_mt: that sole god, whose self is all, is the sovereign Lord through the renunciation of necessity. / And during intermediate emanation and stasis, he remains unconstrained here,

sanskrit_iast:
nojjhatyeṣa vapustyaktaniyatiśca sthito'tra tat /
niyatyaiva yadā caiṣa svarūpācchādanakramāt // 5
meaning:
नोज्झत्येष वपुस्त्यक्तनियतिश्च स्थितोऽत्र तत् /
नियत्यैव यदा चैष स्वरूपाच्छादनक्रमात् // 5
text_mt: not abandoning this form, having abandoned necessity. / And when, precisely through necessity, by the process of veiling his own nature,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuṅkte duḥkhavimohādi tadā karmaphalakramaḥ /
tyaktvā tu niyamaṃ kārmaṃ duḥkhamohaparītatām // 6
meaning:
भुङ्क्ते दुःखविमोहादि तदा कर्मफलक्रमः /
त्यक्त्वा तु नियमं कार्मं दुःखमोहपरीतताम् // 6
text_mt: he experiences suffering, delusion, and so forth, that is the sequence of the fruit of action. / But having abandoned the rule born of action, desiring to manifest the state of being beset by suffering and delusion,

sanskrit_iast:
bibhāsayiṣurāste'yaṃ tirodhāne'napekṣakaḥ /
yathā prakāśasvātantryāt pratibuddho'pyabuddhavat // 7
meaning:
बिभासयिषुरास्तेऽयं तिरोधानेऽनपेक्षकः /
यथा प्रकाशस्वातन्त्र्यात् प्रतिबुद्धोऽप्यबुद्धवत् // 7
text_mt: he abides independent in concealment. / Just as, through the absolute autonomy of luminosity, an awakened person remains like an unawakened one,

sanskrit_iast:
āste tadvadanuttīrṇo'pyuttīrṇa iva ceṣṭate /
yathā ca buddhastāṃ mūḍhaceṣṭāṃ kurvannapi dviṣan // 8
meaning:
आस्ते तद्वदनुत्तीर्णोऽप्युत्तीर्ण इव चेष्टते /
यथा च बुद्धस्तां मूढचेष्टां कुर्वन्नपि द्विषन् // 8
text_mt: so one who has not crossed over acts as if he has crossed over. / And just as an awakened one, even while performing the behavior of a fool, hating it,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdyāste mūḍha evaṃ hi prabuddhānāṃ viceṣṭitam /
śrīvidyādhipatiścāha mānastotre tadīdṛśam // 9
meaning:
हृद्यास्ते मूढ एवं हि प्रबुद्धानां विचेष्टितम् /
श्रीविद्याधिपतिश्चाह मानस्तोत्रे तदीदृशम् // 9
text_mt: remains in the heart a fool, such indeed is the behavior of the awakened. / And the venerable Vidyādhipati said thus in the Mānastotra:

sanskrit_iast:
ye yauṣmāke śāsanamārge kṛtadīkṣāḥ saṃgacchanto mohavaśādvipratipattim /
nūnaṃ teṣā nāsti bhavadbhānuniyogaḥ saṅkocaḥ kiṃ sūryakaraistāmarasānām // 10
meaning:
ये यौष्माके शासनमार्गे कृतदीक्षाः संगच्छन्तो मोहवशाद्विप्रतिपत्तिम् /
नूनं तेषा नास्ति भवद्भानुनियोगः सङ्कोचः किं सूर्यकरैस्तामरसानाम् // 10
text_mt: 'Those who, having received initiation in your doctrinal path, fall into error under the sway of delusion— / surely upon them there is no dispensation from your sun: does the lotus contract because of the sun's rays?

sanskrit_iast:
jñātajñeyā dhātṛpadasthā api santo ye tvanmārgātkāpathagāste'pi na samyaka /
prāyasteṣāṃ laiṅgikabuddhyādisamuttho mithyābodhaḥ sarpavasādīpajakalpaḥ // 11
meaning:
ज्ञातज्ञेया धातृपदस्था अपि सन्तो ये त्वन्मार्गात्कापथगास्तेऽपि न सम्यक /
प्रायस्तेषां लैङ्गिकबुद्ध्यादिसमुत्थो मिथ्याबोधः सर्पवसादीपजकल्पः // 11
text_mt: Even those who, having known what is to be known, abide in the state of the Creator, yet deviate from your path to wrong paths, do not [see] rightly; / mostly, their false awareness arising from inferential intellect and the like is like a lamp made of snake-fat.

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādviddhaṃ sūtakamukhyena nu tāmraṃ tadyadbhūyaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ no samupeyāt /
no taiḥ pītaṃ bhūtalasaṃsthairamṛtaṃ tadyeṣāṃ tṛṭkṣudduḥkhavibādhāḥ punarasmin // 12
meaning:
यस्माद्विद्धं सूतकमुख्येन नु ताम्रं तद्यद्भूयः स्वां प्रकृतिं नो समुपेयात् /
नो तैः पीतं भूतलसंस्थैरमृतं तद्येषां तृट्क्षुद्दुःखविबाधाः पुनरस्मिन् // 12
text_mt: For just as copper transmuted by supreme quicksilver does not return to its original nature, / so nectar was not drunk by those dwelling on earth in whom thirst, hunger, pain, and affliction arise once more.'

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ prabuddhaceṣṭāsau mantracaryārcanādikā /
dveṣeddhāntardahatyenaṃ dāhaḥ śaṅkaiva sā yataḥ // 13
meaning:
ततः प्रबुद्धचेष्टासौ मन्त्रचर्यार्चनादिका /
द्वेषेद्धान्तर्दहत्येनं दाहः शङ्कैव सा यतः // 13
text_mt: Therefore, this behavior of an awakened person—practice of mantras, worship, and the like— / burns him inwardly, inflamed by hatred, since that burning is nothing but doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
na cāsya karmamahimā tādṛgyenetthamāsta saḥ /
kiṃ hi tatkarma kasmādvā pūrveṇātra samo vidhiḥ // 14
meaning:
न चास्य कर्ममहिमा तादृग्येनेत्थमास्त सः /
किं हि तत्कर्म कस्माद्वा पूर्वेणात्र समो विधिः // 14
text_mt: Nor is there such majesty of his past action by which he would remain thus; / for what is that action, or whence does it arise? The rule here is the same as before.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsā parameśecchā yayāyaṃ mohitastathā /
anantakālasaṃvedyaduḥkhapātratvamīhate // 15
meaning:
तस्मात्सा परमेशेच्छा ययायं मोहितस्तथा /
अनन्तकालसंवेद्यदुःखपात्रत्वमीहते // 15
text_mt: Therefore, it is the will of the Supreme Lord by which he has been so deluded / that he desires the status of a vessel of suffering to be experienced for endless time.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi cecchāvaicitryādihāmutrobhayātmakaḥ /
duḥkhasyāpi vibhedo'sti ciraśaighryakṛtastathā // 16
meaning:
तत्रापि चेच्छावैचित्र्यादिहामुत्रोभयात्मकः /
दुःखस्यापि विभेदोऽस्ति चिरशैघ्र्यकृतस्तथा // 16
text_mt: Even there, due to the diversity of will, there is a distinction of suffering / pertaining to this world, the next, or both, as well as caused by slowness or quickness.

sanskrit_iast:
kālakāmāndhakādīnāṃ paulastyapuravāsinām /
tathānyeṣāṃ tirobhāvastāvadduḥkho hyamutra ca // 17
meaning:
कालकामान्धकादीनां पौलस्त्यपुरवासिनाम् /
तथान्येषां तिरोभावस्तावद्दुःखो ह्यमुत्र च // 17
text_mt: Concealment for Kāla, Kāma, Andhaka, and others, as well as for the inhabitants of Rāvaṇa's city / and others, is suffering both here and in the hereafter.

sanskrit_iast:
anyo'pi ca tirobhāvaḥ samayollaṅghanātmakaḥ /
yaduktaṃ parameśena śrīmadānandagahvare // 18
meaning:
अन्योऽपि च तिरोभावः समयोल्लङ्घनात्मकः /
यदुक्तं परमेशेन श्रीमदानन्दगह्वरे // 18
text_mt: There is also another concealment consisting of the transgression of the rule, / as stated by the Supreme Lord in the venerable Ānandagahvara:

sanskrit_iast:
samayollaṅghanāddevi kravyādatvaṃ śataṃ samāḥ /
tatrāpi mandatīvrādibhedādbahuvidhaḥ kramaḥ // 19
meaning:
समयोल्लङ्घनाद्देवि क्रव्यादत्वं शतं समाः /
तत्रापि मन्दतीव्रादिभेदाद्बहुविधः क्रमः // 19
text_mt: 'O Goddess, from the transgression of the rule one becomes a flesh-eating demon for a hundred years.' / There too, the sequence is of many kinds according to the divisions of slow, intense, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
svātantryācca maheśasya tirobhūto'pyasau svayam /
paradvāreṇa vābhyeti bhūyo'nugrahamapyalam // 20
meaning:
स्वातन्त्र्याच्च महेशस्य तिरोभूतोऽप्यसौ स्वयम् /
परद्वारेण वाभ्येति भूयोऽनुग्रहमप्यलम् // 20
text_mt: And by the absolute autonomy of the Great Lord, even having been concealed, he himself / or through an intermediary fully attains grace once again.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūyo'nugrahataḥ prāyaścittādyācaraṇe sati /
anusāreṇa dīkṣādau kṛte syācchivatāmayaḥ // 21
meaning:
भूयोऽनुग्रहतः प्रायश्चित्ताद्याचरणे सति /
अनुसारेण दीक्षादौ कृते स्याच्छिवतामयः // 21
text_mt: From grace once again, when expiation and the like are performed, / and when initiation and so forth are performed accordingly, he will be composed of the state of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
tirobhūtaḥ paretāsurapi bandhusuhṛdgurūn /
ālambya śaktipātena dīkṣādyairanugṛhyate // 22
meaning:
तिरोभूतः परेतासुरपि बन्धुसुहृद्गुरून् /
आलम्ब्य शक्तिपातेन दीक्षाद्यैरनुगृह्यते // 22
text_mt: One who has been concealed, even when his breath has departed, is graced / through a descent of power by means of initiation and the like, resorting to relatives, friends, or gurus.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāpi kālaśīghratvaciratvādivibhedatām /
tathaiti śaktipāto'sau yenāyāti śivātmatām // 23
meaning:
तत्रापि कालशीघ्रत्वचिरत्वादिविभेदताम् /
तथैति शक्तिपातोऽसौ येनायाति शिवात्मताम् // 23
text_mt: There too, that descent of power attains distinctions such as quickness or delay of time, / by means of which he attains the state of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsatirobhāvamanugrahaḥ /
iti pañcasu kartṛtvaṃ śivatvaṃ saṃvidātmanaḥ // 24
meaning:
इत्थं सृष्टिस्थितिध्वंसतिरोभावमनुग्रहः /
इति पञ्चसु कर्तृत्वं शिवत्वं संविदात्मनः // 24
text_mt: Thus, agency in the five [cosmic acts]—emanation, stasis, dissolution, concealment, / and grace—is the state of Śiva belonging to the self of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcakṛtyasvatantratvasaṃpūrṇasvātmamāninaḥ /
yogino'rcājapadhyānayogāḥ saṃsyuḥ sadoditāḥ // 25
meaning:
पञ्चकृत्यस्वतन्त्रत्वसंपूर्णस्वात्ममानिनः /
योगिनोऽर्चाजपध्यानयोगाः संस्युः सदोदिताः // 25
text_mt: For a yogin who regards his own self as complete in autonomy regarding the five acts, / worship, recitation, meditation, and yoga are ever-risen.

sanskrit_iast:
aindrajālikavṛttānte na rajyeta kadācana /
sādāśivo'pi yo bhogo bandhaḥ so'pyucitātmanām // 26
meaning:
ऐन्द्रजालिकवृत्तान्ते न रज्येत कदाचन /
सादाशिवोऽपि यो भोगो बन्धः सोऽप्युचितात्मनाम् // 26
text_mt: He would never take pleasure in the condition of a magician; / even that enjoyment which belongs to Sadāśiva is bondage for those of worthy nature.

sanskrit_iast:
jñātṛtvameva śivatā svātantryaṃ tadihocyate /
kulālavattu kartṛtvaṃ na mukhyaṃ tadadhiṣṭhiteḥ // 27
meaning:
ज्ञातृत्वमेव शिवता स्वातन्त्र्यं तदिहोच्यते /
कुलालवत्तु कर्तृत्वं न मुख्यं तदधिष्ठितेः // 27
text_mt: The state of being the knower is alone the state of Śiva; that is here called absolute autonomy. / Agency like that of a potter is not primary, because it is presided over by that [knower].

sanskrit_iast:
iti jñātvā grahītavyā naiva jātvapi khaṇḍanā /
śivo'haṃ cenmadicchānuvarti kiṃ na jagattviti // 28
meaning:
इति ज्ञात्वा ग्रहीतव्या नैव जात्वपि खण्डना /
शिवोऽहं चेन्मदिच्छानुवर्ति किं न जगत्त्विति // 28
text_mt: Knowing thus, one must never accept the objection: / 'If I am Śiva, why does the universe not conform to my will?'

sanskrit_iast:
mamecchāmanuvartantāmityatrāhaṃvidi sphuret /
śivo vā parameśāno dehādiratha nirmitaḥ // 29
meaning:
ममेच्छामनुवर्तन्तामित्यत्राहंविदि स्फुरेत् /
शिवो वा परमेशानो देहादिरथ निर्मितः // 29
text_mt: When one thinks 'let [all] conform to my will,' in that consciousness of 'I' / what shines forth—Śiva, the Supreme Lord, or the body and so forth fashioned [by him]?

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya tāvadastyetaddehastveṣa tathā tvayā /
kṛtaḥ kānyā dehatāsya tatkiṃ syādvācyatāpadam // 30
meaning:
शिवस्य तावदस्त्येतद्देहस्त्वेष तथा त्वया /
कृतः कान्या देहतास्य तत्किं स्याद्वाच्यतापदम् // 30
text_mt: This [conformity] indeed belongs to Śiva; but this body was made in that way by you. / What other bodily nature does it have, that it should be an object of speech [as independent]?

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca siddhasantānaśrīmadūrmimahākule /
pavanabhramaṇaprāṇavikṣepādikṛtaśramāḥ // 31
meaning:
उक्तं च सिद्धसन्तानश्रीमदूर्मिमहाकुले /
पवनभ्रमणप्राणविक्षेपादिकृतश्रमाः // 31
text_mt: And it is said in the venerable Ūrmimahākula of the lineage of the Siddhas: / 'Those who have exerted themselves in circulating the breath, scattering the vital air, and the like,'

sanskrit_iast:
kuhakādiṣu ye bhrāntāste bhrāntāḥ parame pade /
sarvatra bahumānena yāpyutkrāntirvimuktaye // 32
meaning:
कुहकादिषु ये भ्रान्तास्ते भ्रान्ताः परमे पदे /
सर्वत्र बहुमानेन याप्युत्क्रान्तिर्विमुक्तये // 32
text_mt: Those who are bewildered by jugglery and the like are deluded with regard to the supreme state. / The yogic transit which, being respected everywhere, is taught for liberation

sanskrit_iast:
proktā sā sāraśāstreṣu bhogopāyatayoditā /
yadi sarvagatā devo vadotkramya kva yāsyati // 33
meaning:
प्रोक्ता सा सारशास्त्रेषु भोगोपायतयोदिता /
यदि सर्वगता देवो वदोत्क्रम्य क्व यास्यति // 33
text_mt: is explained in the essential scriptures as a means to enjoyment. / If the deity is omnipresent, tell [me]: having departed, where will he go?

sanskrit_iast:
athāsarvagatastarhi ghaṭatulyastadā bhavet /
utkrāntividhiyogo'yamekadeśena kathyate // 34
meaning:
अथासर्वगतस्तर्हि घटतुल्यस्तदा भवेत् /
उत्क्रान्तिविधियोगोऽयमेकदेशेन कथ्यते // 34
text_mt: If, on the other hand, he is not omnipresent, then he would be like a pot. / This application of the rule of yogic transit is spoken of in relation to a limited realm;

sanskrit_iast:
niraṃśe śivatattve tu kathamutkrāntisaṃgatiḥ /
yathā dharādau vāyvante bhṛgvambvagnyupavāsakaiḥ // 35
meaning:
निरंशे शिवतत्त्वे तु कथमुत्क्रान्तिसंगतिः /
यथा धरादौ वाय्वन्ते भृग्वम्ब्वग्न्युपवासकैः // 35
text_mt: how, however, could yogic transit apply to the partless level of Śiva? / Just as in [the elements] beginning with earth and ending with wind, through [falling from] a cliff, water, fire, or fasting,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano yojanaṃ vyomni tadvadutkrāntivartanā /
tasmānnotkramayejjīvaṃ paratattvasamīhayā // 36
meaning:
आत्मनो योजनं व्योम्नि तद्वदुत्क्रान्तिवर्तना /
तस्मान्नोत्क्रमयेज्जीवं परतत्त्वसमीहया // 36
text_mt: there is the conjoining of the self to space, so operates yogic transit; / therefore, one should not cause the individual soul to depart out of a longing for the supreme reality.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpūrvaśāstre tūktaṃ yadutkrānterlakṣaṇaṃ na tat /
muktyupāyatayā kiṃtu bhogahānyai tathaiṣaṇāt // 37
meaning:
श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे तूक्तं यदुत्क्रान्तेर्लक्षणं न तत् /
मुक्त्युपायतया किंतु भोगहान्यै तथैषणात् // 37
text_mt: What is stated in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra as the definition of yogic transit, however, is not that / as a means to liberation, but rather for the abandonment of enjoyment, because such is [the practitioner's] desire:

sanskrit_iast:
japadhyānādisaṃsiddhaḥ svātantryācchaktipātataḥ /
bhogaṃ prati viraktaśceditthaṃ dehaṃ tyajediti // 38
meaning:
जपध्यानादिसंसिद्धः स्वातन्त्र्याच्छक्तिपाततः /
भोगं प्रति विरक्तश्चेदित्थं देहं त्यजेदिति // 38
text_mt: one who is accomplished through recitation, meditation, and so forth, out of absolute autonomy due to the descent of power, / if he has become detached from enjoyment, may thus abandon the body.

sanskrit_iast:
svacchandamṛtyorapi yad bhīṣmādeḥ śrūyate kila /
bhogavairasyasaṃprāptau jīvitāntopasarpaṇam // 39
meaning:
स्वच्छन्दमृत्योरपि यद् भीष्मादेः श्रूयते किल /
भोगवैरस्यसंप्राप्तौ जीवितान्तोपसर्पणम् // 39
text_mt: Indeed, even regarding those of voluntary death such as Bhīṣma, it is heard / that recourse to the end of life occurs when a distaste for enjoyment is attained.

sanskrit_iast:
yogamantrāmṛtadravyavarādyaiḥ siddhibhāktanuḥ /
hātuṃ nahyanyathā śakyā vinoktakramayogataḥ // 40
meaning:
योगमन्त्रामृतद्रव्यवराद्यैः सिद्धिभाक्तनुः /
हातुं नह्यन्यथा शक्या विनोक्तक्रमयोगतः // 40
text_mt: A body endowed with spiritual accomplishment through yoga, mantras, nectar, excellent substances, and so forth, / can certainly not be abandoned otherwise than by the application of the stated method.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ ca mālinītantre parameśena tādṛśam /
sarvamapyathavā bhogaṃ manyamāno virūpakam // 41
meaning:
उक्तं च मालिनीतन्त्रे परमेशेन तादृशम् /
सर्वमप्यथवा भोगं मन्यमानो विरूपकम् // 41
text_mt: And in the Mālinītantra such was spoken by the Supreme Lord: / "Or else, considering all enjoyment to be deformed,"

sanskrit_iast:
ityādi vadatā sarvairalakṣyāntaḥsatattvakam /
evaṃ sṛṣṭyādikartavyasvasvātantryopadeśanam // 42
meaning:
इत्यादि वदता सर्वैरलक्ष्यान्तःसतत्त्वकम् /
एवं सृष्ट्यादिकर्तव्यस्वस्वातन्त्र्योपदेशनम् // 42
text_mt: and so forth. Saying this, whose inner reality is imperceptible to all, / [the guru gives] the instruction in one's own absolute autonomy regarding what is to be done, such as emission and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
yatsaiva mukhyadīkṣā syācchiṣyasya śivadāyinī /
uktaṃ śrīniśicāre ca bhairavīyeṇa tejasā // 43
meaning:
यत्सैव मुख्यदीक्षा स्याच्छिष्यस्य शिवदायिनी /
उक्तं श्रीनिशिचारे च भैरवीयेण तेजसा // 43
text_mt: which very [instruction] is the principal initiation that bestows Śiva upon the disciple. / And it is said in the venerable Niśicāra: "By Bhairava's radiance

sanskrit_iast:
vyāptaṃ viśvaṃ prapaśyanti vikalpojjhitacetasaḥ /
vikalpayuktacittastu piṇḍapātācchivaṃ vrajet // 44
meaning:
व्याप्तं विश्वं प्रपश्यन्ति विकल्पोज्झितचेतसः /
विकल्पयुक्तचित्तस्तु पिण्डपाताच्छिवं व्रजेत् // 44
text_mt: those whose minds are free of conceptual constructs behold the universe as pervaded. / But one whose mind is endowed with conceptual constructs attains Śiva upon the falling of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyadīkṣādiyogena caryāsamayakalpanaiḥ /
avikalpastathādyaiva jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ // 45
meaning:
बाह्यदीक्षादियोगेन चर्यासमयकल्पनैः /
अविकल्पस्तथाद्यैव जीवन्मुक्तो न संशयः // 45
text_mt: Through the conjunction of external initiation and the like, by the arrangements of conduct and the rule, / one becomes non-conceptual, and thus is liberated while living this very day, without doubt."

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārajīrṇatarumūlakalāpakalpasaṃkalpasāntaratayā paramārthavahneḥ /
syurvisphuliṅgakaṇikā api cettadante dedīpyate vimalabodhahutāśarāśiḥ // 46
itthaṃ dīkṣopakramo'yaṃ darśitaḥ śāstrasaṃmataḥ /
meaning:
संसारजीर्णतरुमूलकलापकल्पसंकल्पसान्तरतया परमार्थवह्नेः /
स्युर्विस्फुलिङ्गकणिका अपि चेत्तदन्ते देदीप्यते विमलबोधहुताशराशिः // 46
इत्थं दीक्षोपक्रमोऽयं दर्शितः शास्त्रसंमतः /
text_mt:
Even if, because thoughts like the cluster of roots of the withered tree of worldly existence intervene, / there are merely sparks from the fire of ultimate reality, at the end of that shines forth a blazing heap of the fire of spotless consciousness.
Thus this introduction to initiation, conforming to the scriptures, has been shown.

sanskrit_iast:
athaitadupayogāya yāgastāvannirūpyate /
tatra dīkṣaiva bhoge ca muktau cāyātyupāyatām // 1
meaning:
अथैतदुपयोगाय यागस्तावन्निरूप्यते /
तत्र दीक्षैव भोगे च मुक्तौ चायात्युपायताम् // 1
text_mt: Now, for the purpose of this, sacrificial worship is first described; / in that context, initiation alone comes to serve as the means both to enjoyment and to liberation.
title: Samayadīkṣāprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
svayaṃ saṃskārayogādvā tadaṅgaṃ tatpradarśyate /
yo yatrābhilaṣedbhogān sa tatraiva niyojitaḥ // 2
meaning:
स्वयं संस्कारयोगाद्वा तदङ्गं तत्प्रदर्श्यते /
यो यत्राभिलषेद्भोगान् स तत्रैव नियोजितः // 2
text_mt: Either spontaneously or through purification, that subordinate element is shown: / wherever one desires enjoyments, there he is conjoined,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhibhāṅmantraśaktyeti śrīmatsvāyaṃbhuve vibhuḥ /
yogyatāvaśato yatra vāsanā yasya tatra saḥ // 3
meaning:
सिद्धिभाङ्मन्त्रशक्त्येति श्रीमत्स्वायंभुवे विभुः /
योग्यतावशतो यत्र वासना यस्य तत्र सः // 3
text_mt: sharing in spiritual accomplishment through the power of mantras—thus the all-pervading Lord in the venerable Svāyambhuva. / Under the influence of capacity, where one's latent impression lies, there he

sanskrit_iast:
yojyo na cyavate tasmāditi śrīmālinīmate /
vadanbhogādyupāyatvaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ prāha no guruḥ // 4
meaning:
योज्यो न च्यवते तस्मादिति श्रीमालिनीमते /
वदन्भोगाद्युपायत्वं दीक्षायाः प्राह नो गुरुः // 4
text_mt: is to be conjoined; he does not fall from that—thus in the venerable doctrine of the Mālinī. / Stating that initiation is the means to enjoyment and the like, our guru said:

sanskrit_iast:
na cādhikāritā dīkṣāṃ vinā yoge'sti śāṅkare /
na ca yogādhikāritvamekamevānayā bhavet // 5
meaning:
न चाधिकारिता दीक्षां विना योगेऽस्ति शाङ्करे /
न च योगाधिकारित्वमेकमेवानया भवेत् // 5
