text_mt: One should complete the consecrations of the fire through the full oblation. / Blazing thus with the brilliance of true volition conjoined with the lord of mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
vahnistacchivasaṃkalpatādātmyācchivatātmakaḥ /
ityetatsaṃskriyātattvaṃ śrīśaṃbhurme nyarūpayat // 408
meaning:
वह्निस्तच्छिवसंकल्पतादात्म्याच्छिवतात्मकः /
इत्येतत्संस्क्रियातत्त्वं श्रीशंभुर्मे न्यरूपयत् // 408
text_mt: The fire has the nature of Śiva-ness through identity with that volition of Śiva. / In this way, illustrious Śambhu explained to me the true reality of the consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
mayāpi darśitaṃ śuddhabuddhayaḥ praviviñcatām /
tenātra ye codayanti yathā bālasya saṃskriyā // 409
meaning:
मयापि दर्शितं शुद्धबुद्धयः प्रविविञ्चताम् /
तेनात्र ये चोदयन्ति यथा बालस्य संस्क्रिया // 409
text_mt: I too have shown it; let those of pure intellect examine it closely. / Therefore, as to those who object here: "Just as a child has consecration,

sanskrit_iast:
bahnau vahnestathānyatretyanavasthaiva saṃskṛteḥ /
te nirutthānavihatā naye'smingurudarśane // 410
meaning:
बह्नौ वह्नेस्तथान्यत्रेत्यनवस्थैव संस्कृतेः /
ते निरुत्थानविहता नयेऽस्मिन्गुरुदर्शने // 410
text_mt: In a fire, [and that] of a fire in another [fire], so there would be an infinite regress of consecration"— / they are silenced and refuted in this system, the doctrine of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
jāte'gnau saṃskṛte śaive śabdarāśiṃ ca mālinīm /
pitarau pūjayitvā svaṃ śuddhaṃ dhāma visarjayet // 411
meaning:
जातेऽग्नौ संस्कृते शैवे शब्दराशिं च मालिनीम् /
पितरौ पूजयित्वा स्वं शुद्धं धाम विसर्जयेत् // 411
text_mt: When the Śaiva fire has been born and consecrated, having worshipped the aggregate of phonemes and Mālinī / as the two parents, one should dismiss them to their own pure abode.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhāgnerbhāgamādāya carvarthaṃ sthāpayetpṛthak /
athavāgneḥ śikhāṃ vāmaprāṇenādāya hṛjjuṣā // 412
meaning:
शुद्धाग्नेर्भागमादाय चर्वर्थं स्थापयेत्पृथक् /
अथवाग्नेः शिखां वामप्राणेनादाय हृज्जुषा // 412
text_mt: Taking a portion of the pure fire, one should set it aside for the caru. / Or, taking a flame of the fire by means of the left breath dwelling in the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
cidagninaikyamānīya kṣipeddakṣeṇa saṃskṛtām /
śiva ityabhimānena dṛḍhena hi vilokanam // 413
meaning:
चिदग्निनैक्यमानीय क्षिपेद्दक्षेण संस्कृताम् /
शिव इत्यभिमानेन दृढेन हि विलोकनम् // 413
text_mt: Bringing it to unity with the fire of consciousness, one should cast it, consecrated, with the right [breath]. / For looking upon [everything] with the firm conviction: "This is Śiva,"

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasya saṃskriyā tattvaṃ tattasmai yadyato'malam /
navāhutīratho dadyānnavātmasahitena tu // 414
meaning:
सर्वस्य संस्क्रिया तत्त्वं तत्तस्मै यद्यतोऽमलम् /
नवाहुतीरथो दद्यान्नवात्मसहितेन तु // 414
text_mt: Is the true consecration of everything, since reality for him is pure because of that. / Then one should offer nine oblations with the Navātman [mantra],

sanskrit_iast:
śivāgnaye tārapūrvaṃ svāhāntaṃ saṃskriyā bhavet /
śivacaitanyasāmānyavyoparūpe'nale tataḥ // 415
meaning:
शिवाग्नये तारपूर्वं स्वाहान्तं संस्क्रिया भवेत् /
शिवचैतन्यसामान्यव्योपरूपेऽनले ततः // 415
text_mt: Preceded by Tāra and ending in svāhā, to the fire of Śiva; that constitutes the consecration. / Then, in the fire whose nature is the universal ether of the consciousness of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvadādhāramādheyaṃ devīcakraṃ ca yojayet /
sruvaṃ srucaṃ ca saṃpaśyedadhovaktrau kramādguruḥ // 416
meaning:
प्राग्वदाधारमाधेयं देवीचक्रं च योजयेत् /
स्रुवं स्रुचं च संपश्येदधोवक्त्रौ क्रमाद्गुरुः // 416
text_mt: The guru should unite the support, that which is supported, and the circle of goddesses as before. / He should look upon the ladles sruva and sruc turned downward in succession,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktitayābhyarcyau tathetthaṃ saṃskriyānayoḥ /
tattvasaṃdarśanānnānyatsaṃskārasyāsti jīvitam // 417
meaning:
शिवशक्तितयाभ्यर्च्यौ तथेत्थं संस्क्रियानयोः /
तत्त्वसंदर्शनान्नान्यत्संस्कारस्यास्ति जीवितम् // 417
text_mt: To be worshipped as Śiva and Śakti. Thus is the consecration of the two; / for the life of a consecration is nothing other than the direct vision of reality.

sanskrit_iast:
iti vaktuṃ sruvādīśaḥ śrīpūrve na samaskarot /
tatastilairmṛgīṃ madhyānāmāṅguṣṭhavaśādguruḥ // 418
meaning:
इति वक्तुं स्रुवादीशः श्रीपूर्वे न समस्करोत् /
ततस्तिलैर्मृगीं मध्यानामाङ्गुष्ठवशाद्गुरुः // 418
text_mt: To declare this, the Lord did not consecrate the sruva and so forth in the illustrious Pūrva [śāstra]. / Then, forming the deer gesture with the middle, ring, and thumb fingers, the guru, with sesame seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā mūlaṃ tarpayet śatenājyasruvaistathā /
aṅgavaktraṃ ṣaḍaṃśena śeṣāṃścāpi daśāṃśataḥ // 419
meaning:
कृत्वा मूलं तर्पयेत् शतेनाज्यस्रुवैस्तथा /
अङ्गवक्त्रं षडंशेन शेषांश्चापि दशांशतः // 419
text_mt: Should gratify the root [mantra] with a hundred sruvas of clarified butter, / and in the same way, the limbs and the faces with a sixth part, and the remaining ones with a tenth part.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrādikahomo'pi tṛptyai vittānusārataḥ /
sati vitte'pi lobhādigrasto bāhyapradhānatām // 420
meaning:
सहस्रादिकहोमोऽपि तृप्त्यै वित्तानुसारतः /
सति वित्तेऽपि लोभादिग्रस्तो बाह्यप्रधानताम् // 420
text_mt: A fire sacrifice of a thousand or more [oblations] is also [prescribed] for satisfaction according to one's wealth. / Even when wealth is present, one who is overcome by greed and the like, giving prominence to the external

sanskrit_iast:
prathayaṃścidguṇībhāvācchaktipātaṃ na vindati /
uktaṃ svacchandatantre taddīkṣito'pi na mokṣabhāk // 421
meaning:
प्रथयंश्चिद्गुणीभावाच्छक्तिपातं न विन्दति /
उक्तं स्वच्छन्दतन्त्रे तद्दीक्षितोऽपि न मोक्षभाक् // 421
text_mt: And making consciousness secondary, does not attain the descent of power. / It is stated in the Svacchandatantra: "Even though initiated, he does not share in liberation."

sanskrit_iast:
nanu yattasya dīkṣāyāṃ kṛtaṃ karmāsya kiṃ phalam /
tatrāhurgamaśāstrajñā vāmāśaktimayāstadā // 422
meaning:
ननु यत्तस्य दीक्षायां कृतं कर्मास्य किं फलम् /
तत्राहुर्गमशास्त्रज्ञा वामाशक्तिमयास्तदा // 422
text_mt: "Now, what is the fruit of the action performed during his initiation?" / Regarding this, those who know the Āgama scriptures say: "At that time, consisting of the Vāmā power,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrā badhnanti taṃ samyagbhavakārāmahāgṛhe /
yā tvanugrāhikā śaktisteṣāṃ sā gurudīpitā // 423
meaning:
मन्त्रा बध्नन्ति तं सम्यग्भवकारामहागृहे /
या त्वनुग्राहिका शक्तिस्तेषां सा गुरुदीपिता // 423
text_mt: The mantras bind him completely in the great prison-house of worldly existence. / But their grace-bestowing power, kindle by the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
śodhayeta svaśāstrasthaniṣkāmollaṅghanakriyām /
tata ūrdhvādharanyāsādanyonyaunmukhyasundaram // 424
meaning:
शोधयेत स्वशास्त्रस्थनिष्कामोल्लङ्घनक्रियाम् /
तत ऊर्ध्वाधरन्यासादन्योन्यौन्मुख्यसुन्दरम् // 424
text_mt: Purifies the transgression of desireless action taught in one's own scripture." / Then, by placing them above and below, beautiful in their mutual orientation toward each other,

sanskrit_iast:
sruksruvaṃ śivaśaktyātmādāyājyāmṛtapūritam /
samacittaprāṇatanuraikātmyavidhiyogataḥ // 425
meaning:
स्रुक्स्रुवं शिवशक्त्यात्मादायाज्यामृतपूरितम् /
समचित्तप्राणतनुरैकात्म्यविधियोगतः // 425
text_mt: Taking the sruc and sruva whose natures are Śiva and Śakti, filled with the nectar of clarified butter, / with body, breath, and mind unified through the application of the rule of oneness,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmaṃ srugdaṇḍagaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ sopayāmakam /
kaṇṭhādhogaṃ vinikṣipya dṛḍhamāpīḍya yatnavān // 426
meaning:
वामं स्रुग्दण्डगं हस्तं दक्षिणं सोपयामकम् /
कण्ठाधोगं विनिक्षिप्य दृढमापीड्य यत्नवान् // 426
text_mt: Placing the left hand on the handle of the sruc, and the right with the supporting stick / below the neck, pressing firmly with effort,

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥ kuryātsrucaṃ prāṇamūrdhvordhvaṃ saṃniyojayan /
yāvaddviṣaṭkaparyante bodhāgnau candracakrataḥ // 427
meaning:
अधः कुर्यात्स्रुचं प्राणमूर्ध्वोर्ध्वं संनियोजयन् /
यावद्द्विषट्कपर्यन्ते बोधाग्नौ चन्द्रचक्रतः // 427
text_mt: He should turn the sruc downward while directing the breath ever upward, / until, into the fire of awakening at the limit of the twelve, from the circle of the moon,

sanskrit_iast:
srugagrātparamaṃ hlādi patedamṛtamuttamam /
tāvadvahnau mantramukhe vauṣaḍantāṃ hutiṃ kṣipet // 428
meaning:
स्रुगग्रात्परमं ह्लादि पतेदमृतमुत्तमम् /
तावद्वह्नौ मन्त्रमुखे वौषडन्तां हुतिं क्षिपेत् // 428
text_mt: From the tip of the sruc, the supreme, delightful, excellent nectar falls; / then he should cast the oblation ending with vauṣaṭ into the fire, the mouth of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ya ūrdhve kila saṃbodhaḥ kuṇḍe sa pratibimbitaḥ /
vahniḥ prāṇaḥ sruksruvau ca snehaḥ saṃkalpacidrasaḥ // 429
meaning:
य ऊर्ध्वे किल संबोधः कुण्डे स प्रतिबिम्बितः /
वह्निः प्राणः स्रुक्स्रुवौ च स्नेहः संकल्पचिद्रसः // 429
text_mt: That which is awakening above is reflected in the fire-pit below: / the fire is the breath, the sruc and sruva [are the two breaths], and the clarified butter is the fluid of the consciousness of volition.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ jñātvāditaḥ kuṇḍasruksruvājyamanūnbhṛśam /
dvādaśāntavibodhāgnau ruddhvā pūrṇāhutiṃ kṣipet // 430
meaning:
इत्थं ज्ञात्वादितः कुण्डस्रुक्स्रुवाज्यमनून्भृशम् /
द्वादशान्तविबोधाग्नौ रुद्ध्वा पूर्णाहुतिं क्षिपेत् // 430
text_mt: Knowing thus from the start, holding the fire-pit, sruc, sruva, clarified butter, and mantras firmly / in the fire of illumination at the limit of the twelve, he should cast the full oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yathā hi gaganamutpatetkalahaṃsakaḥ /
jale binbaṃ bruḍatyasya tathetyatrāpyayaṃ vidhiḥ // 431
meaning:
यथा यथा हि गगनमुत्पतेत्कलहंसकः /
जले बिन्बं ब्रुडत्यस्य तथेत्यत्राप्ययं विधिः // 431
text_mt: For just as a wild goose flies up into the sky, / its reflection sinks into the water, so too is this rule here.

sanskrit_iast:
svābhāvikaṃ sthiraṃ caiva dravaṃ dīptaṃ calaṃ nabhaḥ /
māyā bindustathaivātmā nādaḥ śaktiḥ śivastathā // 432
meaning:
स्वाभाविकं स्थिरं चैव द्रवं दीप्तं चलं नभः /
माया बिन्दुस्तथैवात्मा नादः शक्तिः शिवस्तथा // 432
text_mt: The natural, the steady, the liquid, the blazing, the moving, ether, / māyā, bindu, the self, nāda, śakti, and Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vyāpyavyāpakato vibhedyābhyantarāntam /
tadadhaḥsthāni pṛthvyādimūlāntāni tathā pumān // 433
meaning:
इत्थं व्याप्यव्यापकतो विभेद्याभ्यन्तरान्तम् /
तदधःस्थानि पृथ्व्यादिमूलान्तानि तथा पुमान् // 433
text_mt: Thus, piercing from the pervaded to the pervader up to the innermost, / and beneath it, those beginning with earth and ending with root [nature], and likewise the person,

sanskrit_iast:
avidyārāganiyatikālamāyākalāstathā /
aṇurvidyā tadīśeśau sādākhyaṃ śaktikuṇḍalī // 434
meaning:
अविद्यारागनियतिकालमायाकलास्तथा /
अणुर्विद्या तदीशेशौ सादाख्यं शक्तिकुण्डली // 434
text_mt: Ignorance, attachment, necessity, time, māyā, and kalā, / the atom, pure knowledge, the Lord of that [mantra] and the Sovereign, the Sādākhya, the power Kuṇḍalī,

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpinī samanaunmanyaṃ tato'nāmani yojayet /
recakastho madhyanāḍīsandhividgururityadaḥ // 435
meaning:
व्यापिनी समनौन्मन्यं ततोऽनामनि योजयेत् /
रेचकस्थो मध्यनाडीसन्धिविद्गुरुरित्यदः // 435
text_mt: Vyāpinī, Samanā, and Unmanā—one should then unite them in the Nameless. / Abiding in the recaka, knowing the junction of the central channel, the guru [does] this;

sanskrit_iast:
proktaṃ traiśirase tantre parayojanavarṇane /
tataḥ prāksthāpitānyastamantrasaṃskṛtavahninā // 436
meaning:
प्रोक्तं त्रैशिरसे तन्त्रे परयोजनवर्णने /
ततः प्राक्स्थापितान्यस्तमन्त्रसंस्कृतवह्निना // 436
text_mt: This is declared in the Traiśirasa Tantra in the explanation of the supreme integration. / Then, with the fire consecrated by the mantras previously placed and established,

sanskrit_iast:
caruḥ sādhyo'thavā śiṣyairhomena samakālakaḥ /
carau ca vīradravyāṇi laukikānyathavecchayā // 437
meaning:
चरुः साध्योऽथवा शिष्यैर्होमेन समकालकः /
चरौ च वीरद्रव्याणि लौकिकान्यथवेच्छया // 437
text_mt: The caru is to be prepared, or [it may be prepared] by the disciples simultaneously with the fire sacrifice; / and in the caru are heroic ingredients, or ordinary ones according to wish.

sanskrit_iast:
carusiddhau samastāśca kriyā hṛnmantrayogataḥ /
tataścaruṃ samādāya gururājyena pūritām // 438
meaning:
चरुसिद्धौ समस्ताश्च क्रिया हृन्मन्त्रयोगतः /
ततश्चरुं समादाय गुरुराज्येन पूरिताम् // 438
text_mt: When the caru is ready, all the rites [are performed] through the conjunction of the heart mantra. / Then, taking the caru, the guru, having filled with clarified butter

sanskrit_iast:
srucaṃ sruvaṃ vā kṛtvaiva bhuktimuktyanusārataḥ /
devānāmatha śaktīnāṃ yantrāṇāṃ tu trayaṃ trayam // 439
meaning:
स्रुचं स्रुवं वा कृत्वैव भुक्तिमुक्त्यनुसारतः /
देवानामथ शक्तीनां यन्त्राणां तु त्रयं त्रयम् // 439
text_mt: The sruc or the sruva according to enjoyment or liberation, / [offers] three and three to each of the deities, the powers, and the yantras.

sanskrit_iast:
saptamaṃ mātṛsadbhāvaṃ kramādekaikaśaḥ paṭhan /
svā ityamṛtavarṇena vahnau hutvājyaśeṣakam // 440
meaning:
सप्तमं मातृसद्भावं क्रमादेकैकशः पठन् /
स्वा इत्यमृतवर्णेन वह्नौ हुत्वाज्यशेषकम् // 440
text_mt: Reciting in order, one by one, the seventh [syllable, which is] the true nature of the Mother (mātṛsadbhāva), / having offered the remainder of the ghee into the fire with the nectar syllable "svā",

sanskrit_iast:
carau hetyagnirūpeṇa juhuyāttatpunaḥ punaḥ /
bhojyabhojakacarvagnyoritthamekānusandhitaḥ // 441
meaning:
चरौ हेत्यग्निरूपेण जुहुयात्तत्पुनः पुनः /
भोज्यभोजकचर्वग्न्योरित्थमेकानुसन्धितः // 441
text_mt: one should repeatedly offer it upon the sacrificial porridge (caru) with the form of fire, "hā". / In this way, through unifying contemplation of the food and the eater, and of the chewable and the fire,

sanskrit_iast:
svāhāpratyavamarśātsyātsamantrādadvayaṃ param /
eṣa saṃpātasaṃskāraścarorbhoktā hyadhiṣṭhitaḥ // 442
meaning:
स्वाहाप्रत्यवमर्शात्स्यात्समन्त्रादद्वयं परम् /
एष संपातसंस्कारश्चरोर्भोक्ता ह्यधिष्ठितः // 442
text_mt: from the reflective awareness (vimarśa) of "svāhā", accompanying the mantra, the supreme non-duality arises. / This is the consecrated contact (saṃpātasaṃskāra) of the porridge; for the eater is thereby presided over.

sanskrit_iast:
bhogyasya paramaṃ sāraṃ bhogyaṃ narnarti yatnataḥ /
samamekānusandhānātpātato bhoktṛbhogyayoḥ // 443
meaning:
भोग्यस्य परमं सारं भोग्यं नर्नर्ति यत्नतः /
सममेकानुसन्धानात्पाततो भोक्तृभोग्ययोः // 443
text_mt: The supreme essence of what is enjoyed, the enjoyed itself, dances forth effortlessly, / precisely because of the simultaneous unified contemplation, from the falling of the eater and the enjoyed together,

sanskrit_iast:
anyo'nyatra ca saṃpātātsaṃgamāccetthamucyate /
sthaṇḍile kubhbhakarkaryorbhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ nivedayet // 444
meaning:
अन्योऽन्यत्र च संपातात्संगमाच्चेत्थमुच्यते /
स्थण्डिले कुभ्भकर्कर्योर्भागं भागं निवेदयेत् // 444
text_mt: and because of their mutual convergence and communion; thus it is stated. / One should offer a portion on the ritual ground, and a portion to the jar and the water-pot (karkarī);

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgenāgnau mantratṛptirdvayaṃ śiṣyātmanoratha /
itthaṃ vihitakartavyo vijñāpyeśaṃ tadīritaḥ // 445
meaning:
भागेनाग्नौ मन्त्रतृप्तिर्द्वयं शिष्यात्मनोरथ /
इत्थं विहितकर्तव्यो विज्ञाप्येशं तदीरितः // 445
text_mt: with another portion comes the satisfaction of the mantras in the fire, and two [portions] are for the pupil and oneself. / Having thus performed his obligations, having informed the Lord, and being commanded by Him,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktipātakramācchiṣyānsaṃskartuṃ niḥsaredbahiḥ /
tatraiṣāṃ pañcagavyaṃ ca caruṃ daśanamārjanam // 446
meaning:
शक्तिपातक्रमाच्छिष्यान्संस्कर्तुं निःसरेद्बहिः /
तत्रैषां पञ्चगव्यं च चरुं दशनमार्जनम् // 446
text_mt: he should step outside to consecrate the disciples in accordance with their descent of power (śaktipāta). / There [he gives] to them the fivefold cow-products, the porridge, and the tooth-cleaning twig.

sanskrit_iast:
tasya pātaḥ śubhaḥ prācīsaumyaiśāpyordhvadiggataḥ /
aśubho'nyatra tatrāstrahomo'pyaṣṭaśataṃ bhavet // 447
meaning:
तस्य पातः शुभः प्राचीसौम्यैशाप्योर्ध्वदिग्गतः /
अशुभोऽन्यत्र तत्रास्त्रहोमोऽप्यष्टशतं भवेत् // 447
text_mt: The fall of that [twig] is auspicious when directed toward the east, north, north-east, or upward; / it is inauspicious elsewhere, in which case there should also be one hundred and eight oblations with the weapon-mantra (astra).

sanskrit_iast:
netramantritasadvastrabaddhanetrānacañcalān /
ananyahṛdayībhūtānbalāditthaṃ nirodhataḥ // 448
meaning:
नेत्रमन्त्रितसद्वस्त्रबद्धनेत्रानचञ्चलान् /
अनन्यहृदयीभूतान्बलादित्थं निरोधतः // 448
text_mt: Their eyes bound with fine cloth consecrated with the eye-mantra, motionless, / their minds turned to nothing else because of being restrained by force in this manner,

sanskrit_iast:
muktāratnādikusumasaṃpūrṇāñjalikānguruḥ /
praveśya sthaṇḍilopāgra upaveśyaiva jānubhiḥ // 449
meaning:
मुक्तारत्नादिकुसुमसंपूर्णाञ्जलिकान्गुरुः /
प्रवेश्य स्थण्डिलोपाग्र उपवेश्यैव जानुभिः // 449
text_mt: the guru leads them in, their folded hands filled with pearls, gems, and flowers, / and has them kneel right beside the altar.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣepayedañjaliṃ taṃ taiḥ śiṣyairbhāvitātmabhiḥ /
añjali punarāpūrya teṣāṃ lāghavataḥ paṭam // 450
meaning:
प्रक्षेपयेदञ्जलिं तं तैः शिष्यैर्भावितात्मभिः /
अञ्जलि पुनरापूर्य तेषां लाघवतः पटम् // 450
text_mt: He should have those disciples, whose minds are concentrated, cast that cavity of folded hands [forward]; / having filled their folded hands once more, he swiftly removes the cloth

sanskrit_iast:
dṛśornivārayetso'pi śiṣyo jhaṭiti paśyati /
jhaṭityālokite māntraprabhāvollāsite sthale // 451
meaning:
दृशोर्निवारयेत्सोऽपि शिष्यो झटिति पश्यति /
झटित्यालोकिते मान्त्रप्रभावोल्लासिते स्थले // 451
text_mt: from the eyes of that disciple, who immediately sees. / In that place suddenly beheld, ablaze with the power of the mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
tadāveśavaśācchiṣyastanmayatvaṃ prapadyate /
yathā hi raktahṛdayastāṃstānkāntāguṇānsvayam // 452
meaning:
तदावेशवशाच्छिष्यस्तन्मयत्वं प्रपद्यते /
यथा हि रक्तहृदयस्तांस्तान्कान्तागुणान्स्वयम् // 452
text_mt: by virtue of that immersion (āveśa), the disciple attains identity with that [reality]. / For just as an impassioned heart spontaneously sees

sanskrit_iast:
paśyatyevaṃ śaktipātasaṃskṛto mantrasannidhim /
cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ hi sahakāriṇi tādṛśe // 453
meaning:
पश्यत्येवं शक्तिपातसंस्कृतो मन्त्रसन्निधिम् /
चक्षुरादीन्द्रियाणां हि सहकारिणि तादृशे // 453
text_mt: the various qualities of the beloved, so does one consecrated by the descent of power (śaktipāta) behold the presence of the mantras. / For when such an auxiliary condition for the eye and other senses is present,

sanskrit_iast:
satyatyantamadṛṣṭe prāgapi jāyeta yogyatā /
kṛtaprajñā hi vinyastamantraṃ dehaṃ jalaṃ sthalam // 454
meaning:
सत्यत्यन्तमदृष्टे प्रागपि जायेत योग्यता /
कृतप्रज्ञा हि विन्यस्तमन्त्रं देहं जलं स्थलम् // 454
text_mt: a capacity arises even for what was previously entirely unseen. / For those of cultivated understanding, seeing a body, water, ground,

sanskrit_iast:
pratimādi ca paśyanto viduḥ saṃnidhyasaṃnidhī /
nyastamantrāṃśusubhagātkiṃcidbhūtādimudritāḥ // 455
meaning:
प्रतिमादि च पश्यन्तो विदुः संनिध्यसंनिधी /
न्यस्तमन्त्रांशुसुभगात्किंचिद्भूतादिमुद्रिताः // 455
text_mt: an image, and the like upon which mantras have been deposited, know their presence or absence; / sealed by the subtle spirits and the like, [trembling] as if in fear before that which is splendid with the rays of the deposited mantras—

sanskrit_iast:
trasyantīveti tattaccidakṣaistatsahakāribhiḥ /
tataḥ sa dakṣiṇe haste dīptaṃ sarvādhvapūritam // 456
meaning:
त्रस्यन्तीवेति तत्तच्चिदक्षैस्तत्सहकारिभिः /
ततः स दक्षिणे हस्ते दीप्तं सर्वाध्वपूरितम् // 456
text_mt: so do they [perceive] with their sense faculties accompanied by that [consciousness]. / Then, on the right hand, which is blazing and filled with all the paths (adhvan),

sanskrit_iast:
mantracakraṃ yajedvāmapāṇinā pāśadāhakam /
taṃ śiṣyasya karaṃ mūrdhni dehanyastādhvasaṃtateḥ // 457
meaning:
मन्त्रचक्रं यजेद्वामपाणिना पाशदाहकम् /
तं शिष्यस्य करं मूर्ध्नि देहन्यस्ताध्वसंततेः // 457
text_mt: he should worship with his left hand the circle of mantras that burns bonds. / That hand he should place upon the head of the disciple, upon whose body the series of paths has been deposited,

sanskrit_iast:
nyasyetkrameṇa sarvāṃṅgaṃ tenaivāsya ca saṃspṛśet /
uktaṃ dīkṣottare caitajjvālāsaṃpātaśobhinā // 458
meaning:
न्यस्येत्क्रमेण सर्वांङ्गं तेनैवास्य च संस्पृशेत् /
उक्तं दीक्षोत्तरे चैतज्ज्वालासंपातशोभिना // 458
text_mt: and with that very [hand] touch all his limbs in order. / And this is stated in the Dīkṣottara: "By the Hand of Śiva (śivahasta), bestowed

sanskrit_iast:
dattena śivahastena samayī sa vidhīyate /
sāyujyamīśvare tattve jīvato'dhītiyogyatā // 459
meaning:
दत्तेन शिवहस्तेन समयी स विधीयते /
सायुज्यमीश्वरे तत्त्वे जीवतोऽधीतियोग्यता // 459
text_mt: and shining with the convergence of flames, he is made an initiate into the rule (samayī); / he attains union (sāyujya) in the reality of the Lord and, while living, eligibility for study."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīdevyāthāmale tūktamaṣṭārāntastriśūlake /
cakre bhairavasannābhāvaghorādyaṣṭakārake // 460
meaning:
श्रीदेव्याथामले तूक्तमष्टारान्तस्त्रिशूलके /
चक्रे भैरवसन्नाभावघोराद्यष्टकारके // 460
text_mt: In the venerable Devyāmata, however, it is stated: "On the trident-surmounted wheel with eight spokes at the end, / which produces the octad of Aghora and the rest resembling Bhairava,

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyāpare parānemau madhyaśūlaparāpare /
jvālākule'ruṇe bhrāmyanmātṛpraṇavabhīṣaṇe // 461
meaning:
बाह्यापरे परानेमौ मध्यशूलपरापरे /
ज्वालाकुलेऽरुणे भ्राम्यन्मातृप्रणवभीषणे // 461
text_mt: Aparā on the outer rim, Parā on the outer edge, Parāparā on the middle prong, / filled with flames, red, terrifying with the whirl of Mothers and the Praṇava—

sanskrit_iast:
cintite tu bahirhaste saṃdṛṣṭe samayī bhavet /
pāśastobhādyastu sadya uccikramiṣurasya tam // 462
meaning:
चिन्तिते तु बहिर्हस्ते संदृष्टे समयी भवेत् /
पाशस्तोभाद्यस्तु सद्य उच्चिक्रमिषुरस्य तम् // 462
text_mt: when contemplated on the outer hand and beheld, one becomes an initiate into the rule (samayī). / But for one who desires to depart immediately, owing to the shock of the bonds (pāśastobha),

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇairviyojakaṃ mūrdhni kṣipetsaṃpūjya tadbahiḥ /
anena śivahastena samayī bhavati sphuṭam // 463
meaning:
प्राणैर्वियोजकं मूर्ध्नि क्षिपेत्संपूज्य तद्बहिः /
अनेन शिवहस्तेन समयी भवति स्फुटम् // 463
text_mt: having worshipped it outside, he should cast upon his head that which severs him from the vital breaths. / By this Hand of Śiva (śivahasta) he clearly becomes an initiate into the rule."

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva bhāvividhivattattvapāśaviyojane /
putrakatvaṃ sa ca pare tattve yojyastu daiśikaiḥ // 464
meaning:
तस्यैव भाविविधिवत्तत्त्वपाशवियोजने /
पुत्रकत्वं स च परे तत्त्वे योज्यस्तु दैशिकैः // 464
text_mt: When, by the future rite, the bonds of reality are severed for that same person, / he attains the status of spiritual son (putraka), and he is to be joined to the supreme reality by the masters.

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva mantrajātijño japahomāditattvavit /
nirvāṇakalaśenādau tata īśvarasaṃjñinā // 465
meaning:
स एव मन्त्रजातिज्ञो जपहोमादितत्त्ववित् /
निर्वाणकलशेनादौ तत ईश्वरसंज्ञिना // 465
text_mt: He alone who knows the classes of mantras, who knows the reality of recitation, oblations, and so forth, / consecrated first with the liberation-jar (nirvāṇakalaśa) and then with that named the jar of the Lord (īśvarakalaśa),

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣiktaḥ sādhakaḥ syādbhogānte'sya pare layaḥ /
etairguṇaiḥ samāyukto dīkṣitaḥ śivaśāsane // 466
meaning:
अभिषिक्तः साधकः स्याद्भोगान्तेऽस्य परे लयः /
एतैर्गुणैः समायुक्तो दीक्षितः शिवशासने // 466
text_mt: becomes an adept (sādhaka); at the end of his enjoyment (bhoga) his dissolution is in the Supreme. / Endowed with these qualities, initiated into the teaching of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpātsaṃhitābhijñastantrāṣṭādaśatatparaḥ /
daśatantrātimārgajña ācāryaḥ sa vidhīyate // 467
meaning:
चतुष्पात्संहिताभिज्ञस्तन्त्राष्टादशतत्परः /
दशतन्त्रातिमार्गज्ञ आचार्यः स विधीयते // 467
text_mt: knowing the four-part saṃhitās, devoted to the eighteen tantras, / knowing the Ten Tantras and the Atimārga, he is designated a master (ācārya).

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā nirvāṇānte'sya yojanām /
abhiṣekavidhau kuryādācāryasya gurūttamaḥ // 468
meaning:
पृथिवीमादितः कृत्वा निर्वाणान्तेऽस्य योजनाम् /
अभिषेकविधौ कुर्यादाचार्यस्य गुरूत्तमः // 468
text_mt: Starting from earth and ending with liberation, the supreme guru / should perform the unification (yojanā) of this master during the consecration rite.

sanskrit_iast:
etairvākyairidaṃ coktaṃ samayī rājaputravat /
sarvatraivādhikārī syātputrakādipadatraye // 469
meaning:
एतैर्वाक्यैरिदं चोक्तं समयी राजपुत्रवत् /
सर्वत्रैवाधिकारी स्यात्पुत्रकादिपदत्रये // 469
text_mt: And by these statements this is declared: an initiate into the rule (samayī), like a prince, / is eligible in every respect for the three stages beginning with the spiritual son (putraka).

sanskrit_iast:
putrako daiśikatve tu tulyayojaniko bhavet /
adhikārī sa na punaḥ sādhane bhinnayojane // 470
meaning:
पुत्रको दैशिकत्वे तु तुल्ययोजनिको भवेत् /
अधिकारी स न पुनः साधने भिन्नयोजने // 470
text_mt: A spiritual son (putraka), however, has the same unification [only] with respect to masterhood; / he is eligible [for that], but not for the practice (sādhana) which has a different unification.

sanskrit_iast:
etattantre samayyādikramādāptottarakriyaḥ /
ācāryo na punarbauddhavaiṣṇavādiḥ kadācana // 471
meaning:
एतत्तन्त्रे समय्यादिक्रमादाप्तोत्तरक्रियः /
आचार्यो न पुनर्बौद्धवैष्णवादिः कदाचन // 471
text_mt: In this tantra, one who has received the higher rites successively from initiate into the rule (samayī) onward / is a master (ācārya); never, however, is a Buddhist, a Vaiṣṇava, or the like [eligible].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prasaṅgānnirṇītaṃ prakṛtaṃ tu nirūpyate /
śivahastavidhiṃ kṛtvā tena saṃpluṣṭapāśakam // 472
meaning:
एवं प्रसङ्गान्निर्णीतं प्रकृतं तु निरूप्यते /
शिवहस्तविधिं कृत्वा तेन संप्लुष्टपाशकम् // 472
text_mt: This has been determined by way of digression; the primary topic is now set forth: / having performed the rite of the Hand of Śiva (śivahasta) and thereby burned away the bonds

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaṃ vidhāya viśrāntiparyantaṃ dhyānayogataḥ /
tataḥ kumbhe'strakalaśe vahnau svātmani taṃ śiśum // 473
meaning:
शिष्यं विधाय विश्रान्तिपर्यन्तं ध्यानयोगतः /
ततः कुम्भेऽस्त्रकलशे वह्नौ स्वात्मनि तं शिशुम् // 473
text_mt: of the disciple, bringing him through yoga of meditation up to restful repose, / he should then make that child bow to the jar, to the weapon-pot, to the fire, and to himself;

sanskrit_iast:
praṇāmaṃ kārayetpaścādbhūtamātṛbaliṃ kṣipet /
tataḥ śaṃkaramabhyarcya śayyāmastrābhimantritām // 474
meaning:
प्रणामं कारयेत्पश्चाद्भूतमातृबलिं क्षिपेत् /
ततः शंकरमभ्यर्च्य शय्यामस्त्राभिमन्त्रिताम् // 474
text_mt: next he should cast the offering (bali) to the spirits and Mothers. / Then, having worshipped Śaṅkara, having consecrated a bed with the weapon-mantra (astra),

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāsyāṃ śiṣyamāropya nyastamantraṃ vidhāya ca /
śiṣyahṛccakraviśrāntiṃ kṛtvā taddvādaśāntagaḥ // 475
meaning:
कृत्वास्यां शिष्यमारोप्य न्यस्तमन्त्रं विधाय च /
शिष्यहृच्चक्रविश्रान्तिं कृत्वा तद्द्वादशान्तगः // 475
text_mt: and having placed the disciple upon it, having performed the deposition of mantras on him, / and having brought repose to the disciple's heart-cakra, he should enter his Dvādaśānta;

sanskrit_iast:
bhavetkṣīṇakalājālaḥ svaradvādaśakodayāt /
tataḥ praveśapracitakalāṣoḍaśakojjvalaḥ // 476
meaning:
भवेत्क्षीणकलाजालः स्वरद्वादशकोदयात् /
ततः प्रवेशप्रचितकलाषोडशकोज्ज्वलः // 476
text_mt: his array of digits (kalā) should become diminished through the dawning of the twelve vowels. / Then, radiant with the sixteen digits accumulated through entrance,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃpūrṇasvātmaciccandro viśrāmyeddhṛdaye śiśoḥ /
svayaṃ vyutthānaparyantaṃ dvādaśāntaṃ tato vrajet // 477
meaning:
संपूर्णस्वात्मचिच्चन्द्रो विश्राम्येद्धृदये शिशोः /
स्वयं व्युत्थानपर्यन्तं द्वादशान्तं ततो व्रजेत् // 477
text_mt: the full moon of consciousness of his own Self should rest in the heart of the child / of its own accord until awakening; from there he should go to the Dvādaśānta,

sanskrit_iast:
punarviśecca hṛccakramitthaṃ nidrāvidhikramaḥ /
āyātanidraḥ śiṣyo'sau nirmalau śaśibhāskarau // 478
meaning:
पुनर्विशेच्च हृच्चक्रमित्थं निद्राविधिक्रमः /
आयातनिद्रः शिष्योऽसौ निर्मलौ शशिभास्करौ // 478
text_mt: and again enter the heart-cakra. Such is the sequence of the rite of sleep. / When that disciple has entered sleep, he contemplates in his heart-cakra

sanskrit_iast:
hṛccakre pratisaṃdhatte balātpūrṇakṛśātmakau /
haṭhanirmalacandrārkaprakāśaḥ satyamīkṣate // 479
meaning:
हृच्चक्रे प्रतिसंधत्ते बलात्पूर्णकृशात्मकौ /
हठनिर्मलचन्द्रार्कप्रकाशः सत्यमीक्षते // 479
text_mt: the stainless moon and sun, full and diminished, by force; / with the light of the moon and sun rendered stainless by force, he beholds a true

sanskrit_iast:
svapnaṃ bhāviśubhānyatvasphuṭībhāvanakovidam /
uktaṃ ca pūrṇāṃ ca kṛśāṃ dhyātvā dvādaśagocare // 480
meaning:
स्वप्नं भाविशुभान्यत्वस्फुटीभावनकोविदम् /
उक्तं च पूर्णां च कृशां ध्यात्वा द्वादशगोचरे // 480
text_mt: dream, revealing the good or otherwise that is to come. / And it is said: "Having meditated on the full and the diminished in the sphere of the twelve,

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya hṛdaye dhyāye tsuptaḥ svācchandyamāpnuyāt /
āyātanidre ca śiśau gururabhyarcya śaṅkaram // 481
meaning:
प्रविश्य हृदये ध्याये त्सुप्तः स्वाच्छन्द्यमाप्नुयात् /
आयातनिद्रे च शिशौ गुरुरभ्यर्च्य शङ्करम् // 481
text_mt: having entered the heart, one should meditate [on it]; asleep, he attains freedom." / When the child has fallen asleep, the guru, having worshipped Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
caruṃ bhuñjīta sasakhā tato'dyāddantadhāvanam /
svapyācca mantraraśmīddhahṛccakrārpitamānasaḥ // 482
meaning:
चरुं भुञ्जीत ससखा ततोऽद्याद्दन्तधावनम् /
स्वप्याच्च मन्त्ररश्मीद्धहृच्चक्रार्पितमानसः // 482
text_mt: should eat the porridge together with his companion, and then chew the tooth-cleaning twig; / and he should sleep, his mind fixed on the heart-cakra ablaze with the rays of the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
prātarguruḥ kṛtāśeṣanityo'bhyarcitaśaṃkaraḥ /
śiṣyātmanoḥ svapnadṛṣṭāvarthau vitte balābalāt // 483
meaning:
प्रातर्गुरुः कृताशेषनित्योऽभ्यर्चितशंकरः /
शिष्यात्मनोः स्वप्नदृष्टावर्थौ वित्ते बलाबलात् // 483
text_mt: In the morning, the guru, having performed all his daily rites and worshipped Śaṅkara, / assesses the objects seen in the dreams of both disciple and himself according to their relative strength.

sanskrit_iast:
svadṛṣṭaṃ balavannānyatsaṃbodhodrekayogataḥ /
bodhasāmye punaḥ svapnasāmyaṃ syādguruśiṣyayoḥ // 484
meaning:
स्वदृष्टं बलवन्नान्यत्संबोधोद्रेकयोगतः /
बोधसाम्ये पुनः स्वप्नसाम्यं स्याद्गुरुशिष्ययोः // 484
text_mt: What is seen by oneself is stronger, not what is seen by the other, because of the superiority of one's awakening; / however, when there is equality of awakening, there is equality of dreams between guru and disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
devāgnigurutatpūjākāraṇopaskarādikam /
hṛdyā strī madyapānaṃ cāpyāmamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam // 485
meaning:
देवाग्निगुरुतत्पूजाकारणोपस्करादिकम् /
हृद्या स्त्री मद्यपानं चाप्याममांसस्य भक्षणम् // 485
text_mt: Deities, fire, the guru, and the implements and accessories for their worship, / a charming woman, drinking wine, and eating raw meat:

sanskrit_iast:
raktapānaṃ śiraśchedo raktaviṇmūtralepanam /
parvatāśvagajaprāyahṛdyayugyādhirohaṇam // 486
meaning:
रक्तपानं शिरश्छेदो रक्तविण्मूत्रलेपनम् /
पर्वताश्वगजप्रायहृद्ययुग्याधिरोहणम् // 486
text_mt: drinking blood, decapitation, smearing oneself with blood, feces, and urine, / ascending mountains, horses, elephants, or other delightful vehicles—

sanskrit_iast:
yatprītyai syādapi prāyastattacchubhamudāhṛtam /
taṃ khyāpayettuṣṭivṛddhyai hlādo hi paramaṃ phalam // 487
meaning:
यत्प्रीत्यै स्यादपि प्रायस्तत्तच्छुभमुदाहृतम् /
तं ख्यापयेत्तुष्टिवृद्ध्यै ह्लादो हि परमं फलम् // 487
text_mt: whatever generally leads to pleasure is declared auspicious. / One should announce that in order to increase satisfaction, for delight is the ultimate fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
ato'nyadaśubhaṃ tatra homo'ṣṭaśatako'strataḥ /
aśubhaṃ nāśubhamiti śiṣyebhyo kathayedguruḥ // 488
meaning:
अतोऽन्यदशुभं तत्र होमोऽष्टशतकोऽस्त्रतः /
अशुभं नाशुभमिति शिष्येभ्यो कथयेद्गुरुः // 488
text_mt: Anything other than this is inauspicious; in that case, there should be an offering of one hundred and eight oblations with the weapon-mantra. / The guru should tell the disciples: 'The inauspicious is not inauspicious.'

sanskrit_iast:
rūḍhāṃ hi śaṅkāṃ vicchettuṃ yatnaḥ saṃghaṭate mahān /
yeṣāṃ tu śaṅkāvilayasteṣāṃ svapnavaśotthitam // 489
meaning:
रूढां हि शङ्कां विच्छेत्तुं यत्नः संघटते महान् /
येषां तु शङ्काविलयस्तेषां स्वप्नवशोत्थितम् // 489
text_mt: Indeed, great effort is required to cut through deep-rooted doubt; / but for those whose doubt is dissolved, what arises under the influence of dreams,

sanskrit_iast:
śubhāśubhaṃ na kiṃcitsyāt syuścetthaṃ citratāvaśāt /
sphuṭaṃ paśyati sattvātmā rājaso liṅgamātrataḥ // 490
meaning:
शुभाशुभं न किंचित्स्यात् स्युश्चेत्थं चित्रतावशात् /
स्फुटं पश्यति सत्त्वात्मा राजसो लिङ्गमात्रतः // 490
text_mt: whether auspicious or inauspicious, is nothing at all. And this occurs according to the variety [of natures]: / one of a sattvic nature sees clearly; one of a rajasic nature sees only through signs;

sanskrit_iast:
na kiṃcittāmasastasya sukhaduḥkhācchubhāśubham /
nanvatra tāmaso nāma kathaṃ yogyo vidhau bhavet // 491
meaning:
न किंचित्तामसस्तस्य सुखदुःखाच्छुभाशुभम् /
नन्वत्र तामसो नाम कथं योग्यो विधौ भवेत् // 491
text_mt: one of a tamasic nature sees nothing at all; for him, the auspicious and inauspicious arise from pleasure and pain. / Now, [someone might ask:] how could a tamasic person be qualified for this rite?

sanskrit_iast:
maiva mā vigrahaṃ kaścitkvacitkasyāpi vai guṇaḥ /
sarvasāttvikaceṣṭo'pi bhojane yadi tāmasaḥ // 492
meaning:
मैव मा विग्रहं कश्चित्क्वचित्कस्यापि वै गुणः /
सर्वसात्त्विकचेष्टोऽपि भोजने यदि तामसः // 492
text_mt: Not so: let no one raise an objection! A quality belongs to someone somewhere [and not entirely]; / even if all one’s actions are sattvic, if in eating one is tamasic,

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃ tataḥ so'dhamaḥ kivāpyutkṛṣṭastadviparyayaḥ /
āyātaśaktipāto'pi dīkṣito'pi guṇasthiteḥ // 493
meaning:
किं ततः सोऽधमः किवाप्युत्कृष्टस्तद्विपर्ययः /
आयातशक्तिपातोऽपि दीक्षितोऽपि गुणस्थितेः // 493
text_mt: does that make him base, or conversely superior? / Even one who has experienced the descent of power, even one who is initiated, by virtue of the presence of the guṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrātmā bhavedeva mukhye tvarthe samāhitaḥ /
tato guruḥ śiśormantrapūrvakaṃ devatārcanam // 494
meaning:
विचित्रात्मा भवेदेव मुख्ये त्वर्थे समाहितः /
ततो गुरुः शिशोर्मन्त्रपूर्वकं देवतार्चनम् // 494
text_mt: must have a diversified nature, yet remain focused on the primary objective. / Then the guru should instruct the novice in the worship of the deity preceded by mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
deśayetsa ca tatkuryātsaṃskuryāttaṃ tato guruḥ /
hṛdādicakraṣaṭkasthānbrahmādīn ṣaṭ samāhitaḥ // 495
meaning:
देशयेत्स च तत्कुर्यात्संस्कुर्यात्तं ततो गुरुः /
हृदादिचक्रषट्कस्थान्ब्रह्मादीन् षट् समाहितः // 495
text_mt: and the novice should perform it. Then, concentrated, the guru should consecrate him: / the six [deities] beginning with Brahmā, residing in the six centers beginning with the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
spṛśecchiśoḥ prāṇavṛttyā pratyekaṃ cāṣṭa saṃskriyāḥ /
hṛdayādidviṣaṭkāntaṃ bodhasparśapavitritaḥ // 496
meaning:
स्पृशेच्छिशोः प्राणवृत्त्या प्रत्येकं चाष्ट संस्क्रियाः /
हृदयादिद्विषट्कान्तं बोधस्पर्शपवित्रितः // 496
text_mt: he should touch by means of the novice's vital breath, and perform eight consecrations for each, / up to the end of the twelve [finger-breadths] from the heart, purified by the touch of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
āhārabījabhāvādidoṣadhvaṃsādbhaveddvijaḥ /
vasuvedākhyasaṃskārapūrṇa itthaṃ dvijaḥ sthitaḥ // 497
meaning:
आहारबीजभावादिदोषध्वंसाद्भवेद्द्विजः /
वसुवेदाख्यसंस्कारपूर्ण इत्थं द्विजः स्थितः // 497
text_mt: Through the destruction of defects such as food and seed-nature, he becomes a twice-born. / Thus established as a twice-born, filled with the forty-eight consecrations,

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmanto jātakarma ca /
nāma niṣkrāmaṇaṃ cānnapraśaścūḍā tathāṣṭamī // 498
meaning:
गर्भाधानं पुंसवनं सीमन्तो जातकर्म च /
नाम निष्क्रामणं चान्नप्रशश्चूडा तथाष्टमी // 498
text_mt: namely: conception, the rite for quickening a male child, parting of the hair, natal rite, / naming, first outing, first feeding of solid food, and tonshure as the eighth;

sanskrit_iast:
vratabandhaiṣṭike maujjībhautike saumikaṃ kramāt /
godānamiti vedendusaṃskriyā brahmacaryataḥ // 499
meaning:
व्रतबन्धैष्टिके मौज्जीभौतिके सौमिकं क्रमात् /
गोदानमिति वेदेन्दुसंस्क्रिया ब्रह्मचर्यतः // 499
text_mt: the tying of the girdle for an offering, the maunjī-girdle for the elemental rite, the soma-related [girdle] in succession, / and the gift of a cow: these are the fourteen consecrations from the stage of celibate studenthood;

sanskrit_iast:
pratyudvāhaḥ pañcadaśaḥ sapta pākamakhāstvataḥ /
aṣṭakāḥ pārvaṇī śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrāyaṇīdvayam // 500
meaning:
प्रत्युद्वाहः पञ्चदशः सप्त पाकमखास्त्वतः /
अष्टकाः पार्वणी श्राद्धं श्रावण्याग्रायणीद्वयम् // 500
text_mt: marriage is the fifteenth; then the seven cooked-food sacrifices: / the eight-day rites, the seasonal rite, funeral offering, and the two rites of Śrāvaṇī and Āgrayaṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
caitrī cāśvayujī paścāt saptaiva tu havirmakhāḥ /
ādheyamagnihotraṃ ca paurṇamāsaḥ sadarśakaḥ // 501
meaning:
चैत्री चाश्वयुजी पश्चात् सप्तैव तु हविर्मखाः /
आधेयमग्निहोत्रं च पौर्णमासः सदर्शकः // 501
text_mt: and later Caitrī and Āśvayujī; then the seven oblation-sacrifices: / the setting up of fires, Agnihotra, and the full-moon rite together with the new-moon rite;

sanskrit_iast:
cāturmāsyaṃ paśūdbandhaḥ sautrāmaṇyā saha tvamī /
agniṣṭomo'tipūrvo'tha sokyyaḥ ṣoḍaśivājapau // 502
meaning:
चातुर्मास्यं पशूद्बन्धः सौत्रामण्या सह त्वमी /
अग्निष्टोमोऽतिपूर्वोऽथ सोक्य्यः षोडशिवाजपौ // 502
text_mt: the four-month rite, animal sacrifice, together with Sautrāmaṇī; and then these: / Agniṣṭoma, the anterior [rite], then Ukthya, the sixteen-part rite, Vājapeya,

sanskrit_iast:
āptoryāmātirātrau ca saptaitāḥ somasaṃsthitāḥ /
hiraṇyapādādimakhaḥ sahasreṇa samāvṛtaḥ // 503
meaning:
आप्तोर्यामातिरात्रौ च सप्तैताः सोमसंस्थिताः /
हिरण्यपादादिमखः सहस्रेण समावृतः // 503
text_mt: Āptoryāma, and Atirātra—these seven are situated in the Soma [class]. / The sacrifice of the golden foot and others, surrounded by a thousand [rites],

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭatriṃśastvaśvamedho gārhasthyamiyatā bhavet /
vānasthyapārivrājye ca catvāriṃśadamī matāḥ // 504
meaning:
अष्टत्रिंशस्त्वश्वमेधो गार्हस्थ्यमियता भवेत् /
वानस्थ्यपारिव्राज्ये च चत्वारिंशदमी मताः // 504
text_mt: and the horse-sacrifice as the thirty-eighth: householdership is constituted by these. / And in forest-dwelling and mendicancy, these are held to be forty.

sanskrit_iast:
dayā kṣamānasūyā ca śuddhiḥ satkṛtimaṅgale /
akārpaṇyāspṛhe cātmaguṇāṣṭakamidaṃ smṛtam // 505
meaning:
दया क्षमानसूया च शुद्धिः सत्कृतिमङ्गले /
अकार्पण्यास्पृहे चात्मगुणाष्टकमिदं स्मृतम् // 505
text_mt: Compassion, forbearance, absence of malice, purity, honoring others, and auspiciousness, / lack of meanness, and freedom from yearning: this is remembered as the group of eight soul-qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalā daṇḍamajinatryāyuṣe vahnyupāsanam /
saṃdhyā bhikṣeti saṃskārāḥ sapta sapta vratāni ca // 506
meaning:
मेखला दण्डमजिनत्र्यायुषे वह्न्युपासनम् /
संध्या भिक्षेति संस्काराः सप्त सप्त व्रतानि च // 506
text_mt: Girdle, staff, deer-skin, attendance on the fire for the prayer for long life, / twilight prayers, and begging alms: these are the seven consecrations and seven observances;

sanskrit_iast:
bhauteśapāśupatye dve gāṇeśaṃ gāṇapatyakam /
unmattakāsidhārākhyaghṛteśāni caturdaśa // 507
meaning:
भौतेशपाशुपत्ये द्वे गाणेशं गाणपत्यकम् /
उन्मत्तकासिधाराख्यघृतेशानि चतुर्दश // 507
text_mt: the two of Bhauteśa and Pāśupata, the Gāṇeśa, the Gāṇapatya, / the Unmatta, the Asidhārā, and the Ghṛteśa: these are fourteen.

sanskrit_iast:
ete tu vratabandhasya saṃskārā aṅginaḥ smṛtāḥ /
pārivrājyasya garbhe syādantyeṣṭiriti saṃskṛtaḥ // 508
meaning:
एते तु व्रतबन्धस्य संस्कारा अङ्गिनः स्मृताः /
पारिव्राज्यस्य गर्भे स्यादन्त्येष्टिरिति संस्कृतः // 508
text_mt: These are remembered as auxiliary consecrations to the taking of vows; / in mendicancy the funeral rite is included. Consecrated in this way,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijo bhavettato yogyo rudrāṃśāpādanāya saḥ /
etānprāṇakrameṇaiva saṃskārānyojayedguruḥ // 509
meaning:
द्विजो भवेत्ततो योग्यो रुद्रांशापादनाय सः /
एतान्प्राणक्रमेणैव संस्कारान्योजयेद्गुरुः // 509
text_mt: he becomes a twice-born, and then qualified for the conferral of the state of Rudra's portion. / The guru should apply these consecrations specifically in the order of the vital breath,

sanskrit_iast:
athavāhutiyogena tilādyairmantrapūrvakaiḥ /
praṇavo hṛdayaṃ nāma śodhayāmyagnivallabhā // 510
meaning:
अथवाहुतियोगेन तिलाद्यैर्मन्त्रपूर्वकैः /
प्रणवो हृदयं नाम शोधयाम्यग्निवल्लभा // 510
text_mt: or by means of oblations of sesame and the like preceded by mantra: / 'Oṃ, Hṛdayāya namaḥ, I purify, Svāhā.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ krameṇa mūrdhādyairaṅgairatatpunaḥ punaḥ /
yataściddharma evāsau śāntyādyātmā dvijanmatā // 511
meaning:
एवं क्रमेण मूर्धाद्यैरङ्गैरतत्पुनः पुनः /
यतश्चिद्धर्म एवासौ शान्त्याद्यात्मा द्विजन्मता // 511
text_mt: In this manner, by succession with the limbs beginning with the crown, [repeating] this again and again. / Because being twice-born is indeed an attribute of consciousness, consisting in pacification and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tena rudratayā saṃvittatkrameṇaiva jāyate /
yathā hemādidhātūnāṃ pāke kramavaśādbhavet // 512
meaning:
तेन रुद्रतया संवित्तत्क्रमेणैव जायते /
यथा हेमादिधातूनां पाके क्रमवशाद्भवेत् // 512
text_mt: therefore consciousness arises in the nature of Rudra precisely through that sequence, / just as through the cooking of gold and other metals, in proper succession,

sanskrit_iast:
rajatādi tathā saṃvitsaṃskāre dvijatāntare /
yonirna kāraṇaṃ tatra śāntātmā dvija ucyate // 513
meaning:
रजतादि तथा संवित्संस्कारे द्विजतान्तरे /
योनिर्न कारणं तत्र शान्तात्मा द्विज उच्यते // 513
text_mt: silver and the rest [transmute]. So too, consciousness [is transformed] in the consecration into another twice-born status. / The womb is not the cause there; one whose nature is pacified is called a twice-born.

sanskrit_iast:
muninā mokṣadharmādāvetacca pravivecitam /
mukuṭādiṣu śāstreṣu devenāpi nirūpitam // 514
meaning:
मुनिना मोक्षधर्मादावेतच्च प्रविवेचितम् /
मुकुटादिषु शास्त्रेषु देवेनापि निरूपितम् // 514
text_mt: This was fully investigated by the sage in the Mokṣadharma and elsewhere, / and explained by the Lord in the Mukuṭa and other scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvido dehasaṃbhedātsadṛśātsadṛśodayāt /
bhūmābhiprāyataḥ smārte dvijanmā dvijayoḥ sutaḥ // 515
meaning:
संविदो देहसंभेदात्सदृशात्सदृशोदयात् /
भूमाभिप्रायतः स्मार्ते द्विजन्मा द्विजयोः सुतः // 515
text_mt: Because of the admixture of consciousness and body, and because like arises from like, / in the Smṛti view a twice-born is the child of two twice-born parents only out of widespread convention.

sanskrit_iast:
antyajātīyadhīvādijananījanmalābhataḥ /
utkṛṣṭacittā ṛṣayaḥ kiṃ brāhmaṇyena bhājanam // 516
meaning:
अन्त्यजातीयधीवादिजननीजन्मलाभतः /
उत्कृष्टचित्ता ऋषयः किं ब्राह्मण्येन भाजनम् // 516
text_mt: The sages of exalted mind, having obtained birth from mothers of the lowest caste, fisherwomen, and the like— / were they vessels [of greatness] through [caste] Brahminhood?

sanskrit_iast:
ata evārthasattattvadeśinyasminna diśyate /
rahasyaśāstre jātyādisamācāro hi śāmbhave // 517
meaning:
अत एवार्थसत्तत्त्वदेशिन्यस्मिन्न दिश्यते /
रहस्यशास्त्रे जात्यादिसमाचारो हि शाम्भवे // 517
text_mt: For this very reason, in this Śāmbhava esoteric scripture, which teaches the true essence of reality, / conduct based on caste and the like is not prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśavāni tu śāstrāṇi vāmaśaktyātmakānyalam /
sṛṣṭyāṃcisiddhaye śaṃbhoḥ śaṅkātatphalakḷptaye // 518
meaning:
पाशवानि तु शास्त्राणि वामशक्त्यात्मकान्यलम् /
सृष्ट्यांचिसिद्धये शंभोः शङ्कातत्फलकॢप्तये // 518
text_mt: The scriptures for bound souls, however, consisting entirely of the left power [of God], / serve to accomplish creation for Śambhu and establish doubt and its fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
āpāditadvijatvasya dvādaśānte nijaikyataḥ /
sparśamātrānna viśrāntyā jhaṭityevāvarohataḥ // 519
meaning:
आपादितद्विजत्वस्य द्वादशान्ते निजैक्यतः /
स्पर्शमात्रान्न विश्रान्त्या झटित्येवावरोहतः // 519
text_mt: For one who has been made a twice-born, at the limit of the twelve [finger-breadths], through unity with one's own [nature], / by mere touch without resting, descending immediately,

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṃśāpādanaṃ yena samayī saṃskṛto bhavet /
adhītau śravaṇe nityaṃ pūjāyāṃ gurusevane // 520
meaning:
रुद्रांशापादनं येन समयी संस्कृतो भवेत् /
अधीतौ श्रवणे नित्यं पूजायां गुरुसेवने // 520
text_mt: there is the conferral of the state of Rudra's portion, by which he becomes a consecrated initiate into the rule. / In study, listening, daily worship, and service to the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
samayyadhikṛto'nyatra guruṇā vibhumarcayet /
tamāpāditarudrāṃśaṃ samayān śrāvayedguruḥ // 521
meaning:
समय्यधिकृतोऽन्यत्र गुरुणा विभुमर्चयेत् /
तमापादितरुद्रांशं समयान् श्रावयेद्गुरुः // 521
text_mt: the initiate into the rule is authorized; elsewhere, he should worship the all-pervading Lord through the guru. / To him, who has attained Rudra's portion, the guru should make known the rules of conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṣṭakātmakāndevyāyāmalādau nirūpitān /
avādo'karaṇaṃ gūḍhiḥ pūjā tarpaṇabhāvane // 522
meaning:
अष्टाष्टकात्मकान्देव्यायामलादौ निरूपितान् /
अवादोऽकरणं गूढिः पूजा तर्पणभावने // 522
text_mt: which consist of eight octads, taught in the Devīyāmala and other texts: / non-reproach, non-performance, concealment, worship, propitiation, visualization,

sanskrit_iast:
hananaṃ mohanaṃ ceti samayāṣṭakamaṣṭadhā /
svabhāvaṃ mantratantrāṇāṃ samayācāramelakam // 523
meaning:
हननं मोहनं चेति समयाष्टकमष्टधा /
स्वभावं मन्त्रतन्त्राणां समयाचारमेलकम् // 523
text_mt: slaying, and delusion: this is the octad of rules of conduct, eightfold [in practice]. / The intrinsic nature of mantras and tantras, the meeting of rules and conduct,

sanskrit_iast:
asatpralāpaṃ paruṣamanṛtaṃ nāṣṭadhā vadet /
aphalaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ hiṃsāṃ paradārābhimarśanam // 524
meaning:
असत्प्रलापं परुषमनृतं नाष्टधा वदेत् /
अफलं चेष्टितं हिंसां परदाराभिमर्शनम् // 524
text_mt: meaningless babble, harshness, and falsehood: he should not utter these in eight ways. / Fruitless action, violence, touching another's wife,

sanskrit_iast:
garvaṃ dambhaṃ bhūtaviṣavyādhitantraṃ nacācaret /
svaṃ mantramakṣasūtraṃ ca vidyāṃ jñānasvarūpakam // 525
meaning:
गर्वं दम्भं भूतविषव्याधितन्त्रं नचाचरेत् /
स्वं मन्त्रमक्षसूत्रं च विद्यां ज्ञानस्वरूपकम् // 525
text_mt: arrogance, deceit, and rituals involving spirits, poisons, and diseases: he should not practice these. / One's own mantra, rosary, vidyā, the nature of knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
samācārānguṇānkleśānsiddhiliṅgāni gūhayet /
guruṃ śāstraṃ devavahnī jñānavṛddhāṃstriyo vratam // 526
meaning:
समाचारान्गुणान्क्लेशान्सिद्धिलिङ्गानि गूहयेत् /
गुरुं शास्त्रं देववह्नी ज्ञानवृद्धांस्त्रियो व्रतम् // 526
text_mt: practices, virtues, afflictions, and signs of spiritual accomplishment: he should conceal these. / The guru, scripture, deity, fire, elders in knowledge, women, observance,

sanskrit_iast:
guruvargaṃ yathāśaktyā pūjayedaṣṭakaṃ tvidam /
dīnānkliṣṭānpitṝnkṣetrapālānprāṇigaṇān khagān // 527
meaning:
गुरुवर्गं यथाशक्त्या पूजयेदष्टकं त्विदम् /
दीनान्क्लिष्टान्पितॄन्क्षेत्रपालान्प्राणिगणान् खगान् // 527
text_mt: and the guru's lineage: one should worship this octad according to one's capacity. / The destitute, the afflicted, the ancestors, field-guardians, living creatures, birds,

sanskrit_iast:
śmāśānikaṃ bhūtagaṇaṃ dehadevīśca tarpayet /
śivaṃ śaktiṃ tathātmānaṃ mudrāṃ mantrasvarūpakam // 528
meaning:
श्माशानिकं भूतगणं देहदेवीश्च तर्पयेत् /
शिवं शक्तिं तथात्मानं मुद्रां मन्त्रस्वरूपकम् // 528
text_mt: the host of cremation-ground spirits, and the deities of the body: one should propitiate these. / Śiva, Śakti, oneself, mudrā, the nature of mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārabhuktimuktīśca guruvaktrāttu bhāvayet /
rāgaṃ dveṣamasūyāṃ ca saṃkocerṣyābhimānitāḥ // 529
meaning:
संसारभुक्तिमुक्तीश्च गुरुवक्त्रात्तु भावयेत् /
रागं द्वेषमसूयां च संकोचेर्ष्याभिमानिताः // 529
text_mt: and worldly existence, enjoyment, and liberation: one should contemplate these from the mouth of the guru. / Attachment, aversion, malice, contraction, jealousy, and pride,

sanskrit_iast:
samayapratibhettṝṃstadanācārāṃśca ghātayet /
paśumārgasthitānkrūrāndveṣiṇaḥ piśunāñjaḍān // 530
meaning:
समयप्रतिभेत्तॄंस्तदनाचारांश्च घातयेत् /
पशुमार्गस्थितान्क्रूरान्द्वेषिणः पिशुनाञ्जडान् // 530
text_mt: violators of the rules of conduct, and their bad behaviors: one should eradicate these. / Those standing on the path of the bound soul, the cruel, the hostile, slanderers, fools,

sanskrit_iast:
rājñaścānucarānpāpānvighnakartṝṃśca mohayet /
śākinyaḥ pūjanīyāśca tāścetthaṃ śrīgamoditāḥ // 531
meaning:
राज्ञश्चानुचरान्पापान्विघ्नकर्तॄंश्च मोहयेत् /
शाकिन्यः पूजनीयाश्च ताश्चेत्थं श्रीगमोदिताः // 531
text_mt: the king's evil henchmen, and obstacle-makers: one should bewilder them. / And the śākinīs must be worshipped; they are proclaimed thus in the venerable Gama:

sanskrit_iast:
sāhasaṃ dviguṇaṃ yāsāṃ kāmaścaiva caturguṇaḥ /
lobhaścāṣṭaguṇastāsāṃ śaṅkyaṃ śākinya ityalam // 532
meaning:
साहसं द्विगुणं यासां कामश्चैव चतुर्गुणः /
लोभश्चाष्टगुणस्तासां शङ्क्यं शाकिन्य इत्यलम् // 532
text_mt: Those whose audacity is twofold, passion fourfold, / and greed eightfold, are suspected to be śākinīs; enough [said].

sanskrit_iast:
kulāmnāyasthitā vīradravyabāhyāstu ye na taiḥ /
paśubhiḥ saha vastavyamiti śrīmādhave kule // 533
meaning:
कुलाम्नायस्थिता वीरद्रव्यबाह्यास्तु ये न तैः /
पशुभिः सह वस्तव्यमिति श्रीमाधवे कुले // 533
text_mt: Those established in the Kula transmission who are excluded from the hero's substance—one must not live / with those bound souls; thus it is stated in the Śrīmādhavakula.

sanskrit_iast:
devatācakragurvagniśāstraṃ sāmyātsadārcayet /
aniveditametebhyo na kiṃcidapi bhakṣayet // 534
meaning:
देवताचक्रगुर्वग्निशास्त्रं साम्यात्सदार्चयेत् /
अनिवेदितमेतेभ्यो न किंचिदपि भक्षयेत् // 534
text_mt: One should continually worship the cakra of deities, the guru, the fire, and the scripture with equanimity; / one should not consume anything at all that is unoffered to them.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddravyaṃ nāpaharedguruvargaṃ prapūjayet /
sa ca tadbhrātṛbhāryātukprāyo vidyākṛto bhavet // 535
meaning:
एतद्द्रव्यं नापहरेद्गुरुवर्गं प्रपूजयेत् /
स च तद्भ्रातृभार्यातुक्प्रायो विद्याकृतो भवेत् // 535
text_mt: One should not steal this substance; one should revere the guru's circle, / and that [circle] usually consists of his brother, wife, and child, created through knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
na yonisaṃbandhakṛto laukikaḥ sa paśuryataḥ /
tasyābhiṣvaṅgabhūmistu gurvārādhanasiddhaye // 536
meaning:
न योनिसंबन्धकृतो लौकिकः स पशुर्यतः /
तस्याभिष्वङ्गभूमिस्तु गुर्वाराधनसिद्धये // 536
text_mt: not created through birth-relation, for that worldly person is a bound soul. / But the realm of his affection exists for the accomplishment of serving the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
arcyo na svamahimnā tu tadvargo guruvatpunaḥ /
gurornindāṃ na kurvīta tasyai hetuṃ nacācaret // 537
meaning:
अर्च्यो न स्वमहिम्ना तु तद्वर्गो गुरुवत्पुनः /
गुरोर्निन्दां न कुर्वीत तस्यै हेतुं नचाचरेत् // 537
text_mt: His circle is not to be worshiped by its own greatness, but rather as identical to the guru. / One should not censure the guru, nor should one act in a way that causes it.

sanskrit_iast:
naca tāṃ śṛṇuyānnainaṃ kopayennāgrato'sya ca /
vinājñayā prakurvīta kiṃcittatsevanādṛte // 538
meaning:
नच तां शृणुयान्नैनं कोपयेन्नाग्रतोऽस्य च /
विनाज्ञया प्रकुर्वीत किंचित्तत्सेवनादृते // 538
text_mt: One should not listen to it, nor anger him, nor before him / do anything without permission, except for attending upon him.

sanskrit_iast:
laukikālaukikaṃ kṛtyaṃ krodhaṃ krīḍāṃ tapo japam /
gurūpabhuktaṃ yatkiṃcicchayyāvastrāsanādikam // 539
meaning:
लौकिकालौकिकं कृत्यं क्रोधं क्रीडां तपो जपम् /
गुरूपभुक्तं यत्किंचिच्छय्यावस्त्रासनादिकम् // 539
text_mt: [Whether] a worldly or non-worldly activity, anger, play, austerity, or recitation; / whatever was used by the guru—bed, clothing, seat, and the like—

sanskrit_iast:
nopabhuñjīta tatpadbhyāṃ na spṛśetkiṃtu vandayet /
śrīmattraiśirase'pyuktaṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ // 540
meaning:
नोपभुञ्जीत तत्पद्भ्यां न स्पृशेत्किंतु वन्दयेत् /
श्रीमत्त्रैशिरसेऽप्युक्तं कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः // 540
text_mt: one should not use; one should not touch it with one's feet, but rather bow to it. / In the venerable Traiśirasa it is also stated: 'By severe penances such as the kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
araṇye kāṣṭhavattiṣṭhedasidhārāvrato'pi san /
niyamastho yamastho'pi tatpadaṃ nāśnute param // 541
meaning:
अरण्ये काष्ठवत्तिष्ठेदसिधाराव्रतोऽपि सन् /
नियमस्थो यमस्थोऽपि तत्पदं नाश्नुते परम् // 541
text_mt: even if one stands like a log in the forest, even undertaking the razor-edge vow, / abiding by restraints and ethical observances, one does not attain that supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvārādhanasaktastu manasā karmaṇā girā /
prāpnoti gurutastuṣṭāt pūrṇaṃ śreyo mahādbhutam // 542
meaning:
गुर्वाराधनसक्तस्तु मनसा कर्मणा गिरा /
प्राप्नोति गुरुतस्तुष्टात् पूर्णं श्रेयो महाद्भुतम् // 542
text_mt: But one devoted to serving the guru in mind, action, and speech / obtains from the pleased guru full, magnificent bliss.'

sanskrit_iast:
himapātairyathā bhūmiśchāditā sā samantataḥ /
mārutaśleṣasaṃyogādaśmavattiṣṭhate sadā // 543
meaning:
हिमपातैर्यथा भूमिश्छादिता सा समन्ततः /
मारुतश्लेषसंयोगादश्मवत्तिष्ठते सदा // 543
text_mt: Just as the earth, covered on all sides by snowfalls, / remains perpetually stone-like due to the congealing contact of the wind,

sanskrit_iast:
yamādau niścale tadvadbhāva ekastu gṛhyate /
gurostvārādhitātpūrṇaṃ prasarajjñānamāpyate // 544
meaning:
यमादौ निश्चले तद्वद्भाव एकस्तु गृह्यते /
गुरोस्त्वाराधितात्पूर्णं प्रसरज्ज्ञानमाप्यते // 544
text_mt: even so, when steady in restraints and the rest, only a single entity is grasped; / but from the worshiped guru, full, unfolding knowledge is obtained.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvato'vasthitaṃ cittvaṃ jñeyasthaṃ yasya tatkathā /
sadya eva nayedūrdhvaṃ tasmādārādhayedgurum // 545
meaning:
सर्वतोऽवस्थितं चित्त्वं ज्ञेयस्थं यस्य तत्कथा /
सद्य एव नयेदूर्ध्वं तस्मादाराधयेद्गुरुम् // 545
text_mt: He whose state of consciousness is stationed everywhere, resting in what is to be known, discourse about him / immediately leads upward; therefore, one should worship the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsāre'pyasya saṃbhāṣātpātakaṃ naśyati kṣaṇāt /
tasmātparīkṣya yatnena śāstroktyā jñānalakṣaṇaiḥ // 546
meaning:
श्रीसारेऽप्यस्य संभाषात्पातकं नश्यति क्षणात् /
तस्मात्परीक्ष्य यत्नेन शास्त्रोक्त्या ज्ञानलक्षणैः // 546
text_mt: In the Śrīsāra also: 'From conversation with him, sin is destroyed in an instant.' / Therefore, having carefully tested [him] through scriptural utterance and the marks of knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrācāreṇa varteta tena saṅgaṃ tathā kuru /
snehājjātu vadejjñānaṃ lobhānna hriyate hi saḥ // 547
meaning:
शास्त्राचारेण वर्तेत तेन सङ्गं तथा कुरु /
स्नेहाज्जातु वदेज्ज्ञानं लोभान्न ह्रियते हि सः // 547
text_mt: one should conduct oneself according to scriptural practice; keep company with him in that manner. / Out of affection he might teach knowledge; indeed, he is not swayed by greed.

sanskrit_iast:
tena tuṣṭena tṛpyanti devāḥ pitara evaca /
uttīrya narakādyānti sadyaḥ śivapuraṃ mahat // 548
meaning:
तेन तुष्टेन तृप्यन्ति देवाः पितर एवच /
उत्तीर्य नरकाद्यान्ति सद्यः शिवपुरं महत् // 548
text_mt: When he is pleased, the gods and the ancestors are satisfied; / crossing over from hell, they go immediately to the great city of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuṅkte tiṣṭhedyatra gṛhe vrajecchivapuraṃ tu saḥ /
iti jñātvā sadā pitrye śrāddhe svaṃ gurumarcayet // 549
meaning:
भुङ्क्ते तिष्ठेद्यत्र गृहे व्रजेच्छिवपुरं तु सः /
इति ज्ञात्वा सदा पित्र्ये श्राद्धे स्वं गुरुमर्चयेत् // 549
text_mt: In whichever house he eats and stays, that [householder] goes to the city of Śiva. / Knowing this, one should always worship one's guru in the ancestral śrāddha.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuñjīta sa svayaṃ cānyānādiśettatkṛte guruḥ /
yo dīkṣitastu śrāddhādau svatantraṃ vidhimācaret // 550
meaning:
भुञ्जीत स स्वयं चान्यानादिशेत्तत्कृते गुरुः /
यो दीक्षितस्तु श्राद्धादौ स्वतन्त्रं विधिमाचरेत् // 550
text_mt: He may eat himself and the guru may designate others for that purpose. / But an initiate who performs an autonomous rite in a śrāddha and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tasya tanniṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ samayena ca laṅghyate /
saiddhāntikārpitaṃ caṇḍīyogyaṃ dravyaṃ vivarjayet // 551
meaning:
तस्य तन्निष्फलं सर्वं समयेन च लङ्घ्यते /
सैद्धान्तिकार्पितं चण्डीयोग्यं द्रव्यं विवर्जयेत् // 551
text_mt: all of that is fruitless for him, and he is transgressed by the rule. / One should reject substance offered by Siddhāntins and that which is suitable for Caṇḍī.

sanskrit_iast:
śākinīvācakaṃ śabdaṃ na kadācitsamuccaret /
striyaḥ pūjyā virūpāstu vṛddhāḥ śilpopajīvikāḥ // 552
meaning:
शाकिनीवाचकं शब्दं न कदाचित्समुच्चरेत् /
स्त्रियः पूज्या विरूपास्तु वृद्धाः शिल्पोपजीविकाः // 552
text_mt: One should never pronounce a word that denotes a śākinī. / Women are to be honored: those of misshapen form, the aged, those living by crafts,

sanskrit_iast:
antyā vikāritāṅgyaśca veśyāḥ svacchandaceṣṭitāḥ /
tathāca śrīgame proktaṃ pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ // 553
meaning:
अन्त्या विकारिताङ्ग्यश्च वेश्याः स्वच्छन्दचेष्टिताः /
तथाच श्रीगमे प्रोक्तं पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नतः // 553
text_mt: outcastes, those with deformed limbs, courtesans, and those who act freely. / And likewise it is declared in the Śrī Agama that they are to be worshiped with diligence:

sanskrit_iast:
nirācārāḥ sarvabhakṣyā dharmādharmavivarjitāḥ /
svacchandagāḥ palāśinyo lampaṭā devatā iva // 554
meaning:
निराचाराः सर्वभक्ष्या धर्माधर्मविवर्जिताः /
स्वच्छन्दगाः पलाशिन्यो लम्पटा देवता इव // 554
text_mt: 'Free of rules of conduct, omnivorous, beyond virtue and sin, / moving at will, carnivorous, wanton, like deities,

sanskrit_iast:
veśyāḥ pūjyāstadgṛhaṃ ca prayāgo'tra yajetkramam /
strīṣu tannācaretkicidyena tābhyo jugupsate // 555
meaning:
वेश्याः पूज्यास्तद्गृहं च प्रयागोऽत्र यजेत्क्रमम् /
स्त्रीषु तन्नाचरेत्किचिद्येन ताभ्यो जुगुप्सते // 555
text_mt: courtesans are to be honored, and their house is Prayāga; here one should worship the succession.' / Toward women one must not do anything by which one feels revulsion toward them;

sanskrit_iast:
ato na nagnāstāḥ paśyennacāpi prakaṭastanīḥ /
vṛddhāyāḥ saṃsthitāyā vā na jugupseta mudrikām // 556
meaning:
अतो न नग्नास्ताः पश्येन्नचापि प्रकटस्तनीः /
वृद्धायाः संस्थिताया वा न जुगुप्सेत मुद्रिकाम् // 556
text_mt: therefore, one should not look at them naked, nor with breasts exposed. / Toward an old woman or an established woman, one should not feel disgust for the seal [of the vulva].

sanskrit_iast:
vaikṛtyaṃ tatra saurūpyaṃ melakaṃ na prakāśayet /
devamūrtiṃ śūnyatanuṃ pūjayettripathādiṣu // 557
meaning:
वैकृत्यं तत्र सौरूप्यं मेलकं न प्रकाशयेत् /
देवमूर्तिं शून्यतनुं पूजयेत्त्रिपथादिषु // 557
text_mt: One should not reveal deformity, beauty, or sexual union there. / One should worship the divine form and the void-body at crossroads and similar places.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaparvasu sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ /
pūjā guroranadhyāyo melake lobhavarjanam // 558
meaning:
सर्वपर्वसु सामान्यविशेषेषु विशेषतः /
पूजा गुरोरनध्यायो मेलके लोभवर्जनम् // 558
text_mt: On all festive occasions, general and specific, especially / worship of the guru, cessation of study, and freedom from greed at the gathering [are required].

sanskrit_iast:
na jugupseta madyādi vīradravyaṃ kadācana /
na nindedatha vandeta nityaṃ tajjoṣiṇastathā // 559
meaning:
न जुगुप्सेत मद्यादि वीरद्रव्यं कदाचन /
न निन्देदथ वन्देत नित्यं तज्जोषिणस्तथा // 559
text_mt: One should never despise the hero's substance such as wine; / one should not censure, but rather bow constantly to those who partake of it.

sanskrit_iast:
upadeśāya na doṣā hṛdayaṃ cenna vidviṣet /
vijātīyavikalpāṃśotpuṃsanāya yateta ca // 560
meaning:
उपदेशाय न दोषा हृदयं चेन्न विद्विषेत् /
विजातीयविकल्पांशोत्पुंसनाय यतेत च // 560
text_mt: Faults [pointed out] for the sake of instruction do not count, provided one's heart does not harbor malice, / and one should strive to eradicate the portions of discordant conceptual constructs.

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ śāstrasya devīnāṃ nāma mantre yatastataḥ /
arcāto'nyatra noccāryamāhūtaṃ tarpayettataḥ // 561
meaning:
गुरोः शास्त्रस्य देवीनां नाम मन्त्रे यतस्ततः /
अर्चातोऽन्यत्र नोच्चार्यमाहूतं तर्पयेत्ततः // 561
text_mt: The name of the guru, the scripture, and the goddesses in a mantra is not to be uttered anywhere / other than in worship; thereafter, one should satisfy the one invoked.

sanskrit_iast:
āgatasya ca mantrasya na kuryāttarpaṇaṃ yadi /
haratyardhaśarīraṃ tadityūce bhagavānyataḥ // 562
meaning:
आगतस्य च मन्त्रस्य न कुर्यात्तर्पणं यदि /
हरत्यर्धशरीरं तदित्यूचे भगवान्यतः // 562
text_mt: And if one does not perform libation for the mantra that has arrived, / it takes away half of the body; because the Blessed One said so.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadūrmau ca devīnāṃ vīrāṇāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ na vai /
prathayenna jugupseta vadennādravyapāṇikaḥ // 563
meaning:
श्रीमदूर्मौ च देवीनां वीराणां चेष्टितं न वै /
प्रथयेन्न जुगुप्सेत वदेन्नाद्रव्यपाणिकः // 563
text_mt: And in the venerable Urmi: 'One must not publicize / the conduct of the goddesses and the heroes, nor feel disgust; one should not speak with empty hands.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpūrvaṃ nāma vaktavyaṃ gurordravyakareṇa ca /
gurvādīnāṃ na laṅghyā ca chāyā na tairthikaiḥ saha // 564
meaning:
श्रीपूर्वं नाम वक्तव्यं गुरोर्द्रव्यकरेण च /
गुर्वादीनां न लङ्घ्या च छाया न तैर्थिकैः सह // 564
text_mt: The guru's name is to be spoken preceded by "śrī", with substance in one's hand; / and the shadow of the guru and the rest must not be stepped on; nor [should one] converse with non-initiates,

sanskrit_iast:
jalpaṃ kurvansvaśāstrārthaṃ vadennāpica sūcayet /
nityādviśeṣapūjāṃ ca kuryānnaimittike vidhau // 565
meaning:
जल्पं कुर्वन्स्वशास्त्रार्थं वदेन्नापिच सूचयेत् /
नित्याद्विशेषपूजां च कुर्यान्नैमित्तिके विधौ // 565
text_mt: nor recite nor indicate the meaning of one's own scripture. / And one should perform the special worship beyond the daily rite on an occasional occasion,

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi madhye varṣasya tato'pi hi pavitrake /
anyastamantro nāsīta sevyaṃ śāstrāntaraṃ ca no // 566
meaning:
ततोऽपि मध्ये वर्षस्य ततोऽपि हि पवित्रके /
अन्यस्तमन्त्रो नासीत सेव्यं शास्त्रान्तरं च नो // 566
text_mt: even more so in the middle of the year, and even more so at the Pavitraka festival. / One must not sit with mantras uninstalled, nor should another scripture be pursued.

sanskrit_iast:
aprarūḍhaṃ hi vijñānaṃ kampetetarabhāvanāt /
gṛhopaskaraṇāstrāṇi davatāyāgayogataḥ // 567
meaning:
अप्ररूढं हि विज्ञानं कम्पेतेतरभावनात् /
गृहोपस्करणास्त्राणि दवतायागयोगतः // 567
text_mt: For knowledge that is not deeply rooted would waver from contemplating something else. / The household utensils and weapons, through association with the sacrifice to the deity,

sanskrit_iast:
arcyānīti na padbhyāṃ vai spṛśennāpi vilaṅghyet /
guruvarge gṛhāyāte viśeṣaṃ kaṃcidācaret // 568
meaning:
अर्च्यानीति न पद्भ्यां वै स्पृशेन्नापि विलङ्घ्येत् /
गुरुवर्गे गृहायाते विशेषं कंचिदाचरेत् // 568
text_mt: are to be revered; thus one should not touch them with one's feet nor step over them. / When the guru's circle arrives at the house, one should perform something special.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣitānāṃ na nindādi kuryādvidveṣapūrvakam /
upadeśāya no doṣaḥ sa hyavidveṣapūrvakaḥ // 569
meaning:
दीक्षितानां न निन्दादि कुर्याद्विद्वेषपूर्वकम् /
उपदेशाय नो दोषः स ह्यविद्वेषपूर्वकः // 569
text_mt: One should not censure or disparage the initiated motivated by malice; / for the sake of instruction there is no fault, for that is free of malice.

sanskrit_iast:
na vaṣṇavādikādhaḥsthadṛṣṭibhiḥ saṃvasedalam /
sahabhojanaśayyādyarnaiṣāṃ prakaṭayetsthitim // 570
meaning:
न वष्णवादिकाधःस्थदृष्टिभिः संवसेदलम् /
सहभोजनशय्याद्यर्नैषां प्रकटयेत्स्थितिम् // 570
text_mt: One should not associate at all with those of lower views, such as Vaiṣṇavas; / one must not disclose to them eating together, sharing beds, and so forth.'

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrīṃmādhavakule śāsanāntarasaṃsthitān /
vedoktiṃ vaiṣṇavoktiṃ ca tairuktaṃ varjayetsadā // 571
meaning:
उक्तं श्रींमाधवकुले शासनान्तरसंस्थितान् /
वेदोक्तिं वैष्णवोक्तिं च तैरुक्तं वर्जयेत्सदा // 571
text_mt: It is stated in the Śrīmādhavakula: 'Those established in other teachings, / the Vedic doctrine and the Vaiṣṇava doctrine—what is spoken by them one should always avoid.

sanskrit_iast:
akulīneṣu saṃparkāttatkulātpatanādbhayam /
ekapātre kulāmnāye tasmāttānparivarjayet // 572
meaning:
अकुलीनेषु संपर्कात्तत्कुलात्पतनाद्भयम् /
एकपात्रे कुलाम्नाये तस्मात्तान्परिवर्जयेत् // 572
text_mt: From contact with those outside Kula, there is fear of falling from that Kula / in the single vessel of the Kula transmission; therefore, one should avoid them.

sanskrit_iast:
pramādācca kṛte sakhye goṣṭhyāṃ cakraṃ tu pūjayet /
śrīmadūrmau ca kathitamāgamāntarasevake // 573
meaning:
प्रमादाच्च कृते सख्ये गोष्ठ्यां चक्रं तु पूजयेत् /
श्रीमदूर्मौ च कथितमागमान्तरसेवके // 573
text_mt: And if fellowship is made through negligence, one should worship the cakra in an assembly.' / And in the venerable Urmi it is taught: 'With one devoted to another scripture,

sanskrit_iast:
gurvantararate mūḍhe devadravyopajīvake /
śaktihiṃsākare duṣṭe saṃparkaṃ naiva kārayet // 574
meaning:
गुर्वन्तररते मूढे देवद्रव्योपजीवके /
शक्तिहिंसाकरे दुष्टे संपर्कं नैव कारयेत् // 574
text_mt: with a fool devoted to another guru, with one who lives off the deity's property, / with a wicked person who causes injury to śakti, one should never have contact.

sanskrit_iast:
na vikalpena dīkṣādau vrajedāyatanādikam /
uktāsthāśithilatve yannimittaṃ naiva taccaret // 575
meaning:
न विकल्पेन दीक्षादौ व्रजेदायतनादिकम् /
उक्तास्थाशिथिलत्वे यन्निमित्तं नैव तच्चरेत् // 575
text_mt: One should not go with doubt to a shrine or the like during initiation and other rites; / whatever is a cause for laxity in the stated faith, one should never do that.

sanskrit_iast:
śāsanasthānpurājātyā na paśyennāpyudīrayet /
naca vyavaharetsarvāñchivābhedena kevalam // 576
meaning:
शासनस्थान्पुराजात्या न पश्येन्नाप्युदीरयेत् /
नच व्यवहरेत्सर्वाञ्छिवाभेदेन केवलम् // 576
text_mt: One should not look upon nor address those established in the teaching by their former caste; / nor should one deal with them [as diverse], but solely with non-difference from Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
sadvidyaiḥ sākamāsīta jñānadīptyai yateta ca /
nāsaṃskṛtāṃ vrajettajjaṃ viphalatvaṃ nacānayet // 577
meaning:
सद्विद्यैः साकमासीत ज्ञानदीप्त्यै यतेत च /
नासंस्कृतां व्रजेत्तज्जं विफलत्वं नचानयेत् // 577
text_mt: One should sit with those possessors of true knowledge and strive for the radiance of knowledge; / one should not approach an unconsecrated woman, nor render what arises from her fruitless.'

sanskrit_iast:
melakārdhaniśācaryā janavarjaṃ ca tannahi /
māṃsādidāhagandhaṃ ca jighreddevīpriyo hyasau // 578
meaning:
मेलकार्धनिशाचर्या जनवर्जं च तन्नहि /
मांसादिदाहगन्धं च जिघ्रेद्देवीप्रियो ह्यसौ // 578
text_mt: The observance at midnight in a gathering [of Yoginīs] must not be done away from people. / Nor should he smell the odour of burning meat and the like; for he is dear to the Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
gurvājñāṃ pālayansarvaṃ tyajenmantramayo bhavet /
śāstrapūjājapadhyānavivekatadupakriyāḥ // 579
meaning:
गुर्वाज्ञां पालयन्सर्वं त्यजेन्मन्त्रमयो भवेत् /
शास्त्रपूजाजपध्यानविवेकतदुपक्रियाः // 579
text_mt: Fulfilling the guru's command, he should abandon all else and consist [solely] of mantra. / Without making scriptures, worship, recitation, meditation, discernment, and their beneficial activities

sanskrit_iast:
akurvanniṣphalāṃ naiva ceṣṭeta trividhāṃ kriyām /
mantratantrairna vādaṃ ca kuryānno bhakṣayedviṣam // 580
meaning:
अकुर्वन्निष्फलां नैव चेष्टेत त्रिविधां क्रियाम् /
मन्त्रतन्त्रैर्न वादं च कुर्यान्नो भक्षयेद्विषम् // 580
text_mt: fruitless, he should by no means engage in the threefold activity [that is useless]. / Nor should he debate by means of mantras and tantras, nor should he consume poison.

sanskrit_iast:
samayānāṃ vilope ca guruṃ pṛcchedasannidhau /
tadvargaṃ nijasantānamanyaṃ tasyāpyasaṃnidhau // 581
meaning:
समयानां विलोपे च गुरुं पृच्छेदसन्निधौ /
तद्वर्गं निजसन्तानमन्यं तस्याप्यसंनिधौ // 581
text_mt: And when the rules are transgressed, he should ask the guru; in his absence, / his circle [of disciples]; in his absence too, another from his own lineage.

sanskrit_iast:
tenoktamanutiṣṭhecca nirvikalpaṃ prayatnataḥ /
yataḥ śāstrādisaṃbodhatanmayīkṛtamānasaḥ // 582
meaning:
तेनोक्तमनुतिष्ठेच्च निर्विकल्पं प्रयत्नतः /
यतः शास्त्रादिसंबोधतन्मयीकृतमानसः // 582
text_mt: And he should diligently follow what is spoken by him, free from conceptual constructs. / Because his mind is identified with that through realization of scripture and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
śiva eva gururnāsya vāgasatyā viniḥsaret /
śivasya svātmasaṃskṛtyai prahvībhāvo guroḥ punaḥ // 583
meaning:
शिव एव गुरुर्नास्य वागसत्या विनिःसरेत् /
शिवस्य स्वात्मसंस्कृत्यै प्रह्वीभावो गुरोः पुनः // 583
text_mt: the guru is indeed Śiva; an untrue word would not issue from him. / Bowing down to Śiva serves to consecrate oneself, whereas [bowing] to the guru

sanskrit_iast:
hlādāyetyubhayārthāya tattuṣṭiḥ phaladā śiśoḥ /
gurvāyattaikasiddhirhisamayyapi vibodhabhāk // 584
meaning:
ह्लादायेत्युभयार्थाय तत्तुष्टिः फलदा शिशोः /
गुर्वायत्तैकसिद्धिर्हिसमय्यपि विबोधभाक् // 584
text_mt: serves to give joy; thus, for both purposes, his satisfaction yields the pupil fruit. / For an initiate into the rule whose spiritual accomplishment is solely dependent on the guru also shares in illumination;

sanskrit_iast:
tadbodhabahumānena vidyādgurutamaṃ gurum /
ataḥ saṃprāpya vijñānaṃ yo gurau bāhyamānavān // 585
meaning:
तद्बोधबहुमानेन विद्याद्गुरुतमं गुरुम् /
अतः संप्राप्य विज्ञानं यो गुरौ बाह्यमानवान् // 585
text_mt: out of high regard for that illumination, he should know the guru to be supreme. / Therefore, having attained realization, one who considers the guru to be external

sanskrit_iast:
nāsau vijñānaviśvasto nāsatyaṃ bhraṣṭa eva saḥ /
jñānānāśvastacittaṃ taṃ vacomātreṇa śāstritam // 586
meaning:
नासौ विज्ञानविश्वस्तो नासत्यं भ्रष्ट एव सः /
ज्ञानानाश्वस्तचित्तं तं वचोमात्रेण शास्त्रितम् // 586
text_mt: has no confidence in realization, not to mention truth; he is utterly fallen. / One should never mentally honour a devotee whose heart lacks confidence in knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktaṃ ca nārcayejjātu hṛdā vijñānadūṣakam /
tādṛk ca na guruḥ kāryastaṃ kṛtvāpi parityajet // 587
meaning:
भक्तं च नार्चयेज्जातु हृदा विज्ञानदूषकम् /
तादृक् च न गुरुः कार्यस्तं कृत्वापि परित्यजेत् // 587
text_mt: who is learned in scriptures merely by lip service, and who defames realization. / And such a one must not be made a guru; even having made him [one's guru], one should abandon him.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyabuddhyā na saṃpaśyedvaiṣṇavādigatāngurūn /
tathāca śrīmadūrmyākhye guroruktaṃ viśeṣaṇam // 588
meaning:
मुख्यबुद्ध्या न संपश्येद्वैष्णवादिगतान्गुरून् /
तथाच श्रीमदूर्म्याख्ये गुरोरुक्तं विशेषणम् // 588
text_mt: He should not view gurus belonging to Vaiṣṇava and other [traditions] as primary. / And thus in the revered [work] named Ūrmi, the definition of a guru is stated:

sanskrit_iast:
gurvājñā prāṇasaṃdehe nopekṣyā no vikalpyate /
kauladīkṣā kaulaśāstraṃ tattvajñānaṃ prakāśitam // 589
meaning:
गुर्वाज्ञा प्राणसंदेहे नोपेक्ष्या नो विकल्प्यते /
कौलदीक्षा कौलशास्त्रं तत्त्वज्ञानं प्रकाशितम् // 589
text_mt: “The guru's command must not be neglected or doubted, even when life is in danger. / By whom Kaula initiation, Kaula scriptures, [and] the knowledge of reality have been revealed,

sanskrit_iast:
yenāsau gururityukto hyanye vai nāmadhāriṇaḥ /
śrīmadānandaśāstre ca tathaivoktaṃ viśeṣaṇam // 590
meaning:
येनासौ गुरुरित्युक्तो ह्यन्ये वै नामधारिणः /
श्रीमदानन्दशास्त्रे च तथैवोक्तं विशेषणम् // 590
text_mt: he is declared to be the guru; indeed, others merely bear the name.” / And in the revered Ānandaśāstra, the definition is likewise stated:

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāddīkṣā mantraśāstraṃ tattvajñānaṃ sa vai guruḥ /
tiṣṭhedavyaktaliṅgaśca na liṅgaṃ dhārayet kvacit // 591
meaning:
यस्माद्दीक्षा मन्त्रशास्त्रं तत्त्वज्ञानं स वै गुरुः /
तिष्ठेदव्यक्तलिङ्गश्च न लिङ्गं धारयेत् क्वचित् // 591
text_mt: “From whom come initiation, the scripture of mantras, [and] knowledge of reality, he indeed is the guru.” / And he should remain with unmanifest sectarian marks, and should never wear a sectarian mark.

sanskrit_iast:
na liṅgibhiḥ samaṃ kaiścitkuryādācāramelanam /
kevalaṃ liṅginaḥ pālyā na bībhatsyā virūpakāḥ // 592
meaning:
न लिङ्गिभिः समं कैश्चित्कुर्यादाचारमेलनम् /
केवलं लिङ्गिनः पाल्या न बीभत्स्या विरूपकाः // 592
text_mt: He should not engage in communal observance together with any who wear sectarian marks. / Those who wear sectarian marks are merely to be protected; grotesque persons are not to be loathed.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadrātrikule coktaṃ mokṣaḥ śaṅkāpahānitaḥ /
aśuddhavāsasnayaiṣā mokṣavārtāpi durlabhā // 593
meaning:
श्रीमद्रात्रिकुले चोक्तं मोक्षः शङ्कापहानितः /
अशुद्धवासस्नयैषा मोक्षवार्तापि दुर्लभा // 593
text_mt: And in the revered Rātrikula it is stated: “Liberation comes from the abandonment of doubt; / for one of impure intellect, even talk of liberation is hard to come by.”

sanskrit_iast:
na likhenmantrahṛdayaṃ śrīmanmāloditaṃ kila /
tadaṅgāduddharenmantraṃ natu lekhe vilekhayet // 594
meaning:
न लिखेन्मन्त्रहृदयं श्रीमन्मालोदितं किल /
तदङ्गादुद्धरेन्मन्त्रं नतु लेखे विलेखयेत् // 594
text_mt: He should indeed not write down the heart of the mantra revealed in the revered Mālā. / He should extract the mantra from her body, but should never write it down in a book.

sanskrit_iast:
atattve'bhiniveśaṃ ca na kuryātpakṣapātataḥ /
jātividyākulācāradehadeśaguṇārthajān // 595
meaning:
अतत्त्वेऽभिनिवेशं च न कुर्यात्पक्षपाततः /
जातिविद्याकुलाचारदेहदेशगुणार्थजान् // 595
text_mt: And he should not adhere to what is non-reality out of partiality. / Born of caste, learning, family lineage, conduct, body, country, qualities, and wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
grahāngrahānivāṣṭau drāktyajedgahvararśitān /
tathā śrīniśicārādau hayatvenopadarśitān // 596
meaning:
ग्रहान्ग्रहानिवाष्टौ द्राक्त्यजेद्गह्वरर्शितान् /
तथा श्रीनिशिचारादौ हयत्वेनोपदर्शितान् // 596
text_mt: he should swiftly abandon the eight demonic obsessions, as if they were seizing spirits, shown in the Gahvara, / and likewise shown as horses in the revered Niśicāra and other texts.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇo'haṃ mayā vedaśāstroktādaparaṃ katham /
anuṣṭheyamayaṃ jātigrahaḥ paranirodhakaḥ // 597
meaning:
ब्राह्मणोऽहं मया वेदशास्त्रोक्तादपरं कथम् /
अनुष्ठेयमयं जातिग्रहः परनिरोधकः // 597
text_mt: “I am a Brahmin; how could I perform anything other than what is taught in the Vedic scriptures?”— / this is the demonic obsession of caste, which blocks the highest [truth].

sanskrit_iast:
evamanye'pyudāhāryāḥ kulagahvaravartmanā /
atatsvabhāve tādrūpyaṃ darśayannavaśe'pi yaḥ // 598
meaning:
एवमन्येऽप्युदाहार्याः कुलगह्वरवर्त्मना /
अतत्स्वभावे ताद्रूप्यं दर्शयन्नवशेऽपि यः // 598
text_mt: Others too are to be exemplified in this way according to the method of the Kulagahvara. / That which reveals identity in what is not its own nature, even when one is powerless,

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpācchādakaḥ so'tra graho graha ivoditaḥ /
saṃvitsvabhāve no jātiprabhṛtiḥ kāpi kalpanā // 599
meaning:
स्वरूपाच्छादकः सोऽत्र ग्रहो ग्रह इवोदितः /
संवित्स्वभावे नो जातिप्रभृतिः कापि कल्पना // 599
text_mt: and conceals one's own nature, is here called a demonic obsession, like a seizing spirit. / In the nature of consciousness there is no conceptualization such as caste and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ sā tvasvarūpeṇa tadrūpaṃ chādayatyalam /
yā kācitkalpanā saṃvittattvasyākhaṇḍitātmanaḥ // 600
meaning:
रूपं सा त्वस्वरूपेण तद्रूपं छादयत्यलम् /
या काचित्कल्पना संवित्तत्त्वस्याखण्डितात्मनः // 600
text_mt: Indeed, through an alien form, that form completely conceals that nature. / Any conceptual construct that causes contraction

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkocakāriṇī sarvaḥ sa grahastāṃ parityajet /
śrīmadānandaśāstre ca kathitaṃ parameṣṭhinā // 601
meaning:
संकोचकारिणी सर्वः स ग्रहस्तां परित्यजेत् /
श्रीमदानन्दशास्त्रे च कथितं परमेष्ठिना // 601
text_mt: of the reality of consciousness, whose nature is undivided—all that is a demonic obsession; one should abandon it. / And in the revered Ānandaśāstra it is stated by the Supreme Lord:

sanskrit_iast:
nirapekṣaḥ prabhurvāmo na śuddhyā tatra kāraṇam /
devītṛptirmakhe raktamāṃsairno śaucayojanāt // 602
meaning:
निरपेक्षः प्रभुर्वामो न शुद्ध्या तत्र कारणम् /
देवीतृप्तिर्मखे रक्तमांसैर्नो शौचयोजनात् // 602
text_mt: “The Lord is independent, reverse; purity is of no account there. / The satisfaction of the Goddess in sacrifice comes from blood and meat, not from the application of purity.

sanskrit_iast:
dvijāntyajaiḥ samaṃ kāryā carcānte'pi marīcayaḥ /
avikārakṛtastena vikalpānnirayo bhavet // 603
meaning:
द्विजान्त्यजैः समं कार्या चर्चान्तेऽपि मरीचयः /
अविकारकृतस्तेन विकल्पान्निरयो भवेत् // 603
text_mt: Spiritual inquiry should be conducted equally with twice-born and outcasts; even at the end, the rays [of consciousness] / are unaffected by modification; hell would result from such conceptual doubt.”

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadevamayaḥ kāyaḥ sarvaprāṇiṣviti sphuṭam /
śrīmadbhirnakuleśādyairapyetatsunirūpitam // 604
meaning:
सर्वदेवमयः कायः सर्वप्राणिष्विति स्फुटम् /
श्रीमद्भिर्नकुलेशाद्यैरप्येतत्सुनिरूपितम् // 604
text_mt: The body consists of all deities in all living beings—this is clear. / This was also well established by the revered Nakuleśa and others:

sanskrit_iast:
śarīramevāyatanaṃ nānyadāyatanaṃ vrajet /
tīrthamekaṃ smarenmantramanyatīrthāni varjayet // 605
meaning:
शरीरमेवायतनं नान्यदायतनं व्रजेत् /
तीर्थमेकं स्मरेन्मन्त्रमन्यतीर्थानि वर्जयेत् // 605
text_mt: “The body alone is the sanctuary; he should go to no other sanctuary. / He should remember the mantra as the single sacred ford, and should avoid other sacred fords.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhimenaṃ sukhaṃ jñātvā vidhijālaṃ parityajet /
samādhirniścayaṃ muktvā na cānyenopalabhyate // 606
meaning:
विधिमेनं सुखं ज्ञात्वा विधिजालं परित्यजेत् /
समाधिर्निश्चयं मुक्त्वा न चान्येनोपलभ्यते // 606
text_mt: Knowing this rule to be bliss, he should abandon the web of rules. / Meditative absorption is not attained by anything other than conviction.

sanskrit_iast:
iti matvā vidhānajñaḥ saṃmohaṃ parivarjayet /
mantrasya hṛdayaṃ muktvā na cānyatparamaṃ kvacit // 607
meaning:
इति मत्वा विधानज्ञः संमोहं परिवर्जयेत् /
मन्त्रस्य हृदयं मुक्त्वा न चान्यत्परमं क्वचित् // 607
text_mt: Knowing this, one who knows the procedure should abandon delusion. / Aside from the heart of the mantra, there is nothing supreme anywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
iti matvā vidhānajño mantrajālaṃ parityajet /
naivedyaṃ prāśayennadyāstaccheṣaṃ ca jale kṣipet // 608
meaning:
इति मत्वा विधानज्ञो मन्त्रजालं परित्यजेत् /
नैवेद्यं प्राशयेन्नद्यास्तच्छेषं च जले क्षिपेत् // 608
text_mt: Knowing this, one who knows the procedure should abandon the web of mantras.” / He should offer the food offering to the river, and throw its remainder into the water.

sanskrit_iast:
tairbhukte na bhaveddoṣo jalajaiḥ pūrvadīkṣitaiḥ /
avayaśpālanīyatvātparattvena saṃgamāt // 609
meaning:
तैर्भुक्ते न भवेद्दोषो जलजैः पूर्वदीक्षितैः /
अवयश्पालनीयत्वात्परत्त्वेन संगमात् // 609
