yadyapi vikalpavṛtterapi mokṣaṃ dīkṣayaiva dehānte // 199
meaning:
शिशुरपि तदभेददृशा भक्तिबलाच्चाभ्युपैति शिवभावम् /
यद्यपि विकल्पवृत्तेरपि मोक्षं दीक्षयैव देहान्ते // 199
text_mt: even a novice, by virtue of devotion and by seeing non-difference from him, attains the state of Śiva. / Although the Lord declared in the scripture that liberation occurs through initiation alone at the end of the body, even for one with conceptual mind-functions,

sanskrit_iast:
śāstre provāca vibhustathāpi dṛḍhavāsanā yuktā /
mokṣe'pyasti viśeṣaḥ kriyālpabhūyastvajaḥ salokādiḥ // 200
meaning:
शास्त्रे प्रोवाच विभुस्तथापि दृढवासना युक्ता /
मोक्षेऽप्यस्ति विशेषः क्रियाल्पभूयस्त्वजः सलोकादिः // 200
text_mt: nevertheless, a firm latent impression is appropriate. / Some say: 'Even in liberation there is a distinction born of the paucity or multiplicity of action, such as residing in the same realm (salokatā) and so on.'

sanskrit_iast:
iti kecittadayuktaṃ sa vicitro bhoga eva kathitaḥ syāt /
saṃskāraśeṣavartanajīvitamadhye'sya samayalopādyam // 201
meaning:
इति केचित्तदयुक्तं स विचित्रो भोग एव कथितः स्यात् /
संस्कारशेषवर्तनजीवितमध्येऽस्य समयलोपाद्यम् // 201
text_mt: That is incorrect; for that would merely be described as varied enjoyment. / During life sustained by the remainder of past karmic traces, the network of obstacles such as transgression of the rule does not arise for him—

sanskrit_iast:
nāyāti vighnajālaṃ kriyābahutvaṃ mumukṣostat /
yasmāt sabījadīkṣāsaṃskṛtapuruṣasya samayalopādye // 202
meaning:
नायाति विघ्नजालं क्रियाबहुत्वं मुमुक्षोस्तत् /
यस्मात् सबीजदीक्षासंस्कृतपुरुषस्य समयलोपाद्ये // 202
text_mt: that is why an abundance of action is prescribed for one desiring liberation. / Because for a person consecrated by initiation with seeds (sabījadīkṣā), when transgression of the rule and the like occurs,

sanskrit_iast:
bhukte bhogānmokṣo naivaṃ nirbījadīkṣāyām /
iti kecinmanyante yuktaṃ taccāpi yatsmṛtaṃ śāstre // 203
meaning:
भुक्ते भोगान्मोक्षो नैवं निर्बीजदीक्षायाम् /
इति केचिन्मन्यन्ते युक्तं तच्चापि यत्स्मृतं शास्त्रे // 203
text_mt: liberation occurs only after enjoyments have been experienced, but not so in initiation without seeds (nirbījadīkṣā). / Some hold this view; and that is also appropriate, since it is stated in scripture:

sanskrit_iast: samayollaṅghanāddevi kravyādatvaṃ śataṃ samāḥ // 204
meaning: समयोल्लङ्घनाद्देवि क्रव्यादत्वं शतं समाः // 204
text_mt: 'From transgressing the rule, O goddess, one becomes a flesh-eater for a hundred years.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāduruśiṣyamatau śivabhāvanirūḍhivitaraṇasamartham /
kramikaṃ tattvoddharaṇādi karma mokṣe'pi yuktamativitatam // 205
meaning:
तस्मादुरुशिष्यमतौ शिवभावनिरूढिवितरणसमर्थम् /
क्रमिकं तत्त्वोद्धरणादि कर्म मोक्षेऽपि युक्तमतिविततम् // 205
text_mt: Therefore, according to the great disciples, an extensive, step-by-step ritual, such as the extraction of principles, capable of bestowing a firm rootedness in the state of Śiva, is appropriate even for liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yastu sadā bhāvanayā svabhyastajñānavānguruḥ sa śiśoḥ /
apavargāya yathecchaṃ yaṃ kaṃcidupāyamanutiṣṭhet // 206
meaning:
यस्तु सदा भावनया स्वभ्यस्तज्ञानवान्गुरुः स शिशोः /
अपवर्गाय यथेच्छं यं कंचिदुपायमनुतिष्ठेत् // 206
text_mt: However, that guru who possesses knowledge well-practiced through constant contemplation / may employ any means whatsoever at will for the liberation of the novice.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śiṣyatanau śodhyaṃ nyasyādhvānaṃ yathepsitam /
śodhakaṃ mantramupari nyasyettattvānusārataḥ // 207
meaning:
एवं शिष्यतनौ शोध्यं न्यस्याध्वानं यथेप्सितम् /
शोधकं मन्त्रमुपरि न्यस्येत्तत्त्वानुसारतः // 207
text_mt: Thus, having imposed the path to be purified onto the disciple's body as desired, / he should impose the purifying mantra above it in accordance with the principles.

sanskrit_iast:
dvayormātṛkayostattvasthityā varṇakramaḥ purā /
kathitastaṃ tathā nyasyettattattattvaviśuddhaye // 208
meaning:
द्वयोर्मातृकयोस्तत्त्वस्थित्या वर्णक्रमः पुरा /
कथितस्तं तथा न्यस्येत्तत्तत्तत्त्वविशुद्धये // 208
text_mt: The sequence of phonemes for the two phoneme-matrices according to the status of the principles was stated previously; / he should impose that in the same manner for the purification of each respective principle.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇādhvā yadyapi proktaḥ śodhyaḥ pāśātmakastu saḥ /
māyīyaḥ śodhakastvanyaḥ śivātmā paravāṅmayaḥ // 209
meaning:
वर्णाध्वा यद्यपि प्रोक्तः शोध्यः पाशात्मकस्तु सः /
मायीयः शोधकस्त्वन्यः शिवात्मा परवाङ्मयः // 209
text_mt: Although the phoneme-path is spoken of as the object of purification, it consists of bondage, / being of the nature of Māyā; whereas the purifier is different: it shares the nature of Śiva and consists of supreme speech.

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca sadyojyotiśca vṛttau svāyambhuvasya tat /
bāḍhameko hi pāśātmā śabdo'nyaśca śivātmakaḥ // 210
meaning:
उवाच सद्योज्योतिश्च वृत्तौ स्वायम्भुवस्य तत् /
बाढमेको हि पाशात्मा शब्दोऽन्यश्च शिवात्मकः // 210
text_mt: And Sadyojyotis said in his commentary on the Svāyambhuvasūtrasaṅgraha: / 'Indeed, one kind of sound consists of bondage, and the other shares the nature of Śiva.'

sanskrit_iast:
tasmāttasyaiva varṇasya yuktā śodhakaśodhyatā /
śrīpūrvaśāstre cāpyuktaṃ te tairāliṅgitā iti // 211
meaning:
तस्मात्तस्यैव वर्णस्य युक्ता शोधकशोध्यता /
श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे चाप्युक्तं ते तैरालिङ्गिता इति // 211
text_mt: Therefore, it is appropriate that this very phoneme is both purifier and object of purification. / And in the Śrīpūrva scripture it is also said: 'They are embraced by them.'

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātādivaktrāṇi hṛdādyaṅgāni pañca ca /
ṣaṭkṛtvo nyasya ṣaṭtriṃśannyāsaṃ kuryāddharāditaḥ // 212
meaning:
सद्योजातादिवक्त्राणि हृदाद्यङ्गानि पञ्च च /
षट्कृत्वो न्यस्य षट्त्रिंशन्न्यासं कुर्याद्धरादितः // 212
text_mt: Having imposed the faces such as Sadyojāta and the five limbs such as the heart six times, / one should perform the thirty-six-fold imposition beginning with earth.

sanskrit_iast:
parāparāyā vailomyāddharāyāṃ syātpadatrayam /
tato jalādahaṅkāre pañcāṣṭakasamāśrayāt // 213
meaning:
परापराया वैलोम्याद्धरायां स्यात्पदत्रयम् /
ततो जलादहङ्कारे पञ्चाष्टकसमाश्रयात् // 213
text_mt: In reverse order of Parāparā, there should be three words on earth; / then, from water up to egoity, by relying on five sets of eight,

sanskrit_iast:
padāni pañca dhīmūlapuṃrāgākhye traye trayam /
ekaṃ tvaśuddhavitkāladvaye caikaṃ niyāmake // 214
meaning:
पदानि पञ्च धीमूलपुंरागाख्ये त्रये त्रयम् /
एकं त्वशुद्धवित्कालद्वये चैकं नियामके // 214
text_mt: there are five words; three on the triad named intellect, root-nature, and soul; / one on the pair of impure knowing and time; and one on the regulator (niyati);

sanskrit_iast:
kalāmāyādvaye caikaṃ padamuktamiha kramāt /
vidyeśvarasadāśaktiśiveṣu padapañcakam // 215
meaning:
कलामायाद्वये चैकं पदमुक्तमिह क्रमात् /
विद्येश्वरसदाशक्तिशिवेषु पदपञ्चकम् // 215
text_mt: one word is taught here successively on the pair of limited agency and Māyā; / five words on knowledge, Lord, Sadāśiva, Śakti, and Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
ekonaviṃśatiḥ seyaṃ padānāṃ syātparāparā /
sārdhaṃ caikaṃ caikaṃ sārdhaṃ dve dve śaśī dṛgatha yugmam // 216
meaning:
एकोनविंशतिः सेयं पदानां स्यात्परापरा /
सार्धं चैकं चैकं सार्धं द्वे द्वे शशी दृगथ युग्मम् // 216
text_mt: This constitutes nineteen words of Parāparā: / one and a half, one, one, one and a half, two, two, one, two, and then a pair,

sanskrit_iast:
trāṇi dṛgabdhiścandraḥ śrutiḥ śaśī pañca vidhumahaścandrāḥ /
ekānnaviṃśatau syādakṣarasaṃkhyā padeṣviyaṃ devyāḥ // 217
meaning:
त्राणि दृगब्धिश्चन्द्रः श्रुतिः शशी पञ्च विधुमहश्चन्द्राः /
एकान्नविंशतौ स्यादक्षरसंख्या पदेष्वियं देव्याः // 217
text_mt: three, two, four, one, four, one, five, one, one, and one: / this should be the count of syllables in the nineteen words of the goddess,

sanskrit_iast:
haldvayayutavasucitraguparisaṃkhyātasvavarṇāyāḥ /
mūlāntaṃ sārdhavarṇaṃ syānmāyāntaṃ varṇamekakam // 218
meaning:
हल्द्वययुतवसुचित्रगुपरिसंख्यातस्ववर्णायाः /
मूलान्तं सार्धवर्णं स्यान्मायान्तं वर्णमेककम् // 218
text_mt: whose own phonemes are counted as twenty-seven plus two consonants. / Up to the root-nature there is one and a half phonemes; up to Māyā there is one phoneme;

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyantamekamaparānyāse vidhirudīritaḥ /
māyāntaṃ haltataḥ śaktiparyante svara ucyate // 219
meaning:
शक्त्यन्तमेकमपरान्यासे विधिरुदीरितः /
मायान्तं हल्ततः शक्तिपर्यन्ते स्वर उच्यते // 219
text_mt: up to Śakti there is one—this rule is stated in the imposition of Aparā. / Up to Māyā is a consonant; thereafter, up to Śakti, a vowel is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkale śivatattve vai paro nyāsaḥ paroditaḥ /
parāparāpadānyeva hyaghoryādyaṣṭakadvaye // 220
meaning:
निष्कले शिवतत्त्वे वै परो न्यासः परोदितः /
परापरापदान्येव ह्यघोर्याद्यष्टकद्वये // 220
text_mt: In the partless Śiva-principle, the supreme imposition is taught as supreme. / Indeed, the words of Parāparā are in the two sets of eight beginning with Aghorī;

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāstadanusāreṇa tattveṣvetaddvayaṃ kṣipet /
piṇḍākṣarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ varṇasaṃkhyā vibhedataḥ // 221
meaning:
मन्त्रास्तदनुसारेण तत्त्वेष्वेतद्द्वयं क्षिपेत् /
पिण्डाक्षराणां सर्वेषां वर्णसंख्या विभेदतः // 221
text_mt: the mantras are according to them; one should cast these two upon the principles. / Due to the differentiation of the phonemic count of all composite syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
avyaktāntaṃ svare nyasyā śeṣaṃ śeṣeṣu yojayet /
bījāni sarvatattveṣu vyāptṛtvena prakalpayet // 222
meaning:
अव्यक्तान्तं स्वरे न्यस्या शेषं शेषेषु योजयेत् /
बीजानि सर्वतत्त्वेषु व्याप्तृत्वेन प्रकल्पयेत् // 222
text_mt: the portion up to the unmanifest is to be imposed on the vowel, and the remainder should be applied to the remaining [principles]. / One should assign the seed-syllables as pervadors throughout all the principles.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍānāṃ bījavannyāsamanye tu pratipedire /
akṛte vātha śodhyasya nyāse vastubalāt sthiteḥ // 223
meaning:
पिण्डानां बीजवन्न्यासमन्ये तु प्रतिपेदिरे /
अकृते वाथ शोध्यस्य न्यासे वस्तुबलात् स्थितेः // 223
text_mt: Others, however, have accepted the imposition of composite syllables like seed-syllables. / Or even if the imposition of the object to be purified is not performed, since it is established by the force of reality,

sanskrit_iast:
śodhakanyāsamātreṇa sarvaṃ śodhyaṃ viśudhyati /
śrīmanmṛtyuñjayādau ca kathitaṃ parameṣṭhinā // 224
meaning:
शोधकन्यासमात्रेण सर्वं शोध्यं विशुध्यति /
श्रीमन्मृत्युञ्जयादौ च कथितं परमेष्ठिना // 224
text_mt: everything to be purified is purified merely by the imposition of the purifier. / And in the Śrīmanmṛtyuñjaya and other scriptures, the supreme Lord has declared:

sanskrit_iast:
adhunā nyāsamātreṇa bhūtaśuddhiḥ prajāyate /
dehaśuddhyarthamapyetattulyametena vastutaḥ // 225
meaning:
अधुना न्यासमात्रेण भूतशुद्धिः प्रजायते /
देहशुद्ध्यर्थमप्येतत्तुल्यमेतेन वस्तुतः // 225
text_mt: 'Purification of the elements is brought about instantly merely by the imposition.' / For the purpose of purifying the body, this is also identical to that in reality.

sanskrit_iast:
anyaprakaraṇoktaṃ yadyuktaṃ prakaraṇāntare /
jñāpakatvena sākṣādvā tatkiṃ nānyatra gṛhyate // 226
meaning:
अन्यप्रकरणोक्तं यद्युक्तं प्रकरणान्तरे /
ज्ञापकत्वेन साक्षाद्वा तत्किं नान्यत्र गृह्यते // 226
text_mt: What is stated in another section, if it is appropriate in this section / as an indicator or directly, why is it not accepted elsewhere?

sanskrit_iast:
mālinīmātṛkāṅgasya nyāso yo'rcāvidhau purā /
proktaḥ kevalasaṃśoddhṛmantranyāse sa eva tu // 227
meaning:
मालिनीमातृकाङ्गस्य न्यासो योऽर्चाविधौ पुरा /
प्रोक्तः केवलसंशोद्धृमन्त्रन्यासे स एव तु // 227
text_mt: The imposition of the limbs of the Mālinī and Mātṛkā which was taught previously in the ritual of worship / is the very same in the imposition of the purifying mantras alone.

sanskrit_iast:
tripadī dvayordvayoḥ syātpratyekamathāṣṭasu śrutipadāni /
dikcandracandrarasaraviśaraśaradṛgdṛṅmṛgāṅkaśaśigaṇane // 228
meaning:
त्रिपदी द्वयोर्द्वयोः स्यात्प्रत्येकमथाष्टसु श्रुतिपदानि /
दिक्चन्द्रचन्द्ररसरविशरशरदृग्दृङ्मृगाङ्कशशिगणने // 228
text_mt: There should be three words each for two [principles], then four words for eight [principles], / in the count of ten, one, one, six, twelve, five, five, two, two, one, and one,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulamāne devyā aṣṭādaśa vaibhavena padamanyat /
aparaṃ mānamidaṃ syāt kevalaśodhakamanunyāse // 229
meaning:
अङ्गुलमाने देव्या अष्टादश वैभवेन पदमन्यत् /
अपरं मानमिदं स्यात् केवलशोधकमनुन्यासे // 229
text_mt: in the digit-measure of the goddess; by expansion, there is another word of eighteen [digits]. / This should be another measure in the imposition of the mantra of the purifier alone.

sanskrit_iast:
turyapadātpadaṣaṭke mānadvitayaṃ parāparaparākhyam /
dvādaśakaṃ dvādaśakaṃ tattvopari pūrvavattvanyat // 230
meaning:
तुर्यपदात्पदषट्के मानद्वितयं परापरपराख्यम् /
द्वादशकं द्वादशकं तत्त्वोपरि पूर्ववत्त्वन्यत् // 230
text_mt: From the fourth word, across a group of six words, there are two measures known as Parāparā and Parā: / twelve [digits] and twelve [digits]; upon the principle, the other is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
kevalaśodhakamantranyāsābhiprāyato mahādevaḥ /
tattvakramoditamapi nyāsaṃ punarāha tadviruddhamapi // 231
meaning:
केवलशोधकमन्त्रन्यासाभिप्रायतो महादेवः /
तत्त्वक्रमोदितमपि न्यासं पुनराह तद्विरुद्धमपि // 231
text_mt: With the intention of the imposition of the purifying mantra alone, Mahādeva / taught an imposition according to the sequence of principles, and again one that even contradicts it.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkale padamekārṇaṃ yāvattrīṇi tu pārthive /
ityādinā tattvagatakramanyāsa udīritaḥ // 232
meaning:
निष्कले पदमेकार्णं यावत्त्रीणि तु पार्थिवे /
इत्यादिना तत्त्वगतक्रमन्यास उदीरितः // 232
text_mt: Beginning with 'In the partless [Śiva] there is one word of one syllable, up to three in the earthly,' / the imposition according to the order situated in the principles has been declared.

sanskrit_iast:
punaśca mālinītantre vargavidyāvibhedataḥ /
dvidhā padānītyuktvākhyannyāsamanyādṛśaṃ vibhuḥ // 233
meaning:
पुनश्च मालिनीतन्त्रे वर्गविद्याविभेदतः /
द्विधा पदानीत्युक्त्वाख्यन्न्यासमन्यादृशं विभुः // 233
text_mt: And again in the Mālinītantra, having stated that words are of two kinds / according to the division of class-phonemes (varga) and mantra-phonemes (vidyā), the Lord taught a different kind of imposition:

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ tatra pūrvaṃ padatrayam /
aṣṭāṅgulāni catvāri daśāṅgulamataḥ param // 234
meaning:
एकैकं द्व्यङ्गुलं ज्ञेयं तत्र पूर्वं पदत्रयम् /
अष्टाङ्गुलानि चत्वारि दशाङ्गुलमतः परम् // 234
text_mt: 'There, the first three words should each be known as measuring two digits; / four words of eight digits; after that, one of ten digits;

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgule dve pade cānye ṣaḍaṅgulamataḥ param /
dvādaśāṅgulamanyacca dve'nye pañcāṅgule pṛthak // 235
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गुले द्वे पदे चान्ये षडङ्गुलमतः परम् /
द्वादशाङ्गुलमन्यच्च द्वेऽन्ये पञ्चाङ्गुले पृथक् // 235
text_mt: two other words of two digits; after that, one of six digits; / another of twelve digits; two others of five digits individually;

sanskrit_iast:
padadvayaṃ catuṣparva tathānye dve dviparvaṇī /
evaṃ parāparādevyāḥ svatantro nyāsa ucyate // 236
meaning:
पदद्वयं चतुष्पर्व तथान्ये द्वे द्विपर्वणी /
एवं परापरादेव्याः स्वतन्त्रो न्यास उच्यते // 236
text_mt: two words of four finger-joints, and two others of two finger-joints.' / Thus the independent imposition of the goddess Parāparā is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādvayaṃ śiṣyatanau vyāptṛtvenaiva yojayet /
iti darśayituṃ nāsya pṛthaṅnyāsaṃ nyarūpayat // 237
meaning:
विद्याद्वयं शिष्यतनौ व्याप्तृत्वेनैव योजयेत् /
इति दर्शयितुं नास्य पृथङ्न्यासं न्यरूपयत् // 237
text_mt: One should apply the two vidyās onto the disciple's body solely as pervadors; / to demonstrate this, he did not set forth a separate imposition for it.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ śodhakamantrasya nyāse tadraśmiyogataḥ /
pāśajālaṃ vilīyeta taddhyānabalato guroḥ // 238
meaning:
एवं शोधकमन्त्रस्य न्यासे तद्रश्मियोगतः /
पाशजालं विलीयेत तद्ध्यानबलतो गुरोः // 238
text_mt: Thus, when the purifying mantra is imposed, through the union of its rays, / the snare's net dissolves by the power of the guru's meditation upon it.

sanskrit_iast:
śodhyatattve samastānāṃ yonīnāṃ tulyakālataḥ /
jananādbhogataḥ karmakṣaye syādapavṛktatā // 239
meaning:
शोध्यतत्त्वे समस्तानां योनीनां तुल्यकालतः /
जननाद्भोगतः कर्मक्षये स्यादपवृक्तता // 239
text_mt: In the category being purified, by the simultaneous experiencing / of births in all wombs, liberation occurs upon the destruction of karma.

sanskrit_iast:
dehaistāvadbhirasyāṇościtraṃ bhokturapi sphuṭam /
mano'nusandhirno viśvasaṃyogapravibhāgavat // 240
meaning:
देहैस्तावद्भिरस्याणोश्चित्रं भोक्तुरपि स्फुटम् /
मनोऽनुसन्धिर्नो विश्वसंयोगप्रविभागवत् // 240
text_mt: Though this individual soul experiences through so many diverse bodies, / clearly there is no synthesis of the mind, just as in the conjunction and disjunction of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
niyatyā manaso dehamātre vṛttistataḥ param /
nānusandhā yataḥ saikasvāntayuktākṣakalpitā // 241
meaning:
नियत्या मनसो देहमात्रे वृत्तिस्ततः परम् /
नानुसन्धा यतः सैकस्वान्तयुक्ताक्षकल्पिता // 241
text_mt: Because of limitation (niyati), the mental function is restricted to that body alone; beyond that / there is no synthesis, because it is formed by senses conjoined with a single internal organ.

sanskrit_iast:
pradeśavṛtti ca jñānamātmanastatra tatra tat /
bhogyajñānaṃ nānyadeheṣvanusandhānamarhati // 242
meaning:
प्रदेशवृत्ति च ज्ञानमात्मनस्तत्र तत्र तत् /
भोग्यज्ञानं नान्यदेहेष्वनुसन्धानमर्हति // 242
text_mt: Moreover, the self's knowledge operates only locally; in each instance, that / cognition of objects cannot achieve synthesis across other bodies.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu manasastasya dehavṛtterapi dhruvam /
yogamantrakriyādeḥ syādvaimalyaṃ tadvidā tadā // 243
meaning:
यदा तु मनसस्तस्य देहवृत्तेरपि ध्रुवम् /
योगमन्त्रक्रियादेः स्याद्वैमल्यं तद्विदा तदा // 243
text_mt: When, however, that very mind, even in its bodily function, surely / achieves purity through yoga, mantra, ritual, and the like, then, by one who knows that,

sanskrit_iast:
yathāmalaṃ mano dūrasthitamapyāśu paśyati /
tathā pratyayadīkṣāyāṃ tattadbhuvanadarśanam // 244
meaning:
यथामलं मनो दूरस्थितमप्याशु पश्यति /
तथा प्रत्ययदीक्षायां तत्तद्भुवनदर्शनम् // 244
text_mt: just as the pure mind quickly sees even what is stationed far away, / so too in the initiation of verification there is vision of those respective worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
jananādiviyuktāṃ tu yadā dīkṣāṃ cikīrṣati /
tadāsmāduddharāmīti yuktamūhaprakalpanam // 245
meaning:
जननादिवियुक्तां तु यदा दीक्षां चिकीर्षति /
तदास्मादुद्धरामीति युक्तमूहप्रकल्पनम् // 245
text_mt: When, however, one wishes to perform an initiation devoid of birth and the rest, / then it is fitting to apply reasoning: 'I extract [the soul] from this [reality].'

sanskrit_iast:
yadā śodhyaṃ vinā śoddhṛnyāsastatrāpi mantrataḥ /
jananādikramaṃ kuryāttattvasaṃśleṣavarjitam // 246
meaning:
यदा शोध्यं विना शोद्धृन्यासस्तत्रापि मन्त्रतः /
जननादिक्रमं कुर्यात्तत्त्वसंश्लेषवर्जितम् // 246
text_mt: When the imposition of the purifier is performed without the [tattva] to be purified, even then through the mantra / one should perform the sequence of birth and the rest, free from conjunction with the tattvas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākiśoddhṛnyāse ca jananādivivarjane /
tacchoddhṛsaṃpuṭaṃ nāma kevalaṃ parikalpayet // 247
meaning:
एकाकिशोद्धृन्यासे च जननादिविवर्जने /
तच्छोद्धृसंपुटं नाम केवलं परिकल्पयेत् // 247
text_mt: And in the solitary imposition of the purifier, when birth and the rest are excluded, / one should mentally construct only the enfolding (saṃpuṭa) of that purifier with the name.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyayogena dīkṣāyāṃ tilājyākṣatataṇḍulam /
tattanmantreṇa juhuyājjanmayogaviyogayoḥ // 248
meaning:
द्रव्ययोगेन दीक्षायां तिलाज्याक्षततण्डुलम् /
तत्तन्मन्त्रेण जुहुयाज्जन्मयोगवियोगयोः // 248
text_mt: In initiation performed with substances, one should offer sesame, ghee, unbroken grains, and husked rice / with the respective mantras for the conjunction and disjunction of birth.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā vijñānadīkṣāṃ tu kuryācchiṣyaṃ tadā bhṛśam /
tanmantrasaṃjalpabalāt paśyedā cāvikalpakāt // 249
meaning:
यदा विज्ञानदीक्षां तु कुर्याच्छिष्यं तदा भृशम् /
तन्मन्त्रसंजल्पबलात् पश्येदा चाविकल्पकात् // 249
text_mt: When, however, one performs the initiation through knowledge, then one should intensely / behold the disciple by the force of discursive repetition of that mantra, right up to the non-conceptual.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpaḥ kila saṃjalpamayo yatsa vimarśakaḥ /
mantrātmāsau vimarśaśca śuddho'pāśavatātmakaḥ // 250
meaning:
विकल्पः किल संजल्पमयो यत्स विमर्शकः /
मन्त्रात्मासौ विमर्शश्च शुद्धोऽपाशवतात्मकः // 250
text_mt: For a conceptual construct consists of discursive speech because it is reflective awareness; / and this reflective awareness is mantra itself, pure and free from snares.

sanskrit_iast:
nityaścānādivaradaśivābhedopakalpitaḥ /
tadyogāddaiśikasyāpi vikalpaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet // 251
meaning:
नित्यश्चानादिवरदशिवाभेदोपकल्पितः /
तद्योगाद्दैशिकस्यापि विकल्पः शिवतां व्रजेत् // 251
text_mt: It is eternal, established as non-different from Śiva, the eternal giver of boons; / through union with it, the conceptual construct of the teacher too reaches the state of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsāraśāstre tadidaṃ parameśena bhāṣitam /
arthasya pratipattiryā grāhyagrāhakarūpiṇī // 252
meaning:
श्रीसारशास्त्रे तदिदं परमेशेन भाषितम् /
अर्थस्य प्रतिपत्तिर्या ग्राह्यग्राहकरूपिणी // 252
text_mt: This very thing was spoken by the Supreme Lord in the holy Sāraśāstra: / 'That comprehension of an object which takes the form of object and subject,

sanskrit_iast:
sā eva mantraśaktistu vitatā mantrasantatau /
parāmarśasvabhāvetthaṃ mantraśaktirudāhṛtā // 253
meaning:
सा एव मन्त्रशक्तिस्तु वितता मन्त्रसन्ततौ /
परामर्शस्वभावेत्थं मन्त्रशक्तिरुदाहृता // 253
text_mt: that alone is the mantra-power extended throughout the continuous series of mantras.' / Thus the mantra-power is declared to have the nature of reflective awareness.

sanskrit_iast:
parāmarśo dvidhā śuddhāśuddhatvānmantrabhedakaḥ /
uktaṃ śrīpauṣkare'nye ca brahmaviṣṇvādayo'ṇḍagāḥ // 254
meaning:
परामर्शो द्विधा शुद्धाशुद्धत्वान्मन्त्रभेदकः /
उक्तं श्रीपौष्करेऽन्ये च ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादयोऽण्डगाः // 254
text_mt: Reflective awareness is twofold, differentiating mantras through purity and impurity. / It is stated in the holy Pauṣkara: 'The others, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the rest residing in the Egg,

sanskrit_iast:
prādhānikāḥ sāñjanāste sāttvarājasatāmasāḥ /
tairaśuddhaparāmarśāttanmayībhāvito guruḥ // 255
meaning:
प्राधानिकाः साञ्जनास्ते सात्त्वराजसतामसाः /
तैरशुद्धपरामर्शात्तन्मयीभावितो गुरुः // 255
text_mt: belong to Prakṛti, possess stain, and are composed of sattva, rajas, and tamas; / through impure reflective awareness of them, a guru who has become identified with them,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavādiḥ paśuḥ prokto na yogyaḥ patiśāsane /
ye mantrāḥ śuddhamārgasthāḥ śivabhaṭṭārakādayaḥ // 256
meaning:
वैष्णवादिः पशुः प्रोक्तो न योग्यः पतिशासने /
ये मन्त्राः शुद्धमार्गस्थाः शिवभट्टारकादयः // 256
text_mt: such as a Vaiṣṇava, is declared a bound soul and is unfit in the teaching of the Lord.' / Those mantras that abide in the pure path, such as venerable Śiva and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanmataṅgādidṛśā tanmayo hi guruḥ śivaḥ /
nanu svatantrasaṃjalpayogādastu vimarśitā // 257
meaning:
श्रीमन्मतङ्गादिदृशा तन्मयो हि गुरुः शिवः /
ननु स्वतन्त्रसंजल्पयोगादस्तु विमर्शिता // 257
text_mt: according to the perspective of the venerable Mataṅga and others, the guru identified with them is truly Śiva. / [Objection:] Now, let reflective awareness arise from union with independent speech;

sanskrit_iast:
prākkutaḥ sa vimarśāccetkutaḥ so'pi nirūpaṇe /
ādyastathāvikalpatvapradaḥ syādupadeṣṭṛtaḥ // 258
meaning:
प्राक्कुतः स विमर्शाच्चेत्कुतः सोऽपि निरूपणे /
आद्यस्तथाविकल्पत्वप्रदः स्यादुपदेष्टृतः // 258
text_mt: whence came that [speech] before? If you say it arose from reflective awareness, whence came that too on examination? / [Reply:] The first, which grants such non-conceptuality, arises from the instructor.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ saṃkrānto'bhijalpaḥ syāttasyāpyanyopadeṣṭṛtaḥ /
pūrvapūrvakramāditthaṃ ya evādiguroḥ purā // 259
meaning:
यः संक्रान्तोऽभिजल्पः स्यात्तस्याप्यन्योपदेष्टृतः /
पूर्वपूर्वक्रमादित्थं य एवादिगुरोः पुरा // 259
text_mt: The speech that was transmitted to him also came from another instructor, / and thus, through the preceding sequence, it should be grasped that whatever discursive speech was transmitted

sanskrit_iast:
saṃjalpo hyabhisaṃkrāntaḥ so'dyāpyastīti gṛhyatām /
yastathāvidhasaṃjalpabalātko'pi svatantrakaḥ // 260
meaning:
संजल्पो ह्यभिसंक्रान्तः सोऽद्याप्यस्तीति गृह्यताम् /
यस्तथाविधसंजल्पबलात्कोऽपि स्वतन्त्रकः // 260
text_mt: from the primordial guru of old exists even today. / Whatever independent reflective awareness

sanskrit_iast:
vimarśaḥ kalpyate so'pi tadātmaiva suniścitaḥ /
ghaṭakumbha itītthaṃ vā yadi bhedo nirūpyate // 261
meaning:
विमर्शः कल्प्यते सोऽपि तदात्मैव सुनिश्चितः /
घटकुम्भ इतीत्थं वा यदि भेदो निरूप्यते // 261
text_mt: is conceived through the power of such discursive speech is definitely identical with that. / Or if a difference is posited, like between 'ghaṭa' and 'kumbha' (pot and pitcher),

sanskrit_iast:
so'pyanyakalpanādāyī hyanādṛtyaḥ prayatnataḥ /
paṇāyate karotīti vikalpasyocitau sphuṭam // 262
meaning:
सोऽप्यन्यकल्पनादायी ह्यनादृत्यः प्रयत्नतः /
पणायते करोतीति विकल्पस्योचितौ स्फुटम् // 262
text_mt: that too entails assuming something else and must be carefully disregarded; / for when they are appropriate to the conceptual construct, 'paṇāyate' (he trades) and 'karoti' (he makes)

sanskrit_iast:
karapāṇyabhijalpau tau saṃkīryetāṃ kathaṃ kila /
śabdācchabdāntare tena vyutpattirvyavadhānataḥ // 263
meaning:
करपाण्यभिजल्पौ तौ संकीर्येतां कथं किल /
शब्दाच्छब्दान्तरे तेन व्युत्पत्तिर्व्यवधानतः // 263
text_mt: are evident: how indeed could the verbal expressions for hand, such as 'kara' and 'pāṇi', become confused? / Therefore, comprehension from one word to another occurs through an intermediary;

sanskrit_iast:
vyavahārāttu sā sākṣāccitropākhyāvimarśinī /
tadvimarśodayaḥ prācyasvavimarśamayaḥ sphuret // 264
meaning:
व्यवहारात्तु सा साक्षाच्चित्रोपाख्याविमर्शिनी /
तद्विमर्शोदयः प्राच्यस्वविमर्शमयः स्फुरेत् // 264
text_mt: but from ordinary practice, it directly reflects various names. / The arising of that reflective awareness shines forth consisting of one's own prior reflective awareness,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadbālasya saṃvittirakṛtrimavimarśane /
tena tanmantraśabdārthaviśeṣotthaṃ vikalpanam // 265
meaning:
यावद्बालस्य संवित्तिरकृत्रिमविमर्शने /
तेन तन्मन्त्रशब्दार्थविशेषोत्थं विकल्पनम् // 265
text_mt: which extends back to an infant's consciousness in innate reflective awareness. / Therefore, the conceptual construct arising from the specific word-meaning of that mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
śabdāntarotthādbhedena paśyatā mantra ādṛtaḥ /
yaccāpi bījapiṇḍāderuktaṃ prāgbodharūpakam // 266
meaning:
शब्दान्तरोत्थाद्भेदेन पश्यता मन्त्र आदृतः /
यच्चापि बीजपिण्डादेरुक्तं प्राग्बोधरूपकम् // 266
text_mt: seen as distinct from what arises from another word, is honoured as the mantra. / And that which was previously said to have the nature of consciousness with respect to seed-syllables, masses, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
tattasyaiva kuto'nyasya tatkasmādanyakalpanā /
etadarthaṃ guroryatnāllakṣaṇe tatra tatra tat // 267
meaning:
तत्तस्यैव कुतोऽन्यस्य तत्कस्मादन्यकल्पना /
एतदर्थं गुरोर्यत्नाल्लक्षणे तत्र तत्र तत् // 267
text_mt: belongs to that alone; whence could it belong to another? Why then assume something else? / For this reason, in the definition of a guru, that definition has been carefully stated here and there:

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ hyeṣa mantratantraviśāradaḥ /
tena mantrārthasaṃbodhe mantravārtikamādarāt // 268
meaning:
लक्षणं कथितं ह्येष मन्त्रतन्त्रविशारदः /
तेन मन्त्रार्थसंबोधे मन्त्रवार्तिकमादरात् // 268
text_mt: 'He is skilled in mantra and tantra.' / Therefore, in understanding the meaning of mantra, the guru should by all means practice

sanskrit_iast:
ūhāpohaprayogaṃ vā sarvathā gururācaret /
mantrārthavidabhāve tu sarvathā mantratanmayam // 269
meaning:
ऊहापोहप्रयोगं वा सर्वथा गुरुराचरेत् /
मन्त्रार्थविदभावे तु सर्वथा मन्त्रतन्मयम् // 269
text_mt: the Mantravārtika with reverence, or the application of reasoning and refutation. / In the absence of one who knows the meaning of the mantra, however, one should by all means make a guru

sanskrit_iast:
guruṃ kuryāt tadabhyāsāttatsaṃkalpamayo hyasau /
tatsamānābhisaṃjalpo yadā mantrārthabhāvanāt // 270
meaning:
गुरुं कुर्यात् तदभ्यासात्तत्संकल्पमयो ह्यसौ /
तत्समानाभिसंजल्पो यदा मन्त्रार्थभावनात् // 270
text_mt: who is identified with the mantra, for through its repeated practice he consists of its conception. / When, through meditating on the mantra's meaning, the guru possesses discursive speech identical to that,

sanskrit_iast:
gurorbhavettadā sarvasāmye ko bheda ucyatām /
aṃśenāpyatha vaiṣamye na tato'rthakriyā hi sā // 271
meaning:
गुरोर्भवेत्तदा सर्वसाम्ये को भेद उच्यताम् /
अंशेनाप्यथ वैषम्ये न ततोऽर्थक्रिया हि सा // 271
text_mt: then tell us: since there is complete equality, what difference is there? / If, on the other hand, there were dissimilarity even in part, then that purposeful action would not occur.

sanskrit_iast:
gomayātkīṭataḥ kīṭa ityevaṃ nyāyato yadā /
saṃjalpāntarato'pyarthakriyāṃ tāmeva paśyati // 272
meaning:
गोमयात्कीटतः कीट इत्येवं न्यायतो यदा /
संजल्पान्तरतोऽप्यर्थक्रियां तामेव पश्यति // 272
text_mt: When, by the maxim that a scorpion [is born] from cow dung just as a scorpion [from a scorpion], / one sees the very same purposeful action even from another discursive speech,

sanskrit_iast:
tadaiṣa satyasaṃjalpaḥ śiva eveti kathyate /
sa yadvakti tadeva syānmantro bhogāpavargadaḥ // 273
meaning:
तदैष सत्यसंजल्पः शिव एवेति कथ्यते /
स यद्वक्ति तदेव स्यान्मन्त्रो भोगापवर्गदः // 273
text_mt: then this true speech is said to be Śiva himself; / whatever he speaks becomes the very mantra granting enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
naiṣo'bhinavaguptasya pakṣo mantrārpitātmanaḥ /
yo'rthakriyāmāha bhinnāṃ kīṭayorapi tādṛśoḥ // 274
meaning:
नैषोऽभिनवगुप्तस्य पक्षो मन्त्रार्पितात्मनः /
योऽर्थक्रियामाह भिन्नां कीटयोरपि तादृशोः // 274
text_mt: This is not the view of Abhinavagupta, whose self is surrendered to the mantra, / who states that purposeful action is distinct even between two such scorpions.

sanskrit_iast:
mantrārpitamanāḥ kiṃcidvadanyattu viṣaṃ haret /
tanmantra eva śabdaḥ sa paraṃ tatra ghaṭādivat // 275
meaning:
मन्त्रार्पितमनाः किंचिद्वदन्यत्तु विषं हरेत् /
तन्मन्त्र एव शब्दः स परं तत्र घटादिवत् // 275
text_mt: One whose mind is dedicated to the mantra removes poison even while saying something else; / that word is indeed the mantra itself, whereas another [word] is like 'pot' and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
kāntāsaṃbhogasaṃjalpasundaraḥ kāmukaḥ sadā /
tatsaṃskṛto'pyanyadeṣa kurvansvātmani tṛpyati // 276
meaning:
कान्तासंभोगसंजल्पसुन्दरः कामुकः सदा /
तत्संस्कृतोऽप्यन्यदेष कुर्वन्स्वात्मनि तृप्यति // 276
text_mt: A lover who is always captivated by speech concerning lovemaking with a beloved woman, / being cultivated by that, remains satisfied in himself even while doing something else;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā tanmantrasaṃjalpabhāvito'nyadapi bruvan /
anicchurapi tadrūpastathā kāryakaro dhruvam // 277
meaning:
तथा तन्मन्त्रसंजल्पभावितोऽन्यदपि ब्रुवन् /
अनिच्छुरपि तद्रूपस्तथा कार्यकरो ध्रुवम् // 277
text_mt: similarly, one imbued with the discursive speech of that mantra, even when speaking of other things, / achieves that effect surely, being of that nature even without actively desiring it.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpayannapyekārthaṃ yato'nyadapi paśyati /
viṣāpahārimantrādītyuktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāsane // 278
meaning:
विकल्पयन्नप्येकार्थं यतोऽन्यदपि पश्यति /
विषापहारिमन्त्रादीत्युक्तं श्रीपूर्वशासने // 278
text_mt: For, even while conceptualizing one object, he perceives another as well, / as in the mantra that dispels poison, etc., as stated in the holy Pūrvaśāsana.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi vā viṣanāśe'pi hetubhedādvicitratā /
dhātvāpyāyādikānantakāryabhedādbhaviṣyati // 279
meaning:
यदि वा विषनाशेऽपि हेतुभेदाद्विचित्रता /
धात्वाप्यायादिकानन्तकार्यभेदाद्भविष्यति // 279
text_mt: Or rather, even in the destruction of poison, there will be variety due to differences in causes, / owing to the endless differences of effects such as the replenishment of bodily elements and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tadevaṃ mantrasaṃjalpavikalpābhyāsayogataḥ /
bhāvyavastusphuṭībhāvaḥ saṃjalpahrāsayogataḥ // 280
meaning:
तदेवं मन्त्रसंजल्पविकल्पाभ्यासयोगतः /
भाव्यवस्तुस्फुटीभावः संजल्पह्रासयोगतः // 280
text_mt: Therefore, in this way, through the practice of conceptual constructs of the mantra's discursive speech, / the object to be meditated upon becomes manifest through the decrease of discursive speech.

sanskrit_iast:
vastveva bhāvayatyeṣa na saṃjalpamimaṃ punaḥ /
gṛhṇāti bhāsanopāyaṃ bhāte tatra tu tena kim // 281
meaning:
वस्त्वेव भावयत्येष न संजल्पमिमं पुनः /
गृह्णाति भासनोपायं भाते तत्र तु तेन किम् // 281
text_mt: He meditates upon the reality alone; he no longer / grasps this discursive speech, which is the means to illumination: for what use is it once that has shone forth?

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ saṃjalpanirhrāse suparisphuṭatātmakam /
akṛttrimavimarśātma sphuredvastvavikalpakam // 282
meaning:
एवं संजल्पनिर्ह्रासे सुपरिस्फुटतात्मकम् /
अकृत्त्रिमविमर्शात्म स्फुरेद्वस्त्वविकल्पकम् // 282
text_mt: Thus, when discursive speech dwindles away, the non-conceptual reality, / entirely clear and consisting of innate reflective awareness, shines forth.

sanskrit_iast:
nirvikalpā ca sā saṃvidyadyathā paśyati sphuṭam /
tattathaiva tathātmatvādvastuno'pi bahiḥsthiteḥ // 283
meaning:
निर्विकल्पा च सा संविद्यद्यथा पश्यति स्फुटम् /
तत्तथैव तथात्मत्वाद्वस्तुनोऽपि बहिःस्थितेः // 283
text_mt: And that non-conceptual consciousness, just as it clearly perceives [a reality], / is precisely so, because an external object also has that as its true nature.

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣatastvamāyīyaśivatābhedaśālinaḥ /
mokṣe'bhyupāyaḥ saṃjalpo bandhamokṣau tataḥ kila // 284
meaning:
विशेषतस्त्वमायीयशिवताभेदशालिनः /
मोक्षेऽभ्युपायः संजल्पो बन्धमोक्षौ ततः किल // 284
text_mt: In particular, for one endowed with non-difference from Śiva-hood free of Māyā, / internal articulation is an expedient toward liberation; hence both bondage and liberation [derive] from it.

sanskrit_iast:
vikalpe'pi guroḥ samyagabhinnaśivatājuṣaḥ /
avikalpakaparyantapratīkṣā nopayujyate // 285
meaning:
विकल्पेऽपि गुरोः सम्यगभिन्नशिवताजुषः /
अविकल्पकपर्यन्तप्रतीक्षा नोपयुज्यते // 285
text_mt: Even when a conceptual construct arises, for a guru enjoying fully undivided Śiva-hood, / waiting for the non-conceptual terminus is of no use.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvimarśasvabhāvā hi sā vācyā mantradevatā /
mahāsaṃvitsamāsannetyuktaṃ śrīgamaśāsane // 286
meaning:
तद्विमर्शस्वभावा हि सा वाच्या मन्त्रदेवता /
महासंवित्समासन्नेत्युक्तं श्रीगमशासने // 286
text_mt: For that deity of the mantra, being the object denoted, has reflective awareness as its nature / and is intimate with the Great Consciousness—so it is declared in the venerable scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
nikaṭasthā yathā rājñāmanyeṣāṃ sādhayantyalam /
siddhiṃ rājopagāṃ śīghramevaṃ mantrādayaḥ parām // 287
meaning:
निकटस्था यथा राज्ञामन्येषां साधयन्त्यलम् /
सिद्धिं राजोपगां शीघ्रमेवं मन्त्रादयः पराम् // 287
text_mt: Just as those standing near to kings fully accomplish for others / an accomplishment relating to kings quickly, so mantras and the rest [accomplish] the supreme [result].

sanskrit_iast:
uktābhiprāyagarbhaṃ taduktaṃ śrīmālinīmate /
mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kasmādityukte munibhiḥ kila // 288
meaning:
उक्ताभिप्रायगर्भं तदुक्तं श्रीमालिनीमते /
मन्त्राणां लक्षणं कस्मादित्युक्ते मुनिभिः किल // 288
text_mt: Containing that very intended meaning, it was said in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara, / when the sages asked: 'Why is the definition of mantras [stated]?'

sanskrit_iast:
yogamekatvamicchanti vastuno'nyena vastunā /
tadvastu jñeyamityuktaṃ heyatvādiprasiddhaye // 289
meaning:
योगमेकत्वमिच्छन्ति वस्तुनोऽन्येन वस्तुना /
तद्वस्तु ज्ञेयमित्युक्तं हेयत्वादिप्रसिद्धये // 289
text_mt: 'They desire yoga to be the oneness of one entity with another entity; / that entity is called the object of knowledge, in order to establish what is to be discarded and the rest.'

sanskrit_iast:
tatprasiddhyai śivenoktaṃ jñānaṃ yadupavarṇitam /
sabījayogasaṃsiddhyai mantralakṣaṇamapyalam // 290
meaning:
तत्प्रसिद्ध्यै शिवेनोक्तं ज्ञानं यदुपवर्णितम् /
सबीजयोगसंसिद्ध्यै मन्त्रलक्षणमप्यलम् // 290
text_mt: For that establishment, the knowledge taught by Śiva which has been described / is also fully sufficient as the definition of mantra for accomplishing yoga with seed.

sanskrit_iast:
na cādhikāritā dīkṣāṃ vinā yoge'sti śāṅkare /
kriyājñānavibhedena sā ca dvedhā nigadyate // 291
meaning:
न चाधिकारिता दीक्षां विना योगेऽस्ति शाङ्करे /
क्रियाज्ञानविभेदेन सा च द्वेधा निगद्यते // 291
text_mt: Nor is there qualification for Śaiva yoga without initiation; / and that is spoken of as twofold, divided into action and knowledge.

sanskrit_iast:
dvividhā sā prakartavyā tena caitadudāhṛtam /
naca yogādhikāritvamekamevānayā bhavet // 292
meaning:
द्विविधा सा प्रकर्तव्या तेन चैतदुदाहृतम् /
नच योगाधिकारित्वमेकमेवानया भवेत् // 292
text_mt: It should be performed as twofold, and by that this has been explained; / nor would there arise merely the qualification for yoga by this [initiation],

sanskrit_iast:
api mantrādhikāritvaṃ muktiśca śivadīkṣayā /
anenaitadapi proktaṃ yogī tattvaikyasiddhaye // 293
meaning:
अपि मन्त्राधिकारित्वं मुक्तिश्च शिवदीक्षया /
अनेनैतदपि प्रोक्तं योगी तत्त्वैक्यसिद्धये // 293
text_mt: but also qualification for mantra and liberation through Śiva-initiation. / By this, it is also stated that a yogin, in order to attain oneness with reality,

sanskrit_iast:
mantramevāśrayenmūlaṃ nirvikalpāntamādṛtaḥ /
mantrābhyāsena bhogaṃ vā mokṣaṃ vāpi prasādhayan // 294
meaning:
मन्त्रमेवाश्रयेन्मूलं निर्विकल्पान्तमादृतः /
मन्त्राभ्यासेन भोगं वा मोक्षं वापि प्रसाधयन् // 294
text_mt: should respectfully resort to the root mantra alone, which culminates in the non-conceptual, / accomplishing either enjoyment or even liberation through repeated practice of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrādhikāritālabdhyai dīkṣāṃ gṛhṇīta daiśikāt /
tena mantrajñānayogabalādyadyatprasādhayet // 295
meaning:
तत्राधिकारितालब्ध्यै दीक्षां गृह्णीत दैशिकात् /
तेन मन्त्रज्ञानयोगबलाद्यद्यत्प्रसाधयेत् // 295
text_mt: To attain qualification therein, he should receive initiation from the guru; / thereby, by the power of knowledge and yoga of mantra, whatever he accomplishes,

sanskrit_iast:
tatsyādasyānyatattve'pi yuktasya guruṇā śiśoḥ /
dīkṣā hyasyopayujyeta saṃskriyāyāṃ sa saṃskṛtaḥ // 296
meaning:
तत्स्यादस्यान्यतत्त्वेऽपि युक्तस्य गुरुणा शिशोः /
दीक्षा ह्यस्योपयुज्येत संस्क्रियायां स संस्कृतः // 296
text_mt: that would belong to this pupil conjoined [thereto] by the guru, even in another reality-level. / For initiation is required for his purification; once purified,

sanskrit_iast:
svabalenaiva bhogaṃ vā mokṣaṃ vā labhate budhaḥ /
tena vijñānayogādibalī prāk samayī bhavan // 297
meaning:
स्वबलेनैव भोगं वा मोक्षं वा लभते बुधः /
तेन विज्ञानयोगादिबली प्राक् समयी भवन् // 297
text_mt: the wise one obtains either enjoyment or liberation by his own power alone. / Therefore, one who is strong through yoga of knowledge and the rest, becoming an initiate into the rule first,

sanskrit_iast:
putrako vā na tāvānsyādapitu svabalocitaḥ /
yastu vijñānayogādivandhyaḥ so'ndho yathā pathi // 298
meaning:
पुत्रको वा न तावान्स्यादपितु स्वबलोचितः /
यस्तु विज्ञानयोगादिवन्ध्यः सोऽन्धो यथा पथि // 298
text_mt: or a spiritual son, would not remain merely that, but would be fit for his own power. / But he who is devoid of the yoga of knowledge and the rest, like a blind man on a road,

sanskrit_iast:
daiśikāyatta eva syādbhoge muktau ca sarvathā /
dīkṣā ca kevalā jñānaṃ vināpi nijamāntaram // 299
meaning:
दैशिकायत्त एव स्याद्भोगे मुक्तौ च सर्वथा /
दीक्षा च केवला ज्ञानं विनापि निजमान्तरम् // 299
text_mt: would be entirely dependent upon the guru for enjoyment and for liberation. / And it was previously stated by reasoning and scripture that initiation alone,

sanskrit_iast:
mocikaiveti kathitaṃ yuktyā cāgamataḥ purā /
yastu dīkṣākṛtāmevāpekṣya yojanikāṃ śiśuḥ // 300
meaning:
मोचिकैवेति कथितं युक्त्या चागमतः पुरा /
यस्तु दीक्षाकृतामेवापेक्ष्य योजनिकां शिशुः // 300
text_mt: even without internal personal knowledge, is indeed liberating. / But a pupil who, relying on the conjunction effected by initiation alone,

sanskrit_iast:
sphuṭībhūtyai taducitaṃ jñānaṃ yogamathāśritaḥ /
so'pi yatraiva yuktaḥ syāttanmayatvaṃ prapadyate // 301
meaning:
स्फुटीभूत्यै तदुचितं ज्ञानं योगमथाश्रितः /
सोऽपि यत्रैव युक्तः स्यात्तन्मयत्वं प्रपद्यते // 301
text_mt: has then resorted to the knowledge and yoga appropriate for its manifestation, / he too attains identity with that very level where he is joined.

sanskrit_iast:
gurudīkṣāmantraśāstrādhīnasarvasthitistataḥ /
duṣṭānāmeva sarveṣāṃ bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyatām // 302
meaning:
गुरुदीक्षामन्त्रशास्त्राधीनसर्वस्थितिस्ततः /
दुष्टानामेव सर्वेषां भूतभव्यभविष्यताम् // 302
text_mt: Therefore, for one whose whole condition is dependent on guru, initiation, mantra, and scripture, / purification must be performed only of all the bad karmas—past, present, and future—

sanskrit_iast:
karmaṇāṃ śodhanaṃ kāryaṃ bubhukṣorna śubhātmanām /
yaḥ punarlaukikaṃ bhogaṃ rājyasvargādikaṃ śiśuḥ // 303
meaning:
कर्मणां शोधनं कार्यं बुभुक्षोर्न शुभात्मनाम् /
यः पुनर्लौकिकं भोगं राज्यस्वर्गादिकं शिशुः // 303
text_mt: for one desiring enjoyment, not of auspicious ones. / But for that pupil who, having renounced mundane enjoyment such as kingdom and heaven,

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā lokottaraṃ bhogamīpsustasya śubheṣvapi /
tatra dravyamayīṃ dīkṣāṃ kurvannājyatilādikaiḥ // 304
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा लोकोत्तरं भोगमीप्सुस्तस्य शुभेष्वपि /
तत्र द्रव्यमयीं दीक्षां कुर्वन्नाज्यतिलादिकैः // 304
text_mt: desires transmundane enjoyment, even regarding his auspicious [karmas]: / performing material initiation therein with ghee, sesame seeds, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
karmāsya śodhayāmīti juhuyāddaiśikottamaḥ /
jñānamayyāṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ tadviśuddhyati sandhitaḥ // 305
meaning:
कर्मास्य शोधयामीति जुहुयाद्दैशिकोत्तमः /
ज्ञानमय्यां तु दीक्षायां तद्विशुद्ध्यति सन्धितः // 305
text_mt: the excellent guru should offer oblations, thinking, 'I purify his karma.' / But in initiation of the nature of knowledge, that is purified by meditation;

sanskrit_iast:
guroḥ svasaṃvidrūḍhasya balāttatprakṣayo bhavet /
yadāsyāśubhakarmāṇi śuddhāni syustadā śubham // 306
meaning:
गुरोः स्वसंविद्रूढस्य बलात्तत्प्रक्षयो भवेत् /
यदास्याशुभकर्माणि शुद्धानि स्युस्तदा शुभम् // 306
text_mt: by the power of the guru established in his own consciousness, its destruction takes place. / When his inauspicious karmas are purified, then the auspicious [karma],

sanskrit_iast:
svatāratamyāśrayaṇādadhvamadhye prasūtidam /
śubhapākakramopāttaphalabhogasamāptitaḥ // 307
meaning:
स्वतारतम्याश्रयणादध्वमध्ये प्रसूतिदम् /
शुभपाकक्रमोपात्तफलभोगसमाप्तितः // 307
text_mt: resorting to its relative gradation, produces results midway along the path. / Through the exhaustion of the enjoyment of fruits obtained by the orderly ripening of the auspicious [karma],

sanskrit_iast:
yatraiṣa yojitastatstho bhāvikarmakṣaye kṛte /
bhāvināṃ cādyadehasthadehāntaravibhedinām // 308
meaning:
यत्रैष योजितस्तत्स्थो भाविकर्मक्षये कृते /
भाविनां चाद्यदेहस्थदेहान्तरविभेदिनाम् // 308
text_mt: and when future karma has been destroyed, being established wherever he has been conjoined, / and with the purification of the inauspicious portions of future [karmas] differentiating the present body from other bodies,

sanskrit_iast:
aśubhāṃśaviśuddhau syādbhogasyaivānupakṣayaḥ /
bhuñjānasyāsya satataṃ bhogānmāyālayāntataḥ // 309
meaning:
अशुभांशविशुद्धौ स्याद्भोगस्यैवानुपक्षयः /
भुञ्जानस्यास्य सततं भोगान्मायालयान्ततः // 309
text_mt: there would be no diminishment of enjoyment alone; / for him continuously experiencing enjoyments up to the dissolution of Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
na duḥkhaphaladaṃ dehādyadhvamadhye'pi kiṃcana /
tato māyālaye bhuktasamastasukhabhogakaḥ // 310
meaning:
न दुःखफलदं देहाद्यध्वमध्येऽपि किंचन /
ततो मायालये भुक्तसमस्तसुखभोगकः // 310
text_mt: nothing, including the body, yields painful fruit even midway along the path. / Then, having experienced all pleasures and enjoyments in the dissolution of Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkale sakale vaiti layaṃ yojanikābalāt /
iti prameyaṃ kathitaṃ dīkṣā kāle guroryathā // 311
meaning:
निष्कले सकले वैति लयं योजनिकाबलात् /
इति प्रमेयं कथितं दीक्षा काले गुरोर्यथा // 311
text_mt: he goes to dissolution in the partless or the partitioned by the power of conjunction. / Thus has the object of knowledge been taught, just as [it is] at the time of the guru's initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
atha bhairavatādātmyadāyinīṃ prakriyāṃ bruve /
evaṃ maṇḍalakumbhāgniśiṣyasvātmasu pañcasu // 1
meaning:
अथ भैरवतादात्म्यदायिनीं प्रक्रियां ब्रुवे /
एवं मण्डलकुम्भाग्निशिष्यस्वात्मसु पञ्चसु // 1
text_mt: Now I explain the ritual procedure that bestows identity with Bhairava: / having thus perceived pervasion through oneness in the five—
title: Vikṣiptadīkṣāprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā vyāptimaikyena nyasyādhvānaṃ ca śiṣyagam /
karmamāyāṇumalinatrayaṃ bāhau gale tathā // 2
meaning:
गृहीत्वा व्याप्तिमैक्येन न्यस्याध्वानं च शिष्यगम् /
कर्ममायाणुमलिनत्रयं बाहौ गले तथा // 2
text_mt: the maṇḍala, pot, fire, disciple, and oneself—and having projected the path residing in the disciple, / the guru should cast the triad of impurities consisting of karma, Māyā, and the atomic [impurity] on the arm, throat,

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāyāṃ ca kṣipetsūtragranthiyogena daiśikaḥ /
tasyātadrūpatābhānaṃ malo granthiḥ sa kīrtyate // 3
meaning:
शिखायां च क्षिपेत्सूत्रग्रन्थियोगेन दैशिकः /
तस्यातद्रूपताभानं मलो ग्रन्थिः स कीर्त्यते // 3
text_mt: and crest-knot through knotting the cord. / The appearance of non-identity [with Śiva] is called the impurity, the knot;

sanskrit_iast:
itipratītidārḍhyārthaṃ bahirgranthyupakalpanam /
bāhū karmāspadaṃ viṣṇurmāyātmā galasaṃśritaḥ // 4
meaning:
इतिप्रतीतिदार्ढ्यार्थं बहिर्ग्रन्थ्युपकल्पनम् /
बाहू कर्मास्पदं विष्णुर्मायात्मा गलसंश्रितः // 4
text_mt: to strengthen this conviction, an external knot is constructed. / The two arms are the seat of karma; Viṣṇu, who is of the nature of Māyā, resides in the throat;

sanskrit_iast:
adhovahā śikhāṇutvaṃ tenetthaṃ kalpanā kṛtā /
naraśaktiśivākhyasya trayasya bahubhedatām // 5
meaning:
अधोवहा शिखाणुत्वं तेनेत्थं कल्पना कृता /
नरशक्तिशिवाख्यस्य त्रयस्य बहुभेदताम् // 5
text_mt: the downward-flowing crest-knot is the atomic state; thus this conception has been made. / In order to express the manifold differentiation of the triad known as man, power, and Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
vaktuṃ tristriguṇaṃ sūtraṃ granthaye parikalpayet /
tejojalānnatritayaṃ tredhā pratyekamapyadaḥ // 6
meaning:
वक्तुं त्रिस्त्रिगुणं सूत्रं ग्रन्थये परिकल्पयेत् /
तेजोजलान्नत्रितयं त्रेधा प्रत्येकमप्यदः // 6
text_mt: one should fashion the cord ninefold for knotting. / The triad of fire, water, and earth is also threefold, each one of these;

sanskrit_iast:
śrutyante ke'pyataḥ śuklakṛṣṇaraktaṃ prapedire /
tato'gnau tarpitāśeṣamantre cidvyomamātrake // 7
meaning:
श्रुत्यन्ते केऽप्यतः शुक्लकृष्णरक्तं प्रपेदिरे /
ततोऽग्नौ तर्पिताशेषमन्त्रे चिद्व्योममात्रके // 7
text_mt: hence some in the Upaniṣads adopted white, black, and red. / Then, in the fire where all mantras have been gratified, in the mere ether of consciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyarūpe tattvānāṃ kramācchuddhiṃ samācaret /
tatra svamantrayogena dharāmāvāhayetpurā // 8
meaning:
सामान्यरूपे तत्त्वानां क्रमाच्छुद्धिं समाचरेत् /
तत्र स्वमन्त्रयोगेन धरामावाहयेत्पुरा // 8
text_mt: which has a general form, one should perform the purification of the reality-levels in succession. / There, by employing its own mantra, one should first invoke the earth;

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭvā puṣpādibhiḥ sarpistilādyairatha tarpayet /
tattattvavyāpikāṃ paścānmāyātattvādhidevatām // 9
meaning:
इष्ट्वा पुष्पादिभिः सर्पिस्तिलाद्यैरथ तर्पयेत् /
तत्तत्त्वव्यापिकां पश्चान्मायातत्त्वाधिदेवताम् // 9
text_mt: having worshiped with flowers and the like, one should then gratify with ghee, sesame seeds, and the like. / Afterward, having invoked, worshiped, and gratified with its own mantra the power of Māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
māyāśaktiṃ svamantreṇāvāhyābhyarcya pratarpayet /
āvāhane mātṛkārṇaṃ mālinyarṇaṃ ca pūjane // 10
meaning:
मायाशक्तिं स्वमन्त्रेणावाह्याभ्यर्च्य प्रतर्पयेत् /
आवाहने मातृकार्णं मालिन्यर्णं च पूजने // 10
text_mt: which is the presiding deity of the reality-level of Māyā and the pervader of each respective reality-level— / one should use the syllable of Mātṛkā in invocation, and the syllable of Mālinī in worship,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāditi guruḥ prāha svarūpāpyāyanadvayāt /
tāro varṇo'tha saṃbuddhipadaṃ tvāmityataḥ param // 11
meaning:
कुर्यादिति गुरुः प्राह स्वरूपाप्यायनद्वयात् /
तारो वर्णोऽथ संबुद्धिपदं त्वामित्यतः परम् // 11
text_mt: so the guru said, because of the two: one's own nature and nourishment. / Then the syllable OM, then the word in the vocative case, and after this the word 'you' (tvām);

sanskrit_iast:
uttamaikayutaṃ karmapadaṃ dīpakamapyataḥ /
tabhyaṃ nāma caturthyantaṃ tato'pyucitadīpakam // 12
meaning:
उत्तमैकयुतं कर्मपदं दीपकमप्यतः /
तभ्यं नाम चतुर्थ्यन्तं ततोऽप्युचितदीपकम् // 12
text_mt: then the word for the object of action joined with the first-person singular, then the illuminator; / then the name in the dative case, and then the appropriate illuminator—

sanskrit_iast:
ityūhamantrayogena tattatkarma pravartayet /
āvāhanānantaraṃ hi karma sarvaṃ nigadyate // 13
meaning:
इत्यूहमन्त्रयोगेन तत्तत्कर्म प्रवर्तयेत् /
आवाहनानन्तरं हि कर्म सर्वं निगद्यते // 13
text_mt: by employing the mantra thus adapted, one should perform each respective rite. / For every rite is indeed declared to come after invocation.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanaṃ ca saṃbodhaḥ svasvabhāvavyavasthiteḥ /
bhāvasyāhaṃmayasvātmatādātmyāveśyamānatā // 14
meaning:
आवाहनं च संबोधः स्वस्वभावव्यवस्थितेः /
भावस्याहंमयस्वात्मतादात्म्यावेश्यमानता // 14
text_mt: And invocation is awakening to abiding in one's essential nature, / the causing of an entity to enter into identity with one's own self, which is full of 'I'.

sanskrit_iast:
śāktī bhūmiśca saivoktā yasyāṃ mukhyāsti pūjyatā /
abhātatvādabhedācca nahyasau nṛśivātmanoḥ // 15
meaning:
शाक्ती भूमिश्च सैवोक्ता यस्यां मुख्यास्ति पूज्यता /
अभातत्वादभेदाच्च नह्यसौ नृशिवात्मनोः // 15
text_mt: That itself is declared to be the plane of power, on which the principal worshipfulness rests; / for it does not belong to the self of man or Śiva, due to unmanifestness and non-difference.

sanskrit_iast:
jaḍābhāseṣu tattveṣu saṃvitsthityai tato guruḥ /
āvāhanavibhaktiṃ prāk kṛtvā turyavibhaktitaḥ // 16
meaning:
जडाभासेषु तत्त्वेषु संवित्स्थित्यै ततो गुरुः /
आवाहनविभक्तिं प्राक् कृत्वा तुर्यविभक्तितः // 16
text_mt: Therefore, for the sake of establishing consciousness in the reality-levels that appear insentient, / the guru, having first made the case of invocation, by means of the fourth case...

sanskrit_iast:
namaskārāntatāyogātpūrṇāṃ sattāṃ prakalpayet /
tataḥ pūrṇasvabhāvatvaṃ tadrūpodrekayogataḥ // 17
meaning:
नमस्कारान्ततायोगात्पूर्णां सत्तां प्रकल्पयेत् /
ततः पूर्णस्वभावत्वं तद्रूपोद्रेकयोगतः // 17
text_mt: By conjunction with an ending in salutation (namaḥ), he should project full being; / thence, a nature of fullness arises through conjunction with the exuberance of its form.

sanskrit_iast:
dhyeyodreko bhaveddhyātṛprahvībhāvavaśādyataḥ /
āvāhyeṣṭvā pratarpyeti śrīsvacchande nirūpitam // 18
meaning:
ध्येयोद्रेको भवेद्ध्यातृप्रह्वीभाववशाद्यतः /
आवाह्येष्ट्वा प्रतर्प्येति श्रीस्वच्छन्दे निरूपितम् // 18
text_mt: Since the exuberance of the object of meditation occurs through the meditator's becoming humbled, / having invoked, worshipped, and fully satisfied, so it has been explained in the venerable Svacchanda.

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva pathāneyamityasmadguravo jaguḥ /
paratvena tu yatpūjyaṃ tatsvatantracidātmakam // 19
meaning:
अनेनैव पथानेयमित्यस्मद्गुरवो जगुः /
परत्वेन तु यत्पूज्यं तत्स्वतन्त्रचिदात्मकम् // 19
text_mt: By this very path it is to be led, so our gurus declared; / but that which is to be worshipped as transcendent consists of autonomous consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
anavacchitprakāśatvānna prakāśyaṃ tu kutracit /
tasya hyetatprapūjyatvadhyeyatvādi yadullaset // 20
meaning:
अनवच्छित्प्रकाशत्वान्न प्रकाश्यं तु कुत्रचित् /
तस्य ह्येतत्प्रपूज्यत्वध्येयत्वादि यदुल्लसेत् // 20
text_mt: Because it is consciousness that does not terminate its own light, it is nowhere an object of illumination; / for whatever manifestation it may have as being worthy of worship, of meditation, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaiva tatsvatantratvaṃ yātidurghaṭakāritā /
saṃbodharūpe tattasmin kathaṃ saṃbodhanā bhavet // 21
meaning:
तस्यैव तत्स्वतन्त्रत्वं यातिदुर्घटकारिता /
संबोधरूपे तत्तस्मिन् कथं संबोधना भवेत् // 21
text_mt: that is its very absolute autonomy, bringing about what is exceedingly difficult to accomplish. / How could an address (vocative) apply to that which is itself the form of awakened consciousness?

sanskrit_iast:
prakāśanāyāṃ na syātprakāśasya prakāśatā /
saṃbodhanavibhaktyaiva vinā karmādiśaktitām // 22
meaning:
प्रकाशनायां न स्यात्प्रकाशस्य प्रकाशता /
संबोधनविभक्त्यैव विना कर्मादिशक्तिताम् // 22
text_mt: In the act of illuminating, there can be no further illuminating of luminosity itself. / Only through the case of address (vocative), without the role of an accusative object or other cases,

sanskrit_iast:
svātantryāttaṃ darśayituṃ tatrohamimamācaret /
devamāvāhayāmīti tato devāya dīpakam // 23
meaning:
स्वातन्त्र्यात्तं दर्शयितुं तत्रोहमिममाचरेत् /
देवमावाहयामीति ततो देवाय दीपकम् // 23
text_mt: he should make this contextual adaptation (ūha) in order to display it through its absolute autonomy: / 'I invoke the deity (devam)', and then the illuminator 'to the deity (devāya)'.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgyuktyā pūrṇatādāyi namaḥsvāhādikaṃ bhavet /
nutiḥ pūrṇatvamagnīndusaṃghaṭṭāpyāyatā param // 24
meaning:
प्राग्युक्त्या पूर्णतादायि नमःस्वाहादिकं भवेत् /
नुतिः पूर्णत्वमग्नीन्दुसंघट्टाप्यायता परम् // 24
text_mt: According to the previous reasoning, words such as namaḥ and svāhā bestow fullness; / praise is fullness, while replenishment through the union of fire and moon is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyakaṃ ca procchālaṃ vauṣaḍādi pradīpayet /
tatra bāhye'pi tādātmyaprasiddhaṃ karma codyate // 25
meaning:
आप्यायकं च प्रोच्छालं वौषडादि प्रदीपयेत् /
तत्र बाह्येऽपि तादात्म्यप्रसिद्धं कर्म चोद्यते // 25
text_mt: And vauṣaṭ and the like, which replenish and surge upward, he should kindle; / there, even externally, an accusative object established in identity is employed.

sanskrit_iast:
yadi karmapadaṃ tanno gururabhyūhayetkvacit /
anābhāsitatadvastubhāsanāya niyujyate // 26
meaning:
यदि कर्मपदं तन्नो गुरुरभ्यूहयेत्क्वचित् /
अनाभासिततद्वस्तुभासनाय नियुज्यते // 26
text_mt: If there is an accusative word, the guru should never contextually adapt it there; / a mantra is applied to illuminate an entity that has not been made manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
mantraḥ kiṃ tena tatra syātsphuṭaṃ yatrāvabhāsi tat /
tena prokṣaṇasaṃsekajapādividhiṣu dhruvam // 27
meaning:
मन्त्रः किं तेन तत्र स्यात्स्फुटं यत्रावभासि तत् /
तेन प्रोक्षणसंसेकजपादिविधिषु ध्रुवम् // 27
text_mt: What would it effect in a situation where that is already clearly manifest? / Therefore, in rites such as sprinkling, consecrating with water, recitation, and the like, certainly,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkarmābhyūhanaṃ kuryātpratyuta vyavadhātṛtām /
bahistathātmatābhāve kāryaṃ karmapadohanam // 28
meaning:
तत्कर्माभ्यूहनं कुर्यात्प्रत्युत व्यवधातृताम् /
बहिस्तथात्मताभावे कार्यं कर्मपदोहनम् // 28
text_mt: supplying that accusative object would rather cause obstruction; / contextual adaptation of an accusative word is to be made only when its state of being externally real is absent,

sanskrit_iast:
tṛptāvāhutihutabhukpāśaploṣacchidādiṣu /
yatroddiṣṭe vidhau paścāttadanantaiḥ kriyātmakaiḥ // 29
meaning:
तृप्तावाहुतिहुतभुक्पाशप्लोषच्छिदादिषु /
यत्रोद्दिष्टे विधौ पश्चात्तदनन्तैः क्रियात्मकैः // 29
text_mt: in rites of satisfying, offering oblations, feeding the fire, scorching bonds, severing, and so forth. / Where, after the rite is enjoined, it is to be accomplished by its endless parts

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśaiḥ sādhyaṃ na tatroho dīkṣaṇādividhiṣviva /
tataḥ śiṣyasya tattattvasthāne'streṇa pratāḍanam // 30
meaning:
अंशैः साध्यं न तत्रोहो दीक्षणादिविधिष्विव /
ततः शिष्यस्य तत्तत्त्वस्थानेऽस्त्रेण प्रताडनम् // 30
text_mt: consisting of actions, there is no contextual adaptation there, as in the rites of initiation and the like. / Then, striking [the disciple] with the Astra mantra at the location of that particular tattva,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvātha śivahastena hṛdayaṃ parimarśayet /
tataḥ svanāḍīmārgeṇa hṛdayaṃ prāpya vai śiśoḥ // 31
meaning:
कृत्वाथ शिवहस्तेन हृदयं परिमर्शयेत् /
ततः स्वनाडीमार्गेण हृदयं प्राप्य वै शिशोः // 31
text_mt: and then touching the heart with the hand of Śiva, / the guru should then reach the heart of the child by the path of his own channel (nāḍī).

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyātmanā sahaikatvaṃ gatvādāya ca taṃ hṛdā /
puṭitaṃ haṃsarūpākhyaṃ tatra saṃhāramudrayā // 32
meaning:
शिष्यात्मना सहैकत्वं गत्वादाय च तं हृदा /
पुटितं हंसरूपाख्यं तत्र संहारमुद्रया // 32
text_mt: Attaining oneness with the disciple's soul, and seizing it, / enclosed by the heart, named as the form of the Haṃsa, by means of the mudrā of dissolution (saṃhāra),

sanskrit_iast:
kuryādātmīyahṛdayasthitamapyavabhāsakam /
śiṣyadehasya tejobhī raśmimātrāviyogataḥ // 33
meaning:
कुर्यादात्मीयहृदयस्थितमप्यवभासकम् /
शिष्यदेहस्य तेजोभी रश्मिमात्रावियोगतः // 33
text_mt: he should make it illuminate even though situated in his own heart, / by rays consisting of light, without detachment from the body of the disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
svabandhasthānacalanāt svatantrasthānalābhataḥ /
svakarmāparatantratvātsarvatrotpattimarhati // 34
meaning:
स्वबन्धस्थानचलनात् स्वतन्त्रस्थानलाभतः /
स्वकर्मापरतन्त्रत्वात्सर्वत्रोत्पत्तिमर्हति // 34
text_mt: Because of moving from its place of bondage, obtaining an autonomous abode, / and not being dependent on its own karma, it is worthy of emergence everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
tenātmahṛdayānītaṃ prākkṛtvā pudgalaṃ tataḥ /
māyāyāṃ taddharātattvaśarīrāṇyasya saṃsṛjet // 35
meaning:
तेनात्महृदयानीतं प्राक्कृत्वा पुद्गलं ततः /
मायायां तद्धरातत्त्वशरीराण्यस्य संसृजेत् // 35
text_mt: Having therefore first brought the individual soul (pudgala) into his own heart, then, / in Māyā, he should fashion for it bodies made of the earth tattva.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāsya garbhādhānaṃ ca yuktaṃ puṃsavanādibhiḥ /
garbhaniṣkrāmaparyantairekāṃ kurvīta saṃskriyām // 36
meaning:
तत्रास्य गर्भाधानं च युक्तं पुंसवनादिभिः /
गर्भनिष्क्रामपर्यन्तैरेकां कुर्वीत संस्क्रियाम् // 36
text_mt: There, he should perform as a single purification (saṃskāra) its conception, / along with the rite for producing a male (puṃsavana) and others, up to emergence from the womb.

sanskrit_iast:
jananaṃ bhogabhoktṛtvaṃ militvaikātha saṃskriyā /
tato'sya teṣu bhogeṣu kuryāttanmayatāṃ layam // 37
meaning:
जननं भोगभोक्तृत्वं मिलित्वैकाथ संस्क्रिया /
ततोऽस्य तेषु भोगेषु कुर्यात्तन्मयतां लयम् // 37
text_mt: Birth and the status of experiencing enjoyment together form another single purification; / then he should effect its absorption and identification in those enjoyments.

sanskrit_iast:
tatastattattvapāśānāṃ vicchedaṃ samupācaret /
saṃskārāṇāṃ catuṣke'sminnaparāṃ ca parāparām // 38
meaning:
ततस्तत्तत्त्वपाशानां विच्छेदं समुपाचरेत् /
संस्काराणां चतुष्केऽस्मिन्नपरां च परापराम् // 38
text_mt: Then he should carry out the severing of the bonds of that tattva. / In this quartet of purifications, he should employ in succession Aparā, Parāparā,

sanskrit_iast:
mantrāṇāṃ pañcadaśakaṃ parāṃ vā yojayetkramāt /
pivanyādyaṣṭakaṃ śastrādikaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ parā tathā // 39
meaning:
मन्त्राणां पञ्चदशकं परां वा योजयेत्क्रमात् /
पिवन्याद्यष्टकं शस्त्रादिकं षट्कं परा तथा // 39
text_mt: the group of fifteen mantras, or Parā: / the group of eight beginning with Pivanī, the group of six beginning with the Weapon, and Parā—

sanskrit_iast:
iti pañcadaśaite syuḥ kramāllīnatvasaṃskṛtau /
aparāmantramuktvā prāgamukātmana ityatha // 40
meaning:
इति पञ्चदशैते स्युः क्रमाल्लीनत्वसंस्कृतौ /
अपरामन्त्रमुक्त्वा प्रागमुकात्मन इत्यथ // 40
text_mt: these are the fifteen in succession for the purification of absorption. / Having first recited the Aparā mantra, saying 'of such-and-such a soul',

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhānaṃ karomīti punarmantraṃ tameva ca /
svāhāntamuccarandadyādāhutitritayaṃ guruḥ // 41
meaning:
गर्भाधानं करोमीति पुनर्मन्त्रं तमेव च /
स्वाहान्तमुच्चरन्दद्यादाहुतित्रितयं गुरुः // 41
text_mt: and saying 'I perform the conception', reciting once more that same mantra / ending in svāhā, the guru should offer three oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ parāparāmantramamukātmana ityatha /
jātasya bhogabhoktṛtvaṃ karomyatha parāparām // 42
meaning:
परं परापरामन्त्रममुकात्मन इत्यथ /
जातस्य भोगभोक्तृत्वं करोम्यथ परापराम् // 42
text_mt: Then, reciting the Parāparā mantra, and saying 'of such-and-such a soul / who is born, I perform the status of experiencing enjoyment', and then the Parāparā,

sanskrit_iast:
ante svāheti proccārya vitarettisra āhutīḥ /
uccārya pivanīmantramamukātmana ityatha // 43
meaning:
अन्ते स्वाहेति प्रोच्चार्य वितरेत्तिस्र आहुतीः /
उच्चार्य पिवनीमन्त्रममुकात्मन इत्यथ // 43
text_mt: uttering svāhā at the end, he should bestow three oblations. / Reciting the Pivanī mantra, and saying 'of such-and-such a soul

sanskrit_iast:
bhoge layaṃ karomīti punarmantraṃ tameva ca /
svāhāntamāhutīstisro dadyādājyatilādibhiḥ // 44
meaning:
भोगे लयं करोमीति पुनर्मन्त्रं तमेव च /
स्वाहान्तमाहुतीस्तिस्रो दद्यादाज्यतिलादिभिः // 44
text_mt: I perform absorption in enjoyment', and once more that same mantra / ending in svāhā, he should offer three oblations of clarified butter, sesame seeds, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa eva vamanyādau vidhiḥ pañcadaśāntake /
pūrvaṃ parātmakaṃ mantramamukātmana ityatha // 45
meaning:
एष एव वमन्यादौ विधिः पञ्चदशान्तके /
पूर्वं परात्मकं मन्त्रममुकात्मन इत्यथ // 45
text_mt: This very rule applies to the group ending with the fifteenth, beginning with Vamanī. / Having first recited the mantra whose nature is Parā, saying 'of such-and-such a soul

sanskrit_iast:
pāśācchedaṃ karomīti parāmantraḥ punastataḥ /
huṃ svāhā phaṭ samuccārya dadyāttisro'pyathāhutīḥ // 46
meaning:
पाशाच्छेदं करोमीति परामन्त्रः पुनस्ततः /
हुं स्वाहा फट् समुच्चार्य दद्यात्तिस्रोऽप्यथाहुतीः // 46
text_mt: I perform the severing of the bond', then the Parā mantra again, / uttering 'huṃ svāhā phaṭ', he should also offer three oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskārāṇāṃ catuṣke'sminye mantrāḥ kathitā mayā /
teṣu karmapadātpūrvaṃ dharātattvapadaṃ vadet // 47
meaning:
संस्काराणां चतुष्केऽस्मिन्ये मन्त्राः कथिता मया /
तेषु कर्मपदात्पूर्वं धरातत्त्वपदं वदेत् // 47
text_mt: Among these four purifications, in the mantras I have declared, / before the accusative word he should recite the word for the earth tattva.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dharātattvapatimāmantryeṣṭvā pratarpya ca /
śivābhimānasaṃrabdho gururevaṃ samādiśet // 48
meaning:
ततो धरातत्त्वपतिमामन्त्र्येष्ट्वा प्रतर्प्य च /
शिवाभिमानसंरब्धो गुरुरेवं समादिशेत् // 48
text_mt: Then, having addressed the lord of the earth tattva, worshipped, and fully satisfied him, / filled with the proud identification with Śiva, the guru should command thus:

sanskrit_iast:
tattveśvara tvayā nāsya putrakasya śivājñayā /
pratibandhaḥ prakartavyo yātuḥ padamanāmayam // 49
meaning:
तत्त्वेश्वर त्वया नास्य पुत्रकस्य शिवाज्ञया /
प्रतिबन्धः प्रकर्तव्यो यातुः पदमनामयम् // 49
text_mt: 'O Lord of the Tattva, by the command of Śiva, no obstacle should be made by you / to this spiritual son who is going to the painless realm.'

sanskrit_iast:
tato yadi samīheta dharātattvāntarālagam /
pṛthak śodhayituṃ mantrī bhuvanādyadhvapañcakam // 50
meaning:
ततो यदि समीहेत धरातत्त्वान्तरालगम् /
पृथक् शोधयितुं मन्त्री भुवनाद्यध्वपञ्चकम् // 50
text_mt: Then, if the mantra-knower desires to purify separately / the fivefold path of worlds and so on situated within the earth tattva,

sanskrit_iast:
aparāmantrataḥ prāgvattisrastisrastadāhutīḥ /
dadyātpuraṃ śodhayāmītyūhayuktaṃ prasannadhīḥ // 51
meaning:
अपरामन्त्रतः प्राग्वत्तिस्रस्तिस्रस्तदाहुतीः /
दद्यात्पुरं शोधयामीत्यूहयुक्तं प्रसन्नधीः // 51
text_mt: with a serene mind, he should offer three oblations each by means of the Aparā mantra as before, / accompanied by the adaptation: 'I purify the city.'

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kalāmantrapadavarṇeṣvapi vicakṣaṇaḥ /
tisrastisro hutīrdadyāt pṛthak sāmastyato'pivā // 52
meaning:
एवं कलामन्त्रपदवर्णेष्वपि विचक्षणः /
तिस्रस्तिस्रो हुतीर्दद्यात् पृथक् सामस्त्यतोऽपिवा // 52
text_mt: Likewise, regarding the divisions (kalā), mantras, words (pada), and letters (varṇa), the discerning [guru] / should offer three oblations each, either separately or collectively.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ dattvā parayā vauṣaḍantayā /
aparāmantrataḥ śiṣyamuddhṛtyātmahṛdaṃ nayet // 53
meaning:
ततः पूर्णाहुतिं दत्त्वा परया वौषडन्तया /
अपरामन्त्रतः शिष्यमुद्धृत्यात्महृदं नयेत् // 53
text_mt: Then, having offered the full oblation (pūrṇāhuti) with the Parā mantra ending in vauṣaṭ, / extracting the disciple with the Aparā mantra, he should bring him to his own heart.

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tvekena śuddhena tadantarbhāvacintanāt /
na pṛthak śodhayettattvanāthasaṃśravaṇātparam // 54
meaning:
यदा त्वेकेन शुद्धेन तदन्तर्भावचिन्तनात् /
न पृथक् शोधयेत्तत्त्वनाथसंश्रवणात्परम् // 54
text_mt: When, however, through meditating on their inclusion within that which is purified as one, / he does not purify separately after invoking the lord of the tattva,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā pūrṇāṃ vitīryāṇumutkṣipyātmani yojayet /
tātsthyātmasaṃsthyayogāya tayaivāparayāhutīḥ // 55
meaning:
तदा पूर्णां वितीर्याणुमुत्क्षिप्यात्मनि योजयेत् /
तात्स्थ्यात्मसंस्थ्ययोगाय तयैवापरयाहुतीः // 55
text_mt: then, offering the full oblation and raising the individual soul, he should unite it in himself. / In order to bring about its residing therein and resting in the self, with that very Aparā mantra

sanskrit_iast:
sakarmapadayā dadyāditi kecittu manvate /
anye tu guravaḥ prāhurbhāvanāmayamīdṛśam // 56
meaning:
सकर्मपदया दद्यादिति केचित्तु मन्वते /
अन्ये तु गुरवः प्राहुर्भावनामयमीदृशम् // 56
text_mt: he should offer oblations containing the accusative word—so some think. / Other gurus, however, declared that this is of the nature of imaginative contemplation (bhāvanā);

sanskrit_iast:
nātra bāhyāhutirdeyā daiśikasya pṛthak punaḥ /
dadyādvā yadi no doṣaḥ syādupāyaḥ sa bhāvane // 57
meaning:
नात्र बाह्याहुतिर्देया दैशिकस्य पृथक् पुनः /
दद्याद्वा यदि नो दोषः स्यादुपायः स भावने // 57
text_mt: an external oblation is not to be given here separately by the preceptor; / or if he should give it, there is no fault: it is a means for imaginative contemplation.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prāktanatātsthyātmasaṃsthatve yojayedguruḥ /
tataḥ śiṣyahṛdaṃ neyaḥ sa ātmā tāvato'dhvanaḥ // 58
meaning:
एवं प्राक्तनतात्स्थ्यात्मसंस्थत्वे योजयेद्गुरुः /
ततः शिष्यहृदं नेयः स आत्मा तावतोऽध्वनः // 58
text_mt: Thus the guru should unite [it] into its prior state of residing therein and resting in the self. / Then that soul, purified of that portion of the path,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhastaddārḍhyasiddhyai ca pūrṇā syātparayā punaḥ /
mahāpāśupataṃ pūrvaṃ vilomasya viśuddhaye // 59
meaning:
शुद्धस्तद्दार्ढ्यसिद्ध्यै च पूर्णा स्यात्परया पुनः /
महापाशुपतं पूर्वं विलोमस्य विशुद्धये // 59
text_mt: is to be led to the heart of the disciple; and for the attainment of firmness therein, there should again be a full oblation with Parā. / Saying first: 'I offer the oblation to the Great Pāśupata Weapon for the purification of what is inverted',

sanskrit_iast:
juhomi punarastreṇa vauṣaḍanta iti kṣipet /
punaḥ pūrṇāṃ tato māyāmabhyarcyātha visarjayet // 60
meaning:
जुहोमि पुनरस्त्रेण वौषडन्त इति क्षिपेत् /
पुनः पूर्णां ततो मायामभ्यर्च्याथ विसर्जयेत् // 60
text_mt: ending in vauṣaṭ, he should cast it with the Astra mantra. / Then again offering the full oblation, having worshipped Māyā, he should then dismiss her.

sanskrit_iast:
dharātattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ sajjalena śuddharūpiṇā /
bhāvayenmiśritaṃ vāri śuddhiyogyaṃ tato bhavet // 61
meaning:
धरातत्त्वं विशुद्धं सज्जलेन शुद्धरूपिणा /
भावयेन्मिश्रितं वारि शुद्धियोग्यं ततो भवेत् // 61
text_mt: One should contemplate the earth tattva, having been purified, as mingled with water whose nature is pure; / thence the water becomes suitable for purification.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā tattatpurātattvamiśraṇāduttarottaram /
sarvā śivībhavettattvāvalī śuddhānyathā pṛthak // 62
meaning:
तथा तत्तत्पुरातत्त्वमिश्रणादुत्तरोत्तरम् /
सर्वा शिवीभवेत्तत्त्वावली शुद्धान्यथा पृथक् // 62
text_mt: Likewise, by mixing with the preceding tattva consecutively, / the whole series of tattvas, being purified, becomes identified with Śiva; otherwise, [they remain] separate.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthaktvaṃ ca malo māyābhidhānastasya saṃbhave /
karmakṣaye'pi no muktirbhavedvidyeśvarādivat // 63
meaning:
पृथक्त्वं च मलो मायाभिधानस्तस्य संभवे /
कर्मक्षयेऽपि नो मुक्तिर्भवेद्विद्येश्वरादिवत् // 63
text_mt: And separateness is the impurity named Māyā; when it exists, / even on the exhaustion of karma, there would be no liberation, as in the case of the lords of wisdom and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
tato'pi jalatattvasya vahnau vyomni cidātmake /
āhvānādyakhilaṃ yāvattejasyasya vimaśraṇam // 64
meaning:
ततोऽपि जलतत्त्वस्य वह्नौ व्योम्नि चिदात्मके /
आह्वानाद्यखिलं यावत्तेजस्यस्य विमश्रणम् // 64
text_mt: Then also, of the water-tattwa in the fire, in the sky whose nature is consciousness, / everything from invocation onward up to its reflective awareness in fire [should be performed].

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kramātkalātattve śuddhe pāśaṃ bhujāśritam /
chindyātkalā hi sā kiṃcitkartṛtvonmīlanātmikā // 65
meaning:
एवं क्रमात्कलातत्त्वे शुद्धे पाशं भुजाश्रितम् /
छिन्द्यात्कला हि सा किंचित्कर्तृत्वोन्मीलनात्मिका // 65
text_mt: In this way, when the principle of kalā has been purified in succession, one should sever the bond resting on the arm; / for kalā has the nature of unfolding limited agency. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
karmākhyamalajṛmbhātmā taṃ ca granthiṃ srugagragam /
pūrṇāhutyā samaṃ vahnimantratejasi nirdahet // 66
meaning:
कर्माख्यमलजृम्भात्मा तं च ग्रन्थिं स्रुगग्रगम् /
पूर्णाहुत्या समं वह्निमन्त्रतेजसि निर्दहेत् // 66
text_mt: And that knot, whose essence is the expansion of the impurity named karma, placed on the tip of the ladle, / he should burn completely together with the final oblation in the radiant energy of the fire-mantra. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
mantro hi viśvarūpaḥ sannupāśrayavaśāttathā /
vyaktarūpastato vahnau pāśaploṣavidhāyakaḥ // 67
meaning:
मन्त्रो हि विश्वरूपः सन्नुपाश्रयवशात्तथा /
व्यक्तरूपस्ततो वह्नौ पाशप्लोषविधायकः // 67
text_mt: For the mantra, being universal in form, likewise has an manifest form / by virtue of the support; therefore, in the fire, it effects the burning of the bonds. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
pluṣṭo līnasvabhāvo'sau pāśastaṃ prati śambhuvat /
parameśamahātejaḥśeṣamātratvamaśnute // 68
meaning:
प्लुष्टो लीनस्वभावोऽसौ पाशस्तं प्रति शम्भुवत् /
परमेशमहातेजःशेषमात्रत्वमश्नुते // 68
text_mt: Burnt, its nature dissolved, this bond regarding him, like Śambhu, / attains to being nothing but the remnant of the supreme Lord's great radiant energy. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
karmapāśe'tra hotavye pūrṇayāsya śubhāśubham /
aśubhaṃ vā bhavadbhūtaṃ bhāvi vātha samastakam // 69
meaning:
कर्मपाशेऽत्र होतव्ये पूर्णयास्य शुभाशुभम् /
अशुभं वा भवद्भूतं भावि वाथ समस्तकम् // 69
text_mt: Here, when the bond of karma is to be offered with the full oblation, its auspicious and inauspicious [effects], / or inauspicious, present, past, or future, or all [of them together], // 69

sanskrit_iast:
dahāmi phaṭtrayaṃ vauṣaḍiti pūrṇāṃ vinikṣipet /
evaṃ māyāntasaṃśuddhau kaṇṭhapāśaṃ ca homayet // 70
meaning:
दहामि फट्त्रयं वौषडिति पूर्णां विनिक्षिपेत् /
एवं मायान्तसंशुद्धौ कण्ठपाशं च होमयेत् // 70
text_mt: he should cast the full oblation, reciting: 'I burn, phaṭ, phaṭ, phaṭ, vauṣaṭ.' / Thus, upon the complete purification up to māyā, he should also offer the bond of the throat. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇasya tasya māyākhyaṃ pāśabhedaprathātmakam /
dahāmi phaṭtrayaṃ vauṣaḍiti pūrṇāṃ kṣipedguruḥ // 71
meaning:
पूर्णस्य तस्य मायाख्यं पाशभेदप्रथात्मकम् /
दहामि फट्त्रयं वौषडिति पूर्णां क्षिपेद्गुरुः // 71
text_mt: Saying, 'I burn his [bond] named māyā, of the nature of the spread of differentiated bonds, of the full one, phaṭ, phaṭ, phaṭ, vauṣaṭ,' / the guru should cast the full oblation. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
nirbījā yadi kāryā tu tadātraivāparāṃ kṣipet /
pūrṇāṃ samayapāśākhyabījadāhapadānvitām // 72
meaning:
निर्बीजा यदि कार्या तु तदात्रैवापरां क्षिपेत् /
पूर्णां समयपाशाख्यबीजदाहपदान्विताम् // 72
text_mt: If, however, [an initiation] without seed is to be performed, then right here he should cast another / full oblation, accompanied by the words for burning the seed called the bond of the pledge. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
gurau deve tathā śāstre bhaktiḥ kāryāsya nahyasau /
samayaḥ śaktipātasya svabhāvo hyeṣa no pṛthak // 73
meaning:
गुरौ देवे तथा शास्त्रे भक्तिः कार्यास्य नह्यसौ /
समयः शक्तिपातस्य स्वभावो ह्येष नो पृथक् // 73
text_mt: Devotion to the guru, the deity, and the scripture must be maintained by him; for this is not / a pledge [imposed from outside], but the very nature of the descent of power, not something separate. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
māyānte śuddhimāyāte vāgīśī yā purābhavat /
māyā śaktimayī saiva vidyāśaktitvamaśnute // 74
meaning:
मायान्ते शुद्धिमायाते वागीशी या पुराभवत् /
माया शक्तिमयी सैव विद्याशक्तित्वमश्नुते // 74
text_mt: When purity is attained up to māyā, she who was previously Vāgīśī, / that very Māyā, consisting of power, attains the state of Vidyāśakti. // 74

sanskrit_iast:
tacchuddhavidyāmāhūya vidyāśaktiṃ niyojayet /
evaṃ krameṇa saṃśuddhe sadāśivapade'pyalam // 75
meaning:
तच्छुद्धविद्यामाहूय विद्याशक्तिं नियोजयेत् /
एवं क्रमेण संशुद्धे सदाशिवपदेऽप्यलम् // 75
text_mt: Having invoked her in Śuddhavidyā, he should unite Vidyāśakti; / thus, when the state of Sadāśiva also has been sufficiently purified in succession, // 75

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāṃ granthiyutāṃ chittvā malamāṇavakaṃ dahet /
yato'dhikārabhogākhyau dvau pāśau tu sadāśive // 76
meaning:
शिखां ग्रन्थियुतां छित्त्वा मलमाणवकं दहेत् /
यतोऽधिकारभोगाख्यौ द्वौ पाशौ तु सदाशिवे // 76
text_mt: having severed the tuft joined with the knot, he should burn the āṇava impurity; / for in Sadāśiva there are two bonds, named authority and enjoyment. // 76

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktyāṇavapāśo'tra māyīyastu niśāvadhiḥ /
śiṣyo yathocitaṃ snāyādācāmeddaiśikaḥ svayam // 77
meaning:
इत्युक्त्याणवपाशोऽत्र मायीयस्तु निशावधिः /
शिष्यो यथोचितं स्नायादाचामेद्दैशिकः स्वयम् // 77
text_mt: By this statement, here the āṇava bond [extends up to Sadāśiva], while the māyīya [bond] extends up to the night [of māyā]. / The disciple should bathe as appropriate, and the teacher should perform the sipping of water himself. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
āṇavākhye vinirdagdhe hyadhovāhiśikhāmale /
tataḥ prāguktasakalaprameyaṃ paricintayan // 78
meaning:
आणवाख्ये विनिर्दग्धे ह्यधोवाहिशिखामले /
ततः प्रागुक्तसकलप्रमेयं परिचिन्तयन् // 78
text_mt: When the impurity of the downward-flowing tuft, called āṇava, has been burned completely, / he then, contemplating the entire objective reality previously spoken of, // 78

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyadehādimātmīyadehaprāṇādiyojitam /
kṛtvātmadehaprāṇāderviśvamantaranusmaret // 79
meaning:
शिष्यदेहादिमात्मीयदेहप्राणादियोजितम् /
कृत्वात्मदेहप्राणादेर्विश्वमन्तरनुस्मरेत् // 79
text_mt: having united the disciple's body and so forth with his own body, vital breath, and so forth, / should call to mind the universe inside his own body, vital breath, and so forth. // 79

sanskrit_iast:
uktaprakriyayā caivaṃ dṛḍhabuddhirananyadhīḥ /
prāṇasthaṃ deśakālādhvayugaṃ prāṇaṃ ca śaktigam // 80
meaning:
उक्तप्रक्रियया चैवं दृढबुद्धिरनन्यधीः /
प्राणस्थं देशकालाध्वयुगं प्राणं च शक्तिगम् // 80
text_mt: And in this way, by the prescribed procedure, with firm intellect and undivided mind, / [he contemplates] the pair of paths of space and time residing in the breath, and the breath residing in power; // 80

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ ca saṃvidgatāṃ śuddhāṃ saṃvidaṃ śivarūpiṇīm /
śiṣyasaṃvidabhinnāṃ ca mantravahnyādyabhedinīm // 81
meaning:
तां च संविद्गतां शुद्धां संविदं शिवरूपिणीम् /
शिष्यसंविदभिन्नां च मन्त्रवह्न्याद्यभेदिनीम् // 81
text_mt: and that [power] residing in pure consciousness, consciousness whose form is Śiva, / non-different from the disciple's consciousness, and not different from the fire, the mantra, and so forth; // 81

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyan prāgvatprayogeṇa śivaṃ sakalaniṣkalam /
dvyātmakaṃ vā kṣipetpūrṇāṃ praśāntakaraṇena tu // 82
meaning:
ध्यायन् प्राग्वत्प्रयोगेण शिवं सकलनिष्कलम् /
द्व्यात्मकं वा क्षिपेत्पूर्णां प्रशान्तकरणेन तु // 82
text_mt: meditating as before through the application upon Śiva as composite and impartite, / or dual in nature, he should cast the full oblation with tranquil instrument. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ traiśirase tantre sarvasaṃpūraṇātmakam /
mūlādudayagatyā tu śivenduparisaṃplutam // 83
meaning:
उक्तं त्रैशिरसे तन्त्रे सर्वसंपूरणात्मकम् /
मूलादुदयगत्या तु शिवेन्दुपरिसंप्लुतम् // 83
text_mt: It is stated in the Traiśirasa Tantra: 'whose essence is the complete filling of everything, / rising by the path of arising from the base, inundated with Śiva's moon, // 83

sanskrit_iast:
janmāntamadhyakuharamūlasrotaḥsamutthitam /
śivārkaraśmibhistīvraiḥ kṣubdhaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ tu yat // 84
meaning:
जन्मान्तमध्यकुहरमूलस्रोतःसमुत्थितम् /
शिवार्करश्मिभिस्तीव्रैः क्षुब्धं ज्ञानामृतं तु यत् // 84
text_mt: arisen from the root-current in the central cavity up to the end of birth, / the nectar of knowledge which is agitated by the intense rays of the sun of Śiva— // 84

sanskrit_iast:
tena saṃtarpayetsamyak praśāntakaraṇena tu /
śūnyadhāmābjamadhyasthaprabhākiraṇabhāsvaraḥ // 85
meaning:
तेन संतर्पयेत्सम्यक् प्रशान्तकरणेन तु /
शून्यधामाब्जमध्यस्थप्रभाकिरणभास्वरः // 85
text_mt: with that he should satisfy thoroughly, with a tranquil instrument.' / Radiant with beams of light residing in the center of the lotus of the void-abode, // 85

sanskrit_iast:
ādheyādhāraniḥspandabodhaśāstraparigrahaḥ /
janmādheyaprapañcaikasphoṭasaṃghaṭṭaghaṭṭanaḥ // 86
meaning:
आधेयाधारनिःस्पन्दबोधशास्त्रपरिग्रहः /
जन्माधेयप्रपञ्चैकस्फोटसंघट्टघट्टनः // 86
text_mt: embracing the scripture of consciousness motionless in the supported and the support, / striking the clash of the single burst of the world that is the content of birth, // 86

sanskrit_iast:
mūlasthānātsamārabhya kṛtvā someśamantagam /
khamivātiṣṭhate yāvatpraśāntaṃ tāvaducyate // 87
meaning:
मूलस्थानात्समारभ्य कृत्वा सोमेशमन्तगम् /
खमिवातिष्ठते यावत्प्रशान्तं तावदुच्यते // 87
text_mt: beginning from the root place and making it reach the end of the lord of the moon, / as long as he remains like space, so long it is said to be tranquil. // 87

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre ca srucamāpūrya sarpiṣā /
kṛtvā śiṣyaṃ tathātmasthaṃ mūlamantramanusmaran // 88
meaning:
उक्तं श्रीपूर्वशास्त्रे च स्रुचमापूर्य सर्पिषा /
कृत्वा शिष्यं तथात्मस्थं मूलमन्त्रमनुस्मरन् // 88
text_mt: And it is stated in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra: 'Filling the ladle with ghee, / and placing the disciple in oneself, recollecting the root mantra, // 88

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ śaktiṃ tathātmānaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarpistathānalam /
ekīkurvañchanairgaccheddvādaśāntamananyadhīḥ // 89
meaning:
शिवं शक्तिं तथात्मानं शिष्यं सर्पिस्तथानलम् /
एकीकुर्वञ्छनैर्गच्छेद्द्वादशान्तमनन्यधीः // 89
text_mt: unifying Śiva, power, himself, the disciple, the ghee, and the fire, / he should go slowly to the dvādaśānta with undivided mind. // 89

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kumbhakamāsthāya dhyāyansakalaniṣkalam /
tiṣṭhettāvadanudvigno yāvadājyakṣayo bhvet // 90
meaning:
तत्र कुम्भकमास्थाय ध्यायन्सकलनिष्कलम् /
