tatra prabhāte saṃbudhya sveṣṭāṃ prāgdevatāṃ smaret // 29
meaning:
न्यासं ध्यानं जपं मुद्रां पूजां कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः /
तत्र प्रभाते संबुध्य स्वेष्टां प्राग्देवतां स्मरेत् // 29
text_mt: as well as installation, visualization, recitation, seal, and worship. / Waking there at dawn, he should first remember his chosen deity. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtāvaśyakakartavyaḥ śuddho bhūtvā tato gṛham /
āśrityottaradigvaktraḥ sthānadehāntaratraye // 30
meaning:
कृतावश्यककर्तव्यः शुद्धो भूत्वा ततो गृहम् /
आश्रित्योत्तरदिग्वक्त्रः स्थानदेहान्तरत्रये // 30
text_mt: Having performed the obligatory duties and become pure, he then enters the room, / faces the northern direction, and having performed purification in the triad of place, body, and interior, // 30

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhiṃ vidhāya mantrāṇāṃ yathāsthānaṃ niveśanam /
mudrāpradarśanaṃ dhyānaṃ bhedābhedasvarūpataḥ // 31
meaning:
शुद्धिं विधाय मन्त्राणां यथास्थानं निवेशनम् /
मुद्राप्रदर्शनं ध्यानं भेदाभेदस्वरूपतः // 31
text_mt: he carries out the proper placement of mantras according to location, / the exhibition of seals, and visualization according to the nature of difference and non-difference. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
dehāsudhīvyomabhūṣu manasā tatra cārcanam /
japaṃ cātra yathāśakti devāyaitannivedanam // 32
meaning:
देहासुधीव्योमभूषु मनसा तत्र चार्चनम् /
जपं चात्र यथाशक्ति देवायैतन्निवेदनम् // 32
text_mt: There he mentally performs worship upon the body, breath, intellect, and internal space, / and recitation here according to capacity, offering this to the deity. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
tanmayībhāvasiddhyarthaṃ pratisandhyaṃ samācaret /
anye tu prāgudakpaścāddaśadikṣu catuṣṭayīm // 33
meaning:
तन्मयीभावसिद्ध्यर्थं प्रतिसन्ध्यं समाचरेत् /
अन्ये तु प्रागुदक्पश्चाद्दशदिक्षु चतुष्टयीम् // 33
text_mt: He should perform this at every twilight for the sake of attaining identification with That. / Others, however, speak of a group of four twilights in the east, north, west, and south, // 33

sanskrit_iast:
sandhyānāmāhuretacca tāntrikīyaṃ na no matam /
yāsau kālādhikāre prāk sandhyā proktā catuṣṭayī // 34
meaning:
सन्ध्यानामाहुरेतच्च तान्त्रिकीयं न नो मतम् /
यासौ कालाधिकारे प्राक् सन्ध्या प्रोक्ता चतुष्टयी // 34
text_mt: and this belongs to the Tantric system, not our doctrine. / Composing internally only that fourfold twilight which was explained earlier in the section on Time, // 34

sanskrit_iast:
tāmevāntaḥ samādhāya sāndhyaṃ vidhimupācaret /
sandhyācatuṣṭayīkṛtyamekasyāmathavā śiśuḥ // 35
meaning:
तामेवान्तः समाधाय सान्ध्यं विधिमुपाचरेत् /
सन्ध्याचतुष्टयीकृत्यमेकस्यामथवा शिशुः // 35
text_mt: he should perform the twilight rite; or the novice may perform the duty of the fourfold twilight / in a single one, devoted to sacred recitation, experiential knowledge, the guru's service, and the like. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātsvādhyāyavijñānagurukṛtyāditatparaḥ /
sandhyādhyānoditānantatanmayībhāvayuktitaḥ // 36
meaning:
कुर्यात्स्वाध्यायविज्ञानगुरुकृत्यादितत्परः /
सन्ध्याध्यानोदितानन्ततन्मयीभावयुक्तितः // 36
text_mt: Through application of the endless identification with That arising from the twilight visualization, / he remains indeed identified with That at all times by virtue of its imprint. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃskāravaśātsarvaṃ kālaṃ syāttanmayo hyasau /
tato yatheṣṭakāle'sau pūjāṃ puṣpāsavādibhiḥ // 37
meaning:
तत्संस्कारवशात्सर्वं कालं स्यात्तन्मयो ह्यसौ /
ततो यथेष्टकालेऽसौ पूजां पुष्पासवादिभिः // 37
text_mt: Then, at any desired time, the novice should perform worship with flowers, liquors, and the like / upon a prepared ground and so forth according to his wealth and capacity, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
sthaṇḍilādau śiśuḥ kuryādvibhavādyanurūpataḥ /
suśuddhaḥ sanvidhiṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvāntarajapāntakam // 38
meaning:
स्थण्डिलादौ शिशुः कुर्याद्विभवाद्यनुरूपतः /
सुशुद्धः सन्विधिं सर्वं कृत्वान्तरजपान्तकम् // 38
text_mt: being well purified, having performed the entire ritual up to the conclusion of the internal recitation. / The wise one, having prepared the vessel of oblations with his chosen mantra as before, // 38

sanskrit_iast:
arghapātraṃ purā yadvadvidhāya sveṣṭamantrataḥ /
tena sthaṇḍilapuṣpādi sarvaṃ saṃprokṣayedbudhaḥ // 39
meaning:
अर्घपात्रं पुरा यद्वद्विधाय स्वेष्टमन्त्रतः /
तेन स्थण्डिलपुष्पादि सर्वं संप्रोक्षयेद्बुधः // 39
text_mt: should sprinkle everything with it—the ground, flowers, and the rest. / Then, envisioning right there the sequence of doors, seat, and gurus, // 39

sanskrit_iast:
tatastatraiva saṃkalpya dvārāsanagurukramam /
pūjayecchivatāviṣṭaḥ svadehārcāpuraḥsaram // 40
meaning:
ततस्तत्रैव संकल्प्य द्वारासनगुरुक्रमम् /
पूजयेच्छिवताविष्टः स्वदेहार्चापुरःसरम् // 40
text_mt: filled with Śivahood, he should worship, preceded by the worship of his own body. / Then, beholding that prepared ground as clear as pure sky and crystal, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
tatastatsthaṇḍilaṃ vīdhravyomasphaṭikanirmalam /
bodhātmakaṃ samālokya tatra svaṃ devatāgaṇam // 41
meaning:
ततस्तत्स्थण्डिलं वीध्रव्योमस्फटिकनिर्मलम् /
बोधात्मकं समालोक्य तत्र स्वं देवतागणम् // 41
text_mt: having the nature of consciousness, he should see his own group of deities there / as a reflection, and through consciousness, as the original image. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
pratibimbatayā paśyedbimbatvena ca bodhataḥ /
etadāvāhanaṃ mukhyaṃ vyajanānmarutāmiva // 42
meaning:
प्रतिबिम्बतया पश्येद्बिम्बत्वेन च बोधतः /
एतदावाहनं मुख्यं व्यजनान्मरुतामिव // 42
text_mt: This is the principal invocation, just as of the wind by means of a fan. / Just as the wind, although omnipresent, becomes efficacious when drawn forth by a fan, // 42

sanskrit_iast:
sarvago'pi marudyadvadvyajanenopajīvitaḥ /
arthakṛtsarvagaṃ mantracakraṃ rūḍhestathā bhavet // 43
meaning:
सर्वगोऽपि मरुद्यद्वद्व्यजनेनोपजीवितः /
अर्थकृत्सर्वगं मन्त्रचक्रं रूढेस्तथा भवेत् // 43
text_mt: so the omnipresent wheel of mantras becomes [efficacious] through fixation. / This very reality is taught by the Catuṣkapañcāśikā, // 43

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkapañcāśikayā tadetattattvamucyate /
śrīnirmaryādaśāstre ca tadetadvibhunoditam // 44
meaning:
चतुष्कपञ्चाशिकया तदेतत्तत्त्वमुच्यते /
श्रीनिर्मर्यादशास्त्रे च तदेतद्विभुनोदितम् // 44
text_mt: and in the venerable Nirmaryādaśāstra this very thing was spoken by the Lord. / When asked: 'O God, the God Śiva is omnipresent and unconstrained; how is he invoked // 44

sanskrit_iast:
devaḥ sarvagato deva nirmaryādaḥ kathaṃ śivaḥ /
āvāhyate kṣamyate vetyevaṃpṛṣṭo'bravīdvibhuḥ // 45
meaning:
देवः सर्वगतो देव निर्मर्यादः कथं शिवः /
आवाह्यते क्षम्यते वेत्येवंपृष्टोऽब्रवीद्विभुः // 45
text_mt: or dismissed?', the Lord said: / 'O Goddess, latent impression is invoked, and latent impression is dismissed. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
vāsanāvāhyate devi vāsanā ca visṛjyate /
paramārthena devasya nāvāhanavisarjane // 46
meaning:
वासनावाह्यते देवि वासना च विसृज्यते /
परमार्थेन देवस्य नावाहनविसर्जने // 46
text_mt: In absolute truth, there is neither invocation nor dismissal of the God. / "The God has been invoked by me, established upon the ground, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhito mayā devaḥ sthaṇḍile ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
pūjitaḥ stuta ityevaṃ hṛṣṭvā devaṃ visarjayet // 47
meaning:
आवाहितो मया देवः स्थण्डिले च प्रतिष्ठितः /
पूजितः स्तुत इत्येवं हृष्ट्वा देवं विसर्जयेत् // 47
text_mt: worshipped, and praised"—rejoicing thus, one should dismiss the God. / Invocation and the like are indeed for producing satisfaction in unawakened living beings; // 47

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇināmaprabuddhānāṃ santoṣajananāya vai /
āvāhanādikaṃ teṣāṃ pravṛttiḥ kathamanyathā // 48
meaning:
प्राणिनामप्रबुद्धानां सन्तोषजननाय वै /
आवाहनादिकं तेषां प्रवृत्तिः कथमन्यथा // 48
text_mt: how else would their engagement occur? / In time, however, those engaged in the Lord's teaching understand // 48

sanskrit_iast:
kālena tu vijānanti pravṛttāḥ patiśāsane /
anukrameṇa devasya prāptiṃ bhuvanapūrvikām // 49
meaning:
कालेन तु विजानन्ति प्रवृत्ताः पतिशासने /
अनुक्रमेण देवस्य प्राप्तिं भुवनपूर्विकाम् // 49
text_mt: the gradual attainment of the God, beginning with the cosmic worlds, / their entire accumulation of ignorance destroyed by the radiance of the lamp of knowledge. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
jñānadīpadyutidhvastasamastājñānasañcayāḥ /
kuto vānīyate devaḥ kutra vā nīyate'pi saḥ // 50
meaning:
ज्ञानदीपद्युतिध्वस्तसमस्ताज्ञानसञ्चयाः /
कुतो वानीयते देवः कुत्र वा नीयतेऽपि सः // 50
text_mt: From where would the God be brought, or to where would he be taken? / For he resides everywhere through distinctions such as gross and subtle.' // 50

sanskrit_iast:
sthūlasūkṣmādibhedena sa hi sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ /
āvāhite mantragaṇe puṣpāsavanivedanaiḥ // 51
meaning:
स्थूलसूक्ष्मादिभेदेन स हि सर्वत्र संस्थितः /
आवाहिते मन्त्रगणे पुष्पासवनिवेदनैः // 51
text_mt: When the assembly of mantras has been invoked, propitiation must be made with offerings of flowers and liquor, / and with incenses, suited to the strength of faith and devotion. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpaiśca tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śraddhābhaktibalocitaiḥ /
dīptānāṃ śaktinādādimantrāṇāmāsavaiḥ palaiḥ // 52
meaning:
धूपैश्च तर्पणं कार्यं श्रद्धाभक्तिबलोचितैः /
दीप्तानां शक्तिनादादिमन्त्राणामासवैः पलैः // 52
text_mt: Propitiation of the blazing mantras of Śakti, Nāda, and the rest is performed first with liquors, flesh, / and blood, and afterwards with the elaborate offerings of flowers, incense, and the like. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
raktaiḥ prāk tarpaṇa paścāt puṣpadhūpādivistaraiḥ /
āgatasya tu mantrasya na kuryāttarpaṇaṃ yadi // 53
meaning:
रक्तैः प्राक् तर्पण पश्चात् पुष्पधूपादिविस्तरैः /
आगतस्य तु मन्त्रस्य न कुर्यात्तर्पणं यदि // 53
text_mt: If one does not perform the propitiation of the arrived mantra, // 53

sanskrit_iast:
haratyardhaśarīraṃ sa ityuktaṃ kila śambhunā /
yadyadevāsya manasi vikāsitvaṃ prayacchati // 54
meaning:
हरत्यर्धशरीरं स इत्युक्तं किल शम्भुना /
यद्यदेवास्य मनसि विकासित्वं प्रयच्छति // 54
text_mt: ‘He takes away half of [that person's] body’—so it is said by Śambhu. / Whatever brings about expansion in his mind, // 54

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva kuryātpūjāṃ sa iti śambhorviniścayaḥ /
sādhakānāṃ bubhukṣūṇāṃ vidhirniyatiyantritaḥ // 55
meaning:
तेनैव कुर्यात्पूजां स इति शम्भोर्विनिश्चयः /
साधकानां बुभुक्षूणां विधिर्नियतियन्त्रितः // 55
text_mt: with that very thing he should perform the worship: such is the determination of Śambhu. / For adepts desirous of enjoyment, the rule is bound by cosmic order (niyati); // 55

sanskrit_iast:
mumukṣūṇāṃ tattvavidāṃ sa eva tu nirargalaḥ /
kārye viśeṣamādhitsurviśiṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ spṛśet // 56
meaning:
मुमुक्षूणां तत्त्वविदां स एव तु निरर्गलः /
कार्ये विशेषमाधित्सुर्विशिष्टं कारणं स्पृशेत् // 56
text_mt: but for those desirous of liberation who know reality, that very rule is unhindered. / One who wishes to produce a particular effect should make use of a specific cause, // 56

sanskrit_iast:
raktakarpāsatūlecchustulyatadbījapuñjavat /
santi bhoge viśeṣāśca vicitrāḥ kāraṇeritāḥ // 57
meaning:
रक्तकर्पासतूलेच्छुस्तुल्यतद्बीजपुञ्जवत् /
सन्ति भोगे विशेषाश्च विचित्राः कारणेरिताः // 57
text_mt: just as one who desires red cotton wool [uses] a corresponding heap of its seeds. / In enjoyment there are indeed various distinctions prompted by causes, // 57

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālānusandhānaguṇadravyakriyādibhiḥ /
svalpā kriyā bhūyasī vā hṛdayāhlādadāyibhiḥ // 58
meaning:
देशकालानुसन्धानगुणद्रव्यक्रियादिभिः /
स्वल्पा क्रिया भूयसी वा हृदयाह्लाददायिभिः // 58
text_mt: through the integration of place and time, quality, substance, action, and the like. / An action, whether small or great, arranged by factors of action that give delight to the heart— // 58

sanskrit_iast:
bāhyaiḥ saṃkalpajairvāpi kārakaiḥ parikalpitā /
mumukṣorna viśeṣāya naiḥśreyasavidhiṃ prati // 59
meaning:
बाह्यैः संकल्पजैर्वापि कारकैः परिकल्पिता /
मुमुक्षोर्न विशेषाय नैःश्रेयसविधिं प्रति // 59
text_mt: whether external or born of mental intention— / makes no difference for the seeker of liberation with regard to the path to the highest good. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
nahi brahmaṇi śaṃsanti bāhulyālpatvadurdaśāḥ /
citaḥ svātantryasāratvāt tasyānandaghanatvataḥ // 60
meaning:
नहि ब्रह्मणि शंसन्ति बाहुल्याल्पत्वदुर्दशाः /
चितः स्वातन्त्र्यसारत्वात् तस्यानन्दघनत्वतः // 60
text_mt: For the defective conditions of abundance and deficiency are not praised in Brahman, / because consciousness has absolute autonomy as its essence, and because it is a mass of bliss. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
kriyā syāttanmayībhūtyai hṛdayāhlādadāyibhiḥ /
śivābhedabharādbhāvavargaḥ ścyotati yaṃ rasam // 61
meaning:
क्रिया स्यात्तन्मयीभूत्यै हृदयाह्लाददायिभिः /
शिवाभेदभराद्भाववर्गः श्च्योतति यं रसम् // 61
text_mt: Action should lead to identification with that, through things that give delight to the heart. / The nectar that the multitude of existent things exudes due to the weight of non-duality with Śiva, // 61

sanskrit_iast:
tameva parame dhāmni pūjanāyārpayedbudhaḥ /
stotreṣu bahudhā caitanmayā proktaṃ nijāhnike // 62
meaning:
तमेव परमे धाम्नि पूजनायार्पयेद्बुधः /
स्तोत्रेषु बहुधा चैतन्मया प्रोक्तं निजाह्निके // 62
text_mt: that very [nectar] the wise person should offer for worship in the supreme abode. / And this has been stated by me in many ways in the hymns in my own daily lesson: // 62

sanskrit_iast:
adhiśayya pāramārthikabhāvaprasaraprakāśamullasati /
yā paramāmṛtadṛk tvāṃ tayārcayante rahasyavidaḥ // 63
meaning:
अधिशय्य पारमार्थिकभावप्रसरप्रकाशमुल्लसति /
या परमामृतदृक् त्वां तयार्चयन्ते रहस्यविदः // 63
text_mt: ‘Resting upon the radiance of the expansion of ultimate reality, there flashes forth / that vision of supreme nectar, with which the knowers of the secret worship you.’ // 63

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ /
ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye'harniśam // 64
meaning:
कृत्वाधारधरां चमत्कृतिरसप्रोक्षाक्षणक्षालितामात्तैर्मानसतः स्वभावकुसुमैः स्वामोदसन्दोहिभिः /
आनन्दामृतनिर्भरस्वहृदयानर्घार्घपात्रक्रमात् त्वां देव्या सह देहदेवसदने देवार्चयेऽहर्निशम् // 64
text_mt: ‘Having made the ground of the support washed in an instant by the sprinkling of the juice of wonder, with flowers of one's own nature gathered from the mind and abounding in their own fragrance, / by means of an unpriced vessel of oblations that is one's own heart filled with the nectar of bliss, O God, along with the Goddess, I worship you day and night in the temple of the body.’ // 64

sanskrit_iast:
nānāsvādarasāmimāṃ trijagatīṃ hṛccakrayantrārpitāmūrdhvādhyastavivekagauravabharānniṣpīḍya niḥṣyanditam /
yatsaṃvitparamāmṛtaṃ mṛtijarājanmāpahaṃ jṛmbhate tena tvāṃ haviṣā pareṇa parame saṃtarpaye'harniśam // 65
meaning:
नानास्वादरसामिमां त्रिजगतीं हृच्चक्रयन्त्रार्पितामूर्ध्वाध्यस्तविवेकगौरवभरान्निष्पीड्य निःष्यन्दितम् /
यत्संवित्परमामृतं मृतिजराजन्मापहं जृम्भते तेन त्वां हविषा परेण परमे संतर्पयेऽहर्निशम् // 65
text_mt: ‘Having placed this threefold world, rich in flavors of diverse tastes, into the press of the heart-wheel, and having squeezed it out under the crushing weight of discernment placed above it, / whatever supreme nectar of consciousness unfolds, dispelling death, old age, and birth, with that supreme offering I satiate you day and night in the Supreme, [O Lord]!’ // 65

sanskrit_iast:
iti ślokatrayopāttamarthamantarvibhāvayan /
yena kenāpi bhāvena tarpayeddevatāgaṇam // 66
meaning:
इति श्लोकत्रयोपात्तमर्थमन्तर्विभावयन् /
येन केनापि भावेन तर्पयेद्देवतागणम् // 66
text_mt: Contemplating internally the meaning conveyed by these three verses, / one should satisfy the host of deities through any state whatsoever. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāṃ pradarśayetpaścānmanasā vāpi yogataḥ /
vacasā mantrayogena vapuṣā saṃniveśataḥ // 67
meaning:
मुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत्पश्चान्मनसा वापि योगतः /
वचसा मन्त्रयोगेन वपुषा संनिवेशतः // 67
text_mt: Afterwards he should show the mudrā, either with the mind through yogic union, / or with speech through the union of mantra, or with the body through posture. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā japaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ devatāyai samarpayet /
taccoktaṃ kartṛtātattvanirūpaṇavidhau purā // 68
meaning:
कृत्वा जपं ततः सर्वं देवतायै समर्पयेत् /
तच्चोक्तं कर्तृतातत्त्वनिरूपणविधौ पुरा // 68
text_mt: Having performed recitation, he should then surrender everything to the deity. / And that was spoken of previously in the chapter setting forth the reality of agency. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
tato visarjanaṃ kāryaṃ bodhaikātmyaprayogataḥ /
kṛtvā vā vahnigāṃ mantratṛptiṃ proktavidhānataḥ // 69
meaning:
ततो विसर्जनं कार्यं बोधैकात्म्यप्रयोगतः /
कृत्वा वा वह्निगां मन्त्रतृप्तिं प्रोक्तविधानतः // 69
text_mt: Then the dismissal must be performed through the application of unity with awareness, / or having performed the satisfaction of mantras entering the fire according to the prescribed rule. // 69

sanskrit_iast:
dvārapīṭhaguruvrātasamarpitanivedanāt /
ṛte'nyatsvayamaśnīyādagādhe'mbhasyatha kṣipet // 70
meaning:
द्वारपीठगुरुव्रातसमर्पितनिवेदनात् /
ऋतेऽन्यत्स्वयमश्नीयादगाधेऽम्भस्यथ क्षिपेत् // 70
text_mt: Except for the offering made to the doorway, the seat, and the assembly of gurus, / he should eat the rest himself, or cast it into deep water. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇino jalajāḥ pūrvadīkṣitāḥ śambhunā svayam /
vidhinā bhāvinā śrīmanmīnanāthāvatāriṇā // 71
meaning:
प्राणिनो जलजाः पूर्वदीक्षिताः शम्भुना स्वयम् /
विधिना भाविना श्रीमन्मीननाथावतारिणा // 71
text_mt: Living beings born in water were previously initiated by Śambhu himself / through the prospective rite when he descended as the illustrious Mīnanātha. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
mārjāramūṣikādyairyadadīkṣaiścāpi bhakṣitam /
tacchaṅkātaṅkadānena vyādhaye narakāya ca // 72
meaning:
मार्जारमूषिकाद्यैर्यददीक्षैश्चापि भक्षितम् /
तच्छङ्कातङ्कदानेन व्याधये नरकाय च // 72
text_mt: Whatever is eaten by uninitiated creatures such as cats and mice, / that, by producing the anguish of doubt, leads to disease and hell. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
atastattvavidā dhvastaśaṅkātaṅko'pi paṇḍitaḥ /
prakaṭaṃ nedṛśaṃ kuryāllokānugrahavāñchayā // 73
meaning:
अतस्तत्त्वविदा ध्वस्तशङ्कातङ्कोऽपि पण्डितः /
प्रकटं नेदृशं कुर्याल्लोकानुग्रहवाञ्छया // 73
text_mt: Therefore the learned person who knows reality, even though his anguish of doubt is destroyed, / should not do such a thing openly, out of a desire to show grace to the world. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanmatamahāśāstre taduktaṃ vibhunā svayam /
svayaṃ tu śaṅkāsaṅkocaniṣkāsanaparāyaṇaḥ // 74
meaning:
श्रीमन्मतमहाशास्त्रे तदुक्तं विभुना स्वयम् /
स्वयं तु शङ्कासङ्कोचनिष्कासनपरायणः // 74
text_mt: In the illustrious Matamahāśāstra that has been stated by the all-pervading Lord himself. / But he himself, devoted to expelling the contraction of doubt, // 74

sanskrit_iast:
bhavettathā yathānyeṣāṃ śaṅkā no manasi sphuret /
mārjayitvā tataḥ snānaṃ puṣpeṇātha prapūjayet // 75
meaning:
भवेत्तथा यथान्येषां शङ्का नो मनसि स्फुरेत् /
मार्जयित्वा ततः स्नानं पुष्पेणाथ प्रपूजयेत् // 75
text_mt: should be such that doubt does not flash forth in the minds of others. / Then, having cleansed [the place], taking a bath, he should worship with a flower. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpādi sarvaṃ tatsthaṃ tadagādhāmbhasi nikṣipet /
uktaḥ sthaṇḍilayāgo'yaṃ nityakarmaṇi śambhunā // 76
meaning:
पुष्पादि सर्वं तत्स्थं तदगाधाम्भसि निक्षिपेत् /
उक्तः स्थण्डिलयागोऽयं नित्यकर्मणि शम्भुना // 76
text_mt: He should cast everything situated there, such as flowers, into deep water. / This ground sacrifice in the daily ritual has been taught by Śambhu. // 76

sanskrit_iast: athocyate liṅgapūjā sūcitā mālinīmate // 1
meaning: अथोच्यते लिङ्गपूजा सूचिता मालिनीमते // 1
text_mt: Now the worship of the liṅga indicated in the Mālinī doctrine is explained. // 1b
title: Liṅgārcāprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
eteṣāmūrdhvaśāstroktamantrāṇāṃ na pratiṣṭhitam /
bahiṣkuryāttato hyete rahasyatvena siddhidāḥ // 2
meaning:
एतेषामूर्ध्वशास्त्रोक्तमन्त्राणां न प्रतिष्ठितम् /
बहिष्कुर्यात्ततो ह्येते रहस्यत्वेन सिद्धिदाः // 2
text_mt: One should not externalize the consecration of these mantras spoken in the superior teachings; / for these bestow spiritual accomplishment by virtue of their secret nature. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
svavīryānandamāhātmyapraveśavaśaśālinīm /
ye siddhiṃ dadate teṣāṃ bāhyatvaṃ rūpavicyutiḥ // 3
meaning:
स्ववीर्यानन्दमाहात्म्यप्रवेशवशशालिनीम् /
ये सिद्धिं ददते तेषां बाह्यत्वं रूपविच्युतिः // 3
text_mt: For those [mantras] which grant spiritual accomplishment possessed of the mastery that enters the greatness of their own potency's bliss, / externalization is a loss of their true form. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
kiṃca coktaṃ samāveśapūrṇo bhoktrātmakaḥ śivaḥ /
bhogalāmpaṭyabhāgbhogavicchede nigrahātmakaḥ // 4
meaning:
किंच चोक्तं समावेशपूर्णो भोक्त्रात्मकः शिवः /
भोगलाम्पट्यभाग्भोगविच्छेदे निग्रहात्मकः // 4
text_mt: Moreover, it is said: Śiva is filled with immersion, having the nature of the enjoyer; / he partakes of attachment to enjoyment, and in the cessation of enjoyment he has the nature of restraint. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
śāntatvanyakkriyodbhūtajighatsāvṛṃhitaṃ vapuḥ /
svayaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ yena so'syābhoge vinaśyati // 5
meaning:
शान्तत्वन्यक्क्रियोद्भूतजिघत्सावृंहितं वपुः /
स्वयं प्रतिष्ठितं येन सोऽस्याभोगे विनश्यति // 5
text_mt: One who himself consecrates [an external form] when his body is augmented by hunger arising from the suppression of calm state, / perishes in the absence of enjoyment of this [deity]. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā /
śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ // 6
meaning:
उक्तं ज्ञानोत्तरायां च तदेतत्परमेशिना /
शिवो यागप्रियो यस्माद्विशेषान्मातृमध्यगः // 6
text_mt: And this was spoken by the Supreme Lord in the Jñānottarā: / ‘Because Śiva is fond of sacrifice, especially when situated in the midst of the Mothers, // 6

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādrahasyaśāstreṣu ye mantrāstānbudho bahiḥ /
na pratiṣṭhāpayejjātu viśeṣādvyaktarūpiṇaḥ // 7
meaning:
तस्माद्रहस्यशास्त्रेषु ये मन्त्रास्तान्बुधो बहिः /
न प्रतिष्ठापयेज्जातु विशेषाद्व्यक्तरूपिणः // 7
text_mt: therefore, the mantras that are in the secret teachings, the wise person should never / consecrate externally, especially those that have a manifest form.’ // 7

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva mṛtasyārthe pratiṣṭhānyatra yoditā /
sātra śāstreṣu no kāryā kāryā sādhāraṇī punaḥ // 8
meaning:
अत एव मृतस्यार्थे प्रतिष्ठान्यत्र योदिता /
सात्र शास्त्रेषु नो कार्या कार्या साधारणी पुनः // 8
text_mt: Precisely for this reason, the consecration prescribed elsewhere for the deceased / should not be performed in these scriptures; the common [consecration], however, should be performed. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
ā tanmayatvasaṃsiddherā cābhīṣṭaphalodayāt /
putrakaḥ sādhako vyaktamavyaktaṃ vā samāśrayet // 9
meaning:
आ तन्मयत्वसंसिद्धेरा चाभीष्टफलोदयात् /
पुत्रकः साधको व्यक्तमव्यक्तं वा समाश्रयेत् // 9
text_mt: Until the accomplishment of identification with that, and until the arising of the desired fruit, / the spiritual son and the adept may resort to a manifest or unmanifest [liṅga]. // 9

sanskrit_iast:
putrakairgururabhyarthyaḥ sādhakastu svayaṃ vidan /
yadi tatsthāpayenno cettenāpyarthyo gururbhavet // 10
meaning:
पुत्रकैर्गुरुरभ्यर्थ्यः साधकस्तु स्वयं विदन् /
यदि तत्स्थापयेन्नो चेत्तेनाप्यर्थ्यो गुरुर्भवेत् // 10
text_mt: The guru is to be requested by spiritual sons, but the adept, knowing it himself, / may establish it; if not, the guru should be requested by him as well. // 10

sanskrit_iast:
guruścātra nirodhākhye kāla itthaṃ vibhau vadet /
jīvatyasminphalāntaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭherjīvāvadhīti vā // 11
meaning:
गुरुश्चात्र निरोधाख्ये काल इत्थं विभौ वदेत् /
जीवत्यस्मिन्फलान्तं त्वं तिष्ठेर्जीवावधीति वा // 11
text_mt: And in this [rite] called confinement, the guru should speak thus to the all-pervading Lord regarding time: / ‘While he lives, you should stay until the fruit is achieved,’ or ‘until the end of his life.’ // 11

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgaṃ ca bāṇaliṅgaṃ vā ratnajaṃ vātha mauktikam /
pauṣpamānnamatho vāstraṃ gandhadravyakṛtaṃ ca vā // 12
meaning:
लिङ्गं च बाणलिङ्गं वा रत्नजं वाथ मौक्तिकम् /
पौष्पमान्नमथो वास्त्रं गन्धद्रव्यकृतं च वा // 12
text_mt: And the liṅga may be a bāṇaliṅga, or made of jewel, or of pearl, / made of flowers, or of cooked food, or of cloth, or made of fragrant substances; // 12

sanskrit_iast:
natu pāṣāṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ śilpyutthaṃ parikalpayet /
dhātūtthaṃ ca suvarṇotthavarjamanyadvivarjayet // 13
meaning:
नतु पाषाणजं लिङ्गं शिल्प्युत्थं परिकल्पयेत् /
धातूत्थं च सुवर्णोत्थवर्जमन्यद्विवर्जयेत् // 13
text_mt: but one should not fashion a stone liṅga produced by a sculptor, / and as for that produced from metals, one should avoid all except that made of gold. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
na cātra liṅgamānādi kvacidapyupayujyate /
udāravīryairmantrairyadbhāsitaṃ phaladaṃ hi tat // 14
meaning:
न चात्र लिङ्गमानादि क्वचिदप्युपयुज्यते /
उदारवीर्यैर्मन्त्रैर्यद्भासितं फलदं हि तत् // 14
text_mt: Nor is the measurement or the like of the liṅga useful anywhere here; / for whatever is illumined by mantras of noble potency indeed yields fruit. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpi sthaṇḍilādyuktavidhinā śuddhimācaret /
mantrārpaṇaṃ tathaiva syānnirodhastūktayuktitaḥ // 15
meaning:
तस्यापि स्थण्डिलाद्युक्तविधिना शुद्धिमाचरेत् /
मन्त्रार्पणं तथैव स्यान्निरोधस्तूक्तयुक्तितः // 15
text_mt: One should perform its purification as well according to the rule taught for the bare ground and the rest; / the assignment of mantras is likewise, but confinement is according to the stated method. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
agnau ca tarpaṇaṃ bhūriviśeṣāddakṣiṇā guroḥ /
dīnāditṛptirvibhavādyāga ityadhiko vidhiḥ // 16
meaning:
अग्नौ च तर्पणं भूरिविशेषाद्दक्षिणा गुरोः /
दीनादितृप्तिर्विभवाद्याग इत्यधिको विधिः // 16
text_mt: Abundant satisfaction in the fire, especially a sacrificial fee for the guru, / and the satisfaction of the poor and others according to wealth: this is the additional rule for the sacrifice. // 16

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣvavyaktaliṅgeṣu pradhānaṃ syādakalpitam /
tathā ca tatra tatroktaṃ lakṣaṇe pārameśvare // 17
meaning:
सर्वेष्वव्यक्तलिङ्गेषु प्रधानं स्यादकल्पितम् /
तथा च तत्र तत्रोक्तं लक्षणे पारमेश्वरे // 17
text_mt: Among all unmanifest liṅgas, the unconstructed is principal. / And so it is declared in various places in the characteristics of the Supreme Lord: // 17

sanskrit_iast:
sūtre pātre dhvaje vastre svayambhūbāṇapūjite /
nadīprasravaṇotthe ca nāhvānaṃ nāpi kalpanā // 18
meaning:
सूत्रे पात्रे ध्वजे वस्त्रे स्वयम्भूबाणपूजिते /
नदीप्रस्रवणोत्थे च नाह्वानं नापि कल्पना // 18
text_mt: In a thread, a vessel, a banner, a cloth, in that which is self-manifest and worshipped as a bāṇa, / and in that arising from a river or a mountain torrent, there is neither invocation nor fashioning, // 18

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhaprasādamantrāṃśavelādiniyamo naca /
vyaktaṃ vā citrapustādau devadārusuvarṇajam // 19
meaning:
पीठप्रसादमन्त्रांशवेलादिनियमो नच /
व्यक्तं वा चित्रपुस्तादौ देवदारुसुवर्णजम् // 19
text_mt: nor is there any rule regarding the seat, the sanctum, parts of mantras, time, and so forth. / Or [it may be] a manifest [image] in a painting, a manuscript, and the like, or made of deodar wood or gold. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
atha dīkṣitasacchilpikṛtaṃ sthāpayate guruḥ /
athavā lakṣaṇopetamūrdhatatkarparāśritam // 20
meaning:
अथ दीक्षितसच्छिल्पिकृतं स्थापयते गुरुः /
अथवा लक्षणोपेतमूर्धतत्कर्पराश्रितम् // 20
text_mt: Now, the guru establishes [an image] made by an initiated, good sculptor; / or, endowed with the characteristics, placed upon an upper skull, // 20

sanskrit_iast:
paṅkticakrakaśūlābjavidhinā tūramāśrayet /
tallakṣaṇaṃ bruve śrīmatpicuśāstre nirūpitam // 21
meaning:
पङ्क्तिचक्रकशूलाब्जविधिना तूरमाश्रयेत् /
तल्लक्षणं ब्रुवे श्रीमत्पिचुशास्त्रे निरूपितम् // 21
text_mt: he should resort to the tūra according to the rule of the series, cakra, trident, and lotus. / I shall explain its characteristics as set forth in the venerable Picu scripture. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
tūre yogaḥ sadā śastaḥ siddhido doṣavarjite /
jālakairjarjarai randhrairdantairūnādhikai rujā // 22
meaning:
तूरे योगः सदा शस्तः सिद्धिदो दोषवर्जिते /
जालकैर्जर्जरै रन्ध्रैर्दन्तैरूनाधिकै रुजा // 22
text_mt: the use of a skull-cup is always praised when free of defects, granting accomplishment; / but if the skull-cup is accompanied by webs of cracks, holes, deficient or excess teeth, or disease, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
yukte ca tūre hāniḥ syāt taddhīne yāga uttamaḥ /
kāmya eva bhavettūramiti kecitprapedire // 23
meaning:
युक्ते च तूरे हानिः स्यात् तद्धीने याग उत्तमः /
काम्य एव भवेत्तूरमिति केचित्प्रपेदिरे // 23
text_mt: there would be harm; without those, the sacrifice is highest. / Some have maintained that the skull-cup is used only for optional rites. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti /
vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ // 24
meaning:
गुरवस्तु विधौ काम्ये यत्नाद्दोषांस्त्यजेदिति /
व्याचक्षते पिचुप्रोक्तं न नित्ये कर्मणीत्यदः // 24
text_mt: The gurus, however, explain that the instruction taught in the Picu— / that one should diligently avoid flaws in desire-driven rites—does not apply to obligatory rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsiddhātantra uktaṃ ca tūralakṣaṇamuttamam /
ekādikacatuṣkhaṇḍe gomukhe pūrṇacandrake // 25
meaning:
श्रीसिद्धातन्त्र उक्तं च तूरलक्षणमुत्तमम् /
एकादिकचतुष्खण्डे गोमुखे पूर्णचन्द्रके // 25
text_mt: And in the venerable Siddhātantra the excellent characteristics of the trumpet-shell are taught: / having one to four segments, shaped like a cow's mouth, like the full moon,

sanskrit_iast:
padmagorocanāmuktānīrasphaṭikasaṃnibhe /
ekādipañcasadrandhravidyārekhānvite śubhe // 26
meaning:
पद्मगोरोचनामुक्तानीरस्फटिकसंनिभे /
एकादिपञ्चसद्रन्ध्रविद्यारेखान्विते शुभे // 26
text_mt: resembling a lotus, bile-pigment, pearl, water, or crystal, / endowed with auspicious विद्या-lines having one to five good perforations,

sanskrit_iast:
na rūkṣavakraśakaladīrghanimnasabinduke /
ślakṣṇayā vajrasūcyātra sphuṭaṃ devīgaṇānvitam // 27
meaning:
न रूक्षवक्रशकलदीर्घनिम्नसबिन्दुके /
श्लक्ष्णया वज्रसूच्यात्र स्फुटं देवीगणान्वितम् // 27
text_mt: free from roughness, crookedness, chipped pieces, excessive length, hollows, or dark spots. / With a smooth diamond needle one should clearly inscribe here, along with the retinue of goddesses,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ samālikhetpūjyaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram /
etadevānusartavyamarghapātre'pi lakṣaṇam // 28
meaning:
सर्वं समालिखेत्पूज्यं सर्वावयवसुन्दरम् /
एतदेवानुसर्तव्यमर्घपात्रेऽपि लक्षणम् // 28
text_mt: all that is to be worshipped, beautiful in every limb. / This very same characteristic is to be observed for the vessel of offering.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībrahmayāmale'pyuktaṃ pātraṃ gomukhamuttamam /
gajakūrmatalaṃ kumbhavṛttaśaktikajākṛti // 29
meaning:
श्रीब्रह्मयामलेऽप्युक्तं पात्रं गोमुखमुत्तमम् /
गजकूर्मतलं कुम्भवृत्तशक्तिकजाकृति // 29
text_mt: In the venerable Brahmayāmala also the excellent vessel is stated to be shaped like a cow's mouth, / with a base like an elephant or a tortoise, and shaped like a round jar or a śaktikā-shell.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣasūtramatho kuryāttatraivābhyarcayetkramam /
vīradhātujalodbhūtamuktāratnasuvarṇajam // 30
meaning:
अक्षसूत्रमथो कुर्यात्तत्रैवाभ्यर्चयेत्क्रमम् /
वीरधातुजलोद्भूतमुक्तारत्नसुवर्णजम् // 30
text_mt: Next, one should make a rosary and worship the transmission on it alone: / made of [red] cinnabar, water-born pearls, jewels, or gold,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣasūtraṃ kramotkṛṣṭaṃ raudrākṣaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ /
śataṃ tithyuttaraṃ yadvā sāṣṭaṃ yadvā tadardhakam // 31
meaning:
अक्षसूत्रं क्रमोत्कृष्टं रौद्राक्षं वा विशेषतः /
शतं तिथ्युत्तरं यद्वा साष्टं यद्वा तदर्धकम् // 31
text_mt: the rosary is supreme in the transmission, or especially one of rudrākṣa beads: / one hundred and fifteen, or [one hundred] and eight, or half of that,

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhaṃ vātha pañcāśadyuktaṃ tatparikalpayet /
vaktrāṇi pañca citspandajñānecchākṛtisaṃgateḥ // 32
meaning:
तदर्धं वाथ पञ्चाशद्युक्तं तत्परिकल्पयेत् /
वक्त्राणि पञ्च चित्स्पन्दज्ञानेच्छाकृतिसंगतेः // 32
text_mt: or half of that [twenty-seven], or one should construct it endowed with fifty [beads]. / There are five faces, due to union with the vibration of consciousness, knowledge, will, and action;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadhādyantagaṃ caikyamityupāntyākṣago vidhiḥ /
śaktitadvatprabhedena tatra dvairūpyamucyate // 33
meaning:
पञ्चधाद्यन्तगं चैक्यमित्युपान्त्याक्षगो विधिः /
शक्तितद्वत्प्रभेदेन तत्र द्वैरूप्यमुच्यते // 33
text_mt: or unity at the beginning and the end in fivefold manner—such is the rule regarding the penultimate bead. / A duality is stated there according to the distinction of power and the possessor of power;

sanskrit_iast:
tato dviguṇamāne tu dvirūpaṃ nyāsamācaret /
tato'pi dviguṇe sṛṣṭisaṃhṛtidvitayena tam // 34
meaning:
ततो द्विगुणमाने तु द्विरूपं न्यासमाचरेत् /
ततोऽपि द्विगुणे सृष्टिसंहृतिद्वितयेन तम् // 34
text_mt: in the case of double the measure, one should perform a twofold placement; / in the case of double that again, [one should perform] it with the two pairs of emission and reabsorption.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha nyasyetkhaśarasaṃmite /
uttame tu dvayīṃ nyasyennyasya pūrvaṃ pracoditān // 35
meaning:
मातृकां मालिनीं वाथ न्यस्येत्खशरसंमिते /
उत्तमे तु द्वयीं न्यस्येन्न्यस्य पूर्वं प्रचोदितान् // 35
text_mt: Or one should place the Mātṛkā or Mālinī on [a rosary] of fifty [beads]; / but on the best one, one should place both pairs, having first placed those previously prescribed,

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāyāṃ mukhyato mantrāṃstānpañcadaśa daiśikaḥ /
yadi vā tattvabhuvanakalāmantrapadārṇajaiḥ // 36
meaning:
दीक्षायां मुख्यतो मन्त्रांस्तान्पञ्चदश दैशिकः /
यदि वा तत्त्वभुवनकलामन्त्रपदार्णजैः // 36
text_mt: the principal fifteen mantras in initiation, the master [should place]; / or if it is made with counts born from the principles, worlds, segments, mantras, words, and phonemes,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃkhyābhedaiḥ kṛte sūtre taṃ taṃ nyāsaṃ guruścaret /
kṛtvākṣasūtraṃ tasyāpi sarvaṃ sthaṇḍilavadbhavet // 37
meaning:
संख्याभेदैः कृते सूत्रे तं तं न्यासं गुरुश्चरेत् /
कृत्वाक्षसूत्रं तस्यापि सर्वं स्थण्डिलवद्भवेत् // 37
text_mt: the guru should perform each respective placement on the string made with these various counts. / Having made the rosary, everything for it too should be just as for the sacred ground;

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitena ca tenaiva japaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ /
vidhiruktastvayaṃ śrīmanmālinīvijayottare // 38
meaning:
पूजितेन च तेनैव जपं कुर्यादतन्द्रितः /
विधिरुक्तस्त्वयं श्रीमन्मालिनीविजयोत्तरे // 38
text_mt: and with that very [rosary] worshipped, one should perform recitation unweariedly. / This rule was taught in the venerable Mālinīvijayottara:

sanskrit_iast:
cakravadbhramayannetadyadvakti sa japo bhavet /
yadīkṣate juhotyetadbodhāgnau saṃpraveśanāt // 39
meaning:
चक्रवद्भ्रमयन्नेतद्यद्वक्ति स जपो भवेत् /
यदीक्षते जुहोत्येतद्बोधाग्नौ संप्रवेशनात् // 39
text_mt: Turning this like a wheel, whatever he speaks becomes recitation; / whatever he sees, he offers into the fire, because of entering into the fire of consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
athavārghamahāpātraṃ kuryāttaccottaraṃ param /
nārikelamatho bailvaṃ sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā // 40
meaning:
अथवार्घमहापात्रं कुर्यात्तच्चोत्तरं परम् /
नारिकेलमथो बैल्वं सौवर्णं राजतं च वा // 40
text_mt: Alternatively, one should make a great vessel of offering, which is supreme and excellent: / of coconut, or bilva fruit, or made of gold or silver.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvaḥ pratiṣṭhādau prakīrtitaḥ /
tanniṣkamparasaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvāsminpūjayetkramam // 41
meaning:
तस्याप्येष विधिः सर्वः प्रतिष्ठादौ प्रकीर्तितः /
तन्निष्कम्परसैः पूर्णं कृत्वास्मिन्पूजयेत्क्रमम् // 41
text_mt: All of this rule previously proclaimed for consecration and so forth applies to it as well. / Having filled it with unblemished sap, one should worship the transmission in it.

sanskrit_iast:
adhomukhaṃ sadā sthāpyaṃ pūjitaṃ pūjane punaḥ /
tatpātramunmukhaṃ tacca riktaṃ kuryānna tādṛśam // 42
meaning:
अधोमुखं सदा स्थाप्यं पूजितं पूजने पुनः /
तत्पात्रमुन्मुखं तच्च रिक्तं कुर्यान्न तादृशम् // 42
text_mt: It should always be kept turned downwards when worshipped; but at the time of worship / that vessel is turned upwards, and one should never leave such [a vessel] empty.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjānte tadrasāpūrṇamātmānaṃ pravidhāya tat /
adhomukhaṃ ca saṃpūjya sthāpayet vicakṣaṇaḥ // 43
meaning:
पूजान्ते तद्रसापूर्णमात्मानं प्रविधाय तत् /
अधोमुखं च संपूज्य स्थापयेत् विचक्षणः // 43
text_mt: At the end of the worship, having completely filled oneself with that sap, / the discerning one should worship it and place it turned downwards.

sanskrit_iast:
khaṅgaṃ kṛpāṇikāṃ yadvā kartarīṃ makuraṃ ca vā /
vimalaṃ tattathā kuryācchrīmatkālīmukhoditam // 44
meaning:
खङ्गं कृपाणिकां यद्वा कर्तरीं मकुरं च वा /
विमलं तत्तथा कुर्याच्छ्रीमत्कालीमुखोदितम् // 44
text_mt: Or a sword, a dagger, a pair of scissors, or a mirror, / flawless—one should make it just so, as taught in the venerable Kālīmukha.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībhairavakule'pyuktaṃ kulaparvaprapūjane /
sthaṇḍile'gnau paṭe liṅge pātre padme'tha maṇḍale // 45
meaning:
श्रीभैरवकुलेऽप्युक्तं कुलपर्वप्रपूजने /
स्थण्डिलेऽग्नौ पटे लिङ्गे पात्रे पद्मेऽथ मण्डले // 45
text_mt: It is also taught in the venerable Bhairavakula regarding the worship on Kula festival days: / 'On sacred ground, in fire, on cloth, on a liṅga, in a vessel, on a lotus, or in a maṇḍala,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtau ghaṭe'strasaṃghāte dhaṭe sūtre'tha pūjayet /
svena svenopacāreṇa saṅkaraṃ varjayediti // 46
meaning:
मूर्तौ घटेऽस्त्रसंघाते धटे सूत्रेऽथ पूजयेत् /
स्वेन स्वेनोपचारेण सङ्करं वर्जयेदिति // 46
text_mt: in an image, in a jar, in an array of weapons, in a balance, or on a cord, one should worship, / each with its own service, and one should avoid confusion.'

sanskrit_iast:
yathāpsu śāntaye mantrāstadvadastrādiṣu dhruvam /
śatrucchedādikartāraḥ kāmyo'taḥ saṅkarojjhitaḥ // 47
meaning:
यथाप्सु शान्तये मन्त्रास्तद्वदस्त्रादिषु ध्रुवम् /
शत्रुच्छेदादिकर्तारः काम्योऽतः सङ्करोज्झितः // 47
text_mt: Just as mantras in water are surely for pacification, so [in weapons] they effect the destruction of enemies and the like; / therefore, the desire-driven rite is free from confusion.

sanskrit_iast:
akāmasya tu te tattatsthānopādhivaśāddhruvam /
pāśakartanasaṃśuddhatattvāpyāyādikāriṇaḥ // 48
meaning:
अकामस्य तु ते तत्तत्स्थानोपाधिवशाद्ध्रुवम् /
पाशकर्तनसंशुद्धतत्त्वाप्यायादिकारिणः // 48
text_mt: For one free of desire, however, through the force of the conditions of each respective locus, they surely / effect the severing of bonds, the nourishment of purified principles, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā pustakaṃ tādṛgrahaḥśāstrakramombhitam /
suśuddhaṃ dīkṣitakṛtaṃ tatrāpyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ // 49
meaning:
अथवा पुस्तकं तादृग्रहःशास्त्रक्रमोम्भितम् /
सुशुद्धं दीक्षितकृतं तत्राप्येष विधिः स्मृतः // 49
text_mt: Alternatively, [one may worship] a book composed of the transmission of such secret scriptures, / thoroughly purified, made by an initiate; there too this rule is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ svayaṃpratiṣṭheṣu yāvadyāvatsthitirbhavet /
vibhavaistarpaṇaṃ śuddhistāvadvicchedavarjanam // 50
meaning:
इत्थं स्वयंप्रतिष्ठेषु यावद्यावत्स्थितिर्भवेत् /
विभवैस्तर्पणं शुद्धिस्तावद्विच्छेदवर्जनम् // 50
text_mt: In this way, as long as there is maintenance in things consecrated by oneself, / so long should there be propitiation with riches, purification, and the avoidance of interruption.

sanskrit_iast:
ata eva yadā bhūridinaṃ maṇḍalakalpanam /
tadā dine dine kuryādvibhavaistarpaṇaṃ bahu // 51
meaning:
अत एव यदा भूरिदिनं मण्डलकल्पनम् /
तदा दिने दिने कुर्याद्विभवैस्तर्पणं बहु // 51
text_mt: For this very reason, when the arrangement of the maṇḍala is for many days, / then day after day one should perform abundant propitiation with riches.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ ca sarvatra guruḥ pūrvoditaṃ param /
satattvamanusandhāya saṃnidhiṃ sphuṭamācaret // 52
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठायां च सर्वत्र गुरुः पूर्वोदितं परम् /
सतत्त्वमनुसन्धाय संनिधिं स्फुटमाचरेत् // 52
text_mt: And in consecration everywhere, the guru, having meditated upon the supreme / reality stated before, should distinctly effect the divine presence.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhe tu tanmayībhāve phale putrakasādhakaiḥ /
anyasmai taddvayādanyatarasmai tatsamarpyate // 53
meaning:
सिद्धे तु तन्मयीभावे फले पुत्रकसाधकैः /
अन्यस्मै तद्द्वयादन्यतरस्मै तत्समर्प्यते // 53
text_mt: When identity with That has been achieved as the fruit, it is surrendered by spiritual sons and adepts / to another, to either one of those two.

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ sarvastadalābhe tu sarvathā /
agādhe'mbhasi tatkṣepyaṃ kṣamayitvā visṛjya ca // 54
meaning:
तस्याप्येष विधिः सर्वस्तदलाभे तु सर्वथा /
अगाधेऽम्भसि तत्क्षेप्यं क्षमयित्वा विसृज्य च // 54
text_mt: For that [recipient] as well, all of this rule applies; but in the event of its complete absence, / having asked for forgiveness and dismissed it, it should be thrown into deep water.

sanskrit_iast:
ityeṣa svapratiṣṭhānavidhiḥ śivanirūpitaḥ /
parapratiṣṭhite liṅge bāṇīye'tha svayaṃbhuvi // 55
meaning:
इत्येष स्वप्रतिष्ठानविधिः शिवनिरूपितः /
परप्रतिष्ठिते लिङ्गे बाणीयेऽथ स्वयंभुवि // 55
text_mt: Thus this rule of self-consecration has been expounded by Śiva. / On a liṅga consecrated by another, or a Bāṇa-liṅga, or a self-manifested one,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamāsanapakṣe prāṅnyasya saṃpūjayetkramam /
śuddhāśuddhādhvajāḥ sarve mantrāḥ sarvaḥ śivāntakaḥ // 56
meaning:
सर्वमासनपक्षे प्राङ्न्यस्य संपूजयेत्क्रमम् /
शुद्धाशुद्धाध्वजाः सर्वे मन्त्राः सर्वः शिवान्तकः // 56
text_mt: having first placed everything on the seat, one should worship the transmission. / All mantras belonging to the pure and impure paths, and all ending with Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
adhvā cehāsane proktastatsarvatrārcayedidam /
āvāhanavisṛṣṭī tu tatra prāgvatsamācaret // 57
meaning:
अध्वा चेहासने प्रोक्तस्तत्सर्वत्रार्चयेदिदम् /
आवाहनविसृष्टी तु तत्र प्राग्वत्समाचरेत् // 57
text_mt: the path taught here upon the seat—all this one should worship everywhere; / but invocation and dismissal should be performed there as before.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ tantre'pyaghoreśe svacchande vibhunā tathā /
athavā pratyahaṃ proktamānārdhārdhaniyogataḥ // 58
meaning:
उक्तं तन्त्रेऽप्यघोरेशे स्वच्छन्दे विभुना तथा /
अथवा प्रत्यहं प्रोक्तमानार्धार्धनियोगतः // 58
text_mt: It is likewise taught by the Lord in the Tantra of Aghoreśa, the Svacchanda; / or, having made whatever desired maṇḍala every day

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtveṣṭaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tatra samastaṃ kramamarcayet /
bahuprakārabhinnasya liṅgasyārcā nirūpitā // 59
meaning:
कृत्वेष्टं मण्डलं तत्र समस्तं क्रममर्चयेत् /
बहुप्रकारभिन्नस्य लिङ्गस्यार्चा निरूपिता // 59
text_mt: according to the prescription of half-and-half portions taught [there], one should worship the whole transmission. / Thus the worship of the liṅga, divided into many kinds, has been expounded.

sanskrit_iast: iti nityavidhiḥ prokto naimittikamathocyate // 1
meaning: इति नित्यविधिः प्रोक्तो नैमित्तिकमथोच्यते // 1
text_mt: Thus the obligatory rite has been taught; now the occasional rite is explained.
title: Parvapavitrakādiprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
niyataṃ bhāvi yannityaṃ tadityasminvidhau sthite /
mukhyatvaṃ tanmayībhūtiḥ sarvaṃ naimittikaṃ tataḥ // 2
meaning:
नियतं भावि यन्नित्यं तदित्यस्मिन्विधौ स्थिते /
मुख्यत्वं तन्मयीभूतिः सर्वं नैमित्तिकं ततः // 2
text_mt: Since what is obligatory is that which is invariable, under this rule / primacy belongs to identity with That; therefore, everything is occasional.

sanskrit_iast:
dinādikalpanotthe tu naiyatye sarvanityatā /
dinamāsarkṣavarṣādinaiyatyāducyate tadā // 3
meaning:
दिनादिकल्पनोत्थे तु नैयत्ये सर्वनित्यता /
दिनमासर्क्षवर्षादिनैयत्यादुच्यते तदा // 3
text_mt: When regularity arises from the construction of days and so forth, there is universal obligatoriness; / it is called [obligatory] then because of the regularity of days, months, lunar mansions, years, and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaṅkitavyāvaśyantāsattākaṃ jātucidbhavam /
pramātraniyataṃ prāhurnaimittikamidaṃ budhāḥ // 4
meaning:
अशङ्कितव्यावश्यन्तासत्ताकं जातुचिद्भवम् /
प्रमात्रनियतं प्राहुर्नैमित्तिकमिदं बुधाः // 4
text_mt: That which has a presence occurring occasionally, whose inevitability is not to be doubted, / and which is not fixed to a [single] conscious subject, the wise declare to be occasional.

sanskrit_iast:
sandhyādi parvasaṃpūjā pavitrakamidaṃ sadā /
nityaṃ niyatarūpatvātsarvasmin śāsanāśrite // 5
meaning:
सन्ध्यादि पर्वसंपूजा पवित्रकमिदं सदा /
नित्यं नियतरूपत्वात्सर्वस्मिन् शासनाश्रिते // 5
text_mt: The twilight rites and the like, festival worship, and this Pavitraka are always / obligatory, because of having an invariable nature, for anyone who takes refuge in the teaching.

sanskrit_iast:
jñānaśāstragurubhrātṛtadvargaprāptayastathā /
tajjanmasaṃskriyābhedāḥ svajanmotsavasaṃgatiḥ // 6
meaning:
ज्ञानशास्त्रगुरुभ्रातृतद्वर्गप्राप्तयस्तथा /
तज्जन्मसंस्क्रियाभेदाः स्वजन्मोत्सवसंगतिः // 6
text_mt: Likewise, the acquisition of knowledge, scriptures, gurus, spiritual brothers, and their circle; / the various rites of passage of their birth, and arrival at the celebration of one's own birth;

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ vipatpratīkāraḥ pramodo'dbhutadarśanam /
yoginīmelakaḥ svāṃśasantānādyaiśca melanam // 7
meaning:
श्राद्धं विपत्प्रतीकारः प्रमोदोऽद्भुतदर्शनम् /
योगिनीमेलकः स्वांशसन्तानाद्यैश्च मेलनम् // 7
text_mt: ancestral rites, counteracting adversity, rejoicing, witnessing a wonder, / meeting of yoginīs, and meeting with one's own lineage, spiritual descendants, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
śāstravyākhyāpurāmadhyāvasānāni kramodayaḥ /
devatādarśanaṃ svāpnamājñā samayaniṣkṛtiḥ // 8
meaning:
शास्त्रव्याख्यापुरामध्यावसानानि क्रमोदयः /
देवतादर्शनं स्वाप्नमाज्ञा समयनिष्कृतिः // 8
text_mt: the beginning, middle, and end of expounding scriptures; the rise of the transmission; / vision of the deity in a dream; receiving a command; and expiation of rules.

sanskrit_iast:
iti naimittikaṃ śrīmattantrasāre nirūpitam /
trayoviṃśatibhedena viśeṣārcānibandhanam // 9
meaning:
इति नैमित्तिकं श्रीमत्तन्त्रसारे निरूपितम् /
त्रयोविंशतिभेदेन विशेषार्चानिबन्धनम् // 9
text_mt:
Thus the occasional [ritual] has been described in the venerable Tantrasāra,
classified into twenty-three types, as the basis for special worship. // 9

sanskrit_iast:
tatra parvavidhiṃ brūmo dvidhā parva kulākulam /
kulāṣṭakakṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ proktaṃ śrīyogasaṃcare // 10
meaning:
तत्र पर्वविधिं ब्रूमो द्विधा पर्व कुलाकुलम् /
कुलाष्टककृतं पूर्वं प्रोक्तं श्रीयोगसंचरे // 10
text_mt:
There we explain the rule for the festival day: the festival day is twofold, pertaining to Kula and Akula.
The first, produced by the eight Kulas, was taught in the venerable Yogasaṃcāra: // 10

sanskrit_iast:
abdhīndu munirityetanmāheśyā brahmasantateḥ /
pratipatpañcadaśyau dve kaumāryā rasavahniyuk // 11
meaning:
अब्धीन्दु मुनिरित्येतन्माहेश्या ब्रह्मसन्ततेः /
प्रतिपत्पञ्चदश्यौ द्वे कौमार्या रसवह्नियुक् // 11
text_mt:
[The tithis numbered] ocean (4), moon (1), and sage (7) belong to Māheśī of the Brahmā lineage;
the first and fifteenth belong to Kaumārī, joined with six (taste) and three (fire); // 11

sanskrit_iast:
abdhirakṣīndu vaiṣṇavyā aindryāstvastraṃ trayodaśī /
vārāhyā randhrarudrau dve caṇḍyā vasvakṣiyugmakam // 12
meaning:
अब्धिरक्षीन्दु वैष्णव्या ऐन्द्र्यास्त्वस्त्रं त्रयोदशी /
वाराह्या रन्ध्ररुद्रौ द्वे चण्ड्या वस्वक्षियुग्मकम् // 12
text_mt:
ocean (4), eyes (2), and moon (1) belong to Vaiṣṇavī; thirteen and weapon (14) belong to Aindrī;
nine (aperture) and eleven (Rudra) belong to Vārāhī; eight (Vasus) and pair of eyes (2) belong to Caṇḍī. // 12

sanskrit_iast:
dve dve tithī tu sarvāsāṃ yogeśyā daśamī punaḥ /
tasyā apyaṣṭamī yasmāddvitithiḥ sā prakīrtitā // 13
meaning:
द्वे द्वे तिथी तु सर्वासां योगेश्या दशमी पुनः /
तस्या अप्यष्टमी यस्माद्द्वितिथिः सा प्रकीर्तिता // 13
text_mt:
Two lunar days belong to each of all [the goddesses], but the tenth belongs to Yogeśī;
the eighth also belongs to her, because she is proclaimed to possess two lunar days. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
anyāścākulaparvāpi vaiparītyena lakṣitam /
kulaparveti tadbrūmo yathoktaṃ bhairave kule // 14
meaning:
अन्याश्चाकुलपर्वापि वैपरीत्येन लक्षितम् /
कुलपर्वेति तद्ब्रूमो यथोक्तं भैरवे कुले // 14
text_mt:
The other is the Akula festival, also characterized by contrast;
we explain that Kula festival as stated in the Bhairava Kula [tradition]. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
haiḍare trikasadbhāve trikakālīkulādike /
yo'yaṃ prāṇāśritaḥ pūrvaṃ kālaḥ proktaḥ suvistarāt // 15
meaning:
हैडरे त्रिकसद्भावे त्रिककालीकुलादिके /
योऽयं प्राणाश्रितः पूर्वं कालः प्रोक्तः सुविस्तरात् // 15
text_mt:
In the Haiḍara, the Trikasadbhāva, the Trikakālīkula, and similar texts,
that time which was previously described at great length as resting upon the vital breath— // 15

sanskrit_iast:
sa cakrabhedasaṃcāre kāṃcit sūte svasaṃvidam /
svasaṃvitpūrṇatālābhasamayaḥ parva bhaṇyate // 16
meaning:
स चक्रभेदसंचारे कांचित् सूते स्वसंविदम् /
स्वसंवित्पूर्णतालाभसमयः पर्व भण्यते // 16
text_mt:
that [time], moving through the piercing of the cakras, brings forth a certain awareness belonging to oneself;
the moment of attaining the fullness of one's own awareness is called a festival day. // 16

sanskrit_iast:
parva pūraṇa ityeva yadvā pṝ pūraṇārthakaḥ /
parvaśabdo niruktaśca parva tatpūraṇāditi // 17
meaning:
पर्व पूरण इत्येव यद्वा पॄ पूरणार्थकः /
पर्वशब्दो निरुक्तश्च पर्व तत्पूरणादिति // 17
text_mt:
"Festival day" (parvan) [derives from the root] 'parv' meaning filling, or from 'pṝ' meaning filling;
and the word 'parvan' is etymologized as 'parvan' because it fills that up. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
haiḍare'tra ca śabdo'yaṃ dvidhā nāntetaraḥ śrutaḥ /
taccakracāraniṣṇātā ye kecit pūrṇasaṃvidaḥ // 18
meaning:
हैडरेऽत्र च शब्दोऽयं द्विधा नान्तेतरः श्रुतः /
तच्चक्रचारनिष्णाता ये केचित् पूर्णसंविदः // 18
text_mt:
And here in the Haiḍara, this word is heard twofold, ending in 'n' and otherwise.
Whoever are skilled in the movement through that cakra, whose awareness is full, // 18

sanskrit_iast:
tanmelakasamāyuktāste tatpūjāparāḥ sadā /
yo'pyatanmaya eṣo'pi tatkāle svakramārcanāt // 19
meaning:
तन्मेलकसमायुक्तास्ते तत्पूजापराः सदा /
योऽप्यतन्मय एषोऽपि तत्काले स्वक्रमार्चनात् // 19
text_mt:
joined in assembly with them, are always dedicated to that worship.
Even one who is not yet identified with it, by worshipping according to his own sequence at that time, // 19

sanskrit_iast:
tadyoginīsiddhasaṅghamelakāt tanmayībhavet /
yathā prekṣaṇake tattaddraṣṭṛsaṃvidabheditām // 20
meaning:
तद्योगिनीसिद्धसङ्घमेलकात् तन्मयीभवेत् /
यथा प्रेक्षणके तत्तद्द्रष्टृसंविदभेदिताम् // 20
text_mt:
becomes identified with it through meeting with that assembly of Yoginīs and Siddhas.
Just as at a dramatic spectacle, one immediately attains oneness // 20

sanskrit_iast:
kramoditāṃ sadya eva labhate tatpraveśanāt /
yogābhyāsakramopāttāṃ tathā pūrṇāṃ svasaṃvidam // 21
meaning:
क्रमोदितां सद्य एव लभते तत्प्रवेशनात् /
योगाभ्यासक्रमोपात्तां तथा पूर्णां स्वसंविदम् // 21
text_mt:
with the consciousness of the various spectators that arises in sequence through immersion in it,
so they immediately attain their own full awareness, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
labhante sadya evaitatsaṃvidaikyapraveśanāt /
tatkālaṃ cāpi saṃvitteḥ pūrṇatvāt kāmadogdhṛtā // 22
meaning:
लभन्ते सद्य एवैतत्संविदैक्यप्रवेशनात् /
तत्कालं चापि संवित्तेः पूर्णत्वात् कामदोग्धृता // 22
text_mt:
which is acquired through the sequence of yoga practice, by entering into unity with that consciousness;
and at that time, because consciousness is full, it grants all desires. // 22

sanskrit_iast:
tena tattatphalaṃ tatra kāle saṃpūjayācirāt /
yathā ciropāttadhanaḥ kurvannutsavamādarāt // 23
meaning:
तेन तत्तत्फलं तत्र काले संपूजयाचिरात् /
यथा चिरोपात्तधनः कुर्वन्नुत्सवमादरात् // 23
text_mt:
Therefore, through worship at that time, one quickly obtains that respective fruit.
Just as a man who has long accumulated wealth, respectfully holding a festival, // 23

sanskrit_iast:
atithiṃ so'nugṛhṇāti tatkālābhijñamāgatam /
tathā suphalasaṃsiddhyai yoginīsiddhanāyakāḥ // 24
meaning:
अतिथिं सोऽनुगृह्णाति तत्कालाभिज्ञमागतम् /
तथा सुफलसंसिद्ध्यै योगिनीसिद्धनायकाः // 24
text_mt:
favors a guest who has arrived knowing that time,
likewise, for the complete accomplishment of good fruits, the leaders of Yoginīs and Siddhas, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
yatnavanto'pi tatkālābhijñaṃ tamanugṛhṇate /
uktaṃ ca tatra teneha kule sāmānyatetyalam // 25
meaning:
यत्नवन्तोऽपि तत्कालाभिज्ञं तमनुगृह्णते /
उक्तं च तत्र तेनेह कुले सामान्यतेत्यलम् // 25
text_mt:
even though requiring effort, favor him who knows that time.
And on this point it has been declared: "Therefore, enough of general rules here in Kula! // 25

sanskrit_iast:
yasya yaddhṛdaye devi vartate daiśikājñayā /
mantro yogaḥ kramaścaiva pūjanāt siddhido bhavet // 26
meaning:
यस्य यद्धृदये देवि वर्तते दैशिकाज्ञया /
मन्त्रो योगः क्रमश्चैव पूजनात् सिद्धिदो भवेत् // 26
text_mt:
Whatever resides in someone's heart by command of the spiritual guide,
whether mantra, yoga, or sequence, will bestow accomplishment through worship. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
kulācāreṇa deveśi pūjyaṃ siddhivimuktaye /
ye parvasveṣu deveśi tarpaṇaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ // 27
meaning:
कुलाचारेण देवेशि पूज्यं सिद्धिविमुक्तये /
ये पर्वस्वेषु देवेशि तर्पणं तु विशेषतः // 27
text_mt:
O Goddess of the gods, one should worship according to Kula practice for accomplishment and liberation.
Those who, on these festival days, O Goddess of the gods, especially [for] the offering of libations // 27

sanskrit_iast:
gurūṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca na kurvanti pramādataḥ /
durācārā hi te duṣṭāḥ paśutulyā varānane // 28
meaning:
गुरूणां देवतानां च न कुर्वन्ति प्रमादतः /
दुराचारा हि ते दुष्टाः पशुतुल्या वरानने // 28
text_mt:
to gurus and deities, do not perform it out of negligence,
they are ill-behaved, wicked, and equal to beasts, O lovely-faced one! // 28

sanskrit_iast:
abhāvānnityapūjāyā avaśyaṃ hyeṣu pūjayet /
aṭanaṃ jñānaśaktyādilābhārthaṃ yatprakīrtitam // 29
meaning:
अभावान्नित्यपूजाया अवश्यं ह्येषु पूजयेत् /
अटनं ज्ञानशक्त्यादिलाभार्थं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् // 29
text_mt:
Because daily worship is absent, one must certainly worship on these [days].
The wandering that is proclaimed for obtaining knowledge, power, and the like, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiyāgaśca yaḥ prokto vaśyākarṣaṇamāraṇam /
tatsarvaṃ parvadivaseṣvayatnenaiva siddhyati // 30
meaning:
शक्तियागश्च यः प्रोक्तो वश्याकर्षणमारणम् /
तत्सर्वं पर्वदिवसेष्वयत्नेनैव सिद्ध्यति // 30
text_mt:
and the sacrifice to the Śaktis that has been taught, subjugation, attraction, and killing—
all that is accomplished effortlessly on festival days." // 30

sanskrit_iast:
tatsāmānyaviśeṣābhyāṃ ṣoḍhā parva nirūpitam /
māsasyādyaṃ pañcamaṃ ca śrīdinaṃ paribhāṣyate // 31
meaning:
तत्सामान्यविशेषाभ्यां षोढा पर्व निरूपितम् /
मासस्याद्यं पञ्चमं च श्रीदिनं परिभाष्यते // 31
text_mt:
Through the general and the specific, the festival day is explained as sixfold:
the first and the fifth of the month are defined as "glorious days" (śrīdina). // 31

sanskrit_iast:
utkṛṣṭatvāt parvadinaṃ śrīpūrvatvena bhāṣyate /
samayo hyeṣa yadguptaṃ tannānupapadaṃ vadet // 32
meaning:
उत्कृष्टत्वात् पर्वदिनं श्रीपूर्वत्वेन भाष्यते /
समयो ह्येष यद्गुप्तं तन्नानुपपदं वदेत् // 32
text_mt:
Because of its pre-eminence, a festival day is designated with the prefix "śrī";
for this is the rule: one should not speak that which is secret without an honorific epithet. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
turyāṣṭamānyabhuvanacaramāṇi dvayorapi /
pakṣayoriha sāmānyasāmānyaṃ parva kīrtitam // 33
meaning:
तुर्याष्टमान्यभुवनचरमाणि द्वयोरपि /
पक्षयोरिह सामान्यसामान्यं पर्व कीर्तितम् // 33
text_mt:
The fourth, eighth, fourteenth (other world), and last (full/new moon) of both
fortnights are proclaimed here as the general-general festival day. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
yadeteṣu dineṣveva bhaviṣyadgrahabhātmakaḥ /
ubhayātmā viśeṣaḥ syāttatsāmānyaviśeṣatā // 34
meaning:
यदेतेषु दिनेष्वेव भविष्यद्ग्रहभात्मकः /
उभयात्मा विशेषः स्यात्तत्सामान्यविशेषता // 34
text_mt:
When on these very days there is a twofold specific feature
consisting of the coming planetary position and asterism, that is the general-specific nature. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
sā caikādaśadhaikasminnekasminvibhunoditā /
sajātīyā tu sotkṛṣṭetyevaṃ śambhurnyarūpayat // 35
meaning:
सा चैकादशधैकस्मिन्नेकस्मिन्विभुनोदिता /
सजातीया तु सोत्कृष्टेत्येवं शम्भुर्न्यरूपयत् // 35
text_mt:
And that was stated by the all-pervading Lord to be elevenfold in each single [month];
and that which belongs to the same class is superior: thus Śambhu explained. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇayugaṃ vahnisitaṃ śrutikṛṣṇaṃ vahnisitamiti pakṣāḥ /
arkendujīvacandrā budhayugmendvarkakaviguruvidhu syāt // 36
meaning:
कृष्णयुगं वह्निसितं श्रुतिकृष्णं वह्निसितमिति पक्षाः /
अर्केन्दुजीवचन्द्रा बुधयुग्मेन्द्वर्ककविगुरुविधु स्यात् // 36
text_mt:
The fortnights are: two dark, fire (3) bright, four (Vedas) dark, three (fire) bright.
[The weekdays] should be Sun, Moon, Jupiter, Moon, two Mercury, Moon, Sun, Venus, Jupiter, Moon. // 36

sanskrit_iast:
paraphalguścaitramaghe tiṣyaḥ prākphalgukarṇaśatabhiṣajaḥ /
mūlaprājāpatye viśākhikā śravaṇasaṃjñayā bhāni // 37
meaning:
परफल्गुश्चैत्रमघे तिष्यः प्राक्फल्गुकर्णशतभिषजः /
मूलप्राजापत्ये विशाखिका श्रवणसंज्ञया भानि // 37
text_mt:
The asterisms are designated as: Uttaraphālgunī, Citrā, Maghā, Puṣya, Pūrvaphālgunī, Śravaṇa (ear), Śatabhiṣaj,
Mūla, Rohiṇī (Prājāpatya), Viśākhā, and Śravaṇa. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
randhre tithyarkapare vasurandhre śaśivṛṣāṅkarasarandhrayugam /
prathamaniśāmadhyaniśe madhyāhnaśarā dinodayo madhyadinam // 38
meaning:
रन्ध्रे तिथ्यर्कपरे वसुरन्ध्रे शशिवृषाङ्करसरन्ध्रयुगम् /
प्रथमनिशामध्यनिशे मध्याह्नशरा दिनोदयो मध्यदिनम् // 38
text_mt:
On the ninth, fifteenth (lunar day), twelfth (sun), after that, eighth and ninth, Moon (1), Taurus-marked (11), six, and two nines;
the first part of the night, midnight, midday, five [ghaṭikās], sunrise, midday, // 38

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaniśeti ca samayo mārgaśiraḥprabhṛtimāseṣu /
kanyāntyajātha veśyā rāgavatī tattvavedinī dūtī // 39
meaning:
प्रथमनिशेति च समयो मार्गशिरःप्रभृतिमासेषु /
कन्यान्त्यजाथ वेश्या रागवती तत्त्ववेदिनी दूती // 39
text_mt:
and the first part of the night: this is the time in the months beginning with Mārgaśīrṣa.
A maiden, an outcaste woman, a courtesan, an impassioned woman, a messenger-consort knowing ultimate reality, // 39

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsasamāsāt kramaśaḥ pūjyāścakre'nuyāgākhye /
sarvatra ca parvadine kuryādanuyāgacakramatiśayataḥ // 40
meaning:
व्याससमासात् क्रमशः पूज्याश्चक्रेऽनुयागाख्ये /
सर्वत्र च पर्वदिने कुर्यादनुयागचक्रमतिशयतः // 40
text_mt:
should be worshipped in detail and in summary successively in the cakra called Anuyāga;
and everywhere on a festival day, one should especially perform the circle of the secondary sacrifice, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
guptāguptavidhānādiyāgacaryākrameṇa sampūrṇam /
anuyāgaḥ kila mukhyaḥ sarvasminneva karmaviniyoge // 41
meaning:
गुप्तागुप्तविधानादियागचर्याक्रमेण सम्पूर्णम् /
अनुयागः किल मुख्यः सर्वस्मिन्नेव कर्मविनियोगे // 41
text_mt:
complete according to the procedure of ritual practice, such as the concealed and unconcealed rules;
for the secondary sacrifice is primary in the application of every ritual. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
anuyāgakālalābhe tasmātprayateta tatparamaḥ /
bhagrahasamayaviśeṣo nāśvayuje ko'pi tena tadvarjam // 42
meaning:
अनुयागकाललाभे तस्मात्प्रयतेत तत्परमः /
भग्रहसमयविशेषो नाश्वयुजे कोऽपि तेन तद्वर्जम् // 42
text_mt:
Therefore, intent on that, one should strive to obtain the time of the secondary sacrifice.
In the month of Āśvayuja there is no specific asterism, planet, or time, so it is excluded. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
velābhagrahakalanā kathitaikādaśasu māseṣu /
phālgunamāse śuklaṃ yatproktaṃ dvādaśīdinaṃ parva // 43
meaning:
वेलाभग्रहकलना कथितैकादशसु मासेषु /
फाल्गुनमासे शुक्लं यत्प्रोक्तं द्वादशीदिनं पर्व // 43
text_mt:
The determination of the time-period, asterism, and planet is stated for the eleven months;
the festival proclaimed in the month of Phālguna is the twelfth day of the bright fortnight. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
agratithivedhayogo mukhyatamo'sau viśeṣo'tra /
divasaniśe kila kṛtvā tribhāgaśaḥ prathamamadhyamāparavibhāgaḥ // 44
meaning:
अग्रतिथिवेधयोगो मुख्यतमोऽसौ विशेषोऽत्र /
दिवसनिशे किल कृत्वा त्रिभागशः प्रथममध्यमापरविभागः // 44
text_mt:
The junction piercing the preceding lunar day is the most essential particularity here;
having divided the day and night each into three parts: the first, middle, and last parts, // 44

sanskrit_iast:
pūjākālastatra tribhāgite mukhyatamaḥ kālaḥ /
yadi saṃghaṭeta velā mukhyatamā bhagrahau tathā cakram // 45
meaning:
पूजाकालस्तत्र त्रिभागिते मुख्यतमः कालः /
यदि संघटेत वेला मुख्यतमा भग्रहौ तथा चक्रम् // 45
text_mt:
the time of worship among those tripartite divisions is the most primary time.
If the most primary time-period, asterism, planet, and cakra should coincide, // 45

sanskrit_iast:
tadyāga ādiyāgastatkāmyaṃ pūjayaiva parvasu siddhyet /
dinavelābhagrahakalpanena tatrāpi saumyaraudratvam // 46
meaning:
तद्याग आदियागस्तत्काम्यं पूजयैव पर्वसु सिद्ध्येत् /
दिनवेलाभग्रहकल्पनेन तत्रापि सौम्यरौद्रत्वम् // 46
text_mt:
that sacrifice is the primordial sacrifice; desired ends will be accomplished by worship alone on festival days.
Having known mildness and ferocity even there by determining the day, time-period, asterism, and planet, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
jñātvā sādhakamukhyastattatkāryaṃ tadā tadā kuryāt /
ukto yo'rcākālastaṃ cedullaṅghya bhagrahatithiḥ syāt // 47
meaning:
ज्ञात्वा साधकमुख्यस्तत्तत्कार्यं तदा तदा कुर्यात् /
उक्तो योऽर्चाकालस्तं चेदुल्लङ्घ्य भग्रहतिथिः स्यात् // 47
text_mt:
the foremost of adepts should perform each specific rite at each respective time.
If the lunar day with asterism and planet should transpire, transgressing the stated time of worship, // 47

sanskrit_iast:
tamanādṛtya viśeṣaṃ pradhānayetsāmayamiti kecit /
neti tvasmadguravo viśeṣarūpā hi tithiriha na velā // 48
meaning:
तमनादृत्य विशेषं प्रधानयेत्सामयमिति केचित् /
नेति त्वस्मद्गुरवो विशेषरूपा हि तिथिरिह न वेला // 48
text_mt:
disregarding that specific [astrological factor], one should prioritize the conventional time: so say some.
"Not so," say our gurus; for here the lunar day, not the time-period, constitutes the specific factor. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvedyarūpaśaśadharabhāgaḥ saṃvedakārkakaranikaraiḥ /
yāvānyāvati pūrṇaḥ sā hi tithirbhagrahaiḥ sphuṭībhavati // 49
meaning:
संवेद्यरूपशशधरभागः संवेदकार्ककरनिकरैः /
यावान्यावति पूर्णः सा हि तिथिर्भग्रहैः स्फुटीभवति // 49
text_mt:
To whatever extent the lunar portion, whose nature is the knowable, is filled
by the rays of the sun, whose nature is the knower: that lunar day is made manifest by asterisms and planets. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
tasmānmukhyātra tithiḥ sā ca viśeṣyā graharkṣayogena /
velātra na pradhānaṃ yuktaṃ caitattathāhi parameśaḥ // 50
meaning:
तस्मान्मुख्यात्र तिथिः सा च विशेष्या ग्रहर्क्षयोगेन /
वेलात्र न प्रधानं युक्तं चैतत्तथाहि परमेशः // 50
text_mt:
Therefore the lunar day is primary here, and it is qualified by conjunction with planets and asterisms;
the time-period is not primary here, and this is logical. For the Supreme Lord // 50

sanskrit_iast:
śrītrikabhairavakulaśāstreṣūce na parvadivaseṣu /
velāyogaṃ kaṃcana tithibhagrahayogato hyanyam // 51
meaning:
श्रीत्रिकभैरवकुलशास्त्रेषूचे न पर्वदिवसेषु /
वेलायोगं कंचन तिथिभग्रहयोगतो ह्यन्यम् // 51
text_mt:
in the venerable Trika, Bhairava, and Kula scriptures did not state for festival days
any conjunction of time-periods other than the conjunction of lunar day, asterism, and planet. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
tithistu pūjyā pradhānarūpatvāt /
śvetābhāve kṛṣṇacchāgālambhaṃ hi kathayanti // 52
meaning:
तिथिस्तु पूज्या प्रधानरूपत्वात् /
श्वेताभावे कृष्णच्छागालम्भं हि कथयन्ति // 52
text_mt:
The lunar day, however, must be honored because it is primary;
for they say that in the absence of a white goat, a black goat should be immolated. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
yatpunarūrmiprabhṛtini śāstre veloditāpi tatkāmyam /
mukhyatayoddiśya vidhiṃ tathāca tatra pauṣaparvadine // 53
meaning:
यत्पुनरूर्मिप्रभृतिनि शास्त्रे वेलोदितापि तत्काम्यम् /
मुख्यतयोद्दिश्य विधिं तथाच तत्र पौषपर्वदिने // 53
text_mt: Furthermore, what is taught as a proper time in scriptures such as the Ūrmi is desire-driven, / taking the primary rite as its aim; thus there, on the day of the Pauṣa festival,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvārcanamardhaniśi dhyātvā japtvā bahirgatasya yathā /
ādeśaḥ phalati tathā māghe cakrādvacaḥ phalati // 54
meaning:
कृत्वार्चनमर्धनिशि ध्यात्वा जप्त्वा बहिर्गतस्य यथा /
आदेशः फलति तथा माघे चक्राद्वचः फलति // 54
text_mt: having performed worship at midnight, meditated, and recited, just as an instruction bears fruit / for one who goes outside, so speech from the cakra bears fruit in Māgha.

sanskrit_iast:
acirādabhīṣṭasiddhiḥ pañcasu maitrī dhanaṃ ca melāpaḥ /
cakrasthāne krodhāt pāṣāṇasphoṭanena ripunāśaḥ // 55
meaning:
अचिरादभीष्टसिद्धिः पञ्चसु मैत्री धनं च मेलापः /
चक्रस्थाने क्रोधात् पाषाणस्फोटनेन रिपुनाशः // 55
text_mt: Soon comes the attainment of one's desired aim, friendship with five [people], wealth, and assembly [with Yoginīs]; / and at the site of the circle, destruction of enemies occurs by shattering a stone out of anger.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhādeśaprāptirmārgāntaṃ kathyate vibhunā /
bhagrahayogābhāve velāṃ tu titheravaśyamīkṣeta // 56
meaning:
सिद्धादेशप्राप्तिर्मार्गान्तं कथ्यते विभुना /
भग्रहयोगाभावे वेलां तु तिथेरवश्यमीक्षेत // 56
text_mt: The attainment of infallible prediction up to the end of the road is proclaimed by the all-pervasive Lord. / But in the absence of an astrological conjunction of asterism and planet, one must certainly examine the proper time of the lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
sā hi tathā sphuṭarūpā titheḥ svabhāvodayaṃ dadyāt /
bhagrahatithivelāṃśānuyāyi sarvāṅgasundaraṃ tu dinam // 57
meaning:
सा हि तथा स्फुटरूपा तिथेः स्वभावोदयं दद्यात् /
भग्रहतिथिवेलांशानुयायि सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरं तु दिनम् // 57
text_mt: For that [time], being thus manifest in form, grants the rise of the intrinsic nature of the lunar day. / A day that conforms to the asterism, planet, lunar day, and portion of time is beautiful in all its limbs;

sanskrit_iast:
yadi labhyeta tadāsminviśeṣatamapūjanaṃ racayet /
naca kāmyameva kevalametatparivarjane yataḥ kathitaḥ // 58
meaning:
यदि लभ्येत तदास्मिन्विशेषतमपूजनं रचयेत् /
नच काम्यमेव केवलमेतत्परिवर्जने यतः कथितः // 58
text_mt: if it is obtained, then on this [day] one should perform worship of the most exceptional kind. / Nor is this purely for a desired result, since it is stated that upon omitting it,

sanskrit_iast:
samayavilopaḥ śrīmadbhairavakula ūrmiśāstre ca /
duṣṭā hi durācārāḥ paśutulyāḥ parva ye na viduḥ // 59
meaning:
समयविलोपः श्रीमद्भैरवकुल ऊर्मिशास्त्रे च /
दुष्टा हि दुराचाराः पशुतुल्याः पर्व ये न विदुः // 59
text_mt: there is a breach of the rule in the venerable Bhairavakula and in the Ūrmiśāstra: / ‘Vile indeed are the ill-behaved, equal to bound souls, who do not know the junction-day!’

sanskrit_iast:
naca kāmyasyākaraṇe syājjātu pratyavāyitvam /
tatrānuyāgasiddhyarthaṃ cakrayāgo nirūpyate // 60
meaning:
नच काम्यस्याकरणे स्याज्जातु प्रत्यवायित्वम् /
तत्रानुयागसिद्ध्यर्थं चक्रयागो निरूप्यते // 60
text_mt: And there is never any guilt of transgression in not performing an optional rite. / For the sake of accomplishing the secondary sacrifice therein, the circle-sacrifice is expounded.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiyāga iti prokto yaḥ śrīyogīśvarīmate /
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ karma yadatroktaṃ maheśinā // 61
meaning:
मूर्तियाग इति प्रोक्तो यः श्रीयोगीश्वरीमते /
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं कर्म यदत्रोक्तं महेशिना // 61
text_mt: It is taught as the ‘sacrifice of forms’ in the venerable Yogīśvarīmata. / Whatever regular and occasional rite is taught here by the great Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra cakrayāgo'tra mukhyaḥ kāmye viśeṣataḥ /
jñānī yogī ca puruṣaḥ strī vāsminmūrtisaṃjñake // 62
meaning:
सर्वत्र चक्रयागोऽत्र मुख्यः काम्ये विशेषतः /
ज्ञानी योगी च पुरुषः स्त्री वास्मिन्मूर्तिसंज्ञके // 62
text_mt: in all [such cases] the circle-sacrifice here is primary, especially in an optional rite. / A man or a woman who is a knower and a yogi, in this [sacrifice] called ‘of forms’,

sanskrit_iast:
yoge prayatnato yojyastaddhi pātramanuttaram /
tatsaṃparkātpūrṇatā syāditi traiśirasādiṣu // 63
meaning:
योगे प्रयत्नतो योज्यस्तद्धि पात्रमनुत्तरम् /
तत्संपर्कात्पूर्णता स्यादिति त्रैशिरसादिषु // 63
text_mt: should be engaged with effort in yoga, for that indeed is the unexcelled vessel; / from contact with them fullness arises—thus [it is taught] in the Traiśirasa and other texts.

sanskrit_iast:
tena sarvaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram /
jñānine yogine vāpi yo dadāti karoti vā // 64
meaning:
तेन सर्वं हुतं चेष्टं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् /
ज्ञानिने योगिने वापि यो ददाति करोति वा // 64
text_mt: By him all has been offered into fire, and the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings have been worshipped, / whoever gives to a knower or a yogi, or performs [the rite for them].

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣottare'pi ca proktamannaṃ brahmā raso hariḥ /
bhoktā śiva iti jñānī śvapacānapyathoddhareat // 65
meaning:
दीक्षोत्तरेऽपि च प्रोक्तमन्नं ब्रह्मा रसो हरिः /
भोक्ता शिव इति ज्ञानी श्वपचानप्यथोद्धरेअत् // 65
text_mt: And in the Dīkṣottara it is taught: ‘Food is Brahmā, flavour is Hari, / the consumer is Śiva’—thus a knower may even liberate outcastes.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatattvamayo bhūtvā yadi bhuṅkte sa sādhakaḥ /
tena bhojitamātreṇa sakṛtkoṭistu bhojitā // 66
meaning:
सर्वतत्त्वमयो भूत्वा यदि भुङ्क्ते स साधकः /
तेन भोजितमात्रेण सकृत्कोटिस्तु भोजिता // 66
text_mt: If that adept eats, having become identified with all tattvas, / merely by his being fed, ten million [beings] are fed at once.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tattvavidetasminyadi bhuñjīta tat priye /
parisaṃkhyā na vidyeta tadāha bhagavāñchivaḥ // 67
meaning:
अथ तत्त्वविदेतस्मिन्यदि भुञ्जीत तत् प्रिये /
परिसंख्या न विद्येत तदाह भगवाञ्छिवः // 67
text_mt: Furthermore, if a knower of reality eats in this [rite], O dear one, / there is no counting [the merit]; so said the blessed Śiva:

sanskrit_iast:
bhojyaṃ māyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ śivo bhoktā sa cāpyaham /
evaṃ yo vai vijānāti daiśikastattvapāragaḥ // 68
meaning:
भोज्यं मायात्मकं सर्वं शिवो भोक्ता स चाप्यहम् /
एवं यो वै विजानाति दैशिकस्तत्त्वपारगः // 68
text_mt: ‘Everything to be eaten consists of Māyā; Śiva is the consumer, and he is I.’ / Whoever truly knows thus is a teacher who has crossed beyond reality.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devamāyāntaṃ krīḍantyoṣadhayo gṛhe /
nivṛttamadyaivāsmābhiḥ saṃsāragahanārṇavāt // 69
meaning:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवमायान्तं क्रीडन्त्योषधयो गृहे /
निवृत्तमद्यैवास्माभिः संसारगहनार्णवात् // 69
text_mt: Beholding that divine being arriving, the plants playing in the house [say]: / ‘We have turned back this very day from the impenetrable ocean of transmigratory existence!

sanskrit_iast:
yadasya vaktraṃ saṃprāptā yāsyāmaḥ paramaṃ padam /
anye'pānabhujo hyūrdhve prāṇo'pānastvadhomukhaḥ // 70
meaning:
यदस्य वक्त्रं संप्राप्ता यास्यामः परमं पदम् /
अन्येऽपानभुजो ह्यूर्ध्वे प्राणोऽपानस्त्वधोमुखः // 70
text_mt: Because, having reached his mouth, we shall go to the supreme state!’ / Others, indeed, are consumers of apāna upwards, but prāṇa and apāna [go] downwards.

sanskrit_iast:
tasminbhoktari deveśi dātuḥ kulaśatānyapi /
āśveva parimucyante narakādyātanārṇavāt // 71
meaning:
तस्मिन्भोक्तरि देवेशि दातुः कुलशतान्यपि /
आश्वेव परिमुच्यन्ते नरकाद्यातनार्णवात् // 71
text_mt: When he is the consumer, O Goddess of the gods, even hundreds of families of the giver / are quickly freed from the ocean of hellish torments and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmanniśāṭane'pyuktaṃ kathanānveṣaṇādapi /
śrotrābhyantarasaṃprāpte guruvaktrādvinirgate // 72
meaning:
श्रीमन्निशाटनेऽप्युक्तं कथनान्वेषणादपि /
श्रोत्राभ्यन्तरसंप्राप्ते गुरुवक्त्राद्विनिर्गते // 72
text_mt: In the venerable Niśāṭana also it is taught: ‘Even through reciting and searching [for it], / when it enters into the hearing, having issued from the guru's mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
muktastadaiva kāle tu yantraṃ tiṣṭhati kevalam /
surāpaḥ steyahārī ca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ // 73
meaning:
मुक्तस्तदैव काले तु यन्त्रं तिष्ठति केवलम् /
सुरापः स्तेयहारी च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः // 73
text_mt: he is liberated at that very moment; only the bodily mechanism remains behind. / Whether a drinker of liquor, a thief, a killer of a brahmin, a violator of the guru's bed,

sanskrit_iast:
antyajo vā dvijo vātha bālo vṛddho yuvāpi vā /
paryantavāsī yo jñānī deśasyāpi pavitrakaḥ // 74
meaning:
अन्त्यजो वा द्विजो वाथ बालो वृद्धो युवापि वा /
पर्यन्तवासी यो ज्ञानी देशस्यापि पवित्रकः // 74
text_mt: an outcaste or a twice-born, a child, an old man, or even a youth, / the knower who dwells at the boundary purifies even the country;

sanskrit_iast:
tatra saṃnihito devaḥ sadevīkaḥ sakiṅkaraḥ /
tasmātprādhānyataḥ kṛtvā guruṃ jñānaviśāradam // 75
meaning:
तत्र संनिहितो देवः सदेवीकः सकिङ्करः /
तस्मात्प्राधान्यतः कृत्वा गुरुं ज्ञानविशारदम् // 75
text_mt: in him is present the God accompanied by his Goddess and his attendants.’ / Therefore, having placed principally the guru who is skilled in knowledge,

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtiyāgaṃ carettasya vidhiryogīśvarīmate /
pavitrārohaṇe śrāddhe tathā parvadineṣvalam // 76
meaning:
मूर्तियागं चरेत्तस्य विधिर्योगीश्वरीमते /
पवित्रारोहणे श्राद्धे तथा पर्वदिनेष्वलम् // 76
text_mt: one should perform the sacrifice of forms. Its procedure in the Yogīśvarīmata [is applied] / at the investiture of the sacred thread, in the ancestral rite, as well as on all junction-days,

sanskrit_iast:
sūryacandroparāgādau laukikeṣvapi parvasu /
utsave ca vivāhādau viprāṇāṃ yajñakarmaṇi // 77
meaning:
सूर्यचन्द्रोपरागादौ लौकिकेष्वपि पर्वसु /
उत्सवे च विवाहादौ विप्राणां यज्ञकर्मणि // 77
text_mt: during eclipses of the sun and moon and the like, even during worldly festivals, / at celebrations, weddings, and the like, and in the sacrificial rites of brahmins,

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāyāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ samayānāṃ viśodhane /
kāmanārthaṃ ca kartavyo mūrtiyāgaḥ sa pañcadhā // 78
meaning:
दीक्षायां च प्रतिष्ठायां समयानां विशोधने /
कामनार्थं च कर्तव्यो मूर्तियागः स पञ्चधा // 78
text_mt: at initiation and consecration, and in the purification of vows. / And for the sake of desires, the sacrifice of forms must be performed; it is fivefold:

sanskrit_iast:
kevalo yāmalo miśraścakrayugvīrasaṅkaraḥ /
kevalaḥ kevalaireva gurubhirmiśritaḥ punaḥ // 79
meaning:
केवलो यामलो मिश्रश्चक्रयुग्वीरसङ्करः /
केवलः केवलैरेव गुरुभिर्मिश्रितः पुनः // 79
text_mt: solitary, dyadic, mixed, circle-joined, and hero-mingled. / The ‘solitary’ is with gurus alone; but the ‘mixed’ is

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakādyaiḥ sapatnīkairyāmalaḥ sa dvidhā punaḥ /
patnīyogāt krayānītaveśyāsaṃyogato'thavā // 80
meaning:
साधकाद्यैः सपत्नीकैर्यामलः स द्विधा पुनः /
पत्नीयोगात् क्रयानीतवेश्यासंयोगतोऽथवा // 80
text_mt: with adepts and others with their wives. The ‘dyadic’ is again of two kinds: / from union with a wife, or from union with a courtesan obtained by purchase.

sanskrit_iast:
cakriṇyādyāśca vakṣyante śaktiyogādyathocitāḥ /
tatsaṃyogāccakrayukto yāgaḥ sarvaphalapradaḥ // 81
meaning:
चक्रिण्याद्याश्च वक्ष्यन्ते शक्तियोगाद्यथोचिताः /
तत्संयोगाच्चक्रयुक्तो यागः सर्वफलप्रदः // 81
text_mt: The circle-women and others, appropriate according to their union with śaktis, will be described; / joined with them, the sacrifice is circle-joined, bestowing all fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaistu sahito yāgo vīrasaṅkara ucyate /
madhye gururbhavetteṣāṃ guruvargastadāvṛtiḥ // 82
meaning:
सर्वैस्तु सहितो यागो वीरसङ्कर उच्यते /
मध्ये गुरुर्भवेत्तेषां गुरुवर्गस्तदावृतिः // 82
text_mt: The sacrifice accompanied by all is called ‘hero-mingled’. / The guru should be in their centre, surrounded by the group of gurus.

sanskrit_iast:
tisra āvṛtayo bāhye samayyantā yathākramam /
paṅktikrameṇa vā sarve madhye teṣāṃ guruḥ sadā // 83
meaning:
तिस्र आवृतयो बाह्ये समय्यन्ता यथाक्रमम् /
पङ्क्तिक्रमेण वा सर्वे मध्ये तेषां गुरुः सदा // 83
text_mt: There are three outer circuits in order, ending with the initiates into the rule; / or all [may sit] in order of rows, with the guru always in their centre.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā tadgandhadhūpasraksamālambhanavāsasā /
pūjyaṃ cakrānusāreṇa tattaccakramidaṃ tviti // 84
meaning:
तदा तद्गन्धधूपस्रक्समालम्भनवाससा /
पूज्यं चक्रानुसारेण तत्तच्चक्रमिदं त्विति // 84
text_mt: Then with this scent, incense, garland, unguent, and cloth / each respective circle should be worshipped according to the circle, [thinking:] ‘This is that [deity].’

sanskrit_iast:
ekārake yathā cakre ekavīravidhiṃ smaret /
dvyare yāmalamanyatra trikamevaṃ ṣaḍasrake // 85
meaning:
एकारके यथा चक्रे एकवीरविधिं स्मरेत् /
द्व्यरे यामलमन्यत्र त्रिकमेवं षडस्रके // 85
text_mt: Just as in a one-spoked circle one should remember the rite of the Single Hero, / so in a two-spoked one [that of] the dyad, elsewhere the Trika, likewise in a six-cornered one

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍyoginīḥ saptakaṃ ca saptāre'ṣṭāṣṭake ca vā /
anyadvā tādṛśaṃ tatra cakre tādṛksvarūpiṇi // 86
meaning:
षड्योगिनीः सप्तकं च सप्तारेऽष्टाष्टके च वा /
अन्यद्वा तादृशं तत्र चक्रे तादृक्स्वरूपिणि // 86
text_mt: the six Yoginīs, and the heptad in a seven-spoked [circle], or in an eightfold-eight [group], / or whatever else is of such kind in a circle having such an intrinsic nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ pātre'lisaṃpūrṇe pūrvaṃ cakraṃ yajetsudhīḥ /
ādhārayukte nādhārarahitaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kvacit // 87
meaning:
ततः पात्रेऽलिसंपूर्णे पूर्वं चक्रं यजेत्सुधीः /
आधारयुक्ते नाधाररहितं तर्पणं क्वचित् // 87
text_mt: Then, in a vessel filled with liquor, the wise one should first worship the circle; / [the vessel must be] placed on a base; oblation is never [made] without a base.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāreṇa vinā bhraṃśo naca tuṣyanti raśmayaḥ /
pretarūpaṃ bhavetpātraṃ śāktāmṛtamathāsavaḥ // 88
meaning:
आधारेण विना भ्रंशो नच तुष्यन्ति रश्मयः /
प्रेतरूपं भवेत्पात्रं शाक्तामृतमथासवः // 88
text_mt: Without a base there is a fall, and the rays [of consciousness] are not satisfied; / the vessel would become of the nature of a corpse, whereas the liquor is the nectar of Śakti.

sanskrit_iast:
bhoktrī tatra tu yā śaktiḥ sa śambhuḥ parameśvaraḥ /
aṇuśaktiśivātmetthaṃ dhyātvā saṃmilitaṃ trayam // 89
meaning:
भोक्त्री तत्र तु या शक्तिः स शम्भुः परमेश्वरः /
अणुशक्तिशिवात्मेत्थं ध्यात्वा संमिलितं त्रयम् // 89
text_mt: The power that is the consumer therein is Śambhu, the supreme Lord. / Having thus meditated on the three united—the soul, power, and Śiva—

sanskrit_iast:
tatastu tarpaṇaṃ kāryamāvṛterāvṛteḥ kramāt /
pratisaṃcarayogena punarantaḥ praveśayet // 90
meaning:
ततस्तु तर्पणं कार्यमावृतेरावृतेः क्रमात् /
प्रतिसंचरयोगेन पुनरन्तः प्रवेशयेत् // 90
text_mt: the offering of libations must then be made in succession from circuit to circuit; / by means of reabsorption, he should cause [the libation] to enter within once more,

sanskrit_iast:
yāvadgurvantikaṃ taddhi pūrṇaṃ bhramaṇamucyate /
tatrādau devatāstarpyāstato vīrā iti kramaḥ // 91
meaning:
यावद्गुर्वन्तिकं तद्धि पूर्णं भ्रमणमुच्यते /
तत्रादौ देवतास्तर्प्यास्ततो वीरा इति क्रमः // 91
text_mt: up to the vicinity of the guru; that is called the complete circuit. / Therein the deities are to be offered libation first, and after them the heroes: such is the sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
vīraśca vīraśaktiścetyevamasmadgurukramaḥ /
tato'vadaṃśānvividhān māṃsamatsyādisaṃyutān // 92
meaning:
वीरश्च वीरशक्तिश्चेत्येवमस्मद्गुरुक्रमः /
ततोऽवदंशान्विविधान् मांसमत्स्यादिसंयुतान् // 92
text_mt: The hero and the hero's consort: such is the tradition of our guru. / Then the excellent adept should scatter in front various snacks

sanskrit_iast:
agre tatra pravikiret tṛptyantaṃ sādhakottamaḥ /
pātrābhāve punarbhadraṃ vellitāśuktimeva ca // 93
meaning:
अग्रे तत्र प्रविकिरेत् तृप्त्यन्तं साधकोत्तमः /
पात्राभावे पुनर्भद्रं वेल्लिताशुक्तिमेव च // 93
text_mt: accompanied by meat, fish, and the like, until satisfaction [is attained]. / In the absence of a vessel, the wise one should make the ‘auspicious’ [hand-gesture]

sanskrit_iast:
pātre kurvīta matimāniti siddhāmate kramaḥ /
dakṣahastena bhadraṃ syādvellitā śuktirucyate // 94
meaning:
पात्रे कुर्वीत मतिमानिति सिद्धामते क्रमः /
दक्षहस्तेन भद्रं स्याद्वेल्लिता शुक्तिरुच्यते // 94
text_mt: and the ‘rolled pearl-oyster’ into a vessel; such is the sequence in the Siddhā school. / The ‘auspicious’ is made with the right hand; the ‘rolled pearl-oyster’ is taught [as follows]:

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣahastasya kurvīta vāmopari kanīyasīm /
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogena dakṣādho vāmakāṅgulīḥ // 95
meaning:
दक्षहस्तस्य कुर्वीत वामोपरि कनीयसीम् /
तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठयोगेन दक्षाधो वामकाङ्गुलीः // 95
