text_mt: Therefore, in his transition to another body or the like, there is no assembly / of the senses in the subtle intermediate [body]; it becomes just like this [physical] body again. // 299

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ paraśarīrādicāriṇāmiva yoginām /
tattattattvaśarīrāntaścāriṇāṃ nāsti mūḍhatā // 300
meaning:
एवं परशरीरादिचारिणामिव योगिनाम् /
तत्तत्तत्त्वशरीरान्तश्चारिणां नास्ति मूढता // 300
text_mt: Thus, just as for yogins moving into another body and the like, / for those moving within the body of this or that reality there is no delusion. // 300

sanskrit_iast:
te cāpi dvividhā jñeyā laukikā dīkṣitāstathā /
pūrve śivāḥ syuḥ kramaśaḥ pare tadbhogamātrataḥ // 301
meaning:
ते चापि द्विविधा ज्ञेया लौकिका दीक्षितास्तथा /
पूर्वे शिवाः स्युः क्रमशः परे तद्भोगमात्रतः // 301
text_mt: And they should be understood as twofold: the worldly and the initiated. / The former become Śiva by degrees, the latter through mere enjoyment of that [reality]. // 301

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāpyūrdhvādharānekabhedayojanikāvaśāt /
bhidyamānā yogināṃ syādvicitraphaladāyinī // 302
meaning:
दीक्षाप्यूर्ध्वाधरानेकभेदयोजनिकावशात् /
भिद्यमाना योगिनां स्याद्विचित्रफलदायिनी // 302
text_mt: Initiation too, being differentiated through the power of connection to higher and lower multiple divisions, / grants manifold fruits to yogins. // 302

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu vijñāninaste'tra dvedhā kampretaratvataḥ /
tatra ye kampravijñānāste dehānted śivāḥ sphuṭam // 303
meaning:
ये तु विज्ञानिनस्तेऽत्र द्वेधा कम्प्रेतरत्वतः /
तत्र ये कम्प्रविज्ञानास्ते देहान्तेद् शिवाः स्फुटम् // 303
text_mt: Those, however, who possess higher knowledge are twofold here, through being wavering or otherwise. / Among them, those whose higher knowledge is wavering clearly become Śiva at the end of the body. // 303

sanskrit_iast:
yato vijñānameteṣāmutpannaṃ naca susphuṭam /
vikalpāntarayogena nacāpyunmūlitātmakam // 304
meaning:
यतो विज्ञानमेतेषामुत्पन्नं नच सुस्फुटम् /
विकल्पान्तरयोगेन नचाप्युन्मूलितात्मकम् // 304
text_mt: Because their higher knowledge, though arisen, is not entirely clear, / nor is its nature uprooted by connection with other conceptual constructs. // 304

sanskrit_iast:
ato dehe pramādottho vikalpo dehapātataḥ /
naśyedavaśyaṃ taccāpi budhyate jñānamuttamam // 305
meaning:
अतो देहे प्रमादोत्थो विकल्पो देहपाततः /
नश्येदवश्यं तच्चापि बुध्यते ज्ञानमुत्तमम् // 305
text_mt: Therefore, the conceptual construct arising from negligence in the body will necessarily / perish at the fall of the body, and that supreme knowledge is also realized. // 305

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskārakalpanātiṣṭhadadhvastīkṛtamantarā /
prāptapākaṃ saṃvarīturapāye bhāsate hi tat // 306
meaning:
संस्कारकल्पनातिष्ठदध्वस्तीकृतमन्तरा /
प्राप्तपाकं संवरीतुरपाये भासते हि तत् // 306
text_mt: For that [knowledge], remaining as an imaginative construct of latent traces and undamaged within, / having reached maturity, shines forth when the obscuring factor disappears. // 306

sanskrit_iast:
ye tu svabhyastavijñānamayāḥ śivamayāḥ sadā /
jīvanmuktā hi te naiṣāṃ mṛtau kāpi vicāraṇā // 307
meaning:
ये तु स्वभ्यस्तविज्ञानमयाः शिवमयाः सदा /
जीवन्मुक्ता हि ते नैषां मृतौ कापि विचारणा // 307
text_mt: Those, however, whose nature consists of well-practised higher knowledge are always identical with Śiva; / indeed, they are liberated while living. For them there is no inquiry whatever concerning death. // 307

sanskrit_iast:
yathāhi jīvanmuktānāṃ sthitau nāsti vicāraṇā /
sukhiduḥkhivimūḍhatve, mṛtāvapi tathā na sā // 308
meaning:
यथाहि जीवन्मुक्तानां स्थितौ नास्ति विचारणा /
सुखिदुःखिविमूढत्वे, मृतावपि तथा न सा // 308
text_mt: For just as for those liberated while living there is no deliberation during life / when they are happy, sorrowful, or bewildered, so too there is none at death. // 308

sanskrit_iast:
śrīratnamālāśāstre taduvāca parameśvaraḥ /
svaśāstre cāpyahīśāno viśvādhāradhurandharaḥ // 309
meaning:
श्रीरत्नमालाशास्त्रे तदुवाच परमेश्वरः /
स्वशास्त्रे चाप्यहीशानो विश्वाधारधुरन्धरः // 309
text_mt: The Supreme Lord declared that in the venerable Ratnamālā scripture, / and so did the lord of serpents, bearer of the burden of the foundation of the universe, in his own treatise: // 309

sanskrit_iast:
rathyāntare mūtrapurīṣamadhye caṇḍālagehe niraye śmaśāne /
sacintako vā gatacintako vā jñānī vimokṣaṃ labhate'pi cānte // 310
meaning:
रथ्यान्तरे मूत्रपुरीषमध्ये चण्डालगेहे निरये श्मशाने /
सचिन्तको वा गतचिन्तको वा ज्ञानी विमोक्षं लभतेऽपि चान्ते // 310
text_mt: "In an alleyway, amidst urine and feces, in an outcaste's house, in hell, or in a cremation ground, / whether full of anxious thought or free from anxious thought, the knower attains liberation even at the end." // 310

sanskrit_iast:
apiceti dhvanirjīvanmuktatāmasya bhāṣate /
sacintācintakatvoktiretāvatsaṃbhavasthitim // 311
meaning:
अपिचेति ध्वनिर्जीवन्मुक्ततामस्य भाषते /
सचिन्ताचिन्तकत्वोक्तिरेतावत्संभवस्थितिम् // 311
text_mt: The particle 'even' expresses his state of being liberated while living; / the mention of being with or without thought refers to the status of such a possibility. // 311

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthe śvapacagṛhe vā naṣṭasmṛtirapi parityajeddeham /
jñānasamakālamuktaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti hataśokaḥ // 312
meaning:
तीर्थे श्वपचगृहे वा नष्टस्मृतिरपि परित्यजेद्देहम् /
ज्ञानसमकालमुक्तः कैवल्यं याति हतशोकः // 312
text_mt: "In a sacred place or in a dog-cooker's hut, he may abandon his body even having lost memory; / liberated simultaneously with knowledge, he attains isolation, his sorrow destroyed." // 312

sanskrit_iast:
anantakārikā caiṣā prāhedaṃ bandhakaṃ kila /
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cāsya śaṅkyaṃ taccāsya no bhavet // 313
meaning:
अनन्तकारिका चैषा प्राहेदं बन्धकं किल /
सुकृतं दुष्कृतं चास्य शङ्क्यं तच्चास्य नो भवेत् // 313
text_mt: And this verse of Ananta declared: "This [merit and demerit] is indeed binding; / both good deed and bad deed might be suspected for him, but that does not happen for him." // 313

sanskrit_iast:
apiśabdādaluptasmṛtyā vā saṃbhāvyate kila /
mṛtirnaṣṭasmṛtereva mṛteḥ prāk sāstu kiṃ tayā // 314
meaning:
अपिशब्दादलुप्तस्मृत्या वा संभाव्यते किल /
मृतिर्नष्टस्मृतेरेव मृतेः प्राक् सास्तु किं तया // 314
text_mt: By the word 'even', death is conceived as occurring with unlost memory / or indeed only with lost memory; let that be prior to death, for what does it matter? // 314

sanskrit_iast:
liṅca saṃbhāvanāyāṃ syādiyatsaṃbhāvyate kila /
saca kāladhvaniḥ prāha mṛtermuktāvahetutām // 315
meaning:
लिङ्च संभावनायां स्यादियत्संभाव्यते किल /
सच कालध्वनिः प्राह मृतेर्मुक्तावहेतुताम् // 315
text_mt: And the optative expresses possibility: "so much is indeed possible"; / and that temporal expression affirms that death is not a cause of liberation. // 315

sanskrit_iast:
kaivalyamiti cāśaṅkāpadaṃ yāpyabhavattanuḥ /
bhedapradatvenaiṣāpi dhvastā tena viśokatā // 316
meaning:
कैवल्यमिति चाशङ्कापदं याप्यभवत्तनुः /
भेदप्रदत्वेनैषापि ध्वस्ता तेन विशोकता // 316
text_mt: And by the word 'isolation', even the body, which was an object of suspicion / as bestowing difference, is also destroyed by that; hence the state of being free from sorrow. // 316

sanskrit_iast:
paradehādisaṃbandho yathā nāsya vibhedakaḥ /
tathā svadehasaṃbandho jīvanmuktasya yadyapi // 317
meaning:
परदेहादिसंबन्धो यथा नास्य विभेदकः /
तथा स्वदेहसंबन्धो जीवन्मुक्तस्य यद्यपि // 317
text_mt: Although connection with another's body or the like does not bring division to him, / so too connection with his own body [does not] for one liberated while living; // 317

sanskrit_iast:
ataśca na viśeṣo'sya viśvākṛtinirākṛteḥ /
śivābhinnasya dehe vā tadabhāve'pi vā kila // 318
meaning:
अतश्च न विशेषोऽस्य विश्वाकृतिनिराकृतेः /
शिवाभिन्नस्य देहे वा तदभावेऽपि वा किल // 318
text_mt: and therefore there is no distinction for him, whose universal form is formless, / whether in the body or in its absence, being indivisible from Śiva; // 318

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpi prācyatadbhedasaṃskārāśaṅkanasthiteḥ /
adhunoktaṃ kevalatvaṃ yadvā mātrantarāśrayāt // 319
meaning:
तथापि प्राच्यतद्भेदसंस्काराशङ्कनस्थितेः /
अधुनोक्तं केवलत्वं यद्वा मात्रन्तराश्रयात् // 319
text_mt: nevertheless, because of the persistence of suspicion from previous latent impressions of difference, / isolation is stated now, or else because of relying on other subjects. // 319

sanskrit_iast:
tānyenaṃ na vidurbhinnaṃ taiḥ sa mukto'bhidhīyate /
śrīmattraiśirase'pyuktaṃ sūryendupuṭavarjite // 320
meaning:
तान्येनं न विदुर्भिन्नं तैः स मुक्तोऽभिधीयते /
श्रीमत्त्रैशिरसेऽप्युक्तं सूर्येन्दुपुटवर्जिते // 320
text_mt: They do not know him as separate; by them he is spoken of as liberated. / It is also said in the venerable Traiśirasa: "Free from the enclosure of sun and moon, // 320

sanskrit_iast:
jugupsābhāvabhaṅgasthe sarvataḥ stambhavatsthite /
sarvavyāpattirahite pramāṇapratyayātige // 321
meaning:
जुगुप्साभावभङ्गस्थे सर्वतः स्तम्भवत्स्थिते /
सर्वव्यापत्तिरहिते प्रमाणप्रत्ययातिगे // 321
text_mt: abiding in the cessation of repulsion and existence, standing everywhere like a pillar, / devoid of all afflictions, transcending means of knowledge and cognitions, // 321

sanskrit_iast:
tasminbodhāntare līnaḥ karmakartāpyanañjanaḥ /
pradhānaṃ ghaṭa ākāśa ātmā maṣṭe ghaṭe'pi kham // 322
meaning:
तस्मिन्बोधान्तरे लीनः कर्मकर्ताप्यनञ्जनः /
प्रधानं घट आकाश आत्मा मष्टे घटेऽपि खम् // 322
text_mt: dissolved in that internal consciousness, even doing actions he is unstained; / the matrix is the pot, the self is space, and even when the pot is destroyed, space // 322

sanskrit_iast:
na naśyettadvadevāsāvātmā śivamayo bhavet /
svatantro'vasthito jñānī prasaretsarvavastuṣu // 323
meaning:
न नश्येत्तद्वदेवासावात्मा शिवमयो भवेत् /
स्वतन्त्रोऽवस्थितो ज्ञानी प्रसरेत्सर्ववस्तुषु // 323
text_mt: is not destroyed: just so, this self becomes identical with Śiva; / established as autonomous, the knower expands into all things. // 323

sanskrit_iast:
tasya bhāvo nacābhāvaḥ saṃsthānaṃ naca kalpanā /
etadevāntarāgūrya gururgītāsvabhāṣata // 324
meaning:
तस्य भावो नचाभावः संस्थानं नच कल्पना /
एतदेवान्तरागूर्य गुरुर्गीतास्वभाषत // 324
text_mt: For him there is neither existence nor non-existence, neither configuration nor mental projection." / Having grasped this internally, the Guru declared in the Gītā: // 324

sanskrit_iast:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram /
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ // 325
meaning:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् /
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः // 325
text_mt: "Whatever state one remembers when abandoning the body at the end, / to that very one he goes, O son of Kuntī, constantly cultivated in that state. // 325

sanskrit_iast:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca /
yadā sattve vivṛddhe tu pralīnastvūrdhvagastadā // 326
meaning:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च /
यदा सत्त्वे विवृद्धे तु प्रलीनस्त्वूर्ध्वगस्तदा // 326
text_mt: Therefore, at all times remember Me and fight! / But when one dissolves as sattva has increased, then one goes upward; // 326

sanskrit_iast:
kramādrajastamolīnaḥ karmayonivimūḍhagaḥ /
tatrendriyāṇāṃ saṃmohaśvāsāyāsaparītatā // 327
meaning:
क्रमाद्रजस्तमोलीनः कर्मयोनिविमूढगः /
तत्रेन्द्रियाणां संमोहश्वासायासपरीतता // 327
text_mt: dissolving in rajas and tamas successively, one goes to wombs of action and delusion." / In that regard, the bewilderment of the senses, being overcome by the toil of breathing, // 327

sanskrit_iast:
ityādimṛtibhogo'yaṃ dehe na tyajanaṃ tanoḥ /
yastvasau kṣaṇa evaikaścaramaḥ prāṇanātmakaḥ // 328
meaning:
इत्यादिमृतिभोगोऽयं देहे न त्यजनं तनोः /
यस्त्वसौ क्षण एवैकश्चरमः प्राणनात्मकः // 328
text_mt: and so forth—this is the experience of dying in the body, not the abandoning of the body. / But that which is a single final moment consisting of vitalization, // 328

sanskrit_iast:
yadanantaramevaiṣa dehaḥ syātkāṣṭhakuḍyavat /
sā dehatyāgakālāṃśakalā dehaviyoginī // 329
meaning:
यदनन्तरमेवैष देहः स्यात्काष्ठकुड्यवत् /
सा देहत्यागकालांशकला देहवियोगिनी // 329
text_mt: immediately after which this body becomes like wood or a wall— / that fraction of time of discarding the body is separate from the body. // 329

sanskrit_iast:
tata eva hi taddehasukhaduḥkhādikojjhitā /
tasyāṃ yadeva smarati prāksaṃskāraprabodhataḥ // 330
meaning:
तत एव हि तद्देहसुखदुःखादिकोज्झिता /
तस्यां यदेव स्मरति प्राक्संस्कारप्रबोधतः // 330
text_mt: For this very reason, it is free from the pleasure, pain, and the like of that body; / in that [moment], whatever one remembers through the awakening of prior latent traces // 330

sanskrit_iast:
adṛṣṭābhyāsabhūyastvaśaktipātādihetukāt /
tadeva rūpamabhyeti sukhiduḥkhivimūḍhakam // 331
meaning:
अदृष्टाभ्यासभूयस्त्वशक्तिपातादिहेतुकात् /
तदेव रूपमभ्येति सुखिदुःखिविमूढकम् // 331
text_mt: caused by destiny, repeated practice, or the descent of power and the like, / that very form—happy, sorrowful, or bewildered—he attains. // 331

sanskrit_iast:
yadvā niḥsukhaduḥkhādi yadi vānandarūpakam /
kasmādeti tadevaiṣa yataḥ smarati saṃvidi // 332
meaning:
यद्वा निःसुखदुःखादि यदि वानन्दरूपकम् /
कस्मादेति तदेवैष यतः स्मरति संविदि // 332
text_mt:
Or [a state] free of pleasure, pain, and the like, or characterized by bliss.
Why does it attain precisely that? Because in consciousness it remembers [it]. // 332

sanskrit_iast:
prāk prasphuredyadadhikaṃ deho'sau cidadhiṣṭhiteḥ /
yadeva prāgadhiṣṭhānaṃ citā tādātmyavṛttitaḥ // 333
meaning:
प्राक् प्रस्फुरेद्यदधिकं देहोऽसौ चिदधिष्ठितेः /
यदेव प्रागधिष्ठानं चिता तादात्म्यवृत्तितः // 333
text_mt:
What pulsed most prominently beforehand was this body, because of its governance by consciousness.
Indeed, prior governance by consciousness arises through the relation of identity [with it]. // 333

sanskrit_iast:
saivātra līnatā proktā sattve rajasi tāmase /
nīlapītādike jñeye yataḥ prākkalpitāṃ tanum // 334
meaning:
सैवात्र लीनता प्रोक्ता सत्त्वे रजसि तामसे /
नीलपीतादिके ज्ञेये यतः प्राक्कल्पितां तनुम् // 334
text_mt:
Just that is taught here to be dissolution in sattva, in rajas, in tamas,
[or] in knowables such as blue, yellow, and the rest; because, having governed // 334

sanskrit_iast:
adhiṣṭhāyaiva saṃvittiradhiṣṭhānaṃ karotyalam /
ato'dhiṣṭheyamātrasya śarīratve'pi kuḍyataḥ // 335
meaning:
अधिष्ठायैव संवित्तिरधिष्ठानं करोत्यलम् /
अतोऽधिष्ठेयमात्रस्य शरीरत्वेऽपि कुड्यतः // 335
text_mt:
only a previously conceptualized body, consciousness fully exercises governance.
Therefore, even though mere governed objects have the status of a body, as in the case of a wall, // 335

sanskrit_iast:
dehasyāsti viśeṣo yatsarvādhiṣṭheyapūrvatā /
tādātmyavṛttiranyeṣāṃ tanna satyapi vedyate // 336
meaning:
देहस्यास्ति विशेषो यत्सर्वाधिष्ठेयपूर्वता /
तादात्म्यवृत्तिरन्येषां तन्न सत्यपि वेद्यते // 336
text_mt:
there is a distinctive feature of the [physical] body: its priority to everything governed.
The relation of identity with other [objects] is not experienced even when they are present; // 336

sanskrit_iast:
vedyānāṃ kintu dehasya nityāvyabhicaritvataḥ /
sā ca tasyaiva dehasya pūrvamṛtyantajanmanā // 337
meaning:
वेद्यानां किन्तु देहस्य नित्याव्यभिचरित्वतः /
सा च तस्यैव देहस्य पूर्वमृत्यन्तजन्मना // 337
text_mt:
they are mere knowables, whereas with the body it is invariable and perpetual.
And that [identity] belongs to that very body through its birth culminating in its prior death, // 337

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtyā prācyānubhavanakṛtasaṃskāracitrayā /
yuktyānayāsmatsantānaguruṇā kallaṭena yat // 338
meaning:
स्मृत्या प्राच्यानुभवनकृतसंस्कारचित्रया /
युक्त्यानयास्मत्सन्तानगुरुणा कल्लटेन यत् // 338
text_mt:
by means of memory variegated by traces produced by previous experience.
By this reasoning, that which was stated by Kallaṭa, the guru of our lineage: // 338

sanskrit_iast:
dehāviśeṣe prāṇākhyadārḍhyaṃ heturudīritam /
tadyuktamanyathā prāṇadārḍhye ko heturekataḥ // 339
meaning:
देहाविशेषे प्राणाख्यदार्ढ्यं हेतुरुदीरितम् /
तद्युक्तमन्यथा प्राणदार्ढ्ये को हेतुरेकतः // 339
text_mt:
'Given that embodiment is identical, firmness called breath is declared the cause,'
is established. Otherwise, what single cause would there be for the firmness of breath, // 339

sanskrit_iast:
dehatvasyāviśeṣe'pītyeṣa praśno na śāmyati /
smaranniti śatā hetau tadrūpaṃ pratipadyate // 340
meaning:
देहत्वस्याविशेषेऽपीत्येष प्रश्नो न शाम्यति /
स्मरन्निति शता हेतौ तद्रूपं प्रतिपद्यते // 340
text_mt:
given that the condition of having a body is indistinguishable? This question would never subside.
By the present participle 'remembering' denoting the cause, it assumes that nature. // 340

sanskrit_iast:
prāk smaryate yato dehaḥ prākcitādhiṣṭhitaḥ sphuran /
ataḥ smaraṇamantyaṃ yattadasarvajñamātṛṣu // 341
meaning:
प्राक् स्मर्यते यतो देहः प्राक्चिताधिष्ठितः स्फुरन् /
अतः स्मरणमन्त्यं यत्तदसर्वज्ञमातृषु // 341
text_mt:
Because it is remembered beforehand, the body, having been governed by consciousness beforehand, flashes forth.
Therefore, as for the final memory, among non-omniscient subjects // 341

sanskrit_iast:
na jātu gocaro yasmāddehāntaraviniścayaḥ /
yattu bandhupriyāputrapānādismaraṇaṃ sphuṭam // 342
meaning:
न जातु गोचरो यस्माद्देहान्तरविनिश्चयः /
यत्तु बन्धुप्रियापुत्रपानादिस्मरणं स्फुटम् // 342
text_mt:
it never has as its object the determination of another body;
whereas that which is the vivid memory of kin, beloved, son, drinking, and the like // 342

sanskrit_iast:
na taddehāntarāsaṅgi na tadantyaṃ yato bhavet /
kasyāpi tu śarīrānte vāsanā yā prabhotsyate // 343
meaning:
न तद्देहान्तरासङ्गि न तदन्त्यं यतो भवेत् /
कस्यापि तु शरीरान्ते वासना या प्रभोत्स्यते // 343
text_mt:
is not attached to another body, because it cannot be the final [thought].
However, whatever latent impression awakens in someone at the end of the body, // 343

sanskrit_iast:
dehasattve tadaucityājjāyetānubhavaḥ sphuṭaḥ /
yathā purāṇe kathitaṃ mṛgapotakatṛṣṇayā // 344
meaning:
देहसत्त्वे तदौचित्याज्जायेतानुभवः स्फुटः /
यथा पुराणे कथितं मृगपोतकतृष्णया // 344
text_mt:
while the body still exists, a vivid experience arises in accordance with it,
just as related in the Purāṇa: through longing for a young fawn, // 344

sanskrit_iast:
muniḥ ko'pi mṛgībhāvamabhyuvāhādhivāsitaḥ /
tatra so'nubhavo heturna janmāntarasūtaye // 345
meaning:
मुनिः कोऽपि मृगीभावमभ्युवाहाधिवासितः /
तत्र सोऽनुभवो हेतुर्न जन्मान्तरसूतये // 345
text_mt:
a certain sage, perfumed [by that desire], attained the state of a deer.
There, that experience is not the cause for bringing about another birth; // 345

sanskrit_iast:
tasyaitadvāsanā hetuḥ kākatālīyavat sa tu /
nanu kasmāttadevaiṣa smarati ityāha yatsadā // 346
meaning:
तस्यैतद्वासना हेतुः काकतालीयवत् स तु /
ननु कस्मात्तदेवैष स्मरति इत्याह यत्सदा // 346
text_mt:
the latent impression of it is the cause, but that [experience] is purely accidental.
[Objection:] 'Why does it remember precisely that?' To this it is replied: 'Because, always // 346

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhāvabhāvitastena tadevaiṣa smaratyalam /
evamasmi bhaviṣyāmītyeṣa tadbhāva ucyate // 347
meaning:
तद्भावभावितस्तेन तदेवैष स्मरत्यलम् /
एवमस्मि भविष्यामीत्येष तद्भाव उच्यते // 347
text_mt:
permeated by the condition of that, therefore it completely remembers precisely that.'
'Thus I am, I will be'—this is called 'the condition of that'. // 347

sanskrit_iast:
bhaviṣyato hi bhavanaṃ bhāvyate na sataḥ kvacit /
kramātsphuṭatvakaraṇaṃ bhāvanaṃ parikīrtyate // 348
meaning:
भविष्यतो हि भवनं भाव्यते न सतः क्वचित् /
क्रमात्स्फुटत्वकरणं भावनं परिकीर्त्यते // 348
text_mt:
Indeed, what is yet to be is cultivated [in thought], never that which is already present.
Bringing about vividness in a gradual manner is celebrated as cultivation [or visualization]. // 348

sanskrit_iast:
sphuṭasya cānubhavanaṃ na bhāvanamidaṃ sphuṭam /
tadaharjātabālasya paśoḥ kīṭasya vā taroḥ // 349
meaning:
स्फुटस्य चानुभवनं न भावनमिदं स्फुटम् /
तदहर्जातबालस्य पशोः कीटस्य वा तरोः // 349
text_mt:
And the direct experience of what is vivid is not this cultivation; this is clear.
In the case of a child born that very day, an animal, an insect, or a tree, // 349

sanskrit_iast:
mūḍhatve'pi tadānīṃ prāgbhāvanā hyabhavatsphuṭā /
sā tanmūḍhaśarīrānte saṃskārapratibodhanāt // 350
meaning:
मूढत्वेऽपि तदानीं प्राग्भावना ह्यभवत्स्फुटा /
सा तन्मूढशरीरान्ते संस्कारप्रतिबोधनात् // 350
text_mt:
even though dull at that time, a prior cultivation was indeed vivid.
That, at the end of that dull body, through the awakening of traces, // 350

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtidvāreṇa taddehavaicitryaphaladāyinī /
deśādivyavadhāne'pi vāsanānāmudīritāt // 351
meaning:
स्मृतिद्वारेण तद्देहवैचित्र्यफलदायिनी /
देशादिव्यवधानेऽपि वासनानामुदीरितात् // 351
text_mt:
by means of memory yields the fruit of that bodily variety.
Even when separated by space and time, latent impressions are declared [efficacious] // 351

sanskrit_iast:
ānantaryaikarūpatvātsmṛtisaṃskārayorataḥ /
tathānubhavanārūḍhyā sphuṭasyāpi tu bhāvitā // 352
meaning:
आनन्तर्यैकरूपत्वात्स्मृतिसंस्कारयोरतः /
तथानुभवनारूढ्या स्फुटस्यापि तु भाविता // 352
text_mt:
because memory and latent impression share the nature of unbroken contiguity.
Therefore, through such ascendancy of experience, that which is cultivated even when vivid, // 352

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvyamānā na kiṃ sūte tatsantānasadṛgvapuḥ /
tattādṛktādṛśairbandhuputramitrādibhiḥ saha // 353
meaning:
भाव्यमाना न किं सूते तत्सन्तानसदृग्वपुः /
तत्तादृक्तादृशैर्बन्धुपुत्रमित्रादिभिः सह // 353
text_mt:
being cultivated, does it not produce a body similar to that continuous flow,
together with such and such kin, sons, friends, and the like? // 353

sanskrit_iast:
bhāsate'pi pare loke svapnavadvāsanākramāt /
nanu mātrantarairbandhuputrādyaistattathā na kim // 354
meaning:
भासतेऽपि परे लोके स्वप्नवद्वासनाक्रमात् /
ननु मात्रन्तरैर्बन्धुपुत्राद्यैस्तत्तथा न किम् // 354
text_mt:
It appears even in the next world, like a dream, through the sequence of latent impressions.
[Objection:] 'Is it not the case that other subjects, such as kin and sons, do not cognize it thus?' // 354

sanskrit_iast:
vedyate ka idaṃ prāha sa tāvadveda vedyatām /
vyāpāravyāhṛtivrātavedye mātrantaravraje // 355
meaning:
वेद्यते क इदं प्राह स तावद्वेद वेद्यताम् /
व्यापारव्याहृतिव्रातवेद्ये मात्रन्तरव्रजे // 355
text_mt:
Who said this? He only knows knowability.
Regarding the crowd of other subjects known through the manifold of actions and words, // 355

sanskrit_iast:
svapne nāsti sa ityeṣā vākpramāṇavivarjitā /
ya evaite tu dṛśyante jāgratyete mayekṣitāḥ // 356
meaning:
स्वप्ने नास्ति स इत्येषा वाक्प्रमाणविवर्जिता /
य एवैते तु दृश्यन्ते जाग्रत्येते मयेक्षिताः // 356
text_mt:
the claim that 'it does not exist in a dream' is devoid of any valid means of knowledge.
[Opponent:] 'Only those seen in waking are seen by me [as real]; // 356

sanskrit_iast:
svapna ityastu mithyaitattatpramātṛvacobalāt /
yānapaśyamahaṃ svapne pramātṝṃste na kecana // 357
meaning:
स्वप्न इत्यस्तु मिथ्यैतत्तत्प्रमातृवचोबलात् /
यानपश्यमहं स्वप्ने प्रमातॄंस्ते न केचन // 357
text_mt:
let a dream be false on the strength of the statements of those subjects.
Those subjects whom I did not see in the dream do not grieve, nor do they see me'— // 357

sanskrit_iast:
na śocanti na cekṣante māmityatrāsti kā pramā /
yataḥ sarvānumānānāṃ svasaṃvedananiṣṭhitau // 358
meaning:
न शोचन्ति न चेक्षन्ते मामित्यत्रास्ति का प्रमा /
यतः सर्वानुमानानां स्वसंवेदननिष्ठितौ // 358
text_mt: what proof is there for this? For, since all inferences are grounded in self-awareness, // 358

sanskrit_iast:
pramātrantarasadbhāvaḥ saṃvinniṣṭho na tadgataḥ /
ghaṭāderastitā saṃvinniṣṭhitā natu tadgatā // 359
meaning:
प्रमात्रन्तरसद्भावः संविन्निष्ठो न तद्गतः /
घटादेरस्तिता संविन्निष्ठिता नतु तद्गता // 359
text_mt:
the existence of another subject is grounded in consciousness, not residing in that [other subject].
The existence of a pot or the like is grounded in consciousness, not residing in that [object]; // 359

sanskrit_iast:
tadvanmātrantare'pyeṣā saṃvinniṣṭhā na tadgatā /
tena sthitamidaṃ yadyadbhāvyate tattadeva hi // 360
meaning:
तद्वन्मात्रन्तरेऽप्येषा संविन्निष्ठा न तद्गता /
तेन स्थितमिदं यद्यद्भाव्यते तत्तदेव हि // 360
text_mt:
likewise, in the case of another subject too, this [existence] is grounded in consciousness, not residing in that [subject].
Therefore it is established: whatever is cultivated is indeed precisely that which // 360

sanskrit_iast:
dehānte budhyate no cet syādanyādṛkprabodhanam /
tathāhyantyakṣaṇe brahmavidyākarṇanasaṃskṛtaḥ // 361
meaning:
देहान्ते बुध्यते नो चेत् स्यादन्यादृक्प्रबोधनम् /
तथाह्यन्त्यक्षणे ब्रह्मविद्याकर्णनसंस्कृतः // 361
text_mt:
is cognized at the end of the body; if not, there would be a different kind of awakening.
Thus, at the final moment, one refined by the hearing of the lore of Brahman // 361

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate janturityuktaṃ prāksaṃskārabalatvataḥ /
nipātābhyāmantaśabdātsmaraṇācchaturantyataḥ // 362
meaning:
मुच्यते जन्तुरित्युक्तं प्राक्संस्कारबलत्वतः /
निपाताभ्यामन्तशब्दात्स्मरणाच्छतुरन्त्यतः // 362
text_mt:
is liberated, a living being—so it is declared—by the power of prior latent traces.
Through the two particles, through the word 'end', through 'remembering', through the fourth ending, // 362

sanskrit_iast:
pādācca nikhilādardhaślokācca samanantarāt /
līnaśabdācca sarvaṃ taduktamarthasatattvakam // 363
meaning:
पादाच्च निखिलादर्धश्लोकाच्च समनन्तरात् /
लीनशब्दाच्च सर्वं तदुक्तमर्थसतत्त्वकम् // 363
text_mt:
and through the entire quarter and the immediately following half-verse,
and through the word 'dissolved', all that true nature of the matter has been stated. // 363

sanskrit_iast:
ajñātvaitattu sarve'pi kuśakāśāvalambinaḥ /
yattadorvyatyayaṃ kecitkecidanyādṛśaṃ kramam // 364
meaning:
अज्ञात्वैतत्तु सर्वेऽपि कुशकाशावलम्बिनः /
यत्तदोर्व्यत्ययं केचित्केचिदन्यादृशं क्रमम् // 364
text_mt:
Failing to understand this, however, all [commentators], clutching at straws,
explain an inversion of 'yat' and 'tat', some another kind of sequence, // 364

sanskrit_iast:
bhinnakramau nipātau ca tyajatīti ca saptamīm /
vyācakṣate tacca sarvaṃ nopayogyuktayojane // 365
meaning:
भिन्नक्रमौ निपातौ च त्यजतीति च सप्तमीम् /
व्याचक्षते तच्च सर्वं नोपयोग्युक्तयोजने // 365
text_mt:
a split syntax of the two particles, and the locative in 'abandons'.
All of that is useless for the proper interpretation, // 365

sanskrit_iast:
naca taddarśitaṃ mithyā svāntasammohadāyakam /
taditthaṃprāyaṇasyaitattattvaṃ śrīśambhunāthataḥ // 366
meaning:
नच तद्दर्शितं मिथ्या स्वान्तसम्मोहदायकम् /
तदित्थंप्रायणस्यैतत्तत्त्वं श्रीशम्भुनाथतः // 366
text_mt:
and has not been shown, as it is false and produces confusion in the heart.
Thus, having obtained from revered Śambhunātha this reality concerning dying, // 366

sanskrit_iast:
adhigamyoditaṃ tena mṛtyorbhītirvinaśyati /
viditamṛtisatattvāḥ saṃvidambhonidhānādacalahṛdayavīryākarṣaniṣpīḍanottham /
amṛtamiti nigīrṇe kālakūṭe'tra devā yadi pivatha tadānīṃ niścitaṃ vaḥ śivatvam // 367
meaning:
अधिगम्योदितं तेन मृत्योर्भीतिर्विनश्यति /
विदितमृतिसतत्त्वाः संविदम्भोनिधानादचलहृदयवीर्याकर्षनिष्पीडनोत्थम् /
अमृतमिति निगीर्णे कालकूटेऽत्र देवा यदि पिवथ तदानीं निश्चितं वः शिवत्वम् // 367
text_mt:
it has been expounded by him, whereby the fear of death is destroyed.
O gods who know the true nature of death! When the kālakūṭa poison here has been swallowed,
if you drink the nectar arisen from the squeezing and pulling of the vigor of the steadfast heart
from the receptacle of the ocean of consciousness, then your state of Śiva is certain! // 367

sanskrit_iast:
utsavo'pi hi yaḥ kaścillaukikaḥ so'pi saṃmadam /
saṃvidabdhitaraṅgābhaṃ sūte tadapi parvavat // 368
meaning:
उत्सवोऽपि हि यः कश्चिल्लौकिकः सोऽपि संमदम् /
संविदब्धितरङ्गाभं सूते तदपि पर्ववत् // 368
text_mt:
Even whatever ordinary worldly festival there is, that too generates intense joy
resembling a wave on the ocean of consciousness; therefore, it too is like an auspicious occasion. // 368

sanskrit_iast:
etena ca vipaddhvaṃsapramodādiṣu parvatā /
vyākhyātā tena tatrāpi viśeṣāddevatārcanam // 369
meaning:
एतेन च विपद्ध्वंसप्रमोदादिषु पर्वता /
व्याख्याता तेन तत्रापि विशेषाद्देवतार्चनम् // 369
text_mt:
And by this, the nature of an auspicious occasion in the destruction of calamity, joy, and the like
is explained; therefore, on such occasions too, the worship of the deities is performed with particularity. // 369

sanskrit_iast:
purakṣobhādyadbhutaṃ yattatsvātantrye svasaṃvidaḥ /
dārḍhyadāyīti tallābhadine vaiśeṣikārcanam // 370
meaning:
पुरक्षोभाद्यद्भुतं यत्तत्स्वातन्त्र्ये स्वसंविदः /
दार्ढ्यदायीति तल्लाभदिने वैशेषिकार्चनम् // 370
text_mt:
That which is wondrous, such as the agitation of a city, imparts firmness to the absolute autonomy
of one's own consciousness; therefore, on the day of its attainment, specific worship [is held]. // 370

sanskrit_iast:
yoginīmelako dvedhā haṭhataḥ priyatastathā /
prācye cchidrāṇi saṃrakṣetkāmacāritvamuttare // 371
meaning:
योगिनीमेलको द्वेधा हठतः प्रियतस्तथा /
प्राच्ये च्छिद्राणि संरक्षेत्कामचारित्वमुत्तरे // 371
text_mt:
The gathering of Yoginīs is twofold: by force and through love;
in the former, one should protect vulnerable points, [while] in the latter there is freedom to act as one pleases. // 371

sanskrit_iast:
sa ca dvayo'pi mantroddhṛtprasaṅge darśayiṣyate /
yoginīmelakāccaiṣo'vaśyaṃ jñānaṃ prapadyate // 372
meaning:
स च द्वयोऽपि मन्त्रोद्धृत्प्रसङ्गे दर्शयिष्यते /
योगिनीमेलकाच्चैषोऽवश्यं ज्ञानं प्रपद्यते // 372
text_mt:
And both will be shown in the context of the extraction of mantras.
And from the gathering of Yoginīs, one inevitably attains knowledge; // 372

sanskrit_iast:
tena tatparva tadvacca svasantānādimelanam /
saṃvitsarvātmikā dehabhedādyā saṅkucettu sā // 373
meaning:
तेन तत्पर्व तद्वच्च स्वसन्तानादिमेलनम् /
संवित्सर्वात्मिका देहभेदाद्या सङ्कुचेत्तु सा // 373
text_mt:
therefore, it is an auspicious occasion, as is similarly the assembly of one's own lineage and others.
Consciousness is all-pervading, but it contracts through distinctions of the body and the like; // 373

sanskrit_iast:
melake'nyonyasaṅghaṭṭapratibimbādvikasvarā /
ucchalannijaraśmyoghaḥ saṃvitsu pratibimbitaḥ // 374
meaning:
मेलकेऽन्योन्यसङ्घट्टप्रतिबिम्बाद्विकस्वरा /
उच्छलन्निजरश्म्योघः संवित्सु प्रतिबिम्बितः // 374
text_mt:
in an assembly, blooming through mutual contact and reflection,
the flood of its own rays surging up and reflected in consciousnesses, // 374

sanskrit_iast:
bahudarpaṇavaddīptaḥ sarvāyetāpyayatnataḥ /
ata eva gītagītaprabhṛtau bahuparṣadi // 375
meaning:
बहुदर्पणवद्दीप्तः सर्वायेताप्ययत्नतः /
अत एव गीतगीतप्रभृतौ बहुपर्षदि // 375
text_mt:
blazing like multiple mirrors, effortlessly becomes all-inclusive.
Therefore, in singing, chanting, and the like before a large assembly, // 375

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sarvatanmayībhāve hlādo natvekakasya saḥ /
ānandanirbharā saṃvitpratyekaṃ sā tathaikatām // 376
meaning:
यः सर्वतन्मयीभावे ह्लादो नत्वेककस्य सः /
आनन्दनिर्भरा संवित्प्रत्येकं सा तथैकताम् // 376
text_mt:
that delight which exists in becoming completely identified with it does not belong to a solitary person.
Consciousness, brimming with bliss, similarly attains oneness in each individual. // 376

sanskrit_iast:
nṛttādau viṣaye prāptā pūrṇānandatvamaśnute /
īrṣyāsūyādisaṅkocakāraṇābhāvato'tra sā // 377
meaning:
नृत्तादौ विषये प्राप्ता पूर्णानन्दत्वमश्नुते /
ईर्ष्यासूयादिसङ्कोचकारणाभावतोऽत्र सा // 377
text_mt: having reached an object such as dance, attains full bliss, / because in this state there is no cause of contraction, such as jealousy and malice. // 377

sanskrit_iast:
vikasvarā niṣpratighaṃ saṃvidānandayoginī /
atanmaye tu kasmiṃścittatrasthe pratihanyate // 378
meaning:
विकस्वरा निष्प्रतिघं संविदानन्दयोगिनी /
अतन्मये तु कस्मिंश्चित्तत्रस्थे प्रतिहन्यते // 378
text_mt: Consciousness expands unobstructed, united with bliss; / but it is hindered when someone who does not share that nature is present there, // 378

sanskrit_iast:
sthapuṭasparśavatsaṃvidvijātīyatayā sthite /
ataścakrārcanādyeṣu vijātīyamatanmayam // 379
meaning:
स्थपुटस्पर्शवत्संविद्विजातीयतया स्थिते /
अतश्चक्रार्चनाद्येषु विजातीयमतन्मयम् // 379
text_mt: just like the touch of an uneven surface, because [such a person] exists as of an alien kind. / Therefore, in the worship of the circle and the like, [the master] should by no means // 379

sanskrit_iast:
naiva praveśayetsaṃvitsaṅkocananibandhanam /
yāvantyeva śarīrāṇi svāṅgavatsyuḥ sunirbharām // 380
meaning:
नैव प्रवेशयेत्संवित्सङ्कोचननिबन्धनम् /
यावन्त्येव शरीराणि स्वाङ्गवत्स्युः सुनिर्भराम् // 380
text_mt: allow an alien person who does not share that nature to enter, as this causes the contraction of consciousness. / Only as many bodies as are like one's own limbs, firmly filled [with oneness], // 380

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃ saṃvidamāviśya cakre tāvanti pūjayet /
praviṣṭaścetpramādena saṅkocaṃ na vrajettataḥ // 381
meaning:
एकां संविदमाविश्य चक्रे तावन्ति पूजयेत् /
प्रविष्टश्चेत्प्रमादेन सङ्कोचं न व्रजेत्ततः // 381
text_mt: having entered into a single consciousness, should he worship in the circle. / If an [alien person] enters by negligence, he should not undergo contraction on that account; // 381

sanskrit_iast:
prastutaṃ svasamācāraṃ tena sākaṃ samācaret /
sa tvanugrahaśaktyā cedviddhastattanmayībhavet // 382
meaning:
प्रस्तुतं स्वसमाचारं तेन साकं समाचरेत् /
स त्वनुग्रहशक्त्या चेद्विद्धस्तत्तन्मयीभवेत् // 382
text_mt: he should perform his current ritual observance together with him. / If that person is pierced by the power of grace, he will become identified with it; // 382

sanskrit_iast:
vāmāviddhastu tannindetpaścāttaṃ ghātayedapi /
śrīmatpicumate coktamādau yatnena rakṣayet // 383
meaning:
वामाविद्धस्तु तन्निन्देत्पश्चात्तं घातयेदपि /
श्रीमत्पिचुमते चोक्तमादौ यत्नेन रक्षयेत् // 383
text_mt: but if pierced by the adverse power, he will revile it, and later [the goddess or master] would even cause him to be slain. / And it is stated in the venerable Picumata: 'At first he should guard against // 383

sanskrit_iast:
praveśaṃ saṃpaviṣṭasya na vicāraṃ tu kārayet /
lokācārasthito yastu praviṣṭe tādṛśe tu saḥ // 384
meaning:
प्रवेशं संपविष्टस्य न विचारं तु कारयेत् /
लोकाचारस्थितो यस्तु प्रविष्टे तादृशे तु सः // 384
text_mt: the entry [of outsiders] with effort, but he should not institute an investigation of one who has entered. / However, for one who adheres to worldly conduct, when such a one enters, // 384

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā taṃ samācāraṃ punaścakraṃ prapūjayet /
atha vacmi guroḥ śāstravyākhyākramamudāhṛtam // 385
meaning:
अकृत्वा तं समाचारं पुनश्चक्रं प्रपूजयेत् /
अथ वच्मि गुरोः शास्त्रव्याख्याक्रममुदाहृतम् // 385
text_mt: he should worship the circle again without performing that [secret] rite.' / Now I explain the method of the guru's exposition of the scriptures, as taught // 385

sanskrit_iast:
devyāyāmalaśāstrādau tuhinābhīśumaulinā /
kalpavittatsamūhajñaḥ śāstravitsaṃhitārthavit // 386
meaning:
देव्यायामलशास्त्रादौ तुहिनाभीशुमौलिना /
कल्पवित्तत्समूहज्ञः शास्त्रवित्संहितार्थवित् // 386
text_mt: in the Devyāyāmala and other scriptures by the Moon-crested Lord: / One who knows the rituals (kalpavid), one who knows their collection, one who knows the scripture, one who knows the meaning of the Saṃhitā, // 386

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaśāstrārthavicceti gururbhinno'padiśyate /
yo yatra śāstre svabhyastajñāno vyākhyāṃ carettu saḥ // 387
meaning:
सर्वशास्त्रार्थविच्चेति गुरुर्भिन्नोऽपदिश्यते /
यो यत्र शास्त्रे स्वभ्यस्तज्ञानो व्याख्यां चरेत्तु सः // 387
text_mt: and one who knows the meaning of all scriptures: thus the guru is taught to be manifold. / He who has well-practised knowledge in whichever scripture may deliver the exposition [of that scripture], // 387

sanskrit_iast:
nānyathā tadabhāvaścetsarvathā so'pyathācaret /
śrībhairavakule coktaṃ kalpādijñatvamīdṛśam // 388
meaning:
नान्यथा तदभावश्चेत्सर्वथा सोऽप्यथाचरेत् /
श्रीभैरवकुले चोक्तं कल्पादिज्ञत्वमीदृशम् // 388
text_mt: not otherwise; if there is a total lack of such [knowledgeable masters], even he may do so under any circumstance. / And such knowledge of the rituals and the rest is stated in the venerable Bhairavakula. // 388

sanskrit_iast:
gurorlakṣaṇametāvatsaṃpūrṇajñānataiva yā /
tatrāpi yāsya cidvṛttikarmibhit sāpyavāntarā // 389
meaning:
गुरोर्लक्षणमेतावत्संपूर्णज्ञानतैव या /
तत्रापि यास्य चिद्वृत्तिकर्मिभित् साप्यवान्तरा // 389
text_mt: This alone is the definition of a guru, which is complete knowledge itself; / even there, whatever [guru] divides the activities of the mental states of consciousness is secondary. // 389

sanskrit_iast:
devyāyāmala uktaṃ taddvāpañcāśāhva āhnike /
deva eva gurutvena tiṣṭhāsurdaśadhā bhavet // 390
meaning:
देव्यायामल उक्तं तद्द्वापञ्चाशाह्व आह्निके /
देव एव गुरुत्वेन तिष्ठासुर्दशधा भवेत् // 390
text_mt: In the Devyāyāmala, in the daily lesson called the fifty-second, it is stated: / The Lord himself, desiring to remain in the status of a guru, becomes tenfold: // 390

sanskrit_iast:
ucchuṣmaśavaracaṇḍagumataṅgaghorāntakograhalahalakāḥ /
krodhī huluhulurete daśa guravaḥ śivamayāḥ pūrve // 391
meaning:
उच्छुष्मशवरचण्डगुमतङ्गघोरान्तकोग्रहलहलकाः /
क्रोधी हुलुहुलुरेते दश गुरवः शिवमयाः पूर्वे // 391
text_mt: Ucchuṣma, Śavara, Caṇḍagu, Mataṅga, Ghorāntaka, Ugra, Halahalaka, / Krodhin, [and] Huluhulu—these are the ten ancient gurus consisting of Śiva. // 391

sanskrit_iast:
te svāṃśacittavṛttikrameṇa pauruṣaśarīramāsthāya /
anyonyabhinnasaṃvitkriyā api jñānaparipūrṇāḥ // 392
meaning:
ते स्वांशचित्तवृत्तिक्रमेण पौरुषशरीरमास्थाय /
अन्योन्यभिन्नसंवित्क्रिया अपि ज्ञानपरिपूर्णाः // 392
text_mt: Having assumed human bodies according to the sequence of the mental states of their own portions, / though differing from one another in their consciousness and actions, they are complete in knowledge. // 392

sanskrit_iast:
sarve'limāṃsanidhuvanadīkṣārcanaśāstrasevane niratāḥ /
abhimānaśamakrodhakṣamādiravāntaro bhedaḥ // 393
meaning:
सर्वेऽलिमांसनिधुवनदीक्षार्चनशास्त्रसेवने निरताः /
अभिमानशमक्रोधक्षमादिरवान्तरो भेदः // 393
text_mt: All are devoted to wine, meat, sexual union, initiation, worship, and the study of scripture; / their secondary differences consist of pride, tranquillity, anger, patience, and the like. // 393

sanskrit_iast:
itthaṃ vijñāya sadā śiṣyaḥ sampūrṇaśāstraboddhāram /
vyākhyāyai gurumabhyarthayeta pūjāpuraḥsaraṃ matimān // 394
meaning:
इत्थं विज्ञाय सदा शिष्यः सम्पूर्णशास्त्रबोद्धारम् /
व्याख्यायै गुरुमभ्यर्थयेत पूजापुरःसरं मतिमान् // 394
text_mt: Knowing thus, the intelligent disciple should always request the guru who knows the complete scripture, / preceded by worship, to deliver an exposition. // 394

sanskrit_iast:
so'pi svaśāsanīye paraśiṣye'pivāpi tādṛśaṃ śāstram /
śrotuṃ yogye kuryādvyākhyānaṃ vaiṣṇavādyadhare // 395
meaning:
सोऽपि स्वशासनीये परशिष्येऽपिवापि तादृशं शास्त्रम् /
श्रोतुं योग्ये कुर्याद्व्याख्यानं वैष्णवाद्यधरे // 395
text_mt: He too should deliver an exposition to his own pupil, or even to the pupil of another, who is qualified / to hear such a scripture, [even] to an inferior such as a Vaiṣṇava. // 395

sanskrit_iast:
karuṇārasaparipūrṇo guruḥ punarmarmadhāmaparivarjam /
adhame'pi hi vyākuryātsambhāvya hi śaktipātavaicitryam // 396
meaning:
करुणारसपरिपूर्णो गुरुः पुनर्मर्मधामपरिवर्जम् /
अधमेऽपि हि व्याकुर्यात्सम्भाव्य हि शक्तिपातवैचित्र्यम् // 396
text_mt: Furthermore, the guru filled with the nectar of compassion should deliver an exposition even to a base person, / omitting the secret parts, considering the diversity of the descent of power. // 396

sanskrit_iast:
liptāyāṃ bhuvi pīṭhe caturasre paṅkajatrayaṃ kajage /
kuryādvidyāpīṭhaṃ syādrasavahnyaṅgulaṃ tvetat // 397
meaning:
लिप्तायां भुवि पीठे चतुरस्रे पङ्कजत्रयं कजगे /
कुर्याद्विद्यापीठं स्याद्रसवह्न्यङ्गुलं त्वेतत् // 397
text_mt: On smeared ground, on a square altar, on an eight-petaled lotus, / he should make three lotuses; this seat of knowledge should be thirty-six finger-widths. // 397

sanskrit_iast:
madhye vāgīśānīṃ dakṣottarayorgurūngaṇeśaṃ ca /
adhare kaje ca kalpeśvaraṃ prapūjyārghapuṣpatarpaṇakaiḥ // 398
meaning:
मध्ये वागीशानीं दक्षोत्तरयोर्गुरून्गणेशं च /
अधरे कजे च कल्पेश्वरं प्रपूज्यार्घपुष्पतर्पणकैः // 398
text_mt: Having worshipped Vāgīśānī in the center, the gurus on the right and left, and Gaṇeśa, / and the Lord of Rituals (Kalpeśvara) on the lower lotus, with offerings of water, flowers, and libations, // 398

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyavidhiniyuktārghapātrayogena cakramatha samyak /
santarpya vyākhyānaṃ kuryātsambandhapūrvakaṃ matimān // 399
meaning:
सामान्यविधिनियुक्तार्घपात्रयोगेन चक्रमथ सम्यक् /
सन्तर्प्य व्याख्यानं कुर्यात्सम्बन्धपूर्वकं मतिमान् // 399
text_mt: and then having properly gratified the circle by means of the general offering-vessel prescribed by rule, / the intelligent one should deliver an exposition preceded by the connection [of the text]. // 399

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrapadavākyapaṭalagranthakramayojanena sambandhāt /
avyāhatapūrvāparamupavṛhya nayeta vākyāni // 400
meaning:
सूत्रपदवाक्यपटलग्रन्थक्रमयोजनेन सम्बन्धात् /
अव्याहतपूर्वापरमुपवृह्य नयेत वाक्यानि // 400
text_mt: By arranging the sequence of aphorisms, words, sentences, chapters, and the treatise through contextual connection, / he should elucidate the statements by strengthening them so that earlier and later parts are uncontradicted. // 400

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍūkaplavasiṃhāvalokanādyairyathāyathaṃ nyāyaiḥ /
avihatapūrvāparakaṃ śāstrārthaṃ yojayedasaṅkīrṇam // 401
meaning:
मण्डूकप्लवसिंहावलोकनाद्यैर्यथायथं न्यायैः /
अविहतपूर्वापरकं शास्त्रार्थं योजयेदसङ्कीर्णम् // 401
text_mt: Applying principles appropriately, such as the frog's leap and the lion's backward glance, / he should articulate the unconfused meaning of the scripture so that earlier and later parts are consistent. // 401

sanskrit_iast:
tantrāvartanabādhaprasaṅgatarkādibhiśca sannyāyaiḥ /
vastu vadedvākyajño vastvantarato viviktatāṃ vidadhat // 402
meaning:
तन्त्रावर्तनबाधप्रसङ्गतर्कादिभिश्च सन्न्यायैः /
वस्तु वदेद्वाक्यज्ञो वस्त्वन्तरतो विविक्ततां विदधत् // 402
text_mt: And by sound logical methods such as repeated application, invalidation, context, and reasoning, / he who knows language should explain the real entity, distinguishing it from other entities. // 402

sanskrit_iast:
yadyadvyāhṛtipadavīmāyāti tadeva dṛḍhatarairnyāyaiḥ /
balavatkuryāddūṣyaṃ yadyapyagre bhaviṣyatsyāt // 403
meaning:
यद्यद्व्याहृतिपदवीमायाति तदेव दृढतरैर्न्यायैः /
बलवत्कुर्याद्दूष्यं यद्यप्यग्रे भविष्यत्स्यात् // 403
text_mt: Whatever enters the path of exposition, he should render strong with firmer arguments, / even if it will later become an object of refutation. // 403

sanskrit_iast:
dṛḍharacitapūrvapakṣaproddharaṇapathena vastu yadvācyam /
śiṣyamatāvārohati tadāśu saṃśayaviparyayairvikalam // 404
meaning:
दृढरचितपूर्वपक्षप्रोद्धरणपथेन वस्तु यद्वाच्यम् /
शिष्यमतावारोहति तदाशु संशयविपर्ययैर्विकलम् // 404
text_mt: When an entity to be spoken of ascends to the disciple's intellect along the path of refuting firmly constructed objections, / it promptly enters [the intellect] free from doubts and errors. // 404

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṣā nyāyo vādo layaḥ kramo yadyadeti śiṣyasya /
sambodhopāyatvaṃ tathaiva gururāśrayedvyākhyām // 405
meaning:
भाषा न्यायो वादो लयः क्रमो यद्यदेति शिष्यस्य /
सम्बोधोपायत्वं तथैव गुरुराश्रयेद्व्याख्याम् // 405
text_mt: Language, logic, debate, absorption, or sequence—whatever serves as / the means of comprehension for the disciple, in that very manner the guru should adopt the exposition. // 405

sanskrit_iast:
vācyaṃ vastu samāpya pratarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ bhaveccakre /
punaraparaṃ vastu vadetpaṭalādūrdhvaṃ tu no jalpet // 406
meaning:
वाच्यं वस्तु समाप्य प्रतर्पणं पूजनं भवेच्चक्रे /
पुनरपरं वस्तु वदेत्पटलादूर्ध्वं तु नो जल्पेत् // 406
text_mt: Having concluded the subject matter, there should be libation and worship in the circle; / he may speak on another subject, but he should not discourse beyond the chapter. // 406

sanskrit_iast:
vyākhyānte kṣamayitvā visṛjya sarvaṃ kṣipedagādhajale /
śāstrādimadhyanidhane viśeṣataḥ pūjanaṃ kuryāt // 407
meaning:
व्याख्यान्ते क्षमयित्वा विसृज्य सर्वं क्षिपेदगाधजले /
शास्त्रादिमध्यनिधने विशेषतः पूजनं कुर्यात् // 407
text_mt: At the conclusion of the exposition, having begged forgiveness and dismissed [the deities], he should throw everything into deep water. / He should perform special worship at the beginning, middle, and end of the scripture. // 407

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣapūjanaṃ kuryātsamayebhyaśca niṣkṛtau /
avikalpamaterna syuḥ prāyaścittāni yadyapi // 408
meaning:
विशेषपूजनं कुर्यात्समयेभ्यश्च निष्कृतौ /
अविकल्पमतेर्न स्युः प्रायश्चित्तानि यद्यपि // 408
text_mt: He should also perform special worship as an expiation for [breaches of] vows. / Although there are no expiations for one whose mind is free of conceptual constructs, // 408

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpyatattvavidvargānugrahāya tathā caret /
śrīpicau ca smṛtereva pāpaghnatve kathaṃ vibho // 409
meaning:
तथाप्यतत्त्वविद्वर्गानुग्रहाय तथा चरेत् /
श्रीपिचौ च स्मृतेरेव पापघ्नत्वे कथं विभो // 409
text_mt: nevertheless he should act thus to extend grace to the class of those who do not know reality. / And in the venerable Picu, [it is asked]: 'Since remembrance alone destroys sin, how, O Lord, // 409

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittavidhiḥ prokta iti devyā pracodite /
satyaṃ smaraṇameveha sakṛjjaptaṃ vimocayet // 410
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तविधिः प्रोक्त इति देव्या प्रचोदिते /
सत्यं स्मरणमेवेह सकृज्जप्तं विमोचयेत् // 410
text_mt: has a rule of expiation been proclaimed?' When thus questioned by the Goddess, [the Lord said]: / 'True, remembrance alone, recited once in this world, frees // 410

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasmātkarmaṇo jālātsmṛtitattvakalāvidaḥ /
tathāpi sthitirakṣārthaṃ kartavyaścodito vidhiḥ // 411
meaning:
सर्वस्मात्कर्मणो जालात्स्मृतितत्त्वकलाविदः /
तथापि स्थितिरक्षार्थं कर्तव्यश्चोदितो विधिः // 411
text_mt: from the entire web of action for one who knows the principles of the truth of remembrance. / Nevertheless, for the sake of preserving order, the prescribed rule must be observed. // 411

sanskrit_iast:
atattvavedino ye hi caryāmātraikaniṣṭhitāḥ /
teṣāṃ dolāyite citte jñānahāniḥ prajāyate // 412
meaning:
अतत्त्ववेदिनो ये हि चर्यामात्रैकनिष्ठिताः /
तेषां दोलायिते चित्ते ज्ञानहानिः प्रजायते // 412
text_mt: For those who do not know reality and are devoted solely to external practice, / when their mind wavers, loss of knowledge occurs. // 412

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādvikalparahitaḥ saṃvṛtyuparato yadi /
śāstracaryāsadāyattaiḥ saṅkaraṃ tadvivarjayet // 413
meaning:
तस्माद्विकल्परहितः संवृत्युपरतो यदि /
शास्त्रचर्यासदायत्तैः सङ्करं तद्विवर्जयेत् // 413
text_mt: Therefore, if one who is free from conceptual constructs has ceased from conventional behavior, / he should avoid mingling with those who are constantly devoted to scriptural ritual. // 413

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkaraṃ vā samanvicchetprāyaścittaṃ samācaret /
yathā teṣāṃ na śāstrārthe dolārūḍhā matirbhavet // 414
meaning:
सङ्करं वा समन्विच्छेत्प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् /
यथा तेषां न शास्त्रार्थे दोलारूढा मतिर्भवेत् // 414
text_mt: Or, if he desires to mingle, he should perform expiation / so that their minds do not waver regarding the meaning of the scripture.' // 414

sanskrit_iast:
yatsvayaṃ śivahastākhye vidhau saṃcoditaṃ purā /
śataṃ japtvāsya cāstrasya mucyate strīvadhādṛte // 415
meaning:
यत्स्वयं शिवहस्ताख्ये विधौ संचोदितं पुरा /
शतं जप्त्वास्य चास्त्रस्य मुच्यते स्त्रीवधादृते // 415
text_mt: As was personally enjoined earlier in the rite known as the hand of Śiva: / 'Having recited this weapon-mantra a hundred times, one is freed [from sin], except for the murder of a woman. // 415

sanskrit_iast:
śaktināśānmahādoṣo narakaṃ śāśvataṃ priye /
iti śrīratnamālāyāṃ samayollaṅghane kṛte // 416
meaning:
शक्तिनाशान्महादोषो नरकं शाश्वतं प्रिये /
इति श्रीरत्नमालायां समयोल्लङ्घने कृते // 416
text_mt: From the destruction of a female power comes a grave fault, eternal hell, O beloved.' / Thus, in the venerable Ratnamālā, when a transgression of vows has been committed, // 416

sanskrit_iast:
kulajānāṃ samākhyātā niṣkṛtirduṣṭakartarī /
śrīpūrve samayānāṃ tu śodhanāyoditaṃ yathā // 417
meaning:
कुलजानां समाख्याता निष्कृतिर्दुष्टकर्तरी /
श्रीपूर्वे समयानां तु शोधनायोदितं यथा // 417
text_mt: the expiation named 'the destructive pair of scissors' is declared for members of the Kula. / As is stated in the venerable Pūrva for the purification of vows: // 417

sanskrit_iast:
mālinī mātṛkā vāpi japyā lakṣatrayāntakam /
pratiṣṭhitasya pūrāderdarśane'nadhikāriṇā // 418
meaning:
मालिनी मातृका वापि जप्या लक्षत्रयान्तकम् /
प्रतिष्ठितस्य पूरादेर्दर्शनेऽनधिकारिणा // 418
text_mt: Either the Mālinī or the Mātṛkā should be recited up to three hundred thousand times. / When an established city or [sanctuary] is seen by an unqualified person, // 418

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ prakartavyamiti śrībrahmayāmale /
brahmaghno gurutalpastho vīradravyaharastathā // 419
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकर्तव्यमिति श्रीब्रह्मयामले /
ब्रह्मघ्नो गुरुतल्पस्थो वीरद्रव्यहरस्तथा // 419
text_mt: expiation must be performed. Thus, in the venerable Brahmayāmala: / One who slays a brāhmaṇa, one who violates the guru's bed, likewise one who steals an initiate hero's property, // 419

sanskrit_iast:
devadravyahṛdākāraprahartā liṅgabhedakaḥ /
nityādilopakṛdbhraṣṭasvakamātrāparicchadaḥ // 420
meaning:
देवद्रव्यहृदाकारप्रहर्ता लिङ्गभेदकः /
नित्यादिलोपकृद्भ्रष्टस्वकमात्रापरिच्छदः // 420
text_mt: one who steals the property of the deity, an assailant, a destroyer of the liṅga, / one who causes the omission of daily rites and the rest, one who has abandoned one's own standard equipment— // 420

sanskrit_iast:
śaktivyaṅgatvakṛdyogijñānihantā vilopakaḥ /
naimittikānāṃ lakṣādikramāddvidviguṇaṃ japet // 421
meaning:
शक्तिव्यङ्गत्वकृद्योगिज्ञानिहन्ता विलोपकः /
नैमित्तिकानां लक्षादिक्रमाद्द्विद्विगुणं जपेत् // 421
text_mt:
One who mutilates women, slays a yogin or a knower [of reality], or omits
occasional rites, should recite [the mantra] double [the standard number], beginning with one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
vratena kenacidyukto mitabhugbrahmacaryavān /
dūtīparigrahe'nyatra gataścetkāmamohitaḥ // 422
meaning:
व्रतेन केनचिद्युक्तो मितभुग्ब्रह्मचर्यवान् /
दूतीपरिग्रहेऽन्यत्र गतश्चेत्काममोहितः // 422
text_mt:
Undertaking some vow, eating moderately, and observing celibacy,
if, deluded by desire, he goes elsewhere in the acceptance of a female partner (dūtī),

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣajāpaṃ tataḥ kuryādityuktaṃ brahmayāmale /
dīkṣābhiṣekanaimittavidhyante gurupūjanam // 423
meaning:
लक्षजापं ततः कुर्यादित्युक्तं ब्रह्मयामले /
दीक्षाभिषेकनैमित्तविध्यन्ते गुरुपूजनम् // 423
text_mt:
he should then perform one hundred thousand recitations—so it is stated in the Brahmayāmala.
At the conclusion of the rules for initiation, consecration, and occasional rites, worship of the guru

sanskrit_iast:
aparedyuḥ sadā kāryaṃ siddhayogīśvarīmate /
pūrvoktalakṣaṇopetaḥ kavistrikasatattvavit // 424
meaning:
अपरेद्युः सदा कार्यं सिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते /
पूर्वोक्तलक्षणोपेतः कविस्त्रिकसतत्त्ववित् // 424
text_mt:
must always be performed on the following day, according to the doctrine of the Siddhayogīśvarī.
Endowed with the aforementioned characteristics, an inspired sage knowing the true reality of the Trika,

sanskrit_iast:
sa guruḥ sarvadā grāhyastyaktvānyaṃ tatsthitaṃ tvapi /
maṇḍale svastikaṃ kṛtvā tatra haimādikāsanam // 425
meaning:
स गुरुः सर्वदा ग्राह्यस्त्यक्त्वान्यं तत्स्थितं त्वपि /
मण्डले स्वस्तिकं कृत्वा तत्र हैमादिकासनम् // 425
text_mt:
he is the guru who should always be accepted, abandoning another even if already settled in that office.
Having drawn a svastika in the mandala, having made there a seat of gold or other materials,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvārcayeta tatrasthamadhvānaṃ sakalāntakam /
tato vijñapayedbhaktyā tadadhiṣṭhitaye gurum // 426
meaning:
कृत्वार्चयेत तत्रस्थमध्वानं सकलान्तकम् /
ततो विज्ञपयेद्भक्त्या तदधिष्ठितये गुरुम् // 426
text_mt:
he should worship the path extending up to the Sakala that resides there.
Then, with devotion, he should pray to the guru to preside over it.

sanskrit_iast:
sa tatra pūjyaḥ svairmantraiḥ puṣpadhūpārghavistaraiḥ /
samālambhanasadvastrairnaivedyaistarpaṇaiḥ kramāt // 427
meaning:
स तत्र पूज्यः स्वैर्मन्त्रैः पुष्पधूपार्घविस्तरैः /
समालम्भनसद्वस्त्रैर्नैवेद्यैस्तर्पणैः क्रमात् // 427
text_mt:
There he is to be worshipped with his own mantras, with abundant flowers, incense, and oblations,
with unguents, fine garments, food offerings, and libations in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
āśāntaṃ pūjayitvainaṃ dakṣiṇābhiryajecchiśuḥ /
sarvasvamasmai saṃdadyādātmānamapi bhāvitaḥ // 428
meaning:
आशान्तं पूजयित्वैनं दक्षिणाभिर्यजेच्छिशुः /
सर्वस्वमस्मै संदद्यादात्मानमपि भावितः // 428
text_mt:
Having worshipped him to his satisfaction, the spiritual child should honor him with sacrificial fees (dakṣiṇā);
filled with devotion, he should surrender all his possessions and even himself to him.

sanskrit_iast:
atoṣayitvā tu guruṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ samantataḥ /
tattvajño'pyṛṇabandhena tena yātyadhikāritām // 429
meaning:
अतोषयित्वा तु गुरुं दक्षिणाभिः समन्ततः /
तत्त्वज्ञोऽप्यृणबन्धेन तेन यात्यधिकारिताम् // 429
text_mt:
For without pleasing the guru completely with sacrificial gifts,
even a knower of reality incurs disqualification through the bondage of that debt.

sanskrit_iast:
gurupūjāmakurvāṇaḥ śataṃ janmāni jāyate /
adhikārī tato muktiṃ yātīti skandayāmale // 430
meaning:
गुरुपूजामकुर्वाणः शतं जन्मानि जायते /
अधिकारी ततो मुक्तिं यातीति स्कन्दयामले // 430
text_mt:
Failing to perform the worship of the guru, he is born for a hundred lifetimes
as an adhikārin [bound by worldly office], and only then attains liberation—so it is said in the Skandayāmala.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādavaśyaṃ dātavyā gurave dakṣiṇā punaḥ /
pūrvaṃ hi yāgāṅgatayā proktaṃ tattuṣṭaye tvidam // 431
meaning:
तस्मादवश्यं दातव्या गुरवे दक्षिणा पुनः /
पूर्वं हि यागाङ्गतया प्रोक्तं तत्तुष्टये त्विदम् // 431
text_mt:
Therefore, a sacrificial fee must by all means be given to the guru again;
for earlier it was enjoined as an ancillary of the sacrifice, but this is for his personal satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
tajjuṣṭamatha tasyājñāṃ prāpyāśnīyātsvayaṃ śiśuḥ /
tataḥ prapūjayeccakraṃ yathāvibhavasambhavam // 432
meaning:
तज्जुष्टमथ तस्याज्ञां प्राप्याश्नीयात्स्वयं शिशुः /
ततः प्रपूजयेच्चक्रं यथाविभवसम्भवम् // 432
text_mt:
Then, having received his permission, the spiritual child himself should consume his leftovers;
thereafter he should worship the circle according to the extent of his means.

sanskrit_iast:
akṛtvā guruyāgaṃ tu kṛtamapyakṛtaṃ yataḥ /
tasmātprayatnataḥ kāryo guruyāgo yathābalam // 433
meaning:
अकृत्वा गुरुयागं तु कृतमप्यकृतं यतः /
तस्मात्प्रयत्नतः कार्यो गुरुयागो यथाबलम् // 433
text_mt:
Since without performing the worship of the guru, even what has been done is as good as undone,
therefore the worship of the guru must be performed with effort, according to one's capacity.

sanskrit_iast:
atatrastho'pi hi guruḥ pūjyaḥ saṃkalpya pūrvavat /
taddravyaṃ devatākṛtye kuryādbhaktajaneṣvatha // 434
parvapavitraprabhṛtiprabhedi naimittikaṃ tvidaṃ karma /
meaning:
अतत्रस्थोऽपि हि गुरुः पूज्यः संकल्प्य पूर्ववत् /
तद्द्रव्यं देवताकृत्ये कुर्याद्भक्तजनेष्वथ // 434
पर्वपवित्रप्रभृतिप्रभेदि नैमित्तिकं त्विदं कर्म /

sanskrit_iast:
atha samucitādhikāriṇa uddiśya rahasya ucyate'tra vidhiḥ /
atha sarvāpyupāseyaṃ kulaprakriyayocyate // 1
meaning:
अथ समुचिताधिकारिण उद्दिश्य रहस्य उच्यतेऽत्र विधिः /
अथ सर्वाप्युपासेयं कुलप्रक्रिययोच्यते // 1
text_mt:
Now the secret ritual is expounded here for the appropriate qualified candidate.
Here all this worship is stated according to the Kaula method (kulaprakriyā),
title: Rahasyavidhiprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
tathā dhārādhirūḍheṣu guruśiṣyeṣu yocitā /
uktaṃ ca parameśena sāratvaṃ kramapūjane // 2
meaning:
तथा धाराधिरूढेषु गुरुशिष्येषु योचिता /
उक्तं च परमेशेन सारत्वं क्रमपूजने // 2
text_mt:
and it is appropriate for gurus and disciples who have ascended the stream [of tradition].
And the Supreme Lord has stated the essential nature of the worship of succession (kramapūjana):

sanskrit_iast:
siddhakramaniyuktasya māsenaikena yadbhavet /
na tadvarṣasahasraiḥ syānmantraughairvividhairiti // 3
meaning:
सिद्धक्रमनियुक्तस्य मासेनैकेन यद्भवेत् /
न तद्वर्षसहस्रैः स्यान्मन्त्रौघैर्विविधैरिति // 3
text_mt:
"What is attained in a single month by one dedicated to the perfected sequence (siddhakrama),
would not come about in thousands of years through diverse multitudes of mantras."

sanskrit_iast:
kulaṃ ca parameśasya śaktiḥ sāmarthyamūrdhvatā /
svātantryamojo vīryaṃ ca piṇḍaḥ saṃviccharīrakam // 4
meaning:
कुलं च परमेशस्य शक्तिः सामर्थ्यमूर्ध्वता /
स्वातन्त्र्यमोजो वीर्यं च पिण्डः संविच्छरीरकम् // 4
text_mt:
Kula is the power of the Supreme Lord, his efficacy, transcendence,
absolute autonomy, vigor, virility, the collective mass, consciousness, and the body.

sanskrit_iast:
tathātvena samastāni bhāvajātāni paśyataḥ /
dhvastaśaṅkāsamūhasya yāgastādṛśa eva saḥ // 5
meaning:
तथात्वेन समस्तानि भावजातानि पश्यतः /
ध्वस्तशङ्कासमूहस्य यागस्तादृश एव सः // 5
text_mt:
For one who sees all classes of entities as such,
and whose mass of doubts has been destroyed, sacrifice is of just that nature.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛgrūpanirūḍhyarthaṃ manovākkāyavartmanā /
yadyatsamācaredvīraḥ kulayāgaḥ sa sa smṛtaḥ // 6
meaning:
तादृग्रूपनिरूढ्यर्थं मनोवाक्कायवर्त्मना /
यद्यत्समाचरेद्वीरः कुलयागः स स स्मृतः // 6
text_mt:
For the firm establishment of such a state, whatever the hero (vīra)
undertakes by way of mind, speech, and body—that is remembered as the Kula sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
bahiḥ śaktau yāmale ca dehe prāṇapathe matau /
iti ṣoḍhā kulejyā syātpratibhedaṃ vibhedinī // 7
meaning:
बहिः शक्तौ यामले च देहे प्राणपथे मतौ /
इति षोढा कुलेज्या स्यात्प्रतिभेदं विभेदिनी // 7
text_mt:
Externally, in the śakti, in the dyad, in the body, in the vital path, and in the intellect:
thus the worship of Kula is sixfold, diversifying in each specific division.

sanskrit_iast:
snānamaṇḍalakuṇḍādi ṣoḍhānyāsādi yanna tat /
kiñcidatropayujyeta kṛtaṃ vā khaṇḍanāya no // 8
meaning:
स्नानमण्डलकुण्डादि षोढान्यासादि यन्न तत् /
किञ्चिदत्रोपयुज्येत कृतं वा खण्डनाय नो // 8
text_mt:
Bathing, the mandala, the hearth, and so forth, or the sixfold nyāsa and the like—what is not [required] there
is of no use here; or if performed, it causes no defect.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmaṇḍalavinirmuktaṃ sarvāvaraṇavarjitam /
jñānajñeyamayaṃ kaulaṃ proktaṃ traiśirase mate // 9
meaning:
षण्मण्डलविनिर्मुक्तं सर्वावरणवर्जितम् /
ज्ञानज्ञेयमयं कौलं प्रोक्तं त्रैशिरसे मते // 9
text_mt:
"Free from the six mandalas, devoid of all coverings,
consisting of knowledge and the object of knowledge, the Kaula [rite] is declared in the doctrine of the Traiśirasa."

sanskrit_iast:
atra yāge ca yaddravyaṃ niṣiddhaṃ śāstrasantatau /
tadeva yojayeddhīmānvāmāmṛtapariplutam // 10
meaning:
अत्र यागे च यद्द्रव्यं निषिद्धं शास्त्रसन्ततौ /
तदेव योजयेद्धीमान्वामामृतपरिप्लुतम् // 10
text_mt:
And in this sacrifice, whatever substance is prohibited in the lineage of scriptures,
the wise one should employ precisely that, overflowed with the nectar of the Left.

sanskrit_iast:
śrībrahmayāmale'pyuktaṃ surā śivaraso bahiḥ /
tāṃ vinā bhuktimuktī no piṣṭakṣaudraguḍaistu sā // 11
meaning:
श्रीब्रह्मयामलेऽप्युक्तं सुरा शिवरसो बहिः /
तां विना भुक्तिमुक्ती नो पिष्टक्षौद्रगुडैस्तु सा // 11
text_mt:
It is also said in the venerable Brahmayāmala: "Wine is externally the fluid of Śiva;
without it there is neither enjoyment nor liberation; and it is [made] from flour, honey, or molasses.

sanskrit_iast:
strīnapuṃsakapuṃrūpā tu pūrvāparabhogadā /
drākṣotthaṃ tu paraṃ tejo bhairavaṃ kalpanojjhitam // 12
meaning:
स्त्रीनपुंसकपुंरूपा तु पूर्वापरभोगदा /
द्राक्षोत्थं तु परं तेजो भैरवं कल्पनोज्झितम् // 12
text_mt:
Embodying female, neuter, and male forms, it yields previous and subsequent enjoyment;
that arisen from grapes, however, is supreme splendor, Bhairava-like, devoid of conceptual constructs.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsvayaṃ rasaḥ śuddhaḥ prakāśānandacinmayaḥ /
devatānāṃ priyaṃ nityaṃ tasmādetatpivetsadā // 13
meaning:
एतत्स्वयं रसः शुद्धः प्रकाशानन्दचिन्मयः /
देवतानां प्रियं नित्यं तस्मादेतत्पिवेत्सदा // 13
text_mt:
This itself is pure savor, consisting of luminosity, bliss, and consciousness,
always beloved to the deities; therefore, one should always drink it."

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatkramarahasye ca nyarūpi parameśinā /
arghapātraṃ yāgadhāma dīpa ityucyate trayam // 14
meaning:
श्रीमत्क्रमरहस्ये च न्यरूपि परमेशिना /
अर्घपात्रं यागधाम दीप इत्युच्यते त्रयम् // 14
text_mt:
And in the venerable Kramarahasya, the Supreme Lord determined:
"The vessel for the offering (arghapātra), the site of sacrifice, and the lamp—this triad is declared

sanskrit_iast:
rahasyaṃ kaulike yāge tatrārghaḥ śaktisaṃgamāt /
bhūvastrakāyapīṭhākhyaṃ dhāma cotkarṣabhāk kramāt // 15
meaning:
रहस्यं कौलिके यागे तत्रार्घः शक्तिसंगमात् /
भूवस्त्रकायपीठाख्यं धाम चोत्कर्षभाक् क्रमात् // 15
text_mt:
to be the secret in the Kaula sacrifice. There, the offering [is superior] through union with the śakti;
and the site, termed the ground, cloth, body, and seat, increases in excellence in successive order.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpā ghṛtotthā gāvo hi bhūcaryo devatāḥ smṛtāḥ /
iti jñātvā traye'muṣminyatnavānkauliko bhavet // 16
meaning:
दीपा घृतोत्था गावो हि भूचर्यो देवताः स्मृताः /
इति ज्ञात्वा त्रयेऽमुष्मिन्यत्नवान्कौलिको भवेत् // 16
text_mt:
Lamps arisen from ghee are cows, for they are remembered as the terrestrial deities (bhūcarī)."
Knowing this, the Kaula should make effort regarding this triad.

sanskrit_iast:
tenārghapātraprādhānyaṃ jñātvā dravyāṇi śambhunā /
yānyuktānyaviśaṅko'tra bhavecchaṅkā hi dūṣikā // 17
meaning:
तेनार्घपात्रप्राधान्यं ज्ञात्वा द्रव्याणि शम्भुना /
यान्युक्तान्यविशङ्कोऽत्र भवेच्छङ्का हि दूषिका // 17
text_mt:
Therefore, recognizing the preeminence of the argha vessel, regarding whatever substances
have been spoken of here by Śambhu, one should be free of hesitation, for doubt is defiling.

sanskrit_iast:
yāgauko gandhadhūpāḍhyaṃ praviśya prāgudaṅmukhaḥ /
parayā vā'tha mālinyā vilomāccānulomataḥ // 18
meaning:
यागौको गन्धधूपाढ्यं प्रविश्य प्रागुदङ्मुखः /
परया वाऽथ मालिन्या विलोमाच्चानुलोमतः // 18
text_mt:
Having entered the sacrificial chamber filled with fragrance and incense, facing east or north,
either with the Parā or with Mālinī, in reverse and direct order,

sanskrit_iast:
dāhāpyāyamayīṃ śuddhiṃ dīptasaumyavibhedataḥ /
krameṇa kuryādathavā mātṛsadbhāvamantrataḥ // 19
meaning:
दाहाप्यायमयीं शुद्धिं दीप्तसौम्यविभेदतः /
क्रमेण कुर्यादथवा मातृसद्भावमन्त्रतः // 19
text_mt:
he should progressively perform the purification consisting of combustion and replenishment, differentiated into radiant and placid,
or else through the mantra of Mātṛsadbhāva.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāṃ cetpracikīrṣustacchodhyādhvanyāsakalpanam /
tataḥ saṃśodhyavastūni śaktyaivāmṛtatāṃ nayet // 20
meaning:
दीक्षां चेत्प्रचिकीर्षुस्तच्छोध्याध्वन्यासकल्पनम् /
ततः संशोध्यवस्तूनि शक्त्यैवामृततां नयेत् // 20
text_mt:
If he wishes to perform initiation, [there is] the layout of the nyāsa of the path to be purified;
then he should bring the substances to be purified to the state of nectar through power alone.

sanskrit_iast:
parāsampuṭagā yadvā mātṛsampuṭagāpyatho /
kevalā mālinī yadvā tāḥ samasteṣu karmasu // 21
meaning:
परासम्पुटगा यद्वा मातृसम्पुटगाप्यथो /
केवला मालिनी यद्वा ताः समस्तेषु कर्मसु // 21
text_mt:
Either encased by Parā, or encased by Mātṛkā, or else
Mālinī alone: these [mantras are used] in all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
nandahetuphalairdravyairarghapātraṃ prapūrayet /
tatroktamantratādātmyādbhairavātmatvamānayet // 22
meaning:
नन्दहेतुफलैर्द्रव्यैरर्घपात्रं प्रपूरयेत् /
तत्रोक्तमन्त्रतादात्म्याद्भैरवात्मत्वमानयेत् // 22
text_mt:
One should fill the argha vessel with substances that are the causes and fruits of delight;
and through identity with the mantra taught therein, one should bring it to the nature of Bhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
tena nirbharamātmānaṃ bahiścakrānucakragam /
vipruḍbhirūrdhvādharayorantaḥ pītyā ca tarpayet // 23
meaning:
तेन निर्भरमात्मानं बहिश्चक्रानुचक्रगम् /
विप्रुड्भिरूर्ध्वाधरयोरन्तः पीत्या च तर्पयेत् // 23
text_mt:
With that, one should satisfy oneself completely, residing in the outer wheel and secondary wheels,
with drops above and below, and internally through drinking.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā pūrṇasvaraśmyoghaḥ procchaladvṛttitāvaśāt /
bahistādṛśamātmānaṃ didṛkṣurbahirarcayet // 24
meaning:
तथा पूर्णस्वरश्म्योघः प्रोच्छलद्वृत्तितावशात् /
बहिस्तादृशमात्मानं दिदृक्षुर्बहिरर्चयेत् // 24
text_mt:
Thus, the multitude of rays having become full, through the power of an surging disposition,
desirous of seeing oneself as such externally, he should worship externally.

sanskrit_iast:
arkāṅgule'tha taddvitriguṇe raktapaṭe śubhe /
vyomni sindūrasubhage rājavarttabhṛte'thavā // 25
meaning:
अर्काङ्गुलेऽथ तद्द्वित्रिगुणे रक्तपटे शुभे /
व्योम्नि सिन्दूरसुभगे राजवर्त्तभृतेऽथवा // 25
text_mt:
On an auspicious red cloth measuring twelve finger-breadths, or double or triple that,
or in space, adorned with vermilion, or coated with lapis lazuli,

sanskrit_iast:
nārikelātmake kādye madyapūrṇe'tha bhājane /
yadvā samudite rūpe maṇḍalasthe ca tadṛśi // 26
meaning:
नारिकेलात्मके काद्ये मद्यपूर्णेऽथ भाजने /
यद्वा समुदिते रूपे मण्डलस्थे च तदृशि // 26
text_mt:
or in a skull-vessel made of coconut, filled with wine,
or when [the deity's] form has arisen and is present in such a mandala,

sanskrit_iast:
yāgaṃ kurvīta matimāṃstatrāyaṃ krama ucyate /
diśyudīcyāṃ rudrakoṇādvāyavyantaṃ gaṇeśvaram // 27
meaning:
यागं कुर्वीत मतिमांस्तत्रायं क्रम उच्यते /
दिश्युदीच्यां रुद्रकोणाद्वायव्यन्तं गणेश्वरम् // 27
text_mt:
the wise one should perform the sacrifice. There, this procedure is stated:
in the northern direction, from the Rudra corner up to the Vāyu corner, [he should worship] the Lord of Gaṇas,

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭukaṃ trīn gurūnsiddhānyoginīḥ pīṭhamarcayet /
prācyāṃ diśi gaṇeśādha ārabhyābhyarcayettataḥ // 28
meaning:
वटुकं त्रीन् गुरून्सिद्धान्योगिनीः पीठमर्चयेत् /
प्राच्यां दिशि गणेशाध आरभ्याभ्यर्चयेत्ततः // 28
text_mt:
Vaṭuka, the three gurus, the Siddhas, the Yoginīs, and the sacred seat (pīṭha).
Then, in the eastern direction, starting below Gaṇeśa, he should worship

sanskrit_iast:
siddhacakraṃ dikcatuṣke gaṇeśādhastanāntakam /
khagendraḥ sahavijjāmba illā+ī+ambayā saha // 29
meaning:
सिद्धचक्रं दिक्चतुष्के गणेशाधस्तनान्तकम् /
खगेन्द्रः सहविज्जाम्ब इल्ला+ई+अम्बया सह // 29
text_mt:
the circle of Siddhas across the four directions, ending below Gaṇeśa:
Khagendra together with Vijjāmbā, and [Vakranātha] together with Illāī Ambā;

sanskrit_iast:
vaktaṣṭirvimalo'nantamekhalāmbāyutaḥ purā /
śaktyā maṅgalayā kūrma illā+ī+ambayā saha // 30
meaning:
वक्तष्टिर्विमलोऽनन्तमेखलाम्बायुतः पुरा /
शक्त्या मङ्गलया कूर्म इल्ला+ई+अम्बया सह // 30
text_mt: Vaktaṣṭi, Vimala united with Anantamekhalāmbā in the east; / with the power Maṅgalā, Kūrma together with Illāī Ambā; // 30

sanskrit_iast:
jaitro yāmye hyavijitastathā sānandamekhalaḥ /
kāmamaṅgalayā meṣaḥ kullā+ī+ambayā saha // 31
meaning:
जैत्रो याम्ये ह्यविजितस्तथा सानन्दमेखलः /
काममङ्गलया मेषः कुल्ला+ई+अम्बया सह // 31
text_mt: Jaitra in the south, then Avijita accompanied by Ānandamekhalā; / Meṣa with Kāmamaṅgalā together with Kullāī Ambā; // 31

sanskrit_iast:
vindhyo'jito'pyajarayā saha mekhalayā pare /
macchandaḥ kuṅkuṇāmbā ca ṣaḍyugmaṃ sādhikārakam // 32
meaning:
विन्ध्योऽजितोऽप्यजरया सह मेखलया परे /
मच्छन्दः कुङ्कुणाम्बा च षड्युग्मं साधिकारकम् // 32
text_mt: Vindhya along with Ajitā and Mekhalā in the west; / Macchanda and Kuṅkuṇāmbā: [this] group of six couples possesses authority. // 32

sanskrit_iast:
saumye marutta īśāntaṃ dvitīyā paṅktirīdṛśī /
amaravaradevacitrālivindhyaguḍikā iti kramātṣaḍamī // 33
meaning:
सौम्ये मरुत्त ईशान्तं द्वितीया पङ्क्तिरीदृशी /
अमरवरदेवचित्रालिविन्ध्यगुडिका इति क्रमात्षडमी // 33
text_mt: In the north, [extending] from the wind [northwest] to the northeastern direction, is the second row of such a kind: / Amaradeva, Varadeva, Citrālī, Vindhya, Guḍikā—these are the six in order. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
sillā+ī eruṇayā tathā kumārī ca bodhā+ī /
samahālacchī cāparamekhalayā śaktayaḥ ṣaḍimāḥ // 34
meaning:
सिल्ला+ई एरुणया तथा कुमारी च बोधा+ई /
समहालच्छी चापरमेखलया शक्तयः षडिमाः // 34
text_mt: Sillāī with Eruṇā, then Kumārī and Bodhāī, / Mahālacchī and [she] with another Mekhalā: these are the six powers. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
ete hi sādhikārāḥ pūjyā yeṣāmiyaṃ bahuvibhedā /
santatiranavacchinnā citrā śiṣyapraśiṣyamayī // 35
meaning:
एते हि साधिकाराः पूज्या येषामियं बहुविभेदा /
सन्ततिरनवच्छिन्ना चित्रा शिष्यप्रशिष्यमयी // 35
text_mt: These indeed possess authority and are to be worshipped, whose unbroken / and manifold lineage consisting of disciples and grand-disciples is of many divisions. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
ānandāvalibodhiprabhupādāntātha yogiśabdāntā /
etā ovallyaḥ syurmudrāṣaṭkaṃ kramāttvetat // 36
meaning:
आनन्दावलिबोधिप्रभुपादान्ताथ योगिशब्दान्ता /
एता ओवल्ल्यः स्युर्मुद्राषट्कं क्रमात्त्वेतत् // 36
text_mt: [Those lineages] ending with the words ānanda, āvali, bodhi, prabhu, pāda, and yogin— / these are the traditions (ovallī); and this is the set of six mudrās in succession: // 36

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣāṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhikāntamatha sā kanīyasī vāmāt /
dvidaśāntordhvagakuṇḍalibaindavahṛnnābhikandamiti chu mmāḥ // 37
meaning:
दक्षाङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठिकान्तमथ सा कनीयसी वामात् /
द्विदशान्तोर्ध्वगकुण्डलिबैन्दवहृन्नाभिकन्दमिति छु म्माः // 37
text_mt: from the right thumb to the little finger, and then the [little finger] of the left; / the upper twelve-finger space, Kuṇḍalinī, the bindu-point, heart, navel, and bulb: these are the secret signs (chummā). // 37

sanskrit_iast:
śavarāḍabillapaṭṭillāḥ karabillāmbiśarabillāḥ /
aḍabīḍombīdakṣiṇabillāḥ kumbhārikākṣarākhyāca // 38
meaning:
शवराडबिल्लपट्टिल्लाः करबिल्लाम्बिशरबिल्लाः /
अडबीडोम्बीदक्षिणबिल्लाः कुम्भारिकाक्षराख्याच // 38
text_mt: Śavarā, Aḍabillā, Paṭṭillā, Karabillā, Ambiśarabillā, / Aḍabī, Ḍombī, Dakṣiṇabillā, Kumbhārikā, and the one named Akṣarā; // 38

sanskrit_iast:
devīkoṭṭakulādritripurīkāmākhyamaṭṭahāsaśca /
dakṣiṇapīṭhaṃ caitatṣaṭkaṃ gharapallipīṭhagaṃ kramaśaḥ // 39
meaning:
देवीकोट्टकुलाद्रित्रिपुरीकामाख्यमट्टहासश्च /
दक्षिणपीठं चैतत्षट्कं घरपल्लिपीठगं क्रमशः // 39
text_mt: Devīkoṭṭa, Kulādri, Tripurī, Kāmākhyā, Aṭṭahāsa, / and the Southern Seat: this sextet belongs to the houses (ghara), hamlets (palli), and seats (pīṭha) in sequence. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṅketābhijño bhramate pīṭheṣu yadi sa siddhīpsuḥ /
acirāllabhate tattatprāpyaṃ yadyoginīvadanāt // 40
meaning:
इति सङ्केताभिज्ञो भ्रमते पीठेषु यदि स सिद्धीप्सुः /
अचिराल्लभते तत्तत्प्राप्यं यद्योगिनीवदनात् // 40
text_mt: If he who desires spiritual accomplishment, knowing these conventions, wanders among the seats, / he attains before long whatever is to be obtained from the mouth of the yoginī. // 40

sanskrit_iast:
bhaṭṭendravalkalāhīndragajendrāḥ samahīdharāḥ /
ūrdhvaretasa ete ṣaḍadhikārapadojjhitāḥ // 41
meaning:
भट्टेन्द्रवल्कलाहीन्द्रगजेन्द्राः समहीधराः /
ऊर्ध्वरेतस एते षडधिकारपदोज्झिताः // 41
text_mt: Bhaṭṭendra, Valkala, Ahīndra, Gajendra, together with Mahīdhara: / these [first] five and one [other] are celibate (ūrdhvaretas), destitute of the station of authority. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
adhikāro hi vīryasya prasaraḥ kulavartmani /
tadaprasarayogena te proktā ūrdhvaretasaḥ // 42
meaning:
अधिकारो हि वीर्यस्य प्रसरः कुलवर्त्मनि /
तदप्रसरयोगेन ते प्रोक्ता ऊर्ध्वरेतसः // 42
text_mt: For authority is the outflow of semen along the path of Kula; / due to their lack of that outflow, they are proclaimed to be celibate. // 42

sanskrit_iast:
anyāśca gurutatpatnyaḥ śrīmatkālīkuloditāḥ /
anāttadehāḥ krīḍanti taistairdehairaśaṅkitāḥ // 43
meaning:
अन्याश्च गुरुतत्पत्न्यः श्रीमत्कालीकुलोदिताः /
अनात्तदेहाः क्रीडन्ति तैस्तैर्देहैरशङ्किताः // 43
text_mt: And other gurus and their consorts declared in the auspicious Kālīkula, / having assumed no [gross] bodies, sport without hesitation through various [other] bodies. // 43

sanskrit_iast:
prabodhitatathecchākaistajje kaulaṃ prakāśate /
tathārūpatayā tatra gurutvaṃ paribhāṣitam // 44
meaning:
प्रबोधिततथेच्छाकैस्तज्जे कौलं प्रकाशते /
तथारूपतया तत्र गुरुत्वं परिभाषितम् // 44
text_mt: In him who is awakened by their will, the Kaula [knowledge] born of it shines forth; / because of having such a nature, the state of being a guru is designated there. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
te viśeṣānna saṃpūjyāḥ smartavyā eva kevalam /
tato'bhyantarato vāyuvahnyormātṛkayā saha // 45
meaning:
ते विशेषान्न संपूज्याः स्मर्तव्या एव केवलम् /
ततोऽभ्यन्तरतो वायुवह्न्योर्मातृकया सह // 45
text_mt: They are not to be specifically worshipped, but rather are merely to be remembered. / Then inside, in the wind and fire [directions], along with Mātṛkā, // 45

sanskrit_iast:
mālinī kramaśaḥ pūjyā tato'ntarmantracakrakam /
mantrasiddhaprāṇasaṃvitkaraṇātmani yā kule // 46
meaning:
मालिनी क्रमशः पूज्या ततोऽन्तर्मन्त्रचक्रकम् /
मन्त्रसिद्धप्राणसंवित्करणात्मनि या कुले // 46
text_mt: Mālinī is to be worshipped in sequence, and then inside, the wheel of mantras. / In the Kula consisting of the senses, consciousness, vital breath, and mantras of the Siddhas, // 46

sanskrit_iast:
cakrātmake citiḥ prabhvī proktā seha kuleśvarī /
sā madhye śrīparā devī mātṛsadbhāvarūpiṇī // 47
meaning:
चक्रात्मके चितिः प्रभ्वी प्रोक्ता सेह कुलेश्वरी /
सा मध्ये श्रीपरा देवी मातृसद्भावरूपिणी // 47
text_mt: the sovereign consciousness within the realm of the wheel is declared here to be Kuleśvarī. / She in the center is the venerable goddess Parā, embodying the true reality of the Mothers. // 47

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyātha tatsamāropādaparātha parāparā /
ekavīrā ca sā pūjyā yadivā sakuleśvarā // 48
meaning:
पूज्याथ तत्समारोपादपराथ परापरा /
एकवीरा च सा पूज्या यदिवा सकुलेश्वरा // 48
text_mt: She is to be worshipped, and by superposition onto her, Aparā and Parāparā; / she is to be worshipped either as the solitary heroine (ekavīrā) or along with Kuleśvara. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
prasarecchaktirucchūnā sollāso bhairavaḥ punaḥ /
saṅghaṭṭānandaviśrāntyā yugmamitthaṃ prapūjayet // 49
meaning:
प्रसरेच्छक्तिरुच्छूना सोल्लासो भैरवः पुनः /
सङ्घट्टानन्दविश्रान्त्या युग्ममित्थं प्रपूजयेत् // 49
text_mt: The power swollen with the desire for expansion, and Bhairava radiant with joy: / thus one should worship the couple through resting in the bliss of their union. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
mahāprakāśarūpāyāḥ saṃvido visphuliṅgavat /
yo raśmyoghastamevātra pūjayeddevatāgaṇam // 50
meaning:
महाप्रकाशरूपायाः संविदो विस्फुलिङ्गवत् /
यो रश्म्योघस्तमेवात्र पूजयेद्देवतागणम् // 50
text_mt: Resembling sparks of consciousness whose nature is great luminosity, / the flood of rays which exists—precisely that host of deities one should worship here. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
antardvādaśakaṃ pūjyaṃ tato'ṣṭāṣṭākameva ca /
catuṣkaṃ vā yathecchaṃ vā kā saṅkhyā kila raśmiṣu // 51
meaning:
अन्तर्द्वादशकं पूज्यं ततोऽष्टाष्टाकमेव च /
चतुष्कं वा यथेच्छं वा का सङ्ख्या किल रश्मिषु // 51
text_mt: Inside, the group of twelve is to be worshipped, and then the group of sixty-four (eight times eight), / or four, or according to wish: for what fixed number can there be among rays? // 51

sanskrit_iast:
māheśī vairiñcī kaumārī vaiṣṇavī caturdikkam /
aindrī yāmyā muṇḍā yogeśīrīśatastu koṇeṣu // 52
meaning:
माहेशी वैरिञ्ची कौमारी वैष्णवी चतुर्दिक्कम् /
ऐन्द्री याम्या मुण्डा योगेशीरीशतस्तु कोणेषु // 52
text_mt: Māheśī, Vairiñcī, Kaumārī, and Vaiṣṇavī in the four cardinal directions; / Aindrī, Yāmyā, Muṇḍā, and Yogeśī, starting from the northeast, in the corner directions. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
pavanāntamaghorādikamaṣṭakamasminnathāṣṭake kramaśaḥ /
saṅghaṭṭānandadṛśā sampūjyaṃ yāmalībhūtam // 53
meaning:
पवनान्तमघोरादिकमष्टकमस्मिन्नथाष्टके क्रमशः /
सङ्घट्टानन्ददृशा सम्पूज्यं यामलीभूतम् // 53
text_mt: In this octet, the group of eight beginning with Aghora down to Pavana in sequence / is to be worshipped as couples from the perspective of the bliss of union. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṣṭake'pi hi vidhau nānānāmaprapañcite bahudhā /
vidhireṣa eva vihitastatsaṃkhyā dīpamālā syāt // 54
meaning:
अष्टाष्टकेऽपि हि विधौ नानानामप्रपञ्चिते बहुधा /
विधिरेष एव विहितस्तत्संख्या दीपमाला स्यात् // 54
text_mt: Even in the rite of sixty-four, elaborated in many ways with various names, / this very rule is prescribed; their number may constitute a garland of lamps. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
śrīratnamālāśāstre tu varṇasaṃkhyāḥ pradīpakāḥ /
varṇāṃśca mukhyapūjyāyā vidyāyā gaṇayetsudhīḥ // 55
meaning:
श्रीरत्नमालाशास्त्रे तु वर्णसंख्याः प्रदीपकाः /
वर्णांश्च मुख्यपूज्याया विद्याया गणयेत्सुधीः // 55
text_mt: In the sacred Ratnamālā treatise, however, the lights are the number of phonemes; / and the wise practitioner should count the phonemes of the principal mantra to be worshipped. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhakṣetrādibhiḥ sākaṃ kuryādvā kulapūjanam /
yathā śrīmādhavakule parameśena bhāṣitam // 56
meaning:
पीठक्षेत्रादिभिः साकं कुर्याद्वा कुलपूजनम् /
यथा श्रीमाधवकुले परमेशेन भाषितम् // 56
text_mt: Or one should perform the worship of Kula together with the sacred seats, fields, and other places, / as was spoken by the Supreme Lord in the auspicious Mādhavakula: // 56

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhārānāmakramacatuṣṭayam /
pīṭhaśmaśānasahitaṃ pūjayedbhogamokṣayoḥ // 57
meaning:
सृष्टिसंस्थितिसंहारानामक्रमचतुष्टयम् /
पीठश्मशानसहितं पूजयेद्भोगमोक्षयोः // 57
text_mt: One should worship the quartet of creation, maintenance, dissolution, and the nameless [fourth], / accompanied by the sacred seats and cremation grounds, for enjoyment and liberation. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
ātmano vāthavā śakteścakrasyātha smaredimam /
nyasyatvena vidhiṃ dehe pīṭhākhye pārameśvaram // 58
meaning:
आत्मनो वाथवा शक्तेश्चक्रस्याथ स्मरेदिमम् /
न्यस्यत्वेन विधिं देहे पीठाख्ये पारमेश्वरम् // 58
text_mt: One should mentally visualize this divine rule either in oneself, in the śakti, / or in the wheel, by way of installation (nyāsa) upon the body called the sacred seat: // 58

sanskrit_iast:
aṭṭahāsaṃ śikhāsthāne caritraṃ ca karandhrake /
śrutyoḥ kaulagiriṃ nāsārandhrayośca jayantikām // 59
meaning:
अट्टहासं शिखास्थाने चरित्रं च करन्ध्रके /
श्रुत्योः कौलगिरिं नासारन्ध्रयोश्च जयन्तिकाम् // 59
text_mt: Aṭṭahāsa at the crown-lock, and Caritra at the ear-aperture; / Kaulagiri in the ears, and Jayantikā in the nostrils; // 59

sanskrit_iast:
bhruvorujjayinīṃ vaktre prayāgaṃ hṛdaye punaḥ /
vārāṇasīṃ skandhayuge śrīpīṭhaṃ virajaṃ gale // 60
meaning:
भ्रुवोरुज्जयिनीं वक्त्रे प्रयागं हृदये पुनः /
वाराणसीं स्कन्धयुगे श्रीपीठं विरजं गले // 60
text_mt: Ujjayinī in the eyebrows, Prayāga in the mouth, and further / Vārāṇasī in the heart, the Śrīpīṭha on the two shoulders, and Viraja in the throat; // 60

sanskrit_iast:
eḍābhīmudare hālāṃ nābhau kande tu gośrutim /
upasthe marukośaṃ ca nagaraṃ pauṇḍravardhanam // 61
meaning:
एडाभीमुदरे हालां नाभौ कन्दे तु गोश्रुतिम् /
उपस्थे मरुकोशं च नगरं पौण्ड्रवर्धनम् // 61
text_mt: Eḍābhī in the belly, Hālā in the navel, and Gośruti in the bulb; / Marukośa in the generative organ, and the city Pauṇḍravardhana; // 61

sanskrit_iast:
elāpuraṃ purastīraṃ sakthyūrvordakṣiṇāditaḥ /
kuḍyākeśīṃ ca sopānaṃ māyāpūkṣīrake tathā // 62
meaning:
एलापुरं पुरस्तीरं सक्थ्यूर्वोर्दक्षिणादितः /
कुड्याकेशीं च सोपानं मायापूक्षीरके तथा // 62
text_mt: Elāpura and Purastīra on the right thigh and buttock, and following; / Kuḍyākeśī and Sopāna, as well as Māyāpū and Kṣīraka; // 62

sanskrit_iast:
jānujaṅghe gulphayugme tvāmrātanṛpasadmanī /
pādādhāre tu vairiñcīṃ kālāgnyavadhidārikām // 63
meaning:
जानुजङ्घे गुल्फयुग्मे त्वाम्रातनृपसद्मनी /
पादाधारे तु वैरिञ्चीं कालाग्न्यवधिदारिकाम् // 63
text_mt: on the knees, shanks, and pair of ankles, Āmrātaka and Nṛpasadman; / and on the soles of the feet, Vairiñcī and Kālāgnyavadhidārikā. // 63

sanskrit_iast:
nāhamasmi nacānyo'sti kevalāḥ śaktayastvaham /
ityevaṃvāsanāṃ kuryātsarvadā smṛtimātrataḥ // 64
meaning:
नाहमस्मि नचान्योऽस्ति केवलाः शक्तयस्त्वहम् /
इत्येवंवासनां कुर्यात्सर्वदा स्मृतिमात्रतः // 64
text_mt: ‘I am not, nor does any other exist; I am solely the powers’— / in this manner one should cultivate the contemplative attitude at all times through mere remembrance. // 64

sanskrit_iast:
na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ nopavāso vidhīyate /
grāmyadharmarataḥ siddhyetsarvadā smaraṇena hi // 65
meaning:
न तिथिर्न च नक्षत्रं नोपवासो विधीयते /
ग्राम्यधर्मरतः सिद्ध्येत्सर्वदा स्मरणेन हि // 65
text_mt: Neither lunar day nor asterism nor fasting is prescribed; / devoted to worldly pleasure, he achieves spiritual accomplishment through constant remembrance. // 65

sanskrit_iast:
mātaṅgakṛṣṇasaunikakārmukacārmikavikoṣidhātuvibhedāḥ /
