mātsyikacākrikadayitāsteṣāṃ patnyo navātra navayāge // 66
meaning:
मातङ्गकृष्णसौनिककार्मुकचार्मिकविकोषिधातुविभेदाः /
मात्स्यिकचाक्रिकदयितास्तेषां पत्न्यो नवात्र नवयागे // 66
text_mt: Mātaṅga, Kṛṣṇa, the butcher, bowmaker, leatherworker, swordsmith, metallurgist, / fisherman, and oil-presser: their wives are the nine consorts here in the sacrifice of nine. // 66

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgamavaruṇākulagiryaṭṭahāsajayantīcaritrakāmrakakoṭṭam /
haimapuraṃ navamaṃ syānmadhye tāsāṃ ca cakriṇī mukhyā // 67
meaning:
सङ्गमवरुणाकुलगिर्यट्टहासजयन्तीचरित्रकाम्रककोट्टम् /
हैमपुरं नवमं स्यान्मध्ये तासां च चक्रिणी मुख्या // 67
text_mt: Saṅgama, Varuṇā, Kulagiri, Aṭṭahāsa, Jayantī, Caritra, Āmraka, Koṭṭa, / and Haimapura is the ninth; and in their center, Cakriṇī is primary. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
bījaṃ sā pīḍayate rasaśalkavibhāgato'tra kuṇḍalinī /
adhyuṣṭapīṭhanetrī kandasthā viśvato bhramati // 68
meaning:
बीजं सा पीडयते रसशल्कविभागतोऽत्र कुण्डलिनी /
अध्युष्टपीठनेत्री कन्दस्था विश्वतो भ्रमति // 68
text_mt: She presses the seed through division of juice and husk: Kuṇḍalinī here, / the guide of the three and a half seats, residing in the bulb, moves everywhere. // 68

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭvā cakrodayaṃ tvitthaṃ madhye pūjyā kuleśvarī /
saṅkarṣiṇī tadantānte saṃhārāpyāyakāriṇī // 69
meaning:
इष्ट्वा चक्रोदयं त्वित्थं मध्ये पूज्या कुलेश्वरी /
सङ्कर्षिणी तदन्तान्ते संहाराप्यायकारिणी // 69
text_mt: Having thus offered worship to the rising of the wheel, Kuleśvarī is to be worshipped in the center; / Saṅkarṣiṇī at its ultimate limit, who brings about destruction and repletion, // 69

sanskrit_iast:
ekavīrā cakrayuktā cakrayāmalagāpi vā /
īśendrāgniyamakravyātkavāyūdakṣu hāsataḥ // 70
meaning:
एकवीरा चक्रयुक्ता चक्रयामलगापि वा /
ईशेन्द्राग्नियमक्रव्यात्कवायूदक्षु हासतः // 70
text_mt: either as the solitary heroine, accompanied by the wheel, or situated in a dyad with the wheel. / In the northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest, and north, beginning with the north-northeast, // 70

sanskrit_iast:
trikaṃ trikaṃ yajedetadbhāvisvatrikasaṃyutam /
hṛtkuṇḍalī bhruvormadhyametadeva kramāttrayam // 71
meaning:
त्रिकं त्रिकं यजेदेतद्भाविस्वत्रिकसंयुतम् /
हृत्कुण्डली भ्रुवोर्मध्यमेतदेव क्रमात्त्रयम् // 71
text_mt: one should worship each triad united with its future triad. / The heart, Kuṇḍalinī, and the center between the eyebrows: this is precisely the triad in sequence. // 71

sanskrit_iast:
śmaśānāni kramātkṣetrabhavaṃ sadyoginīgaṇam /
vasvaṅgulonnatānūrdhvavartulān kṣāmamadhyakān // 72
meaning:
श्मशानानि क्रमात्क्षेत्रभवं सद्योगिनीगणम् /
वस्वङ्गुलोन्नतानूर्ध्ववर्तुलान् क्षाममध्यकान् // 72
text_mt: The cremation grounds, the immediate host of yoginīs born of the sacred fields in sequence: / lamps eight fingers high, elevated and round, thin in their middle, // 72

sanskrit_iast:
raktavartīñśrutidṛśo dīpānkurvīta sarpiṣā /
yatkiñcidathavā madhye svānuṣṭhānaṃ prapūjayet // 73
meaning:
रक्तवर्तीञ्श्रुतिदृशो दीपान्कुर्वीत सर्पिषा /
यत्किञ्चिदथवा मध्ये स्वानुष्ठानं प्रपूजयेत् // 73
text_mt: with red wicks and the appearance of the ears, one should make with clarified butter; / or one should worship whatever inner ritual performance is there in the center. // 73

sanskrit_iast:
advaitameva na dvaitamityājñā parameśituḥ /
siddhāntavaiṣṇavādyuktā mantrā malayutāstataḥ // 74
meaning:
अद्वैतमेव न द्वैतमित्याज्ञा परमेशितुः /
सिद्धान्तवैष्णवाद्युक्ता मन्त्रा मलयुतास्ततः // 74
text_mt: ‘Only non-duality, never duality’: this is the command of the Supreme Lord. / Therefore, the mantras taught in Siddhānta, Vaiṣṇava, and other systems are accompanied by impurity; // 74

sanskrit_iast:
tāvattejo'sahiṣṇutvānnirjīvāḥ syurihādvaye /
kalaśaṃ netrabandhādi maṇḍalaṃ sruksruvānalam // 75
meaning:
तावत्तेजोऽसहिष्णुत्वान्निर्जीवाः स्युरिहाद्वये /
कलशं नेत्रबन्धादि मण्डलं स्रुक्स्रुवानलम् // 75
text_mt: because they cannot endure that brilliance, they are lifeless here in non-duality. / The water vessel, blindfolding of the eyes, mandala, ladle, spoon, and fire— // 75

sanskrit_iast:
hitvātra siddhiḥ sanmadye pātre madhye kṛśāṃ yajet /
ahorātramimaṃ yāgaṃ kurvataścāpare'hani // 76
meaning:
हित्वात्र सिद्धिः सन्मद्ये पात्रे मध्ये कृशां यजेत् /
अहोरात्रमिमं यागं कुर्वतश्चापरेऽहनि // 76
text_mt:
[…] Leaving aside this accomplishment here, in the vessel containing good wine, he should worship Kṛśā in the center.
And for one performing this sacrifice for a day and night, on the following day,

sanskrit_iast:
vīrabhojye kṛte'vaśyaṃ mantrāḥ siddhyantyayatnataḥ /
pīṭhastotraṃ paṭhedatra yāge bhāgyāvahāhvaye // 77
meaning:
वीरभोज्ये कृतेऽवश्यं मन्त्राः सिद्ध्यन्त्ययत्नतः /
पीठस्तोत्रं पठेदत्र यागे भाग्यावहाह्वये // 77
text_mt:
when the banquet of the heroes (vīrabhojya) has been performed, mantras inevitably attain success without effort.
In this sacrifice called Bhāgyāvaha ("conferring good fortune"), one should recite the hymn to the seats (pīṭhastotra).

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtīrevāthavā yugmarūpā vīrasvarūpiṇīḥ /
avadhūtā nirācārāḥ pūjayetkramaśo budhaḥ // 78
meaning:
मूर्तीरेवाथवा युग्मरूपा वीरस्वरूपिणीः /
अवधूता निराचाराः पूजयेत्क्रमशो बुधः // 78
text_mt: Or else the wise one should worship in succession the forms, / as couples, having the nature of heroes, wandering unattached, free of conventional conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
eka evātha kauleśaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvāpi tāvatīḥ /
śaktīryāmalayogena tarpayedviśvarūpavat // 79
meaning:
एक एवाथ कौलेशः स्वयं भूत्वापि तावतीः /
शक्तीर्यामलयोगेन तर्पयेद्विश्वरूपवत् // 79
text_mt: Or the lord of the Kaula alone, having himself become [one], / should satisfy as many powers through the yoga of the dyad, like the universal form.

sanskrit_iast:
kramo nāma na kaścitsyātprakāśamayasaṃvidi /
cidabhāvo hi nāstyeva tenākālaṃ tu tarpaṇam // 80
meaning:
क्रमो नाम न कश्चित्स्यात्प्रकाशमयसंविदि /
चिदभावो हि नास्त्येव तेनाकालं तु तर्पणम् // 80
text_mt: There can be no succession whatsoever in consciousness consisting of luminosity; / for an absence of consciousness does not exist at all, and therefore the satisfying is timeless.

sanskrit_iast:
atra krame bhedataroḥ samūlamunmūlanādāsanapakṣacarcā /
pṛthaṅna yuktā parameśvaro hi svaśaktidhāmnīva viśaṃśramīti // 81
meaning:
अत्र क्रमे भेदतरोः समूलमुन्मूलनादासनपक्षचर्चा /
पृथङ्न युक्ता परमेश्वरो हि स्वशक्तिधाम्नीव विशंश्रमीति // 81
text_mt: In this sequence, since the tree of duality is uprooted together with its roots, discussion of the matter of the seat / separately is not appropriate; for the Supreme Lord rests as if in the abode of his own power.

sanskrit_iast:
tato japaḥ prakartavyastrilakṣādivibhedataḥ /
uktaṃ śrīyogasañcāre sa ca citrasvarūpakaḥ // 82
meaning:
ततो जपः प्रकर्तव्यस्त्रिलक्षादिविभेदतः /
उक्तं श्रीयोगसञ्चारे स च चित्रस्वरूपकः // 82
text_mt: Then recitation should be performed, differentiated into three hundred thousand and the like; / and that of varied nature has been taught in the venerable Yogasañcāra:

sanskrit_iast:
udaye saṅgame śāntau trilakṣo japa ucyate /
āsye gamāgame sūtre haṃsākhye śaivayugmake // 83
meaning:
उदये सङ्गमे शान्तौ त्रिलक्षो जप उच्यते /
आस्ये गमागमे सूत्रे हंसाख्ये शैवयुग्मके // 83
text_mt: "At rising, at union, [and] at rest, a recitation of three hundred thousand is declared; / in the mouth, in movement and return, in the thread named Haṃsa, and in the Śaiva couple—

sanskrit_iast:
pañcalakṣā ime proktā daśāṃśaṃ homamācaret /
netre gamāgame vaktre haṃse caivākṣasūtrake // 84
meaning:
पञ्चलक्षा इमे प्रोक्ता दशांशं होममाचरेत् /
नेत्रे गमागमे वक्त्रे हंसे चैवाक्षसूत्रके // 84
text_mt: these are declared to be five hundred thousand; one should perform oblation of a tenth part [thereof]. / In the eye, in movement and return, in the mouth, in Haṃsa, and in the rosary—

sanskrit_iast:
śivaśaktisamāyoge ṣaḍlakṣo japa ucyate /
netre gamāgame karṇe haṃse vaktre ca bhāmini // 85
meaning:
शिवशक्तिसमायोगे षड्लक्षो जप उच्यते /
नेत्रे गमागमे कर्णे हंसे वक्त्रे च भामिनि // 85
text_mt: in the union of Śiva and power, a recitation of six hundred thousand is declared. / In the eye, in movement and return, in the ear, in Haṃsa, and in the mouth, O beautiful lady,

sanskrit_iast:
haste ca yugmake caiva japaḥ saptavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ /
netre gamāgame karṇāvāsyaṃ guhyaṃ ca guhyakam // 86
meaning:
हस्ते च युग्मके चैव जपः सप्तविधः स्मृतः /
नेत्रे गमागमे कर्णावास्यं गुह्यं च गुह्यकम् // 86
text_mt: and in the hand, and in the pair, recitation is traditionally taught as sevenfold. / In the eye, in movement and return, in the ears, in the mouth, and in the secret and secret-most,

sanskrit_iast:
śatāreṣu ca madhyasthaṃ sahasrāreṣu bhāmini /
japa eṣa rudralakṣo homo'pyatra daśāṃśataḥ // 87
meaning:
शतारेषु च मध्यस्थं सहस्रारेषु भामिनि /
जप एष रुद्रलक्षो होमोऽप्यत्र दशांशतः // 87
text_mt: and in that which stands in the center of the hundred-spoked [centers], [and] in the thousand-spoked, O beautiful lady— / this is the recitation of eleven hundred thousand; the oblation here also is a tenth part.

sanskrit_iast:
netre gamāgame karṇau mukhaṃ brahmabilāntaram /
stanau hastau ca pādau ca guhyacakre dvirabhyaset // 88
meaning:
नेत्रे गमागमे कर्णौ मुखं ब्रह्मबिलान्तरम् /
स्तनौ हस्तौ च पादौ च गुह्यचक्रे द्विरभ्यसेत् // 88
text_mt: In the eye, in movement and return, in the ears, in the mouth, within the aperture of Brahmā, / in the breasts, the hands, and the feet, one should practice twice in the secret wheel.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra yatra gataṃ cakṣuryatra yatra gataṃ manaḥ /
haṃsastatra dvirabhyasyo vikāsākuñcanātmakaḥ // 89
meaning:
यत्र यत्र गतं चक्षुर्यत्र यत्र गतं मनः /
हंसस्तत्र द्विरभ्यस्यो विकासाकुञ्चनात्मकः // 89
text_mt: Wherever the eye goes, wherever the mind goes, / there Haṃsa, consisting of expansion and contraction, is to be practiced twice.

sanskrit_iast:
sa ātmā mātṛkā devī śivo dehavyavasthitaḥ /
anyaḥ so'nyo'hamityevaṃ vikalpaṃ nācaredyataḥ // 90
meaning:
स आत्मा मातृका देवी शिवो देहव्यवस्थितः /
अन्यः सोऽन्योऽहमित्येवं विकल्पं नाचरेद्यतः // 90
text_mt: He is the Self, the goddess Mātṛkā, Śiva situated in the body; / since one should not entertain the conceptual construct: 'He is another, I am another.'

sanskrit_iast:
yo vilpayate tasya siddhimuktī sudūrataḥ /
atha ṣoḍaśalakṣādiprāṇacāre puroktavat // 91
meaning:
यो विल्पयते तस्य सिद्धिमुक्ती सुदूरतः /
अथ षोडशलक्षादिप्राणचारे पुरोक्तवत् // 91
text_mt: For whoever entertains conceptual constructs, spiritual accomplishment and liberation are very far away." / Now, in the movement of breath of sixteen hundred thousand and so on, as previously stated,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhāśuddhavikalpānāṃ tyāga ekānta ucyate /
tatrasthaḥ svayamevaiṣa juhoti ca japatyapi // 92
meaning:
शुद्धाशुद्धविकल्पानां त्याग एकान्त उच्यते /
तत्रस्थः स्वयमेवैष जुहोति च जपत्यपि // 92
text_mt: the abandonment of pure and impure conceptual constructs is declared to be solitary. / Standing therein, he himself both offers oblation and recites.

sanskrit_iast:
japaḥ sañjalpavṛttiśca nādāmarśasvarūpiṇī /
tadāmṛṣṭasya cidvahnau layo homaḥ prakīrtitaḥ // 93
meaning:
जपः सञ्जल्पवृत्तिश्च नादामर्शस्वरूपिणी /
तदामृष्टस्य चिद्वह्नौ लयो होमः प्रकीर्तितः // 93
text_mt: Recitation is the activity of internal discourse consisting of the reflective apprehension of resonance; / the dissolution into the fire of consciousness of what has been so reflectively apprehended is proclaimed to be oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
āmarśaśca purā prokto devīdvādaśakātmakaḥ /
dve antye saṃvidau tatra layarūpāhutikriyā // 94
meaning:
आमर्शश्च पुरा प्रोक्तो देवीद्वादशकात्मकः /
द्वे अन्त्ये संविदौ तत्र लयरूपाहुतिक्रिया // 94
text_mt: And reflective awareness was taught previously as consisting of the twelve goddesses; / among them, the final two consciousnesses are the rite of offering in the form of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast:
daśānyāstadupāyāyetyevaṃ home daśāṃśatām /
śrīśambhunātha ādikṣattrikārthāmbhodhicandramāḥ // 95
meaning:
दशान्यास्तदुपायायेत्येवं होमे दशांशताम् /
श्रीशम्भुनाथ आदिक्षत्त्रिकार्थाम्भोधिचन्द्रमाः // 95
text_mt: The other ten are the means thereto; thus the ten-part nature in oblation / was instructed by the venerable Śambhunātha, the moon of the ocean of Trika teachings.

sanskrit_iast:
sākaṃ bāhyasthayā śaktyā yadā tveṣa samarcayet /
tadāyaṃ parameśokto rahasyo bhaṇyate vidhiḥ // 96
meaning:
साकं बाह्यस्थया शक्त्या यदा त्वेष समर्चयेत् /
तदायं परमेशोक्तो रहस्यो भण्यते विधिः // 96
text_mt: When, however, he worships together with an external power, / then this secret ritual taught by the Supreme Lord is set forth.

sanskrit_iast:
uktaṃ śrīyogasañcāre brahmacarye sthitiṃ bhajet /
ānando brahma paramaṃ tacca dehe tridhā sthitam // 97
meaning:
उक्तं श्रीयोगसञ्चारे ब्रह्मचर्ये स्थितिं भजेत् /
आनन्दो ब्रह्म परमं तच्च देहे त्रिधा स्थितम् // 97
text_mt: It is stated in the venerable Yogasañcāra: "One should abide in the celibate observance; / bliss is the supreme Brahman, and that stands threefold in the body.

sanskrit_iast:
upakāri dvayaṃ tatra phalamanyattadātmakam /
oṣṭhyāntyatritayāsevī brahmacārī sa ucyate // 98
meaning:
उपकारि द्वयं तत्र फलमन्यत्तदात्मकम् /
ओष्ठ्यान्त्यत्रितयासेवी ब्रह्मचारी स उच्यते // 98
text_mt: Among them, two are instrumental, the other is the fruit of that nature; / one who serves the final triad of labials is called a celibate practitioner.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvarjitā ye paśava ānandaparivarjitāḥ /
ānandakṛttrimāhārāstadvarjaṃ cakrayājakāḥ // 99
meaning:
तद्वर्जिता ये पशव आनन्दपरिवर्जिताः /
आनन्दकृत्त्रिमाहारास्तद्वर्जं चक्रयाजकाः // 99
text_mt: Those bound souls who are devoid of it are devoid of bliss; / they consume artificial food of bliss, and worship the wheel devoid of it;

sanskrit_iast:
dvaye'pi niraye yānti raurave bhīṣaṇe tviti /
śakterlakṣaṇametāvattadvato hyavibheditā // 100
meaning:
द्वयेऽपि निरये यान्ति रौरवे भीषणे त्विति /
शक्तेर्लक्षणमेतावत्तद्वतो ह्यविभेदिता // 100
text_mt: both go to the terrible hell of Raurava." / The definition of the power is just this: non-differentiation from the possessor of power.

sanskrit_iast:
tādṛśīṃ tena tāṃ kuryānnatu varṇādyapekṣaṇam /
laukikālaukikadvyātmasaṅgāttādātmyato'dhikāt // 101
meaning:
तादृशीं तेन तां कुर्यान्नतु वर्णाद्यपेक्षणम् /
लौकिकालौकिकद्व्यात्मसङ्गात्तादात्म्यतोऽधिकात् // 101
text_mt: Therefore he should make her of such a kind, and not look to caste and the like; / from the union of both ordinary and extraordinary natures, from an even greater non-duality,

sanskrit_iast:
kāryahetusahotthā sā tridhoktā śāsane guroḥ /
sākṣātparamparāyogāttattulyeti tridhā punaḥ // 102
meaning:
कार्यहेतुसहोत्था सा त्रिधोक्ता शासने गुरोः /
साक्षात्परम्परायोगात्तत्तुल्येति त्रिधा पुनः // 102
text_mt: she is taught as threefold in the master's teaching: born of effect, born of cause, and co-born; / and again threefold: by direct connection, by indirect connection, and as equal to that.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsarvācārahṛdaye tadetadupasaṃhṛtam /
ṣaḍetāḥ śaktayaḥ proktā bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ // 103
meaning:
श्रीसर्वाचारहृदये तदेतदुपसंहृतम् /
षडेताः शक्तयः प्रोक्ता भुक्तिमुक्तिफलप्रदाः // 103
text_mt: In the venerable Sarvācārahṛdaya this very teaching is summarized: / these six powers are declared to bestow the fruit of enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
dvābhyāṃ tu sṛṣṭisaṃhārau tasmānmelakamuttamam /
tāmāhṛtya mitho'bhyarcya tarpayitvā parasparam // 104
meaning:
द्वाभ्यां तु सृष्टिसंहारौ तस्मान्मेलकमुत्तमम् /
तामाहृत्य मिथोऽभ्यर्च्य तर्पयित्वा परस्परम् // 104
text_mt: By the two, however, are emission and dissolution; therefore the meeting of the two is supreme. / Having brought her, having worshipped each other, and having satisfied one another,

sanskrit_iast:
antaraṅgakrameṇaiva mukhyacakrasya pūjanam /
yadevānandasandohi saṃvido hyantaraṅgakam // 105
meaning:
अन्तरङ्गक्रमेणैव मुख्यचक्रस्य पूजनम् /
यदेवानन्दसन्दोहि संविदो ह्यन्तरङ्गकम् // 105
text_mt: the worship of the principal wheel proceeds purely by the inner sequence; / whatever is an abundance of bliss is indeed internal to consciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpradhānaṃ bhaveccakramanucakramato'param /
vikāsāttṛptitaḥ pāśotkartanātkṛtiśaktitaḥ // 106
meaning:
तत्प्रधानं भवेच्चक्रमनुचक्रमतोऽपरम् /
विकासात्तृप्तितः पाशोत्कर्तनात्कृतिशक्तितः // 106
text_mt: That becomes the primary wheel, and the subordinate wheel is other than that; / through expansion, satisfaction, cutting of the fetter, and power of action,

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ kaseścakeḥ kṛtyā karoteśca kiloditam /
yāgaśca tarpaṇaṃ bāhye vikāsastacca kīrtyate // 107
meaning:
चक्रं कसेश्चकेः कृत्या करोतेश्च किलोदितम् /
यागश्च तर्पणं बाह्ये विकासस्तच्च कीर्त्यते // 107
text_mt: the wheel (cakra) is indeed proclaimed from the roots 'to expand' (kas), 'to satisfy' (cak), 'to act' (kṛ), and 'to cut' (kṛt). / Ritual worship and satisfaction are in the external realm, and that is proclaimed as expansion.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrānucakrāntaragācchaktimatparikalpitāt /
prāṇagādapyathānandasyandino'bhyavahārataḥ // 108
meaning:
चक्रानुचक्रान्तरगाच्छक्तिमत्परिकल्पितात् /
प्राणगादप्यथानन्दस्यन्दिनोऽभ्यवहारतः // 108
text_mt: From what is located within the wheel and subordinate wheels, imagined by the possessor of power, / and also from what is located in the breath, from the food that flows with bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhadhūpasragādeśca bāhyāducchalanaṃ citaḥ /
itthaṃ svocitavastvaṃśairanucakreṣu tarpaṇam // 109
meaning:
गन्धधूपस्रगादेश्च बाह्यादुच्छलनं चितः /
इत्थं स्वोचितवस्त्वंशैरनुचक्रेषु तर्पणम् // 109
text_mt: and from perfume, incense, garlands, and the like, external overflow of consciousness [arises]. / In this way, with portions of their suitable substances, satisfaction in the subordinate wheels

sanskrit_iast:
kurvīyātāmihānyonyaṃ mukhyacakraikatākṛte /
uktaṃ ca triśirastantre vimalāsanagocaraḥ // 110
meaning:
कुर्वीयातामिहान्योन्यं मुख्यचक्रैकताकृते /
उक्तं च त्रिशिरस्तन्त्रे विमलासनगोचरः // 110
text_mt: the two should perform for each other here, for the sake of the unity of the primary wheel. / And it is stated in the Triśirastantra: "Having the spotless seat as its sphere,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣaṣaṭkasya madhye tu rudrasthānaṃ samāviśet /
nijanijabhogābhogapravikāsinijasvarūpaparimarśe // 111
meaning:
अक्षषट्कस्य मध्ये तु रुद्रस्थानं समाविशेत् /
निजनिजभोगाभोगप्रविकासिनिजस्वरूपपरिमर्शे // 111
text_mt: in the center of the six senses one should enter the station of Rudra." / In the reflective awareness of their own nature expanding in the fullness of their respective enjoyments,

sanskrit_iast:
kramaśo'nucakradevyaḥ saṃviccakraṃ hi madhyamaṃ yānti /
svasthatanoraparasya tu tā dehādhiṣṭhitaṃ vihāya yataḥ // 112
meaning:
क्रमशोऽनुचक्रदेव्यः संविच्चक्रं हि मध्यमं यान्ति /
स्वस्थतनोरपरस्य तु ता देहाधिष्ठितं विहाय यतः // 112
text_mt: the goddesses of the subordinate wheels indeed go gradually to the central wheel of consciousness; / for, leaving what resides in the body of another whose body is healthy,

sanskrit_iast:
āsata iti tadahaṃyurno pūrṇo nāpi cocchalati /
anucakradevatātmakamarīciparipūraṇādhigatavīryam // 113
meaning:
आसत इति तदहंयुर्नो पूर्णो नापि चोच्छलति /
अनुचक्रदेवतात्मकमरीचिपरिपूरणाधिगतवीर्यम् // 113
text_mt: they abide [within]. Therefore, his ego-sense is neither complete nor does it surge forth. / Having attained potency through the replenishment of rays consisting of the deities of the subordinate wheels,

sanskrit_iast:
tacchaktiśaktimadyugamanyonyasamunmukhaṃ bhavati /
tadyugalamūrdhvadhāmapraveśasaṃsparśajātasaṅkṣobham // 114
meaning:
तच्छक्तिशक्तिमद्युगमन्योन्यसमुन्मुखं भवति /
तद्युगलमूर्ध्वधामप्रवेशसंस्पर्शजातसङ्क्षोभम् // 114
text_mt: that pair of power and possessor of power becomes oriented towards each other. / That pair, agitated by the agitation born of touching the entrance to the upper abode,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣubhnātyanucakrāṇyapi tāni tadā tanmayāni na pṛthaktu /
itthaṃ yāmalametadgalitabhidāsaṃkathaṃ yadeva syāt // 115
meaning:
क्षुभ्नात्यनुचक्राण्यपि तानि तदा तन्मयानि न पृथक्तु /
इत्थं यामलमेतद्गलितभिदासंकथं यदेव स्यात् // 115
text_mt: agitates also the subordinate wheels; then they consist of that, and are not separate. / Thus this dyad, in whatever way its talk of difference is dissolved,

sanskrit_iast:
kramatāratamyayogātsaiva hi saṃvidvisargasaṅghaṭṭaḥ /
taddhruvadhāmānuttaramubhayātmakajagadudārasānandam // 116
meaning:
क्रमतारतम्ययोगात्सैव हि संविद्विसर्गसङ्घट्टः /
तद्ध्रुवधामानुत्तरमुभयात्मकजगदुदारसानन्दम् // 116
text_mt: by virtue of the graduation of sequence, that very consciousness is the friction of creative emission; / that is the stable abode, the unexcelled, filled with the noble bliss of the world possessing both natures,

sanskrit_iast:
no śāntaṃ nāpyuditaṃ śāntoditasūtikāraṇaṃ paraṃ kaulam /
anavacchinnapadepsustāṃ saṃvidamātmasātsadā kuryāt // 117
meaning:
नो शान्तं नाप्युदितं शान्तोदितसूतिकारणं परं कौलम् /
अनवच्छिन्नपदेप्सुस्तां संविदमात्मसात्सदा कुर्यात् // 117
text_mt: neither quiescent nor emergent, the source and cause of the quiescent and the emergent, the supreme Kaula. / Desiring the unconditioned state, one should always assimilate that consciousness to oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
anavacchinnaṃ paramārthato hi rūpaṃ cito devyāḥ /
īdṛktādṛkprāyapraśamodayabhāvavilayaparikathayā // 118
meaning:
अनवच्छिन्नं परमार्थतो हि रूपं चितो देव्याः /
ईदृक्तादृक्प्रायप्रशमोदयभावविलयपरिकथया // 118
text_mt: For in the highest sense the nature of the goddess of consciousness is unconditioned. / Through discourse on the dissolution of entities into cessation and emergence of such-and-such kind,

sanskrit_iast:
anavacchinnaṃ dhāma praviśedvaisargikaṃ subhagaḥ /
śāntoditātmakaṃ dvayamatha yugapadudeti śaktiśaktimatoḥ // 119
meaning:
अनवच्छिन्नं धाम प्रविशेद्वैसर्गिकं सुभगः /
शान्तोदितात्मकं द्वयमथ युगपदुदेति शक्तिशक्तिमतोः // 119
text_mt: the fortunate one should enter the unconditioned, emissive abode. / Then the pair consisting of quiescent and emergent arises simultaneously in power and the possessor of power;

sanskrit_iast:
rūpamuditaṃ parasparadhāmagataṃ śāntamātmagatameva /
ubhayamapi vastutaḥ kila yāmalamiti tathoditaṃ śāntam // 120
meaning:
रूपमुदितं परस्परधामगतं शान्तमात्मगतमेव /
उभयमपि वस्तुतः किल यामलमिति तथोदितं शान्तम् // 120
text_mt: the emergent form goes to the abode of the other, the quiescent remains only in oneself. / Both indeed are fundamentally a dyad; thus it is spoken of as quiescent and emergent.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktistadvaducitāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān /
śāntoditātmakobhayarūpaparāmarśasāmyayoge'pi // 121
meaning:
शक्तिस्तद्वदुचितां सृष्टिं पुष्णाति नो तद्वान् /
शान्तोदितात्मकोभयरूपपरामर्शसाम्ययोगेऽपि // 121
text_mt: The power nourishes the appropriate creation in that manner, but the possessor of power does not; / even in the union of equal reflective awareness of the dual nature consisting of the quiescent and the emergent,

sanskrit_iast:
pravikasvaramadhyapadā śaktiḥ śāstre tataḥ kathitā /
tasyāmeva kulārthaṃ samyak saṃcārayedgurustena // 122
meaning:
प्रविकस्वरमध्यपदा शक्तिः शास्त्रे ततः कथिता /
तस्यामेव कुलार्थं सम्यक् संचारयेद्गुरुस्तेन // 122
text_mt: therefore in scripture power is declared to have an expanding central state; / for that reason, the guru should fully transmit the secret Kula teaching into her alone.

sanskrit_iast:
taddvāreṇa ca kathitakrameṇa saṃcārayeta nṛṣu /
svaśarīrādhikasadbhāvabhāvitāmiti tataḥ prāha // 123
meaning:
तद्द्वारेण च कथितक्रमेण संचारयेत नृषु /
स्वशरीराधिकसद्भावभावितामिति ततः प्राह // 123
text_mt: And by that door, in the manner described, he should transmit [it] into men. / Therefore he says: '[He should transmit it] as brought into being by the true reality exceeding one's own body.' // 123

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmatkallaṭanāthaḥ proktasamastārthalabdhaye vākyam /
tanmukhyacakramuktaṃ maheśinā yoginīvaktram // 124
meaning:
श्रीमत्कल्लटनाथः प्रोक्तसमस्तार्थलब्धये वाक्यम् /
तन्मुख्यचक्रमुक्तं महेशिना योगिनीवक्त्रम् // 124
text_mt: The venerable Kallaṭanātha uttered this statement for obtaining the entire meaning: / 'That primary wheel has been proclaimed by the Great Lord as the Yoginī-mouth.' // 124

sanskrit_iast:
tatraiṣa sampradāyastasmātsaṃprāpyate jñānam /
tadidamalekhyaṃ bhaṇitaṃ vaktrādvaktrasthamuktayuktyā ca // 125
meaning:
तत्रैष सम्प्रदायस्तस्मात्संप्राप्यते ज्ञानम् /
तदिदमलेख्यं भणितं वक्त्राद्वक्त्रस्थमुक्तयुक्त्या च // 125
text_mt: There is this lineage transmission; from that, knowledge is obtained. / That very thing has been declared to be non-writable, residing from mouth to mouth, by the logic stated. // 125

sanskrit_iast:
vaktraṃ pradhānacakraṃ svā saṃvillikhyatāṃ ca katham /
atha sṛṣṭe dvitaye'smin śāntoditadhāmni ye'nusaṃdadhate // 126
meaning:
वक्त्रं प्रधानचक्रं स्वा संविल्लिख्यतां च कथम् /
अथ सृष्टे द्वितयेऽस्मिन् शान्तोदितधाम्नि येऽनुसंदधते // 126
text_mt: The mouth is the primary wheel, and how could one's own consciousness be written down? / Now, in this twofold creation, in the abode of the quiescent and the emergent, those who concentrate // 126

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ visargasattāmanavacchidi te pade rūḍhāḥ /
ye siddhimāptukāmāste'bhyuditaṃ rūpamāhareyuratho // 127
meaning:
प्राच्यां विसर्गसत्तामनवच्छिदि ते पदे रूढाः /
ये सिद्धिमाप्तुकामास्तेऽभ्युदितं रूपमाहरेयुरथो // 127
text_mt: upon the primordial presence of creative emission, are rooted in the undivided state. / Those who wish to attain spiritual accomplishment may gather the emergent form, and then // 127

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva pūjayeyuḥ saṃvinnaikaṭyaśuddhatamavapuṣā /
tadapica mitho hi vaktrātpradhānato vaktragaṃ yato bhaṇitam // 128
meaning:
तेनैव पूजयेयुः संविन्नैकट्यशुद्धतमवपुषा /
तदपिच मिथो हि वक्त्रात्प्रधानतो वक्त्रगं यतो भणितम् // 128
text_mt: they should worship by means of that very body, supremely purified by proximity to consciousness. / Moreover, that which passes mutually from the primary mouth into the mouth is described, // 128

sanskrit_iast:
ajarāmarapadadānapravaṇaṃ kulasaṃjñitaṃ paramam /
ye'pyaprāptavibodhāste'bhyuditotphullayāgasaṃrūḍhāḥ // 129
meaning:
अजरामरपददानप्रवणं कुलसंज्ञितं परमम् /
येऽप्यप्राप्तविबोधास्तेऽभ्युदितोत्फुल्लयागसंरूढाः // 129
text_mt: since it is inclined toward granting the unaging and immortal state, designated as Kula, the supreme. / Even those who have not attained awakening, being firmly established in the emergent, blossoming ritual, // 129

sanskrit_iast:
tatparikalpitacakrasthadevatāḥ prāpnuvanti vijñānam /
te tatra śakticakre tenaivānandarasamayena bahiḥ // 130
meaning:
तत्परिकल्पितचक्रस्थदेवताः प्राप्नुवन्ति विज्ञानम् /
ते तत्र शक्तिचक्रे तेनैवानन्दरसमयेन बहिः // 130
text_mt: reach realization, becoming the deities abiding in that imagined wheel. / There, in that wheel of powers, through that very [wheel] composed of the nectar of bliss, externally // 130

sanskrit_iast:
dikṣu catasṛṣu proktakrameṇa gaṇanāthataḥ prabhṛti sarvam /
saṃpūjya madhyamapade kuleśayugmaṃ tvarātraye devīḥ // 131
meaning:
दिक्षु चतसृषु प्रोक्तक्रमेण गणनाथतः प्रभृति सर्वम् /
संपूज्य मध्यमपदे कुलेशयुग्मं त्वरात्रये देवीः // 131
text_mt: in the four directions according to the described order, having worshiped everything beginning with the Lord of Hosts, / the sage should worship in the middle state the pair of Kula-lords, the goddesses in the triad of Tvarā, // 131

sanskrit_iast:
bāhye pratyaramatha kila catuṣkamiti raśmicakramarkāram /
aṣṭakamaṣṭāṣṭakamatha vividhaṃ saṃpūjayetkrameṇa muniḥ // 132
meaning:
बाह्ये प्रत्यरमथ किल चतुष्कमिति रश्मिचक्रमर्कारम् /
अष्टकमष्टाष्टकमथ विविधं संपूजयेत्क्रमेण मुनिः // 132
text_mt: and outside, on each spoke, a quartet: the twelve-spoked wheel of rays, / the octad, and the sixty-four-fold wheel in various ways, in succession. // 132

sanskrit_iast:
nijadehagate dhāmani tathaiva pūjyaṃ samabhyasyet /
yattacchāntaṃ rūpaṃ tenābhyastena hṛdayasaṃvittyā // 133
meaning:
निजदेहगते धामनि तथैव पूज्यं समभ्यस्येत् /
यत्तच्छान्तं रूपं तेनाभ्यस्तेन हृदयसंवित्त्या // 133
text_mt: Just so, one should repeatedly practice what is to be worshiped in the abode located within one's own body. / That which is the quiescent form, when practiced through the consciousness of the heart, // 133

sanskrit_iast:
śāntaṃ śivapadameti hi galitataraṅgārṇavaprakhyam /
tacchāntapadādhyāsāccakrastho devatāgaṇaḥ sarvaḥ // 134
meaning:
शान्तं शिवपदमेति हि गलिततरङ्गार्णवप्रख्यम् /
तच्छान्तपदाध्यासाच्चक्रस्थो देवतागणः सर्वः // 134
text_mt: leads indeed to the quiescent state of Śiva, resembling an ocean whose waves have subsided. / Due to overlay upon that quiescent state, the entire multitude of deities abiding in the wheel // 134

sanskrit_iast:
tiṣṭhatyuparatavṛttiḥ śūnyālambī nirānandaḥ /
yo'pyanucakradṛgādisvarūpabhāk so'pi yattadāyattaḥ // 135
meaning:
तिष्ठत्युपरतवृत्तिः शून्यालम्बी निरानन्दः /
योऽप्यनुचक्रदृगादिस्वरूपभाक् सोऽपि यत्तदायत्तः // 135
text_mt: remains with ceased activity, relying on the void, devoid of bliss. / Even that which partakes of the nature of the secondary wheels such as sight, since it depends on that, // 135

sanskrit_iast:
tenānande magnastiṣṭhatyānandasākāṅkṣaḥ /
paratatsvarūpasaṅghaṭṭamantareṇaiṣa karaṇaraśmigaṇaḥ // 136
meaning:
तेनानन्दे मग्नस्तिष्ठत्यानन्दसाकाङ्क्षः /
परतत्स्वरूपसङ्घट्टमन्तरेणैष करणरश्मिगणः // 136
text_mt: remains immersed in that [quiescence], longing for bliss. / Without collision with that supreme nature, this multitude of rays of the senses // 136

sanskrit_iast:
āste hi niḥsvarūpaḥ svarūpalābhāya conmukhitaḥ /
raṇaraṇakarasānnijarasabharitabahirbhāvacarvaṇavaśena // 137
meaning:
आस्ते हि निःस्वरूपः स्वरूपलाभाय चोन्मुखितः /
रणरणकरसान्निजरसभरितबहिर्भावचर्वणवशेन // 137
text_mt: remains indeed devoid of its own nature, yet directed upward to attain its nature, / out of the flavor of longing, through relishing external entities filled with its own flavor. // 137

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāntidhāma kiñcillabdhvā svātmanyathārpayate /
tannijaviṣayārpaṇataḥ pūrṇasamucchalitasaṃvidāsāraḥ // 138
meaning:
विश्रान्तिधाम किञ्चिल्लब्ध्वा स्वात्मन्यथार्पयते /
तन्निजविषयार्पणतः पूर्णसमुच्छलितसंविदासारः // 138
text_mt: Having obtained a slight place of rest, it then offers [them] into its own self; / from that offering of its own objects, a torrential downpour of full, surging consciousness [arises]. // 138

sanskrit_iast:
anucakradevatāgaṇaparipūraṇajātavīryavikṣobhaḥ /
cakreśvaro'pi pūrvoktayuktitaḥ procchaledrabhasāt // 139
meaning:
अनुचक्रदेवतागणपरिपूरणजातवीर्यविक्षोभः /
चक्रेश्वरोऽपि पूर्वोक्तयुक्तितः प्रोच्छलेद्रभसात् // 139
text_mt: With an agitation of potency born of fully filling the multitude of deities of the secondary wheels, / even the lord of the wheel surges forth impetuously, in the manner previously explained. // 139

sanskrit_iast:
trividho visarga itthaṃ saṅghaṭṭaḥ proditastathā śāntaḥ /
visṛjati yato vicitraḥ sargo vigataśca yatra sarga iti // 140
meaning:
त्रिविधो विसर्ग इत्थं सङ्घट्टः प्रोदितस्तथा शान्तः /
विसृजति यतो विचित्रः सर्गो विगतश्च यत्र सर्ग इति // 140
text_mt: Thus creative emission is threefold: collision, emergent, and quiescent; / for it emits, diverse creation [arises], and into it creation dissolves. // 140

sanskrit_iast:
śrītattvarakṣaṇe śrīnigame triśiromate ca tatproktam /
kuṇḍaṃ śaktiḥ śivo liṅgaṃ melakaṃ paramaṃ padam // 141
meaning:
श्रीतत्त्वरक्षणे श्रीनिगमे त्रिशिरोमते च तत्प्रोक्तम् /
कुण्डं शक्तिः शिवो लिङ्गं मेलकं परमं पदम् // 141
text_mt: In the venerable Tattvarakṣaṇa, the venerable Nigama, and in the Triśiromata, that has been taught: / 'The pit is the power; Śiva is the liṅga; their union is the supreme state. // 141

sanskrit_iast:
dvābhyāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ saṃhṛtistadvisargastrividho game /
srotodvayasya niṣṭhāntamūrdhvādhaścakrabodhanam // 142
meaning:
द्वाभ्यां सृष्टिः संहृतिस्तद्विसर्गस्त्रिविधो गमे /
स्रोतोद्वयस्य निष्ठान्तमूर्ध्वाधश्चक्रबोधनम् // 142
text_mt: From both arise creation and withdrawal; that threefold creative emission is in the Āgama. / It is the awakening of the upper and lower wheels, the boundary of the two streams, // 142

sanskrit_iast:
viśrāmaṃ ca samāveśaṃ suṣīṇāṃ marutāṃ tathā /
gatabhedaṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ sandhīnāṃ marmaṇāmapi // 143
meaning:
विश्रामं च समावेशं सुषीणां मरुतां तथा /
गतभेदं च यन्त्राणां सन्धीनां मर्मणामपि // 143
text_mt: the rest and absorption of the channels and winds, / and the overcoming of the division of mystical mechanisms, joints, and vital points, // 143

sanskrit_iast:
dvāsaptatipade dehe sahasrāre ca nityaśaḥ /
gatyāgatyantarā vittī saṅghaṭṭayati yacchivaḥ // 144
meaning:
द्वासप्ततिपदे देहे सहस्रारे च नित्यशः /
गत्यागत्यन्तरा वित्ती सङ्घट्टयति यच्छिवः // 144
text_mt: in the body of seventy-two [thousand] channels, and continuously in the thousand-petaled [lotus]. / Because Śiva brings into collision the two awarenesses between going and coming, // 144

sanskrit_iast:
tatprayatnātsadā tiṣṭhetsaṅghaṭṭe bhairave pade /
ubhayostannirākārabhāvasaṃprāptilakṣaṇam // 145
meaning:
तत्प्रयत्नात्सदा तिष्ठेत्सङ्घट्टे भैरवे पदे /
उभयोस्तन्निराकारभावसंप्राप्तिलक्षणम् // 145
text_mt: therefore, by effort, one should always abide in the collision, in the state of Bhairava, / which has the characteristic of attaining the formless reality of both [Śiva and Śakti], // 145

sanskrit_iast:
mātrāvibhāgarahitaṃ susphuṭārthaprakāśakam /
abhyasyedbhāvasaṃvittiṃ sarvabhāvanivartanāt // 146
meaning:
मात्राविभागरहितं सुस्फुटार्थप्रकाशकम् /
अभ्यस्येद्भावसंवित्तिं सर्वभावनिवर्तनात् // 146
text_mt: is free of distinction of morae, and reveals clearly manifest reality. / One should cultivate consciousness of reality by turning back from all objective entities, // 146

sanskrit_iast:
sūryasomau tu saṃrudhya layavikṣepamārgataḥ /
evaṃ trividhavimarśāveśasamāpattidhāmni ya udeti // 147
meaning:
सूर्यसोमौ तु संरुध्य लयविक्षेपमार्गतः /
एवं त्रिविधविमर्शावेशसमापत्तिधाम्नि य उदेति // 147
text_mt: restraining the sun and moon through the paths of dissolution and projection. / Thus, in the abode of attainment of the absorption of threefold reflective awareness, that which arises, // 147

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvitparimarśātmā dhvanistadeveha mantravīryaṃ syāt /
tatraivoditatādṛśaphalalābhasamutsukaḥ svakaṃ mantram // 148
meaning:
संवित्परिमर्शात्मा ध्वनिस्तदेवेह मन्त्रवीर्यं स्यात् /
तत्रैवोदिततादृशफललाभसमुत्सुकः स्वकं मन्त्रम् // 148
text_mt: the resonance whose essence is reflective awareness of consciousness, would here be the potency of mantra. / Eager to attain such a fruit arising right there, if he constantly dwells // 148

sanskrit_iast:
anusandhāya sadā cedāste mantrodayaṃ sa vai vetti /
atraiva japaṃ kuryādanucakraikatvasaṃvidāgamane // 149
meaning:
अनुसन्धाय सदा चेदास्ते मन्त्रोदयं स वै वेत्ति /
अत्रैव जपं कुर्यादनुचक्रैकत्वसंविदागमने // 149
text_mt: upon his own mantra, he truly knows the rising of mantra. / One should perform repetition right here when the consciousness of oneness of the secondary wheels arrives, // 149

sanskrit_iast:
yugapallakṣavibhedaprapañcitaṃ nādavṛttyaiva /
śrīyogasañcare'pica mudreyaṃ yoginīpriyā paramā // 150
meaning:
युगपल्लक्षविभेदप्रपञ्चितं नादवृत्त्यैव /
श्रीयोगसञ्चरेऽपिच मुद्रेयं योगिनीप्रिया परमा // 150
text_mt: which is elaborated through hundreds of thousands of distinctions simultaneously, solely by the operation of sound. / Also in the venerable Yogasañcāra [it is taught]: 'This supreme mudrā is dear to the yoginīs. // 150

sanskrit_iast:
koṇatrayāntarāśritanityonmukhamaṇḍalacchade kamale /
satatāviyutaṃ nālaṃ ṣoḍaśadalakamalakalitasanmūlam // 151
meaning:
कोणत्रयान्तराश्रितनित्योन्मुखमण्डलच्छदे कमले /
सततावियुतं नालं षोडशदलकमलकलितसन्मूलम् // 151
text_mt: On the lotus having petal-coverings of the circle perpetually facing upward, resting within the three corners, / the stalk is constantly joined, possessing a firm root composed of a sixteen-petaled lotus. // 151

sanskrit_iast:
madhyasthanālagumphitasarojayugaghaṭṭanakramādagnau /
madhyasthapūrṇasundaraśaśadharadinakarakalaughasaṅghaṭṭāt // 152
meaning:
मध्यस्थनालगुम्फितसरोजयुगघट्टनक्रमादग्नौ /
मध्यस्थपूर्णसुन्दरशशधरदिनकरकलौघसङ्घट्टात् // 152
text_mt: In the fire, through the friction of the pair of lotuses strung upon the central stalk, / from the collision of the host of digits of the full, beautiful moon and sun situated in the middle, // 152

sanskrit_iast:
tridalāruṇavīryakalāsaṅgānmadhye'ṅkuraḥ sṛṣṭiḥ /
iti śaśadharavāsarapaticitragusaṃghaṭṭamudrayā jhaṭiti // 153
meaning:
त्रिदलारुणवीर्यकलासङ्गान्मध्येऽङ्कुरः सृष्टिः /
इति शशधरवासरपतिचित्रगुसंघट्टमुद्रया झटिति // 153
text_mt: creation is the sprout in the middle, born of union with the red potency-digit of three petals.' / Thus, through the mudrā of collision of the moon, the sun, and the fire, instantly // 153

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭyādikramamantaḥ kurvaṃsturye sthitiṃ labhate /
etatkhecaramudrāveśe'nyonyasya śaktiśaktimatoḥ // 154
meaning:
सृष्ट्यादिक्रममन्तः कुर्वंस्तुर्ये स्थितिं लभते /
एतत्खेचरमुद्रावेशेऽन्योन्यस्य शक्तिशक्तिमतोः // 154
text_mt: effecting within the sequence of creation and the rest, one attains stability in the Fourth. / When this mudrā of the skyfarer penetrates the power and the possessor of power mutually, // 154

sanskrit_iast:
pānopabhogalīlāhāsādiṣu yo bhavedvimarśamayaḥ /
avyaktadhvanirāvasphoṭaśrutinādanādāntaiḥ // 155
meaning:
पानोपभोगलीलाहासादिषु यो भवेद्विमर्शमयः /
अव्यक्तध्वनिरावस्फोटश्रुतिनादनादान्तैः // 155
text_mt: whatever consists of reflective awareness during drinking, enjoyment, amorous play, laughter, and so forth, / as inarticulate sound, burst, audition, resonance, and sound's end, // 155

sanskrit_iast:
avyucchinnānāhatarūpaistanmantravīryaṃ syāt /
iti cakrāṣṭakarūḍhaḥ sahajaṃ japamācaran pare dhāmni // 156
meaning:
अव्युच्छिन्नानाहतरूपैस्तन्मन्त्रवीर्यं स्यात् /
इति चक्राष्टकरूढः सहजं जपमाचरन् परे धाम्नि // 156
text_mt: in uninterrupted and unstruck forms, that would be the potency of mantra. / Established thus in the eight wheels, performing the spontaneous repetition in the supreme abode, // 156

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhairavāṣṭakapadaṃ tallabhate'ṣṭakakalābhinnam /
gamanāgamane'vasitau karṇe nayane dviliṅgasaṃparke // 157
meaning:
यद्भैरवाष्टकपदं तल्लभतेऽष्टककलाभिन्नम् /
गमनागमनेऽवसितौ कर्णे नयने द्विलिङ्गसंपर्के // 157
text_mt: one attains that state of the eight Bhairavas differentiated by the eight digits: / in going and coming, in cessation, in the ear, in the eye, in the contact of the two sexes, // 157

sanskrit_iast:
tatsaṃmelanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre /
kucamadhyahṛdayadeśādoṣṭhāntaṃ kaṇṭhagaṃ yadavyaktam // 158
meaning:
तत्संमेलनयोगे देहान्ताख्ये च यामले चक्रे /
कुचमध्यहृदयदेशादोष्ठान्तं कण्ठगं यदव्यक्तम् // 158
text_mt: in the union thereof, and in the dyadic wheel named the body's end; / and whatever is inarticulate, rising from the breast-center, the heart region, to the lip-edge and throat, // 158

sanskrit_iast:
taccakradvayamadhyagamākarṇya kṣobhavigamasamaye yat /
nirvānti tatra caivaṃ yo'ṣṭavidho nādabhairavaḥ paramaḥ // 159
meaning:
तच्चक्रद्वयमध्यगमाकर्ण्य क्षोभविगमसमये यत् /
निर्वान्ति तत्र चैवं योऽष्टविधो नादभैरवः परमः // 159
text_mt: hearing that which is situated between the two wheels, at the moment of cessation of agitation / they dissolve therein; and thus the supreme eightfold Sound-Bhairava, // 159

sanskrit_iast:
jyotirdhvanisamirakṛtaḥ sā māntrī vyāptirucyate paramā /
sakalākaleśaśūnyaṃ kalāḍhyakhamale tathā kṣapaṇakaṃ ca // 160
meaning:
ज्योतिर्ध्वनिसमिरकृतः सा मान्त्री व्याप्तिरुच्यते परमा /
सकलाकलेशशून्यं कलाढ्यखमले तथा क्षपणकं च // 160
text_mt: composed of light, sound, and air, is declared to be the supreme pervasion of mantra: / devoid of all and parts, full of digits, in the sky-impurity, and in the ascetic, // 160

sanskrit_iast:
antaḥsthaṃ kaṇṭhyoṣṭhyaṃ candrādvyāptistathonmanānteyam /
evaṃ karmaṇi karmaṇi yatra kvāpi smaran vyāptim // 161
meaning:
अन्तःस्थं कण्ठ्योष्ठ्यं चन्द्राद्व्याप्तिस्तथोन्मनान्तेयम् /
एवं कर्मणि कर्मणि यत्र क्वापि स्मरन् व्याप्तिम् // 161
text_mt: internal, guttural, labial, from the moon, and likewise this pervasion ending in Unmanā. / Thus remembering this pervasion wherever [he may be] in every action, // 161

sanskrit_iast:
satatamalepo jīvanmuktaḥ parabhairavībhavati /
tādṛṅmelakakalikākalitatanuḥ ko'pi yo bhavedgarbhe // 162
meaning:
सततमलेपो जीवन्मुक्तः परभैरवीभवति /
तादृङ्मेलककलिकाकलिततनुः कोऽपि यो भवेद्गर्भे // 162
text_mt: eternally unstained, liberated while living, he becomes the supreme Bhairava. / Whoever has his body formed in the womb from the bud of such a union // 162

sanskrit_iast:
uktaḥ sa yoginībhūḥ svayameva jñānabhājanaṃ rudraḥ /
śrīvīrāvaliśāstre bālo'pi ca garbhago hi śivarūpaḥ // 163
meaning:
उक्तः स योगिनीभूः स्वयमेव ज्ञानभाजनं रुद्रः /
श्रीवीरावलिशास्त्रे बालोऽपि च गर्भगो हि शिवरूपः // 163
text_mt: is declared to be yoginī-born, Rudra himself, a vessel of knowledge. / In the venerable Vīrāvalī scripture [it is said]: 'Even as an infant in the womb, he is indeed of the nature of Śiva.' // 163

sanskrit_iast:
ādīyate yataḥ sāraṃ tasya mukhyasya caiṣa yat /
mukhyaśca yāgastenāyamādiyāga iti smṛtaḥ // 164
meaning:
आदीयते यतः सारं तस्य मुख्यस्य चैष यत् /
मुख्यश्च यागस्तेनायमादियाग इति स्मृतः // 164
text_mt:
Because its essence is extracted, and because this principal [rite]
is the chief sacrifice, it is remembered as the 'primordial sacrifice' (ādiyāga). // 164

sanskrit_iast:
tatra tatra ca śāstre'sya svarūpaṃ stutavān vibhuḥ /
śrīvīrāvalihārdeśakhamatārṇavavartiṣu // 165
meaning:
तत्र तत्र च शास्त्रेऽस्य स्वरूपं स्तुतवान् विभुः /
श्रीवीरावलिहार्देशखमतार्णववर्तिषु // 165
text_mt:
And in various scriptures the all-pervading Lord praised its nature:
in the Śrīvīrāvalī, the Hārdeśa, the Khamatārṇava, // 165

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsiddhotphullamaryādāhīnacaryākulādiṣu /
yugmasyāsya prasādena vratayogavivarjitaḥ // 166
meaning:
श्रीसिद्धोत्फुल्लमर्यादाहीनचर्याकुलादिषु /
युग्मस्यास्य प्रसादेन व्रतयोगविवर्जितः // 166
text_mt:
the Śrīsiddhotphulla, the Maryādāhīna, the Caryākula, and others.
By the grace of this couple, free from vows and yogic practices, // 166

sanskrit_iast:
sarvadā smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ādiyāgaikatatparaḥ /
śaktidehe nije nyasyedvidyāṃ kūṭamanukramāt // 167
meaning:
सर्वदा स्मरणं कृत्वा आदियागैकतत्परः /
शक्तिदेहे निजे न्यस्येद्विद्यां कूटमनुक्रमात् // 167
text_mt:
always remembering [this], devoted solely to the primordial sacrifice,
he should deposit the Vidyā and the Kūṭa sequentially upon the body of his śakti and upon his own. // 167

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā candranibhaṃ padmamātmānaṃ bhāskaradyutim /
vidyāmantrātmakaṃ pīṭhadvayamatraiva melayet // 168
meaning:
ध्यात्वा चन्द्रनिभं पद्ममात्मानं भास्करद्युतिम् /
विद्यामन्त्रात्मकं पीठद्वयमत्रैव मेलयेत् // 168
text_mt:
Meditating on the moon-like lotus and on oneself having the radiance of the sun,
he should unite right here the two seats, which consist of the vidyā and the mantra. // 168

sanskrit_iast:
na paṭhyate rahasyatvātspaṣṭaiḥ śabdairmayā punaḥ /
kutūhalī tūktaśāstrasaṃpāṭhādeva lakṣayet // 169
meaning:
न पठ्यते रहस्यत्वात्स्पष्टैः शब्दैर्मया पुनः /
कुतूहली तूक्तशास्त्रसंपाठादेव लक्षयेत् // 169
text_mt:
It is not recited again by me in explicit words due to its secret nature;
but the curious one should understand [it] from the recitation of the scriptures mentioned. // 169

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhajante sadā sarve yadvān devaśca devatā /
taccakraṃ paramaṃ devīyāgādau saṃnidhāpakam // 170
meaning:
यद्भजन्ते सदा सर्वे यद्वान् देवश्च देवता /
तच्चक्रं परमं देवीयागादौ संनिधापकम् // 170
text_mt:
That which all worship always, or which the god and goddess worship,
that supreme wheel is that which makes present [the deities] at the beginning of the sacrifice of the Goddess and the like. // 170

sanskrit_iast:
deha eva paraṃ liṅgaṃ sarvatattvātmakaṃ śivam /
devatācakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ pūjādhāma taduttamam // 171
meaning:
देह एव परं लिङ्गं सर्वतत्त्वात्मकं शिवम् /
देवताचक्रसंजुष्टं पूजाधाम तदुत्तमम् // 171
text_mt:
The body itself is the supreme linga, Śiva comprising all tattvas,
frequented by the wheel of deities, the supreme abode of worship. // 171

sanskrit_iast:
tadeva maṇḍalaṃ mukhyaṃ tritriśūlābjacakrakham /
tatraiva devatācakraṃ bahirantaḥ sadā yajet // 172
meaning:
तदेव मण्डलं मुख्यं त्रित्रिशूलाब्जचक्रखम् /
तत्रैव देवताचक्रं बहिरन्तः सदा यजेत् // 172
text_mt:
That itself is the principal maṇḍala, the void of the wheel of three tridents and lotuses;
right there one should constantly worship the wheel of deities internally and externally. // 172

sanskrit_iast:
svasvamantraparāmarśapūrvaṃ tajjanmabhī rasaiḥ /
ānandabahulaiḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāravidhinā spṛśet // 173
meaning:
स्वस्वमन्त्रपरामर्शपूर्वं तज्जन्मभी रसैः /
आनन्दबहुलैः सृष्टिसंहारविधिना स्पृशेत् // 173
text_mt:
Preceded by the reflective awareness of their respective mantras, with the fluids born thereof
abounding in bliss, he should touch [them] according to the rule of emission and retraction. // 173

sanskrit_iast:
tatsparśarabhasodbuddhasaṃviccakraṃ tadīśvaraḥ /
labhate paramaṃ dhāma tarpitāśeṣadaivataḥ // 174
meaning:
तत्स्पर्शरभसोद्बुद्धसंविच्चक्रं तदीश्वरः /
लभते परमं धाम तर्पिताशेषदैवतः // 174
text_mt:
He whose wheel of consciousness is awakened by the impetuosity of that contact, the master thereof,
having satisfied all the deities, attains the supreme abode. // 174

sanskrit_iast:
anuyāgoktavidhinā dravyairhṛdayahāribhiḥ /
tathaiva svasvakāmarśayogādantaḥ pratarpayet // 175
meaning:
अनुयागोक्तविधिना द्रव्यैर्हृदयहारिभिः /
तथैव स्वस्वकामर्शयोगादन्तः प्रतर्पयेत् // 175
text_mt:
According to the rule prescribed for the subsequent sacrifice, with heart-captivating substances,
he should likewise gratify them within, through the yoga of reflective awareness of their respective natures. // 175

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ /
ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye'harniśam // 176
meaning:
कृत्वाधारधरां चमत्कृतिरसप्रोक्षाक्षणक्षालितामात्तैर्मानसतः स्वभावकुसुमैः स्वामोदसन्दोहिभिः /
आनन्दामृतनिर्भरस्वहृदयानर्घार्घपात्रक्रमात् त्वां देव्या सह देहदेवसदने देवार्चयेऽहर्निशम् // 176
text_mt:
Having made the supporting earth cleansed in an instant by the sprinkling of the savor of wonder,
with flowers of intrinsic nature gathered mentally, brimming with their own fragrant multitudes,
in the sequence of the priceless vessel of offering that is one's own heart filled with the nectar of bliss,
O God, I worship you day and night together with the Goddess in the temple that is the body. // 176

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvīrāvalyamaryādaprabhṛtau śāstrasañcaye /
sa eṣa paramo yāgaḥ stutaḥ śītāṃśumaulinā // 177
meaning:
श्रीवीरावल्यमर्यादप्रभृतौ शास्त्रसञ्चये /
स एष परमो यागः स्तुतः शीतांशुमौलिना // 177
text_mt:
In the collection of scriptures beginning with the Śrīvīrāvalī and the Maryādāhīna,
this very supreme sacrifice was praised by the moon-crested Lord. // 177

sanskrit_iast:
athavā prāṇavṛttisthaṃ samastaṃ devatāgaṇam /
paśyetpūrvoktayuktyaiva tatraivābhyarcayedguruḥ // 178
meaning:
अथवा प्राणवृत्तिस्थं समस्तं देवतागणम् /
पश्येत्पूर्वोक्तयुक्त्यैव तत्रैवाभ्यर्चयेद्गुरुः // 178
text_mt:
Or rather, the guru should behold the entire assembly of deities residing in the operation of the vital breath
by the very method stated before, and should worship them right there. // 178

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāśritānāṃ devīnāṃ brahmanāsādibhedibhiḥ /
karandhrairviśatāpānacāndracakreṇa tarpaṇam // 179
meaning:
प्राणाश्रितानां देवीनां ब्रह्मनासादिभेदिभिः /
करन्ध्रैर्विशतापानचान्द्रचक्रेण तर्पणम् // 179
text_mt:
The gratification of the goddesses residing in the vital breath is accomplished by the lunar wheel of the apāna,
entering through the apertures of the hands that penetrate the opening of Brahman, the nose, and so forth. // 179

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prāṇakrameṇaiva tarpayeddevatāgaṇam /
acirāttatprasādena jñānasiddhīrathāśnute // 180
meaning:
एवं प्राणक्रमेणैव तर्पयेद्देवतागणम् /
अचिरात्तत्प्रसादेन ज्ञानसिद्धीरथाश्नुते // 180
text_mt:
Thus, in the very sequence of the vital breath, he should gratify the host of deities;
soon, through their grace, he obtains spiritual accomplishments of knowledge. // 180

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvinmātrasthitaṃ devīcakraṃ vā saṃvidarpaṇāt /
viśvābhogaprayogeṇa tarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścitā // 181
meaning:
संविन्मात्रस्थितं देवीचक्रं वा संविदर्पणात् /
विश्वाभोगप्रयोगेण तर्पणीयं विपश्चिता // 181
text_mt:
Or the wise man should gratify the wheel of goddesses residing solely in consciousness, through the offering of consciousness,
by means of the practice of universal expanse. // 181

sanskrit_iast:
yatra sarve layaṃ yānti dahyante tattvasañcayāḥ /
tāṃ citiṃ paśya kāyasthāṃ kālānalasamaprabhām // 182
meaning:
यत्र सर्वे लयं यान्ति दह्यन्ते तत्त्वसञ्चयाः /
तां चितिं पश्य कायस्थां कालानलसमप्रभाम् // 182
text_mt:
Behold that funeral pyre of consciousness stationed in the body, possessing a radiance like the fire of destruction,
wherein all dissolve and the heaps of tattvas are consumed. // 182

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyarūpe śmaśāne'smin yoginīsiddhasevite /
krīḍāsthāne mahāraudre sarvāstamitavigrahe // 183
meaning:
शून्यरूपे श्मशानेऽस्मिन् योगिनीसिद्धसेविते /
क्रीडास्थाने महारौद्रे सर्वास्तमितविग्रहे // 183
text_mt:
In this cremation ground of the nature of the void, frequented by yoginīs and siddhas,
a place of sport, immensely terrible, where all physical form has set, // 183

sanskrit_iast:
svaraśmimaṇḍalākīrṇe dhvaṃsitadhvāntasantatau /
sarvairvikalpairnirmukte ānandapadakevale // 184
meaning:
स्वरश्मिमण्डलाकीर्णे ध्वंसितध्वान्तसन्ततौ /
सर्वैर्विकल्पैर्निर्मुक्ते आनन्दपदकेवले // 184
text_mt:
filled with the circle of its own rays, the continuity of darkness destroyed,
freed from all conceptual constructs, nothing but the plane of bliss, // 184

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃkhyacitisaṃpūrṇe śmaśāne citibhīṣaṇe /
samastadevatādhāre praviṣṭaḥ ko na siddhyati // 185
meaning:
असंख्यचितिसंपूर्णे श्मशाने चितिभीषणे /
समस्तदेवताधारे प्रविष्टः को न सिद्ध्यति // 185
text_mt:
in the cremation ground filled with countless pyres, terrifying with funeral fires,
the support of all deities—who that enters here does not attain spiritual accomplishment? // 185

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadvīrāvalīśāstre itthaṃ provāca bhairavī /
itthaṃ yāgaṃ vidhāyādau tādṛśaucityabhāginam // 186
meaning:
श्रीमद्वीरावलीशास्त्रे इत्थं प्रोवाच भैरवी /
इत्थं यागं विधायादौ तादृशौचित्यभागिनम् // 186
text_mt:
Thus the Goddess Bhairavī spoke in the venerable Vīrāvalīśāstra.
Having thus performed the sacrifice at the outset, one endowed with such fitness, // 186

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaikīyaṃ svaśiṣyaṃ taṃ dīkṣayettādṛśi krame /
rudraśaktyā tu taṃ prokṣya devābhyāśe niveśayet // 187
meaning:
लक्षैकीयं स्वशिष्यं तं दीक्षयेत्तादृशि क्रमे /
रुद्रशक्त्या तु तं प्रोक्ष्य देवाभ्याशे निवेशयेत् // 187
text_mt:
his own disciple of a single aim, he should initiate into such a sequence:
having sprinkled him with the power of Rudra, he should seat him near the deity. // 187

sanskrit_iast:
bhujau tasya samālokya rudraśaktyā pradīpayet /
tayaivāsyārpayetpuṣpaṃ karayorgandhadigdhayoḥ // 188
meaning:
भुजौ तस्य समालोक्य रुद्रशक्त्या प्रदीपयेत् /
तयैवास्यार्पयेत्पुष्पं करयोर्गन्धदिग्धयोः // 188
text_mt:
Looking at his two arms, he should kindle them with the power of Rudra;
with that very [power] he should place a flower into his hands anointed with fragrant paste. // 188

sanskrit_iast:
nirālambau tu tau tasya sthāpayitvā vicintayet /
rudraśaktyākṛṣyamāṇau dīptayāṅkuśarūpayā // 189
meaning:
निरालम्बौ तु तौ तस्य स्थापयित्वा विचिन्तयेत् /
रुद्रशक्त्याकृष्यमाणौ दीप्तयाङ्कुशरूपया // 189
text_mt:
Placing the two [arms] without support, he should meditate on them
as being drawn by the radiant power of Rudra in the form of a hook. // 189

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ sa svayamādāya vastraṃ baddhadṛśirbhavet /
svayaṃ ca pātayetpuṣpaṃ tatpātāllakṣayetkulam // 190
meaning:
ततः स स्वयमादाय वस्त्रं बद्धदृशिर्भवेत् /
स्वयं च पातयेत्पुष्पं तत्पाताल्लक्षयेत्कुलम् // 190
text_mt:
Then, having taken the cloth himself, [the disciple] should have his eyes bound,
and he should drop the flower himself; from its fall [the guru] should recognize the spiritual family (kula). // 190

sanskrit_iast:
tato'sya mukhamuddhāṭya pādayoḥ praṇipātayet /
hastayormūrdhni cāpyasya devīcakraṃ samarcayet // 191
meaning:
ततोऽस्य मुखमुद्धाट्य पादयोः प्रणिपातयेत् /
हस्तयोर्मूर्ध्नि चाप्यस्य देवीचक्रं समर्चयेत् // 191
text_mt:
Then, uncovering his face, he should have him prostrate at his feet;
and upon his hands and head he should worship the wheel of goddesses. // 191

sanskrit_iast:
ākarṣyākarṣakatvena preryaprerakabhāvataḥ /
uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nābhiṃ daṇḍena saṃpuṭam // 192
meaning:
आकर्ष्याकर्षकत्वेन प्रेर्यप्रेरकभावतः /
उक्तं श्रीरत्नमालायां नाभिं दण्डेन संपुटम् // 192
text_mt:
Through the state of being attracted and attractor, and through the nature of impeller and impelled,
it is taught in the Śrīratnamālā: having the navel enclosed by the staff, // 192

sanskrit_iast:
vāmabhūṣaṇajaṅghābhyāṃ nitambenāpyalaṅkṛtam /
śiṣyahaste puṣpabhṛte codanāstraṃ tu yojayet // 193
meaning:
वामभूषणजङ्घाभ्यां नितम्बेनाप्यलङ्कृतम् /
शिष्यहस्ते पुष्पभृते चोदनास्त्रं तु योजयेत् // 193
text_mt:
adorned with the left ornament and the shanks, and also with the hip—
he should apply the missile of impulsion to the disciple's hand holding the flower, // 193

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsa stobhamāyātaḥ svayaṃ patati mūrdhani /
śivahastaḥ svayaṃ so'yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ // 194
meaning:
यावत्स स्तोभमायातः स्वयं पतति मूर्धनि /
शिवहस्तः स्वयं सोऽयं सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकः // 194
text_mt:
until, undergoing possession, it falls of its own accord upon the head.
This is the hand of Śiva itself, producing immediate conviction. // 194

sanskrit_iast:
anenaiva prayogeṇa carukaṃ grāhayedguruḥ /
śiṣyeṇa dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca tatpātaḥ prāgvadeva tu // 195
meaning:
अनेनैव प्रयोगेण चरुकं ग्राहयेद्गुरुः /
शिष्येण दन्तकाष्ठं च तत्पातः प्राग्वदेव तु // 195
text_mt:
By this very practice the guru should have the sacrificial food (caru) taken
by the disciple, as well as the tooth-cleaning stick; its fall is just as before. // 195

sanskrit_iast:
karastobho netrapaṭagrahāt prabhṛti yaḥ kila /
dantakāṣṭhasamādānaparyantastatra lakṣayet // 196
meaning:
करस्तोभो नेत्रपटग्रहात् प्रभृति यः किल /
दन्तकाष्ठसमादानपर्यन्तस्तत्र लक्षयेत् // 196
text_mt:
The seizure of the hand, which indeed begins from the taking of the blindfold
and lasts up to the grasping of the tooth-stick—therein he should discern // 196

sanskrit_iast:
tīvramandādibhedena śaktipātaṃ tathāvidham /
ityeṣa samayī proktaḥ śrīpūrve karakampataḥ // 197
meaning:
तीव्रमन्दादिभेदेन शक्तिपातं तथाविधम् /
इत्येष समयी प्रोक्तः श्रीपूर्वे करकम्पतः // 197
text_mt:
the descent of power according to the divisions of intense, mild, and so forth, in that manner.
Such a one is declared an initiate into the rule (samayī) in the Śrīpūrva from the trembling of the hand; // 197

sanskrit_iast:
samayī tu karastobhāditi śrībhogahastake /
carveva vā gururdadyādvāmāmṛtapariplutam // 198
meaning:
समयी तु करस्तोभादिति श्रीभोगहस्तके /
चर्वेव वा गुरुर्दद्याद्वामामृतपरिप्लुतम् // 198
text_mt:
and 'an initiate into the rule from the seizure of the hand' in the Śrībhogahastaka.
Or the guru may give the caru flooded with the nectar of the left. // 198

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśaṅkaṃ grahaṇācchaktigotro māyojjhito bhavet /
sakampastvādadānaḥ syāt samayī vācanādiṣu // 199
meaning:
निःशङ्कं ग्रहणाच्छक्तिगोत्रो मायोज्झितो भवेत् /
सकम्पस्त्वाददानः स्यात् समयी वाचनादिषु // 199
text_mt:
From taking it without hesitation, he belongs to the lineage of Śakti and is freed from māyā;
but taking it with trembling, he would be an initiate into the rule with regard to instruction and the like. // 199

sanskrit_iast:
kālāntare'dhvasaṃśuddhyā pālanātsamayasthiteḥ /
siddhipātramiti śrīmadānandeśvara ucyate // 200
meaning:
कालान्तरेऽध्वसंशुद्ध्या पालनात्समयस्थितेः /
सिद्धिपात्रमिति श्रीमदानन्देश्वर उच्यते // 200
text_mt:
In time, through the purification of the path and the keeping of the rule,
he becomes a vessel of spiritual accomplishment: thus it is said in the Śrīmadānandeśvara. // 200

sanskrit_iast:
yadā tu putrakaṃ kuryāttadā dīkṣāṃ samācaret /
uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nādiphāntāṃ jvalatprabhām // 201
meaning:
यदा तु पुत्रकं कुर्यात्तदा दीक्षां समाचरेत् /
उक्तं श्रीरत्नमालायां नादिफान्तां ज्वलत्प्रभाम् // 201
text_mt:
When, however, he would make him a spiritual son (putraka), then he should perform the initiation.
It is said in the Śrīratnamālā: [the mantra] beginning with nāda and ending with phaṭ, of blazing radiance, // 201

sanskrit_iast:
nyasyecchikhāntaṃ patati tenātredṛk kramo bhavet /
prokṣitasya śiśornyastaproktaśodhyādhvapaddhateḥ // 202
meaning:
न्यस्येच्छिखान्तं पतति तेनात्रेदृक् क्रमो भवेत् /
प्रोक्षितस्य शिशोर्न्यस्तप्रोक्तशोध्याध्वपद्धतेः // 202
text_mt:
he should install up to the tuft of hair; it falls, and therefore such a sequence should occur here.
For the child who has been sprinkled, upon whom the stated course of the path to be purified has been installed, // 202

sanskrit_iast:
ṛjudehajuṣaḥ śaktiṃ pādānmūrdhāntamāgatām /
pāśāndahantīṃ saṃdīptāṃ cintayettanmayo guruḥ // 203
meaning:
ऋजुदेहजुषः शक्तिं पादान्मूर्धान्तमागताम् /
पाशान्दहन्तीं संदीप्तां चिन्तयेत्तन्मयो गुरुः // 203
text_mt:
the guru, identified with it, should meditate on the power that occupies an upright body,
which has reached from the feet to the head, burning the bonds, blazing brightly. // 203

sanskrit_iast:
upaviśya tatastasya mūlaśodhyāt prabhṛtyalam /
antaśodhyāvasānāntāṃ dahantīṃ cintayetkramāt // 204
meaning:
उपविश्य ततस्तस्य मूलशोध्यात् प्रभृत्यलम् /
अन्तशोध्यावसानान्तां दहन्तीं चिन्तयेत्क्रमात् // 204
text_mt:
Having seated himself, he should then completely meditate on it sequentially
burning from the primary element to be purified up to the end of the final element to be purified. // 204

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ sarvāṇi śodhyāni tattvādīni puroktavat /
dagdhvā līnāṃ śive dhyāyenniṣkale sakale'thavā // 205
meaning:
एवं सर्वाणि शोध्यानि तत्त्वादीनि पुरोक्तवत् /
दग्ध्वा लीनां शिवे ध्यायेन्निष्कले सकलेऽथवा // 205
text_mt:
Having thus burned all the tattvas and other items to be purified as previously explained,
he should meditate on [the power] dissolved in Śiva, either formless or with form. // 205

sanskrit_iast:
yoginā yojitā mārge sajātīyasya poṣaṇam /
kurute nirdahatyantadbhinnajātikadambakam // 206
meaning:
योगिना योजिता मार्गे सजातीयस्य पोषणम् /
कुरुते निर्दहत्यन्तद्भिन्नजातिकदम्बकम् // 206
text_mt:
Employed on the path by the yogin, it provides nourishment to that of the same kind,
and utterly burns the collection of different kinds. // 206

sanskrit_iast:
anayā śodhyamānasya śiśostīvrādibhedataḥ /
śaktipātāccitivyomaprāṇanāntarbahistanūḥ // 207
meaning:
अनया शोध्यमानस्य शिशोस्तीव्रादिभेदतः /
शक्तिपाताच्चितिव्योमप्राणनान्तर्बहिस्तनूः // 207
text_mt:
For the child being purified by this, according to the distinction of intense and other [degrees]
of the descent of power, into the bodies that are internal and external, comprising consciousness, void, and vital breath, // 207

sanskrit_iast:
āviśantī rudraśaktiḥ kramātsūte phalaṃ tvidam /
ānandamudbhavaṃ kampaṃ nidrāṃ ghūrṇiṃ ca dehagām // 208
meaning:
आविशन्ती रुद्रशक्तिः क्रमात्सूते फलं त्विदम् /
आनन्दमुद्भवं कम्पं निद्रां घूर्णिं च देहगाम् // 208
text_mt:
the power of Rudra, penetrating, gradually produces this fruit:
bliss, ascent, trembling, sleep, and whirling occurring in the body. // 208

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ stobhitapāśasya yojitasyātmanaḥ śive /
śeṣabhogāya kurvīta sṛṣṭiṃ saṃśuddhatattvagām // 209
meaning:
एवं स्तोभितपाशस्य योजितस्यात्मनः शिवे /
शेषभोगाय कुर्वीत सृष्टिं संशुद्धतत्त्वगाम् // 209
text_mt: In this way, for one whose bonds have been agitated [and] whose self has been united with Śiva, / he should perform the emission abiding in the completely purified tattvas for the remainder of enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā kasyacinnaivamāveśastaddahedimam /
bahirantaścoktaśaktyā pateditthaṃ sa bhūtale // 210
meaning:
अथवा कस्यचिन्नैवमावेशस्तद्दहेदिमम् /
बहिरन्तश्चोक्तशक्त्या पतेदित्थं स भूतले // 210
text_mt: Or, if someone does not experience possession in this manner, he should burn him / externally and internally by the aforesaid power; in this way he falls to the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
yasya tvevamapi syānna tamatropalavattyajet /
atha sapratyayāṃ dīkṣāṃ vakṣye tuṣṭena dhīmatā // 211
meaning:
यस्य त्वेवमपि स्यान्न तमत्रोपलवत्त्यजेत् /
अथ सप्रत्ययां दीक्षां वक्ष्ये तुष्टेन धीमता // 211
text_mt: The one, however, who does not [fall] even in this way, he should abandon here like a stone. / Now I will explain the initiation accompanied by experiential verification, taught by the wise Śambhunātha,

sanskrit_iast:
śaṃbhunāthenopadiṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭāṃ sadbhāvaśāsane /
sudhāgnimaruto mandaparakālāgnivāyavaḥ // 212
meaning:
शंभुनाथेनोपदिष्टां दृष्टां सद्भावशासने /
सुधाग्निमरुतो मन्दपरकालाग्निवायवः // 212
text_mt: who was pleased, [and] seen in the Sadbhāvaśāsana: / nectar, fire, wind; the subtle, transcendent fire of time and winds;

sanskrit_iast:
vahnisaudhāsukūṭāgnivāyuḥ sarve saṣaṣṭhakāḥ /
etatpiṇḍatrayaṃ stobhakāri pratyekamucyate // 213
meaning:
वह्निसौधासुकूटाग्निवायुः सर्वे सषष्ठकाः /
एतत्पिण्डत्रयं स्तोभकारि प्रत्येकमुच्यते // 213
text_mt: fire, nectar, breath, the peak fire, and wind—all together with the sixth [vowel]. / This triad of aggregates is taught individually as causing agitation.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktibījaṃ smṛtaṃ yacca nyasyetsārvāṅgikaṃ tu tat /
hṛccakre nyasyate mantro dvādaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ // 214
meaning:
शक्तिबीजं स्मृतं यच्च न्यस्येत्सार्वाङ्गिकं तु तत् /
हृच्चक्रे न्यस्यते मन्त्रो द्वादशस्वरभूषितः // 214
text_mt: And that which is remembered as the seed-syllable of power, he should install on all his limbs; / in the heart-cakra the mantra adorned with the twelve vowels is installed.

sanskrit_iast:
japākusumasaṃkāśaṃ caitanyaṃ tasya madhyataḥ /
vāyunā preritaṃ cakraṃ vahninā paridīpitam // 215
meaning:
जपाकुसुमसंकाशं चैतन्यं तस्य मध्यतः /
वायुना प्रेरितं चक्रं वह्निना परिदीपितम् // 215
text_mt: Consciousness resembles a hibiscus flower in the middle of it; / the cakra is impelled by the wind and kindled around by fire.

sanskrit_iast:
taddhyāyecca japenmantraṃ nāmāntaritayogataḥ /
nimeṣārdhāttu śiṣyasya bhavetstobho na saṃśayaḥ // 216
meaning:
तद्ध्यायेच्च जपेन्मन्त्रं नामान्तरितयोगतः /
निमेषार्धात्तु शिष्यस्य भवेत्स्तोभो न संशयः // 216
text_mt: He should meditate on that and recite the mantra through the practice of interleaving with the name; / within half a twinkling of an eye, agitation certainly occurs in the disciple.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ prekṣate devi tattve tattve niyojitaḥ /
yāvatprāptaḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ tadā tveṣa na paśyati // 217
meaning:
आत्मानं प्रेक्षते देवि तत्त्वे तत्त्वे नियोजितः /
यावत्प्राप्तः परं तत्त्वं तदा त्वेष न पश्यति // 217
text_mt: Appointed to tattva after tattva, O Goddess, he beholds the self; / as long as he has not reached the supreme tattva; then indeed he does not see.

sanskrit_iast:
anena kramayogena sarvādhvānaṃ sa paśyati /
athavā sarvaśāstrāṇyapyudgrāhayati tatkṣaṇāt // 218
meaning:
अनेन क्रमयोगेन सर्वाध्वानं स पश्यति /
अथवा सर्वशास्त्राण्यप्युद्ग्राहयति तत्क्षणात् // 218
text_mt: By this method of progression, he beholds the entire path; / or rather, in that very instant he masters all the scriptures as well.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthaktattvavidhau dīkṣāṃ yogyatāvaśavartinaḥ /
tattvābhyāsavidhānena siddhayogī samācaret // 219
meaning:
पृथक्तत्त्वविधौ दीक्षां योग्यतावशवर्तिनः /
तत्त्वाभ्यासविधानेन सिद्धयोगी समाचरेत् // 219
text_mt: In the rite of distinct tattvas, the accomplished yogin should perform initiation / through the rite of repeating the tattvas for one who is subject to fitness.

sanskrit_iast:
iti saṃdīkṣitasyāsya mumukṣoḥ śeṣavartane /
kulakrameṣṭirādeśyā pañcāvasthāsamanvitā // 220
meaning:
इति संदीक्षितस्यास्य मुमुक्षोः शेषवर्तने /
कुलक्रमेष्टिरादेश्या पञ्चावस्थासमन्विता // 220
text_mt: Thus for this seeker of liberation who has been consecrated, in the remaining conduct of life, / the sacrifice of the Kula succession endowed with the five states should be instructed,

sanskrit_iast:
jāgradādiṣu saṃvittiryathā syādanapāyinī /
kulayāgastathādeśyo yoginīmukhasaṃsthitaḥ // 221
meaning:
जाग्रदादिषु संवित्तिर्यथा स्यादनपायिनी /
कुलयागस्तथादेश्यो योगिनीमुखसंस्थितः // 221
text_mt: so that consciousness in waking and the other states may become unfailing; / thus the Kula sacrifice situated in the mouth of the yoginīs should be instructed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvaṃ jāgrati kartavyaṃ svapne pratyekamantragam /
nivārya supte mūlākhyaḥ svaśaktiparibṛṃhitaḥ // 222
meaning:
सर्वं जाग्रति कर्तव्यं स्वप्ने प्रत्येकमन्त्रगम् /
निवार्य सुप्ते मूलाख्यः स्वशक्तिपरिबृंहितः // 222
text_mt: Everything should be performed in the waking state; in dreaming, it penetrates each individual mantra; / having held it back in deep sleep, he is called 'the root', magnified by his own power.

sanskrit_iast:
turye tvekaiva dūtyākhyā tadatīte kuleśitā /
svaśaktiparipūrṇānāmitthaṃ pūjā pravartate // 223
meaning:
तुर्ये त्वेकैव दूत्याख्या तदतीते कुलेशिता /
स्वशक्तिपरिपूर्णानामित्थं पूजा प्रवर्तते // 223
text_mt: In the fourth state, however, she is called only the messenger; beyond that is the Lady of Kula. / In this way proceeds the worship of those who are fully complete in their own power.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍasthādi ca pūrvoktaṃ sarvātītāvasānakam /
avasthāpañcakaṃ proktabhedaṃ tasmai nirūpayet // 224
meaning:
पिण्डस्थादि च पूर्वोक्तं सर्वातीतावसानकम् /
अवस्थापञ्चकं प्रोक्तभेदं तस्मै निरूपयेत् // 224
text_mt: And the previously mentioned five states, beginning with 'abiding in the body' / and ending with 'transcending all', with their stated divisions, he should demonstrate to him.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhakasya bubhukṣostu samyagyogābhiṣecanam /
tatreṣṭvā vibhavairdevaṃ hemādimayamavraṇam // 225
meaning:
साधकस्य बुभुक्षोस्तु सम्यग्योगाभिषेचनम् /
तत्रेष्ट्वा विभवैर्देवं हेमादिमयमव्रणम् // 225
text_mt: For the adept desiring enjoyment, however, [there is] the complete consecration of yoga; / having worshipped the Lord there with riches made of gold and other materials, free from blemish,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpāṣṭakaṃ raktavartisarpiṣāpūrya bodhayet /
kulāṣṭakena tatpūjyaṃ śaṅkhe cāpi kuleśvarau // 226
meaning:
दीपाष्टकं रक्तवर्तिसर्पिषापूर्य बोधयेत् /
कुलाष्टकेन तत्पूज्यं शङ्खे चापि कुलेश्वरौ // 226
text_mt: he should fill eight lamps with red wicks and ghee, and kindle them; / they are to be worshipped with the group of eight Kulas, and also the two Lords of Kula in the conch shell.

sanskrit_iast:
ānandāmṛtasaṃpūrṇe śivahastoktavartmanā /
tenābhiṣiñcettaṃ paścāt sa kuryānmantrasādhanam // 227
meaning:
आनन्दामृतसंपूर्णे शिवहस्तोक्तवर्त्मना /
तेनाभिषिञ्चेत्तं पश्चात् स कुर्यान्मन्त्रसाधनम् // 227
text_mt: Filled with the nectar of bliss according to the method spoken of for the Hand of Śiva, / he should consecrate him with that; afterwards he may perform mantra-sādhana.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryasyābhiṣeko'yamadhikārānvitaḥ sa tu /
kuryātpiṣṭādibhiścāsya catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ pradīpakān // 228
meaning:
आचार्यस्याभिषेकोऽयमधिकारान्वितः स तु /
कुर्यात्पिष्टादिभिश्चास्य चतुष्षष्टिं प्रदीपकान् // 228
text_mt: This consecration of the master, however, is endowed with authority; / he should make sixty-four lamps of flour and other substances for him.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṣṭakena pūjyāste madhye prāgvat kuleśvarau /
śivahastoktayuktyaiva gurumapyabhiṣecayet // 229
meaning:
अष्टाष्टकेन पूज्यास्ते मध्ये प्राग्वत् कुलेश्वरौ /
शिवहस्तोक्तयुक्त्यैव गुरुमप्यभिषेचयेत् // 229
text_mt: They are to be worshipped with the eight-fold eight, and in the middle, as before, the two Lords of Kula; / by the very method taught for the Hand of Śiva, he should consecrate the guru as well.

sanskrit_iast:
abhiṣiktāvimāvevaṃ sarvayogigaṇena tu /
viditau bhavatastatra gururmokṣaprado bhavet // 230
meaning:
अभिषिक्ताविमावेवं सर्वयोगिगणेन तु /
विदितौ भवतस्तत्र गुरुर्मोक्षप्रदो भवेत् // 230
text_mt: These two, having been consecrated in this way, are acknowledged by the entire assembly of yogins; / there the guru is the granter of liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
tātparyamasya pādasya sa siddhīḥ saṃprayacchati /
gururyaḥ sādhakaḥ prāksyādanyo mokṣaṃ dadātyalam // 231
meaning:
तात्पर्यमस्य पादस्य स सिद्धीः संप्रयच्छति /
गुरुर्यः साधकः प्राक्स्यादन्यो मोक्षं ददात्यलम् // 231
text_mt: which is the purport of this quarter-verse: he bestows spiritual accomplishments. / The guru who was formerly an adept, another fully gives liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
anayoḥ kathayejjñānaṃ trividhaṃ sarvamapyalam /
svakīyājñāṃ ca vitaret svakriyākaraṇaṃ prati // 232
meaning:
अनयोः कथयेज्ज्ञानं त्रिविधं सर्वमप्यलम् /
स्वकीयाज्ञां च वितरेत् स्वक्रियाकरणं प्रति // 232
text_mt: He should explain all threefold knowledge completely to both of them, / and bestow his own authority regarding the performance of one's own rites.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭkaṃ kāraṇasaṃjñaṃ yattathā yaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ /
sākaṃ bhairavanāthena tadaṣṭakamudāhṛtam // 233
meaning:
षट्कं कारणसंज्ञं यत्तथा यः परमः शिवः /
साकं भैरवनाथेन तदष्टकमुदाहृतम् // 233
text_mt: The hexad known as the causal deities, and he who is the supreme Śiva, / together with the Lord Bhairava—that is declared to be the octad.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ tasya sārvātmyaṃ paśyaṃstāṃ vṛttimātmagām /
cakṣurādau saṃkramayedyatra yatrendriye guruḥ // 234
meaning:
प्रत्येकं तस्य सार्वात्म्यं पश्यंस्तां वृत्तिमात्मगाम् /
चक्षुरादौ संक्रमयेद्यत्र यत्रेन्द्रिये गुरुः // 234
text_mt: Seeing the all-pervading nature of each, the guru should transfer that activity pertaining to the self / into the eyes and other sense-faculties, into whichever sense-organ [he chooses].

sanskrit_iast:
sa eva pūrṇaiḥ kalaśairabhiṣekaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ /
vinā bāhyairapītyuktaṃ śrīvīrāvalibhairave // 235
meaning:
स एव पूर्णैः कलशैरभिषेकः परः स्मृतः /
विना बाह्यैरपीत्युक्तं श्रीवीरावलिभैरवे // 235
text_mt: That itself is remembered as the supreme consecration with full jars, / even without external ones; thus it is taught in the venerable Vīrāvalībhairava.

sanskrit_iast:
sadya eva tu bhogepsoryogātsiddhatamo guruḥ /
kuryātsadyastathābhīṣṭaphaladaṃ vedhadīkṣaṇam // 236
meaning:
सद्य एव तु भोगेप्सोर्योगात्सिद्धतमो गुरुः /
कुर्यात्सद्यस्तथाभीष्टफलदं वेधदीक्षणम् // 236
text_mt: For one desiring enjoyment immediately, however, the guru, most accomplished through yoga, / should straightway perform the piercing-initiation that yields the desired fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
vedhadīkṣā ca bahudhā tatra tatra nirūpitā /
sā cābhyāsavatā kāryā yenordhvordhvapraveśataḥ // 237
meaning:
वेधदीक्षा च बहुधा तत्र तत्र निरूपिता /
सा चाभ्यासवता कार्या येनोर्ध्वोर्ध्वप्रवेशतः // 237
text_mt: And piercing-initiation is described in various ways in various places; / it must be performed by one who possesses practice, through which, by entering higher and higher,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyasya cakrasaṃbhedapratyayo jāyate dhruvaḥ /
yenāṇimādikā siddhiḥ śrīmālāyāṃ ca coditā // 238
meaning:
शिष्यस्य चक्रसंभेदप्रत्ययो जायते ध्रुवः /
येनाणिमादिका सिद्धिः श्रीमालायां च चोदिता // 238
text_mt: the disciple's conviction arising from piercing the cakras certainly occurs, / through which the siddhi of atomicity and the rest is taught in the venerable Mālā.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvacakradaśālābhe piśācāveśa eva sā /
mantranādabinduśaktibhujaṅgamaparātmikā // 239
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वचक्रदशालाभे पिशाचावेश एव सा /
मन्त्रनादबिन्दुशक्तिभुजङ्गमपरात्मिका // 239
text_mt: When the state of the upper cakra is attained, that is indeed possession like that of a piśāca; / consisting of mantra, sonic vibration, the point, power, the serpent, and the supreme,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍhā śrīgahvare vedhadīkṣoktā parameśinā /
jvālākulaṃ svaśāstroktaṃ cakramaṣṭārakādikam // 240
meaning:
षोढा श्रीगह्वरे वेधदीक्षोक्ता परमेशिना /
ज्वालाकुलं स्वशास्त्रोक्तं चक्रमष्टारकादिकम् // 240
text_mt: piercing-initiation is taught as sixfold in the venerable Gahvara by the Supreme Lord. / Meditating on the cakra described in one's own scripture, having eight spokes and so forth, filled with flames,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā tenāsya hṛccakravedhanānmantravedhanam /
ākāraṃ navadhā dehe nyasya saṃkramayettataḥ // 241
meaning:
ध्यात्वा तेनास्य हृच्चक्रवेधनान्मन्त्रवेधनम् /
आकारं नवधा देहे न्यस्य संक्रमयेत्ततः // 241
text_mt: from piercing his heart-cakra with that, [there is] the piercing by mantra. / Having installed the form in nine ways in the body, he should then transfer it,

sanskrit_iast:
nyāsayogena śiṣyāya dīpyamānaṃ mahārciṣam /
pāśastobhāttatastasya paratattve tu yojanam // 242
meaning:
न्यासयोगेन शिष्याय दीप्यमानं महार्चिषम् /
पाशस्तोभात्ततस्तस्य परतत्त्वे तु योजनम् // 242
text_mt: blazing with great flames, to the disciple through the yoga of installation; / then, because of the agitation of the bonds, his union in the supreme tattva [takes place].

sanskrit_iast:
iti dīkṣottare dṛṣṭo vidhirme śaṃbhunoditaḥ /
nādoccāreṇa nādākhyaḥ sṛṣṭikramaniyogataḥ // 243
meaning:
इति दीक्षोत्तरे दृष्टो विधिर्मे शंभुनोदितः /
नादोच्चारेण नादाख्यः सृष्टिक्रमनियोगतः // 243
text_mt: Thus the rule seen in the Dīkṣottara has been spoken to me by Śambhu. / By the sounding of sonic vibration, [it is] called sonic, through application of the order of emission;

sanskrit_iast:
nādena vedhayeccittaṃ nādavedha udīritaḥ /
bindusthānagataṃ cittaṃ bhrūmadhyapathasaṃsthitam // 244
meaning:
नादेन वेधयेच्चित्तं नादवेध उदीरितः /
बिन्दुस्थानगतं चित्तं भ्रूमध्यपथसंस्थितम् // 244
text_mt: one should pierce consciousness with sonic vibration: [this] is declared as piercing by sonic vibration. / The mind gone to the place of the point, situated on the path between the eyebrows,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛllakṣye vā maheśāni binduṃ jvālākulaprabham /
tena saṃbodhayetsādhyaṃ bindvākhyo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ // 245
meaning:
हृल्लक्ष्ये वा महेशानि बिन्दुं ज्वालाकुलप्रभम् /
तेन संबोधयेत्साध्यं बिन्द्वाख्योऽयं प्रकीर्तितः // 245
text_mt: or, O Great Lady, at the target of the heart, [visualising] the point radiant with a mass of flames, / he should awaken the disciple with that; this is celebrated as the one called 'point'.

sanskrit_iast:
śāktaṃ śaktimaduccārādgandhoccāreṇa sundari /
śṛṅgāṭakāsanasthaṃ tu kuṭilaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim // 246
meaning:
शाक्तं शक्तिमदुच्चाराद्गन्धोच्चारेण सुन्दरि /
शृङ्गाटकासनस्थं तु कुटिलं कुण्डलाकृतिम् // 246
text_mt: Belonging to power from the sounding of the possessor of power, through the sounding of fragrance, O beautiful one; / seated on the triangular seat, curved, coiled in shape,

sanskrit_iast:
anuccāreṇa coccārya vedhayennikhilaṃ jagat /
evaṃ bhramaravedhena śāktavedha udāhṛtaḥ // 247
meaning:
अनुच्चारेण चोच्चार्य वेधयेन्निखिलं जगत् /
एवं भ्रमरवेधेन शाक्तवेध उदाहृतः // 247
text_mt: and sounding it through non-sounding, he should pierce the entire universe; / in this way, by piercing like a bee, piercing through power is described.

sanskrit_iast:
sā caiva paramā śaktirānandapravikāsinī /
janmasthānātparaṃ yāti phaṇapañcakabhūṣitā // 248
meaning:
सा चैव परमा शक्तिरानन्दप्रविकासिनी /
जन्मस्थानात्परं याति फणपञ्चकभूषिता // 248
text_mt: And that very supreme power, blossoming with bliss, / ascends beyond the place of birth, adorned with five hoods:

sanskrit_iast:
kalāstattvāni nandādyā vyomāni ca kulāni ca /
brahmādikāraṇānyakṣāṇyeva sā pañcakātmikā // 249
meaning:
कलास्तत्त्वानि नन्दाद्या व्योमानि च कुलानि च /
ब्रह्मादिकारणान्यक्षाण्येव सा पञ्चकात्मिका // 249
text_mt: the kalās, the tattvas, Nandā and the rest, the voids, and the Kulas, / the causal deities beginning with Brahmā, the senses—she consists of these pentads.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pañcaprakārā sā brahmasthānavinirgatā /
brahmasthāne viśantī tu taḍillīnā virājate // 250
meaning:
एवं पञ्चप्रकारा सा ब्रह्मस्थानविनिर्गता /
ब्रह्मस्थाने विशन्ती तु तडिल्लीना विराजते // 250
text_mt: Thus fivefold, emerging from the seat of Brahmā, / entering into the seat of Brahmā, she shines like lightning dissolved.

sanskrit_iast:
praviṣṭā vedhayetkāyamātmānaṃ pratibhedayet /
evaṃ bhujaṅgavedhastu kathito bhairavāgame // 251
meaning:
प्रविष्टा वेधयेत्कायमात्मानं प्रतिभेदयेत् /
एवं भुजङ्गवेधस्तु कथितो भैरवागमे // 251
text_mt: Having entered, she pierces the body and perforates the self; / thus the serpent-piercing is declared in the Bhairava scripture.

sanskrit_iast:
tāvadbhāvayate cittaṃ yāvaccittaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam /
kṣīṇe citte sureśāni parānanda udāhṛtaḥ // 252
meaning:
तावद्भावयते चित्तं यावच्चित्तं क्षयं गतम् /
क्षीणे चित्ते सुरेशानि परानन्द उदाहृतः // 252
text_mt: He meditates on consciousness as long as consciousness has gone to dissolution; / when consciousness has dissolved, O Ruler of Gods, supreme bliss is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
nendriyāṇi na vai prāṇā nāntaḥkaraṇagocaraḥ /
na mano nāpi mantavyaṃ na mantā na manikriyā // 253
meaning:
नेन्द्रियाणि न वै प्राणा नान्तःकरणगोचरः /
न मनो नापि मन्तव्यं न मन्ता न मनिक्रिया // 253
text_mt: There are no senses, indeed no breaths, no range of the internal organ; / no mind, nor the thinkable, no thinker, nor the act of thinking.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhāvaparikṣīṇaḥ paravedha udāhṛtaḥ /
manuśaktibhuvanarūpajñāpiṇḍasthānanāḍiparabhedāt // 254
meaning:
सर्वभावपरिक्षीणः परवेध उदाहृतः /
मनुशक्तिभुवनरूपज्ञापिण्डस्थाननाडिपरभेदात् // 254
text_mt: Transcending all entities, it is declared as the supreme piercing. / By the distinction of mantra, power, worlds, form, knower, body, location, channel, and the supreme,

sanskrit_iast:
navadhā kalayantyanye vedaṃ guravo rahasyavidaḥ /
māyāgarbhāgnivarṇaughayukte tryaśriṇi maṇḍale // 255
meaning:
नवधा कलयन्त्यन्ये वेदं गुरवो रहस्यविदः /
मायागर्भाग्निवर्णौघयुक्ते त्र्यश्रिणि मण्डले // 255
text_mt: Other gurus who know the secret teachings reckon the piercing (vedha) to be of nine kinds: / in a triangular mandala endowed with a multitude of letters representing fire and containing māyā,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyātvā jvālākarālena tena granthīn vibhedayet /
puṣpairhanyādyojayecca pare mantrābhidho vidhiḥ // 256
meaning:
ध्यात्वा ज्वालाकरालेन तेन ग्रन्थीन् विभेदयेत् /
पुष्पैर्हन्याद्योजयेच्च परे मन्त्राभिधो विधिः // 256
text_mt: having meditated [on the mantra], he should pierce the knots with that [fire] terrible with flames; / he should strike with flowers and unite [the disciple] with the Supreme; this procedure is named the piercing by mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍyāviśyānyatarayā caitanyaṃ kandadhāmani /
piṇḍīkṛtya paribhramya pañcāṣṭaśikhayā haṭhāt // 257
meaning:
नाड्याविश्यान्यतरया चैतन्यं कन्दधामनि /
पिण्डीकृत्य परिभ्रम्य पञ्चाष्टशिखया हठात् // 257
text_mt: Having entered consciousness into the locus of the bulb through either nāḍī, / bringing it into a mass and revolving it forcibly with a flame of five and eight [sparks],

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiśūlāgragamitaṃ kvāpi cakre niyojayet /
śaktyeti śākto vedho'yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ // 258
meaning:
शक्तिशूलाग्रगमितं क्वापि चक्रे नियोजयेत् /
शक्त्येति शाक्तो वेधोऽयं सद्यःप्रत्ययकारकः // 258
text_mt: he should unite it, brought to the tip of the trident of power, into some wheel. / Since it is accomplished through power, this is the piercing by power (śākta), which produces immediate conviction.

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārānnirgatayā śikhayā jyotsnāvadātayā rabhasāt /
aṅguṣṭhamūlapīṭhakrameṇa śiṣyasya līnayā vyomni // 259
meaning:
आधारान्निर्गतया शिखया ज्योत्स्नावदातया रभसात् /
अङ्गुष्ठमूलपीठक्रमेण शिष्यस्य लीनया व्योम्नि // 259
text_mt: With a flame emerging from the mūlādhāra, bright like moonlight, [moving] with impetuous speed / through the succession from the base of the great toe, dissolved into the void of the disciple,

sanskrit_iast:
dehaṃ svacchīkṛtya kṣādīnāntān smaranpuroktapuryoghān /
nijamaṇḍalanirdhyānātpratibimbayate bhuvanavedhaḥ // 260
meaning:
देहं स्वच्छीकृत्य क्षादीनान्तान् स्मरन्पुरोक्तपुर्योघान् /
निजमण्डलनिर्ध्यानात्प्रतिबिम्बयते भुवनवेधः // 260
text_mt: having purified the body, contemplating the letters from kṣa to a and the previously explained hosts of cities, / from deep meditation on his own mandala, the piercing of the worlds (bhuvana-vedha) produces a reflection.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūmadhyoditabaindavadhāmāntaḥ kāṃcidākṛtiṃ rucirām /
tādātmyena dhyāyecchiṣyaṃ paścācca tanmayīkuryāt // 261
meaning:
भ्रूमध्योदितबैन्दवधामान्तः कांचिदाकृतिं रुचिराम् /
तादात्म्येन ध्यायेच्छिष्यं पश्चाच्च तन्मयीकुर्यात् // 261
text_mt: Within the luminous domain of the bindu risen between the eyebrows, he should meditate on some radiant form / as identical with himself, and afterwards make the disciple identical with that.

sanskrit_iast:
iti rūpavedha uktaḥ sā cehākṛtirupaiti dṛśyatvam /
ante tatsāyujyaṃ śiṣyaścāyāti tanmayībhūtaḥ // 262
meaning:
इति रूपवेध उक्तः सा चेहाकृतिरुपैति दृश्यत्वम् /
अन्ते तत्सायुज्यं शिष्यश्चायाति तन्मयीभूतः // 262
