text_mt: This is described as the piercing by form (rūpa-vedha), and here that form comes into visibility; / at the end, having become identical with it, the disciple attains union with it.

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānamaṣṭadhā yaddhrāṇādikabuddhisaṃjñakaraṇāntaḥ /
tat svasvanāḍisūtrakrameṇa saṃcārayecchiṣye // 263
meaning:
विज्ञानमष्टधा यद्ध्राणादिकबुद्धिसंज्ञकरणान्तः /
तत् स्वस्वनाडिसूत्रक्रमेण संचारयेच्छिष्ये // 263
text_mt: The consciousness which is eightfold within the instruments known as intellect, smell, and the rest— / he should transmit that into the disciple through the cords of their respective nāḍīs.

sanskrit_iast:
abhimānadārḍhyabandhakrameṇa vijñānasaṃjñako vedhaḥ /
hṛdayavyomani sadyo divyajñānārkasamudayaṃ dhatte // 264
meaning:
अभिमानदार्ढ्यबन्धक्रमेण विज्ञानसंज्ञको वेधः /
हृदयव्योमनि सद्यो दिव्यज्ञानार्कसमुदयं धत्ते // 264
text_mt: Through the process of binding firmness to identity, the piercing termed 'by consciousness' (vijñāna-vedha) / immediately brings about the rising of the sun of divine knowledge in the space of the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍaḥ paraḥ kalātmā sūkṣmaḥ puryaṣṭako bahiḥ sthūlaḥ /
chāyātmā sa parāṅmukha ādarśādau ca saṃmukho jñeyaḥ // 265
meaning:
पिण्डः परः कलात्मा सूक्ष्मः पुर्यष्टको बहिः स्थूलः /
छायात्मा स पराङ्मुख आदर्शादौ च संमुखो ज्ञेयः // 265
text_mt: The mass (piṇḍa) is the supreme consisting of parts, the subtle consisting of the city of eight, and the gross external one; / that shadow-nature should be known as turned away, and facing [oneself] in a mirror and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
iti yaḥ piṇḍavibhedastaṃ rabhasāduttarottare śamayet /
tattadnalane kramaśaḥ paramapadaṃ piṇḍavedhena // 266
meaning:
इति यः पिण्डविभेदस्तं रभसादुत्तरोत्तरे शमयेत् /
तत्तद्नलने क्रमशः परमपदं पिण्डवेधेन // 266
text_mt: Thus, whatever division of the mass there is, he should dissolve that with speed into each subsequent one; / in the burning of each respective one, by the piercing of the mass (piṇḍa-vedha) one reaches the supreme state.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyaddehe cakraṃ tatra śiśoretya viśramaṃ kramaśaḥ /
ujjvalayettaccakraṃ sthānākhyastatphalaprado vedhaḥ // 267
meaning:
यद्यद्देहे चक्रं तत्र शिशोरेत्य विश्रमं क्रमशः /
उज्ज्वलयेत्तच्चक्रं स्थानाख्यस्तत्फलप्रदो वेधः // 267
text_mt: Entering into whichever wheel in the body of the child [initiate], having found rest sequentially, / he should illuminate that wheel; this is the piercing called 'by locus' (sthāna-vedha), which bestows the fruit thereof.

sanskrit_iast:
nāḍyaḥ pradhānabhūtāstisro'nyāstadgatāstvasaṃkhyeyāḥ /
ekīkārastābhirnāḍīvedho'tra tatphalakṛt // 268
meaning:
नाड्यः प्रधानभूतास्तिस्रोऽन्यास्तद्गतास्त्वसंख्येयाः /
एकीकारस्ताभिर्नाडीवेधोऽत्र तत्फलकृत् // 268
text_mt: The principal nāḍīs are three, while the others situated within them are innumerable; / oneness achieved through them is here the piercing by nāḍī (nāḍī-vedha), which produces that fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
abhilaṣitanāḍivāho mukhyābhiścakṣurādiniṣṭhābhiḥ /
adbodhaprāptiḥ syānnāḍīvedhe vicitrabahurūpā // 269
meaning:
अभिलषितनाडिवाहो मुख्याभिश्चक्षुरादिनिष्ठाभिः /
अद्बोधप्राप्तिः स्यान्नाडीवेधे विचित्रबहुरूपा // 269
text_mt: The flow into a desired nāḍī through the principal ones residing in the eye and other organs / would bring about an awakening of manifold and diverse forms in the piercing by nāḍī.

sanskrit_iast:
lāṅgūlākṛtibalavat svanāḍisaṃvoṣṭitāmaparanāḍīm /
āsphoṭya siddhamapi bhuvi pātayati haṭhānmahāyogī // 270
meaning:
लाङ्गूलाकृतिबलवत् स्वनाडिसंवोष्टितामपरनाडीम् /
आस्फोट्य सिद्धमपि भुवि पातयति हठान्महायोगी // 270
text_mt: Wrapping another's nāḍī forcefully with his own nāḍī like a tail, / having struck it, the great yogin forcibly brings down to the ground even an accomplished adept (siddha).

sanskrit_iast:
paravedhaṃ samasteṣu cakreṣvadvaitamāmṛśan /
paraṃ śivaṃ prakurvīta śivatāpattido guruḥ // 271
meaning:
परवेधं समस्तेषु चक्रेष्वद्वैतमामृशन् /
परं शिवं प्रकुर्वीत शिवतापत्तिदो गुरुः // 271
text_mt: Contemplating non-duality across all the wheels in the supreme piercing (para-vedha), / the guru, bestowing the attainment of the state of Śiva, should make [the disciple] supreme Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīmadvīrāvalikule tathā cetthaṃ nirūpitam /
abhedyaṃ sarvathā jñeyaṃ madhyaṃ jñātvā na lipyate // 272
meaning:
श्रीमद्वीरावलिकुले तथा चेत्थं निरूपितम् /
अभेद्यं सर्वथा ज्ञेयं मध्यं ज्ञात्वा न लिप्यते // 272
text_mt: In the venerable Vīrāvalikula it is also described in this manner: / 'What is entirely impenetrable is to be known; knowing the middle, one is not tainted.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvibhāgakrame siddhaḥ sa gururmocayet paśūn /
guroragre viśecchiṣyo vaktraṃ vaktre tu vedhayet // 273
meaning:
तद्विभागक्रमे सिद्धः स गुरुर्मोचयेत् पशून् /
गुरोरग्रे विशेच्छिष्यो वक्त्रं वक्त्रे तु वेधयेत् // 273
text_mt: Established in the method of that division, that guru should liberate the bound souls. / The disciple should enter before the guru, and pierce mouth into mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ rūpe tu viṣayairyāvatsamarasībhavet /
citte samarasībhūte dvayoraunmanasī sthitiḥ // 274
meaning:
रूपं रूपे तु विषयैर्यावत्समरसीभवेत् /
चित्ते समरसीभूते द्वयोरौन्मनसी स्थितिः // 274
text_mt: and form into form, until there is a single flavour through sense objects; / when the mind has become of single flavour, the state beyond mind (unmanā) arises for both.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhayośconmanogatyā tatkāle dīkṣito bhavet /
śaśibhāskarasaṃyoge jīvastanmayatāṃ vrajet // 275
meaning:
उभयोश्चोन्मनोगत्या तत्काले दीक्षितो भवेत् /
शशिभास्करसंयोगे जीवस्तन्मयतां व्रजेत् // 275
text_mt: And through the movement beyond mind of both, at that very moment he becomes initiated; / in the union of moon and sun, the individual soul attains identity with that.

sanskrit_iast:
atra brahmādayo devā muktaye mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ /
nirudhya raśmicakraṃ svaṃ bhogamokṣāvubhāvapi // 276
meaning:
अत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा मुक्तये मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणः /
निरुध्य रश्मिचक्रं स्वं भोगमोक्षावुभावपि // 276
text_mt: Here, gods such as Brahmā desire liberation for the sake of release; / having restrained his own wheel of rays, both enjoyment and liberation,

sanskrit_iast:
grasate yadi taddīkṣā śārvīyaṃ parikīrtitā /
sa eṣa mokṣaḥ kathito niḥspandaḥ sarvajantuṣu // 277
meaning:
ग्रसते यदि तद्दीक्षा शार्वीयं परिकीर्तिता /
स एष मोक्षः कथितो निःस्पन्दः सर्वजन्तुषु // 277
text_mt: if he consumes [them], that is proclaimed to be the initiation of Śarva. / That very liberation, vibrationless in all living beings, is taught.

sanskrit_iast:
agnīṣomakalāghātasaṅghātāt spandanaṃ haret /
bāhyaṃ prāṇaṃ bāhyagataṃ timirākārayogataḥ // 278
meaning:
अग्नीषोमकलाघातसङ्घातात् स्पन्दनं हरेत् /
बाह्यं प्राणं बाह्यगतं तिमिराकारयोगतः // 278
text_mt: From the impact and clash of the fractions of fire and moon, he should remove the vibration; / the external breath gone outside through the union of the dark form,

sanskrit_iast:
niryātaṃ romakūpaistu bhramantaṃ sarvakāraṇaiḥ /
madhyaṃ nirlakṣyamāsthāya bhramayedvisṛjettataḥ // 279
meaning:
निर्यातं रोमकूपैस्तु भ्रमन्तं सर्वकारणैः /
मध्यं निर्लक्ष्यमास्थाय भ्रमयेद्विसृजेत्ततः // 279
text_mt: emerging through the pores of the skin, wandering through all the causes— / resting in the middle devoid of marks, he should make it revolve and then emit it.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃghaṭṭotpāṭayogena vedhayedgranthipañcakam /
saṃghaṭṭavṛttiyugalaṃ madhyadhāma vicintayet // 280
meaning:
संघट्टोत्पाटयोगेन वेधयेद्ग्रन्थिपञ्चकम् /
संघट्टवृत्तियुगलं मध्यधाम विचिन्तयेत् // 280
text_mt: Through the union of collision and eradication, he should pierce the five knots; / he should contemplate the central abode as a pair of oscillating collisions.

sanskrit_iast:
nātmavyomabahirmantradehasaṃdhānamācaret /
dīkṣeyaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ śivatāpattidāyikā // 281
meaning:
नात्मव्योमबहिर्मन्त्रदेहसंधानमाचरेत् /
दीक्षेयं सर्वजन्तूनां शिवतापत्तिदायिका // 281
text_mt: He should not perform the conjunction of body, mantra, external space, and self; / this initiation bestows the attainment of the state of Śiva for all living beings.'

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣānte dīpakān paktvā samastaiḥ sādhakaiḥ saha /
caruḥ prāśyaḥ kulācāryairmahāpātakanāśanaḥ // 282
meaning:
दीक्षान्ते दीपकान् पक्त्वा समस्तैः साधकैः सह /
चरुः प्राश्यः कुलाचार्यैर्महापातकनाशनः // 282
text_mt: At the conclusion of initiation, having cooked the dīpakas together with all the adepts, / the sacrificial offering (caru), destroying great sins, is to be consumed by the masters of the Kula.

sanskrit_iast:
iti śrīratnamālāyāmūnādhikavidhistu yaḥ /
sa eva pātakaṃ tasya praśamo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ // 283
meaning:
इति श्रीरत्नमालायामूनाधिकविधिस्तु यः /
स एव पातकं तस्य प्रशमोऽयं प्रकीर्तितः // 283
text_mt: Thus in the venerable Ratnamālā, whatever rite has a deficiency or an excess, / that itself is a sin, and this [consumption] is proclaimed as its appeasement.

sanskrit_iast:
pare'hani guroḥ kāryo yāgastena vinā yataḥ /
na vidhiḥ pūrṇatāṃ yāti kuryādyatnena taṃ tataḥ // 284
meaning:
परेऽहनि गुरोः कार्यो यागस्तेन विना यतः /
न विधिः पूर्णतां याति कुर्याद्यत्नेन तं ततः // 284
text_mt: On the next day, a sacrifice to the guru must be performed, because without it / the ritual does not attain completion; therefore, he should perform it with effort.

sanskrit_iast:
yena yena gurustuṣyettattadasmai nivedayet /
cakracaryāntarāle'syā vidhiḥ saṃcāra ucyāte // 285
meaning:
येन येन गुरुस्तुष्येत्तत्तदस्मै निवेदयेत् /
चक्रचर्यान्तरालेऽस्या विधिः संचार उच्याते // 285
text_mt: Whatever would please the guru, all that he should offer to him; / in the interval of the cakra-practice, the ritual is called 'transmission' (saṃcāra).

sanskrit_iast:
alipātraṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ vīrendrakarasaṃsthitam /
avalokya paraṃ brahma tatpivedājñayā guroḥ // 286
meaning:
अलिपात्रं सुसंपूर्णं वीरेन्द्रकरसंस्थितम् /
अवलोक्य परं ब्रह्म तत्पिवेदाज्ञया गुरोः // 286
text_mt: Beholding the cup of wine (alipātra) completely filled, resting in the hand of the lord of heroes, / as the supreme Brahman, he should drink it by the command of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
tarpayitvā tu bhūtāni gurave vinivedayet /
kṛtvā bhuvi guruṃ natvādāya saṃtarpya khecarīḥ // 287
meaning:
तर्पयित्वा तु भूतानि गुरवे विनिवेदयेत् /
कृत्वा भुवि गुरुं नत्वादाय संतर्प्य खेचरीः // 287
text_mt: Having gratified the elements, he should offer [it] to the guru; / placing it on the ground, bowing to the guru, taking it and gratifying the khecarīs,

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ mantraṃ tacca vanditvā dūtīṃ gaṇaptiṃ gurūn /
kṣetrapaṃ vīrasaṅghātaṃ gurvādikramaśastataḥ // 288
meaning:
स्वं मन्त्रं तच्च वन्दित्वा दूतीं गणप्तिं गुरून् /
क्षेत्रपं वीरसङ्घातं गुर्वादिक्रमशस्ततः // 288
text_mt: and praising his own mantra, that [vessel], the messenger (dūtī), Gaṇapati, the gurus, / the protector of the field (kṣetrapāla), and the host of heroes, then sequentially beginning with the guru,

sanskrit_iast:
vīraspṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃ dravyaṃ pivennaivānyathā kvacit /
parabrahmaṇyavettāro'gamāgamavivarjitāḥ // 289
meaning:
वीरस्पृष्टं स्वयं द्रव्यं पिवेन्नैवान्यथा क्वचित् /
परब्रह्मण्यवेत्तारोऽगमागमविवर्जिताः // 289
text_mt: he should drink the substance touched by the heroes himself, and never otherwise under any circumstance. / Those who do not know the supreme Brahman, who are devoid of the traditional scriptures,

sanskrit_iast:
lobhamohamadakrodharāgamāyājuṣaśca ye /
taiḥ sākaṃ na ca kartavyametacchreyorthinātmani // 290
meaning:
लोभमोहमदक्रोधरागमायाजुषश्च ये /
तैः साकं न च कर्तव्यमेतच्छ्रेयोर्थिनात्मनि // 290
text_mt: and who are devoted to greed, delusion, pride, anger, passion, and deception— / with them, this must not be performed by one who desires well-being for himself.

sanskrit_iast:
yāgādau yāgamadhye ca yāgānte gurupūjane /
naimittikeṣu prokteṣu śiṣyaḥ kuryādimaṃ vidhim // 291
iti rahasyavidhiḥ paricarcito gurumukhānubhavaiḥ suparisphuṭaḥ /
meaning:
यागादौ यागमध्ये च यागान्ते गुरुपूजने /
नैमित्तिकेषु प्रोक्तेषु शिष्यः कुर्यादिमं विधिम् // 291
इति रहस्यविधिः परिचर्चितो गुरुमुखानुभवैः सुपरिस्फुटः /
text_mt:
At the beginning of sacrifice, in the middle of sacrifice, at the end of sacrifice, in worship of the guru, / [and] in the occasional rites that have been taught, the disciple should perform this ritual.
Thus the secret rite has been examined, made fully clear through the experiences from the mouth of the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
atha yathocitamantrakadambakaṃ trikakulakramayogi nirūpyate /
tāvadvimarśānārūḍhadhiyāṃ tātsiddhaye kramāt // 1
meaning:
अथ यथोचितमन्त्रकदम्बकं त्रिककुलक्रमयोगि निरूप्यते /
तावद्विमर्शानारूढधियां तात्सिद्धये क्रमात् // 1
text_mt: Now, the collection of mantras suitable for union with the Trika, Kula, and Krama is expounded / in order to bring about the accomplishment of those whose intellects have not yet ascended to reflective awareness: // 1
title: Mantrādiprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
pratibuddhā hi te mantrā vimarśaikasvabhāvakāḥ /
svatantrasyaiva ciddhāmnaḥ svātantryāt kartṛtāmayāḥ // 2
meaning:
प्रतिबुद्धा हि ते मन्त्रा विमर्शैकस्वभावकाः /
स्वतन्त्रस्यैव चिद्धाम्नः स्वातन्त्र्यात् कर्तृतामयाः // 2
text_mt: For those mantras are awakened, having reflective awareness as their sole nature, / consisting of agency through the absolute autonomy of the independent realm of consciousness alone. // 2

sanskrit_iast:
yamāviśanti cācāryaṃ taṃ tādātmyanirūḍhitaḥ /
svatantrīkurvate yānti karaṇānyapi kartṛtām // 3
meaning:
यमाविशन्ति चाचार्यं तं तादात्म्यनिरूढितः /
स्वतन्त्रीकुर्वते यान्ति करणान्यपि कर्तृताम् // 3
text_mt: And whatever master they enter, through confirmed identity with him, / they make him independent, and even his sense organs attain the state of being an agent. // 3

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktau hrīṃ pṛthvīprabhṛtau tu catuṣṭaye /
kṣlāṃ kṣvīṃ vaṃ kṣamiti prāhuḥ kramādvarṇacatuṣṭayam // 4
meaning:
आधारशक्तौ ह्रीं पृथ्वीप्रभृतौ तु चतुष्टये /
क्ष्लां क्ष्वीं वं क्षमिति प्राहुः क्रमाद्वर्णचतुष्टयम् // 4
text_mt: In the support power (ādhāraśakti) is hrīṃ; but in the tetrad beginning with earth, / they declare the four letters in sequence as kṣlāṃ, kṣvīṃ, vaṃ, and kṣam. // 4

sanskrit_iast:
haṃ nāle yaṃ tathā raṃ laṃ vaṃ dharmādicatuṣṭaye /
ṛṃ ṝṃ ḷṃ ḷḷṃ catuṣke ca viparītakramādbhavet // 5
meaning:
हं नाले यं तथा रं लं वं धर्मादिचतुष्टये /
ऋं ॠं ऌं ऌऌं चतुष्के च विपरीतक्रमाद्भवेत् // 5
text_mt: 'haṃ' on the stalk; likewise 'yaṃ', 'raṃ', 'laṃ', and 'vaṃ' on the tetrad of dharma and the rest; / and on the tetrad [of adharma and the rest] it should be 'ṛṃ', 'ṝṃ', 'ḷṃ', and 'ḷḷṃ' in reverse order. // 5

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ auṃ hastrayamityetadvidyāmāyākalātraye /
anusvāravisargau ca vidyeśeśvaratattvayoḥ // 6
meaning:
ओं औं हस्त्रयमित्येतद्विद्यामायाकलात्रये /
अनुस्वारविसर्गौ च विद्येशेश्वरतत्त्वयोः // 6
text_mt: 'oṃ', 'auṃ', and the triad of 'ha' on the triad of Vidyā, Māyā, and Kalā; / and the anusvāra and visarga on the tattvas of Vidyeśa and Īśvara. // 6

sanskrit_iast:
kādibhāntāḥ kesareṣu prāṇo'ṣṭasvarasaṃyutaḥ /
sabinduko daleṣvaṣṭasvatha svaṃ nāma dīpitam // 7
meaning:
कादिभान्ताः केसरेषु प्राणोऽष्टस्वरसंयुतः /
सबिन्दुको दलेष्वष्टस्वथ स्वं नाम दीपितम् // 7
text_mt: [The letters] from 'ka' to 'bha' are on the filaments; the prāṇa joined with the eight vowels / with the bindu is on the eight petals; then one's own name is illuminated. // 7

sanskrit_iast:
śaktīnāṃ navakasya syācchaṣasā maṇḍalatraye /
sabindukāḥ kṣmaṃ prete jraṃ śūlaśṛṅgeṣu kalpayet // 8
meaning:
शक्तीनां नवकस्य स्याच्छषसा मण्डलत्रये /
सबिन्दुकाः क्ष्मं प्रेते ज्रं शूलशृङ्गेषु कल्पयेत् // 8
text_mt: On the three maṇḍalas should be 'śa', 'ṣa', and 'sa' of the nine powers, / with the bindu; 'kṣmaṃ' on the corpse, and one should visualize 'jraṃ' on the prongs of the trident. // 8

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthagāsanapūjāyāṃ kramānmantrā ime smṛtāḥ /
saṃkṣepapūjane tu prāgādyamantyaṃ ca bījakam // 9
meaning:
पृथगासनपूजायां क्रमान्मन्त्रा इमे स्मृताः /
संक्षेपपूजने तु प्रागाद्यमन्त्यं च बीजकम् // 9
text_mt: In individual worship of the seat, these mantras are traditionally taught in order; / but in abridged worship, first taking the first and the last seed-syllables, // 9

sanskrit_iast:
ādāyādhāraśaktyādiśūlaśṛṅgāntamarcayet /
agnimārutapṛthvyambusaṣaṣṭhasvarabindukam // 10
meaning:
आदायाधारशक्त्यादिशूलशृङ्गान्तमर्चयेत् /
अग्निमारुतपृथ्व्यम्बुसषष्ठस्वरबिन्दुकम् // 10
text_mt: one should worship from the foundation power up to the prongs of the trident. / Fire, wind, earth, and water, with the sixth vowel and bindu, // 10

sanskrit_iast:
ratiśekharamantro'sya vaktrāṅgaṃ hrasvadīrghakaiḥ /
agniprāṇāgnisaṃhārakālendrāmbusamīraṇāḥ // 11
meaning:
रतिशेखरमन्त्रोऽस्य वक्त्राङ्गं ह्रस्वदीर्घकैः /
अग्निप्राणाग्निसंहारकालेन्द्राम्बुसमीरणाः // 11
text_mt: constitute the Ratiśekhara mantra; its limbs and faces are formed with the short and long vowels. / Fire, prāṇa, fire, destruction, time, Indra, water, and wind, // 11

sanskrit_iast:
saṣaṣṭhasvarabirndvadhacandrādyāḥ syurnavātmanaḥ /
bindunādādikā vyāptiḥ śrīmattraiśirase mate // 12
meaning:
सषष्ठस्वरबिर्न्द्वधचन्द्राद्याः स्युर्नवात्मनः /
बिन्दुनादादिका व्याप्तिः श्रीमत्त्रैशिरसे मते // 12
text_mt: with the sixth vowel, bindu, half-moon, and so forth, belong to the ninefold Self (Navātman). / In the venerable doctrine of the Traiśirasa, the pervasion begins with bindu and nāda, // 12

sanskrit_iast:
kṣepākrānticidudbodhadīpanasthāpanānyatha /
tatsaṃvittistadāpattiriti saṃjñābhiśabditā // 13
meaning:
क्षेपाक्रान्तिचिदुद्बोधदीपनस्थापनान्यथ /
तत्संवित्तिस्तदापत्तिरिति संज्ञाभिशब्दिता // 13
text_mt: designated by the technical terms 'projection', 'pervasion', 'awakening of consciousness', 'illumination', 'establishment', / 'its consciousness', and 'attainment thereof'. // 13

sanskrit_iast:
etāvatī mahāvyāptirmūrtitvenātra kīrtitā /
pariṇāmastallayaśca namaskāraḥ sa ucyate // 14
meaning:
एतावती महाव्याप्तिर्मूर्तित्वेनात्र कीर्तिता /
परिणामस्तल्लयश्च नमस्कारः स उच्यते // 14
text_mt: A great pervasion of this extent is proclaimed here as an embodiment; / its transformation and dissolution into that are called salutation. // 14

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa tryarṇojjhito'dhastāddīrghaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ svarairyutaḥ /
ṣaḍaṅgāni hṛdādīni vaktrāṇyasya ca kalpayet // 15
meaning:
एष त्र्यर्णोज्झितोऽधस्ताद्दीर्घैः षड्भिः स्वरैर्युतः /
षडङ्गानि हृदादीनि वक्त्राण्यस्य च कल्पयेत् // 15
text_mt: Devoid of the bottom three phonemes, joined with the six long vowels, / one should project its six limbs—heart and the rest—and its faces. // 15

sanskrit_iast:
kṣayaravalabījaistu dīptairbinduvibhūṣitaiḥ /
jhakārasaṃhṛtiprāṇāḥ saṣaṣṭhasvarabindukāḥ // 16
meaning:
क्षयरवलबीजैस्तु दीप्तैर्बिन्दुविभूषितैः /
झकारसंहृतिप्राणाः सषष्ठस्वरबिन्दुकाः // 16
text_mt: By means of the seed-syllables 'kṣa', 'ya', 'ra', 'va', and 'la', radiant and adorned with bindu, / the letter 'jha', destruction, and prāṇa, accompanied by the sixth vowel and bindu, // 16

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa bhairavasadmāvaścandrārdhādivibhūṣitaḥ /
mātṛkāmālinīmantrau prāgeva samudāhṛtau // 17
meaning:
एष भैरवसद्मावश्चन्द्रार्धादिविभूषितः /
मातृकामालिनीमन्त्रौ प्रागेव समुदाहृतौ // 17
text_mt: this essence of Bhairava is adorned with the half-moon and the rest. / The Mātṛkā and Mālinī mantras have already been declared. // 17

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkāro'tha caturthyantā saṃjñā natiriti kramāt /
gaṇeśādiṣu mantraḥ syādbījaṃ yeṣu na coditam // 18
meaning:
ओंकारोऽथ चतुर्थ्यन्ता संज्ञा नतिरिति क्रमात् /
गणेशादिषु मन्त्रः स्याद्बीजं येषु न चोदितम् // 18
text_mt: The syllable 'oṃ', then the designation ending in the dative case, and the obeisance—in this order / is the mantra for Gaṇeśa and the rest for whom a seed-syllable is not prescribed. // 18

sanskrit_iast:
nāmādyakṣaramākārabinducandrādidīpitam /
sarveṣāmeva bījānāṃ taccaturdaśaṣaṣṭhayuk // 19
meaning:
नामाद्यक्षरमाकारबिन्दुचन्द्रादिदीपितम् /
सर्वेषामेव बीजानां तच्चतुर्दशषष्ठयुक् // 19
text_mt: The first phoneme of the name, illuminated by the long 'ā', bindu, crescent moon, and the like, / is joined with the fourteenth and sixth vowels for all the seed-syllables. // 19

sanskrit_iast:
āmantritānyaghoryāditritayasya kramoditaiḥ /
bījairvisargiṇī māyā huṃ hakāro visargavān // 20
meaning:
आमन्त्रितान्यघोर्यादित्रितयस्य क्रमोदितैः /
बीजैर्विसर्गिणी माया हुं हकारो विसर्गवान् // 20
text_mt: The vocatives of the triad of Aghorī and the others, with the seed-syllables uttered in order, / are Māyā with visarga, 'huṃ', and the letter 'ha' endowed with visarga. // 20

sanskrit_iast:
punardevītrayasyāpi kramādāmantraṇatrayam /
dvitīyasminpade'kāra ekārasyeha ca smṛtaḥ // 21
meaning:
पुनर्देवीत्रयस्यापि क्रमादामन्त्रणत्रयम् /
द्वितीयस्मिन्पदेऽकार एकारस्येह च स्मृतः // 21
text_mt: Then also the three vocatives of the triad of goddesses in succession; / here, on the second word, the letter 'a' is taught in place of the letter 'e'. // 21

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śaktidvayāmantro luptaṃ tatrāntyamakṣaram /
he'gnivarṇāvubhau pañcasvarayuktau parau pṛthak // 22
meaning:
ततः शक्तिद्वयामन्त्रो लुप्तं तत्रान्त्यमक्षरम् /
हेऽग्निवर्णावुभौ पञ्चस्वरयुक्तौ परौ पृथक् // 22
text_mt: Then the invocation of the two powers, where the final phoneme is dropped; / the two fiery phonemes, each joined with the fifth vowel, separate and subsequent, // 22

sanskrit_iast:
akārayuktāvastraṃ huṃ ha visargī punaḥ śaraḥ /
tāreṇa saha vasvagnivarṇārdhārṇadvayādhikā // 23
meaning:
अकारयुक्तावस्त्रं हुं ह विसर्गी पुनः शरः /
तारेण सह वस्वग्निवर्णार्धार्णद्वयाधिका // 23
text_mt: joined with the letter 'a', the weapon 'huṃ', 'ha' with visarga, and again the arrow; / together with the Praṇava, [the mantra] exceeds thirty-eight phonemes by a half-phoneme. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
eṣā parāparādevyā vidyā śrītrikaśāsane /
pañcaṣaṭpañcavedākṣivahninetrākṣaraṃ padam // 24
meaning:
एषा परापरादेव्या विद्या श्रीत्रिकशासने /
पञ्चषट्पञ्चवेदाक्षिवह्निनेत्राक्षरं पदम् // 24
text_mt: This is the vidyā of the goddess Parāparā in the venerable Trika teaching; / its words consist of five, six, five, four, two, three, and two phonemes. // 24

sanskrit_iast:
aghoryādau saptake syāt pivanyāḥ pariśiṣṭakam /
pratyekavarṇago'pyuktaḥ siddhayogīśvarīmate // 25
meaning:
अघोर्यादौ सप्तके स्यात् पिवन्याः परिशिष्टकम् /
प्रत्येकवर्णगोऽप्युक्तः सिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते // 25
text_mt: In the heptad beginning with Aghorī, there would be the remainder of the Pivanī; / in the doctrine of the Siddhayogīśvarī, it is also said to reside in each individual phoneme. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
devatācakravinyāsaḥ sa bahutvānna lipyate /
māyā visargiṇī huṃ phaṭ ceti mantro'parātmakaḥ // 26
meaning:
देवताचक्रविन्यासः स बहुत्वान्न लिप्यते /
माया विसर्गिणी हुं फट् चेति मन्त्रोऽपरात्मकः // 26
text_mt: The placement of the circle of deities is not written here because of its multiplicity. / Māyā with visarga, 'huṃ', and 'phaṭ'—this is the mantra of Aparā. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
parāyāstūktasadvyāptirjīvaḥ sahacaturdaśaḥ /
sānekabhedā triśiraḥśāstre proktā maheśinā // 27
meaning:
परायास्तूक्तसद्व्याप्तिर्जीवः सहचतुर्दशः /
सानेकभेदा त्रिशिरःशास्त्रे प्रोक्ता महेशिना // 27
text_mt: Of Parā, however, the real pervasion has been stated: the jīva along with the fourteenth [vowel]. / In the treatise of the Triśiras, it has been proclaimed in many varieties by the Great Lord. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpato vibhinnāpi racanānekasaṅkulā /
jīvaḥ prāṇastha evātra prāṇo vā jīvasaṃsthitaḥ // 28
meaning:
स्वरूपतो विभिन्नापि रचनानेकसङ्कुला /
जीवः प्राणस्थ एवात्र प्राणो वा जीवसंस्थितः // 28
text_mt: Though different in its own nature, it is an arrangement crowded with many [forms]: / here, the jīva resides within prāṇa, or prāṇa resides within the jīva, // 28

sanskrit_iast:
ādhārādheyabhāvena avinābhāvayogataḥ /
haṃsaṃ cāmṛtamadhyasthaṃ kālarudravibheditam // 29
meaning:
आधाराधेयभावेन अविनाभावयोगतः /
हंसं चामृतमध्यस्थं कालरुद्रविभेदितम् // 29
text_mt: in the relation of locus and located, through their invariable concomitance. / The 'haṃsa', situated in the midst of nectar, differentiated by Kālarudra, // 29

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvaneśaśiroyuktamanaṅgadvayayojitam /
dīptāddīptataraṃ jñeyaṃ ṣaṭcakrakramayojitam // 30
meaning:
भुवनेशशिरोयुक्तमनङ्गद्वययोजितम् /
दीप्ताद्दीप्ततरं ज्ञेयं षट्चक्रक्रमयोजितम् // 30
text_mt: joined with the head of Bhuvaneśa, united with two cupids, / should be known as brighter than the bright, aligned with the sequence of the six cakras. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇaṃ daṇḍāsanasthaṃ tu guhyaśaktīcchayā yutam /
pareyaṃ vācikoddiṣṭā mahājñānasvarūpataḥ // 31
meaning:
प्राणं दण्डासनस्थं तु गुह्यशक्तीच्छया युतम् /
परेयं वाचिकोद्दिष्टा महाज्ञानस्वरूपतः // 31
text_mt: The prāṇa seated upon the staff, endowed with the will of the secret power— / this Parā is indicated vocally by virtue of its nature as great knowledge. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
sphuṭaṃ bhairavahṛjjñānamidaṃ tvekākṣaraṃ param /
amṛtaṃ kevalaṃ khasthaṃ yadvā sāvitrikāyutam // 32
meaning:
स्फुटं भैरवहृज्ज्ञानमिदं त्वेकाक्षरं परम् /
अमृतं केवलं खस्थं यद्वा सावित्रिकायुतम् // 32
text_mt: This is clearly the supreme single-phoneme knowledge of the heart of Bhairava: / pure nectar situated in the void, or else joined with the Sāvitrī, // 32

sanskrit_iast:
śūnyadvayasamopetaṃ parāyā hṛdayaṃ param /
yugmayāge prasiddhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tattvavedibhiḥ // 33
meaning:
शून्यद्वयसमोपेतं पराया हृदयं परम् /
युग्मयागे प्रसिद्धं तु कर्तव्यं तत्त्ववेदिभिः // 33
text_mt: accompanied by the two voids: the supreme heart of Parā. / It should be performed by the knowers of reality, renowned in the ritual of the couple. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
anye'pyekākṣarā ye tu ekavīravidhānataḥ /
guptā guptatarāste tu aṃgābhijanavarjitāḥ // 34
meaning:
अन्येऽप्येकाक्षरा ये तु एकवीरविधानतः /
गुप्ता गुप्ततरास्ते तु अंगाभिजनवर्जिताः // 34
text_mt: As for the other single-phoneme [mantras] according to the procedure of the single hero, / they are secret and more secret, devoid of limbs and family. // 34

sanskrit_iast:
yaṣṭavyāḥ sādhakendraistu kulasthāḥ siddhidāyakāḥ /
kulakramavidhānena sūkṣmavijñānayogataḥ // 35
meaning:
यष्टव्याः साधकेन्द्रैस्तु कुलस्थाः सिद्धिदायकाः /
कुलक्रमविधानेन सूक्ष्मविज्ञानयोगतः // 35
text_mt: They are to be worshipped by the lords of adepts, situated in Kula, granting accomplishments, / through the procedure of the Kula succession, by the application of subtle knowledge. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
anuṣṭheyāḥ sadā devi striyā vā puruṣeṇa vā /
sakāro dīrghaṣaṭkena yukto'ṅgānyānanāni tu // 36
meaning:
अनुष्ठेयाः सदा देवि स्त्रिया वा पुरुषेण वा /
सकारो दीर्घषट्केन युक्तोऽङ्गान्याननानि तु // 36
text_mt: They are to be practiced always, O Goddess, either by a woman or by a man. / The letter 'sa' joined with the six long vowels forms the limbs and faces; // 36

sanskrit_iast:
syāt sa eva paraṃ hrasvapañcasvarakhasaṃyutaḥ /
oṃkāraiḥ pañcabhirmantro vidyāṅgahṛdayaṃ bhavet // 37
meaning:
स्यात् स एव परं ह्रस्वपञ्चस्वरखसंयुतः /
ओंकारैः पञ्चभिर्मन्त्रो विद्याङ्गहृदयं भवेत् // 37
text_mt: that very [letter] becomes the supreme [form] when joined with the five short vowels and the void. / The mantra with the five 'oṃ' syllables becomes the heart of the limb of the vidyā. // 37

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaścāmṛte tejomālini svāhayā saha /
ekādaśākṣaraṃ brahmaśirastanmālinīmate // 38
meaning:
प्रणवश्चामृते तेजोमालिनि स्वाहया सह /
एकादशाक्षरं ब्रह्मशिरस्तन्मालिनीमते // 38
text_mt: The Praṇava, and 'amṛte tejomālini svāhā'— / that eleven-phoneme head of Brahman is according to the Mālinī doctrine. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
vedavedani hūṃ phaṭca praṇavādiyutā śikhā /
vajriṇe vajradharāya svāhetyoṃkārapūrvakam // 39
meaning:
वेदवेदनि हूं फट्च प्रणवादियुता शिखा /
वज्रिणे वज्रधराय स्वाहेत्योंकारपूर्वकम् // 39
text_mt: 'vedavedani hūṃ phaṭ', preceded by the Praṇava, is the tuft of hair. / 'vajriṇe vajradharāya svāhā', preceded by the syllable 'oṃ', // 36

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśākṣaraṃ varma puruṣṭutamiti smṛtam /
tāro dvijihvaḥ khaśarasvarayugjīva eva ca // 40
meaning:
एकादशाक्षरं वर्म पुरुष्टुतमिति स्मृतम् /
तारो द्विजिह्वः खशरस्वरयुग्जीव एव च // 40
text_mt: is the eleven-phoneme armor celebrated as 'puruṣṭuta'. / The Praṇava, the two-tongued, the jīva joined with the vowel of space and arrow, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
netrametatprakāśātma sarvasādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam /
tāraḥ ślīṃ paśu huṃ phat ca tadastraṃ rasavarṇakam // 41
meaning:
नेत्रमेतत्प्रकाशात्म सर्वसाधारणं स्मृतम् /
तारः श्लीं पशु हुं फत् च तदस्त्रं रसवर्णकम् // 41
text_mt: this is the eye, consisting of light, taught as common to all. / The Praṇava, 'ślīṃ', 'paśu', 'huṃ', and 'phaṭ' form its six-phoneme weapon. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
laraṭakṣavayairdīrghaiḥ samayuktaiḥ sabindukaiḥ /
indrādayastadastrāṇi hrasvairviṣṇuprajāpatī // 42
meaning:
लरटक्षवयैर्दीर्घैः समयुक्तैः सबिन्दुकैः /
इन्द्रादयस्तदस्त्राणि ह्रस्वैर्विष्णुप्रजापती // 42
text_mt: 'la', 'ra', 'ṭa', 'kṣa', 'va', and 'ya' in their long forms, joined with 'sa' and bindu, / are Indra and the others; their weapons are formed with short vowels; Viṣṇu and Prajāpati // 42

sanskrit_iast:
smṛtau turyadvitīyābhyāṃ hrasvābhyāṃ padmacakrake /
namaḥ svāhā tathā vauṣaṭ huṃ vaṣaṭ phaṭ ca jātayaḥ // 43
meaning:
स्मृतौ तुर्यद्वितीयाभ्यां ह्रस्वाभ्यां पद्मचक्रके /
नमः स्वाहा तथा वौषट् हुं वषट् फट् च जातयः // 43
text_mt: are taught with the fourth and second short vowels in the lotus and the cakra. / 'namaḥ', 'svāhā', likewise 'vauṣaṭ', 'huṃ', 'vaṣaṭ', and 'phaṭ' are the ritual endings // 43

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgeṣu kramaśaḥ ṣaṭsu karmasvatha tadātmikāḥ /
jape home tathāpyāye samuccāṭe'tha śāntike // 44
meaning:
अङ्गेषु क्रमशः षट्सु कर्मस्वथ तदात्मिकाः /
जपे होमे तथाप्याये समुच्चाटेऽथ शान्तिके // 44
text_mt: on the six limbs respectively, and in the rituals consisting of them: / in recitation, oblation, nourishing, expulsion, pacification, // 44

sanskrit_iast:
abhicāre ca mantrāṇāṃ namaskārādijātayaḥ /
akṣiṣaṇmunivargebhyo dvitīyāḥ saha bindunā // 45
meaning:
अभिचारे च मन्त्राणां नमस्कारादिजातयः /
अक्षिषण्मुनिवर्गेभ्यो द्वितीयाः सह बिन्दुना // 45
text_mt: and malevolent magic, [these are] the endings of mantras beginning with 'namas'. / The second phonemes of the groups of two, six, and seven, with the bindu // 45

sanskrit_iast:
yonyarṇena ca mātṝṇāṃ sadmāvaḥ kālakarṣiṇī /
ādyojjhito vāpyantena varjito vātha saṃmataḥ // 46
meaning:
योन्यर्णेन च मातॄणां सद्मावः कालकर्षिणी /
आद्योज्झितो वाप्यन्तेन वर्जितो वाथ संमतः // 46
text_mt: and the phoneme of the womb, constitute the essence of the Mothers, Kālakarṣiṇī; / or it is approved as devoid of the first, or devoid of the last. // 46

sanskrit_iast:
jīvaḥ prāṇapuṭāntaḥsthaḥ kālānalasamadyutiḥ /
atidīptastu vāmāṃghrirbhūṣito mūrdhni bindunā // 47
meaning:
जीवः प्राणपुटान्तःस्थः कालानलसमद्युतिः /
अतिदीप्तस्तु वामांघ्रिर्भूषितो मूर्ध्नि बिन्दुना // 47
text_mt: The jīva placed inside the casing of prāṇa, shining like the fire of cosmic dissolution, / exceedingly radiant, is the left foot, adorned on its crest with a bindu, // 47

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣajānugataścāyaṃ sarvamātṛgaṇārcitaḥ /
anena prāṇitāḥ sarve dadate vāñchitaṃ phalam // 48
meaning:
दक्षजानुगतश्चायं सर्वमातृगणार्चितः /
अनेन प्राणिताः सर्वे ददते वाञ्छितं फलम् // 48
text_mt: and reaching to the right knee, worshipped by the entire troop of Mothers; / ensouled by this, they all bestow the desired fruit. // 48

sanskrit_iast:
sadbhāvaḥ paramo hyeṣa mātṝṇāṃ bhairavasya ca /
tasmādenaṃ japenmantrī ya icchetsiddhimuttamām // 49
meaning:
सद्भावः परमो ह्येष मातॄणां भैरवस्य च /
तस्मादेनं जपेन्मन्त्री य इच्छेत्सिद्धिमुत्तमाम् // 49
text_mt: For this is the supreme essence of the Mothers and of Bhairava; / therefore, the mantrin who desires excellent accomplishment should recite it. // 49

sanskrit_iast:
rudraśaktisamāveśo nityamatra pratiṣṭhitaḥ /
yasmādeṣā parā śaktirbhedenānyena kīrtitā // 50
meaning:
रुद्रशक्तिसमावेशो नित्यमत्र प्रतिष्ठितः /
यस्मादेषा परा शक्तिर्भेदेनान्येन कीर्तिता // 50
text_mt: The immersion into the power of Rudra is permanently established here, / since this supreme power has been proclaimed under another distinction. // 50

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatyaḥ siddhayastantre tāḥ sarvāḥ kurute tviyam /
aṅgavaktrāṇi cāpyasyāḥ prāgvatsvaraniyogataḥ // 51
meaning:
यावत्यः सिद्धयस्तन्त्रे ताः सर्वाः कुरुते त्वियम् /
अङ्गवक्त्राणि चाप्यस्याः प्राग्वत्स्वरनियोगतः // 51
text_mt: Whatever accomplishments are in the Tantra, this [power] brings them all about; / and its limbs and faces are formed through the employment of vowels, as before. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍo jīvastriśūlaṃ ca dakṣāṅgulyaparastanau /
nābhikaṇṭhau marudrudrau visargaḥ satriśūlakaḥ // 52
meaning:
दण्डो जीवस्त्रिशूलं च दक्षाङ्गुल्यपरस्तनौ /
नाभिकण्ठौ मरुद्रुद्रौ विसर्गः सत्रिशूलकः // 52
text_mt: The staff, the soul, and the trident; in the right finger and on the other breast, / the navel and the throat, wind and Rudra, the creative emission with the trident: // 52

sanskrit_iast:
sarvayoginicakrāṇāmadhipo'yamudāhṛtaḥ /
asyāpyuccāraṇādeva saṃvittiḥ syātpuroditā // 53
meaning:
सर्वयोगिनिचक्राणामधिपोऽयमुदाहृतः /
अस्याप्युच्चारणादेव संवित्तिः स्यात्पुरोदिता // 53
text_mt: This is declared to be the sovereign of all the circles of yoginīs; / from its very pronunciation, the consciousness previously described will arise. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
mahācaṇḍeti tu yogeśvaṛ ityaṣṭavarṇakam /
navārṇeyaṃ guptatarā sadbhāvaḥ kālakarṣiṇī // 54
meaning:
महाचण्डेति तु योगेश्वऋ इत्यष्टवर्णकम् /
नवार्णेयं गुप्ततरा सद्भावः कालकर्षिणी // 54
text_mt: "mahācaṇḍeti tu yogeśvarī" consists of eight syllables; / this nine-syllabled one is more secret, the Sadbhāva, Kālakarṣiṇī. // 54

sanskrit_iast:
śrīḍāmare mahāyāge parātparataroditā /
sudhācchedakaṣaṇṭhādyairbījaṃ chedakamasvaram // 55
meaning:
श्रीडामरे महायागे परात्परतरोदिता /
सुधाच्छेदकषण्ठाद्यैर्बीजं छेदकमस्वरम् // 55
text_mt: In the Śrīḍāmara, in the great sacrifice, she is taught as higher than the high: / with the elixir, the severance [letter], the neuter [vowels] and so forth, the consonant-seed of severance. // 55

sanskrit_iast:
adhyardhārṇā kālarātriḥ kṣurikā mālinīmate /
śatāvartanayā hyasyā jāyate mūrdhni vedanā // 56
meaning:
अध्यर्धार्णा कालरात्रिः क्षुरिका मालिनीमते /
शतावर्तनया ह्यस्या जायते मूर्ध्नि वेदना // 56
text_mt: One and a half syllables is Kālarātri, the razor in the doctrine of the Mālinī; / for by its repetition a hundred times, pain arises in the head. // 56

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pratyayamālocya mṛtyujiddhyānamāśrayet /
naināṃ samuccareddevi ya iccheddīrghajīvitam // 57
meaning:
एवं प्रत्ययमालोच्य मृत्युजिद्ध्यानमाश्रयेत् /
नैनां समुच्चरेद्देवि य इच्छेद्दीर्घजीवितम् // 57
text_mt: Having thus observed the conviction [of its effect], one should take refuge in meditation on Mṛtyujit. / One who desires long life, O Goddess, should not recite this [mantra]. // 57

sanskrit_iast:
dvirdaṇḍāgnī śūlanabhaḥprāṇāśchettranalau tathā /
kūṭāgnī savisargāśca pañcāpyete'tha pañcasu // 58
meaning:
द्विर्दण्डाग्नी शूलनभःप्राणाश्छेत्त्रनलौ तथा /
कूटाग्नी सविसर्गाश्च पञ्चाप्येतेऽथ पञ्चसु // 58
text_mt: Staff and fire twice, trident, space, and breath, and cutter and fire, / and kūṭa and fire with creative emission—these five also in the five // 58

sanskrit_iast:
vyomasviti śivenoktaṃ tantrasadbhāvaśāsane /
chedinī kṣurikeyaṃ syādyayā yojayate pare // 59
meaning:
व्योमस्विति शिवेनोक्तं तन्त्रसद्भावशासने /
छेदिनी क्षुरिकेयं स्याद्यया योजयते परे // 59
text_mt: voids: thus it was spoken by Śiva in the teaching of the Tantrasadbhāva. / This is the severing razor by which one unites [the soul] with the supreme. // 59

sanskrit_iast:
bindvindvanalakūṭāgnimarutṣaṣṭhasvarairyutam /
āpādatalamūrdhāntaṃ smaredastramidaṃ jvalat // 60
meaning:
बिन्द्विन्द्वनलकूटाग्निमरुत्षष्ठस्वरैर्युतम् /
आपादतलमूर्धान्तं स्मरेदस्त्रमिदं ज्वलत् // 60
text_mt: Endowed with bindu, moon, fire, kūṭa, fire, wind, and the sixth vowel, / one should contemplate this blazing weapon from the soles of the feet to the crown of the head. // 60

sanskrit_iast:
kuñcanaṃ cāṅgulīnāṃ tu kartavyaṃ codanaṃ tataḥ /
jānvādiparacakrāntaṃ cakrāccakraṃ tu kuñcayet // 61
meaning:
कुञ्चनं चाङ्गुलीनां तु कर्तव्यं चोदनं ततः /
जान्वादिपरचक्रान्तं चक्राच्चक्रं तु कुञ्चयेत् // 61
text_mt: A contraction of the toes is to be performed, and then impulsion; / from knee and so forth up to the highest wheel, one should contract from wheel to wheel. // 61

sanskrit_iast:
kathitaṃ sarahasyaṃ tu sadyonirvāṇakaṃ param /
athocyate brahmavidyā sadyaḥpratyayadāyinī // 62
meaning:
कथितं सरहस्यं तु सद्योनिर्वाणकं परम् /
अथोच्यते ब्रह्मविद्या सद्यःप्रत्ययदायिनी // 62
text_mt: Thus the supreme [practice] has been explained with its secret, bestowing instant nirvāṇa. / Now the knowledge of Brahman is taught, which yields immediate conviction, // 62

sanskrit_iast:
śivaḥ śrībhūtirājo yāmasmabhyaṃ pratyapādayat /
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ maraṇe samupasthite // 63
meaning:
शिवः श्रीभूतिराजो यामस्मभ्यं प्रत्यपादयत् /
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां मरणे समुपस्थिते // 63
text_mt: which the divine Śrībhūtirāja communicated to us: / when death is at hand for any living being, // 63

sanskrit_iast:
yayā paṭhitayotkramya jīvo yāti nirañjanam /
yā jñānino'pi saṃpūrṇakṛtyasyāpi śrutā satī // 64
meaning:
यया पठितयोत्क्रम्य जीवो याति निरञ्जनम् /
या ज्ञानिनोऽपि संपूर्णकृत्यस्यापि श्रुता सती // 64
text_mt: reciting which the living soul departs and goes to the spotless [state]; / and which, even when heard by a knower whose task is already accomplished, // 64

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇādicchedajāṃ mṛtyuvyathāṃ sadyo vyapohati /
yāmākarṇya mahāmohavivaśo'pi kramādgataḥ // 65
meaning:
प्राणादिच्छेदजां मृत्युव्यथां सद्यो व्यपोहति /
यामाकर्ण्य महामोहविवशोऽपि क्रमाद्गतः // 65
text_mt: immediately dispels the anguish of death caused by the severing of the vital breaths and other faculties; / hearing which, even one overwhelmed by great delusion gradually // 65

sanskrit_iast:
prabodhaṃ vaktṛsāṃmukhyamabhyeti rabhasātsvayam /
paramapadāttvamihāgāḥ sanātanastvaṃ jahīhi dehāntam // 66
meaning:
प्रबोधं वक्तृसांमुख्यमभ्येति रभसात्स्वयम् /
परमपदात्त्वमिहागाः सनातनस्त्वं जहीहि देहान्तम् // 66
text_mt: attains awakening, directly turning toward the speaker impetuously on his own: / 'From the supreme abode you came here; you are eternal; abandon the confines of the body! // 66

sanskrit_iast:
pādāṅguṣṭhādi vibho nibandhanaṃ bandhanaṃ hyugram /
āryāvākyamidaṃ pūrvaṃ bhuvanākhyaiḥ padairbhavet // 67
meaning:
पादाङ्गुष्ठादि विभो निबन्धनं बन्धनं ह्युग्रम् /
आर्यावाक्यमिदं पूर्वं भुवनाख्यैः पदैर्भवेत् // 67
text_mt: The binding, O all-pervading one, beginning from the big toe, is indeed a terrible bondage!' / This first Āryā verse consists of fourteen words. // 67

sanskrit_iast:
gulphānte jānugataṃ jatrusthaṃ bandhanaṃ tathā meḍhre /
jahihi puramagryamadhyaṃ hṛtpadmāttvaṃ samuttiṣṭha // 68
meaning:
गुल्फान्ते जानुगतं जत्रुस्थं बन्धनं तथा मेढ्रे /
जहिहि पुरमग्र्यमध्यं हृत्पद्मात्त्वं समुत्तिष्ठ // 68
text_mt: 'At the ankles, going to the knees, stationed in the collarbones, and likewise the binding in the penis: / abandon the foremost and middle city; arise from the heart lotus!' // 68

sanskrit_iast:
etāvadbhiḥ padairetadāryāvākyaṃ dvitīyakam /
haṃsa hayagrīva vibho sadāśivastvaṃ paro'si jīvākhyaḥ // 69
meaning:
एतावद्भिः पदैरेतदार्यावाक्यं द्वितीयकम् /
हंस हयग्रीव विभो सदाशिवस्त्वं परोऽसि जीवाख्यः // 69
text_mt: With this many words, this is the second Āryā verse: / 'O Haṃsa, O Hayagrīva, O all-pervading one, you are Sadāśiva, the supreme, called the living soul! // 69

sanskrit_iast:
ravisomavahnisaṅghadṛbindudeho hahaha samutkrāma /
tṛtīyamāryāvākyaṃ prāksaṃkhyairekādhikaiḥ padaiḥ // 70
meaning:
रविसोमवह्निसङ्घदृबिन्दुदेहो हहह समुत्क्राम /
तृतीयमार्यावाक्यं प्राक्संख्यैरेकाधिकैः पदैः // 70
text_mt: O you whose body is the point of union of the multitude of sun, moon, and fire, ha ha ha, ascend!' / The third Āryā verse is with one more word than the preceding number. // 70

sanskrit_iast:
haṃsamahāmantramayaḥ sanātanastvaṃ śubhāśubhāpekṣī /
maṇḍalamadhyaniviṣṭaḥ śaktimahāsetukāraṇamahārthaḥ // 71
meaning:
हंसमहामन्त्रमयः सनातनस्त्वं शुभाशुभापेक्षी /
मण्डलमध्यनिविष्टः शक्तिमहासेतुकारणमहार्थः // 71
text_mt: 'Consisting of the great mantra Haṃsa, you are eternal, regarding the auspicious and inauspicious, / seated in the middle of the maṇḍala, the great reality that is the cause of the great embankment of power; // 71

sanskrit_iast:
kamalobhayaviniviṣṭaḥ prabodhamāyāhi devatādeha /
āryāvākyamidaṃ sārdhaṃ rudrasaṃkhyapaderitam // 72
meaning:
कमलोभयविनिविष्टः प्रबोधमायाहि देवतादेह /
आर्यावाक्यमिदं सार्धं रुद्रसंख्यपदेरितम् // 72
text_mt: seated within both lotuses, come to awakening, O you whose body is the deity!' / This Āryā-and-a-half verse is uttered with eleven words. // 72

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśvāse tvapaśabdasya sthāne'styupa iti dhvaniḥ /
ajñānāttvaṃ baddhaḥ prabodhitottiṣṭha devāde // 73
meaning:
निःश्वासे त्वपशब्दस्य स्थानेऽस्त्युप इति ध्वनिः /
अज्ञानात्त्वं बद्धः प्रबोधितोत्तिष्ठ देवादे // 73
text_mt: In the Niḥśvāsa, however, in place of the word 'apa-', there is the sound 'upa-': / 'Bound through ignorance, awakened, arise, O origin of the gods!' // 73

sanskrit_iast:
etatpañcamamāryārdhavākyaṃ syātsaptabhiḥ padaiḥ /
vraja tālusāhvayāntaṃ hyauḍambaraghaṭṭitaṃ mahādvāram // 74
meaning:
एतत्पञ्चममार्यार्धवाक्यं स्यात्सप्तभिः पदैः /
व्रज तालुसाह्वयान्तं ह्यौडम्बरघट्टितं महाद्वारम् // 74
text_mt: This fifth half-Āryā verse consists of seven words: / 'Go to that which is called the palate, the great doorway struck by the fig tree; // 74

sanskrit_iast:
prāpya prayāhi haṃho haṃho vā vāmadevapadam /
āryyāvākyamidaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ syāccaturdaśabhiḥ padaiḥ // 75
meaning:
प्राप्य प्रयाहि हंहो हंहो वा वामदेवपदम् /
आर्य्यावाक्यमिदं षष्ठं स्याच्चतुर्दशभिः पदैः // 75
text_mt: having reached it, depart, haṃho haṃho, to the abode of Vāmadeva!' / This sixth Āryā verse consists of fourteen words. // 75

sanskrit_iast:
granthīśvara paramātman śānta mahātālurandhramāsādya /
utkrama he deheśvara nirañjanaṃ śivapadaṃ prayāhyāśu // 76
meaning:
ग्रन्थीश्वर परमात्मन् शान्त महातालुरन्ध्रमासाद्य /
उत्क्रम हे देहेश्वर निरञ्जनं शिवपदं प्रयाह्याशु // 76
text_mt: 'O Lord of the knot, O supreme Self, tranquil one, having reached the aperture of the great palate, / ascend, O Lord of the body; quickly go to the stainless abode of Śiva!' // 76

sanskrit_iast:
āryāvākyaṃ saptamaṃ syāttaccaturdaśabhiḥ padaiḥ /
prabhañjanastvamityevaṃ pāṭho niḥśvāsaśāsane // 77
meaning:
आर्यावाक्यं सप्तमं स्यात्तच्चतुर्दशभिः पदैः /
प्रभञ्जनस्त्वमित्येवं पाठो निःश्वासशासने // 77
text_mt: The seventh Āryā verse consists of fourteen words; / 'You are the tempest-wind' is the reading in the scripture Niḥśvāsa. // 77

sanskrit_iast:
ākramya madhyamārgaṃ prāṇāpānau samāhṛtya /
dharmādharmau tyaktvā nārāyaṇa yāhi śāntāntam // 78
meaning:
आक्रम्य मध्यमार्गं प्राणापानौ समाहृत्य /
धर्माधर्मौ त्यक्त्वा नारायण याहि शान्तान्तम् // 78
text_mt: 'Mounting the central channel, gathering together the incoming and outgoing breaths, / abandoning merit and demerit, O Nārāyaṇa, go to the end of the tranquil!' // 78

sanskrit_iast:
āryāvākyamidaṃ proktamaṣṭamaṃ navabhiḥ padaiḥ /
he brahman he viṣṇo he rudra śivo'si vāsudevastvam // 79
meaning:
आर्यावाक्यमिदं प्रोक्तमष्टमं नवभिः पदैः /
हे ब्रह्मन् हे विष्णो हे रुद्र शिवोऽसि वासुदेवस्त्वम् // 79
text_mt: This eighth Āryā verse is declared to have nine words: / 'O Brahman, O Viṣṇu, O Rudra, you are Śiva, you are Vāsudeva! // 79

sanskrit_iast:
agnīṣomasanātanamṛtpiṇḍaṃ jahihi he mahākāśa /
etadbhuvanasaṃkhyātairāryyāvākyaṃ prakīrtitam // 80
meaning:
अग्नीषोमसनातनमृत्पिण्डं जहिहि हे महाकाश /
एतद्भुवनसंख्यातैरार्य्यावाक्यं प्रकीर्तितम् // 80
text_mt: Abandon this lump of clay eternalized by fire and soma, O great ether!' / This Āryā verse is proclaimed with fourteen words. // 80

sanskrit_iast:
sanātma tripiṇḍamiti mahākośamiti sthitam /
padatrayaṃ tu niḥśvāsamukuṭottarakādiṣu // 81
meaning:
सनात्म त्रिपिण्डमिति महाकोशमिति स्थितम् /
पदत्रयं तु निःश्वासमुकुटोत्तरकादिषु // 81
text_mt: 'sanātma', 'tripiṇḍam', and 'mahākośam'—these three words / stand in the Niḥśvāsa, Mukuṭottara, and other texts. // 81

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhamātramamalamāvaraṇaṃ jahihi he mahāsūkṣma /
āryyāvākyamidaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ padairdaśamamucyate // 82
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठमात्रममलमावरणं जहिहि हे महासूक्ष्म /
आर्य्यावाक्यमिदं षड्भिः पदैर्दशममुच्यते // 82
text_mt: 'Abandon this stainless covering that is the size of a thumb, O immensely subtle one!' / This tenth Āryā verse is declared with six words. // 82

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ dviriti sūkṣmaṃ cetyevaṃ śrīmukuṭottare /
puruṣastvaṃ prakṛtimayairbaddho'haṅkāratantunā bandhaiḥ // 83
meaning:
अलं द्विरिति सूक्ष्मं चेत्येवं श्रीमुकुटोत्तरे /
पुरुषस्त्वं प्रकृतिमयैर्बद्धोऽहङ्कारतन्तुना बन्धैः // 83
text_mt: 'alam' twice and 'sūkṣmam': such is the reading in the revered Mukuṭottara. / 'You are the Puruṣa, bound by bonds made of Prakṛti with the thread of ego! // 83

sanskrit_iast:
abhavābhava nityodita paramātmaṃstyaja sarāgamadhvānam /
etattrayodaśapadaṃ syādāryāvākyamuttamam // 84
meaning:
अभवाभव नित्योदित परमात्मंस्त्यज सरागमध्वानम् /
एतत्त्रयोदशपदं स्यादार्यावाक्यमुत्तमम् // 84
text_mt: O free from worldly existence, ever-risen supreme Self, abandon the path associated with passion!' / This excellent Āryā verse consists of thirteen words. // 84

sanskrit_iast:
hrīṃhūṃmantraśarīramavilambamāśu tvamehi dehāntam /
āryārdhavākyametatsyād dvādaśaṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ param // 85
meaning:
ह्रींहूंमन्त्रशरीरमविलम्बमाशु त्वमेहि देहान्तम् /
आर्यार्धवाक्यमेतत्स्याद् द्वादशं षट्पदं परम् // 85
text_mt: 'O you whose body is the mantras hrīṃ and hūṃ, without delay, swiftly come to the end of the body!' / This supreme twelfth half-Āryā verse consists of six words. // 85

sanskrit_iast:
tadidaṃ guṇabhūtamayaṃ tyaja sva ṣoṭkośikaṃ piṇḍam /
syāt trayodaśamāryārdhaṃ padaiḥ saptabhirīdṛśam // 86
meaning:
तदिदं गुणभूतमयं त्यज स्व षोट्कोशिकं पिण्डम् /
स्यात् त्रयोदशमार्यार्धं पदैः सप्तभिरीदृशम् // 86
text_mt: 'Abandon this body of your own, composed of the qualities and elements, consisting of six sheaths!' / The thirteenth half-Āryā verse is such, with seven words. // 86

sanskrit_iast:
mā dehaṃ bhūtamayaṃ pragṛhyatāṃ śāśvataṃ mahādeham /
āryārdhavākyaṃ tāvadbhiḥ padairetaccaturdaśam // 87
meaning:
मा देहं भूतमयं प्रगृह्यतां शाश्वतं महादेहम् /
आर्यार्धवाक्यं तावद्भिः पदैरेतच्चतुर्दशम् // 87
text_mt: 'Do not take up a body composed of elements; let the eternal great body be assumed!' / This fourteenth half-Āryā verse has that same number of words. // 87

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalamamalamanantaṃ tridhā sthitaṃ gaccha bhittvaitat /
āryārdhavākyamaṣṭābhiḥ padaiḥ pañcadaśaṃ tvidam // 88
meaning:
मण्डलममलमनन्तं त्रिधा स्थितं गच्छ भित्त्वैतत् /
आर्यार्धवाक्यमष्टाभिः पदैः पञ्चदशं त्विदम् // 88
text_mt: 'Having pierced this stainless, endless circle situated in threefold form, depart!' / This fifteenth half-Āryā verse, however, has eight words. // 88

sanskrit_iast:
sakaleyaṃ brahmavidyā syātpañcadaśabhiḥ sphuṭaiḥ /
vākyaiḥ pañcākṣaraistvasyā niṣkalā parikīrtyate // 89
meaning:
सकलेयं ब्रह्मविद्या स्यात्पञ्चदशभिः स्फुटैः /
वाक्यैः पञ्चाक्षरैस्त्वस्या निष्कला परिकीर्त्यते // 89
text_mt: This is the complete knowledge of Brahman with its distinct fifteen / verses; but its partless form is proclaimed with five syllables, // 89

sanskrit_iast:
prativākyaṃ yayādyantayojitā paripaṭhyate /
tāro māyā vedakalo mātṛtāro navātmakaḥ // 90
meaning:
प्रतिवाक्यं ययाद्यन्तयोजिता परिपठ्यते /
तारो माया वेदकलो मातृतारो नवात्मकः // 90
text_mt: by which, applied at the beginning and the end of each verse, it is recited: / the praṇava, māyā, vedakalā, the mātṛ-praṇava, and the nine-fold [seed]— // 90

sanskrit_iast:
iti pañcākṣarāṇi syuḥ proktavyāptyanusārataḥ /
binduprāṇāmṛtajalaṃ marutṣaṣṭhasvarānvitam // 91
meaning:
इति पञ्चाक्षराणि स्युः प्रोक्तव्याप्त्यनुसारतः /
बिन्दुप्राणामृतजलं मरुत्षष्ठस्वरान्वितम् // 91
text_mt: these are the five syllables according to the taught pervasive extension: / bindu, prāṇa, nectar-water, endowed with the wind and the sixth vowel. // 91

sanskrit_iast:
etena śaktyuccārasthabījenālabhyate paśuḥ /
kṛtadīkṣāvidhiḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaghno'pi viśuddhyati // 92
meaning:
एतेन शक्त्युच्चारस्थबीजेनालभ्यते पशुः /
कृतदीक्षाविधिः पूर्वं ब्रह्मघ्नोऽपि विशुद्ध्यति // 92
text_mt: When the bound soul is touched with this seed situated in the utterance of śakti, / even one who has killed a brahmin becomes purified, having performed the rite of initiation previously. // 92

sanskrit_iast:
laghutvena tulāśuddhiḥ sadyaḥpratyayakāriṇī /
tāraḥ śamarayaiḥ piṇḍo natiśca caturarṇakam // 93
meaning:
लघुत्वेन तुलाशुद्धिः सद्यःप्रत्ययकारिणी /
तारः शमरयैः पिण्डो नतिश्च चतुरर्णकम् // 93
text_mt: By lightness, the purification on the balance produces instant conviction. / The praṇava, the cluster of śa, ma, ra, and ya, and obeisance: a four-syllabled [mantra]. // 93

sanskrit_iast:
śākinīstobhanaṃ marma hṛdayaṃ jīvitaṃ tvidam /
ṣaṣṭhaprāṇatrikūṭordhvabāhuśūlākhyabindubhiḥ // 94
meaning:
शाकिनीस्तोभनं मर्म हृदयं जीवितं त्विदम् /
षष्ठप्राणत्रिकूटोर्ध्वबाहुशूलाख्यबिन्दुभिः // 94
text_mt: This is the vital core that paralyzes the Śākinīs, their heart and life. / With the sixth [vowel], prāṇa, the triple kūṭa, the raised arm, the trident, and bindus, // 94

sanskrit_iast:
anackanāsādhovaktracandrakhaṇḍaiśca maṇḍitam /
hṛdayaṃ bhairavākhyaṃ tu sarvasaṃhārakārakam // 95
meaning:
अनच्कनासाधोवक्त्रचन्द्रखण्डैश्च मण्डितम् /
हृदयं भैरवाख्यं तु सर्वसंहारकारकम् // 95
text_mt: and adorned with the vowelless [consonant], nose, downward face, and crescent moons, / this heart named Bhairava brings about the dissolution of all. // 95

sanskrit_iast:
agnimaṇḍalamadhyasthabhairavānalatāpitāḥ /
vaśamāyānti śākinyaḥ sthānametena ceddahet // 96
meaning:
अग्निमण्डलमध्यस्थभैरवानलतापिताः /
वशमायान्ति शाकिन्यः स्थानमेतेन चेद्दहेत् // 96
text_mt: Tormented by the fire of Bhairava situated in the center of the fire-circle, / the Śākinīs come under control; and if one burns the spot with this [mantra], // 96

sanskrit_iast:
visarjayettāḥ prathamamanyathā cchidrayanti tāḥ /
hrīṃ klīṃ vleṃ kleṃ ebhirvarṇairdvādaśasvarabhūṣitaiḥ // 97
meaning:
विसर्जयेत्ताः प्रथममन्यथा च्छिद्रयन्ति ताः /
ह्रीं क्लीं व्लें क्लें एभिर्वर्णैर्द्वादशस्वरभूषितैः // 97
text_mt: one should dismiss them first, otherwise they create vulnerabilities. / With these syllables, hrīṃ, klīṃ, vleṃ, and kleṃ, adorned with the twelve vowels, // 97

sanskrit_iast:
priyamelāpanaṃ nāma hṛdayaṃ sampuṭaṃ japet /
pratyekamathavā dvābhyāṃ sarvairvā vidhiruttamaḥ // 98
meaning:
प्रियमेलापनं नाम हृदयं सम्पुटं जपेत् /
प्रत्येकमथवा द्वाभ्यां सर्वैर्वा विधिरुत्तमः // 98
text_mt: one should recite the heart named 'Pleasing Encounter' encased [by them]; / individually, or by twos, or with all of them, the procedure is supreme. // 98

sanskrit_iast:
tulāmelakayogaḥ śrītantrasadbhāvaśāsane /
ya uktaḥ śambhunāthena sa mayā darśitaḥ kramāt // 99
meaning:
तुलामेलकयोगः श्रीतन्त्रसद्भावशासने /
य उक्तः शम्भुनाथेन स मया दर्शितः क्रमात् // 99
text_mt: The yoga of weighing and encounter taught by Śambhunātha / in the revered Tantrasadbhāva tradition has been set forth by me in proper sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vittavihīnānāṃ prapannānāṃ ca tattvataḥ /
deśakālādidoṣeṇa na tathādhyavasāyinām // 100
meaning:
अथ वित्तविहीनानां प्रपन्नानां च तत्त्वतः /
देशकालादिदोषेण न तथाध्यवसायिनाम् // 100
text_mt: Now, for those who lack wealth, who have truly surrendered, / but who, through faults of place, time, and so forth, do not possess such resolve,

sanskrit_iast:
prakartavyā yathā dīKṣā śrīsantatyāgamoditā /
kathyate hāṭakeśānapātālādhipacoditā // 101
meaning:
प्रकर्तव्या यथा दीक्षा श्रीसन्तत्यागमोदिता /
कथ्यते हाटकेशानपातालाधिपचोदिता // 101
text_mt: how dīkṣā should be performed as taught in the revered Santatyāgama, / impelled by the ruler of the nether world, the lord Hāṭakeśa, is now explained:

sanskrit_iast:
śrīnātha ārya bhagavannetattritayaṃ hi kanda ādhāre /
varuṇo macchando bhagavatta iti trayamidaṃ hṛdaye // 102
meaning:
श्रीनाथ आर्य भगवन्नेतत्त्रितयं हि कन्द आधारे /
वरुणो मच्छन्दो भगवत्त इति त्रयमिदं हृदये // 102
text_mt: “Śrīnātha, Ārya, Bhagavān”—this triad is indeed in the root-bulb, the base; / “Varuṇa, Macchanda, Bhagavatta”—this triad is in the heart;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādivargasaṃjñāścatvāraḥ kaṇṭhadeśagāḥ pūjyāḥ /
hrīṃśrīṃpūrvāḥ sarve sambodhajuṣaśca pādaśabdāntāḥ // 103
meaning:
धर्मादिवर्गसंज्ञाश्चत्वारः कण्ठदेशगाः पूज्याः /
ह्रींश्रींपूर्वाः सर्वे सम्बोधजुषश्च पादशब्दान्ताः // 103
text_mt: the four named after the classes beginning with Dharma are to be worshipped in the throat; / all preceded by Hrīṃ and Śrīṃ, in the vocative case, and ending with the word ‘Pāda’.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhatale vidyātrayamuktaṃ bhāvyatha mano'bhiyogena /
kusumairānandairvā bhāvanayā vāpi kevalayā // 104
meaning:
मूर्धतले विद्यात्रयमुक्तं भाव्यथ मनोऽभियोगेन /
कुसुमैरानन्दैर्वा भावनया वापि केवलया // 104
text_mt: On the crown of the head the triad of vidyās is proclaimed; one should then contemplate [them] through mental concentration, / or with flowers and bliss, or even through mere contemplation.

sanskrit_iast:
guruṇā tattvavidā kila śiṣyo yadi mokṣamātrakṛtahṛdayaḥ /
mokṣaikadānacaturā dīkṣā seyaṃ paropaniṣaduktā // 105
meaning:
गुरुणा तत्त्वविदा किल शिष्यो यदि मोक्षमात्रकृतहृदयः /
मोक्षैकदानचतुरा दीक्षा सेयं परोपनिषदुक्ता // 105
text_mt: By a guru who knows reality, indeed, if the disciple has set his heart solely on liberation, / this dīkṣā, adept at bestowing liberation alone, is declared in the supreme Upaniṣad.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddīkṣādīkṣita etadvidyātrayaṃ smaran hṛdaye /
bāhyārcādi vinaiva hi vrajati paraṃ dhāma dehānte // 106
meaning:
एतद्दीक्षादीक्षित एतद्विद्यात्रयं स्मरन् हृदये /
बाह्यार्चादि विनैव हि व्रजति परं धाम देहान्ते // 106
text_mt: Initiated by this dīkṣā, remembering this triad of vidyās in his heart, / even without external worship and the rest, he goes at the end of the body to the supreme abode.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavo māyā bindurvarṇatrayamāditaḥ kuryāt /
padapañcakasya saṃbodhanayuktasyāgnidayitānte // 107
meaning:
प्रणवो माया बिन्दुर्वर्णत्रयमादितः कुर्यात् /
पदपञ्चकस्य संबोधनयुक्तस्याग्निदयितान्ते // 107
text_mt: One should first utter the three phonemes: the praṇava, māyā, and the bindu; / of five words in the vocative case, ending with the wife of Agni [Svāhā]:

sanskrit_iast:
siddhasādhani tatpūrvaṃ śabdabrahmasvarūpiṇi /
samastabandhaśabdena sahitaṃ ca nikṛntani // 108
meaning:
सिद्धसाधनि तत्पूर्वं शब्दब्रह्मस्वरूपिणि /
समस्तबन्धशब्देन सहितं च निकृन्तनि // 108
text_mt: Siddhasādhani, preceded by ‘Tat’, Śabdabrahmasvarūpiṇi, / accompanied by the words Samastabandha, and Nikṛntani,

sanskrit_iast:
bodhani śivasadbhāvajananyāmantritaṃ ca tat /
pañcāṣṭarandhratryaṣṭārṇakrameṇa padapañcakam // 109
meaning:
बोधनि शिवसद्भावजनन्यामन्त्रितं च तत् /
पञ्चाष्टरन्ध्रत्र्यष्टार्णक्रमेण पदपञ्चकम् // 109
text_mt: Bodhani, and the vocative Śivasadbhāvajananī: / such is the five-word mantra, with words of five, eight, nine, three, and eight syllables in order.

sanskrit_iast:
khapañcārṇā parabrahmavidyeyaṃ mokṣadā śivā /
anuttarecche ghāntaśca satrayodaśasusvaraḥ // 110
meaning:
खपञ्चार्णा परब्रह्मविद्येयं मोक्षदा शिवा /
अनुत्तरेच्छे घान्तश्च सत्रयोदशसुस्वरः // 110
text_mt: This auspicious, fifty-syllable vidyā of the supreme Brahman bestows liberation: / The unexcelled [A], the will [I], and the letter ending with Gh [Ṅ], adorned with the thirteenth good vowel [O],

sanskrit_iast:
asya varṇatrayasyānte tvantaḥsthānāṃ catuṣṭayam /
vargādyaśvau tryasrabinduyuk pānto'rṇatrayādataḥ // 111
meaning:
अस्य वर्णत्रयस्यान्ते त्वन्तःस्थानां चतुष्टयम् /
वर्गाद्यश्वौ त्र्यस्रबिन्दुयुक् पान्तोऽर्णत्रयादतः // 111
text_mt: and at the end of these three phonemes, the four semivowels; / then the first of the vargas [K], the horse [S], united with the triangle [E] and bindu, followed by the letter ending with P [M], from these three phonemes;

sanskrit_iast:
mahāhāṭakaśabdādyamīśvarītyarṇasaptakam /
āmantritaṃ kṣamasveti tryarṇaṃ pāpāntakāriṇi // 112
meaning:
महाहाटकशब्दाद्यमीश्वरीत्यर्णसप्तकम् /
आमन्त्रितं क्षमस्वेति त्र्यर्णं पापान्तकारिणि // 112
text_mt: the seven-syllable phrase beginning with the word Mahāhāṭaka and ending with Īśvarī; / the three-syllable vocative Kṣamasva; then Pāpāntakāriṇi;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍarṇaṃ pāpaśabdādivimohanipadaṃ tataḥ /
pāpaṃ hana dhuna dvirdvirdaśārṇaṃ padamīdṛśam // 113
meaning:
षडर्णं पापशब्दादिविमोहनिपदं ततः /
पापं हन धुन द्विर्द्विर्दशार्णं पदमीदृशम् // 113
text_mt: the six-syllable phrase beginning with the word Pāpa, ending with Vimohani; / then ‘Pāpaṃ hana dhuna’ repeated twice, such being the ten-syllable phrase;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamyantaṃ ṣaḍarṇaṃ syādrudraśaktivaśāditi /
tata ekākṣaraṃ yattadvisargabrahma kīrtitam // 114
meaning:
पञ्चम्यन्तं षडर्णं स्याद्रुद्रशक्तिवशादिति /
तत एकाक्षरं यत्तद्विसर्गब्रह्म कीर्तितम् // 114
text_mt: then Rudraśaktivaśād, which is six syllables ending in the ablative case; / then the single syllable which is proclaimed as the emission-Brahman [Ḥ],

sanskrit_iast:
tadanackatakāreṇa sahaikībhāvataḥ paṭhet /
randhrābdhivarṇā vidyeyaṃ dīkṣāvidyeti kīrtitā // 115
meaning:
तदनच्कतकारेण सहैकीभावतः पठेत् /
रन्ध्राब्धिवर्णा विद्येयं दीक्षाविद्येति कीर्तिता // 115
text_mt: one should recite that fused with the vowel-less dental stop [T]; / this forty-nine-syllable vidyā is proclaimed as the Dīkṣāvidyā.

sanskrit_iast:
māyārṇañca pare brahme caturvidye padatrayam /
aṣṭārṇamatha pañcārṇaṃ yogadhāriṇisaṃjñitam // 116
meaning:
मायार्णञ्च परे ब्रह्मे चतुर्विद्ये पदत्रयम् /
अष्टार्णमथ पञ्चार्णं योगधारिणिसंज्ञितम् // 116
text_mt: The syllable of māyā [Hrīṃ], and ‘Pare Brahme Caturvidye’ as three words / of eight syllables; then a five-syllable word named Yogadhāriṇī;

sanskrit_iast:
ātmāntarātmaparamātmarūpaṃ ca padatrayam /
ekārāntaṃ bodhanasthaṃ daśārṇaṃ parikīrtitam // 117
meaning:
आत्मान्तरात्मपरमात्मरूपं च पदत्रयम् /
एकारान्तं बोधनस्थं दशार्णं परिकीर्तितम् // 117
text_mt: and three words in the forms Ātman, Antarātman, and Paramātman / ending with the letter E, situated before Bodhana, proclaimed as ten syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
rudraśaktīti vedārṇaṃ syādrudradayite'tha me /
pāpaṃ dahadahetyeṣā dvādaśārṇā catuṣpadī // 118
meaning:
रुद्रशक्तीति वेदार्णं स्याद्रुद्रदयितेऽथ मे /
पापं दहदहेत्येषा द्वादशार्णा चतुष्पदी // 118
text_mt: ‘Rudraśakti’ of four syllables, then ‘Rudradayite’, and then ‘me / pāpaṃ daha daha’: this has four words and twelve syllables;

sanskrit_iast:
saumye sadāśive yugmaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ bindviṣusāvahā /
sārdhavarṇacatuṣkaṃ tadityeṣā samayāpahā // 119
meaning:
सौम्ये सदाशिवे युग्मं षट्कं बिन्द्विषुसावहा /
सार्धवर्णचतुष्कं तदित्येषा समयापहा // 119
text_mt: ‘Saumye Sadāśive’ as a pair of six syllables; with the bindu, arrow [five], and breath [S], Vāhā / consisting of four and a half syllables; this vidyā destroys vows,

sanskrit_iast:
vidyā sārdhārṇakhaśarasaṃkhyā sā pārameśvarī /
etadvidyātrayaṃ śrīmadbhūtirājo nyarūpayat // 120
meaning:
विद्या सार्धार्णखशरसंख्या सा पारमेश्वरी /
एतद्विद्यात्रयं श्रीमद्भूतिराजो न्यरूपयत् // 120
text_mt: and consists of fifty and a half syllables, being the supreme goddess’s own. / This triad of vidyās was explained by the venerable Bhūtirāja,

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sākṣādabhajacchrīmāñśrīkaṇṭho mānuṣīṃ tanum /
atra vīryaṃ puraivoktaṃ sarvatrānusaredguruḥ // 121
meaning:
यः साक्षादभजच्छ्रीमाञ्श्रीकण्ठो मानुषीं तनुम् /
अत्र वीर्यं पुरैवोक्तं सर्वत्रानुसरेद्गुरुः // 121
text_mt: who was the illustrious Śrīkaṇṭha manifest in human form. / The vitality here has already been spoken of; the guru should apply it everywhere,

sanskrit_iast:
arthabījapraveśāntaruccārādyanusārataḥ /
nahi tatkiṃcanāpyasti yatpurā na nirūpitam // 122
meaning:
अर्थबीजप्रवेशान्तरुच्चाराद्यनुसारतः /
नहि तत्किंचनाप्यस्ति यत्पुरा न निरूपितम् // 122
text_mt: in accordance with the entry into the seed of meaning, internal recitation, and so forth. / For there is nothing whatsoever that has not been expounded before;

sanskrit_iast:
niṣphalā punaruktistu nāsmabhyaṃ jātu rocate /
ityevaṃ mantravidyādisvarūpamupavarṇitam // 123
meaning:
निष्फला पुनरुक्तिस्तु नास्मभ्यं जातु रोचते /
इत्येवं मन्त्रविद्यादिस्वरूपमुपवर्णितम् // 123
text_mt: we never take pleasure in useless repetition. / Thus the nature of mantras, vidyās, and the like has been fully described.

sanskrit_iast:
atha maṇḍalasadbhāvaḥ saṃkṣepeṇābhidhīyate /
sādhayitvā diśaṃ pūrvāṃ sūtramāsphālayetsamam // 1
meaning:
अथ मण्डलसद्भावः संक्षेपेणाभिधीयते /
साधयित्वा दिशं पूर्वां सूत्रमास्फालयेत्समम् // 1
text_mt: Now the true nature of the maṇḍala is set forth in brief: / Having determined the eastern direction, one should snap the cord straight.
title: Maṇḍalaprakāśana

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhayitvā madhyaprākpratīcīṣvaṅkayetpunaḥ /
tato'pyardhatadardhārdhamānataḥ pūrvapaścimau // 2
meaning:
तदर्धयित्वा मध्यप्राक्प्रतीचीष्वङ्कयेत्पुनः /
ततोऽप्यर्धतदर्धार्धमानतः पूर्वपश्चिमौ // 2
text_mt: Having halved it, one should mark the centre, east, and west again; / then, by the measure of half of that and half of that half, one should mark east and west.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkayettāvatā dadyāt sūtreṇa bhramayugmakam /
matsyasandhidvayaṃ tvevaṃ dakṣiṇottarayorbhavet // 3
meaning:
अङ्कयेत्तावता दद्यात् सूत्रेण भ्रमयुग्मकम् /
मत्स्यसन्धिद्वयं त्वेवं दक्षिणोत्तरयोर्भवेत् // 3
text_mt: With a cord of that measure, one should draw two circular sweeps; / thus two intersections forming fish figures will result on the south and the north.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmadhye pātayetsūtraṃ dakṣiṇottarasiddhaye /
yadi vā prākparāktulyasūtreṇottaradakṣiṇe // 4
meaning:
तन्मध्ये पातयेत्सूत्रं दक्षिणोत्तरसिद्धये /
यदि वा प्राक्पराक्तुल्यसूत्रेणोत्तरदक्षिणे // 4
text_mt: Between them one should drop a cord to establish the south and north; / or, with a cord equal to that between east and west, one should mark on the north and south

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkayedaparādaṅkāt pūrvādapi tathaiva te /
matsyamadhye kṣipetsūtramāyataṃ dakṣiṇottare // 5
meaning:
अङ्कयेदपरादङ्कात् पूर्वादपि तथैव ते /
मत्स्यमध्ये क्षिपेत्सूत्रमायतं दक्षिणोत्तरे // 5
text_mt: from the western mark, and likewise from the eastern mark; / between the fish figures one should cast the cord stretched south to north.

sanskrit_iast:
matakṣetrārdhamānena madhyāddikṣvaṅkayettataḥ /
sūtrābhyāṃ digdvayotthābhyāṃ matsyaḥ syātpratikoṇagaḥ // 6
meaning:
मतक्षेत्रार्धमानेन मध्याद्दिक्ष्वङ्कयेत्ततः /
सूत्राभ्यां दिग्द्वयोत्थाभ्यां मत्स्यः स्यात्प्रतिकोणगः // 6
text_mt: Then, by the measure of half the desired area, one should mark from the centre in the cardinal directions; / by two cords originating from pairs of cardinal points, a fish figure is produced at each corner.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyeṣu vedāḥ sūtrāṇītyevaṃ syāccaturasrakam /
ekasmātprabhṛti proktaṃ śatāntaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yataḥ // 7
meaning:
मत्स्येषु वेदाः सूत्राणीत्येवं स्याच्चतुरस्रकम् /
एकस्मात्प्रभृति प्रोक्तं शतान्तं मण्डलं यतः // 7
text_mt: At the fish figures are the four cords; thus a square is formed. / Since the maṇḍala is taught starting from one up to a hundred,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhātantre maṇḍalānāṃ śataṃ tatpīṭha ucyate /
yattanmadhyagataṃ mukhyaṃ maṇḍalānāṃ trayaṃ smṛtam // 8
meaning:
सिद्धातन्त्रे मण्डलानां शतं तत्पीठ उच्यते /
यत्तन्मध्यगतं मुख्यं मण्डलानां त्रयं स्मृतम् // 8
text_mt: a hundred maṇḍalas are described on that seat in the Siddhātantra, / of which the primary triad of maṇḍalas situated in their midst is remembered,

sanskrit_iast:
madhyaśūlaṃ tritriśūlaṃ navaśūlamiti sphuṭam /
tatra śūlavidhānaṃ yaduktaṃ bhedairanantakaiḥ // 9
meaning:
मध्यशूलं त्रित्रिशूलं नवशूलमिति स्फुटम् /
तत्र शूलविधानं यदुक्तं भेदैरनन्तकैः // 9
text_mt: clearly known as the central trident, the three-trident, and the nine-trident. / There, the procedure for the trident, which is taught with endless varieties,

sanskrit_iast:
tadyoni maṇḍalaṃ brūmaḥ sadbhāvakramadarśitam /
vedāśrite caturhaste tribhāgaṃ sarvatastyajet // 10
meaning:
तद्योनि मण्डलं ब्रूमः सद्भावक्रमदर्शितम् /
वेदाश्रिते चतुर्हस्ते त्रिभागं सर्वतस्त्यजेत् // 10
text_mt: is the matrix-maṇḍala which we now describe as shown in the sequence of the Sadbhāva: / In a four-cubit square, one should discard one third on every side;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ sarvaṃ tattatkṣetraṃ vibhājayet /
brahmasūtradvayasyātha madhyaṃ brahmapadaṃ sphuṭam // 11
meaning:
भागैः षोडशभिः सर्वं तत्तत्क्षेत्रं विभाजयेत् /
ब्रह्मसूत्रद्वयस्याथ मध्यं ब्रह्मपदं स्फुटम् // 11
text_mt: one should divide that entire field into sixteen parts. / Then, clearly taking the centre of the two central cords as the station of Brahman,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāvadhiṃ tato lakṣyaṃ caturthaṃ sūtramāditaḥ /
tatastiryagvrajet sūtraṃ caturthaṃ tadanantare // 12
meaning:
कृत्वावधिं ततो लक्ष्यं चतुर्थं सूत्रमादितः /
ततस्तिर्यग्व्रजेत् सूत्रं चतुर्थं तदनन्तरे // 12
text_mt: making it the limit, the fourth line is to be sighted from the beginning; / then the transverse line should run to the fourth one adjacent to it.

sanskrit_iast:
koṣṭhe cendudvayaṃ kuryādbahirbhāgārdhabhāgataḥ /
tayorlagnaṃ brahmasūtrāttṛtīye marmaṇi sthitam // 13
meaning:
कोष्ठे चेन्दुद्वयं कुर्याद्बहिर्भागार्धभागतः /
तयोर्लग्नं ब्रह्मसूत्रात्तृतीये मर्मणि स्थितम् // 13
text_mt: In the compartment, one should make two crescents from half a part on the outer side; / touching them, situated at the third intersection from the central cord,

sanskrit_iast:
koṣṭhakārdhe'paraṃ ceti yugmamantarmukhaṃ bhavet /
brahmasūtrāddvitīyasmin haste marmaṇi niścalam // 14
meaning:
कोष्ठकार्धेऽपरं चेति युग्ममन्तर्मुखं भवेत् /
ब्रह्मसूत्राद्द्वितीयस्मिन् हस्ते मर्मणि निश्चलम् // 14
text_mt: and another in half a compartment, a pair facing inwards will result. / Making [the compass] steady at the intersection on the second cubit from the central cord,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā pūrṇenduyugalaṃ vartayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ /
brahmasūtragatāt ṣaṣṭhāt tiryagbhāgāttṛtīyake // 15
meaning:
कृत्वा पूर्णेन्दुयुगलं वर्तयेत विचक्षणः /
ब्रह्मसूत्रगतात् षष्ठात् तिर्यग्भागात्तृतीयके // 15
text_mt: the wise practitioner should trace a pair of full circles. / From the sixth transverse section from that on the central cord, in the third,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvārdhakoṣṭhake sūtraṃ pūrṇacandrāgralambitam /
bhramayedunmukhaṃ khaṇḍacandrayugvahnibhāgagam // 16
meaning:
कृत्वार्धकोष्ठके सूत्रं पूर्णचन्द्राग्रलम्बितम् /
भ्रमयेदुन्मुखं खण्डचन्द्रयुग्वह्निभागगम् // 16
text_mt: placing the cord in the half-compartment, hanging from the front of the full circle, / one should sweep it facing upwards, reaching the fire [south-east] division, conjoined with a pair of crescent moons.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagbhāgadvayaṃ tyaktvā khaṇḍendoḥ paścimāttataḥ /
koṇaṃ yāvattathā syācca kuryāt khaṇḍaṃ bhramadvayam // 17
meaning:
तिर्यग्भागद्वयं त्यक्त्वा खण्डेन्दोः पश्चिमात्ततः /
कोणं यावत्तथा स्याच्च कुर्यात् खण्डं भ्रमद्वयम् // 17
text_mt: Leaving two transverse divisions, from the west of the crescent moon, / until the corner is reached, one should make two crescent sweeps in that manner.

sanskrit_iast:
sutīkṣṇakuṭilāgraṃ tadekaṃ śṛṅgaṃ prajāyate /
dvitīyasminnapi proktaḥ śṛṅga eṣa vidhiḥ sphuṭaḥ // 18
meaning:
सुतीक्ष्णकुटिलाग्रं तदेकं शृङ्गं प्रजायते /
द्वितीयस्मिन्नपि प्रोक्तः शृङ्ग एष विधिः स्फुटः // 18
text_mt: Thus a single prong is produced, having a very sharp and curved tip. / This same rule is clearly taught for the second prong as well.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyaśṛṅge'tha kartavye tṛtīye ūrdhvakoṣṭhake /
caturthārdhe ca candrārdhadvayamantarmukhaṃ bhavet // 19
meaning:
मध्यशृङ्गेऽथ कर्तव्ये तृतीये ऊर्ध्वकोष्ठके /
चतुर्थार्धे च चन्द्रार्धद्वयमन्तर्मुखं भवेत् // 19
text_mt: Now, when the central prong is to be made, in the third upper compartment / and in half of the fourth, two crescents should face inward,

sanskrit_iast:
tacca pūrṇendumekaṃ prāgvartitaṃ prāpnuyādyathā /
anyonyagranthiyogena baddhāratvaṃ prajāyate // 20
meaning:
तच्च पूर्णेन्दुमेकं प्राग्वर्तितं प्राप्नुयाद्यथा /
अन्योन्यग्रन्थियोगेन बद्धारत्वं प्रजायते // 20
text_mt: in such a way that they meet the one full circle traced earlier; / through their mutual knotting, unity is produced.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ dvitīyapārśve'sya khaṇḍendudvayavartanāt /
madhyābhyāṃ gaṇḍikā śliṣṭā parābhyāmagrato nayet // 21
meaning:
एवं द्वितीयपार्श्वेऽस्य खण्डेन्दुद्वयवर्तनात् /
मध्याभ्यां गण्डिका श्लिष्टा पराभ्यामग्रतो नयेत् // 21
text_mt:
In this way, on its second side, by drawing two crescents,
one should lead [the line] from the middle pair [so that] a segment is joined, and from the outer pair toward the front, // 21

sanskrit_iast:
sūtraṃ pārśvadvaye yena tīkṣṇaṃ syānmadhyaśṛṅgagam /
pārśvadvayādhare paścādbrahmasūtraṃ dvitīyakam // 22
meaning:
सूत्रं पार्श्वद्वये येन तीक्ष्णं स्यान्मध्यशृङ्गगम् /
पार्श्वद्वयाधरे पश्चाद्ब्रह्मसूत्रं द्वितीयकम् // 22
text_mt:
by which thread on both flanks the [prong] extending to the central prong becomes sharp.
Below the two flanks, behind, a second central thread // 22

sanskrit_iast:
avadhānena saṃgrāhyamācāryeṇohavedinā /
bhavetpaścānmukho mantrī tasmiṃśca brahmasūtrake // 23
meaning:
अवधानेन संग्राह्यमाचार्येणोहवेदिना /
भवेत्पश्चान्मुखो मन्त्री तस्मिंश्च ब्रह्मसूत्रके // 23
text_mt:
must be carefully apprehended by the master who understands deduction.
And on that central thread, the mantrin should face west. // 23

sanskrit_iast:
madhyaśṛṅgaṃ varjayitvā sarvaḥ pūrvodito vidhiḥ /
tato yadunmukhaṃ khaṇḍacandrayugmaṃ puroditam // 24
meaning:
मध्यशृङ्गं वर्जयित्वा सर्वः पूर्वोदितो विधिः /
ततो यदुन्मुखं खण्डचन्द्रयुग्मं पुरोदितम् // 24
text_mt:
Leaving aside the central prong, the entire procedure is as previously stated.
Then, from that upward-turned pair of crescents described before, // 24

sanskrit_iast:
tato dvayena kartavyā gaṇḍikāntaḥsusaṃgatā /
dvayenāgragasūtrābhyāṃ madhyaśṛṅgadvayaṃ bhavet // 25
meaning:
ततो द्वयेन कर्तव्या गण्डिकान्तःसुसंगता /
द्वयेनाग्रगसूत्राभ्यां मध्यशृङ्गद्वयं भवेत् // 25
text_mt:
by [the first] pair a segment well joined within is to be made;
by the [second] pair, through two threads extending to the front, the pair of central prongs is formed. // 25

sanskrit_iast:
adho bhāgavivṛddhyāsya padmaṃ vṛttacatuṣṭayam /
tataścakraṃ ṣoḍaśāraṃ dvādaśāraṃ dvidhātha tat // 26
meaning:
अधो भागविवृद्ध्यास्य पद्मं वृत्तचतुष्टयम् /
ततश्चक्रं षोडशारं द्वादशारं द्विधाथ तत् // 26
text_mt:
By expanding its lower part, [there is] a lotus [with] four concentric circles;
then a wheel of sixteen spokes, or of twelve spokes; or it is twofold. // 26

sanskrit_iast:
madhye kuleśvarīsthānaṃ vyoma vā tilakaṃ ca vā /
padmaṃ vātha ṣaḍaraṃ vā viyaddvādaśakaṃ ca vā // 27
meaning:
मध्ये कुलेश्वरीस्थानं व्योम वा तिलकं च वा /
पद्मं वाथ षडरं वा वियद्द्वादशकं च वा // 27
text_mt:
In the center is the seat of the Kuleśvarī, or the void, or a dot,
or a lotus, or a six-spoked [wheel], or a group of twelve voids. // 27

sanskrit_iast:
tritriśūle'tra saptāre śliṣṭamātreṇa madhyataḥ /
padmānāmatha cakrāṇāṃ vyomnāṃ vā saptakaṃ bhavet // 28
meaning:
त्रित्रिशूलेऽत्र सप्तारे श्लिष्टमात्रेण मध्यतः /
पद्मानामथ चक्राणां व्योम्नां वा सप्तकं भवेत् // 28
text_mt:
Here, in the three tridents having seven spokes, simply by joining from the center,
there may be a group of seven lotuses, or of wheels, or of voids, // 28

sanskrit_iast:
miśritaṃ vātha saṃkīrṇaṃ samāsavyāsabhedataḥ /
tataḥ kṣetrārdhamānena kṣetraṃ tatrādhikaṃ kṣipet // 29
meaning:
मिश्रितं वाथ संकीर्णं समासव्यासभेदतः /
ततः क्षेत्रार्धमानेन क्षेत्रं तत्राधिकं क्षिपेत् // 29
text_mt:
or mixed, or combined through distinctions of concise and expanded [arrangements].
Then, measuring half the field, one should project an additional field there. // 29

sanskrit_iast:
tatra daṇḍaḥ smṛto bhāgaḥ ṣaḍarāmalasārakaḥ /
sutīkṣṇāgraḥ suraktābhaḥ kṣaṇādāveśakārakaḥ // 30
meaning:
तत्र दण्डः स्मृतो भागः षडरामलसारकः /
सुतीक्ष्णाग्रः सुरक्ताभः क्षणादावेशकारकः // 30
text_mt:
There, the shaft is taught as a section, having the pure essence of six spokes,
with an exceedingly sharp tip, very reddish in hue, inducing possession in an instant. // 30

sanskrit_iast:
yā sā kuṇḍalinī devī taraṅgākhyā mahormiṇī /
sā ṣaḍaśreṇa kandākhye sthitā ṣaḍdevatātmikā // 31
meaning:
या सा कुण्डलिनी देवी तरङ्गाख्या महोर्मिणी /
सा षडश्रेण कन्दाख्ये स्थिता षड्देवतात्मिका // 31
text_mt:
That goddess Kuṇḍalinī, called Taraṅgā, possessing great waves,
she is situated in the [center] called Kanda in a hexagonal form, composed of six deities. // 31

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭabhāgaiśca vistīrṇo dīrghaścāpi tadardhataḥ /
tato dvārāṇi kāryāṇi citravartanayā kramāt // 32
meaning:
अष्टभागैश्च विस्तीर्णो दीर्घश्चापि तदर्धतः /
ततो द्वाराणि कार्याणि चित्रवर्तनया क्रमात् // 32
text_mt:
And it is eight units wide, and in length half of that.
Then the doors are to be constructed in sequence by variegated drawing: // 32

sanskrit_iast:
vedāśrāyatarūpāṇi yadivā vṛttamātrataḥ /
spaṣṭaśṛṅgamatho kuryādyadivā vaiparītyataḥ // 33
meaning:
वेदाश्रायतरूपाणि यदिवा वृत्तमात्रतः /
स्पष्टशृङ्गमथो कुर्याद्यदिवा वैपरीत्यतः // 33
text_mt:
having four-cornered, oblong shapes, or simply circular,
one should make the prong distinct, or conversely [reversed]. // 33

sanskrit_iast:
unmukhaṃ candrayugmaṃ vā bhaṅktvā kuryāccatuṣṭayam /
kuṭilo madhyataḥ spaṣṭo'dhomukhaḥ pārśvagaḥ sthitaḥ // 34
meaning:
उन्मुखं चन्द्रयुग्मं वा भङ्क्त्वा कुर्याच्चतुष्टयम् /
कुटिलो मध्यतः स्पष्टोऽधोमुखः पार्श्वगः स्थितः // 34
text_mt:
Or breaking the upward-turned pair of crescents, one may make four:
curved in the middle, distinct, downward-turned, located on the flanks, // 34

sanskrit_iast:
uttāno'rdho'samaḥ pūrṇaḥ śliṣṭo granthigatastathā /
candrasyetthaṃ dvādaśadhā vartanā bhramabhedinī // 35
meaning:
उत्तानोऽर्धोऽसमः पूर्णः श्लिष्टो ग्रन्थिगतस्तथा /
चन्द्रस्येत्थं द्वादशधा वर्तना भ्रमभेदिनी // 35
text_mt:
upward-facing, halved, uneven, full, joined, and situated at a knot.
Thus twelvefold is the drawing of the crescent that dispels confusion. // 35

sanskrit_iast:
antarbahirmukhatvena sā punardvividhā matā /
tadbhedānmaṇḍalānāṃ syādasaṅkhyo bhedavistaraḥ // 36
meaning:
अन्तर्बहिर्मुखत्वेन सा पुनर्द्विविधा मता /
तद्भेदान्मण्डलानां स्यादसङ्ख्यो भेदविस्तरः // 36
text_mt:
Moreover, through facing inward and outward, it is considered twofold.
From these variations there arises an innumerable multitude of maṇḍalas, // 36

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhavīthībahiarbhūmikaṇṭhakarṇakapolataḥ /
śobhopaśobhāsaṃbhedādguṇarekhāvikalpataḥ // 37
meaning:
पीठवीथीबहिअर्भूमिकण्ठकर्णकपोलतः /
शोभोपशोभासंभेदाद्गुणरेखाविकल्पतः // 37
text_mt:
due to the plinth, the pathway, the outer ground, the neck, the corners, and the cheeks,
due to the interplay of main and secondary ornaments, and due to options among the colored boundary lines, // 37

sanskrit_iast:
svastikadvitayādyaṣṭatayāparyantabhedataḥ /
bhāvābhāvavikalpena maṇḍalānāmanantatā // 38
meaning:
स्वस्तिकद्वितयाद्यष्टतयापर्यन्तभेदतः /
भावाभावविकल्पेन मण्डलानामनन्तता // 38
text_mt:
due to distinctions ranging from two svastikas up to eight,
and due to the presence or absence of options, the maṇḍalas are infinite. // 38

sanskrit_iast:
tato rajāṃsi deyāni yathāśobhānusārataḥ /
sindūraṃ rājavartaṃ ca khaṭikā ca sitottamā // 39
meaning:
ततो रजांसि देयानि यथाशोभानुसारतः /
सिन्दूरं राजवर्तं च खटिका च सितोत्तमा // 39
text_mt:
Then colored powders are to be applied according to proper beauty:
vermilion, lapis lazuli, and excellent white chalk. // 39

sanskrit_iast:
uttamāni rajāṃsīha devatātrayayogataḥ /
parā candrasamaprakhyā raktā devī parāparā // 40
meaning:
उत्तमानि रजांसीह देवतात्रययोगतः /
परा चन्द्रसमप्रख्या रक्ता देवी परापरा // 40
text_mt:
These are the highest powders here, corresponding to the triad of deities:
Parā resembles the moon, the goddess Parāparā is red, // 40

sanskrit_iast:
aparā sā parā kālī bhīṣaṇā caṇḍayoginī /
dṛṣṭvaitanmaṇḍalaṃ devyaḥ sarvā nṛtyanti sarvadā // 41
meaning:
अपरा सा परा काली भीषणा चण्डयोगिनी /
दृष्ट्वैतन्मण्डलं देव्यः सर्वा नृत्यन्ति सर्वदा // 41
text_mt:
and Aparā is that supreme Kālī, terrifying, the fierce yoginī.
Seeing this maṇḍala, all the goddesses dance constantly. // 41

sanskrit_iast:
anarcite'pyadīkṣeṇa dṛṣṭe dīkṣyeta mātṛbhiḥ /
kiṃvātibahunoktena tritriśūlārasaptakāḥ // 42
meaning:
अनर्चितेऽप्यदीक्षेण दृष्टे दीक्ष्येत मातृभिः /
किंवातिबहुनोक्तेन त्रित्रिशूलारसप्तकाः // 42
text_mt:
Even if uninitiated, one who sees it, even without worship, is initiated by the Mothers.
What need to say more? The seven spokes of the three tridents // 42

sanskrit_iast:
śūlayāgāḥ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇyevaṃ sārdhaśatadvayam /
yā sā devī parā śaktiḥ prāṇavāhā vyavasthitā // 43
meaning:
शूलयागाः षट् सहस्राण्येवं सार्धशतद्वयम् /
या सा देवी परा शक्तिः प्राणवाहा व्यवस्थिता // 43
text_mt:
are six thousand two hundred and fifty trident-sacrifices.
That goddess who is the supreme power, residing as the flow of the vital breath, // 43

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāntaḥ kuṇḍalākārā sā sākṣādatra vartitā /
tattvāni tattvadevyaśca viśvamasminpratiṣṭhitam // 44
meaning:
विश्वान्तः कुण्डलाकारा सा साक्षादत्र वर्तिता /
तत्त्वानि तत्त्वदेव्यश्च विश्वमस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितम् // 44
text_mt:
coiled within the universe, is directly drawn here.
The principles of reality, the deities of the principles, and the entire universe are established in this [maṇḍala]. // 44

sanskrit_iast:
atrordhve tantumātreṇa tisraḥ śūlāragāḥ sthitāḥ /
āsanatvena cecchādyā bhogamokṣaprasādhikāḥ // 45
meaning:
अत्रोर्ध्वे तन्तुमात्रेण तिस्रः शूलारगाः स्थिताः /
आसनत्वेन चेच्छाद्या भोगमोक्षप्रसाधिकाः // 45
text_mt:
Here, above, by the mere cord, the three [goddesses] are located on the trident tips;
and as the seat [stand] Will and the others, bestowing enjoyment and liberation. // 45

sanskrit_iast:
tāstu mokṣaikakāmasya śūlārāviddhamadhyakāḥ /
tasmādenaṃ mahāyāgaṃ mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ // 46
meaning:
तास्तु मोक्षैककामस्य शूलाराविद्धमध्यकाः /
तस्मादेनं महायागं महाविभवविस्तरैः // 46
text_mt:
For one whose sole desire is liberation, however, their centers are pierced by the trident's prongs.
Therefore, the wise person desiring prosperity or desiring liberation // 46

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedbhūtikāmo vā mokṣakāmo'pivā budhaḥ /
asya darśanamātreṇa bhūtavetālaguhyakāḥ // 47
meaning:
पूजयेद्भूतिकामो वा मोक्षकामोऽपिवा बुधः /
अस्य दर्शनमात्रेण भूतवेतालगुह्यकाः // 47
text_mt:
should worship this great sacrifice with extensive and great riches.
By the mere sight of this, spirits, vetālas, and guhyakas // 47

sanskrit_iast:
palāyante daśa diśaḥ śivaḥ sākṣātprasīdati /
mandaśaktibalāviddho'pyetanmaṇḍalapūjanāt // 48
meaning:
पलायन्ते दश दिशः शिवः साक्षात्प्रसीदति /
मन्दशक्तिबलाविद्धोऽप्येतन्मण्डलपूजनात् // 48
text_mt:
flee into the ten directions, and Śiva becomes visibly gracious.
Even one affected by weak power, by worshiping this maṇḍala // 48

sanskrit_iast:
satataṃ māsaṣaṭkena trikajñānaṃ samaśnute /
yatprāpya heyopādeyaṃ svayameva vicārya saḥ // 49
meaning:
सततं मासषट्केन त्रिकज्ञानं समश्नुते /
यत्प्राप्य हेयोपादेयं स्वयमेव विचार्य सः // 49
text_mt:
continually for six months attains the knowledge of the Trika.
Having attained that, discerning on his own what is to be abandoned and what is to be embraced, // 49

sanskrit_iast:
dehānte syādbhairavātmā siddhikāmo'tha siddhyati /
maṇḍalasyāsya yo vyāptiṃ devatānyāsameva ca // 50
meaning:
देहान्ते स्याद्भैरवात्मा सिद्धिकामोऽथ सिद्ध्यति /
मण्डलस्यास्य यो व्याप्तिं देवतान्यासमेव च // 50
text_mt:
at the end of the body he becomes of the nature of Bhairava, or if desiring spiritual accomplishments, he succeeds.
He who knows the pervasion of this maṇḍala, the installation of its deities, // 50

sanskrit_iast:
vartanāṃ ca vijānāti sa gurustrikaśāsane /
tasya pādarajo mūrdhni dhāryaṃ śivasamīhinā // 51
meaning:
वर्तनां च विजानाति स गुरुस्त्रिकशासने /
तस्य पादरजो मूर्ध्नि धार्यं शिवसमीहिना // 51
text_mt:
and its drawing, is a guru in the Trika teaching;
the dust of his feet should be placed upon the head by one who aspires to Śiva. // 51

sanskrit_iast:
atra sṛṣṭisthitidhvaṃsān kramāt trīnapi pūjayet /
turyaṃ tu madhyato yadvā sarveṣu paripūrakam // 52
meaning:
अत्र सृष्टिस्थितिध्वंसान् क्रमात् त्रीनपि पूजयेत् /
तुर्यं तु मध्यतो यद्वा सर्वेषु परिपूरकम् // 52
text_mt:
Here one should worship in succession the three: emanation, stasis, and dissolution;
or the fourth in the center, which fills all [three]. // 52

sanskrit_iast:
catustriśūlaṃ vā guptadaṇḍaṃ yāgaṃ samācaret /
tatra tat pūjayetsamyak sphuṭaṃ kramacatuṣṭayam // 53
meaning:
चतुस्त्रिशूलं वा गुप्तदण्डं यागं समाचरेत् /
तत्र तत् पूजयेत्सम्यक् स्फुटं क्रमचतुष्टयम् // 53
text_mt:
Or one may perform the sacrifice [having] four tridents or a hidden shaft;
there one should properly worship that distinct fourfold cycle. // 53

sanskrit_iast:
ityetatkathitaṃ gupte ṣaḍardhahṛdaye pare /
ṣaṭke proktaṃ sūcitaṃ śrīsiddhayogīśvarīmate // 54
meaning:
इत्येतत्कथितं गुप्ते षडर्धहृदये परे /
षट्के प्रोक्तं सूचितं श्रीसिद्धयोगीश्वरीमते // 54
text_mt:
Thus this has been taught in the secret, supreme Heart of the Trika,
